-- -1, built from text at runtime. MoonVeil miscompiles `a - b * c` (and flips some negative
-- constants), so that math is written `a + b * c * NEG_ONE` instead.
local NEG_ONE = tonumber("-1")

-- LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE (MoonVeil's alias for MV_OMIT_FUNCTION) keeps a function out of the obfuscator's
-- VM; the per-frame ESP and chams code is wrapped in it, since running it virtualized lagged the
-- game. The obfuscator swaps the macro out at build time; unobfuscated, this makes it a no-op.
-- The name is built from two pieces so the obfuscator doesn't see the macro here. (This used to be
-- a loadstring of a string; the obfuscated build passed loadstring an Instance instead and stopped
-- with "invalid argument #1 to 'loadstring' (string expected, got Instance)".)
do
	local env = getfenv()
	local macro = "LPH_" .. "NO_VIRTUALIZE"
	if not env[macro] then
		env[macro] = function(fn)
			return fn
		end
	end
end

-- Executor compatibility. Other executors (Volt, Solara, Xeno, ...) name some functions
-- differently or leave them out; a missing one used to stop the script before the menu loaded.
-- Each one falls back to its other common names, then to a safe stand-in.
do
	local noop = function() end

	getgenv = getgenv or function()
		return _G
	end
	request = request or http_request or (syn and syn.request) or (http and http.request) or (fluxus and fluxus.request)
	if not request then
		-- GET only, through HttpGet.
		request = function(options)
			local ok, body = pcall(game.HttpGet, game, options.Url)
			return { Success = ok, StatusCode = ok and 200 or 0, Body = ok and body or "" }
		end
	end
	setclipboard = setclipboard or toclipboard or set_clipboard or (Clipboard and Clipboard.set) or noop
	getcustomasset = getcustomasset or getsynasset
	makefolder = makefolder or noop
	isfolder = isfolder or function()
		return false
	end
	isfile = isfile or function()
		return false
	end
	writefile = writefile or noop
	appendfile = appendfile or noop
	delfile = delfile or noop
	readfile = readfile or function()
		return ""
	end
	listfiles = listfiles or function()
		return {}
	end
	newcclosure = newcclosure or function(callback)
		return callback
	end
	checkcaller = checkcaller or function()
		return false
	end
	isexecutorclosure = isexecutorclosure or is_synapse_function or iskrnlclosure or function()
		return false
	end
	getconnections = getconnections or get_signal_cons or function()
		return {}
	end
	cloneref = cloneref or function(instance)
		return instance
	end
	identifyexecutor = identifyexecutor or getexecutorname or function()
		return "Unknown", ""
	end
	setthreadidentity = setthreadidentity or set_thread_identity or (syn and syn.set_thread_identity) or setidentity or noop
	getthreadidentity = getthreadidentity or get_thread_identity or (syn and syn.get_thread_identity) or getidentity or function()
		return 8
	end
	gethiddenproperty = gethiddenproperty or function(instance, property)
		local ok, value = pcall(function()
			return instance[property]
		end)
		return ok and value or nil, false
	end
	sethiddenproperty = sethiddenproperty or function(instance, property, value)
		pcall(function()
			instance[property] = value
		end)
		return false
	end
	isnetworkowner = isnetworkowner or function(part)
		-- ReceiveAge is 0 for parts this client simulates.
		local ok, age = pcall(function()
			return part.ReceiveAge
		end)
		return ok and age == 0
	end
	setsimulationradius = setsimulationradius or function(radius)
		local player = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer
		pcall(sethiddenproperty, player, "SimulationRadius", radius)
		pcall(sethiddenproperty, player, "MaxSimulationRadius", radius)
	end
	firetouchinterest = firetouchinterest or noop
	setnamecallmethod = setnamecallmethod or noop
	getnamecallmethod = getnamecallmethod or function()
		return ""
	end
	-- hookmetamethod built from the raw metatable when it's missing.
	if not hookmetamethod and getrawmetatable then
		local makeWritable = setreadonly and function(meta)
			setreadonly(meta, false)
		end or make_writeable or noop
		hookmetamethod = function(object, method, hook)
			local meta = getrawmetatable(object)
			local original = meta[method]
			pcall(makeWritable, meta)
			meta[method] = hook
			return original
		end
	end
	hookmetamethod = hookmetamethod or function(object, method)
		local ok, meta = pcall(getrawmetatable or getmetatable, object)
		return ok and type(meta) == "table" and meta[method] or noop
	end

	-- Drawing: some executors have none, others are missing shapes (Triangle). Anything that
	-- can't be made becomes an invisible stand-in instead of an error.
	local realDrawing = Drawing
	local function standIn()
		return setmetatable({}, {
			__index = function(_, key)
				if key == "Remove" or key == "Destroy" then
					return noop
				end
				return nil
			end,
			__newindex = noop,
		})
	end
	Drawing = {
		-- Whether real Drawing objects exist (ESP tracers use them then; they're much cheaper
		-- to move every frame than rotated gui frames).
		real = realDrawing ~= nil,
		Fonts = (realDrawing and realDrawing.Fonts) or { UI = 0, System = 1, Plex = 2, Monospace = 3 },
		new = function(kind)
			if realDrawing then
				local ok, object = pcall(realDrawing.new, kind)
				if ok and object then
					return object
				end
			end
			return standIn()
		end,
	}

	-- The UI library is loaded with loadstring and reads the executor's shared globals, so the
	-- stand-ins go there too (only where the executor has nothing of its own).
	local shared = getgenv()
	local provided = {
		request = request, setclipboard = setclipboard, getcustomasset = getcustomasset,
		makefolder = makefolder, isfolder = isfolder, isfile = isfile, writefile = writefile,
		appendfile = appendfile, delfile = delfile, readfile = readfile, listfiles = listfiles,
		newcclosure = newcclosure, checkcaller = checkcaller, isexecutorclosure = isexecutorclosure,
		getconnections = getconnections, cloneref = cloneref, identifyexecutor = identifyexecutor,
		setthreadidentity = setthreadidentity, getthreadidentity = getthreadidentity,
		gethiddenproperty = gethiddenproperty, sethiddenproperty = sethiddenproperty,
		isnetworkowner = isnetworkowner, setsimulationradius = setsimulationradius,
		firetouchinterest = firetouchinterest, setnamecallmethod = setnamecallmethod,
		getnamecallmethod = getnamecallmethod, hookmetamethod = hookmetamethod,
	}
	for name, value in pairs(provided) do
		pcall(function()
			if shared[name] == nil then
				shared[name] = value
			end
		end)
	end
end

---Download text. Pastebin (and sometimes GitHub) answers "HTTP 403" to some executors,
---mobile ones especially, which stopped the whole script; a refused download is retried
---looking like a browser before giving up with a clear message.
---@param url string
---@return string
local function fetchText(url)
	local ok, body = pcall(game.HttpGet, game, url)
	if ok and type(body) == "string" and #body > 0 then
		return body
	end
	local firstError = body
	local okRequest, response = pcall(request, {
		Url = url,
		Method = "GET",
		Headers = {
			["User-Agent"] = "Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/124.0 Safari/537.36",
			["Accept"] = "text/plain, */*",
		},
	})
	if okRequest and type(response) == "table" and response.Body and #response.Body > 0
		and (response.StatusCode == nil or response.StatusCode < 400) then
		return response.Body
	end
	local status = okRequest and type(response) == "table" and response.StatusCode or tostring(firstError)
	error("[aqua labs] couldn't download " .. url .. " (" .. tostring(status) .. "). Try again in a minute.", 0)
end

---Compile and run downloaded code. loadstring returns nil when it can't compile something
---(for example an error page instead of code), and calling that nil was the bare
---":1: attempt to call a nil value"; this says what failed and why instead.
---@param source string
---@param name string
local function runCode(source, name)
	if type(loadstring) ~= "function" then
		error("[aqua labs] this executor has no loadstring, so " .. name .. " can't load.", 0)
	end
	if type(source) ~= "string" then
		error("[aqua labs] couldn't load " .. name .. ": the download gave " .. typeof(source) .. ", not text.", 0)
	end
	local chunk, compileError = loadstring(source, "=" .. name)
	if not chunk then
		error("[aqua labs] couldn't load " .. name .. ": " .. tostring(compileError), 0)
	end
	return chunk()
end


-- Services.
local playersService = game:GetService("Players")
local runService = game:GetService("RunService")
local userInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local httpService = game:GetService("HttpService")
local marketplaceService = game:GetService("MarketplaceService")
local localizationService = game:GetService("LocalizationService")
local teleportService = game:GetService("TeleportService")
local lightingService = game:GetService("Lighting")
-- Every GUI the script makes lives in CoreGui (each still needs its own ScreenGui to draw).
local coreGui = game:GetService("CoreGui")
local tweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")

-- Lifecycle: the newest execution always wins. It shuts the previous copy down completely
-- (UI, loops, effects, hooks), and an older copy that's still loading stops itself.
local RUN_ID = {}
local worldCleanupTasks = {}
local shuttingDown = false
local library = nil
local originalUnload = nil

---Register cleanup for a feature. Every feature that creates instances, loops, hooks or
---changes game state should add one here, so Unload (or re-running) stops it entirely.
---@param callback function
local function onUnload(callback)
	table.insert(worldCleanupTasks, callback)
end

---Whether this copy of the script is still the active one.
---@return boolean
local function isCurrentRun()
	return getgenv().AquaLabsRunId == RUN_ID and not shuttingDown
end

---Stop everything this copy started, newest first, then remove the UI.
local function shutdown()
	if shuttingDown then
		return
	end

	shuttingDown = true

	if getgenv().AquaLabsRunId == RUN_ID then
		getgenv().AquaLabsRunId = nil
	end

	for index = #worldCleanupTasks, 1, -1 do
		pcall(worldCleanupTasks[index])
	end

	if library and originalUnload and library.gui and library.gui.Parent then
		pcall(originalUnload, library)
	end

	if getgenv().potentCleanup == shutdown then
		getgenv().potentCleanup = nil
	end
end

-- Shut down whatever copy is already running, then claim the active slot.
if getgenv().potentCleanup then
	pcall(getgenv().potentCleanup)
end

getgenv().AquaLabsRunId = RUN_ID
getgenv().potentCleanup = shutdown

-- Sweep any tagged leftovers from older runs that never cleaned up.
for _, child in ipairs(coreGui:GetChildren()) do
	if child:GetAttribute("AquaLabs") then
		child:Destroy()
	end
end

---The aqua labs "A", drawn from frames so it takes any color (the theme accent) and can't be
---broken by obfuscators: legs, apex cap and crossbar placed by scale with fixed rotations.
---@param parent GuiObject a square frame to draw into
---@param color Color3
---@return table frames to recolor later
local function drawLogoA(parent, color)
	local frames = {}
	for _, piece in ipairs({
		{ 0.34, 0.52, 0.2, 0.93, 20 },
		{ 0.66, 0.52, 0.2, 0.93, 340 },
		{ 0.5, 0.11, 0.34, 0.14, 0 },
		{ 0.5, 0.66, 0.42, 0.13, 0 },
	}) do
		local frame = Instance.new("Frame")
		frame.Name = ""
		frame.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
		frame.Position = UDim2.fromScale(piece[1], piece[2])
		frame.Size = UDim2.fromScale(piece[3], piece[4])
		frame.Rotation = piece[5]
		frame.BorderSizePixel = 0
		frame.BackgroundColor3 = color
		frame.ZIndex = parent.ZIndex + 1
		frame.Parent = parent
		table.insert(frames, frame)
	end
	return frames
end

-- Intro: a loader panel drawn in the same style as the menu, shown while the script builds.
local Intro = {
	startedAt = os.clock(),
	progress = 0,
	target = 0,
	DURATION = 3,
	ACCENT = Color3.fromRGB(100, 100, 255),
}

do
	local tweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
	local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
	local codeFont = Font.fromEnum(Enum.Font.Code)

	local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
	gui.Name = ""
	gui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
	gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
	gui.DisplayOrder = 1000
	gui:SetAttribute("AquaLabs", true)
	gui.Parent = coreGui
	Intro.gui = gui

	---Small helper for building the intro's instances.
	local function make(className, properties)
		local instance = Instance.new(className)
		for key, value in pairs(properties) do
			instance[key] = value
		end
		return instance
	end

	-- One CanvasGroup so the whole panel fades in and out together.
	local holder = make("CanvasGroup", {
		Parent = gui,
		AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
		Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 10),
		Size = UDim2.fromOffset(360, 134),
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		GroupTransparency = 1,
	})
	make("UIScale", {
		Parent = holder,
		Scale = math.clamp(math.min(camera.ViewportSize.X / 440, camera.ViewportSize.Y / 260), 0.6, 1.25),
	})

	-- Outer border, inner panel and content box, matching the menu's layering.
	local outer = make("Frame", {
		Parent = holder,
		Position = UDim2.fromOffset(1, 1),
		Size = UDim2.new(1, -2, 1, -2),
		BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40, 40, 40),
		BorderColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0),
	})
	local accentLine = make("Frame", {
		Parent = outer,
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 2),
		BorderSizePixel = 0,
		BackgroundColor3 = Intro.ACCENT,
		ZIndex = 3,
	})
	local inner = make("Frame", {
		Parent = outer,
		Position = UDim2.fromOffset(3, 5),
		Size = UDim2.new(1, -6, 1, -8),
		BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(26, 26, 26),
		BorderColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(57, 57, 57),
	})
	local content = make("Frame", {
		Parent = inner,
		Position = UDim2.fromOffset(5, 22),
		Size = UDim2.new(1, -10, 1, -27),
		BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(22, 22, 22),
		BorderSizePixel = 0,
	})
	make("UIStroke", { Parent = content, Color = Color3.fromRGB(57, 57, 57), LineJoinMode = Enum.LineJoinMode.Miter })

	local labels = {}

	---Text in the menu's font and size.
	local function label(parent, properties)
		local object = make("TextLabel", {
			Parent = parent,
			BackgroundTransparency = 1,
			FontFace = codeFont,
			TextSize = 12,
			TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(170, 170, 170),
			TextStrokeTransparency = 0.5,
			TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
			RichText = true,
		})
		for key, value in pairs(properties) do
			object[key] = value
		end
		table.insert(labels, object)
		return object
	end

	local title = label(inner, { Position = UDim2.fromOffset(6, 3), Size = UDim2.new(1, -12, 0, 16), Text = "" })
	local gameLabel = label(inner, {
		Position = UDim2.fromOffset(6, 3),
		Size = UDim2.new(1, -12, 0, 16),
		Text = "",
		TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right,
		TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(90, 90, 90),
	})

	local status = label(content, { Position = UDim2.fromOffset(8, 6), Size = UDim2.new(1, -16, 0, 14), Text = "starting" })

	-- Loading button filling up with water: two rolling wave layers (a dim one behind for
	-- depth) rising from the bottom, clipped to the rounded box, with small bubbles rising
	-- through it, a glassy shine on top, and the percent in the middle.
	local track = make("Frame", {
		Parent = content,
		Position = UDim2.fromOffset(9, 24),
		Size = UDim2.new(1, -18, 0, 34),
		BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(12, 16, 26),
		BorderSizePixel = 0,
	})
	make("UICorner", { Parent = track, CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8) })
	make("UIStroke", { Parent = track, Color = Color3.fromRGB(60, 150, 235), Thickness = 1, Transparency = 0.45 })

	-- The water: a body (deep blue at the bottom, brighter toward the top) with a wavy surface
	-- of thin columns on top, each column foamy at its tip, and a dimmer wave behind it that
	-- rolls the other way. Colors are set on the frames themselves.
	local WATER_SURFACE = Color3.fromRGB(56, 160, 245)
	local WATER_DEEP = Color3.fromRGB(10, 52, 160)
	local WATER_FOAM = Color3.fromRGB(175, 232, 255)
	local water = make("Frame", {
		Parent = track,
		Position = UDim2.fromOffset(1, 1),
		Size = UDim2.new(1, -2, 1, -2),
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		ClipsDescendants = true,
		ZIndex = 2,
	})
	local waterBody = make("Frame", {
		Parent = water,
		AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 1),
		Position = UDim2.fromScale(0, 1),
		Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 0),
		BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1),
		BorderSizePixel = 0,
		ZIndex = 3,
	})
	make("UICorner", { Parent = waterBody, CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 7) })
	make("UIGradient", { Parent = waterBody, Rotation = 90, Color = ColorSequence.new(WATER_SURFACE, WATER_DEEP) })

	local COLUMNS = 60
	local COLUMN_WIDTH = tonumber("0.0166667")
	---One row of surface columns.
	local function waveRow(color, transparency, zIndex, foam)
		local columns = {}
		for index = 1, COLUMNS do
			local column = make("Frame", {
				Parent = water,
				AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 1),
				Position = UDim2.fromScale((index + NEG_ONE) * COLUMN_WIDTH, 1),
				Size = UDim2.new(COLUMN_WIDTH, 1, 0, 0),
				BackgroundColor3 = color,
				BackgroundTransparency = transparency,
				BorderSizePixel = 0,
				ZIndex = zIndex,
			})
			if foam then
				make("UIGradient", {
					Parent = column,
					Rotation = 90,
					Color = ColorSequence.new({
						ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, WATER_FOAM),
						ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.45, color),
						ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, color),
					}),
				})
			end
			columns[index] = column
		end
		return { columns = columns }
	end
	local backWater = waveRow(Color3.fromRGB(28, 105, 205), 0.3, 2, false)
	local frontWater = waveRow(WATER_SURFACE, 0, 3, true)

	-- Bubbles drifting up through the water, each on its own loop.
	local bubbles = {}
	for index = 1, 7 do
		local bubble = make("Frame", {
			Parent = water,
			ZIndex = 4,
			AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
			Size = UDim2.fromOffset(3 + index % 3, 3 + index % 3),
			BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1),
			BackgroundTransparency = 0.45,
			BorderSizePixel = 0,
		})
		make("UICorner", { Parent = bubble, CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0) })
		bubbles[index] = { frame = bubble, x = (index * 0.137 + 0.06) % 1, speed = 0.35 + (index % 4) * 0.12, phase = index * 0.61 }
	end

	-- Glassy shine across the top half of the button.
	local shine = make("Frame", {
		Parent = track,
		Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 0.5),
		BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1),
		BackgroundTransparency = 0,
		BorderSizePixel = 0,
		ZIndex = 4,
	})
	make("UICorner", { Parent = shine, CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8) })
	make("UIGradient", {
		Parent = shine,
		Rotation = 90,
		Transparency = NumberSequence.new({ NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.86), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1) }),
	})
	local percent = label(track, {
		Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1),
		Text = "0%",
		TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center,
		TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1),
		TextStrokeTransparency = 0.2,
		ZIndex = 5,
	})

	local discord = label(content, {
		Position = UDim2.fromOffset(8, 64),
		Size = UDim2.new(1, -16, 0, 14),
		Text = "discord.gg/GMGXHMJSJt",
		TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(90, 90, 90),
	})

	-- Script logo in the bottom-right corner, sized to the card.
	-- Numeric asset id kept as a local so obfuscators don't break the string concat.
	local logoAssetId = "126991906779623"
	make("ImageLabel", {
		Parent = content,
		AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 1),
		Position = UDim2.new(1, -6, 1, -4),
		Size = UDim2.fromOffset(30, 30),
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Fit,
		Image = "rbxassetid://" .. logoAssetId,
	})

	---Redraw the title with the current accent.
	local function refreshTitle()
		title.Text = string.format('<font color="#%s">aqua labs</font>', Intro.ACCENT:ToHex())
	end
	refreshTitle()

	task.spawn(function()
		local success, info = pcall(function()
			return game:GetService("MarketplaceService"):GetProductInfo(game.PlaceId)
		end)
		gameLabel.Text = success and info.Name or ""
	end)

	---Switch to the menu's font and accent once the library has loaded.
	function Intro.applyTheme(fontFace, accent)
		if fontFace then
			for _, object in ipairs(labels) do
				object.FontFace = fontFace
			end
		end
		if accent then
			Intro.ACCENT = accent
			accentLine.BackgroundColor3 = accent
			refreshTitle()
		end
	end

	local quick = TweenInfo.new(0.3, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
	tweenService:Create(holder, quick, { GroupTransparency = 0, Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5) }):Play()

	-- Ease the water level toward the current step, with the surface rolling: two sine waves
	-- moving in opposite directions per layer, calmer as the button fills to the top.
	Intro.connection = runService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(deltaTime)
		Intro.progress += (Intro.target - Intro.progress) * math.min(deltaTime * 6, 1)
		local level = Intro.progress
		local height = water.AbsoluteSize.Y
		local base = height * level
		local now = os.clock()
		local calm = level > 0.96 and math.max((1 + NEG_ONE * level) * 25, 0) or 1
		local amplitude = (level > 0.01 and 2.2 or 0) * calm
		-- The body stops just under the lowest trough; the columns draw the surface above it.
		local bodyHeight = math.max(base + NEG_ONE * amplitude * 1.6, 0)
		waterBody.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, bodyHeight)
		local columnBottom = math.max(bodyHeight + NEG_ONE * 2, 0)

		local function roll(layer, speed, offset, lift)
			for index, column in ipairs(layer.columns) do
				local x = index * 0.21
				local wave = math.sin(x + now * speed + offset) * amplitude
					+ math.sin(x * 2.3 + NEG_ONE * now * speed * 1.6 + offset) * amplitude * 0.45
				local columnHeight = level > 0.001 and math.max(base + wave + lift + NEG_ONE * columnBottom, 0) or 0
				column.Position = UDim2.new((index + NEG_ONE) * COLUMN_WIDTH, 0, 1, NEG_ONE * columnBottom)
				column.Size = UDim2.new(COLUMN_WIDTH, 1, 0, columnHeight)
			end
		end
		roll(backWater, 1.7, 1.3, 1.5)
		roll(frontWater, 2.4, 0, 0)

		-- Bubbles rise from the floor to just under the surface, then start over.
		for _, bubble in ipairs(bubbles) do
			local cycle = (now * bubble.speed + bubble.phase) % 1
			local y = height + NEG_ONE * cycle * math.max(base + NEG_ONE * 4, 0)
			bubble.frame.Visible = base > 8
			bubble.frame.Position = UDim2.new(bubble.x + math.sin(now * 2 + bubble.phase * 5) * 0.01, 0, 0, y)
			bubble.frame.BackgroundTransparency = 0.35 + cycle * 0.5
		end
		percent.Text = string.format("%d%%", math.floor(Intro.progress * 100 + 0.5))
	end)

	---Show a loading step and give it a moment on screen.
	---@param text string
	---@param fraction number
	function Intro.step(text, fraction)
		status.Text = text
		Intro.target = fraction
		task.wait(0.25)

		-- A newer execution took over while this one was loading: undo what we built and stop.
		if not isCurrentRun() then
			shutdown()
			error("[aqua labs] replaced by a newer execution", 0)
		end
	end

	---Finish the bar, hold briefly, fade out, then run `onDone`.
	---@param onDone function
	function Intro.finish(onDone)
		Intro.step("ready", 1)

		local remaining = Intro.DURATION - 0.3 - (os.clock() - Intro.startedAt)
		if remaining > 0 then
			task.wait(remaining)
		end

		local fade = TweenInfo.new(0.3, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint, Enum.EasingDirection.In)
		tweenService:Create(holder, fade, { GroupTransparency = 1, Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, -10) }):Play()

		task.wait(0.15)
		pcall(onDone)
		task.wait(0.2)
		Intro.destroy()
	end

	---Remove the intro immediately (also used if the script errors or is re-run).
	function Intro.destroy()
		if Intro.connection then
			Intro.connection:Disconnect()
			Intro.connection = nil
		end

		if gui.Parent then
			gui:Destroy()
		end
	end

	onUnload(Intro.destroy)
end

	game.Loaded:Wait()

local librarySource = fetchText("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/i77lhm/vaderpaste/refs/heads/main/library.lua")

-- Performance patches for vaderpaste:
-- 1) Color pickers start with `selected = normal` (an undefined global, so nil). Their loop then
--    re-applies the color and fires the callback every single frame for every picker.
-- 2) Its `while true do` animation loops never stop, so each re-run leaks more threads.
-- Wrapped in parentheses so only the text comes back (gsub also returns a count, and the
-- obfuscated build mixes up multiple return values).
librarySource = (librarySource:gsub("local selected = normal", 'local selected = "normal"', 1))
librarySource = (librarySource:gsub("while true do", "while library and library.gui and library.gui.Parent do"))
-- The UI library goes in CoreGui too, even if a newer version switches to gethui().
librarySource = (librarySource:gsub("gethui%(%s*%)", 'game:GetService("CoreGui")'))

---Replace the first plain-text `old` after `anchor` (no Lua patterns involved).
local function patchSource(anchor, old, new)
	local anchorAt = string.find(librarySource, anchor, 1, true)
	local at = anchorAt and string.find(librarySource, old, anchorAt, true)
	if at then
		librarySource = string.sub(librarySource, 1, at - 1) .. new .. string.sub(librarySource, at + #old)
	end
end

-- 3) Slider values hung under the bar at the fill's edge (off the text line). Put them
--    right-aligned on the slider's name row instead.
local VALUE_ANCHOR = 'local VALUE_TEXT = library:create("TextLabel", {'
patchSource(VALUE_ANCHOR, "Parent = fill_inline,", "Parent = slider_inline, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right, ZIndex = 3,")
patchSource(VALUE_ANCHOR, "Size = UDim2.new(0, 1, 0, 11),", "Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 12),")
patchSource(VALUE_ANCHOR, "Position = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 1),", "Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, -14),")

-- 8) Dragging the menu lagged the game (about 64ms a frame): every dropdown and keybind (~250)
--    moved its hidden popup each time the menu moved. Popups now only follow while open, and
--    snap into place when they open.
-- The follow handlers aren't connected at all (even an empty callback, 250 times a frame,
-- still cost ~15ms); the open popup is closed when a drag starts instead.
patchSource(
	"function library:dropdown(properties)",
	'dropdown_inline:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsolutePosition"):Connect(function()',
	"local _ = (function(handler) return handler end)(function()"
)
patchSource(
	"function library:keybind(properties)",
	'keybind:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsolutePosition"):Connect(function()',
	"local _ = (function(handler) return handler end)(function()"
)
patchSource(
	"function library:dropdown(properties)",
	"content_inline.Visible = bool",
	"content_inline.Visible = bool if bool then content_inline.Position = UDim2.new(0, dropdown_inline.AbsolutePosition.X, 0, dropdown_inline.AbsolutePosition.Y + dropdown_inline.AbsoluteSize.Y + 2) end"
)
patchSource(
	"function library:keybind(properties)",
	"content_inline.Visible = bool",
	"content_inline.Visible = bool if bool then content_inline.Position = UDim2.new(0, keybind.AbsolutePosition.X, 0, keybind.AbsolutePosition.Y + 15) end"
)

-- 12) Backspace clears a keybind (the library only did that for Escape).
patchSource(
	"function library:keybind(properties)",
	'input = input.Name == "Escape" and "..." or input',
	'input = (input.Name == "Escape" or input.Name == "Backspace") and "..." or input'
)
patchSource(
	"function library:keybind(properties)",
	'input.key = input.key == Enum.KeyCode.Escape and "..." or input.key',
	'input.key = (input.key == Enum.KeyCode.Escape or input.key == Enum.KeyCode.Backspace) and "..." or input.key'
)

-- 9) Long multi-select dropdown values ran out past the box; cut them off with "..." instead.
patchSource(
	"function library:dropdown(properties)",
	'Text = "option 1, option 3",',
	'Text = "option 1, option 3", TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd, ClipsDescendants = true,'
)

-- 7) Sliders glide to their new value instead of jumping.
patchSource(
	"function library:slider(properties)",
	"fill_inline.Size = dim2((cfg.value - cfg.min) / (cfg.max - cfg.min), 0, 1, 0)",
	'game:GetService("TweenService"):Create(fill_inline, TweenInfo.new(0.14, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), { Size = dim2((cfg.value - cfg.min) / (cfg.max - cfg.min), 0, 1, 0) }):Play()'
)

-- 4) Notification stacking is done by us (see the cursor loop), so drop the library's
--    re-stack tween that freed slots too early.
patchSource("function cfg:refresh_notifications()", "{ Position = dim2(0, 20, 0, 72 + (_ * 28)) }", "{}")

-- 6) Touch support: sliders, color pickers and resizing only followed the mouse. Accept
--    touch drags too. PC never produces touch input, so mouse behavior is unchanged.
do
	local function replaceAll(old, new)
		local pieces, position = {}, 1
		while true do
			local at = string.find(librarySource, old, position, true)
			if not at then
				break
			end
			table.insert(pieces, string.sub(librarySource, position, at - 1))
			table.insert(pieces, new)
			position = at + #old
		end
		table.insert(pieces, string.sub(librarySource, position))
		librarySource = table.concat(pieces)
	end

	replaceAll(
		"input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement",
		"(input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch)"
	)
	replaceAll(
		"if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then",
		"if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then"
	)
end

-- 5) A notification still on screen when the menu unloads (re-running the script) used to
--    error once its timer fired, because the library table is gone by then.
patchSource(
	"task.delay(cfg.time + 0.1, function()",
	"table.remove(library.notifications, table.find(library.notifications, holder))",
	"if not (library and library.notifications) then return end table.remove(library.notifications, table.find(library.notifications, holder))"
)

-- 10) Hidden tabs still cost layout every time the menu moved or redrew (6400 objects instead of
--     ~1000). Tabs not on screen are parked outside the gui and put back when opened.
patchSource(

	"library.current_tab[2].Visible = false",
	"library.current_tab[2].Visible = false if library.tab_home then library.parked_tabs[library.current_tab[2]] = true library.current_tab[2].Parent = nil end"
)
patchSource(
	"function cfg.open_tab()",
	"TAB.Visible = true",
	"if library.tab_home and TAB.Parent == nil then library.parked_tabs[TAB] = nil TAB.Parent = library.tab_home end TAB.Visible = true"
)
-- 11) Let the script animate a tab as it opens (the slide-in in Settings > Menu > menu animations).
patchSource(
	"function cfg.open_tab()",
	"TAB.Visible = true",
	"TAB.Visible = true if library.onTabOpened then pcall(library.onTabOpened, TAB) end"
)

-- Testing only: with getgenv().AquaLabsProfile = {} set before running, every connection's
-- callback is timed (total seconds and calls, by source line) to find what costs frame time.
if type(getgenv().AquaLabsProfile) == "table" then
	local profile = getgenv().AquaLabsProfile
	local connect = library.connection
	library.connection = function(self, signal, callback, ...)
		local where = debug.info(callback, "l")
		local entry = { line = where, time = 0, calls = 0 }
		table.insert(profile, entry)
		return connect(self, signal, function(...)
			local started = os.clock()
			callback(...)
			entry.time += os.clock() - started
			entry.calls += 1
		end, ...)
	end
end

do
	-- Every label in the menu is Title Case ("spin speed" -> "Spin Speed") with no commas or
	-- periods. Acronyms and names that already mix cases (HumanoidRootPart) are kept as is.
	local ACRONYMS = {
		fov = "FOV", esp = "ESP", tp = "TP", ui = "UI", id = "ID", hp = "HP", fps = "FPS",
		["2d"] = "2D", ["3d"] = "3D", rgb = "RGB", ms = "ms", rps = "rps",
	}

	---@param text string
	---@return string
	local function titleCase(text)
		text = string.gsub(text, "[,%.]", "")
		return (string.gsub(text, "[%w']+", function(word)
			local acronym = ACRONYMS[string.lower(word)]
			if acronym then
				return acronym
			end
			if string.find(string.sub(word, 2), "%u") then
				return word
			end
			return string.upper(string.sub(word, 1, 1)) .. string.sub(word, 2)
		end))
	end

	for _, method in ipairs({ "tab", "section", "toggle", "slider", "dropdown", "button", "textbox", "keybind", "colorpicker" }) do
		local original = library[method]
		if type(original) == "function" then
			library[method] = function(self, properties)
				if type(properties) == "table" then
					if type(properties.name) == "string" then
						properties.name = titleCase(properties.name)
					end
					if type(properties.placeholder) == "string" then
						properties.placeholder = titleCase(properties.placeholder)
					end
				end

				local result = original(self, properties)

				-- More breathing room: wider gaps between elements and between sections.
				if method == "section" and type(result) == "table" and result.holder then
					local layout = result.holder:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIListLayout")
					if layout then
						layout.Padding = UDim.new(0, 7)
					end
					-- Remembered by tab and name, so the menu layout pass at the end can arrange them.
					library.sectionRegistry = library.sectionRegistry or {}
					library.sectionRegistry[self] = library.sectionRegistry[self] or {}
					library.sectionRegistry[self][properties.name] = result
				elseif method == "tab" and type(result) == "table" then
					for _, column in ipairs({ result.left, result.right }) do
						local layout = column and column:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIListLayout")
						if layout then
							layout.Padding = UDim.new(0, 14)
						end
						-- A little air at the top and bottom of each column.
						local padding = column and column:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIPadding")
						if padding then
							padding.PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, 4)
							padding.PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, 20)
						end
					end
					-- Wider gap between the two columns.
					local columns = result.column_holder and result.column_holder:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIListLayout")
					if columns then
						columns.Padding = UDim.new(0, 10)
					end
				end

				return result
			end
		end
	end
end

-- Any unload path (our Unload button, the library's own, or a newer execution replacing
-- this one) goes through shutdown(), so every feature stops with the UI.
originalUnload = library.unload
library.unload = function()
	shutdown()
end

-- The library's config list assumes "/" in file paths; some executors return "\", which
-- made it error and stop the script. Parse names from either separator instead.
function library:config_list_update()
	if not library.config_holder then
		return
	end

	local list = {}
	for _, file in ipairs(listfiles(library.directory .. "/configs")) do
		local name = string.match(file, "([^/\\]+)%.cfg$")
		if name then
			table.insert(list, name)
		end
	end

	library.config_holder:refresh_options(list)
end

local flags = library.flags
local localPlayer = playersService.LocalPlayer

-- Notifications: limited to a few on screen at once, spaced out by a cooldown (extras wait in a
-- short queue), repeats of the same text within a second dropped, and the UI background image
-- shown behind each one. Settings > Menu sets the limit and cooldown.
do
	local showNotification = library.notification
	local queue = {}
	local lastText, lastShownAt = {}, 0

	local function present(properties)
		lastShownAt = os.clock()
		local result = showNotification(library, properties)
		local holder = library.notifications and library.notifications[#library.notifications]
		-- When it should be gone by (shown time + 1 s fade-out + 2 s spare); see the backup
		-- removal in the notification stacking loop.
		if holder then
			library.notificationExpiry = library.notificationExpiry or setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
			library.notificationExpiry[holder] = os.clock() + (tonumber(properties.time) or 5) + 3
		end
		local inline1 = holder and holder:FindFirstChildOfClass("Frame")
		local inline2 = inline1 and inline1:FindFirstChildOfClass("Frame")
		local main = inline2 and inline2:FindFirstChildOfClass("Frame")
		local image = library.notificationImage and library.notificationImage()
		if main and image and image ~= "" then
			-- The notification sizes itself to its text, so a stretch-to-fit image inside it made it
			-- grow across the whole screen. The image goes behind it at its measured size instead.
			task.defer(function()
				if not inline1.Parent then
					return
				end
				local backdrop = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
				backdrop.Name = ""
				backdrop.BackgroundTransparency = 1
				backdrop.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(inline1.AbsoluteSize.X, inline1.AbsoluteSize.Y)
				backdrop.Position = inline1.Position
				backdrop.ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Crop
				backdrop.Image = image
				backdrop.ImageTransparency = 0.5
				backdrop.ZIndex = 0
				backdrop.Parent = holder
				inline1.BackgroundTransparency = 0.45
				inline2.BackgroundTransparency = 0.45
				main.BackgroundTransparency = 0.45
			end)
		end
		return result
	end

	library.notification = function(self, properties)
		properties = type(properties) == "table" and properties or { text = tostring(properties) }
		local text = properties.text or ""
		local now = os.clock()
		if lastText[text] and now - lastText[text] < 1 then
			return
		end
		lastText[text] = now
		if #queue >= 6 then
			table.remove(queue, 1)
		end
		table.insert(queue, properties)
	end

	task.spawn(function()
		while isCurrentRun() do
			task.wait(0.05)
			local maximum = flags.notification_max or 5
			local cooldown = flags.notification_cooldown or 0.15
			if #queue > 0 and #(library.notifications or {}) < maximum and os.clock() - lastShownAt >= cooldown then
				pcall(present, table.remove(queue, 1))
			end
		end
	end)
end

-- Aqua Labs users find each other through an animation. Attributes and values you put on your
-- character never leave your client, but animations you play on it replicate to everyone. So each
-- copy of the script plays the default idle animation at an invisible weight and an unusual exact
-- speed (the "beacon"), and looks for that same track on other players.
local AQUA_BEACON = { id = "http://www.roblox.com/asset/?id=180435571", speed = 0.0137, track = nil, cache = {}, known = {} }
-- Dev build: THE one switch (Hooks.DEV_BUILD reads it). Unlocks premium, plays the developer beacon
-- (shown as Developer to everyone), makes you untargetable and gives admin over everyone else.
-- Set false for the public build.
AQUA_BEACON.devBuild = true
-- ============================================================================
-- DEVELOPER USERNAMES - edit this list to add / change developers (not case sensitive).
-- Only these accounts count as Developer, and only while running the dev build. Usernames
-- can't be faked, so nobody else can pose as a developer by copying the beacon.
-- ============================================================================
AQUA_BEACON.DEV_NAMES = {
	"g3QWFGqwgfq",
}
-- Developer copies beacon at this speed instead, so everyone else can tell them apart.
AQUA_BEACON.devSpeed = 0.0173
AQUA_BEACON.devKnown = {}

-- Developers are identified by UserId only (DEV_NAMES above now only grants premium).
-- Hardcoded IDs always count; the GitHub list can add more once it loads.
AQUA_BEACON.DEV_LIST_URL = "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Dacmdu/Usre732/refs/heads/main/ya"
AQUA_BEACON.devIds = {
	[2420309630] = true,
	[11143442077] = true,
	[5333256023] = true,
}

---Whether this account is on the developer UserId whitelist.
function AQUA_BEACON.isListedDev(player)
	return player ~= nil and AQUA_BEACON.devIds[player.UserId] == true
end

---Start (or keep) the beacon track on your character.
local function applyAquaMarker(character)
	if not character then
		return
	end
	local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") or character:WaitForChild("Humanoid", 5)
	local animator = humanoid and (humanoid:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator") or humanoid:WaitForChild("Animator", 5))
	if not animator then
		return
	end

	local track = AQUA_BEACON.track
	local speed = (AQUA_BEACON.devBuild and AQUA_BEACON.isListedDev(localPlayer)) and AQUA_BEACON.devSpeed or AQUA_BEACON.speed
	-- Re-announce: the track is restarted every few seconds (and when someone joins). Players who
	-- join or load the script after it started don't get its exact speed until it restarts, so
	-- they used to only spot you after your next respawn.
	local due = os.clock() >= (AQUA_BEACON.restartAt or 0)
	if track and due then
		pcall(track.Stop, track, 0)
		pcall(track.Destroy, track)
		track = nil
	end
	if not (track and track.IsPlaying and AQUA_BEACON.animator == animator) then
		AQUA_BEACON.restartAt = os.clock() + 6
		local animation = Instance.new("Animation")
		animation.AnimationId = AQUA_BEACON.id
		local ok, loaded = pcall(animator.LoadAnimation, animator, animation)
		animation:Destroy()
		if not ok then
			return
		end
		track = loaded
		track.Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Core
		track.Looped = true
		track:Play(0, 0.001, speed)
		AQUA_BEACON.track, AQUA_BEACON.animator = track, animator
	end
	track:AdjustWeight(0.001, 0)
	track:AdjustSpeed(speed)
end

---Whether a player is running the script (they're playing the beacon). Cached briefly.
---Requires a recent beacon sighting so leave + rejoin without re-executing drops them.
local function isAquaLabsUser(player)
	if not player or player == localPlayer then
		return false
	end
	local now = os.clock()
	local cached = AQUA_BEACON.cache[player]
	if cached and now - cached.at < 0.75 then
		return cached.value
	end

	local found = false
	local character = player.Character
	local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	local animator = humanoid and humanoid:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator")
	if animator then
		for _, track in ipairs(animator:GetPlayingAnimationTracks()) do
			local animation = track.Animation
			if animation and animation.AnimationId == AQUA_BEACON.id then
				if math.abs(track.Speed - AQUA_BEACON.devSpeed) < 0.0005 then
					AQUA_BEACON.devKnown[player.UserId] = now
					found = true
					break
				elseif math.abs(track.Speed - AQUA_BEACON.speed) < 0.0005 then
					found = true
					break
				end
			end
		end
	end

	-- Short grace after a confirmed sighting so brief replication gaps don't flicker the tag.
	if found then
		AQUA_BEACON.known[player.UserId] = now
	elseif AQUA_BEACON.known[player.UserId] and now - AQUA_BEACON.known[player.UserId] < 8 then
		found = true
	else
		AQUA_BEACON.known[player.UserId] = nil
	end

	AQUA_BEACON.cache[player] = { at = now, value = found }
	return found
end

---Whether a player is running the dev build (developer beacon seen in the last 8s). You count
---for yourself when this copy is the dev build.
function AQUA_BEACON.isDeveloper(player)
	if not (player and AQUA_BEACON.isListedDev(player)) then
		return false
	end
	if player == localPlayer then
		return AQUA_BEACON.devBuild == true
	end
	-- UserId whitelist already passed; the beacon just confirms they're running the script.
	return isAquaLabsUser(player)
end

		name.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(52, 42)
		name.Size = UDim2.new(1, -62, 0, 20)
		name.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
		name.Text = player.DisplayName .. " (@" .. player.Name .. ")"
		name.TextSize = 14
		name.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
		name.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
		name.TextColor3 = AQUA_COLOR
		name.Parent = card

		local timer = Instance.new("Frame")
		timer.BorderSizePixel = 0
		timer.BackgroundColor3 = AQUA_COLOR
		timer.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 1)
		timer.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0, 1)
		timer.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 2)
		timer.Parent = card

		local sound = Instance.new("Sound")
		sound.SoundId = "rbxassetid://" .. ALERT_SOUND
		sound.Volume = 1
		sound.Parent = workspace.CurrentCamera or workspace
		sound:Play()
		game:GetService("Debris"):AddItem(sound, 5)

		local tweens = game:GetService("TweenService")
		tweens:Create(card, TweenInfo.new(0.35, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), { Position = UDim2.new(1, -16, 0, 70) }):Play()
		tweens:Create(timer, TweenInfo.new(5, Enum.EasingStyle.Linear), { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 2) }):Play()
		task.delay(5, function()
			if card.Parent then
				tweens:Create(card, TweenInfo.new(0.3, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In), { Position = UDim2.new(1, 360, 0, 70) }):Play()
				task.wait(0.35)
				card:Destroy()
			end
		end)
	end

	task.spawn(function()
		while isCurrentRun() and aquaGui.Parent do
			-- Keep our own beacon playing (respawns, other scripts stopping tracks).
			pcall(applyAquaMarker, localPlayer.Character)

			for _, player in ipairs(playersService:GetPlayers()) do
				if player ~= localPlayer and isAquaLabsUser(player) and not alerted[player.UserId] then
					alerted[player.UserId] = true
					task.spawn(showJoinAlert, player)
				end
			end

			task.wait(0.5)
		end
	end)

	-- The library isn't loaded yet here, so this one is disconnected through onUnload.
	local removingConnection = playersService.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
		alerted[player.UserId] = nil
		AQUA_BEACON.known[player.UserId] = nil
		AQUA_BEACON.devKnown[player.UserId] = nil
		AQUA_BEACON.cache[player] = nil
	end)

	onUnload(function()
		removingConnection:Disconnect()
		aquaGui:Destroy()
	end)
end

	end

---True while the player is typing in chat (slash or TextBox focused).
local function isTyping()
	if userInputService:GetFocusedTextBox() then
		return true
	end
	-- TextChatService input bar
	local ok, focused = pcall(function()
		local tcs = game:GetService("TextChatService")
		local chatInput = tcs and tcs:FindFirstChild("ChatInputBarConfiguration")
		return chatInput and chatInput.IsFocused
	end)
	return ok and focused == true
end

---Dropdown label: "DisplayName (@Username)" or just Username if they match.
---@param player Player
---@return string
local function playerLabel(player)
	if not player then
		return ""
	end
	if player.DisplayName ~= player.Name then
		return string.format("%s (@%s)", player.DisplayName, player.Name)
	end
	return player.Name
end

---Pull the username out of a dropdown label (supports plain Name or "Display (@User)").
---@param label any
---@return string?
local function usernameFromLabel(label)
	if type(label) ~= "string" or label == "" or label == "---" then
		return nil
	end
	local user = string.match(label, "%(@([^%)]+)%)$")
	return user or label
end

---True if multi-select flag contains this username (matches plain or "Display (@User)" entries).
---@param list any
---@param name string
---@return boolean
local function listHas(list, name)
	if type(list) ~= "table" or type(name) ~= "string" or name == "" then
		return false
	end
	if list[name] == true then
		return true
	end
	for key, value in pairs(list) do
		if type(value) == "string" then
			if usernameFromLabel(value) == name or value == name then
				return true
			end
		end
		if type(key) == "string" and value then
			if usernameFromLabel(key) == name or key == name then
				return true
			end
		end
	end
	return false
end

---Whether this player is on the global combat whitelist.
---@param player Player|string
---@return boolean
local function isGloballyWhitelisted(player)
	local name = typeof(player) == "Instance" and player.Name or player
	return listHas(flags.global_whitelist, name)
end

-- Proggy Tiny: the pixel font the vaderpaste visuals ESP uses. Downloaded once, then wrapped in a
-- font family file so Roblox can load it. Kept out of the fonts folder so it isn't listed twice.
pcall(function()
	local folder = (library.directory or "Aqua Lab") .. "/esp"
	local fontFile = folder .. "/ProggyTiny.ttf"
	local familyFile = folder .. "/ProggyTiny.json"
	pcall(makefolder, folder)

	if not isfile(fontFile) then
		local response = request({ Url = "https://github.com/i77lhm/storage/raw/refs/heads/main/fonts/ProggyTiny.ttf", Method = "GET" })
		if not (response and response.Success and #response.Body > 1000) then
			return
		end
		writefile(fontFile, response.Body)
	end

	writefile(familyFile, httpService:JSONEncode({
		name = "ProggyTiny",
		faces = { { name = "Regular", weight = 400, style = "normal", assetId = getcustomasset(fontFile) } },
	}))
	FONT_FACES["Proggy Tiny"] = Font.new(getcustomasset(familyFile), Enum.FontWeight.Regular, Enum.FontStyle.Normal)
end)

-- Fortnite: Burbank Big Condensed (Bold and Black) from "Aqua Lab/esp" in the executor workspace.
-- Without those files it stays on Oswald Bold, the closest font Roblox ships.
pcall(function()
	local folder = (library.directory or "Aqua Lab") .. "/esp"
	local bold, black = folder .. "/BurbankBold.otf", folder .. "/BurbankBlack.otf"
	if not (isfile(bold) and isfile(black)) then
		return
	end

	local familyFile = folder .. "/Burbank.json"
	writefile(familyFile, httpService:JSONEncode({
		name = "Burbank",
		faces = {
			{ name = "Bold", weight = 700, style = "normal", assetId = getcustomasset(bold) },
			{ name = "Black", weight = 900, style = "normal", assetId = getcustomasset(black) },
		},
	}))
	local family = getcustomasset(familyFile)
	FONT_FACES["Fortnite"] = Font.new(family, Enum.FontWeight.Bold, Enum.FontStyle.Normal)
end)

local fontNames = {}
local themeFontDropdown = nil
local espFontDropdown = nil

---Rebuild the sorted font name list from FONT_FACES.
local function rebuildFontNames()
	table.clear(fontNames)
	for name in pairs(FONT_FACES) do
		table.insert(fontNames, name)
	end
	table.sort(fontNames)
end

---Load .ttf / .otf / .ttc from the executor workspace fonts folder into FONT_FACES.
local function loadCustomFonts()
	pcall(makefolder, FONT_DIRECTORY)
	-- Drop previous custom entries so removed files disappear after refresh.
	for name in pairs(FONT_FACES) do
		if string.sub(name, 1, 8) == "Custom: " then
			FONT_FACES[name] = nil
		end
	end

	local okList, files = pcall(listfiles, FONT_DIRECTORY)
	if not okList or type(files) ~= "table" then
		rebuildFontNames()
		return 0
	end

	local loaded = 0
	for _, file in ipairs(files) do
		local base = string.match(file, "([^/\\]+)$") or file
		local stem = string.match(base, "^(.+)%.[Oo][Tt][Ff]$")
			or string.match(base, "^(.+)%.[Tt][Tt][Ff]$")
			or string.match(base, "^(.+)%.[Tt][Tt][Cc]$")
		if stem then
			local asset = nil
			if getcustomasset then
				local okAsset, result = pcall(getcustomasset, file)
				if okAsset then
					asset = result
				end
			end
			if asset then
				-- Roblox only loads fonts through a font family file that points at the font, so
				-- one is written per font (in Aqua Lab/esp, out of the fonts folder).
				local fontObj = nil
				pcall(function()
					local folder = (library.directory or "Aqua Lab") .. "/esp"
					pcall(makefolder, folder)
					local familyFile = folder .. "/custom_" .. string.gsub(stem, "[^%w_%-]", "_") .. ".json"
					writefile(familyFile, httpService:JSONEncode({
						name = stem,
						faces = { { name = "Regular", weight = 400, style = "normal", assetId = asset } },
					}))
					fontObj = Font.new(getcustomasset(familyFile), Enum.FontWeight.Regular, Enum.FontStyle.Normal)
				end)
				if fontObj then
					FONT_FACES["Custom: " .. stem] = fontObj
					loaded += 1
				end
			end
		end
	end

	rebuildFontNames()
	return loaded
end

loadCustomFonts()

local Hooks = {}

-- Premium: usernames from the GitHub whitelist. Premium-only controls are grayed out and held off
-- for everyone else. While the list is still downloading they're held off too, then switched back
-- on for premium users.
Hooks.premium = {
	url = "https://gist.github"
		.. "usercontent.com/obama"
		.. "joepoop/96601d9de277451c90cb"
		.. "837d848170ef/raw/"
		.. "whitelist.txt",
	loaded = false,
	names = {},
	gates = {},
	flags = {},
	locked = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" }),
	forced = {},
	warnedAt = 0,
}

-- Always premium, even if the gist doesn't list them.

-- Developers are always premium too (normal build included).
for _, devName in ipairs(AQUA_BEACON.DEV_NAMES) do
	table.insert(Hooks.premium.extraNames, devName)
end
Hooks.premium.extraHwids = { ["D3E7DC80-8353-4881-959F-C631AF353E35"] = true }

-- Dev build: every premium feature is unlocked and nothing is grayed. Switch it at AQUA_BEACON.devBuild.
-- Only for accounts on AQUA_BEACON.DEV_NAMES; anyone else running the dev build is treated normally.
Hooks.DEV_BUILD = AQUA_BEACON.devBuild and AQUA_BEACON.isListedDev(localPlayer)
Hooks.isDeveloper = AQUA_BEACON.isDeveloper
-- Players tab buttons locked behind premium.
Hooks.premium.buttons = {}

-- A developer's Blacklist command takes the premium features and the Premium rank (admin
-- commands) away from a premium user. Saved to a file so re-executing doesn't clear it.
Hooks.premium.BLACKLIST_FILE = "aqualabs_blacklist.txt"
Hooks.premium.blacklisted = (function()
	local ok, exists = pcall(isfile, Hooks.premium.BLACKLIST_FILE)
	return ok and exists == true
end)()
-- Permanent blacklist (UserIds, one per line) on GitHub. Deleting the local file doesn't clear this,
-- and developers in the server re-send the Blacklist command to anyone on their own list.
Hooks.premium.BLACKLIST_URL = "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Dacmdu/Usre732/refs/heads/main/blacklist"
Hooks.premium.remoteBlacklisted = false
-- Everyone on the GitHub blacklist, so other clients treat them as Free too.
Hooks.premium.blacklistIds = {}
-- Premium UserIds: numeric lines in the gist, plus every listed username resolved to its UserId.
Hooks.premium.ids = {}

---Turn the blacklist on/off for this account and re-gray the premium controls.
function Hooks.setBlacklisted(state)
	Hooks.premium.blacklisted = state == true
	if state then
		pcall(writefile, Hooks.premium.BLACKLIST_FILE, tostring(localPlayer.UserId))
	else
		pcall(delfile, Hooks.premium.BLACKLIST_FILE)
	end
	-- Running carkicks stop now (the premium flags are held off by the Heartbeat check below).
	if state then
		if Hooks.carKick and Hooks.carKick.target then
			pcall(Hooks.carKick.stop)
		end
		if Hooks.carToss and Hooks.carToss.target then
			pcall(Hooks.carToss.stop)
		end
	end
	Hooks.refreshPremiumGates()
end

---Whether you're on the premium whitelist (and not blacklisted). Only gates the premium features;
---your Premium rank / admin commands come from the whitelist alone.
function Hooks.isPremium()
	if Hooks.DEV_BUILD then
		return true
	end
	if Hooks.premium.blacklisted or Hooks.premium.remoteBlacklisted then
		return false
	end
	return Hooks.premium.loaded == true and Hooks.isPremiumPlayer(localPlayer)
end

---Whether a player is on the premium whitelist, by UserId first (survives renames) then by name.
function Hooks.isPremiumPlayer(player)
	if not player then
		return false
	end
	return Hooks.premium.ids[player.UserId] == true or Hooks.premium.names[string.lower(player.Name)] == true
end

---Gray a Players tab button for non-premium users. `baseText` is its idle label.
function Hooks.premiumButton(button, baseText)
	local entry = { button = button, text = baseText, color = button.TextColor3 }
	table.insert(Hooks.premium.buttons, entry)
	-- Theme / hover recolors don't un-gray a locked button.
	button:GetPropertyChangedSignal("TextColor3"):Connect(function()
		if entry.locked and button.TextColor3 ~= DULL_TEXT then
			button.TextColor3 = DULL_TEXT
		end
	end)
	Hooks.refreshPremiumGates()
end

---Gray out (or restore) every premium control to match your status.
function Hooks.refreshPremiumGates()
	local locked = not Hooks.isPremium()
	for _, entry in ipairs(Hooks.premium.buttons) do
		local button = entry.button
		if button.Parent then
			local wasLocked = entry.locked
			entry.locked = locked
			if locked then
				button.Text = entry.text .. " [Premium]"
				button.TextColor3 = DULL_TEXT
			elseif Hooks.DEV_BUILD then
				button.Text = entry.text .. " [Dev]"
				button.TextColor3 = entry.color
			elseif wasLocked then
				button.Text = entry.text
				button.TextColor3 = entry.color
			end
		end
	end
	for _, gate in ipairs(Hooks.premium.gates) do
		local label = gate.label
		if label.Parent then
			Hooks.premium.locked[label] = locked or nil
			label.Text = locked and (gate.text .. " [Premium]") or (Hooks.DEV_BUILD and gate.text .. " [Dev]" or gate.text)
			if locked then
				label.TextColor3 = DULL_TEXT
			elseif gate.color then
				label.TextColor3 = gate.color
			end
		end
	end
end

---Lock a control (found by its label in `section`) behind premium. `flag` is held off while locked.
function Hooks.premiumGate(section, name, flag)
	local wanted = string.lower(string.gsub(name, "[,%.]", ""))
	local label
	for _, object in ipairs(section.holder and section.holder:GetDescendants() or {}) do
		if (object:IsA("TextButton") or object:IsA("TextLabel")) and string.lower(object.Text) == wanted then
			label = object
		end
	end
	if flag then
		Hooks.premium.flags[flag] = true
	end
	if not label then
		return
	end
	local gate = { label = label, text = label.Text, color = label.TextColor3 }
	table.insert(Hooks.premium.gates, gate)
	-- The library recolors text on theme changes; keep locked labels gray.
	library:connection(label:GetPropertyChangedSignal("TextColor3"), function()
		if Hooks.premium.locked[label] and label.TextColor3 ~= DULL_TEXT then
			label.TextColor3 = DULL_TEXT
		elseif not Hooks.premium.locked[label] and label.TextColor3 ~= DULL_TEXT then
			gate.color = label.TextColor3
		end
	end)
	Hooks.refreshPremiumGates()
end

---Whether another script has swapped this function out (how the whitelist gets spoofed).
---(On Hooks: the top level is at Luau's 200-local limit.)
---Uses four independent checks, and runs them on the checkers too, so hooking isfunctionhooked
---(or any single checker) to lie isn't enough. Clean executor functions are native "[C]" closures:
---not hooked, not newcclosure wrappers, not Luau closures.
function Hooks.isTampered(fn)
	if type(fn) ~= "function" then
		return false
	end
	local function looksHooked(target)
		local okHooked, hooked = pcall(isfunctionhooked, target)
		if okHooked and hooked == true then
			return true
		end
		local okWrapped, wrapped = pcall(isnewcclosure, target)
		if okWrapped and wrapped == true then
			return true
		end
		local okLua, lua = pcall(islclosure, target)
		if okLua and lua == true then
			return true
		end
		local okSource, source = pcall(debug.info, target, "s")
		return okSource and source ~= "[C]"
	end
	for _, checker in ipairs({ isfunctionhooked, isnewcclosure, islclosure, debug.info }) do
		if type(checker) == "function" and looksHooked(checker) then
			return true
		end
	end
	return looksHooked(fn)
end

task.spawn(function()
	-- Fetched with request, never game:HttpGet (the usual spoof target). If either one has been
	-- hooked, someone is faking the answer, so the list is ignored and nobody gets premium from it.
	local body = nil
	local problem = nil
	if Hooks.isTampered(request) or Hooks.isTampered(game.HttpGet) then
		problem = "another script hooked request/HttpGet (rejoin and run Aqua Labs first)"
	else
		-- Up to 3 tries. The time on the end skips GitHub's cached copy, so a name added minutes ago
		-- counts right away. Some executors give the status as text or leave it out, so any reply
		-- that isn't an error status counts.
		for attempt = 1, 3 do
			local ok, response = pcall(request, {
				Url = Hooks.premium.url .. "?t=" .. tostring(os.time()) .. attempt,
				Method = "GET",
				Headers = { ["Cache-Control"] = "no-cache" },
			})
			local status = ok and type(response) == "table" and tonumber(response.StatusCode) or nil
			if ok and type(response) == "table" and type(response.Body) == "string" and response.Body ~= ""
				and (status == nil or (status >= 200 and status < 300)) then
				body = response.Body
				break
			end
			problem = ok and ("the whitelist download failed (status " .. tostring(type(response) == "table" and response.StatusCode or "?") .. ")")
				or ("the whitelist download errored: " .. tostring(response))
			task.wait(1.5)
		end
	end
	if not body and problem then
		warn("[Aqua] premium list not loaded:", problem)
		task.delay(3, function()
			if library then
				library:notification({ text = "Premium list not loaded: " .. problem, time = 6 })
			end
		end)
	end
	if body then
		local names, ids, count = {}, {}, 0
		for line in string.gmatch(body, "[^\r\n]+") do
			line = string.gsub(string.gsub(line, "^%s+", ""), "%s+$", "")
			if line ~= "" and not string.find(line, "^#") then
				if string.find(line, "^%d+$") then
					ids[tonumber(line)] = true
				else
					names[string.lower(line)] = true
				end
				count += 1
			end
		end
		-- A "list" that is only your own name / id is what the spoof sends back.
		if not (count == 1 and (names[string.lower(localPlayer.Name)] or ids[localPlayer.UserId])) then
			for name in pairs(names) do
				Hooks.premium.names[name] = true
			end
			for id in pairs(ids) do
				Hooks.premium.ids[id] = true
			end
		end
	end
	for _, name in ipairs(Hooks.premium.extraNames) do
		Hooks.premium.names[string.lower(name)] = true
	end
	local okHwid, hwid = pcall(gethwid)
	if okHwid and Hooks.premium.extraHwids[string.upper(tostring(hwid))] then
		Hooks.premium.ids[localPlayer.UserId] = true
	end

	-- Resolve every listed username to its UserId so premium follows the account, not the name.
	-- Capped at 6s so a slow Roblox API doesn't hold the menu locked.
	do
		local pending = 0
		for name in pairs(Hooks.premium.names) do
			pending += 1
			task.spawn(function()
				local ok, id = pcall(playersService.GetUserIdFromNameAsync, playersService, name)
				if ok and type(id) == "number" then
					Hooks.premium.ids[id] = true
				end
				pending -= 1
			end)
		end
		local started = os.clock()
		while pending > 0 and os.clock() - started < 6 do
			task.wait(0.1)
		end
	end

	-- Permanent GitHub blacklist. A missing file (404) just means nobody is on it.
	if not Hooks.isTampered(request) then
		local ok, response = pcall(request, {
			Url = Hooks.premium.BLACKLIST_URL .. "?t=" .. tostring(os.time()),
			Method = "GET",
			Headers = { ["Cache-Control"] = "no-cache" },
		})
		local status = ok and type(response) == "table" and tonumber(response.StatusCode) or nil
		if ok and type(response) == "table" and type(response.Body) == "string"
			and (status == nil or (status >= 200 and status < 300)) then
			for id in string.gmatch(response.Body, "%d+") do
				Hooks.premium.blacklistIds[tonumber(id)] = true
				if tonumber(id) == localPlayer.UserId then
					Hooks.premium.remoteBlacklisted = true
				end
			end
		end
	end

	-- Developer UserIds from GitHub add to the hardcoded ones. Skipped if request is hooked, and a
	-- list holding only your own id is ignored (that's what a spoofed reply looks like).
	if not Hooks.isTampered(request) then
		local ok, response = pcall(request, {
			Url = AQUA_BEACON.DEV_LIST_URL .. "?t=" .. tostring(os.time()),
			Method = "GET",
			Headers = { ["Cache-Control"] = "no-cache" },
		})
		local status = ok and type(response) == "table" and tonumber(response.StatusCode) or nil
		if ok and type(response) == "table" and type(response.Body) == "string"
			and (status == nil or (status >= 200 and status < 300)) then
			local ids, count = {}, 0
			for id in string.gmatch(response.Body, "%d+") do
				ids[tonumber(id)] = true
				count += 1
			end
			if not (count == 1 and ids[localPlayer.UserId]) then
				for id in pairs(ids) do
					AQUA_BEACON.devIds[id] = true
				end
			end
		end
	end
	Hooks.DEV_BUILD = AQUA_BEACON.devBuild and AQUA_BEACON.isListedDev(localPlayer)

	Hooks.premium.loaded = true
	Hooks.refreshPremiumGates()

	-- Not whitelisted: the script still runs as Free, premium controls stay grayed.
	if not Hooks.isPremium() then
		pcall(function()
			library:notification({ text = "Running as Free. Premium features are locked.", time = 6 })
		end)
	end
	if Hooks.DEV_BUILD then
		pcall(function()
			library:notification({ text = "Dev build loaded - everything unlocked.", time = 4 })
		end)
	end

	-- Premium: turn back on whatever was held off while the list was loading.
	if Hooks.isPremium() then
		for flag in pairs(Hooks.premium.forced) do
			local setter = library.config_flags[flag]
			if setter then
				pcall(setter, true)
			else
				flags[flag] = true
			end
		end
	end
	table.clear(Hooks.premium.forced)
end)

-- Hold premium flags off for free users (clicks, keybinds and configs all land here).
library:connection(runService.Heartbeat, function()
	if Hooks.isPremium() then
		return
	end
	for flag in pairs(Hooks.premium.flags) do
		if flags[flag] == true then
			if Hooks.premium.loaded then
				if os.clock() - Hooks.premium.warnedAt > 2 then
					Hooks.premium.warnedAt = os.clock()
					library:notification({ text = "That's a Premium feature.", time = 3 })
				end
			else
				Hooks.premium.forced[flag] = true
			end
			local setter = library.config_flags[flag]
			if setter then
				pcall(setter, false)
			else
				flags[flag] = false
			end
		end
	end
end)
-- Invisible, Anti Aim (Desync) and Anti Punch put your body back each frame where it was a moment
-- ago; a teleport has to clear that, or the next frame snaps you right back.
Hooks.desyncResets = {}
function Hooks.clearDesync()
	for _, reset in ipairs(Hooks.desyncResets) do
		pcall(reset)
	end
end

---True while any cartoss mode is running (Anti Fling and Anti Car Fling stand down so the car can hit).
function Hooks.isTossing()
	return flags.tools_car_fling == true
		or (Hooks.persistentExploiterFling ~= nil and next(Hooks.persistentExploiterFling) ~= nil)
		or (Hooks.persistentCarFling ~= nil and next(Hooks.persistentCarFling) ~= nil)
		or (Hooks.carToss ~= nil and Hooks.carToss.target ~= nil)
end

	Hooks.isMobile = math.min(vp.X, vp.Y) <= 900

-- Performance profile (Settings > Performance). Quality updates every visual every frame.
-- Balanced (the PC default) caps the heavy visuals at 60 updates a second and thins far ESP.
-- Performance (the phone and tablet default) drops them to 30, thins ESP harder, cuts tracers and
-- impact effects, and turns the costly menu effects off.
Hooks.PROFILE_LEVELS = { Quality = 0, Balanced = 1, Performance = 2 }
function Hooks.perfLevel()
	-- Optimize Mode forces the lightest profile everywhere.
	if flags.optimize_mode == true then
		return 2
	end
	local profile = flags.performance_profile
	if profile == nil or profile == "Auto" then
		-- Older configs saved a plain "performance mode" toggle.
		if flags.performance_mode == true then
			return 2
		end
		return Hooks.isMobile and 2 or 1
	end
	return Hooks.PROFILE_LEVELS[profile] or 1
end
function Hooks.lowPower()
	return Hooks.perfLevel() >= 2
end
---Where a character's feet are: the ground right under them, or (in the air) the bottom of the
---legs. R6 rigs report a hip height of 0, so their 2-stud legs are counted directly.
function Hooks.feetPosition(character, root)
	local params = Hooks.feetParams
	if not params then
		params = RaycastParams.new()
		params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
		Hooks.feetParams = params
	end
	params.FilterDescendantsInstances = { character, workspace.CurrentCamera }
	local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	local legs = 2
	if humanoid and humanoid.RigType ~= Enum.HumanoidRigType.R6 and humanoid.HipHeight > 0.1 then
		legs = humanoid.HipHeight
	end
	local drop = root.Size.Y / 2 + legs
	local hit = workspace:Raycast(root.Position, Vector3.new(0, (drop + 1.5) * NEG_ONE, 0), params)
	if hit then
		return hit.Position
	end
	return root.Position - Vector3.new(0, drop, 0)
end
---Shortest time between updates for the heavy per-frame visuals.
function Hooks.visualInterval()
	local level = Hooks.perfLevel()
	return level >= 2 and 1 / 30 or level == 1 and 1 / 60 or 0
end

local crosshairImage = ""

---Pause game listeners that force collision back on (Prison Life's CharacterCollision
---flips Head.CanCollide back to true whenever it changes).
---@param character Model
local function pauseCollisionGuards(character)
	guardedCharacter = character

	for _, part in ipairs(character:GetChildren()) do
		if not part:IsA("BasePart") then
			continue
		end

		for _, connection in ipairs(getconnections(part:GetPropertyChangedSignal("CanCollide"))) do
			local callback = connection.Function
			if connection.Enabled and not (callback and isexecutorclosure(callback)) then
				connection:Disable()
				table.insert(pausedCollisionGuards, connection)
			end
		end
	end
end

---Disconnect noclip, restore original collision, then hand control back to the game.
local function disableNoclip()
	if noclipConnection then
		noclipConnection:Disconnect()
		noclipConnection = nil
	end

	for part, canCollide in pairs(originalCollision) do
		if part.Parent then
			part.CanCollide = canCollide
		end
	end

	table.clear(originalCollision)

	for _, connection in ipairs(pausedCollisionGuards) do
		pcall(connection.Enable, connection)
	end

	table.clear(pausedCollisionGuards)
	guardedCharacter = nil
end

---Disable character collision every physics step.
local function enableNoclip()
	if noclipConnection then
		return
	end

	noclipConnection = runService.Stepped:Connect(function()
		local character = localPlayer.Character
		if not character then
			return
		end

		-- Respawns create a fresh guard connection, so re-pause per character.
		if character ~= guardedCharacter then
			pauseCollisionGuards(character)
		end

		for _, part in ipairs(character:GetDescendants()) do
			if not part:IsA("BasePart") then
				continue
			end

			if originalCollision[part] == nil then
				originalCollision[part] = part.CanCollide
			end

			part.CanCollide = false
		end
	end)
end

---Recolor one GUI object if its original color belongs to a tracked shade group.
---@param object Instance
local function applyShade(object)
	if not object:IsA("GuiObject") then
		return
	end

	local original = originalShades[object] or object.BackgroundColor3
	originalShades[object] = original

	local hex = original:ToHex()

	for group, shades in pairs(SHADE_GROUPS) do
		if shades[hex] and shadeColors[group] then
			object.BackgroundColor3 = shadeColors[group]
		end
	end
end

---Recolor every object in a shade group.
---@param group string
---@param color Color3
local function setShade(group, color)
	shadeColors[group] = color

	for _, object in ipairs(library.gui:GetDescendants()) do
		applyShade(object)
	end
	for _, parked in ipairs({ library.parked_tabs, library.parked_popups }) do
		for root in pairs(parked) do
			for _, object in ipairs(root:GetDescendants()) do
				applyShade(object)
			end
		end
	end
end

---Apply the current font to a text object.
---@param object Instance
local function applyFont(object)
	-- Text marked KeepFont (like the menu logo) keeps its own font.
	if (object:IsA("TextLabel") or object:IsA("TextButton") or object:IsA("TextBox")) and not object:GetAttribute("KeepFont") then
		object.FontFace = currentFont
	end
end

---Swap every text object over to a new font (menu + overlays + Aqua Labs UI).
---@param fontName string
local function setFont(fontName)
	currentFont = FONT_FACES[fontName] or library.font

	local roots = { library.gui }
	for tab in pairs(library.parked_tabs) do
		table.insert(roots, tab)
	end
	for popup in pairs(library.parked_popups) do
		table.insert(roots, popup)
	end
	pcall(function()
		for _, child in ipairs(coreGui:GetChildren()) do
			if child:GetAttribute("AquaLabs") then
				table.insert(roots, child)
			end
		end
	end)

	for _, root in ipairs(roots) do
		if root then
			for _, object in ipairs(root:GetDescendants()) do
				applyFont(object)
			end
		end
	end
end

---Create a button that acts as a text label and return its TextButton.
---@param section table
---@param text string
---@return TextButton
local function createLabel(section, text)
	section:button({ name = text })

	local children = section.holder:GetChildren()

	for index = #children, 1, -1 do
		local button = children[index]:FindFirstChildOfClass("TextButton")
		if button then
			button.AutoButtonColor = false
			return button
		end
	end
end

---WCAG relative luminance of a color.
---@param color Color3
---@return number
local function getLuminance(color)
	local function channel(value)
		return value <= 0.03928 and value / 12.92 or ((value + 0.055) / 1.055) ^ 2.4
	end

	return 0.2126 * channel(color.R) + 0.7152 * channel(color.G) + 0.0722 * channel(color.B)
end

---Refresh the contrast label from the text and background colors.
local function updateContrast()
	if not contrastLabel then
		return
	end

	local textColor = flags.theme_text and flags.theme_text.Color or Color3.fromRGB(170, 170, 170)
	local backgroundColor = shadeColors.background or Color3.fromRGB(26, 26, 26)

	local lighter = math.max(getLuminance(textColor), getLuminance(backgroundColor))
	local darker = math.min(getLuminance(textColor), getLuminance(backgroundColor))
	local ratio = (lighter + 0.05) / (darker + 0.05)

	local rating = ratio >= 7 and "good" or ratio >= 4.5 and "ok" or "poor"
	contrastLabel.Text = string.format("Contrast check: %s (%.1f:1)", rating, ratio)
end

---Read a config name from a flag and make sure it isn't empty.
---@param flag string
---@return string?
local function getName(flag)
	local name = flags[flag]

	if type(name) ~= "string" or name == "" or name == "---" then
		library:notification({ text = "Pick or type a name first." })
		return nil
	end

	return name
end

---Refresh the autoload label text.
local function updateAutoloadLabel()
	if not autoloadLabel then
		return
	end

	local name = isfile(AUTOLOAD_FILE) and readfile(AUTOLOAD_FILE) or "none"
	autoloadLabel.Text = "Current autoload config: " .. name
end

---Collect the current theme flags into a JSON string.
---@return string
local function getTheme()
	local theme = {}

	for _, flag in ipairs(THEME_FLAGS) do
		local value = flags[flag]

		if type(value) == "table" and value.Color then
			theme[flag] = { Color = value.Color:ToHex(), Transparency = value.Transparency }
		else
			theme[flag] = value
		end
	end

	return httpService:JSONEncode(theme)
end

---Apply a theme JSON string through the existing config setters.
---@param json string
local function loadTheme(json)
	local success, theme = pcall(httpService.JSONDecode, httpService, json)
	if not success then
		return library:notification({ text = "Theme file is corrupted." })
	end

	for flag, value in pairs(theme) do
		local setter = library.config_flags[flag]
		if not setter then
			continue
		end

		if type(value) == "table" and value.Color then
			setter(Color3.fromHex(value.Color), value.Transparency)
		else
			setter(value)
		end
	end
end

---List file names without extension in a folder.
---@param directory string
---@param extension string
---@return table
local function listNames(directory, extension)
	local names = {}

	for _, file in ipairs(listfiles(directory)) do
		local name = file:match("([^/\\]+)%" .. extension .. "$")
		if name then
			table.insert(names, name)
		end
	end

	return names
end

-- Decal id -> image content id, cached since each lookup downloads the decal.
local resolvedImages = {}

---Find the image behind a store/catalog decal id, falling back to the raw id.
---Accepts plain ids, rbxassetid:// strings or store URLs.
---@param input string
---@return string
local function resolveImage(input)
	if not input or input == "" then
		return ""
	end

	local assetId = input:match("(%d+)")
	if not assetId then
		return input
	end

	if resolvedImages[assetId] then
		return resolvedImages[assetId]
	end

	local result = "rbxassetid://" .. assetId
	local success, objects = pcall(getobjects, game, "rbxassetid://" .. assetId)

	if success then
		for _, object in ipairs(objects) do
			local decal = object:IsA("Decal") and object or object:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Decal", true)
			if decal and decal.Texture ~= "" then
				result = decal.Texture
				break
			end
		end
	end

	resolvedImages[assetId] = result
	return result
end

---Search the Creator Store's 2D (decal) category.
---@param query string
---@return table names, table idsByName
local function searchDecals(query)
	local response = request({
		Url = DECAL_SEARCH_URL .. httpService:UrlEncode(query),
		Method = "GET",
	})

	local names, ids = {}, {}
	local success, data = pcall(httpService.JSONDecode, httpService, response.Body)
	if not success or type(data.creatorStoreAssets) ~= "table" then
		return names, ids
	end

	for _, entry in ipairs(data.creatorStoreAssets) do
		local asset = entry.asset
		if asset then
			local name = string.sub(asset.name, 1, 28)
			if ids[name] then
				name = name .. " #" .. asset.id
			end

			ids[name] = asset.id
			table.insert(names, name)
		end
	end

	return names, ids
end

---Restyle a part, writing only the properties that differ from what we last applied.
---`record` remembers the applied values (and the part's originals for restoring).
---@param record table
---@param part BasePart
---@param material Enum.Material
---@param color Color3
---@param transparency number? nil leaves transparency alone
local function applyPartLook(record, part, material, color, transparency)
	if record.appliedMaterial ~= material then
		record.appliedMaterial = material
		part.Material = material
	end

	if record.appliedColor ~= color then
		record.appliedColor = color
		part.Color = color
	end

	if transparency and record.appliedTransparency ~= transparency then
		record.appliedTransparency = transparency
		part.Transparency = transparency
	end
end

---Material chams: a thin shell copied from every part of a character (packages, hats and
---custom meshes included), so the chams wrap the real body in the chosen material. A Highlight
---on the shells adds the outline (and a faint fill through walls).
local Chams = {}
Chams.__index = Chams

-- Images for textured looks (the same ones Tool Visuals uses for gun skins).
Chams.TEXTURES = {
	matrix = "rbxassetid://108962544192848",
	aurora = "rbxassetid://124100490232201",
	water = "rbxassetid://119639132290940",
