		button.TextColor3 = getAccent()
		button.ZIndex = 3
		button.Parent = quickHolder
		Instance.new("UICorner", button).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
		local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
		stroke.Color = getAccent()
		stroke.Parent = button
		return button
	end
	local grip = handle("≡", UDim2.fromOffset(-6, -6), Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5))
	local resizer = handle("◢", UDim2.new(1, 6, 1, 6), Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5))

	local barDrag = nil
	local lastGripTap = 0
	local function beginDrag(kind, input, fromBackground)
		if input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch and input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
			return
		end
		if kind == "move" and not fromBackground then
			if os.clock() - lastGripTap < 0.35 then
				-- Double tap: back above the hotbar, normal size.
				barState.custom, barState.scale = false, 1
				barDrag = nil
				applyBar()
				saveBar()
				lastGripTap = 0
				return
			end
			lastGripTap = os.clock()
		end
		local absolute, size = quickHolder.AbsolutePosition, quickHolder.AbsoluteSize
		barDrag = {
			kind = kind,
			start = Vector2.new(input.Position.X, input.Position.Y),
			anchor = Vector2.new(absolute.X + size.X / 2, absolute.Y + size.Y),
			scale = barState.scale,
		}
	end
	grip.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
		beginDrag("move", input)
	end)
	-- The bar's background (between and around the buttons) drags it too, so it can always be
	-- moved even if the small grip is hard to reach.
	quickFrame.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
		beginDrag("move", input, true)
	end)
	resizer.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
		beginDrag("resize", input)
	end)
	library:connection(userInputService.InputChanged, function(input)
		if not barDrag or (input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch and input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement) then
			return
		end
		local delta = Vector2.new(input.Position.X, input.Position.Y) - barDrag.start
		-- A plain tap (a few pixels of finger wobble) never moves or resizes it.
		if not barDrag.moved and delta.Magnitude < 8 then
			return
		end
		barDrag.moved = true
		if barDrag.kind == "move" then
			local spot = barDrag.anchor + delta
			barState.custom, barState.x, barState.y = true, spot.X, spot.Y
		else
			barState.scale = math.clamp(barDrag.scale + (delta.X + delta.Y) / 300, 0.6, 1.8)
		end
		applyBar()
	end)
	library:connection(userInputService.InputEnded, function(input)
		if barDrag and (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1) then
			local moved = barDrag.moved
			barDrag = nil
			if moved then
				saveBar()
			end
		end
	end)

	-- The bar used to sit on top of the game's hotbar, so tapping a gun slot hit our buttons
	-- instead and you couldn't equip. Until you move it, it sits just above the hotbar.
	task.spawn(function()
		local guiService = game:GetService("GuiService")
		while isCurrentRun() and quickFrame.Parent do
			if barState.custom then
				-- Re-checked so it settles fully on screen once the bar has its real size (the
				-- first check ran before its buttons were laid out).
				if not barDrag then
					applyBar()
				end
				task.wait(0.5)
				continue
			end
			local playerGui = localPlayer:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui")
			local toolbar = playerGui and playerGui:FindFirstChild("Toolbar", true)
			local lift = 10
			if toolbar and toolbar:IsA("GuiObject") and toolbar.Visible and toolbar.AbsoluteSize.Y > 0 then
				local holder = toolbar:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("ScreenGui")
				local inset = (holder and not holder.IgnoreGuiInset) and guiService:GetGuiInset().Y or 0
				local viewport = workspace.CurrentCamera.ViewportSize
				lift = math.max(10, viewport.Y - (toolbar.AbsolutePosition.Y + inset) + 8)
			end
			local position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 1, -lift)
			if quickHolder.Position ~= position then
				quickHolder.Position = position
			end
			task.wait(0.5)
		end
	end)

	local function setFlag(flag, enabled)
		local setter = library.config_flags and library.config_flags[flag]
		if setter then
			pcall(setter, enabled)
		else
			flags[flag] = enabled
		end
	end

	local function makeQuick(label, flag)
		local btn = Instance.new("TextButton")
		btn.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(74, 34)
		btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(32, 32, 40)
		btn.AutoButtonColor = false
		btn.Text = label
		btn.TextSize = 12
		btn.FontFace = library.font
		btn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 200, 210)
		btn.Parent = quickFrame
		Instance.new("UICorner", btn).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
		local function paint()
			local on = flags[flag] == true
			btn.BackgroundColor3 = on and getAccent() or Color3.fromRGB(32, 32, 40)
			btn.TextColor3 = on and Color3.new(1, 1, 1) or Color3.fromRGB(200, 200, 210)
		end
		paint()
		btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
			setFlag(flag, not (flags[flag] == true))
			paint()
		end)
		task.spawn(function()
			while isCurrentRun() and btn.Parent do
				task.wait(0.4)
				paint()
			end
		end)
	end

	---Rebuild the bar from Settings > Mobile > mobile buttons (any feature can have one, in place of
	---a keybind). Called once the features exist and whenever the selection changes.
	function Hooks.rebuildMobileButtons(featureList)
		for _, child in ipairs(quickFrame:GetChildren()) do
			if child:IsA("TextButton") then
				child:Destroy()
			end
		end
		local chosen = type(flags.mobile_buttons) == "table" and flags.mobile_buttons or {}
		for _, feature in ipairs(featureList) do
			if table.find(chosen, feature.name) then
				makeQuick(feature.name, feature.flag)
			end
		end
	end

	-- Fly down: phones have no Ctrl, so a held button lowers you while Fly is on.
	local flyDown = Instance.new("TextButton")
	flyDown.Name = ""
	flyDown.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 1)
	flyDown.Position = UDim2.new(1, -24, 1, -170)
	flyDown.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(56, 56)
	flyDown.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(32, 32, 40)
	flyDown.BackgroundTransparency = 0.2
	flyDown.AutoButtonColor = false
	flyDown.Text = "Down"
	flyDown.TextSize = 13
	flyDown.FontFace = library.font
	flyDown.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
	flyDown.Visible = false
	flyDown.Parent = toggleGui
	Instance.new("UICorner", flyDown).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
	flyDown.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
		if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
			Hooks.mobileFlyDown = true
		end
	end)
	flyDown.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
		if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
			Hooks.mobileFlyDown = false
		end
	end)
	library:connection(runService.Heartbeat, function()
		local show = flags.fly_enabled == true
		if flyDown.Visible ~= show then
			flyDown.Visible = show
			if not show then
				Hooks.mobileFlyDown = false
			end
		end
	end)

	local dragStart, buttonStart, dragged = nil, nil, false
	toggleButton.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
		if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
			dragStart, buttonStart, dragged = input.Position, toggleButton.Position, false
		end
	end)
	library:connection(userInputService.InputChanged, function(input)
		if not dragStart then
			return
		end
		if input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch and input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement then
			return
		end
		local delta = input.Position - dragStart
		if delta.Magnitude > 8 then
			dragged = true
		end
		if dragged then
			toggleButton.Position = UDim2.new(
				buttonStart.X.Scale,
				buttonStart.X.Offset + delta.X,
				buttonStart.Y.Scale,
				buttonStart.Y.Offset + delta.Y
			)
		end
	end)
	library:connection(userInputService.InputEnded, function(input)
		if input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch and input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
			return
		end
		if not dragStart then
			return
		end
		if not dragged then
			window.set_menu_visibility(not windowFrame.Visible)
		end
		dragStart, buttonStart, dragged = nil, nil, false
	end)

	library:connection(runService.Heartbeat, function()
		local accent = getAccent()
		if toggleButton.TextColor3 ~= accent then
			toggleButton.TextColor3 = accent
			toggleStroke.Color = accent
		end
	end)

	pcall(function()
		if library.config_flags.keybind_list then
			library.config_flags.keybind_list(false)
		end
	end)

	onUnload(function()
		toggleGui:Destroy()
	end)
end

---Put the "$$" the same distance from both ends of the title's drawn text (rich text tags
---threw off the box's own auto width, which left them lopsided).

	dollars[2].Position = UDim2.new(0.5, reach, 0.5, 0)
end

-- The logo decal recolored to the theme: read once into an EditableImage shrunk to 128px, keeping
-- its shading and edges, then repainted in the accent whenever the theme color changes.
Hooks.logoTint = { SIZE = 128, ready = false, paintedAt = 0 }
task.spawn(function()
	local tint = Hooks.logoTint
	local assetService = game:GetService("AssetService")
	local okSource, source = pcall(function()
		return assetService:CreateEditableImageAsync(Content.fromUri("rbxassetid://" .. logoAssetId))
	end)
	if not (okSource and source) then
		return
	end
	local okTarget, target = pcall(function()
		return assetService:CreateEditableImage({ Size = Vector2.new(tint.SIZE, tint.SIZE) })
	end)
	if not (okTarget and target) then
		source:Destroy()
		return
	end
	local width, height = source.Size.X, source.Size.Y
	local pixels = source:ReadPixelsBuffer(Vector2.zero, source.Size)
	source:Destroy()

	-- Each output pixel: average coverage, and brightness weighted by coverage, over its source cell.
	local size = tint.SIZE
	local cellX, cellY = width / size, height / size
	local stride = math.max(1, math.floor(math.min(cellX, cellY) / 4))
	tint.shade, tint.alpha = table.create(size * size, 0), table.create(size * size, 0)
	local brightest = 0.001
	for y = 0, size - 1 do
		for x = 0, size - 1 do
			local lumSum, alphaSum, count = 0, 0, 0
			for sy = math.floor(y * cellY), math.max(math.floor(y * cellY), math.floor((y + 1) * cellY) - 1), stride do
				for sx = math.floor(x * cellX), math.max(math.floor(x * cellX), math.floor((x + 1) * cellX) - 1), stride do
					local index = (sy * width + sx) * 4
					local a = buffer.readu8(pixels, index + 3) / 255
					local lum = (0.299 * buffer.readu8(pixels, index) + 0.587 * buffer.readu8(pixels, index + 1)
						+ 0.114 * buffer.readu8(pixels, index + 2)) / 255
					lumSum += lum * a
					alphaSum += a
					count += 1
				end
			end
			local slot = y * size + x + 1
			tint.alpha[slot] = count > 0 and alphaSum / count or 0
			tint.shade[slot] = alphaSum > 0 and lumSum / alphaSum or 0
			if tint.shade[slot] > brightest then
				brightest = tint.shade[slot]
			end
		end
		if y % 16 == 0 then
			task.wait()
		end
	end
	tint.brightest = brightest
	tint.target = target
	tint.out = buffer.create(size * size * 4)

	---Repaint the logo in `accent`: darker parts of the decal are deeper shades, its highlights glow lighter.
	function tint.paint(accent)
		local out = tint.out
		for slot = 1, size * size do
			local level = tint.shade[slot] / tint.brightest
			local k = 0.35 + 0.65 * level
			local glow = math.max(0, level - 0.8) * 1.5
			local base = (slot - 1) * 4
			buffer.writeu8(out, base, math.clamp(math.floor((accent.R * k + (1 - accent.R * k) * glow) * 255 + 0.5), 0, 255))
			buffer.writeu8(out, base + 1, math.clamp(math.floor((accent.G * k + (1 - accent.G * k) * glow) * 255 + 0.5), 0, 255))
			buffer.writeu8(out, base + 2, math.clamp(math.floor((accent.B * k + (1 - accent.B * k) * glow) * 255 + 0.5), 0, 255))
			buffer.writeu8(out, base + 3, math.clamp(math.floor(tint.alpha[slot] * 255 + 0.5), 0, 255))
		end
		tint.target:WritePixelsBuffer(Vector2.zero, tint.target.Size, out)
		tint.paintedAt = os.clock()
		tint.color = accent
	end

	tint.paint(getAccent())
	Hooks.headerLogoImage.ImageContent = Content.fromObject(target)
	tint.ready = true
end)

library:create("Frame", {
	Parent = headerRow,
	Name = "",
	Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, 1),
	Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 1),
	BorderSizePixel = 0,
	BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(57, 57, 57),
})

---The "aqua labs" brand as rich text. Split logo (like "name.cc"): "aqua" in white, "lab"
---in the theme color, the rest in the text color; otherwise all of it in the theme color.
---@return string
function Hooks.brandText()
	local accentHex = getAccent():ToHex()
	local devTag = Hooks.DEV_BUILD and ' <font color="#ffd700">dev build</font>' or ""
	if flags.header_split_logo == false then
		return string.format('<font color="#%s">aqua labs</font>%s', accentHex, devTag)
	end
	return string.format('<font color="#FFFFFF">aqua</font> <font color="#%s">labs</font>%s', accentHex, devTag)
end

---Redraw the header with the current accent and game name.
local function refreshHeader()
	local accent = getAccent()
	local accentHex = accent:ToHex()
	-- The corner logo is always your decal, recolored to the theme (Hooks.logoTint).
	-- Settings > Menu > "corner logo" hides the logo in the header's corner entirely.
	local showLogo = flags.header_logo ~= false
	Hooks.headerLogoImage.Visible = showLogo
	Hooks.headerLogoA.Visible = false
	for _, piece in ipairs(Hooks.headerLogoPieces or {}) do
		piece.BackgroundColor3 = accent
	end
	for _, dollar in ipairs(Hooks.headerDollars or {}) do
		dollar.Visible = flags.header_dollars ~= false
	end

	headerTitle.Text = string.format(
		'%s - %s  <font transparency="0.5">|</font>  <font color="#%s">%s</font>',
		Hooks.brandText(),
		DISCORD_INVITE,
		accentHex,
		headerGameName
	)
	headerTitle.TextColor3 = getTextColor()
end
Hooks.refreshHeader = refreshHeader

headerTitle.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	setclipboard(DISCORD_INVITE)
	library:notification({ text = "Copied Discord invite." })
end)

refreshHeader()

-- The theme picker and rainbow never call refreshHeader, so the logo kept its first color.
-- Repaint the decal whenever the accent changes (at most 20 times a second for rainbow).
library:connection(runService.Heartbeat, function()
	local tint = Hooks.logoTint
	if not (tint.ready and Hooks.headerLogoImage.Visible) then
		return
	end
	local accent = getAccent()
	if tint.color == accent or os.clock() - tint.paintedAt < 0.05 then
		return
	end
	pcall(tint.paint, accent)
end)

do
	local libraryOverlays = {}

	-- The keybind list is the top-level frame that holds library.keybind_path.
	local keybindRoot = library.keybind_path
	while keybindRoot and keybindRoot.Parent ~= library.gui do
		keybindRoot = keybindRoot.Parent
	end
	table.insert(libraryOverlays, keybindRoot)

	-- The watermark is the top-level frame whose label animates "... | private".
	for _, child in ipairs(library.gui:GetChildren()) do
		for _, descendant in ipairs(child:GetDescendants()) do
			if descendant:IsA("TextLabel") and descendant.Text:find("private", 1, true) then
				table.insert(libraryOverlays, child)
				break
			end
		end
	end

	for _, overlay in ipairs(libraryOverlays) do
		overlay.Visible = false
		library:connection(overlay:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Visible"), function()
			if overlay.Visible then
				overlay.Visible = false
			end
		end)
	end
end

local keybindHolder, keybindContent = createOverlay(UDim2.new(0, 20, 0.5, -60))
-- Fixed-width layout: a centered title over a divider, then one row per feature with the
-- name on the left and its key on the right. Every row shares the widest row's width.
local KEYBIND_MIN_WIDTH = 150

local keybindTitle = createOverlayText(keybindContent, "keybinds")
keybindTitle.LayoutOrder = -2
keybindTitle.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
keybindTitle.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.None
keybindTitle.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(KEYBIND_MIN_WIDTH, 16)
keybindHolder.Visible = false

local keybindDivider = library:create("Frame", {
	Parent = keybindContent,
	Name = "",
	LayoutOrder = -1,
	BorderSizePixel = 0,
	BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(57, 57, 57),
	Size = UDim2.fromOffset(KEYBIND_MIN_WIDTH, 1),
})

local keybindRows = {}

local emptyKeybindRow = createOverlayText(keybindContent, "no keys bound")
emptyKeybindRow.LayoutOrder = 1000
emptyKeybindRow.TextColor3 = DULL_TEXT
emptyKeybindRow.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
emptyKeybindRow.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.None
emptyKeybindRow.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(KEYBIND_MIN_WIDTH, 14)

---One list row: feature name (left) and key/mode (right).
---@param order number
---@return table
local function createKeybindRow(order)
	local frame = library:create("Frame", {
		Parent = keybindContent,
		Name = "",
		LayoutOrder = order,
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		Size = UDim2.fromOffset(KEYBIND_MIN_WIDTH, 14),
		Visible = false,
	})

	local name = createOverlayText(frame, "")
	name.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.None
	name.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)

	local state = createOverlayText(frame, "")
	state.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.None
	state.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	state.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right

	return { frame = frame, name = name, state = state }
end

---Give the title, divider and every row the same width.
local function resizeKeybindList()
	local width = KEYBIND_MIN_WIDTH
	for _, row in pairs(keybindRows) do
		if row.frame.Visible then
			width = math.max(width, row.name.TextBounds.X + row.state.TextBounds.X + 18)
		end
	end

	width = math.ceil(width)
	keybindTitle.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(width, 16)
	keybindDivider.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(width, 1)
	emptyKeybindRow.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(width, 14)
	for _, row in pairs(keybindRows) do
		row.frame.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(width, 14)
	end
end

---Redraw the keybind list: bound features, plus features that are on without a key.
refreshKeybindList = function()
	local anyBound = false
	local changed = false

	for index, feature in ipairs(features) do
		local row = keybindRows[feature]
		if not row then
			row = createKeybindRow(index)
			keybindRows[feature] = row
		end

		local bind = flags[feature.bindFlag]
		local key = type(bind) == "table" and bind.key or nil
		local mode = type(bind) == "table" and bind.mode or "toggle"
		local enabled = flags[feature.flag] == true

		-- Rows only update when something changed.
		local bound = typeof(key) == "EnumItem"
		local activeUnbound = not bound and enabled and flags.keybind_list_active == true and feature.listActive ~= false
		local show = bound or activeUnbound
		local stateText = bound and string.format("%s  %s", getKeyName(key), mode) or "on"

		local color = enabled and getAccent() or DULL_TEXT
		local stateKey = (show and "1" or "0") .. stateText .. color:ToHex()

		if feature.rowState ~= stateKey then
			feature.rowState = stateKey
			changed = true
			row.frame.Visible = show
			row.name.Text = feature.name
			row.name.TextColor3 = color
			row.state.Text = stateText
			row.state.TextColor3 = DULL_TEXT
		end

		anyBound = anyBound or show
	end

	-- With nothing bound, show a hint row instead of an empty box.
	if emptyKeybindRow.Visible == anyBound then
		emptyKeybindRow.Visible = not anyBound
	end

	if changed then
		resizeKeybindList()
		task.defer(resizeKeybindList)
	end

	-- Shown whenever the "Keybind List" toggle in settings is on.
	-- Phones can't bind keys, so the keybind list stays hidden there.
	local showPanel = flags.keybind_list ~= false and not Hooks.isMobile
	if keybindHolder.Visible ~= showPanel then
		keybindHolder.Visible = showPanel
	end
end

-- Main tab.
local mainTab = window:tab({ name = "main" })

-- Every tab is made up front so each feature can go where it belongs, in this order:
-- main (movement, character), combat (aiming, guns), esp, visuals (you, screen, effects),
-- world (lighting, map), misc (Prison Life tools), players, then settings.
Tabs.combat = window:tab({ name = "combat" })
Tabs.esp = window:tab({ name = "esp" })
Tabs.visuals = window:tab({ name = "visuals" })
Tabs.world = window:tab({ name = "world" })
Tabs.misc = window:tab({ name = "misc" })
Tabs.players = window:tab({ name = "players" })
-- Premium: empty for now.
Tabs.premium = window:tab({ name = "premium" })
local movementSection = mainTab:section({ name = "Movement" })

addFeature(movementSection, {
	name = "Noclip",
	flag = "noclip_enabled",
	callback = function(enabled)
		if enabled then
			enableNoclip()
		else
			disableNoclip()
		end
	end,
})

-- Void: sit under the map (hide). Toggle off to return to last ground.
do
	local voidSection = mainTab:section({ name = "Void", side = "left" })
	local lastVoidCFrame = nil
	addFeature(voidSection, {
		name = "Void",
		flag = "void_enabled",
		callback = function(enabled)
			local character = localPlayer.Character
			local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			if not root then
				return
			end
			if enabled then
				lastVoidCFrame = root.CFrame
				local depth = flags.void_depth or -20
				root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
				root.CFrame = CFrame.new(root.Position.X, depth, root.Position.Z)
			elseif lastVoidCFrame then
				root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
				root.CFrame = lastVoidCFrame + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0)
			end
		end,
	})
	-- Higher = closer under the floor (e.g. -5); lower = deeper void (e.g. -200).
	voidSection:slider({ name = "void height", flag = "void_depth", min = -500, max = -1, default = -20, interval = 1, suffix = " y" })
	library:connection(runService.Heartbeat, function()
		if not flags.void_enabled or isTyping() or Hooks.grabbing then
			return
		end
		local root = localPlayer.Character and localPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		if not root then
			return
		end
		local depth = flags.void_depth or -20
		if math.abs(root.Position.Y - depth) > 1 then
			root.CFrame = CFrame.new(root.Position.X, depth, root.Position.Z)
		end
		root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
	end)
end

do
	-- Spinbot: spin your character in place. AutoRotate is paused so the humanoid
	-- doesn't keep snapping you back to your walk direction.
	local spinAngle = 0
	local pausedAutoRotate = nil

	---Give the humanoid its own facing control back.
	local function restoreAutoRotate()
		if pausedAutoRotate and pausedAutoRotate.Parent then
			pausedAutoRotate.AutoRotate = true
		end
		pausedAutoRotate = nil
	end

	addFeature(movementSection, {
		name = "Spinbot",
		flag = "spinbot_enabled",
		callback = function(enabled)
			if not enabled then
				restoreAutoRotate()
			end
		end,
	})
	movementSection:slider({ name = "spin speed", flag = "spinbot_speed", min = 0.25, max = 10, default = 3, interval = 0.25, suffix = "rps" })

	-- TP walk: moves you a little extra each frame in the direction you're walking.
	-- Speed is hard capped, big frame spikes are clamped, and it never steps into a wall
	-- or off a ledge with nothing under it, so you can't shoot out of the map.
	addFeature(movementSection, { name = "TP Walk", flag = "tpwalk_enabled" })
	movementSection:slider({ name = "tp walk speed", flag = "tpwalk_speed", min = 1, max = TPWALK_MAX_SPEED, default = 20, interval = 1, suffix = " st/s" })
	movementSection:toggle({ name = "edge protection", flag = "tpwalk_edge_guard", default = true })

	local movementParams = RaycastParams.new()
	movementParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude

	library:connection(runService.Heartbeat, function(deltaTime)
		local character = localPlayer.Character
		local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

		if not (humanoid and root and humanoid.Health > 0) or Hooks.grabbing then
			return
		end

		-- Spinbot (paused while you're in any seat, so driving works normally).
		if flags.spinbot_enabled and humanoid.SeatPart then
			restoreAutoRotate()
		elseif flags.spinbot_enabled then
			if humanoid.AutoRotate then
				humanoid.AutoRotate = false
				pausedAutoRotate = humanoid
			end

			spinAngle = (spinAngle + deltaTime * (flags.spinbot_speed or 3) * math.pi * 2) % (math.pi * 2)
			root.CFrame = CFrame.new(root.Position) * CFrame.Angles(0, spinAngle, 0)
		end

		-- TP walk.
		-- Seated (cars, chairs): don't drag the seat around.
		local direction = humanoid.MoveDirection
		if not flags.tpwalk_enabled or isTyping() or direction.Magnitude < 0.05 or humanoid.Sit then
			return
		end

		-- Clamp the frame time so a lag spike can't turn into one giant teleport.
		local speed = math.clamp(flags.tpwalk_speed or 12, 1, TPWALK_MAX_SPEED)
		local step = direction.Unit * speed * math.min(deltaTime, 1 / 30)

		movementParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = { character, workspace.CurrentCamera }

		-- Stop at walls instead of tunnelling through them (unless noclip is on).
		if not flags.noclip_enabled then
			local wall = workspace:Raycast(root.Position, step.Unit * (step.Magnitude + 1.5), movementParams)
			if wall then
				return
			end
		end

		-- Don't step off into the void: there must be ground under the new spot.
		if flags.tpwalk_edge_guard ~= false then
			local ground = workspace:Raycast(root.Position + step, Vector3.new(0, -TPWALK_GROUND_CHECK, 0), movementParams)
			if not ground then
				return
			end
		end

		root.CFrame += step
	end)

	onUnload(restoreAutoRotate)

	-- Infinite jump: every jump press jumps again, even mid-air.
	addFeature(movementSection, { name = "Infinite Jump", flag = "infinite_jump" })

	library:connection(userInputService.JumpRequest, function()
		if not flags.infinite_jump then
			return
		end

		local humanoid = localPlayer.Character and localPlayer.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		if humanoid then
			humanoid:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping)
		end
	end)

	-- Anti sit: every chair outside the car folder is removed on your side (car seats in
	-- workspace.CarContainer are never touched), so nothing can sit you down. Chairs come back
	-- when it's turned off.
	local function buildAntiSit()
		addFeature(movementSection, { name = "Anti Sit", flag = "anti_sit" })
		local removedSeats = {}
		local seatWatcher = nil

		local function isChair(object)
			-- Fake Position's own seat must stay, or it stops working.
			if object:GetAttribute("AquaSeat") then
				return false
			end
			local cars = workspace:FindFirstChild("CarContainer")
			return object:IsA("Seat") or (object:IsA("VehicleSeat") and not (cars and object:IsDescendantOf(cars)))
		end

		local function removeSeat(object)
			local cars = workspace:FindFirstChild("CarContainer")
			if isChair(object) and not (cars and object:IsDescendantOf(cars)) and object.Parent then
				table.insert(removedSeats, { seat = object, parent = object.Parent })
				object.Parent = nil
			end
		end

		local function setSeatsRemoved(enabled)
			if seatWatcher then
				seatWatcher:Disconnect()
				seatWatcher = nil
			end
			if enabled then
				for _, object in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
					removeSeat(object)
				end
				seatWatcher = workspace.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(object)
					task.defer(removeSeat, object)
				end)
			else
				for _, entry in ipairs(removedSeats) do
					if entry.parent.Parent then
						entry.seat.Parent = entry.parent
					end
				end
				table.clear(removedSeats)
			end
		end

		library:connection(runService.Heartbeat, function()
			local wanted = flags.anti_sit == true
			if wanted ~= (seatWatcher ~= nil) then
				setSeatsRemoved(wanted)
			end
		end)

		onUnload(function()
			setSeatsRemoved(false)
		end)
	end

	buildAntiSit()

	-- Fly: camera-directed flight (WASD, Space up, Ctrl down), speed capped like TP walk.
	local FLY_MAX_SPEED = 250
	addFeature(movementSection, { name = "Fly", flag = "fly_enabled", callback = function(enabled)
		local character = localPlayer.Character
		local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		if not enabled and humanoid then
			humanoid:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Freefall)
		end
	end })
	movementSection:slider({ name = "fly speed", flag = "fly_speed", min = 5, max = FLY_MAX_SPEED, default = 30, interval = 1, suffix = " st/s" })
	movementSection:dropdown({ name = "fly method", flag = "fly_method", items = { "Velocity", "CFrame", "BodyVelocity" }, default = "Velocity" })

	local flyBodyVelocity = nil
	library:connection(runService.Heartbeat, function(deltaTime)
		-- Get Weapons is holding you at a gun rack: fly lets go until it's done.
		if not flags.fly_enabled or Hooks.grabbing then
			if flyBodyVelocity then
				flyBodyVelocity:Destroy()
				flyBodyVelocity = nil
			end
			return
		end

		local character = localPlayer.Character
		local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		if not (humanoid and root and humanoid.Health > 0) or humanoid.Sit then
			return
		end

		local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
		local direction = Vector3.zero

		-- While typing in chat, keep hovering in place but ignore WASD / Space / Ctrl so keys go to chat.
		if not isTyping() then
			local move = humanoid.MoveDirection
			if move.Magnitude > 0.05 then
				local look = camera.CFrame.LookVector
				local flat = Vector3.new(look.X, 0, look.Z)
				local forwardAmount = flat.Magnitude > 0 and move:Dot(flat.Unit) or 0
				direction = move + Vector3.new(0, look.Y * forwardAmount, 0)
			end
			if userInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.Space) or (Hooks.isMobile and humanoid.Jump) then
				direction += Vector3.yAxis
			end
			if userInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftControl) or Hooks.mobileFlyDown then
				direction -= Vector3.yAxis
			end
		end

		local speed = math.clamp(flags.fly_speed or 30, 5, FLY_MAX_SPEED)
		local method = flags.fly_method or "Velocity"
		local vel = direction.Magnitude > 0 and direction.Unit * speed or Vector3.zero

		if method == "CFrame" then
			root.CFrame = root.CFrame + vel * deltaTime
			root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
		elseif method == "BodyVelocity" then
			if not flyBodyVelocity or flyBodyVelocity.Parent ~= root then
				if flyBodyVelocity then flyBodyVelocity:Destroy() end
				flyBodyVelocity = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
				-- Unlimited force so high speeds hold steady instead of sagging or stalling.
				flyBodyVelocity.MaxForce = Vector3.one * math.huge
				flyBodyVelocity.P = 1e4
				flyBodyVelocity.Parent = root
			end
			flyBodyVelocity.Velocity = vel
		else
			-- Velocity hover: fully cancel gravity so you stay still in the air.
			root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = vel + Vector3.new(0, workspace.Gravity * deltaTime, 0)
		end
		if humanoid:GetState() ~= Enum.HumanoidStateType.Physics then
			humanoid:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Freefall)
		end
	end)

end

do

	-- Fake Position (seat lag core only, no GUI).
	do
		local lagSection = mainTab:section({ name = "Fake Position", side = "right" })
		local seatHolder, vehicleSeat, weld, lagConn, storedAnimate
		local createLagSeat, removeLagSeat

		-- On and off straight from the toggle (and its keybind); the loop below only rebuilds the
		-- seat if something deletes it while on.
		addFeature(lagSection, {
			name = "Fake Position",
			flag = "fake_position",
			callback = function(enabled)
				-- The toggle fires once while it's being built, before the seat functions exist.
				if not createLagSeat then
					return
				end
				if enabled and Hooks.isPremium() then
					createLagSeat()
				else
					removeLagSeat()
				end
			end,
		})

		function removeLagSeat()
			if lagConn then
				lagConn:Disconnect()
				lagConn = nil
			end
			if weld then pcall(function() weld:Destroy() end) end
			if vehicleSeat then pcall(function() vehicleSeat:Destroy() end) end
			if seatHolder then pcall(function() seatHolder:Destroy() end) end
			weld, vehicleSeat, seatHolder = nil, nil, nil
			local char = localPlayer.Character
			if storedAnimate and char and not char:FindFirstChild("Animate") then
				storedAnimate.Parent = char
			end
			storedAnimate = nil
		end

		function createLagSeat()
			removeLagSeat()
			local char = localPlayer.Character
			local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			if not hrp then return end
			seatHolder = Instance.new("Part")
			seatHolder.Name = "AquaSeatHolder"
			seatHolder.Size = Vector3.new(1.5, 1.5, 1.5)
			seatHolder.Position = hrp.Position + Vector3.new(0, 5, 0)
			seatHolder.Anchored = true
			seatHolder.CanCollide = false
			seatHolder.Transparency = 1
			seatHolder.Parent = workspace
			vehicleSeat = Instance.new("VehicleSeat")
			vehicleSeat.Name = "AquaSeatObject"
			-- Tagged so Anti Sit leaves it alone.
			vehicleSeat:SetAttribute("AquaSeat", true)
			vehicleSeat.Parent = seatHolder
			vehicleSeat.Position = seatHolder.Position + Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)
			vehicleSeat.CanCollide = false
			vehicleSeat.Transparency = 1
			weld = Instance.new("Weld")
			weld.Part0 = hrp
			weld.Part1 = vehicleSeat
			weld.Parent = vehicleSeat
			lagConn = runService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
				for _ = 1, 500 do
					workspace:FindFirstChild("NonExistentObject")
				end
			end)
			storedAnimate = char:FindFirstChild("Animate")
			if storedAnimate then
				storedAnimate.Parent = nil
			end
		end

		Hooks.premiumGate(lagSection, "Fake Position", "fake_position")

		library:connection(runService.Heartbeat, function()
			local on = flags.fake_position == true and Hooks.isPremium()
			local broken = vehicleSeat == nil or vehicleSeat.Parent == nil or weld == nil or weld.Parent == nil
			if on and broken then
				createLagSeat()
			elseif not on and seatHolder then
				removeLagSeat()
			end
		end)

		library:connection(localPlayer.CharacterAdded, function()
			if flags.fake_position then
				-- disable on respawn for clean state
				if library.config_flags and library.config_flags.fake_position then
					library.config_flags.fake_position(false)
				else
					flags.fake_position = false
				end
			end
			removeLagSeat()
		end)

		onUnload(removeLagSeat)
	end

	-- Orbit: circle a target (height can go under the map). Mouse keybind locks closest in FOV.
	local orbitSection = mainTab:section({ name = "Orbit", side = "right" })

	addFeature(orbitSection, { name = "Orbit", flag = "tools_orbit" })
	orbitSection:slider({ name = "orbit speed", flag = "tools_orbit_speed", min = 0.5, max = 60, default = 3, interval = 0.5, suffix = " rps" })
	orbitSection:dropdown({ name = "orbit mode", flag = "tools_orbit_mode", items = { "Circle", "Random TP" }, default = "Circle" })
	orbitSection:slider({ name = "random tp spread", flag = "tools_orbit_spread", min = 2, max = 30, default = 8, interval = 0.5, suffix = " studs" })
	orbitSection:slider({ name = "random tp delay", flag = "tools_orbit_tp_delay", min = 0, max = 0.25, default = 0, interval = 0.01, suffix = "s" })
	orbitSection:toggle({ name = "only orbit unforcefielded", flag = "tools_orbit_unff_only", default = false })
	orbitSection:slider({ name = "orbit height", flag = "tools_orbit_height", min = -200, max = 50, default = 6, interval = 0.5, suffix = " studs" })
	orbitSection:slider({ name = "orbit distance", flag = "tools_orbit_radius", min = 0, max = 40, default = 8, interval = 0.5, suffix = " studs" })
	orbitSection:toggle({ name = "void on forcefield", flag = "tools_orbit_void", default = true })
	orbitSection:slider({ name = "void height", flag = "tools_orbit_void_depth", min = -500, max = -1, default = -20, interval = 1, suffix = " y" })
	orbitSection:slider({ name = "mouse FOV", flag = "orbit_mouse_fov", min = 40, max = 600, default = 180, interval = 5, suffix = " px" })
	-- Car Orbit: while driving, the car circles the orbit target instead of you.
	addFeature(orbitSection, { name = "Car Orbit", flag = "tools_car_orbit" })
	orbitSection:slider({ name = "car orbit speed", flag = "tools_car_orbit_speed", min = 0.1, max = 5, default = 0.8, interval = 0.1, suffix = " rps" })
	orbitSection:slider({ name = "car orbit distance", flag = "tools_car_orbit_radius", min = 4, max = 60, default = 14, interval = 0.5, suffix = " studs" })
	orbitSection:slider({ name = "car orbit height", flag = "tools_car_orbit_height", min = -50, max = 50, default = 0, interval = 0.5, suffix = " studs" })
	-- Car Orbit only works while you drive, so this gets you into a car when needed.
	orbitSection:toggle({ name = "auto spawn car", flag = "tools_car_orbit_spawn", default = true })

	---Closest living player to the mouse cursor (prefer in FOV, else any on-screen).
	local function closestToMouseInFov()
		local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
		if not camera then
			return nil
		end
		-- Touch screens have no cursor: pick from the middle of the screen instead.
		local touch = Hooks.isMobile or (userInputService.TouchEnabled and not userInputService.MouseEnabled)
		local mouse = touch and camera.ViewportSize / 2 or userInputService:GetMouseLocation()
		local maxPx = tonumber(flags.orbit_mouse_fov) or 180
		local bestInFov, bestInFovDist = nil, maxPx
		local bestAny, bestAnyDist = nil, math.huge
		for _, player in ipairs(playersService:GetPlayers()) do
			if player == localPlayer then
				continue
			end
			if isGloballyWhitelisted(player) then
				continue
			end
			local char = player.Character
			local humanoid = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
			local root = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			if not (humanoid and root and humanoid.Health > 0) then
				continue
			end
			local screen, onScreen = camera:WorldToViewportPoint(root.Position)
			if screen.Z <= 0 then
				continue
			end
			-- Allow slightly off-screen edges (onScreen can be false near borders).
			local dist = (Vector2.new(screen.X, screen.Y) - mouse).Magnitude
			if dist < bestAnyDist then
				bestAny, bestAnyDist = player, dist
			end
			if dist <= maxPx and dist <= bestInFovDist then
				bestInFov, bestInFovDist = player, dist
			end
		end
		return bestInFov or bestAny
	end

	-- Phantom: everyone else sees your body blinking around a target, randomly 15 studs above or
	-- below them every split second, shooting down / up at them, while on your screen you walk
	-- around normally and watch a glowing ghost of yourself where the server has you. Same
	-- after-physics swap as Anti Aim's Desync (real position back before the camera draws).
	-- Target: the player nearest your cursor when you turn it on (keybind), or Players tab > Phantom.
	-- Own function scope: this block is close to the 200-local limit.
	;(function()
		Hooks.phantom = { target = nil, queued = nil, real = nil, fake = nil, nextHop = 0, offset = nil, history = {}, ghost = nil }
		local Phantom = Hooks.phantom
		local RENDER_KEY = "AquaPhantom"

		---Whether Phantom is running: it then owns your body, so Invisible, Anti Aim, Anti Punch,
		---Orbit and Ragebot / Triggerbot stand down.
		function Hooks.phantomActive()
			return flags.phantom_enabled == true and Phantom.target ~= nil
		end
		table.insert(Hooks.desyncResets, function()
			Phantom.real = nil
		end)

		---Flip the toggle (so the keybind list and button labels follow).
		function Phantom.set(enabled)
			local setter = library.config_flags.phantom_enabled
			if setter then
				setter(enabled)
			else
				flags.phantom_enabled = enabled
				Phantom.toggle(enabled)
			end
		end

		---Remove the ghost.
		function Phantom.clearGhost()
			local ghost = Phantom.ghost
			Phantom.ghost = nil
			if ghost then
				for _, connection in ipairs(ghost.connections) do
					connection:Disconnect()
				end
				pcall(ghost.model.Destroy, ghost.model)
			end
		end

		---Copy your character into a see-through glowing ghost (only on your screen), each part
		---paired with the real one it mirrors.
		function Phantom.buildGhost(character)
			Phantom.clearGhost()
			local originals = {}
			for _, part in ipairs(character:GetDescendants()) do
				if part:IsA("BasePart") then
					table.insert(originals, part)
					part:SetAttribute("AquaPhantom", #originals)
				end
			end
			local archivable = character.Archivable
			character.Archivable = true
			local ok, copy = pcall(character.Clone, character)
			character.Archivable = archivable
			for _, part in ipairs(originals) do
				part:SetAttribute("AquaPhantom", nil)
			end
			if not (ok and copy) then
				return
			end
			local ghost = { model = copy, character = character, pairs = {}, connections = {} }
			for _, object in ipairs(copy:GetDescendants()) do
				if object:IsA("BaseScript") or object:IsA("Sound") or object:IsA("ForceField") or object:IsA("JointInstance")
					or object:IsA("Constraint") or object:IsA("ParticleEmitter") or object:IsA("Light") or object:IsA("Highlight")
					or object:IsA("Beam") or object:IsA("Trail") then
					object:Destroy()
				elseif object:IsA("BasePart") then
					local index = object:GetAttribute("AquaPhantom")
					object:SetAttribute("AquaPhantom", nil)
					object.Anchored = true
					object.CanCollide, object.CanQuery, object.CanTouch, object.CastShadow = false, false, false, false
					object.Transparency = object.Name == "HumanoidRootPart" and 1 or math.max(object.Transparency, 0.45)
					if index and originals[index] then
						table.insert(ghost.pairs, { originals[index], object })
					end
				elseif object:IsA("Humanoid") then
					object.DisplayDistanceType = Enum.HumanoidDisplayDistanceType.None
				end
			end
			copy.Name = ""
			local glow = Instance.new("Highlight")
			glow.Name = ""
			glow.DepthMode = Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop
			glow.FillTransparency = 0.55
			glow.OutlineTransparency = 0
			glow.Adornee = copy
			glow.Parent = copy
			ghost.glow = glow
			copy.Parent = workspace
			-- Re-copy when you pull out / put away a tool, so the ghost holds the same gun.
			local function dirty()
				ghost.dirty = true
			end
			table.insert(ghost.connections, character.ChildAdded:Connect(dirty))
			table.insert(ghost.connections, character.ChildRemoved:Connect(dirty))
			Phantom.ghost = ghost
		end

		---Toggle callback: lock a target (queued from the Players tab, else nearest your cursor).
		function Phantom.toggle(enabled)
			if not enabled then
				Phantom.target, Phantom.queued, Phantom.fake = nil, nil, nil
				Phantom.clearGhost()
				return
			end
			local target = Phantom.queued or closestToMouseInFov()
			Phantom.queued = nil
			if not target then
				library:notification({ text = "Phantom: no player near your cursor.", time = 2 })
				task.defer(Phantom.set, false)
				return
			end
			Phantom.target = target
			Phantom.offset, Phantom.history = nil, {}
			library:notification({ text = "Phantom on " .. target.DisplayName, time = 2 })
		end

		Phantom.rayParams = RaycastParams.new()
		Phantom.rayParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude

		---Whether a phantom body at `spot` has a clear shot from its head to `aimAt`.
		function Phantom.sees(spot, aimAt)
			local eye = spot + Vector3.new(0, 1.5, 0)
			local hit = workspace:Raycast(eye, aimAt - eye, Phantom.rayParams)
			return hit == nil
		end

		---Next orbit stop around the target: 50-100 degrees further round than the last one, at a
		---random height above them. Walks further round until a spot can see their head.
		---Nil when nothing in reach can see them (keeps the last one).
		function Phantom.pickOffset(base, aimAt)
			local distance = flags.phantom_distance or 15
			Phantom.angle = Phantom.angle or math.random() * math.pi * 2
			local step = math.rad(50 + math.random() * 50)
			for attempt = 1, 18 do
				local angle = Phantom.angle + step * attempt
				-- Later attempts also try straight overhead / lower heights.
				local rise = attempt <= 12 and distance * (0.2 + math.random() * 0.7) or distance * math.random()
				local flat = math.sqrt(math.max(0, distance * distance - rise * rise))
				local offset = Vector3.new(math.cos(angle) * flat, rise, math.sin(angle) * flat)
				if Phantom.sees(base + offset, aimAt) then
					Phantom.angle = angle
					return offset
				end
			end
			return nil
		end

		---Players tab: phantom this player (or stop if already on them).
		function Phantom.startOn(player)
			if flags.phantom_enabled and Phantom.target == player then
				return Phantom.set(false)
			end
			if flags.phantom_enabled then
				Phantom.target = player
				Phantom.offset, Phantom.history = nil, {}
				return library:notification({ text = "Phantom on " .. player.DisplayName, time = 2 })
			end
			Phantom.queued = player
			Phantom.set(true)
		end

		addFeature(orbitSection, { name = "Phantom", flag = "phantom_enabled", rage = true, callback = function(enabled)
			Phantom.toggle(enabled)
		end })
		orbitSection:slider({ name = "phantom distance", flag = "phantom_distance", min = 6, max = 30, default = 15, interval = 1, suffix = " studs" })
		-- Time on each random spot. Shots need a spot held a few frames, so very low = fewer shots.
		orbitSection:slider({ name = "phantom hop delay", flag = "phantom_hop_delay", min = 0.03, max = 0.2, default = 0.05, interval = 0.005, suffix = "s" })
		-- How far behind the server's copy of you runs (plus half your ping). Shots go out from
		-- where you were this long ago; tune it if shots stop landing.
		orbitSection:slider({ name = "phantom sync", flag = "phantom_sync", min = 0, max = 0.3, default = 0.06, interval = 0.005, suffix = "s" })
		orbitSection:toggle({ name = "phantom shoots", flag = "phantom_shoot", default = true })
		orbitSection:colorpicker({ name = "phantom ghost color", flag = "phantom_color", color = Color3.fromRGB(150, 110, 255) })

		-- After physics: move the body to the phantom spot (that's what replicates) and shoot from it.
		library:connection(runService.Heartbeat, function()
			local target = Phantom.target
			if not (flags.phantom_enabled and target) then
				return
			end
			if target.Parent ~= playersService then
				library:notification({ text = "Phantom: they left.", time = 2 })
				return Phantom.set(false)
			end
			local character = localPlayer.Character
			local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
			local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			if not (humanoid and root and humanoid.Health > 0) then
				return
			end
			-- A seat would drag the phantom spot along with it.
			if humanoid.SeatPart then
				humanoid.Sit = false
				return
			end
			local targetCharacter = target.Character
			local targetHumanoid = targetCharacter and targetCharacter:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
			local targetRoot = targetCharacter and targetCharacter:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			if not (targetHumanoid and targetRoot and targetHumanoid.Health > 0) then
				return
			end

			-- Never stops: a new random spot around them (under the map, beside them, over their head)
			-- every hop. The server's copy of you runs a moment behind, so shots go out from where you
			-- were that moment ago - the spot the server has you on right now.
			local now = os.clock()
			local ping = math.clamp(localPlayer:GetNetworkPing(), 0, 0.3)
			local base = targetRoot.Position + targetRoot.AssemblyLinearVelocity * ping
			local aimPart = targetCharacter:FindFirstChild(flags.rage_part or "Head") or targetCharacter:FindFirstChild("Head") or targetRoot
			local aimAt = aimPart.Position
			local ignore = { character, targetCharacter, Phantom.ghost and Phantom.ghost.model or nil }
			-- Cars don't block spots when the shot will go through them anyway.
			local carContainer = Hooks._carContainer
			if carContainer and Hooks._carWallbangAllowed and Hooks._carWallbangAllowed(aimPart) then
				table.insert(ignore, carContainer)
			end
			Phantom.rayParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = ignore

			-- Random spot anywhere on a sphere around them (top or bottom half alike), new every hop.
			if now >= (Phantom.nextHop or 0) or not Phantom.offset then
				local distance = flags.phantom_distance or 15
				local angle = math.random() * math.pi * 2
				local rise = distance * (math.random() * 2 - 1)
				local flat = math.sqrt(math.max(0, distance * distance - rise * rise))
				Phantom.offset = Vector3.new(math.cos(angle) * flat, rise, math.sin(angle) * flat)
				Phantom.nextHop = now + math.max(flags.phantom_hop_delay or 0.05, 0.03)
			end
			local spot = base + Phantom.offset
			local look = Vector3.new(targetRoot.Position.X, spot.Y, targetRoot.Position.Z)
			local fake = (look - spot).Magnitude > 0.05 and CFrame.lookAt(spot, look) or CFrame.new(spot)

			Phantom.real = root.CFrame
			root.CFrame = fake
			Phantom.fake = fake

			-- Last word before the position is sent: if anything else moved you this frame after us,
			-- put the body back on the phantom spot.
			task.defer(function()
				if Phantom.fake == fake and Phantom.real and root.Parent and (root.Position - fake.Position).Magnitude > 0.5 then
					root.CFrame = fake
				end
			end)

			-- Where your head went out this frame, kept for a second.
			local head = character:FindFirstChild("Head")
			local history = Phantom.history
			table.insert(history, { now, head and head.Position or spot })
			while history[1] and now - history[1][1] > 1 do
				table.remove(history, 1)
			end

			-- Shoot from where the server has you: your spot from `sync` ago, but only when every
			-- frame around that moment was on the same spot (so being a frame off doesn't matter).
			local wantsShot = (flags.rage_enabled or flags.phantom_shoot ~= false)
				and not targetCharacter:FindFirstChildOfClass("ForceField")
			if not (wantsShot and Hooks.phantomFire) then
				return
			end
			local sync = (flags.phantom_sync or 0.06) + ping * 0.5
			local margin = 0.02
			local origin, low, high = nil, nil, nil
			for _, entry in ipairs(history) do
				local age = now - entry[1]
				if math.abs(age - sync) <= margin then
					low = low or entry[2]
					high = entry[2]
					if (entry[2] - low).Magnitude > 3 then
						return
					end
					if not origin or math.abs(age - sync) < origin[1] then
						origin = { math.abs(age - sync), entry[2] }
					end
				end
			end
			if not (origin and high) then
				return
			end
			origin = origin[2]
			-- Only shots with a line to them (or through a car / one wall the wallbang handles).
			local clear = workspace:Raycast(origin, aimAt - origin, Phantom.rayParams) == nil
			if not clear and not (flags.rage_enabled and flags.rage_wallbang ~= false) and not flags.aim_wallbang then
				return
			end
			Hooks.phantomOrigin = origin
			Hooks.phantomFire(aimPart)
			Hooks.phantomOrigin = nil
		end)

		-- Before the camera draws: your real position back, and the ghost posed at the phantom spot.
		runService:BindToRenderStep(RENDER_KEY, Enum.RenderPriority.Camera.Value - 3, function()
			local root = localPlayer.Character and localPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			if Phantom.real then
				if root then
					root.CFrame = Phantom.real
				end
				Phantom.real = nil
			end
			if not (flags.phantom_enabled and Phantom.target and Phantom.fake and root) then
				if Phantom.ghost then
					Phantom.clearGhost()
				end
				return
			end
			local character = localPlayer.Character
			local ghost = Phantom.ghost
			if not ghost or ghost.character ~= character or ghost.dirty then
				Phantom.buildGhost(character)
				ghost = Phantom.ghost
				if not ghost then
					return
				end
			end
			-- Every ghost part copies its real part's pose, carried over to the phantom spot.
			local toFake = Phantom.fake * root.CFrame:Inverse()
			for _, pair in ipairs(ghost.pairs) do
				local real, copy = pair[1], pair[2]
				if real.Parent then
					copy.CFrame = toFake * real.CFrame
				end
			end
			local color = flags.phantom_color and flags.phantom_color.Color or Color3.fromRGB(150, 110, 255)
			ghost.glow.FillColor = color
			ghost.glow.OutlineColor = color:Lerp(Color3.new(1, 1, 1), 0.5)
		end)

		library:connection(localPlayer.CharacterAdded, function()
			Phantom.real = nil
			Phantom.offset, Phantom.history = nil, {}
			Phantom.clearGhost()
		end)

		onUnload(function()
			pcall(runService.UnbindFromRenderStep, runService, RENDER_KEY)
			Phantom.clearGhost()
			Phantom.target = nil
		end)
	end)()

	---Lock orbit onto a player and force orbit on.
	local function lockOrbitTarget(target)
		if not target then
			return false
		end
		Hooks.orbitTargetName = target.Name
		pcall(function()
			if library.config_flags.tools_player then
				library.config_flags.tools_player(playerLabel(target))
			end
		end)
		flags.tools_orbit = true
		pcall(function()
			if library.config_flags.tools_orbit then
				library.config_flags.tools_orbit(true)
			end
		end)
		library:notification({ text = "Orbiting " .. (target.DisplayName or target.Name), time = 2 })
		return true
	end

	---Stop orbiting (clear mouse-lock target + turn orbit off).
	local function stopOrbitTarget()
		Hooks.orbitTargetName = nil
		flags.tools_orbit = false
		pcall(function()
			if library.config_flags.tools_orbit then
				library.config_flags.tools_orbit(false)
			end
		end)
		library:notification({ text = "Orbit stopped.", time = 2 })
	end

	-- Keybind: press once to orbit closest to mouse, press again to stop.
	addFeature(orbitSection, {
		name = "Orbit Closest (Mouse)",
		flag = "orbit_mouse_lock",
		callback = function(enabled)
			if not enabled then
				return
			end
			-- Already orbiting via mouse lock → stop.
			if flags.tools_orbit and Hooks.orbitTargetName then
				stopOrbitTarget()
			else
				local target = closestToMouseInFov()
				if not target then
					library:notification({ text = "No player near mouse.", time = 2 })
				else
					lockOrbitTarget(target)
				end
			end
			-- Momentary flag so the same key works every press.
			task.defer(function()
				flags.orbit_mouse_lock = false
				pcall(function()
					if library.config_flags.orbit_mouse_lock then
						library.config_flags.orbit_mouse_lock(false)
					end
				end)
			end)
		end,
	})

	orbitSection:button({
		name = "Clear orbit target",
		callback = function()
			stopOrbitTarget()
		end,
	})

	-- Humanoid: walk speed and jump power overrides, plus Ctrl + click to teleport.
	local humanoidSection = mainTab:section({ name = "Humanoid", side = "right" })
	addFeature(humanoidSection, { name = "Walk Speed", flag = "humanoid_speed" })
	humanoidSection:slider({ name = "walk speed", flag = "humanoid_speed_value", min = 16, max = 120, default = 24, interval = 1 })
	addFeature(humanoidSection, { name = "Jump Power", flag = "humanoid_jump" })
	humanoidSection:slider({ name = "jump power", flag = "humanoid_jump_value", min = 50, max = 200, default = 70, interval = 1 })
	addFeature(humanoidSection, { name = "Click TP", flag = "click_tp" })
	humanoidSection:button({ name = "Hold Ctrl And Click To TP", callback = function() end })

	-- What the game had, put back when an override turns off.
	local humanoidDefaults = { speed = nil, jump = nil }
	library:connection(runService.Heartbeat, function()
		local humanoid = localPlayer.Character and localPlayer.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		if not humanoid then
			return
		end

		if flags.humanoid_speed then
			humanoidDefaults.speed = humanoidDefaults.speed or humanoid.WalkSpeed
			humanoid.WalkSpeed = flags.humanoid_speed_value or 24
		elseif humanoidDefaults.speed then
			humanoid.WalkSpeed = humanoidDefaults.speed
			humanoidDefaults.speed = nil
		end

		if flags.humanoid_jump then
			humanoidDefaults.jump = humanoidDefaults.jump or humanoid.JumpPower
			humanoid.UseJumpPower = true
			humanoid.JumpPower = flags.humanoid_jump_value or 70
		elseif humanoidDefaults.jump then
			humanoid.JumpPower = humanoidDefaults.jump
			humanoidDefaults.jump = nil
		end
	end)

	-- Click TP: hold the chosen key and left click to go where the mouse points.
	humanoidSection:dropdown({ name = "click tp key", flag = "click_tp_key", items = { "Left Ctrl", "Left Alt", "Left Shift", "No Key" }, default = "Left Ctrl" })
	local CLICK_TP_KEYS = { ["Left Ctrl"] = Enum.KeyCode.LeftControl, ["Left Alt"] = Enum.KeyCode.LeftAlt, ["Left Shift"] = Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift }
	local clickParams = RaycastParams.new()
	clickParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
	---Teleport to whatever is under a screen point (`ray` from the camera through it).
	local function clickTeleport(ray, point)
		if windowFrame.Visible then
			local position, size = windowFrame.AbsolutePosition, windowFrame.AbsoluteSize
			if point.X >= position.X and point.Y >= position.Y and point.X <= position.X + size.X and point.Y <= position.Y + size.Y then
				return
			end
		end
		local character = localPlayer.Character
		local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		if not root then
			return
		end
		local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
		clickParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = { character, camera }
		local hit = workspace:Raycast(ray.Origin, ray.Direction * 2000, clickParams)
		if hit then
			if humanoid and humanoid.Sit then
				humanoid.Sit = false
			end
			-- Clear Invisible / Anti Aim / Anti Punch's saved spot so they don't snap you back.
			Hooks.clearDesync()
			root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
			character:PivotTo(CFrame.new(hit.Position + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0)) * root.CFrame.Rotation)
		end
	end

	-- Mouse: hold the key and left click. Guns mark every click as "processed" by the game, so
	-- that flag isn't checked; clicks on the open menu are skipped instead.
	library:connection(userInputService.InputBegan, function(input)
		if not flags.click_tp or input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
			return
		end
		local key = CLICK_TP_KEYS[flags.click_tp_key or "Left Ctrl"]
		if key and not userInputService:IsKeyDown(key) then
			return
		end
		local mouse = userInputService:GetMouseLocation()
		clickTeleport(workspace.CurrentCamera:ViewportPointToRay(mouse.X, mouse.Y), Vector2.new(input.Position.X, input.Position.Y))
	end)

	-- Phones and tablets: a quick tap on the world teleports (no key to hold). TouchTap only fires
	-- for real taps, so moving with the joystick or turning the camera never teleports you, and
	-- taps on the game's buttons come through as processed.
	library:connection(userInputService.TouchTap, function(positions, gameProcessed)
		local point = positions[1]
		if not flags.click_tp or gameProcessed or not point then
			return
		end
		clickTeleport(workspace.CurrentCamera:ScreenPointToRay(point.X, point.Y), Vector2.new(point.X, point.Y))
	end)

	onUnload(function()
		local humanoid = localPlayer.Character and localPlayer.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		if humanoid and humanoidDefaults.speed then
			humanoid.WalkSpeed = humanoidDefaults.speed
		end
		if humanoid and humanoidDefaults.jump then
			humanoid.JumpPower = humanoidDefaults.jump
		end
	end)
end

do
	-- Character: stamina, tase immunity, invisibility and cosmetics.
	local characterSection = mainTab:section({ name = "Character", side = "left" })
	local replicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

	-- Infinite stamina: Prison Life limits jumping with a character script called AntiJump.
	addFeature(characterSection, { name = "Infinite Stamina", flag = "infinite_stamina" })

	local antiJumpAcc = 0
	library:connection(runService.Heartbeat, function(dt)
		antiJumpAcc += dt
		if antiJumpAcc < 0.35 then
			return
		end
		antiJumpAcc = 0
		local antiJump = localPlayer.Character and localPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("AntiJump")
		if antiJump and antiJump.Disabled ~= (flags.infinite_stamina == true) then
			antiJump.Disabled = flags.infinite_stamina == true
		end
	end)

	-- Anti tase: mute the client listeners that stun you when tased (restored when off).
	local pausedTaseConnections = {}

	---Pause or resume the game's tase listeners.
	local function setAntiTase(enabled)
		if not enabled then
			for _, connection in ipairs(pausedTaseConnections) do
				pcall(connection.Enable, connection)
			end
			table.clear(pausedTaseConnections)
			return
		end

		local remotes = replicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("GunRemotes")
		local tased = remotes and remotes:FindFirstChild("PlayerTased")
		if not tased then
			return
		end

		for _, connection in ipairs(getconnections(tased.OnClientEvent)) do
			if connection.Enabled then
				connection:Disable()
				table.insert(pausedTaseConnections, connection)
			end
		end
	end

	addFeature(characterSection, { name = "Anti Tase", flag = "anti_tase", callback = setAntiTase })

	-- Re-check on respawn, since the game hooks the listener again.
	task.spawn(function()
		while isCurrentRun() and watermarkHolder.Parent do
			task.wait(1)
			if not isCurrentRun() then
				break
			end
			if flags.anti_tase then
				setAntiTase(true)
			end
		end
	end)

	onUnload(function()
		setAntiTase(false)
	end)

	-- Invisible (A2Flacko's method): your real body is tucked under the floor with a pose
	-- animation for the server, while your camera keeps the real position.
	local INVISIBLE_RENDER_KEY = "AquaInvisible"
	local invisibleTrack = nil
	local realCFrame = nil
	local invisibleOriginals = {}
	table.insert(Hooks.desyncResets, function()
		realCFrame = nil
	end)

	---Play the hiding pose for this rig.
	local function loadInvisibleAnimation(humanoid)
		local animator = humanoid:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator")
		if not animator then
			return nil
		end

		local isR15 = humanoid.RigType == Enum.HumanoidRigType.R15
		local animation = Instance.new("Animation")
		animation.AnimationId = isR15 and "rbxassetid://18665825805" or "rbxassetid://215384594"

		local track = animator:LoadAnimation(animation)
		track.Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Action4
		track:Play(0, 0.001, 0)
		animation:Destroy()

		task.defer(function()
			track.TimePosition = isR15 and 1.95 or 0.4
		end)

		return track
	end

	---Turn invisibility off and put you back where you really are.
	local function stopInvisible()
		pcall(runService.UnbindFromRenderStep, runService, INVISIBLE_RENDER_KEY)

		if invisibleTrack then
			invisibleTrack:Stop()
			invisibleTrack:Destroy()
			invisibleTrack = nil
		end

		local character = localPlayer.Character
		local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		if root and realCFrame then
			root.CFrame = realCFrame
			local velocity = root.AssemblyLinearVelocity
			root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(velocity.X, 0, velocity.Z)
		end
		realCFrame = nil

		for part, original in pairs(invisibleOriginals) do
			if part.Parent then
				part.Transparency = original.transparency
				part.CanCollide = original.canCollide
			end
		end
		table.clear(invisibleOriginals)
	end

	---Start invisibility on the current character.
	local function startInvisible()
		local character = localPlayer.Character
		local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		if not (humanoid and root) then
			return
		end

		invisibleTrack = loadInvisibleAnimation(humanoid)
		realCFrame = nil

		-- You see yourself as a ghost so you know it's on.
		for _, part in ipairs(character:GetDescendants()) do
			if part:IsA("BasePart") and part ~= root then
				invisibleOriginals[part] = { transparency = part.Transparency, canCollide = part.CanCollide }
				part.Transparency = 0.5
				part.CanCollide = false
			end
		end

		pcall(runService.UnbindFromRenderStep, runService, INVISIBLE_RENDER_KEY)
		runService:BindToRenderStep(INVISIBLE_RENDER_KEY, Enum.RenderPriority.Camera.Value - 1, function()
			if flags.invisible_enabled and realCFrame and root.Parent then
				root.CFrame = realCFrame
				if invisibleTrack then
					invisibleTrack:AdjustWeight(0.001)
				end
			end
		end)
	end

	addFeature(characterSection, { name = "Invisible", flag = "invisible_enabled", rage = true, callback = function(enabled)
		if enabled then
			startInvisible()
		else
			stopInvisible()
		end
	end })

	-- After physics, drop the real body under you for the server's view.
	library:connection(runService.Heartbeat, function()
		if not flags.invisible_enabled or Hooks.grabbing then
			return
		end
		-- Phantom owns your body while it runs (and Invisible mustn't snap you to an old spot).
		if Hooks.phantomActive and Hooks.phantomActive() then
			realCFrame = nil
			return
		end

		local character = localPlayer.Character
		local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		if not (humanoid and root) then
			return
		end

		local isR15 = humanoid.RigType == Enum.HumanoidRigType.R15
		local drop = humanoid.HipHeight + root.Size.Y / 2 - 1

		realCFrame = root.CFrame
		root.CFrame = (root.CFrame - Vector3.new(0, drop, 0)) * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(isR15 and 180 or 90), 0, 0)

		local velocity = root.AssemblyLinearVelocity
		root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(velocity.X, 0, velocity.Z)

		if invisibleTrack then
			invisibleTrack:AdjustWeight(100)
		end
	end)

	library:connection(localPlayer.CharacterAdded, function()
		if flags.invisible_enabled then
			stopInvisible()
			task.wait(0.5)
			startInvisible()
		end
	end)

	onUnload(stopInvisible)

	-- Anti invisible: freezes animations that aren't part of the game, which is how
	-- other players' invisibility poses work.
	-- Default avatar and Prison Life animations (from the old script). The two
	-- invisibility poses are deliberately NOT here, so anti invisible catches them.
	local knownAnimations = {}
	for _, id in ipairs({
		"125750702", "128777973", "128853357", "129423030", "129423131", "129967390", "129967478",
		"178130996", "180426354", "180435571", "180435792", "180436148", "180436334", "182393478",
		"182435998", "182436842", "182436935", "182491037", "182491065", "182491248", "182491277",
		"182491368", "182491423",
	}) do
		knownAnimations["http://www.roblox.com/asset/?id=" .. id] = true
	end
	for _, id in ipairs({
		"279227693", "279229192", "287112271", "388723916", "388726667", "389472570", "405194080",
		"405212265", "481088553", "481089053", "484200742", "484926359", "83690472549256",
		"107176344504758", "111090572475133", "113267949064300", "131326339350805",
	}) do
		knownAnimations["rbxassetid://" .. id] = true
	end

	-- Every animation the game ships in ReplicatedStorage is legit too.
	pcall(function()
		for _, animation in ipairs(replicatedStorage:GetDescendants()) do
			if animation:IsA("Animation") then
				knownAnimations[animation.AnimationId] = true
			end
		end
	end)

	---Whether an animation id is one the game itself uses.
	local function isGameAnimation(animationId)
		return knownAnimations[animationId] == true
	end

	addFeature(characterSection, { name = "Anti Invisible", flag = "anti_invisible" })

	---Watch one character's animator for foreign animations.
	local function watchAnimations(character)
		local humanoid = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid", 5)
		local animator = humanoid and humanoid:WaitForChild("Animator", 5)
		if not animator then
			return
		end

		library:connection(animator.AnimationPlayed, function(track)
			if not flags.anti_invisible then
				return
			end

			local id = track.Animation and track.Animation.AnimationId
			if not id or isGameAnimation(id) then
				return
			end

			task.spawn(function()
				while track.IsPlaying and flags.anti_invisible and isCurrentRun() do
					track:AdjustWeight(0, 0)
					task.wait()
				end
			end)
		end)
	end

	---Hook a player's current and future characters.
	local function watchPlayerAnimations(player)
		if player == localPlayer then
			return
		end

		if player.Character then
			task.spawn(watchAnimations, player.Character)
		end

		library:connection(player.CharacterAdded, function(character)
			task.spawn(watchAnimations, character)
		end)
	end

	for _, player in ipairs(playersService:GetPlayers()) do
		watchPlayerAnimations(player)
	end
	library:connection(playersService.PlayerAdded, watchPlayerAnimations)

	-- HvH protection: Anti Fling and Anti Aim. In its own function for a fresh local budget.
	local function buildProtection()
		-- Anti Fling: other players' bodies can't push you (their collision is off on your
		-- side), and if something still launches or spins you, your speed is cancelled and
		-- you're put back where you were.
		addFeature(characterSection, { name = "Anti Fling", flag = "anti_fling" })
		local FLING_SPEED = 120
		local FLING_SPIN = 40
		local bodyCollisions = {}
		local lastSafe = nil

		---Give other players' bodies their collision back.
		local function restoreBodies()
			for part in pairs(bodyCollisions) do
				if part.Parent then
					part.CanCollide = true
				end
			end
			table.clear(bodyCollisions)
		end

		library:connection(runService.Heartbeat, function()
			if not flags.anti_fling or Hooks.isTossing() then
				lastSafe = nil
				if next(bodyCollisions) then
					restoreBodies()
				end
				return
			end

			-- Other bodies' collision: 5 times a second is plenty (it stays off once set).
			local now = os.clock()
			if now - (Hooks.antiFlingScanAt or 0) >= 0.2 then
				Hooks.antiFlingScanAt = now
				for _, player in ipairs(playersService:GetPlayers()) do
					local other = player ~= localPlayer and player.Character
					if other then
						for _, part in ipairs(other:GetChildren()) do
							if part:IsA("BasePart") and part.CanCollide then
								bodyCollisions[part] = true
								part.CanCollide = false
							end
						end
					end
				end
			end

			local character = localPlayer.Character
			local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
			local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			if not (humanoid and root and humanoid.Health > 0) or humanoid.SeatPart then
				lastSafe = nil
				return
			end

			-- Falling fast is normal; sideways or upward launches and wild spinning aren't.
			local velocity = root.AssemblyLinearVelocity
			local sideways = Vector3.new(velocity.X, 0, velocity.Z).Magnitude
			-- Your own fast movement (Fly, Orbit) isn't a fling; at Fly speeds over 120 this used to
			-- yank you back every frame.
			local selfMoving = flags.fly_enabled or flags.tools_orbit or flags.void_enabled
			local flung = not selfMoving and (sideways > FLING_SPEED or velocity.Y > FLING_SPEED or root.AssemblyAngularVelocity.Magnitude > FLING_SPIN)

			if flung then
				root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
				root.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
				if lastSafe then
					root.CFrame = lastSafe
				end
			else
				lastSafe = root.CFrame
			end
		end)

		onUnload(restoreBodies)

		-- Anti Aim: makes you harder to hit by hand or with prediction-based aimbots.
		-- Jitter snaps your facing back and forth; Desync shows your body to others a few studs
		-- to the side of where you really are (you still see yourself in place).
		addFeature(characterSection, { name = "Anti Aim", flag = "anti_aim", rage = true })
		characterSection:dropdown({ name = "anti aim mode", flag = "anti_aim_mode", items = { "Jitter", "Desync" }, default = "Jitter" })
		characterSection:slider({ name = "desync distance", flag = "anti_aim_distance", min = 1, max = 4, default = 2.5, interval = 0.5, suffix = " studs" })

		local ANTI_AIM_KEY = "AquaAntiAim"
		local jitterSide = 1
		local realCFrame = nil
		local pausedRotate = nil
		table.insert(Hooks.desyncResets, function()
			realCFrame = nil
		end)

		---Turn the humanoid's own facing control back on.
		local function restoreRotate()
			if pausedRotate and pausedRotate.Parent then
				pausedRotate.AutoRotate = true
			end
			pausedRotate = nil
		end

		-- Desync: put the real position back before the camera renders, so only other players
		-- see the shifted body.
		runService:BindToRenderStep(ANTI_AIM_KEY, Enum.RenderPriority.Camera.Value - 1, function()
			if not realCFrame then
				return
			end
			local root = localPlayer.Character and localPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			if root then
				root.CFrame = realCFrame
			end
			realCFrame = nil
		end)

		library:connection(runService.Heartbeat, function()
			local character = localPlayer.Character
			local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
			local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			local active = flags.anti_aim and not Hooks.grabbing and humanoid and root and humanoid.Health > 0 and not humanoid.SeatPart
				and not flags.invisible_enabled and not flags.spinbot_enabled and not (Hooks.phantomActive and Hooks.phantomActive())

			if not active then
				restoreRotate()
				return
			end

			jitterSide = -jitterSide

			if (flags.anti_aim_mode or "Jitter") == "Jitter" then
				-- Face roughly where the camera looks, snapping 75 degrees either side every frame.
				if humanoid.AutoRotate then
					humanoid.AutoRotate = false
					pausedRotate = humanoid
				end
				local look = workspace.CurrentCamera.CFrame.LookVector
				local yaw = math.atan2(-look.X, -look.Z)
				root.CFrame = CFrame.new(root.Position) * CFrame.Angles(0, yaw + math.rad(75) * jitterSide, 0)
			else
				restoreRotate()
				-- After physics: shift the body sideways for replication, alternating sides.
				realCFrame = root.CFrame
				local side = root.CFrame.RightVector * (flags.anti_aim_distance or 2.5) * jitterSide
				root.CFrame = realCFrame + side
			end
		end)

		onUnload(function()
			pcall(runService.UnbindFromRenderStep, runService, ANTI_AIM_KEY)
			restoreRotate()
		end)

		-- Anti Punch: a punch only lands if the attacker finds your body a few studs in front of
		-- them. While an enemy is within punch range, your body is shown to everyone else a few
		-- studs under the floor (you still see yourself in place, same trick as Invisible), so
		-- their punch finds nothing to hit.
		addFeature(characterSection, { name = "Anti Punch", flag = "anti_punch", rage = true })
		characterSection:slider({ name = "anti punch range", flag = "anti_punch_range", min = 4, max = 20, default = 10, interval = 1, suffix = " studs" })

		local ANTI_PUNCH_KEY = "AquaAntiPunch"
		local punchReal = nil
		table.insert(Hooks.desyncResets, function()
			punchReal = nil
		end)

		---Is any other player close enough to punch you?
		local function enemyInReach(root)
			local reach = flags.anti_punch_range or 10
			for _, player in ipairs(playersService:GetPlayers()) do
				local other = player ~= localPlayer and player.Character
				local otherRoot = other and other:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
				local humanoid = other and other:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
				if otherRoot and humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0 and (otherRoot.Position - root.Position).Magnitude <= reach then
					return true
				end
			end
			return false
		end

		-- Put the real position back before the camera draws, so only others see the hidden body.
		runService:BindToRenderStep(ANTI_PUNCH_KEY, Enum.RenderPriority.Camera.Value - 2, function()
			if not punchReal then
				return
			end
			local root = localPlayer.Character and localPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			if root then
				root.CFrame = punchReal
			end
			punchReal = nil
		end)

		library:connection(runService.Heartbeat, function()
			local character = localPlayer.Character
			local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
			local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			-- Invisible and Anti Aim's Desync already move the body; don't stack with them.
			local active = flags.anti_punch and not Hooks.grabbing and humanoid and root and humanoid.Health > 0 and not humanoid.SeatPart
				and not flags.invisible_enabled and not (flags.anti_aim and flags.anti_aim_mode == "Desync")
				and not (Hooks.phantomActive and Hooks.phantomActive())
			if not active then
				return
			end
			if not enemyInReach(root) then
				return
			end

			-- After physics: drop the replicated body 6 studs, just under the floor. Not more: the
			-- server only accepts your shots from within ~7 studs of where it thinks your head is.
			punchReal = root.CFrame
			root.CFrame = punchReal - Vector3.new(0, 6, 0)
		end)

		onUnload(function()
			pcall(runService.UnbindFromRenderStep, runService, ANTI_PUNCH_KEY)
		end)
	end

	buildProtection()

	-- Crouch Bypass and Hide Head (own function, so its locals get their own budget).
	local function buildCharacterExtras()
		-- Crouch Bypass: crouching sets your player's BackpackEnabled attribute to false, which hides
		-- your inventory so you can't pull a gun out. This keeps it true.
		addFeature(characterSection, { name = "Crouch Bypass", flag = "crouch_bypass" })
		local function keepBackpack()
			if flags.crouch_bypass and localPlayer:GetAttribute("BackpackEnabled") ~= true then
				localPlayer:SetAttribute("BackpackEnabled", true)
			end
		end
		library:connection(localPlayer:GetAttributeChangedSignal("BackpackEnabled"), keepBackpack)
		library:connection(runService.Heartbeat, keepBackpack)

		-- No Jump Cooldown: the game's AntiJump script in your character (workspace.<your name>)
		-- cancels jumps that come too fast. It's switched off (which stops it) instead of deleted,
		-- so turning the feature off switches it back on. Each respawn brings a new one.
		local function removeAntiJump()
			local character = workspace:FindFirstChild(localPlayer.Name) or localPlayer.Character
			local antiJump = character and character:FindFirstChild("AntiJump")
			if antiJump then
				local enabled = not flags.no_jump_cooldown
				pcall(function()
					if antiJump.Enabled ~= enabled then
						antiJump.Enabled = enabled
					end
				end)
			end
		end
		addFeature(characterSection, { name = "No Jump Cooldown", flag = "no_jump_cooldown", callback = removeAntiJump })
		library:connection(localPlayer.CharacterAdded, function(character)
			removeAntiJump()
			-- The script can be added a moment after the character.
			library:connection(character.ChildAdded, function(child)
				if child.Name == "AntiJump" then
					removeAntiJump()
				end
			end)
		end)
		if localPlayer.Character then
			library:connection(localPlayer.Character.ChildAdded, function(child)
				if child.Name == "AntiJump" then
					removeAntiJump()
				end
			end)
		end

		-- Hide Head: your head comes off the body (neck joint removed, only on your side) and is
