		-- held tucked behind your torso. Your character owns its own physics, so the head's
		-- position is what everyone else sees.
		addFeature(characterSection, { name = "Hide Head", flag = "hide_head", rage = true })
		local hidden = nil

		local function restoreHead()
			-- Cleared first: after you die the old neck is locked and can't be put back, and a
			-- failed restore used to retry (and error) every frame.
			local previous = hidden
			hidden = nil
			if not previous then
				return
			end
			pcall(function()
				if previous.torso.Parent and previous.neck then
					previous.neck.Parent = previous.torso
				end
			end)
			pcall(function()
				if previous.humanoid.Parent then
					previous.humanoid.RequiresNeck = previous.requiresNeck
				end
				if previous.head.Parent then
					previous.head.CanCollide = previous.canCollide
				end
			end)
		end

		library:connection(runService.Heartbeat, function()
			local character = localPlayer.Character
			local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
			local torso = character and (character:FindFirstChild("Torso") or character:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso"))
			local head = character and character:FindFirstChild("Head")

			if not (flags.hide_head and humanoid and torso and head and humanoid.Health > 0) then
				if hidden then
					restoreHead()
				end
				return
			end

			-- New character (or first frame on): take the neck off, without dying from it.
			if not hidden or hidden.head ~= head then
				restoreHead()
				local neck = torso:FindFirstChild("Neck")
				if not neck then
					return
				end
				hidden = { head = head, torso = torso, humanoid = humanoid, neck = neck,
					requiresNeck = humanoid.RequiresNeck, canCollide = head.CanCollide }
				humanoid.RequiresNeck = false
				neck.Parent = nil
				head.CanCollide = false
			end

			-- Tucked right behind your torso (your back), facing the same way.
			head.CFrame = torso.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0.3, torso.Size.Z / 2 + head.Size.Z / 2 + 0.05)
			head.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
			head.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
		end)

		onUnload(restoreHead)
	end

	buildCharacterExtras()

	;(function()
		addFeature(characterSection, { name = "Anti Arrest", flag = "anti_arrest", rage = true })
		addFeature(characterSection, { name = "Car Shield", flag = "car_shield", rage = true })
		characterSection:dropdown({ name = "car shield shape", flag = "car_shield_shape", items = { "Front", "Triangle", "Box" }, default = "Box" })

		local SHIELD_PAD = Vector3.new(624, 98, 2495)
		local SHIELD_SHAPES = { Front = 1, Triangle = 3, Box = 4 }
		-- A new car counts as coming from the spawner it shows up next to.
		local SPAWNER_REACH = 60

		local function shieldCount()
			return SHIELD_SHAPES[flags.car_shield_shape or "Box"] or 4
		end
		local shield = { walls = {}, spawning = false, retryAt = 0, parkedAt = 0, floor = nil }

		local function shieldSpawners()
			local items = workspace:FindFirstChild("Prison_ITEMS")
			local buttons = items and items:FindFirstChild("buttons")
			local list = {}
			for _, child in ipairs(buttons and buttons:GetChildren() or {}) do
				local spawner = child:FindFirstChild("Car Spawner")
				if spawner and spawner:IsA("BasePart") then
					table.insert(list, spawner)
				end
			end
			return list
		end

		---Spawners that aren't holding one of our walls, ready (cyan) ones first. Pressing a spawner
		---replaces the car it made last, so refilling from the nearest spawner used to destroy another
		---wall and the shield never got back to full.
		local function freeSpawners()
			local used = {}
			for _, wall in ipairs(shield.walls) do
				if wall.spawner then
					used[wall.spawner] = true
				end
			end
			local cyan = BrickColor.new("Cyan")
			local free, score = {}, {}
			for _, spawner in ipairs(shieldSpawners()) do
				if not used[spawner] then
					table.insert(free, spawner)
					score[spawner] = (spawner.Position - SHIELD_PAD).Magnitude + (spawner.BrickColor == cyan and 0 or 1000)
				end
			end
			table.sort(free, function(a, b)
				return score[a] < score[b]
			end)
			return free
		end

		local function maxSimulation()
			pcall(sethiddenproperty, localPlayer, "SimulationRadius", 1e9)
			pcall(sethiddenproperty, localPlayer, "MaximumSimulationRadius", 1e9)
			pcall(setsimulationradius, 1e9, 1e9)
		end

		local function parkFor(index)
			return CFrame.new(629 + (index - 1) * 25, NEG_ONE * 20, 2499)
		end

		---Whether someone other than you is sitting in one of the car's seats.
		local function hijacked(car)
			local myHumanoid = localPlayer.Character and localPlayer.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
			for _, seat in ipairs(car:GetDescendants()) do
				if (seat:IsA("Seat") or seat:IsA("VehicleSeat")) and seat.Occupant and seat.Occupant ~= myHumanoid then
					return true
				end
			end
			return false
		end

		---Walls whose car still exists and is still ours. Lost ones are dropped, which frees their
		---spawner for the refill.
		local function liveWalls()
			local alive = {}
			for _, wall in ipairs(shield.walls) do
				if wall.car.Parent and wall.box.Parent and not hijacked(wall.car) then
					table.insert(alive, wall)
				end
			end
			shield.walls = alive
			return alive
		end

		local function clearShield()
			table.clear(shield.walls)
			if shield.floor then
				shield.floor:Destroy()
				shield.floor = nil
			end
		end

		local function ensureFloor()
			if shield.floor and shield.floor.Parent then
				return
			end
			shield.floor = Instance.new("Part")
			shield.floor.Name = ""
			shield.floor.Anchored = true
			shield.floor.Size = Vector3.new(220, 10, 200)
			shield.floor.CFrame = CFrame.new(667, NEG_ONE * 25, 2499)
			shield.floor.Parent = workspace
		end

		---Press free spawners one at a time until `needed` new walls exist.
		local function spawnShieldCars(needed)
			shield.spawning = true
			local character = localPlayer.Character
			local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			local container = workspace:FindFirstChild("CarContainer")
			local remotes = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):FindFirstChild("Remotes")
			local interact = remotes and remotes:FindFirstChild("InteractWithItem")
			local spawners = freeSpawners()
			if not (root and container and interact and spawners[1]) then
				shield.spawning = false
				return
			end

			local home = root.CFrame
			Hooks.clearDesync()
			maxSimulation()
			ensureFloor()

			local got = 0
			for _, spawner in ipairs(spawners) do
				if got >= needed or not flags.car_shield or not root.Parent or #shield.walls >= shieldCount() then
					break
				end

				local before = {}
				for _, car in ipairs(container:GetChildren()) do
					before[car] = true
				end

				-- Stand on this pad and press it until its car shows up (skip it after a few seconds,
				-- e.g. when it's on cooldown).
				local found = nil
				local started = os.clock()
				while flags.car_shield and not found and root.Parent and os.clock() - started < 2.5 do
					root.CFrame = CFrame.new(spawner.Position + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0))
					root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
					pcall(interact.InvokeServer, interact, spawner)
					local waited = os.clock()
					while not found and os.clock() - waited < 0.6 do
						task.wait(0.1)
						for _, car in ipairs(container:GetChildren()) do
							if car:IsA("Model") and not before[car] then
								local ok, pivot = pcall(car.GetPivot, car)
								if ok and (pivot.Position - spawner.Position).Magnitude <= SPAWNER_REACH then
									found = car
									break
								end
							end
						end
					end
				end

				local box = found and found:WaitForChild("Box", 4)
				if box and flags.car_shield then
					local body = found:FindFirstChild("Body")
					local wall = {
						car = found,
						box = box,
						spawner = spawner,
						main = body and body:FindFirstChild("Main"),
						seat = body and body:FindFirstChild("VehicleSeat"),
					}
					table.insert(shield.walls, wall)
					if wall.main then
						local park = parkFor(#shield.walls)
						pcall(function()
							wall.main.CFrame = park
							wall.main.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
							wall.main.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
							wall.main.Anchored = true
						end)
					end
					got += 1
				end
			end

			if root.Parent then
				Hooks.clearDesync()
				root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
				root.CFrame = home
			end

			if flags.car_shield and #shield.walls < shieldCount() then
				library:notification({ text = string.format("Car Shield: got %d of %d cars, retrying.", #shield.walls, shieldCount()), time = 3 })
			end
			shield.spawning = false
		end

		library:connection(runService.Heartbeat, function()
			if not flags.car_shield then
				if #shield.walls > 0 or shield.floor then
					clearShield()
				end
				return
			end

			local character = localPlayer.Character
			local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
			if not (root and humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0) then
				return
			end

			local count = shieldCount()
			local walls = liveWalls()
			local now = os.clock()
			if #walls < count and not shield.spawning and now >= shield.retryAt then
				shield.retryAt = now + 3
				task.spawn(spawnShieldCars, count - #walls)
			end
			if #walls == 0 then
				return
			end

			maxSimulation()
			local repark = now - shield.parkedAt > 1
			if repark then
				shield.parkedAt = now
			end

			-- Extra cars (after switching to a smaller shape) stay parked, ready for a bigger shape again.
			local active = math.min(#walls, count)
			local feetY = Hooks.feetPosition(character, root).Y
			local length, thickness = 0, 0
			for index = 1, active do
				length = math.max(length, walls[index].box.Size.Z)
				thickness = math.max(thickness, walls[index].box.Size.Y)
			end
			local base = Vector3.new(0, 0, NEG_ONE)
			local spread = length / 2
			if count == 1 then
				local look = root.CFrame.LookVector
				local flat = Vector3.new(look.X, 0, look.Z)
				base = flat.Magnitude > 0.01 and flat.Unit or base
				spread = 1 + thickness / 2
			elseif count == 3 then
				spread = length * 0.2887
			end

			for index, wall in ipairs(walls) do
				local box = wall.box
				for _, part in ipairs({ wall.main, wall.seat, box }) do
					pcall(sethiddenproperty, part, "NetworkIsSleeping", true)
				end
				if repark and wall.main and wall.main.Parent then
					local park = parkFor(index)
					pcall(function()
						wall.main.CFrame = park
						wall.main.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
						wall.main.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
					end)
				end

				if index <= active then
					local side = CFrame.Angles(0, (index - 1) * math.pi * 2 / count, 0):VectorToWorldSpace(base)
					local along = side:Cross(Vector3.yAxis)
					local rotation = CFrame.fromMatrix(Vector3.zero, Vector3.yAxis, side * NEG_ONE, along)
					local height = box.Size.X
					local center = Vector3.new(root.Position.X, feetY + height / 2 + NEG_ONE * 3, root.Position.Z)
						+ side * spread
					pcall(function()
						box.CFrame = rotation + center
						box.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
						box.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
					end)
				end
			end
		end)

		onUnload(clearShield)
	end)()

	-- Cosmetics (only you see these): headless and Korblox leg, fully undone when off.
	local cosmeticSection = Tabs.visuals:section({ name = "Cosmetics", side = "left" })
	local KORBLOX_MESH = "rbxassetid://101851696"
	local KORBLOX_TEXTURE = "rbxassetid://101851254"
	local headlessState = nil
	local korbloxState = nil

	---Hide or restore your head and face.
	local function setHeadless(enabled)
		local head = localPlayer.Character and localPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("Head")

		if headlessState and (not enabled or headlessState.head ~= head) then
			if headlessState.head.Parent then
				headlessState.head.Transparency = headlessState.transparency
				for decal, transparency in pairs(headlessState.decals) do
					decal.Transparency = transparency
				end
			end
			headlessState = nil
		end

		if enabled and head and not headlessState then
			headlessState = { head = head, transparency = head.Transparency, decals = {} }
			for _, decal in ipairs(head:GetChildren()) do
				if decal:IsA("Decal") then
					headlessState.decals[decal] = decal.Transparency
					decal.Transparency = 1
				end
			end
			head.Transparency = 1
		end
	end

	---Swap your right leg for the Korblox leg, or restore it.
	local function setKorblox(enabled)
		local leg = localPlayer.Character and localPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("Right Leg")

		if korbloxState and (not enabled or korbloxState.leg ~= leg) then
			korbloxState.mesh:Destroy()
			for _, original in ipairs(korbloxState.originals) do
				if korbloxState.leg.Parent then
					original.Parent = korbloxState.leg
				end
			end
			korbloxState = nil
		end

		if enabled and leg and not korbloxState then
			korbloxState = { leg = leg, originals = {} }

			for _, child in ipairs(leg:GetChildren()) do
				if child:IsA("SpecialMesh") or child:IsA("CharacterMesh") then
					table.insert(korbloxState.originals, child)
					child.Parent = nil
				end
			end

			local mesh = Instance.new("SpecialMesh")
			mesh.MeshType = Enum.MeshType.FileMesh
			mesh.MeshId = KORBLOX_MESH
			mesh.TextureId = KORBLOX_TEXTURE
			mesh.Parent = leg
			korbloxState.mesh = mesh
		end
	end

	addFeature(cosmeticSection, { name = "Headless", flag = "cosmetic_headless", callback = setHeadless })
	addFeature(cosmeticSection, { name = "Korblox", flag = "cosmetic_korblox", callback = setKorblox })

	-- Limiteds: real catalog items loaded by asset id and worn on your character (only you see them).
	local LIMITED_ITEMS = {
		["Dominus Empyreus"] = 21070012, ["Dominus Frigidus"] = 48545806, ["Dominus Infernus"] = 31101391,
		["Dominus Rex"] = 250395631, ["Dominus Messor"] = 64444871, ["Dominus Vespertilio"] = 96103379,
		["Dominus Aureus"] = 138932314, ["Valkyrie Helm"] = 1365767, ["Violet Valkyrie"] = 1402432199,
		["Emerald Valkyrie"] = 2830437685, ["Blackvalk"] = 124730194, ["Sparkle Time Fedora"] = 1285307,
		["Red Sparkle Time Fedora"] = 72082328, ["Green Sparkle Time Fedora"] = 100929604,
		["Purple Sparkle Time Fedora"] = 63043890, ["Midnight Blue Sparkle Time Fedora"] = 119916949,
		["Fiery Horns of the Netherworld"] = 215718515, ["Frozen Horns of the Frigid Planes"] = 74891470,
		["Poisoned Horns of the Toxic Wasteland"] = 1744060292, ["Clockwork's Headphones"] = 1235488,
		["Clockwork's Shades"] = 11748356, ["Silver King of the Night"] = 439945661, ["Domino Crown"] = 1031429,
		["8-Bit Royal Crown"] = 10159600649, ["Bighead"] = 1048037, ["Eerie Pumpkin Head"] = 1158416,
	}
	local LIMITED_FACES = { ["Super Super Happy Face"] = 494291269, ["Playful Vampire"] = 2409285794 }

	local limitedNames = {}
	for name in pairs(LIMITED_ITEMS) do
		table.insert(limitedNames, name)
	end
	table.sort(limitedNames)

	local assetCache = {}
	local wornLimiteds = {}
	local hiddenAccessories = {}
	local faceState = nil
	local applyingLimiteds = false

	---Load a catalog asset (yields). Only a successful load is cached: caching a failed one (a
	---hiccup, or the executor busy) used to leave that item broken for the rest of the session.
	---Executors without getobjects fall back to game:GetObjects and InsertService.
	local function loadAsset(id)
		if assetCache[id] then
			return assetCache[id]
		end
		local content = "rbxassetid://" .. id
		local loaders = {
			function()
				return getobjects(game, content)
			end,
			function()
				return game:GetObjects(content)
			end,
			function()
				return { game:GetService("InsertService"):LoadLocalAsset(content) }
			end,
		}
		for _, loader in ipairs(loaders) do
			local ok, objects = pcall(loader)
			local first = ok and type(objects) == "table" and objects[1]
			if typeof(first) == "Instance" then
				assetCache[id] = first
				return first
			end
		end
		return nil
	end

	---Weld an accessory onto your character ourselves: Humanoid:AddAccessory doesn't build
	---the weld on the client, so the item just fell off.
	---@return boolean
	local function wearAccessory(character, accessory)
		local handle = accessory:FindFirstChild("Handle")
		if not (handle and handle:IsA("BasePart")) then
			return false
		end

		-- Match the item's attachment (HatAttachment, FaceFrontAttachment...) on a body part,
		-- never on another accessory.
		local itemAttachment = handle:FindFirstChildOfClass("Attachment")
		local bodyAttachment
		if itemAttachment then
			for _, part in ipairs(character:GetChildren()) do
				local match = part:IsA("BasePart") and part:FindFirstChild(itemAttachment.Name)
				if match and match:IsA("Attachment") then
					bodyAttachment = match
					break
				end
			end
		end

		local weld = Instance.new("Weld")
		weld.Name = "AccessoryWeld"
		weld.Part0 = handle

		if bodyAttachment then
			weld.Part1 = bodyAttachment.Parent
			weld.C0 = itemAttachment.CFrame
			weld.C1 = bodyAttachment.CFrame
		else
			-- Older hats have no attachment and sit on top of the head by AttachmentPoint.
			local head = character:FindFirstChild("Head")
			if not head then
				return false
			end
			weld.Part1 = head
			weld.C0 = accessory.AttachmentPoint
			weld.C1 = CFrame.new(0, head.Size.Y / 2, 0)
		end

		weld.Parent = handle
		accessory.Parent = character
		return true
	end

	---Take off every limited and give back your own hats and face.
	local function clearLimiteds()
		for _, accessory in ipairs(wornLimiteds) do
			accessory:Destroy()
		end
		table.clear(wornLimiteds)

		for handle, transparency in pairs(hiddenAccessories) do
			if handle.Parent then
				handle.Transparency = transparency
			end
		end
		table.clear(hiddenAccessories)

		if faceState then
			if faceState.decal.Parent then
				faceState.decal.Texture = faceState.texture
			end
			faceState = nil
		end
	end

	---Re-dress your character from the current settings.
	local pendingLimiteds = false
	local dressLimiteds
	local function applyLimiteds()
		if applyingLimiteds then
			pendingLimiteds = true
			return
		end
		applyingLimiteds = true
		-- Protected: an error part way used to leave applyingLimiteds stuck on, and Limiteds never
		-- worked again until you re-ran the script.
		local ok, problem = pcall(dressLimiteds)
		if not ok then
			warn("[Aqua] limiteds:", problem)
		end
		applyingLimiteds = false

		-- A setting changed while items were loading: dress again with the newest choice.
		if pendingLimiteds then
			pendingLimiteds = false
			task.spawn(applyLimiteds)
		end
	end

	function dressLimiteds()
		clearLimiteds()

		local character = localPlayer.Character
		local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		if not (flags.cosmetic_limiteds and humanoid) then
			return
		end

		-- Optionally hide the hats you're really wearing so the limiteds don't clip into them.
		if flags.cosmetic_hide_hats then
			for _, accessory in ipairs(character:GetChildren()) do
				local handle = accessory:IsA("Accessory") and accessory:FindFirstChild("Handle")
				if handle then
					hiddenAccessories[handle] = handle.Transparency
					handle.Transparency = 1
				end
			end
		end

		for _, name in ipairs(type(flags.cosmetic_hats) == "table" and flags.cosmetic_hats or {}) do
			local template = LIMITED_ITEMS[name] and loadAsset(LIMITED_ITEMS[name])
			-- Accoutrement covers both Accessory and the old Hat class some classic items load as.
			if template and template:IsA("Accoutrement") and localPlayer.Character == character then
				local accessory = template:Clone()
				for _, part in ipairs(accessory:GetDescendants()) do
					if part:IsA("BasePart") then
						part.Anchored = false
						part.CanCollide = false
						part.CanQuery = false
						part.CanTouch = false
						part.Massless = true
					end
				end
				if wearAccessory(character, accessory) then
					table.insert(wornLimiteds, accessory)
				else
					accessory:Destroy()
				end
			end
		end

		local faceId = LIMITED_FACES[flags.cosmetic_face or ""]
		local head = character:FindFirstChild("Head")
		local decal = head and head:FindFirstChildOfClass("Decal")
		local faceTemplate = faceId and loadAsset(faceId)
		if decal and faceTemplate and faceTemplate:IsA("Decal") then
			faceState = { decal = decal, texture = decal.Texture }
			decal.Texture = faceTemplate.Texture
		end
	end

	-- Every 2 seconds: if something took a worn limited off (the game, a respawn that beat the
	-- re-dress, a team change), put everything back on.
	task.spawn(function()
		while isCurrentRun() do
			task.wait(2)
			local character = localPlayer.Character
			if flags.cosmetic_limiteds and character and not applyingLimiteds then
				local broken = false
				for _, accessory in ipairs(wornLimiteds) do
					if accessory.Parent ~= character then
						broken = true
					end
				end
				if broken then
					applyLimiteds()
				end
			end
		end
	end)

	-- Deferred so the library has stored the new toggle state before we read it.
	addFeature(cosmeticSection, { name = "Limiteds", flag = "cosmetic_limiteds", callback = function()
		task.defer(applyLimiteds)
	end })
	-- Re-dress whenever the item, face or hat settings change.
	local function reapplyLimiteds()
		task.defer(function()
			if flags.cosmetic_limiteds then
				applyLimiteds()
			end
		end)
	end

	cosmeticSection:dropdown({
		name = "items",
		flag = "cosmetic_hats",
		items = limitedNames,
		default = { "Dominus Empyreus" },
		multi = true,
		callback = reapplyLimiteds,
	})
	cosmeticSection:dropdown({
		name = "face",
		flag = "cosmetic_face",
		items = { "None", "Super Super Happy Face", "Playful Vampire" },
		default = "None",
		callback = reapplyLimiteds,
	})
	cosmeticSection:toggle({ name = "hide my own hats", flag = "cosmetic_hide_hats", default = false, callback = reapplyLimiteds })

	library:connection(localPlayer.CharacterAdded, function(character)
		character:WaitForChild("Head", 5)
		task.wait(1)
		table.clear(wornLimiteds)
		table.clear(hiddenAccessories)
		faceState = nil
		if flags.cosmetic_limiteds and isCurrentRun() then
			applyLimiteds()
		end
	end)

	onUnload(clearLimiteds)

	-- Reapply after respawns.
	library:connection(localPlayer.CharacterAdded, function(character)
		character:WaitForChild("Head", 5)
		task.wait(0.5)
		setHeadless(flags.cosmetic_headless == true)
		setKorblox(flags.cosmetic_korblox == true)
	end)

	onUnload(function()
		setHeadless(false)
		setKorblox(false)
	end)
end

local serverInfo = { game = "loading...", region = "..." }
local serverLabelSets = {}

---Build a server info section; every copy is refreshed by the update loop below.
---@param tab table
---@param side string
local function createServerSection(tab, side)
	local section = tab:section({ name = "Server", side = side })

	local labels = {
		game = createLabel(section, "Game: " .. serverInfo.game),
		players = createLabel(section, "Players: ..."),
		session = createLabel(section, "Time in server: ..."),
		ping = createLabel(section, "Ping: ..."),
		region = createLabel(section, "Your region: " .. serverInfo.region),
	}
	createLabel(section, "Job ID: " .. string.sub(game.JobId, 1, 18))

	section:button({
		name = "Copy Job ID",
		callback = function()
			setclipboard(game.JobId)
			library:notification({ text = "Copied Job ID." })
		end,
	})

	section:button({
		name = "Copy join script",
		callback = function()
			setclipboard(string.format(
				'game:GetService("TeleportService"):TeleportToPlaceInstance(%d, "%s", game.Players.LocalPlayer)',
				game.PlaceId,
				game.JobId
			))
			library:notification({ text = "Copied join script." })
		end,
	})

	section:button({
		name = "Rejoin",
		callback = function()
			teleportService:TeleportToPlaceInstance(game.PlaceId, game.JobId, localPlayer)
		end,
	})

	section:button({
		name = "Server Hop",
		callback = function()
			task.spawn(function()
				local placeId = game.PlaceId
				local jobId = game.JobId
				local ok, body = pcall(function()
					return request({
						Url = string.format(
							"https://games.roblox.com/v1/games/%d/servers/Public?sortOrder=Desc&limit=100",
							placeId
						),
						Method = "GET",
					}).Body
				end)
				if not ok or type(body) ~= "string" then
					return library:notification({ text = "Server hop failed (request)." })
				end
				local decodedOk, data = pcall(httpService.JSONDecode, httpService, body)
				if not decodedOk or type(data) ~= "table" or type(data.data) ~= "table" then
					return library:notification({ text = "Server hop failed (parse)." })
				end
				local candidates = {}
				for _, server in ipairs(data.data) do
					if server.id and server.id ~= jobId and (server.playing or 0) < (server.maxPlayers or 1) then
						table.insert(candidates, server)
					end
				end
				if #candidates == 0 then
					return library:notification({ text = "No other servers found." })
				end
				local pick = candidates[math.random(1, #candidates)]
				library:notification({ text = "Hopping servers..." })
				pcall(teleportService.TeleportToPlaceInstance, teleportService, placeId, pick.id, localPlayer)
			end)
		end,
	})

	section:button({
		name = "Server Hop Lowest",
		callback = function()
			task.spawn(function()
				local placeId = game.PlaceId
				local jobId = game.JobId
				local ok, body = pcall(function()
					return request({
						Url = string.format(
							"https://games.roblox.com/v1/games/%d/servers/Public?sortOrder=Asc&limit=100",
							placeId
						),
						Method = "GET",
					}).Body
				end)
				if not ok or type(body) ~= "string" then
					return library:notification({ text = "Server hop failed (request)." })
				end
				local decodedOk, data = pcall(httpService.JSONDecode, httpService, body)
				if not decodedOk or type(data) ~= "table" or type(data.data) ~= "table" then
					return library:notification({ text = "Server hop failed (parse)." })
				end
				local best, bestCount = nil, math.huge
				for _, server in ipairs(data.data) do
					local playing = server.playing or 0
					if server.id and server.id ~= jobId and playing < (server.maxPlayers or 1) and playing < bestCount then
						best, bestCount = server, playing
					end
				end
				if not best then
					return library:notification({ text = "No other servers found." })
				end
				library:notification({ text = string.format("Hopping to %d player server...", bestCount) })
				pcall(teleportService.TeleportToPlaceInstance, teleportService, placeId, best.id, localPlayer)
			end)
		end,
	})

	table.insert(serverLabelSets, labels)
end


-- Fetch slow, one-off info without blocking the GUI.
task.spawn(function()
	local success, info = pcall(marketplaceService.GetProductInfo, marketplaceService, game.PlaceId)
	serverInfo.game = success and info.Name or "unknown"

	local regionSuccess, region = pcall(localizationService.GetCountryRegionForPlayerAsync, localizationService, localPlayer)
	serverInfo.region = regionSuccess and region or "unknown"
end)

Intro.step("loading aim helper", 0.55)

do
	local function buildAimCore()
	-- Aim Helper and weapon tools (Prison Life). Lives in the main tab.
	local aimTab = Tabs.combat

	local replicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
	local gunRemotes = replicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("GunRemotes")
	local shootRemote = gunRemotes and gunRemotes:FindFirstChild("ShootEvent")
	local reloadRemote = gunRemotes and gunRemotes:FindFirstChild("FuncReload")
	local sharedModules = replicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("SharedModules")
	local carContainer = workspace:FindFirstChild("CarContainer")

	local GUN_NAMES = { "M9", "Revolver", "MP5", "AK-47", "M4A1", "FAL", "Remington 870", "M700" }
	local RANDOM_PARTS = { "Head", "Torso", "Left Arm", "Right Arm", "Left Leg", "Right Leg", "HumanoidRootPart" }
	local RAY_METHODS = {
		Raycast = { required = 3, types = { "Instance", "Vector3", "Vector3", "RaycastParams" } },
		FindPartOnRay = { required = 2, types = { "Instance", "Ray", "Instance", "boolean", "boolean" } },
		FindPartOnRayWithIgnoreList = { required = 3, types = { "Instance", "Ray", "table", "boolean", "boolean" } },
		FindPartOnRayWithWhitelist = { required = 3, types = { "Instance", "Ray", "table", "boolean" } },
	}

	---Require a game module at game-script identity so it never sees executor globals.
	local function safeRequire(moduleScript)
		local previous = getthreadidentity and getthreadidentity() or 8
		if setthreadidentity then
			setthreadidentity(2)
		end
		local ok, result = pcall(require, moduleScript)
		if setthreadidentity then
			setthreadidentity(previous)
		end
		return ok and result or nil
	end

	local currentTarget = nil
	local smoothedPosition = nil
	local randomPart = "HumanoidRootPart"
	local autoShootCasting = false
	local friendCache = {}
	local random = Random.new()

	-- Aim Helper settings.
	local aimSection = aimTab:section({ name = "Silent Aim", side = "left" })

	addFeature(aimSection, { name = "Silent Aim", flag = "aim_enabled" })
	aimSection:dropdown({ name = "target priority", flag = "aim_mode", items = { "FOV", "Distance", "Lowest Health" }, default = "FOV" })
	aimSection:dropdown({
		name = "target part",
		flag = "aim_part",
		items = { "Head", "HumanoidRootPart", "Torso", "Random", "Closest Part", "Closest Point" },
		default = "HumanoidRootPart",
	})
	aimSection:dropdown({
		name = "ray method",
		flag = "aim_method",
		items = { "Raycast", "FindPartOnRay", "FindPartOnRayWithIgnoreList", "FindPartOnRayWithWhitelist" },
		default = "Raycast",
	})
	aimSection:toggle({ name = "team check", flag = "aimhelper_team_check", default = true })
	aimSection:dropdown({ name = "whitelist teams", flag = "aimhelper_team_whitelist", items = { "Inmates", "Guards", "Criminals" }, default = {}, multi = true })
	aimSection:slider({ name = "hit chance", flag = "aim_hit_chance", min = 0, max = 100, default = 100, interval = 1, suffix = "%" })
	aimSection:slider({ name = "smoothing", flag = "aim_smoothing", min = 0, max = 1, default = 0, interval = 0.01 })
	aimSection:slider({ name = "max range", flag = "aim_range", min = 50, max = 5000, default = 2500, interval = 25, suffix = " studs" })

	local filterSection = aimTab:section({ name = "Target Filters", side = "left" })

	filterSection:toggle({ name = "visible check", flag = "aim_visible_check", default = true })
	filterSection:toggle({ name = "team check", flag = "aim_team_check", default = true })
	filterSection:toggle({ name = "friend check", flag = "aim_friend_check", default = true })
	filterSection:toggle({ name = "force field check", flag = "aim_forcefield_check", default = true })
	filterSection:toggle({ name = "hostile only", flag = "aim_hostile_check", default = false })
	filterSection:toggle({ name = "trespassing only", flag = "aim_trespass_check", default = false })
	filterSection:dropdown({
		name = "target teams",
		flag = "aim_teams",
		items = { "Inmates", "Guards", "Criminals" },
		default = { "Inmates", "Guards", "Criminals" },
		multi = true,
	})
	filterSection:textbox({ placeholder = "Only Target Names", flag = "aim_only_targets" })
	filterSection:textbox({ placeholder = "Never Target Names", flag = "aim_ignore_targets" })
	filterSection:textbox({ placeholder = "Priority Target Names", flag = "aim_priority_targets" })
	-- Resolver: aims at whichever body part is actually visible, and ignores fake speeds from
	-- desync or jitter when predicting.
	filterSection:toggle({ name = "resolver", flag = "aim_resolver", default = false })

	-- FOV circle.
	local fovSection = aimTab:section({ name = "FOV Circle", side = "right" })

	fovSection:toggle({ name = "show FOV circle", flag = "aim_fov_visible", default = true })
	fovSection:colorpicker({ flag = "aim_fov_color", color = Color3.new(1, 1, 1) })
	fovSection:slider({ name = "fov radius", flag = "aim_fov_radius", min = 20, max = 1200, default = 200, interval = 5, suffix = "px" })
	fovSection:slider({ name = "fov thickness", flag = "aim_fov_thickness", min = 1, max = 4, default = 1, interval = 1, suffix = "px" })
	fovSection:toggle({ name = "filled", flag = "aim_fov_filled", default = false })
	fovSection:toggle({ name = "rainbow", flag = "aim_fov_rainbow", default = false })
	fovSection:toggle({ name = "highlight target", flag = "aim_target_highlight", default = true })
	fovSection:colorpicker({ flag = "aim_target_color", color = Color3.fromRGB(140, 0, 0) })
	fovSection:toggle({ name = "snapline to target", flag = "aim_target_snapline", default = false })

	local fovOutline = Drawing.new("Circle")
	fovOutline.NumSides = 64
	fovOutline.Color = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
	fovOutline.Transparency = 0.6
	fovOutline.ZIndex = 4

	local fovCircle = Drawing.new("Circle")
	fovCircle.NumSides = 64
	fovCircle.ZIndex = 5

	local fovFill = Drawing.new("Circle")
	fovFill.NumSides = 64
	fovFill.Filled = true
	fovFill.Transparency = 0.12
	fovFill.ZIndex = 3

	-- "aqua [logo] labs" centered just under the crosshair, in the moving water look. Built from
	-- gui (Drawing text can't hold an image or a gradient), behind a small stand-in with the same
	-- Visible / Size / Position / Color / Remove the render loop already uses.
	do
		local labelGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
		labelGui.Name = ""
		labelGui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
		labelGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
		labelGui.DisplayOrder = 7
		labelGui.Enabled = false
		labelGui:SetAttribute("AquaLabs", true)
		labelGui.Parent = coreGui

		local row = Instance.new("Frame")
		row.Name = ""
		row.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0)
		row.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.XY
		row.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		row.Parent = labelGui
		local layout = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
		layout.FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal
		layout.VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Center
		layout.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
		layout.Padding = UDim.new(0, 3)
		layout.Parent = row

		local labelFont = Font.new("rbxasset://fonts/families/GothamSSm.json", Enum.FontWeight.Medium)
		local words = {}
		local function word(text, order, phase)
			local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
			label.Name = ""
			label.LayoutOrder = order
			label.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X
			label.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 16)
			label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
			label.FontFace = labelFont
			label.Text = text
			label.TextSize = 14
			label.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
			label:SetAttribute("KeepFont", true)
			label.Parent = row
			local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
			stroke.Color = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
			stroke.Transparency = 0.1
			stroke.Parent = label
			local gradient = Instance.new("UIGradient")
			gradient.Parent = label
			Hooks.water.add(gradient, phase, true)
			table.insert(words, label)
		end
		word("aqua", 1, 0)
		-- A small heavy "A" in the same water look, gently bobbing and swaying.
		local icon = Instance.new("TextLabel")
		icon.Name = ""
		icon.LayoutOrder = 2
		icon.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(16, 18)
		icon.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		icon.FontFace = Font.new("rbxasset://fonts/families/GothamSSm.json", Enum.FontWeight.Heavy)
		icon.Text = "A"
		icon.TextSize = 17
		icon.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
		icon:SetAttribute("KeepFont", true)
		icon.Parent = row
		local iconStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
		iconStroke.Color = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
		iconStroke.Transparency = 0.1
		iconStroke.Parent = icon
		-- The A holds still and fills with water: a bright surface line that rises and falls and
		-- tilts as it sloshes, light "air" above it and the theme color deepening below.
		local iconGradient = Instance.new("UIGradient")
		iconGradient.Parent = icon
		local fillAt = 0
		library:connection(runService.RenderStepped, function()
			local now = os.clock()
			if not labelGui.Enabled or now - fillAt < 1 / 30 then
				return
			end
			fillAt = now
			local accent = getAccent()
			local level = 0.48 + math.sin(now * 1.4) * 0.09 + math.sin(now * 3.7) * 0.025
			iconGradient.Color = ColorSequence.new({
				ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, accent:Lerp(Color3.new(1, 1, 1), 0.8)),
				ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(level + NEG_ONE * 0.05, accent:Lerp(Color3.new(1, 1, 1), 0.7)),
				ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(level, Color3.new(1, 1, 1)),
				ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(level + 0.06, accent:Lerp(Color3.new(1, 1, 1), 0.25)),
				ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, accent:Lerp(Color3.new(0, 0, 0), 0.15)),
			})
			-- Top to bottom, tilted a little either way like water rocking in a glass.
			iconGradient.Rotation = 90 + math.sin(now * 1.9) * 14
		end)
		word("labs", 3, 0.9)

		-- Self flags: one small line under the logo with what you're doing right now
		-- ("shooting jawsome · in air · reloading").
		local flagLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
		flagLabel.Name = ""
		flagLabel.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0)
		flagLabel.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X
		flagLabel.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 14)
		flagLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		flagLabel.FontFace = Font.new("rbxasset://fonts/families/GothamSSm.json", Enum.FontWeight.Medium)
		flagLabel.TextSize = 12
		flagLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
		flagLabel.Text = ""
		flagLabel.RichText = true
		flagLabel:SetAttribute("KeepFont", true)
		flagLabel.Parent = labelGui
		local flagStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
		flagStroke.Color = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
		flagStroke.Transparency = 0.2
		flagStroke.Parent = flagLabel
		-- Flags animation (Aim > FOV > flags animation).
		Hooks.textFx.attach(flagLabel, "fov_flags", true)

		---What you're doing, most important first.
		local function selfFlags()
			local list = {}
			local now = os.clock()
			local character = localPlayer.Character
			local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
			local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			if not (humanoid and root) or humanoid.Health <= 0 then
				return "dead"
			end

			-- Combat: a kill you just got, then shooting, then who you're locked onto.
			local locked = Hooks.lockedTarget and Hooks.lockedTarget.Parent
			local lockedPlayer = locked and playersService:GetPlayerFromCharacter(locked)
			local lockedName = lockedPlayer and string.lower(lockedPlayer.DisplayName)
			if Hooks.lastKill and now - Hooks.lastKill.at < 2.5 then
				table.insert(list, "killed " .. string.lower(Hooks.lastKill.name))
			elseif now - (Hooks.lastShotAt or 0) < 0.35 then
				table.insert(list, lockedName and ("shooting " .. lockedName) or "shooting")
			elseif lockedName then
				table.insert(list, "target " .. lockedName)
			end

			local tool = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")
			if tool and (tool:GetAttribute("Local_ReloadSession") or 0) ~= 0 then
				table.insert(list, "reloading")
			end
			if Hooks.healPending and Hooks.healPending() then
				table.insert(list, "eating")
			end

			-- Movement.
			local seat = humanoid.SeatPart
			if seat then
				table.insert(list, seat:IsA("VehicleSeat") and "driving" or "sitting")
			elseif humanoid:GetState() == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Climbing then
				table.insert(list, "climbing")
			elseif humanoid.FloorMaterial == Enum.Material.Air then
				table.insert(list, "in air")
			else
				if Hooks.isCrouched and Hooks.isCrouched() then
					table.insert(list, "crouching")
				end
				local speed = Vector3.new(root.AssemblyLinearVelocity.X, 0, root.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Z).Magnitude
				if speed > 18 then
					table.insert(list, "running")
				elseif speed > 1 then
					table.insert(list, "walking")
				else
					table.insert(list, "idle")
				end
			end

			if character:FindFirstChildOfClass("ForceField") then
				table.insert(list, "forcefield")
			end
			if flags.invisible_enabled then
				table.insert(list, "invisible")
			end
			if flags.noclip_enabled then
				table.insert(list, "noclip")
			end
			if flags.anti_aim then
				table.insert(list, "anti aim")
			end
			return table.concat(list, " · ")
		end

		-- Per Flag colors: each kind of flag reads its own color picker (Aim > FOV).
		local FLAG_KINDS = {
			killed = "combat", shooting = "combat", target = "combat",
			reloading = "action", eating = "action",
			walking = "movement", running = "movement", idle = "movement", ["in air"] = "movement",
			climbing = "movement", sitting = "movement", driving = "movement", crouching = "movement",
			forcefield = "status", dead = "status",
			invisible = "cheat", noclip = "cheat", ["anti aim"] = "cheat",
		}
		Hooks.FLAG_KIND_DEFAULTS = {
			combat = Color3.fromRGB(255, 70, 70),
			action = Color3.fromRGB(255, 215, 70),
			movement = Color3.fromRGB(200, 200, 200),
			status = Color3.fromRGB(110, 200, 255),
			cheat = Color3.fromRGB(190, 140, 255),
		}
		local FLAG_COLORS = setmetatable({}, {
			__index = function(_, name)
				local kind = FLAG_KINDS[name]
				if not kind then
					return nil
				end
				local picked = flags["self_flags_color_" .. kind]
				return picked and picked.Color or Hooks.FLAG_KIND_DEFAULTS[kind]
			end,
		})

		---Color the flags line by the picked color mode.
		local function paintFlags(text)
			local mode = flags.self_flags_color_mode or "White"
			local separator = '<font transparency="0.4"> · </font>'
			local parts = {}
			for part in string.gmatch(text, "[^·]+") do
				part = part:match("^%s*(.-)%s*$")
				if part ~= "" then
					local color
					if mode == "Theme" then
						color = getAccent()
					elseif mode == "Custom" then
						color = flags.self_flags_color and flags.self_flags_color.Color or Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
					elseif mode == "Per Flag" then
						color = FLAG_COLORS[part] or FLAG_COLORS[part:match("^(%S+)") or ""] or getAccent():Lerp(Color3.new(1, 1, 1), 0.5)
					elseif mode == "Theme Fade" then
						color = getAccent():Lerp(Color3.new(1, 1, 1), (#parts % 3) * 0.3)
					end
					table.insert(parts, color and string.format('<font color="#%s">%s</font>', color:ToHex(), part) or part)
				end
			end
			return table.concat(parts, separator)
		end

		local flagsAt = 0
		library:connection(runService.Heartbeat, function()
			local show = labelGui.Enabled and flags.self_flags ~= false
			flagLabel.Visible = show
			local now = os.clock()
			if not show then
				return
			end
			-- Glow: the outline takes the theme color and breathes.
			if flags.self_flags_glow == true then
				flagStroke.Color = getAccent()
				flagStroke.Thickness = 1.5
				flagStroke.Transparency = 0.25 + (math.sin(now * 3) + 1) * 0.2
			else
				flagStroke.Color = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
				flagStroke.Thickness = 1
				flagStroke.Transparency = 0.2
			end
			if now - flagsAt < 0.1 then
				return
			end
			flagsAt = now
			local raw = selfFlags()
			local text = Hooks.textFx.tintText("fov_flags", paintFlags(raw))
			-- New flags just swap in place (no bounce).
			if flagLabel.Text ~= text then
				flagLabel.Text = text
			end
		end)

		local state = {}
		Hooks.fovLabel = setmetatable({}, {
			__index = function(_, key)
				if key == "Remove" or key == "Destroy" then
					return function()
						labelGui:Destroy()
					end
				end
				return state[key]
			end,
			__newindex = function(_, key, value)
				if state[key] == value then
					return
				end
				state[key] = value
				if key == "Visible" then
					labelGui.Enabled = value == true
				elseif key == "Position" then
					row.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(math.floor(value.X), math.floor(value.Y))
				elseif key == "Size" then
					for _, label in ipairs(words) do
						label.TextSize = value
						label.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, value + 2)
					end
					icon.TextSize = value + 3
					icon.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(value + 2, value + 4)
				elseif key == "FlagSize" then
					flagLabel.TextSize = value
					flagLabel.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, value + 2)
				end
				-- Flags sit right under the logo row, nudged by their own x / y offset.
				if (key == "Position" or key == "Size" or key == "FlagOffset") and state.Position then
					local size = state.Size or 14
					local nudge = state.FlagOffset or Vector2.zero
					flagLabel.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(math.floor(state.Position.X + nudge.X), math.floor(state.Position.Y + size + 6 + nudge.Y))
				end
			end,
		})
	end
	fovSection:toggle({ name = "fov label", flag = "aim_fov_label", default = true })
	fovSection:toggle({ name = "label without circle", flag = "aim_fov_label_only", default = false })
	fovSection:toggle({ name = "self flags", flag = "self_flags", default = true })
	fovSection:dropdown({ name = "flags color", flag = "self_flags_color_mode", items = { "White", "Theme", "Theme Fade", "Per Flag", "Custom" }, default = "Per Flag" })
	fovSection:colorpicker({ flag = "self_flags_color", color = Color3.new(1, 1, 1) })
	-- Per Flag colors, one per kind of flag.
	fovSection:colorpicker({ name = "combat flags (killed, shooting)", flag = "self_flags_color_combat", color = Hooks.FLAG_KIND_DEFAULTS.combat })
	fovSection:colorpicker({ name = "action flags (reloading, eating)", flag = "self_flags_color_action", color = Hooks.FLAG_KIND_DEFAULTS.action })
	fovSection:colorpicker({ name = "movement flags (idle, walking)", flag = "self_flags_color_movement", color = Hooks.FLAG_KIND_DEFAULTS.movement })
	fovSection:colorpicker({ name = "status flags (forcefield)", flag = "self_flags_color_status", color = Hooks.FLAG_KIND_DEFAULTS.status })
	fovSection:colorpicker({ name = "cheat flags (noclip, anti aim)", flag = "self_flags_color_cheat", color = Hooks.FLAG_KIND_DEFAULTS.cheat })
	fovSection:dropdown({ name = "flags animation", flag = "self_flags_anim", items = table.clone(Hooks.textFx.STYLES), default = "Shimmer" })
	fovSection:toggle({ name = "flags glow", flag = "self_flags_glow", default = false })	-- Negative moves it left / up, positive right / down. Flags follow the label, plus their own offset.
	fovSection:slider({ name = "label x", flag = "aim_fov_label_x", min = tonumber("-300"), max = 300, default = 0, interval = 1, suffix = "px" })
	fovSection:slider({ name = "label y", flag = "aim_fov_label_offset", min = tonumber("-300"), max = 300, default = 0, interval = 1, suffix = "px" })
	fovSection:slider({ name = "flags x", flag = "self_flags_x", min = tonumber("-300"), max = 300, default = 0, interval = 1, suffix = "px" })
	fovSection:slider({ name = "flags y", flag = "self_flags_y", min = tonumber("-300"), max = 300, default = 0, interval = 1, suffix = "px" })
	fovSection:slider({ name = "label text size", flag = "aim_fov_label_scale", min = 0.5, max = 3, default = 1, interval = 0.05, suffix = "x" })
	fovSection:slider({ name = "flags text size", flag = "self_flags_scale", min = 0.5, max = 3, default = 1, interval = 0.05, suffix = "x" })

	-- Auto trigger and hitbox assist.
	local assistSection = aimTab:section({ name = "Hitbox Assist", side = "right" })

	assistSection:slider({ name = "hitbox size", flag = "hitbox_size", min = 2, max = 25, default = 8, interval = 0.5, suffix = " studs" })
	assistSection:slider({ name = "hitbox transparency", flag = "hitbox_transparency", min = 0, max = 1, default = 0.7, interval = 0.05 })

	---Comma-separated name list from a textbox flag, lowercased.
	local function nameList(flag)
		local list = {}
		for name in string.gmatch(flags[flag] or "", "[^,%s]+") do
			list[string.lower(name)] = true
		end
		return list
	end

	---Prioritized (Players tab > Prioritize): skips every "who can I shoot" rule (teams, guard
	---targets, friends, hostile only, name lists), so the player you picked always counts.
	local function isPrioritized(player)
		return player ~= nil and nameList("aim_priority_targets")[string.lower(player.Name)] == true
	end

	Hooks.isPrioritized = isPrioritized

	-- "PRIORITIZED" over the head of everyone you've prioritized while ESP is off. With ESP on
	-- it's one of the ESP's tags instead (next to HOSTILE / TRESPASSING).
	do
		local folder = Instance.new("Folder")
		folder.Name = ""
		folder.Parent = coreGui
		onUnload(function()
			folder:Destroy()
		end)
		local tags = {}

		---The tag for one player, made the first time it's needed.
		local function tagFor(player)
			local billboard = tags[player]
			if billboard then
				return billboard
			end
			billboard = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
			billboard.Name = ""
			billboard.AlwaysOnTop = true
			billboard.LightInfluence = 0
			billboard.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(120, 18)
			billboard.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, 2.4, 0)
			billboard.Enabled = false
			local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
			label.Name = ""
			label.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
			label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
			label.Text = "PRIORITIZED"
			label.FontFace = Font.new("rbxasset://fonts/families/GothamSSm.json", Enum.FontWeight.Bold, Enum.FontStyle.Normal)
			label.TextSize = 13
			label.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 70, 70)
			label.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.2
			label.Parent = billboard
			billboard.Parent = folder
			tags[player] = billboard
			return billboard
		end

		task.spawn(function()
			while isCurrentRun() and folder.Parent do
				local priority = nameList("aim_priority_targets")
				for _, player in ipairs(playersService:GetPlayers()) do
					local head = player ~= localPlayer and player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("Head")
					local show = head ~= nil and not flags.esp_enabled and priority[string.lower(player.Name)] == true
					if show then
						local billboard = tagFor(player)
						billboard.Adornee = head
						billboard.Enabled = true
					elseif tags[player] then
						tags[player].Enabled = false
					end
				end
				-- Players who left lose their tag.
				for player, billboard in pairs(tags) do
					if not player.Parent then
						billboard:Destroy()
						tags[player] = nil
					end
				end
				task.wait(0.25)
			end
		end)
	end

	---Friends are looked up once per player in the background (the call yields).
	local function isFriend(player)
		local cached = friendCache[player.UserId]
		if cached == nil then
			friendCache[player.UserId] = false
			task.spawn(function()
				local ok, result = pcall(localPlayer.IsFriendsWith, localPlayer, player.UserId)
				friendCache[player.UserId] = ok and result or false
			end)
			return false
		end
		return cached
	end

	local aimParams = RaycastParams.new()
	aimParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
	-- Same collision group as the game's bullets, so "visible" means "a bullet gets there".
	pcall(function()
		aimParams.CollisionGroup = "ClientBullet"
	end)

	---Car wallbang: shooting through vehicles only applies to a target within range, and
	---(with "wanted only") only to criminals and hostile or trespassing inmates.
	---@param targetPart BasePart?
	---@return boolean
	local function carWallbangAllowed(targetPart)
		if not (flags.shoot_through_cars and carContainer and targetPart) then
			return false
		end

		local character = targetPart:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")
		local player = character and playersService:GetPlayerFromCharacter(character)
		local myRoot = localPlayer.Character and localPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		if not (player and myRoot) then
			return false
		end

		if (targetPart.Position - myRoot.Position).Magnitude > (flags.car_wallbang_range or 150) then
			return false
		end

		if flags.car_wallbang_wanted ~= false then
			local team = player.Team and player.Team.Name
			if team == "Criminals" then
				return true
			end
			return team == "Inmates" and (character:GetAttribute("Hostile") == true or character:GetAttribute("Trespassing") == true)
		end
		return true
	end

	local overlapParams = OverlapParams.new()
	overlapParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
	local wallCache = { at = 0, parts = {} }

	---The wall you're standing in (noclipped). A ray skips the part it starts inside, but
	---Prison Life walls are several overlapping pieces, so the next piece still blocked every
	---sight line. While your head is inside a wall, the pieces around it are ignored.
	---@return {BasePart}
	local function wallsAroundMe()
		local now = os.clock()
		if now - wallCache.at < 0.1 then
			return wallCache.parts
		end
		wallCache.at = now
		table.clear(wallCache.parts)

		local character = localPlayer.Character
		local head = character and character:FindFirstChild("Head")
		if not head then
			return wallCache.parts
		end

		overlapParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = { character, workspace.CurrentCamera }
		if #workspace:GetPartsInPart(head, overlapParams) == 0 then
			return wallCache.parts
		end

		for _, part in ipairs(workspace:GetPartBoundsInRadius(head.Position, 3, overlapParams)) do
			local model = part:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")
			if part.Anchored and not (model and model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")) then
				table.insert(wallCache.parts, part)
			end
		end
		return wallCache.parts
	end

	---Things a sight line (or bullet) passes through: you, the target and the camera, the
	---wall you're inside (if noclipped), plus cars when the target qualifies for car wallbang.
	local function sightIgnoreList(character)
		local list = { localPlayer.Character, character, workspace.CurrentCamera }
		local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		if root and carWallbangAllowed(root) then
			table.insert(list, carContainer)
		end
		for _, part in ipairs(wallsAroundMe()) do
			table.insert(list, part)
		end
		return list
	end

	local carCheckParams = RaycastParams.new()
	carCheckParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
	pcall(function()
		carCheckParams.CollisionGroup = "ClientBullet"
	end)

	---For a plain shot (no aim target): the player part this ray would hit if cars weren't
	---in the way, so car wallbang can decide whether it's allowed.
	---@return BasePart?
	local function playerBehindCars(origin, direction)
		carCheckParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = { localPlayer.Character, workspace.CurrentCamera, carContainer }
		-- This runs inside the shot hook on the game's thread, so this Raycast comes back
		-- through the hook; the flag makes the hook pass it straight through instead of
		-- checking it again (which recursed until the camera script crashed).
		autoShootCasting = true
		local ok, result = pcall(workspace.Raycast, workspace, origin, direction, carCheckParams)
		autoShootCasting = false
		if not ok then
			return nil
		end
		local model = result and result.Instance:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")
		if model and playersService:GetPlayerFromCharacter(model) then
			return result.Instance
		end
		return nil
	end

	---Closest Part / Closest Point: aim at whatever bit of the body is nearest your cursor,
	---so shots land where you're already looking instead of snapping to one part.
	Hooks.BODY_PARTS = {
		"Head", "Torso", "Left Arm", "Right Arm", "Left Leg", "Right Leg",
		"UpperTorso", "LowerTorso", "LeftUpperArm", "RightUpperArm", "LeftLowerArm", "RightLowerArm",
		"LeftUpperLeg", "RightUpperLeg", "LeftLowerLeg", "RightLowerLeg",
	}

	---Touch screen with no mouse.
	function Hooks.isTouch()
		return Hooks.isMobile or (userInputService.TouchEnabled and not userInputService.MouseEnabled)
	end

	---Cursor position on screen (on touch: the screen center).
	function Hooks.aimCursor()
		-- Phones aim from the middle of the screen, where the FOV circle is drawn.
		if Hooks.isTouch() then
			return workspace.CurrentCamera.ViewportSize / 2
		end
		return userInputService:GetMouseLocation()
	end

	---The on-screen body part nearest the cursor.
	---@return BasePart?
	function Hooks.closestBodyPart(character)
		local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
		local cursor = Hooks.aimCursor()
		local best, bestDistance = nil, math.huge
		for _, name in ipairs(Hooks.BODY_PARTS) do
			local part = character:FindFirstChild(name)
			if part and part:IsA("BasePart") then
				local screen, onScreen = camera:WorldToViewportPoint(part.Position)
				if onScreen then
					local distance = (Vector2.new(screen.X, screen.Y) - cursor).Magnitude
					if distance < bestDistance then
						best, bestDistance = part, distance
					end
				end
			end
		end
		return best
	end

	---Where on `part` to aim. Closest Point aims where your line of sight enters the part
	---(pulled a little inside it), or at the spot on it nearest that line when it misses.
	---@return Vector3
	function Hooks.aimPointOn(part)
		if flags.aim_part ~= "Closest Point" then
			return part.Position
		end
		local cursor = Hooks.aimCursor()
		local ray = workspace.CurrentCamera:ViewportPointToRay(cursor.X, cursor.Y)
		local cf = part.CFrame
		local origin = cf:PointToObjectSpace(ray.Origin)
		local direction = cf:VectorToObjectSpace(ray.Direction)
		local half = part.Size * 0.5

		-- Ray against the part's box.
		local near, far = NEG_ONE * math.huge, math.huge
		for _, axis in ipairs({ "X", "Y", "Z" }) do
			local o, d, h = origin[axis], direction[axis], half[axis]
			if math.abs(d) < 1e-6 then
				if math.abs(o) > h then
					near, far = 1, 0
					break
				end
			else
				local t1 = (h * NEG_ONE + o * NEG_ONE) / d
				local t2 = (h + o * NEG_ONE) / d
				near = math.max(near, math.min(t1, t2))
				far = math.min(far, math.max(t1, t2))
			end
		end
		if near <= far and far > 0 then
			local hit = origin + direction * math.max(near, 0)
			return cf:PointToWorldSpace(hit * 0.85)
		end

		local along = NEG_ONE * origin:Dot(direction)
		local nearest = origin + direction * along
		local inner = part.Size * 0.4
		return cf:PointToWorldSpace(Vector3.new(
			math.clamp(nearest.X, NEG_ONE * inner.X, inner.X),
			math.clamp(nearest.Y, NEG_ONE * inner.Y, inner.Y),
			math.clamp(nearest.Z, NEG_ONE * inner.Z, inner.Z)
		))
	end

	---Hit chance: one roll per shot, shared by the ray redirect and the bullet rewrite (they
	---happen in the same frame), so a missed roll really misses instead of half-applying.
	---@return boolean
	function Hooks.aimRollHit()
		local now = os.clock()
		if now - (Hooks.aimRollAt or 0) > 0.05 then
			Hooks.aimRollAt = now
			local chance = tonumber(flags.aim_hit_chance) or 100
			-- Dot call, not random:NextNumber: this runs inside the namecall hook, and a ':' call there
			-- overwrote the game's method name, so missed rolls sent ShootEvent:NextNumber and the gun
			-- stopped firing.
			Hooks.aimRollResult = chance >= 100 or random.NextNumber(random, 0, 100) < chance
		end
		return Hooks.aimRollResult
	end

	---The part to aim at. Crouched or prone players keep their root part at standing
	---height while the body is lower, so root/torso aim follows the real torso instead.
	---@return BasePart?
	local function resolveAimPart(character, partName)
		if partName == "Closest Part" or partName == "Closest Point" then
			return Hooks.closestBodyPart(character) or character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		end
		local part = character:FindFirstChild(partName) or character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		if partName == "HumanoidRootPart" or partName == "Torso" then
			local root = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			local torso = character:FindFirstChild("Torso") or character:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso")
			if root and torso and (torso.CFrame.UpVector.Y < 0.75 or (torso.Position - root.Position).Magnitude > 1) then
				part = torso
			end
		end

		-- Resolver: players using invisible, desync or odd poses hide parts behind walls or
		-- under the floor. If the chosen part can't be seen, aim at one that can.
		if flags.aim_resolver and part then
			local myHead = localPlayer.Character and localPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("Head")
			if myHead then
				aimParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = sightIgnoreList(character)
				local function visible(candidate)
					return candidate ~= nil and workspace:Raycast(myHead.Position, candidate.Position - myHead.Position, aimParams) == nil
				end

				if not visible(part) then
					local candidates = {
						character:FindFirstChild("Head"),
						character:FindFirstChild("Torso") or character:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso"),
						character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart"),
						character:FindFirstChild("Left Arm") or character:FindFirstChild("LeftUpperArm"),
						character:FindFirstChild("Right Arm") or character:FindFirstChild("RightUpperArm"),
					}
					for _, candidate in ipairs(candidates) do
						if candidate ~= part and visible(candidate) then
							return candidate
						end
					end
				end
			end
		end

		return part
	end

	---Wallbang shot finder (its own function so its locals don't count against this block).
	---The server checks each bullet's path from the start point it's sent and accepts a start
	---point near you and a hit point near the target. So: look for a spot within Wallbang Range
	---of you that isn't inside anything and has a clear line to the target (or to a spot just
	---beside them), and fire from there.
	---@return table
	local function buildWallbang()
		local Wallbang = {}
		local rayParams = RaycastParams.new()
		rayParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
		local pointParams = OverlapParams.new()
		pointParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
		pcall(function()
			rayParams.CollisionGroup = "ClientBullet"
			pointParams.CollisionGroup = "ClientBullet"
		end)

		local cache = {}
		local ignoreUpdatedAt = 0

		---Every player's body is see-through for these checks.
		local function refreshIgnore()
			if os.clock() - ignoreUpdatedAt < 0.5 then
				return
			end
			ignoreUpdatedAt = os.clock()
			local ignore = { workspace.CurrentCamera }
			for _, player in ipairs(playersService:GetPlayers()) do
				if player.Character then
					table.insert(ignore, player.Character)
				end
			end
			rayParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = ignore
			pointParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = ignore
		end

		---A point that isn't inside a solid part.
		local function isOpen(position)
			for _, part in ipairs(workspace:GetPartBoundsInRadius(position, 0, pointParams)) do
				if part.CanCollide and (part:GetClosestPointOnSurface(position) - position).Magnitude <= 0.0001 then
					return false
				end
			end
			return true
		end

		-- Evenly spread directions on a sphere (golden-angle spiral).
		local SPHERE = {}
		for index = 0, 27 do
			local y = 1 + 2 * (index + 0.5) / 28 * NEG_ONE
			local radius = math.sqrt(math.max(0, 1 + y * y * NEG_ONE))
			local angle = index * 2.399963
			table.insert(SPHERE, Vector3.new(math.cos(angle) * radius, y, math.sin(angle) * radius))
		end

		---Is the straight path from `origin` to the target blocked?
		local function blockedImpl(origin, targetPart)
			refreshIgnore()
			return workspace:Raycast(origin, targetPart.Position - origin, rayParams) ~= nil
		end

		---A start point near you and a hit point on/near the target with a clear line between.
		---Cached briefly per target so the aim loops don't rescan every frame.
		---@return Vector3?, Vector3?
		local function findImpl(targetPart)
			local myRoot = localPlayer.Character and localPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			local targetRoot = targetPart.Parent and targetPart.Parent:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			if not (myRoot and targetRoot) then
				return nil
			end

			local now = os.clock()
			local cached = cache[targetPart]
			-- Phantom's origin changes every hop, so no reusing an old start point.
			if cached and now - cached.at < 0.15 and not Hooks.phantomOrigin then
				return cached.origin, cached.hit
			end

			refreshIgnore()
			local range = flags.wallbang_range or 7
			-- Measured from your head: that's where the game's own shots start, so it's the
			-- point the server compares the start point against.
			local myHead = localPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("Head")
			local origin = Hooks.phantomOrigin or (myHead and myHead.Position or myRoot.Position)
			local deadline = now + 0.006

			-- Where the bullet may land: the part itself, or open spots just around them.
			local hits = {}
			if isOpen(targetPart.Position) then
				table.insert(hits, targetPart.Position)
			end
			for _, normal in ipairs(Enum.NormalId:GetEnumItems()) do
				local position = targetRoot.Position + Vector3.fromNormalId(normal) * 4
				if isOpen(position) then
					table.insert(hits, position)
				end
			end

			-- Where the shot may start, nearest to your head first (the server only accepts a start
			-- point close to you): your head itself, then points straight toward the target
			-- (just past the wall you're against), then points around you.
			local starts = { origin }
			local toTarget = (targetPart.Position - origin)
			local forward = toTarget.Magnitude > 0.01 and toTarget.Unit or Vector3.zAxis
			for distance = 0.5, math.min(range, toTarget.Magnitude - 1), 0.5 do
				local position = origin + forward * distance
				if isOpen(position) then
					table.insert(starts, position)
				end
			end
			for step = 1, 3 do
				local radius = range * step / 3
				for _, direction in ipairs(SPHERE) do
					if direction:Dot(forward) > -0.2 then
						local position = origin + direction * radius
						if isOpen(position) then
							table.insert(starts, position)
						end
					end
				end
				if os.clock() > deadline then
					break
				end
			end
			table.sort(starts, function(a, b)
				return (a - origin).Magnitude < (b - origin).Magnitude
			end)

			local foundOrigin, foundHit = nil, nil
			-- Closest start point first; for each, any landing spot with a clear line.
			for _, start in ipairs(starts) do
				for _, hit in ipairs(hits) do
					if not workspace:Raycast(start, hit - start, rayParams) then
						foundOrigin, foundHit = start, hit
						break
					end
				end
				if foundOrigin or os.clock() > deadline + 0.004 then
					break
				end
			end

			cache[targetPart] = { at = now, origin = foundOrigin, hit = foundHit }
			return foundOrigin, foundHit
		end

		-- Forget old results.
		library:connection(runService.Heartbeat, function()
			local now = os.clock()
			for part, entry in pairs(cache) do
				if now - entry.at > 1 then
					cache[part] = nil
				end
			end
		end)

		---These run inside the shot hook too; mark our own raycasts so the hook lets them
		---straight through instead of treating them as shots.
		local function guarded(fn)
			return function(...)
				local previous = autoShootCasting
				autoShootCasting = true
				local results = table.pack(pcall(fn, ...))
				autoShootCasting = previous
				if results[1] then
					return table.unpack(results, 2, results.n)
				end
				return nil
			end
		end

		Wallbang.blocked = guarded(blockedImpl)
		Wallbang.find = guarded(findImpl)

		return Wallbang
	end
	local Wallbang = buildWallbang()

	---Fully visible: clear lines from your head (where shots start) to the aim part, head
	---and torso. A target half behind a wall doesn't count (cars don't count as cover for
	---targets that qualify for car wallbang). With Wallbang on, a target also counts when a
	---wallbang shot to them exists.
	local wallParams = RaycastParams.new()
	wallParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
	-- Only solid parts are walls (trigger zones, invisible boundaries and decor don't count).
	wallParams.RespectCanCollide = true
	pcall(function()
		wallParams.CollisionGroup = "ClientBullet"
	end)

	---How many separate walls are between your head and a part (stops counting past `limit`).
	---Prison Life walls are several overlapping pieces, so hits within a few studs of the last
	---counted wall are the same wall.
	---@return number
	local function wallsBetween(character, part, limit)
		local myHead = localPlayer.Character and localPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("Head")
		if not (myHead and part) then
			return math.huge
		end

		local ignore = sightIgnoreList(character)
		for _, player in ipairs(playersService:GetPlayers()) do
			if player.Character then
				table.insert(ignore, player.Character)
			end
		end

		local origin = myHead.Position
		local direction = part.Position - origin
		local walls, lastWall = 0, nil
		autoShootCasting = true
		for _ = 1, 16 do
			wallParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = ignore
			local ok, hit = pcall(workspace.Raycast, workspace, origin, direction, wallParams)
			if not (ok and hit) then
				break
			end
			if hit.Instance.Transparency >= 0.9 then
				-- See-through parts (glass panes are kept: they're under 0.9) don't block.
				table.insert(ignore, hit.Instance)
				continue
			end
			if not lastWall or (hit.Position - lastWall).Magnitude > 3 then
				walls += 1
				lastWall = hit.Position
				if walls > limit then
					break
				end
			else
				lastWall = hit.Position
			end
			table.insert(ignore, hit.Instance)
		end
		autoShootCasting = false
		return walls
	end

	local function canSee(character, aimPart)
		local myHead = localPlayer.Character and localPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("Head")

		if not myHead then
			return false
		end

		-- Wallbang only reaches through one wall (the server's limit), so a target behind more
		-- walls than "max walls" never counts as visible.
		if flags.aim_wallbang then
			local part = aimPart or character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			local maxWalls = flags.wallbang_max_walls or 1
			if part and wallsBetween(character, part, maxWalls) <= maxWalls and Wallbang.find(part) then
				return true
			end
		end

		aimParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = sightIgnoreList(character)
		local origin = myHead.Position
		local points = {
			aimPart or character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart"),
			character:FindFirstChild("Head"),
			character:FindFirstChild("Torso") or character:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso"),
		}

		for _, part in ipairs(points) do
			if part and workspace:Raycast(origin, part.Position - origin, aimParams) then
				return false
			end
		end
		return true
	end

	---Whether a player passes every target filter.
	local function isValidTarget(player, onlyList, ignoreList, maxRange, skipSight, skipFriendCheck)
		if player == localPlayer then
			return false
		end

		local character = player.Character
		local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		if not (humanoid and root and humanoid.Health > 0) then
			return false
		end

		local prioritized = isPrioritized(player)
		local lowered = string.lower(player.Name)
		if not prioritized and (ignoreList[lowered] or (next(onlyList) and not onlyList[lowered])) then
			return false
		end

		-- Triggerbot / generic path. pickTarget passes skipFriendCheck and applies its own flags.
		if not prioritized and not skipFriendCheck and flags.aim_friend_check ~= false and isFriend(player) then
			return false
		end

		if not prioritized and flags.aim_team_check and localPlayer.Team and player.Team == localPlayer.Team then
			return false
		end

		local teams = flags.aim_teams
		if not prioritized and player.Team and type(teams) == "table" and not table.find(teams, player.Team.Name) then
			return false
		end

		local myRoot = localPlayer.Character and localPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		if myRoot and (root.Position - myRoot.Position).Magnitude > (maxRange or flags.aim_range or 500) then
			return false
		end

		if flags.aim_forcefield_check and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("ForceField") then
			return false
		end

		-- As a guard/criminal, optionally only shoot inmates who are hostile or trespassing.
		if not prioritized and (flags.aim_hostile_check or flags.aim_trespass_check) then
			local myTeam = localPlayer.Team and localPlayer.Team.Name
			if (myTeam == "Guards" or myTeam == "Criminals") and player.Team and player.Team.Name == "Inmates" then
				local hostile = character:GetAttribute("Hostile")
				local trespassing = character:GetAttribute("Trespassing")
				local allowed = (flags.aim_hostile_check and hostile) or (flags.aim_trespass_check and trespassing)
				if not allowed then
					return false
				end
			end
		end

		if not skipSight and flags.aim_visible_check and not canSee(character) then
			return false
		end

		return true
	end

	---Where the aim point is measured from on screen (mouse, or screen center on touch).
	local function aimOrigin()
		if Hooks.isMobile or (userInputService.TouchEnabled and not userInputService.MouseEnabled) then
			return workspace.CurrentCamera.ViewportSize / 2
		end
		return userInputService:GetMouseLocation()
	end

	---Shared target picker for Aim Helper, Aim Lock and Ragebot.
	---`priority` is "FOV"/"Crosshair" (closest to the cursor), "Distance"/"Closest" (closest
	---to you) or "Lowest Health". Players named in "priority targets" always win.
	---@param priority string
	---@param partName string
	---@param useFov boolean only consider targets inside the FOV circle
	---@param maxRange number?
	---@param requireSight boolean?
	---@return BasePart?
	---A feature's own team rules ("rage", "aimlock", "aimhelper"): its Team Check and its
	---Whitelist Teams, plus the shared "never target" names.
	---@return boolean
	local function teamAllowed(prefix, player)
		if not player then
			return false
		end
		-- Global whitelist: never target these players with any combat feature.
		if isGloballyWhitelisted(player) then
			return false
		end
		-- Prioritized players skip the team and target-kind rules below.
		if isPrioritized(player) then
			return true
		end
		-- Target-only mode: only shoot names on the list.
		if flags.global_target_only_enabled then
			if not listHas(flags.global_target_only, player.Name) then
				return false
			end
		end
		if nameList("aim_ignore_targets")[string.lower(player.Name)] then
			return false
		end
		if flags[prefix .. "_team_check"] and localPlayer.Team and player.Team == localPlayer.Team then
			return false
		end
		local whitelist = flags[prefix .. "_team_whitelist"]
		if player.Team and type(whitelist) == "table" and table.find(whitelist, player.Team.Name) then
			return false
		end

		-- As a guard, only the picked kinds of target: criminals, hostile inmates and/or
		-- trespassing inmates. (Shooting a plain or trespassing inmate gets you warned.)
		local wanted = flags[prefix .. "_guard_targets"]
		if type(wanted) == "table" and localPlayer.Team and localPlayer.Team.Name == "Guards" then
			local team = player.Team and player.Team.Name
			local character = player.Character
			local allowed = (team == "Criminals" and table.find(wanted, "Criminals") ~= nil)
				or (team == "Inmates" and character ~= nil and (
					(character:GetAttribute("Hostile") == true and table.find(wanted, "Hostile") ~= nil)
					or (character:GetAttribute("Trespassing") == true and (table.find(wanted, "Trespassing") ~= nil
						-- Taser Trespassers: Ragebot goes after trespassers with the taser either way.
						or (prefix == "rage" and flags.rage_taser_trespass == true)))
				))
			if not allowed then
				return false
			end
		end
		return true
	end

	---Same check from a targeted body part.
	local function partAllowed(prefix, part)
		local character = part and part.Parent
		return character ~= nil and teamAllowed(prefix, playersService:GetPlayerFromCharacter(character))
	end

	local function pickTarget(priority, partName, useFov, maxRange, requireSight, skipSight, prefix)
		local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
		local myRoot = localPlayer.Character and localPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		if not myRoot then
			return nil
		end

		local onlyList, ignoreList = nameList("aim_only_targets"), nameList("aim_ignore_targets")
		local priorityList = nameList("aim_priority_targets")
		local origin = Hooks.aimCursor()
		local radius = flags.aim_fov_radius or 100
		local best, bestScore = nil, math.huge

		-- Prioritized players are the only targets while any of them is in the server
		-- (prioritized players who left don't count, so nobody is left untargetable).
		local priorityOnly = false
		for _, player in ipairs(playersService:GetPlayers()) do
			if priorityList[string.lower(player.Name)] then
				priorityOnly = true
				break
			end
		end

		for _, player in ipairs(playersService:GetPlayers()) do
			if priorityOnly and not priorityList[string.lower(player.Name)] then
				continue
			end
			if not isValidTarget(player, onlyList, ignoreList, maxRange, skipSight, true) then
				continue
			end

			-- Per-feature team rules: skip your own team, and never target whitelisted teams.
			if prefix and not teamAllowed(prefix, player) then
				continue
			end

			-- Friend check: per feature (silent aim / aimlock / rage).
			local checkFriends
			if prefix == "rage" then
				checkFriends = flags.rage_friend_check ~= false
			elseif prefix == "aimlock" then
				checkFriends = flags.aimlock_friend_check ~= false
			else
				checkFriends = flags.aim_friend_check ~= false
			end
			if checkFriends and not priorityOnly and isFriend(player) then
				continue
			end

			local character = player.Character
			local part = resolveAimPart(character, partName)
			if not part then
				continue
			end

			if requireSight and not flags.aim_visible_check and not canSee(character, part) then
				continue
			end

			-- With Wallbang on, Ragebot never goes for someone behind more than "max walls" walls,
			-- even with its visible check off (it can still shoot across the map through open air).
			if prefix == "rage" and (flags.rage_wallbang ~= false or flags.aim_wallbang) then
				local maxWalls = flags.rage_wallbang ~= false and (flags.rage_max_walls or 1)
					or (flags.wallbang_max_walls or 1)
				local walls = wallsBetween(character, part, maxWalls)
				if walls > maxWalls then
					continue
				end
				-- Behind a wall: only worth locking onto if a wallbang shot to them exists.
				if walls > 0 and not Wallbang.find(part) then
					continue
				end
			end

			local screenDistance = math.huge
			if useFov or priority == "FOV" or priority == "Crosshair" then
				local screen, onScreen = camera:WorldToViewportPoint(part.Position)
				if onScreen then
					screenDistance = (Vector2.new(screen.X, screen.Y) - origin).Magnitude
				end
				if useFov and screenDistance > radius then
					continue
				end
			end

			local score
			if priority == "Lowest Health" then
				score = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid").Health
			elseif priority == "Distance" or priority == "Closest" then
