				score = (part.Position - myRoot.Position).Magnitude
			else
				score = screenDistance
			end

			if priorityList[string.lower(player.Name)] then
				score -= 1e7
			end

			if score < bestScore then
				best, bestScore = part, score
			end
		end

		return best
	end

	---Pick the best target part right now.
	local function findTarget()
		local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
		local myRoot = localPlayer.Character and localPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		if not myRoot then
			return nil
		end

		local partName = flags.aim_part == "Random" and randomPart or (flags.aim_part or "HumanoidRootPart")
		return pickTarget(flags.aim_mode or "FOV", partName, flags.aim_mode ~= "Distance", nil, nil, nil, "aimhelper")
	end

	---Aim direction from `origin` toward the (smoothed) target with a little natural spread.
	local function redirect(origin, originalDirection, target)
		target = target or currentTarget
		if not (target and target.Parent) then
			return nil
		end

		local size = target.Size
		-- Closest Point already picks an exact spot; spread would push it off the part.
		local spread = Vector3.zero
		if flags.aim_part ~= "Closest Point" then
			spread = Vector3.new(
				(math.random() - 0.5) * size.X * 0.15,
				(math.random() - 0.5) * size.Y * 0.15,
				(math.random() - 0.5) * size.Z * 0.15
			)
		end
		local aimPoint = target == currentTarget and smoothedPosition or target.Position
		local direction = aimPoint + spread - origin
		if direction.Magnitude == 0 then
			return nil
		end

		return direction.Unit * math.max(originalDirection.Magnitude, direction.Magnitude)
	end

	---Pull origin/direction out of any of the supported ray methods.
	local function rayOf(method, arguments)
		if method == "Raycast" then
			if typeof(arguments[2]) == "Vector3" and typeof(arguments[3]) == "Vector3" then
				return arguments[2], arguments[3]
			end
		elseif RAY_METHODS[method] or method == "findPartOnRay" then
			local ray = arguments[2]
			if typeof(ray) == "Ray" then
				return ray.Origin, ray.Direction
			end
		end
	end

	---Whether this ray is your gun firing (from the camera, long enough, or ignoring your character).
	local function isLocalShot(method, arguments, origin, direction)
		local character = localPlayer.Character
		if not character then
			return false
		end

		local fromCamera = (origin - workspace.CurrentCamera.CFrame.Position).Magnitude <= 2
		if fromCamera and direction.Magnitude < 30 then
			return false
		end

		local ignoreList
		if method == "Raycast" and typeof(arguments[4]) == "RaycastParams" then
			ignoreList = arguments[4].FilterDescendantsInstances
		elseif typeof(arguments[3]) == "table" then
			ignoreList = arguments[3]
		elseif typeof(arguments[4]) == "table" then
			ignoreList = arguments[4]
		end

		if ignoreList then
			for _, instance in ipairs(ignoreList) do
				if instance == character then
					return true
				end
			end
		end

		return fromCamera
	end

	---Arguments match what the game passes for this method.
	local function argumentsMatch(arguments, spec)
		if #arguments < spec.required then
			return false
		end

		local matches = 0
		for index, argument in ipairs(arguments) do
			if typeof(argument) == spec.types[index] then
				matches += 1
			end
		end
		return matches >= spec.required
	end

	---A player hit by one of your shots (from the shoot remote's bullet data).
	local function reportHit(hitInstance)
		if typeof(hitInstance) ~= "Instance" or not hitInstance.Parent then
			return
		end

		local model = hitInstance:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")
		local hitPlayer = model and playersService:GetPlayerFromCharacter(model)
		if hitPlayer and hitPlayer ~= localPlayer then
			-- Remembered so kill effects only play for players you actually shot.
			Hooks.lastHit = Hooks.lastHit or setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
			Hooks.lastHit[hitPlayer] = os.clock()
			-- Track head vs body for Fortnite damage number color.
			Hooks.lastHitPart = Hooks.lastHitPart or setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
			local partName = hitInstance.Name
			Hooks.lastHitPart[hitPlayer] = (partName == "Head" or partName == "HeadTopAttachment")
			-- The part name itself, for the hit log ("in the Head").
			Hooks.lastHitName = Hooks.lastHitName or setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
			-- Hats and hair: name the body part the accessory sits on, not "Handle".
			local accessory = hitInstance:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Accessory")
			if accessory then
				local weld = hitInstance:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("JointInstance")
				partName = weld and weld.Part1 and weld.Part1.Name or "Head"
			end
			Hooks.lastHitName[hitPlayer] = partName
			if Hooks.onHit then
				Hooks.onHit(hitPlayer)
			end
		end
	end

	-- One namecall hook: redirects your gun's ray toward the target and reports hits.
	local oldNamecall
	oldNamecall = hookmetamethod(game, "__namecall", newcclosure(function(...)
		if checkcaller() or shuttingDown then
			return oldNamecall(...)
		end

		local self = ...
		local method = getnamecallmethod()

		local wantsAim = flags.aim_enabled and currentTarget
		if self == workspace and not autoShootCasting and (wantsAim or flags.shoot_through_cars or flags.aimlock_enabled) and RAY_METHODS[method] then
			local arguments = table.pack(...)
			local origin, direction = rayOf(method, arguments)

			if origin and direction and isLocalShot(method, arguments, origin, direction) then
				local changed = false

				-- Only the gun's own pellet ray starts at your head; camera rays (clicking items,
				-- zoom, mouse aim) must stay untouched, or picking up guns and food stops working.
				local myHead = localPlayer.Character and localPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("Head")
				local fromHead = myHead ~= nil and (origin - myHead.Position).Magnitude < 2
				local heldTool = localPlayer.Character and localPlayer.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")
				local holdingGun = heldTool ~= nil and (table.find(GUN_NAMES, heldTool.Name) ~= nil or heldTool.Name == "Taser")

				-- Aim Helper: bend your shot toward the target.
				local spec = RAY_METHODS[method]
				if wantsAim and fromHead and holdingGun and string.lower(flags.aim_method or "Raycast") == string.lower(method)
					and argumentsMatch(arguments, spec) and Hooks.aimRollHit() then
					local newDirection = redirect(origin, direction)
					if newDirection then
						direction = newDirection
						changed = true
					end
				end

				-- Shoot Through Cars: the bullet ignores vehicles, but only when the player it's
				-- going for qualifies (in range, and wanted if that filter is on).
				-- The gun aims in two steps: a camera ray finds the point under your cursor, then the
				-- bullet flies from your head toward it. If only the head ray ignored cars, the
				-- camera ray stopped on the car and the bullet was aimed at the car's surface,
				-- missing the player behind it. So the camera ray passes through cars too.
				local fromGunCamera = not fromHead and holdingGun and method == "Raycast"
					and typeof(arguments[4]) == "RaycastParams" and arguments[4].CollisionGroup == "ClientBullet"
					and (origin - workspace.CurrentCamera.CFrame.Position).Magnitude <= 2
				local carTarget = nil
				if (fromHead or fromGunCamera) and flags.shoot_through_cars and carContainer then
					carTarget = wantsAim and currentTarget or playerBehindCars(origin, direction)
				end
				-- Extra things this shot passes through: qualifying cars, and the wall you're
				-- standing in when noclipped.
				local extra = {}
				if carTarget and carWallbangAllowed(carTarget) then
					table.insert(extra, carContainer)
				end
				if fromHead then
					for _, part in ipairs(wallsAroundMe()) do
						table.insert(extra, part)
					end
				end

				if #extra > 0 then
					if method == "Raycast" then
						local params = arguments[4]
						local copy = RaycastParams.new()
						copy.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
						local list = {}
						if typeof(params) == "RaycastParams" then
							copy.CollisionGroup = params.CollisionGroup
							copy.IgnoreWater = params.IgnoreWater
							copy.RespectCanCollide = params.RespectCanCollide
							if params.FilterType == Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude then
								list = params.FilterDescendantsInstances
							end
						end
						if typeof(params) ~= "RaycastParams" or params.FilterType == Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude then
							for _, instance in ipairs(extra) do
								table.insert(list, instance)
							end
							copy.FilterDescendantsInstances = list
							arguments[4] = copy
							arguments.n = math.max(arguments.n, 4)
							changed = true
						end
					elseif method == "FindPartOnRayWithIgnoreList" and type(arguments[3]) == "table" then
						local list = table.clone(arguments[3])
						for _, instance in ipairs(extra) do
							table.insert(list, instance)
						end
						arguments[3] = list
						changed = true
					end
				end

				-- Our own lookups above (walls, cars) are namecalls too and overwrite the method
				-- name the game's call is waiting on; put it back before passing the call on.
				setnamecallmethod(method)

				if changed then
					if method == "Raycast" then
						arguments[3] = direction
					else
						arguments[2] = Ray.new(origin, direction)
					end
					return oldNamecall(table.unpack(arguments, 1, arguments.n))
				end
			end
			setnamecallmethod(method)
		elseif shootRemote and self == shootRemote and method == "FireServer" then
			Hooks.lastShotAt = os.clock()
			if Hooks.onShot then
				task.defer(Hooks.onShot)
			end
			local _, bulletData = ...

			-- Phones: the target is picked again right now (from the middle of the screen) so a quick
			-- tap never fires at an old target.
			if flags.aim_enabled and Hooks.isTouch() and type(bulletData) == "table" then
				autoShootCasting = true
				local ok, fresh = pcall(findTarget)
				autoShootCasting = false
				if ok and fresh then
					currentTarget = fresh
				end
				setnamecallmethod(method)
			end

			-- Silent Aim: rewrite every pellet onto the current target (works with ragebot on).
			local target = currentTarget
			if not (target and target.Parent) and flags.rage_enabled and Hooks.rageTarget and Hooks.rageTarget.Parent then
				-- Fall back to rage target so silent + rage both land shots.
				target = Hooks.rageTarget
			end
			-- Hit chance only gates Silent Aim's own target; the ragebot fallback always lands.
			local rolledHit = target ~= currentTarget or Hooks.aimRollHit()
			if flags.aim_enabled and rolledHit and target and target.Parent and type(bulletData) == "table" then
				local rewritten, changed = {}, false
				local hitPos = target == currentTarget and Hooks.aimPointOn(target) or target.Position
				for index, pellet in ipairs(bulletData) do
					if type(pellet) == "table" and typeof(pellet[1]) == "Vector3" then
						local origin = pellet[1]
						local finalHit = hitPos
						local finalInst = target
						local rageWallbang = target == Hooks.rageTarget and flags.rage_wallbang ~= false
						if (flags.aim_wallbang or rageWallbang) and Wallbang.blocked(origin, target) then
							local start, hit = Wallbang.find(target)
							if start then
								origin = start
								finalHit = hit or hitPos
							end
						end
						rewritten[index] = { origin, finalHit, finalInst }
						changed = true
					else
						rewritten[index] = pellet
					end
				end
				setnamecallmethod(method)
				if changed then
					task.defer(reportHit, target)
					return oldNamecall(self, rewritten)
				end
			end

			local firstPellet = type(bulletData) == "table" and bulletData[1]
			local hitInstance = type(firstPellet) == "table" and firstPellet[3]
			if hitInstance then
				task.defer(reportHit, hitInstance)
			end
		end

		-- Anything above may have made its own ':' calls; put the game's method name back first.
		setnamecallmethod(method)
		return oldNamecall(...)
	end))

	onUnload(function()
		hookmetamethod(game, "__namecall", oldNamecall)
	end)

	-- Target refresh (10/s) and random part rotation.
	task.spawn(function()
		local lastRandom = 0
		while isCurrentRun() and watermarkHolder.Parent do
			task.wait(0.1)
			if not isCurrentRun() then
				break
			end

			if os.clock() - lastRandom > 0.5 then
				lastRandom = os.clock()
				randomPart = RANDOM_PARTS[math.random(1, #RANDOM_PARTS)]
			end

			currentTarget = flags.aim_enabled and findTarget() or nil
		end
	end)

	-- Smoothing and FOV circle every frame.
	library:connection(runService.RenderStepped, function(deltaTime)
		-- A new target part (Closest Part switching head to torso) snaps instead of gliding across.
		if Hooks.smoothedTarget ~= currentTarget then
			Hooks.smoothedTarget = currentTarget
			smoothedPosition = nil
		end
		if flags.aim_enabled and currentTarget and currentTarget.Parent then
			local tau = (flags.aim_smoothing or 0) * 1.5
			local alpha = tau > 0.0001 and (1 - math.exp(-deltaTime / tau)) or 1
			local aimPoint = Hooks.aimPointOn(currentTarget)
			smoothedPosition = smoothedPosition and smoothedPosition:Lerp(aimPoint, alpha) or aimPoint
		else
			smoothedPosition = nil
		end

		-- Hidden while the mouse is over the open menu.
		local overMenu = Hooks.mouseOverMenu()
		local showCircle = flags.aim_fov_visible ~= false and not overMenu
			and ((flags.aim_enabled == true and flags.aim_mode ~= "Distance") or flags.aimlock_enabled == true)
		-- Any style but Classic is drawn by FOV Effects (animated ring and fills) instead.
		local classic = (flags.aim_fov_style or "Classic") == "Classic"
		Hooks.fovShown = showCircle and flags.aim_fov_label_only ~= true
		fovCircle.Visible = showCircle and classic
		fovOutline.Visible = showCircle and classic
		-- Fills are drawn by FOV Effects for every style (the "filled" toggle counts as Solid).
		fovFill.Visible = false
		-- "Label without circle" shows the AquaLabs text on its own, with no aim feature needed.
		local labelOnly = flags.aim_fov_label_only == true
		local showLabel = not overMenu and (labelOnly or (showCircle and flags.aim_fov_label ~= false))
		Hooks.fovLabel.Visible = showLabel
		if labelOnly then
			fovCircle.Visible, fovOutline.Visible, fovFill.Visible = false, false, false
		end

		if showCircle or showLabel then
			local center = aimOrigin()
			local radius = flags.aim_fov_radius or 100
			local color = flags.aim_fov_rainbow and getRainbow(0.3)
				or (flags.aim_fov_color and flags.aim_fov_color.Color or Color3.new(1, 1, 1))
			local thickness = flags.aim_fov_thickness or 1

			fovCircle.Position, fovOutline.Position, fovFill.Position = center, center, center
			fovCircle.Radius, fovOutline.Radius, fovFill.Radius = radius, radius, radius
			fovCircle.Thickness = thickness
			fovOutline.Thickness = thickness + 2
			fovCircle.Color, fovFill.Color = color, color
			-- Centered under the crosshair at any radius: just below the crosshair's arms (or the
			-- center when no crosshair is on). Text size follows the screen height and the FOV size:
			-- smaller inside a small circle, bigger in a large one (200px is the normal size).
			local viewportHeight = workspace.CurrentCamera.ViewportSize.Y
			local fovScale = math.clamp(math.sqrt(radius / 200), 0.85, 1.35)
			local labelSize = math.clamp(math.floor(14 * viewportHeight / 1080 * fovScale + 0.5), 11, 24)
			Hooks.fovLabel.Size = math.max(math.floor(labelSize * (flags.aim_fov_label_scale or 1) + 0.5), 6)
			-- Flags a little smaller than the logo by default, with their own size slider.
			Hooks.fovLabel.FlagSize = math.max(math.floor(math.max(labelSize - 2, 10) * (flags.self_flags_scale or 1) + 0.5), 6)
			local below = flags.crosshair_enabled and ((flags.crosshair_gap or 4) + (flags.crosshair_length or 8)) or 4
			-- A visible mouse arrow hangs about 20px below its tip; keep the label under it.
			local touch = Hooks.isMobile or (userInputService.TouchEnabled and not userInputService.MouseEnabled)
			if not touch and (userInputService.MouseIconEnabled or flags.custom_cursor) then
				below = math.max(below, 20)
			end
			Hooks.fovLabel.FlagOffset = Vector2.new(flags.self_flags_x or 0, flags.self_flags_y or 0)
			Hooks.fovLabel.Position = center + Vector2.new(flags.aim_fov_label_x or 0, below + 6 + (flags.aim_fov_label_offset or 0))
			Hooks.fovLabel.Color = color
		end
	end)

	-- Auto Trigger: fires the shoot remote at the current target with the gun's own fire rate.
	local gunTracers = sharedModules and sharedModules:FindFirstChild("GunTracers") and safeRequire(sharedModules.GunTracers)
	local shotParams = RaycastParams.new()
	shotParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
	pcall(function()
		shotParams.CollisionGroup = "ClientBullet"
	end)
	local lastShot = {}

	---Equipped gun, if any.
	local function equippedGun()
		local character = localPlayer.Character
		local tool = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")
		return tool and (table.find(GUN_NAMES, tool.Name) or tool.Name == "Taser") and tool or nil
	end

	---Keep the game's ammo counter in sync after our own shots/reloads.
	local function updateAmmoLabel(weapon, ammo)
		local home = localPlayer.PlayerGui:FindFirstChild("Home")
		local label = home and home:FindFirstChild("BulletsLabel", true)
		if not label then
			return
		end

		if weapon:GetAttribute("Behavior") == "Sniper" then
			label.Text = ammo .. " | " .. (weapon:GetAttribute("StoredAmmo") or 0)
		else
			label.Text = ammo .. "/" .. (weapon:GetAttribute("MaxAmmo") or ammo)
		end
	end
	Hooks.updateAmmoLabel = updateAmmoLabel

	---Cast one pellet with the gun's spread.
	local function castPellet(weapon, origin, aimPoint, spread)
		local roll = math.random()
		local behavior = weapon:GetAttribute("Behavior")
		if behavior == "Sniper" or behavior == "Shotgun" then
			roll = math.sqrt(roll)
		end

		local range = weapon:GetAttribute("Range") or 1000
		local direction = (CFrame.lookAt(origin, aimPoint)
			* CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(360 + 720 * math.random() * NEG_ONE))
			* CFrame.Angles(0, roll * spread, 0)).LookVector * range

		autoShootCasting = true
		local result = workspace:Raycast(origin, direction, shotParams)
		autoShootCasting = false

		return result and result.Instance, result and result.Position or origin + direction
	end

	---Fire one auto trigger volley.
	local function autoShoot(weapon, target)
		target = target or currentTarget
		if (weapon:GetAttribute("Local_ReloadSession") or 0) ~= 0 then
			return
		end

		local ammo = weapon:GetAttribute("Local_CurrentAmmo") or 0
		if ammo <= 0 then
			return
		end

		local character = localPlayer.Character
		local head = character and character:FindFirstChild("Head")
		if not head then
			return
		end

		-- Phantom sends shots from where the server has you, not where you are this frame.
		local origin = Hooks.phantomOrigin or head.Position
		-- Cars are ignored for targets that qualify for car wallbang.
		local ignore = carWallbangAllowed(target) and { character, carContainer } or { character }
		-- Shooting from inside a wall: the wall pieces around you don't stop the pellet.
		for _, part in ipairs(wallsAroundMe()) do
			table.insert(ignore, part)
		end
		shotParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = ignore

		local aimPoint = target.Position
		local redirected = redirect(origin, aimPoint - origin, target)
		if redirected then
			aimPoint = origin + redirected
		end

		local behavior = weapon:GetAttribute("Behavior")
		local muzzle = weapon:FindFirstChild("Muzzle")
		local muzzlePosition = muzzle and muzzle.Position or origin
		local bullets = {}

		-- Wallbang: if a wall is in the way, fire from the found start point onto the target.
		local wallStart, wallHit = nil, nil
		local rageWallbang = (target == Hooks.rageTarget or Hooks.phantomShooting) and flags.rage_wallbang ~= false
		if (flags.aim_wallbang or rageWallbang) and target.Parent and Wallbang.blocked(origin, target) then
			wallStart, wallHit = Wallbang.find(target)
		end

		for _ = 1, weapon:GetAttribute("ProjectileCount") or 1 do
			local hitInstance, hitPosition
			if wallStart then
				hitInstance, hitPosition = target, wallHit
				table.insert(bullets, { wallStart, hitPosition, hitInstance })
			else
				hitInstance, hitPosition = castPellet(weapon, origin, aimPoint, weapon:GetAttribute("SpreadRadius") or 0)
				table.insert(bullets, { origin, hitPosition, hitInstance })
			end

			-- Our own shots draw straight into the custom tracers when they're on.
			local drawn = Hooks.spawnTracer and Hooks.spawnTracer(muzzlePosition, hitPosition)
			if gunTracers and not drawn then
				pcall(function()
					if behavior == "Sniper" then
						gunTracers.createSniper(muzzlePosition, hitPosition)
					elseif behavior == "Taser" then
						gunTracers.createTaser(muzzlePosition, hitPosition)
					else
						gunTracers.createBullet(muzzlePosition, hitPosition)
					end
				end)
			end
		end

		shootRemote:FireServer(bullets)
		Hooks.lastShotAt = os.clock()

		-- Our own shots skip the hook, so report the hit here (kill effects, hit logs).
		local firstHit = bullets[1] and bullets[1][3]
		if firstHit then
			task.defer(reportHit, firstHit)
		end
		weapon:SetAttribute("Local_CurrentAmmo", ammo - 1)
		updateAmmoLabel(weapon, ammo - 1)

		local handle = weapon:FindFirstChild("Handle")
		local sound = handle and handle:FindFirstChild("ShootSound")
		if Hooks.onShot then
			Hooks.onShot(weapon, true)
		elseif sound then
			local clone = sound:Clone()
			clone.Parent = handle
			clone:Play()
			game:GetService("Debris"):AddItem(clone, 5)
		end
	end

	-- Ragebot and Aim Lock targets, picked by their blocks below.
	Hooks.rageTarget = nil
	local aimLockTarget = nil
	Hooks.triggerTarget = nil

	-- One firing loop for Ragebot and Triggerbot, paced by the gun's own fire rate.
	library:connection(runService.Heartbeat, function()
		local target = nil
		local function isDrivingNow()
			local char = localPlayer.Character
			local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
			if not hum or not hum.Sit then return false end
			local seat = hum.SeatPart
			return seat ~= nil
		end
		-- Auto Arrest prioritizes over ragebot / gun equip (forcefield = no arrest).
		---Guard auto-arrest candidate in range (anyone the handcuffs can take right now).
		local function nearArrestTarget()
			if not flags.auto_arrest then return nil end
			if not (localPlayer.Team and localPlayer.Team.Name == "Guards") then return nil end
			local myRoot = localPlayer.Character and localPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			if not myRoot then return nil end
			-- The handcuffs only reach 7.5 studs.
			local range = math.min(flags.auto_arrest_range or 7.5, 7.5)
			for _, plr in ipairs(playersService:GetPlayers()) do
				if plr == localPlayer then continue end
				if isGloballyWhitelisted(plr) then continue end
				local char = plr.Character
				if not char or char:FindFirstChildOfClass("ForceField") then continue end
				local root = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
				local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
				if not root or not hum or hum.Health <= 0 then continue end
				if (root.Position - myRoot.Position).Magnitude > range then continue end
				-- Same rules as the arrest loop (skips anyone already cuffed), and nothing while the
				-- handcuffs are on their 7s cooldown.
				local ok = Hooks.canArrestPlayer and Hooks.canArrestPlayer(plr) and os.clock() >= (Hooks.arrestReadyAt or 0)
				if ok then
					return plr
				end
			end
			return nil
		end

		local arrestTarget = nearArrestTarget()
		if arrestTarget then
			Hooks._arrestActive = true
			target = nil -- arrest loop handles cuffs + remote
		elseif flags.rage_enabled and Hooks.rageTarget and Hooks.rageTarget.Parent and not isDrivingNow() then
			target = Hooks.rageTarget
		elseif flags.trigger_enabled and Hooks.triggerTarget and Hooks.triggerTarget.Parent then
			target = Hooks.triggerTarget
		end

		if not (shootRemote and target) then
			return
		end
		-- Phantom fires Ragebot's shots itself, from the orbit stop (shots from your real spot get rejected).
		if Hooks.phantomActive and Hooks.phantomActive() then
			return
		end

		local humanoid = localPlayer.Character and localPlayer.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		local weapon = equippedGun()
		if not (humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0 and weapon) then
			return
		end

		-- Ragebot's taser rules: Taser Only fires nothing but the taser; otherwise the taser
		-- only fires with Use Taser on.
		if target == Hooks.rageTarget then
			-- Rage Delay: optional wait after picking a new target (0 = fire instantly).
			if (flags.rage_delay or 0) > 0 and os.clock() - (Hooks.rageAcquiredAt or 0) < flags.rage_delay / 1000 then
				return
			end
			-- Taser Trespassers: a trespasser in range only ever gets the taser.
			if Hooks.taserOverride then
				if weapon.Name ~= "Taser" then
					return
				end
			else
				if flags.rage_taser_only and weapon.Name ~= "Taser" then
					return
				end
				-- The taser also fires when Quick Swap cycles onto it with "include taser" on.
				local swapTaser = flags.gunswitch_enabled and flags.gunswitch_taser ~= false
				if weapon.Name == "Taser" and not (flags.rage_taser_only or flags.rage_use_taser or swapTaser) then
					return
				end
			end
		end

		local fireRate = weapon:GetAttribute("FireRate") or 0.1
		if not weapon:GetAttribute("AutoFire") then
			fireRate *= 1.5
		end
		if weapon.Name == "Remington 870" then
			fireRate = math.max(fireRate, 0.45)
		end

		if os.clock() - (lastShot[weapon.Name] or 0) < fireRate then
			return
		end
		lastShot[weapon.Name] = os.clock()

		pcall(autoShoot, weapon, target)
	end)

	---Phantom: fire one volley at `target` (a part) from wherever your body is right now (the
	---phantom spot, so the shot comes from where the server thinks you are). Pulls out a gun if
	---you aren't holding one, and keeps to the gun's own fire rate.
	function Hooks.phantomFire(target)
		local humanoid = localPlayer.Character and localPlayer.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		if not (shootRemote and humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0) then
			return
		end
		local weapon = equippedGun()
		local empty = weapon and (weapon:GetAttribute("Local_CurrentAmmo") or 0) <= 0
			and (weapon:GetAttribute("Local_ReloadSession") or 0) == 0
		-- Ragebot's taser rules: no taser unless Taser Only / Use Taser, Taser Only = nothing else.
		local taserOk = not flags.rage_enabled or flags.rage_taser_only or flags.rage_use_taser
		local wrongTaser = weapon and weapon.Name == "Taser" and not taserOk
		if weapon and flags.rage_enabled and flags.rage_taser_only and weapon.Name ~= "Taser" then
			local taser = localPlayer:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack") and localPlayer.Backpack:FindFirstChild("Taser")
			if taser then
				pcall(humanoid.EquipTool, humanoid, taser)
			end
			return
		end
		if wrongTaser then
			weapon = nil
		end
		-- No gun out, or this one is empty: pull out a loaded one (Auto Reload refills the rest).
		if not weapon or empty then
			local backpack = localPlayer:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack")
			for _, name in ipairs(GUN_NAMES) do
				local tool = backpack and backpack:FindFirstChild(name)
				if tool and (tool:GetAttribute("Local_CurrentAmmo") or 1) > 0 then
					pcall(humanoid.EquipTool, humanoid, tool)
					break
				end
			end
			if not weapon then
				return
			end
		end
		local fireRate = weapon:GetAttribute("FireRate") or 0.1
		if not weapon:GetAttribute("AutoFire") then
			fireRate *= 1.5
		end
		if weapon.Name == "Remington 870" then
			fireRate = math.max(fireRate, 0.45)
		end
		if os.clock() - (lastShot[weapon.Name] or 0) < fireRate then
			return
		end
		lastShot[weapon.Name] = os.clock()
		-- Ragebot's wallbang setting applies to Phantom's shots too.
		Hooks.phantomShooting = flags.rage_enabled == true
		pcall(autoShoot, weapon, target)
		Hooks.phantomShooting = false
		return true
	end

	-- Hitbox Assist: bigger root parts on other players (client-side), restored when off.
	local hitboxOriginals = {}

	---Put one root part back the way the game had it.
	local function resetHitbox(root)
		local original = hitboxOriginals[root]
		if original and root.Parent then
			root.Size = original.size
			root.Transparency = original.transparency
			root.Material = original.material
			root.Shape = original.shape
			root.CanCollide = original.canCollide
		end
		hitboxOriginals[root] = nil
	end

	library:connection(runService.Heartbeat, function()
		if not flags.hitbox_enabled then
			if next(hitboxOriginals) then
				for root in pairs(hitboxOriginals) do
					resetHitbox(root)
				end
			end
			return
		end

		local size = flags.hitbox_size or 8

		for _, player in ipairs(playersService:GetPlayers()) do
			local character = player.Character
			local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

			if player == localPlayer or not (root and humanoid) then
				continue
			end

			local skip = humanoid.Sit or humanoid.SeatPart ~= nil or humanoid.Health <= 0
				or (flags.hitbox_team_check and localPlayer.Team and player.Team == localPlayer.Team)

			if skip then
				if hitboxOriginals[root] then
					resetHitbox(root)
				end
				continue
			end

			if not hitboxOriginals[root] then
				hitboxOriginals[root] = {
					size = root.Size,
					transparency = root.Transparency,
					material = root.Material,
					shape = root.Shape,
					canCollide = root.CanCollide,
				}
			end

			local shape = flags.hitbox_shape == "Ball" and Enum.PartType.Ball or Enum.PartType.Block
			if root.Size.X ~= size then
				root.Size = Vector3.one * size
			end
			-- Only write what changed (these ran for every player every frame).
			local transparency = flags.hitbox_transparency or 0.7
			if root.Transparency ~= transparency then
				root.Transparency = transparency
			end
			if root.Material ~= Enum.Material.ForceField then
				root.Material = Enum.Material.ForceField
			end
			if root.CanCollide then
				root.CanCollide = false
			end
			if root.Shape ~= shape then
				root.Shape = shape
			end
		end
	end)

	onUnload(function()
		for root in pairs(hitboxOriginals) do
			resetHitbox(root)
		end

		fovCircle:Remove()
		fovOutline:Remove()
		fovFill:Remove()
		Hooks.fovLabel:Remove()
	end)

	-- Shared helpers for later aim builders (keeps register count under limit).
	Hooks.isFriend = isFriend
	Hooks._pickTarget = pickTarget
	Hooks._canSee = canSee
	Hooks._teamAllowed = teamAllowed
	Hooks._partAllowed = partAllowed
	Hooks._isPrioritized = isPrioritized
	---Whether anyone you prioritized is in the server (then they're the only targets).
	function Hooks._priorityPresent()
		for _, player in ipairs(playersService:GetPlayers()) do
			if isPrioritized(player) then
				return true
			end
		end
		return false
	end
	Hooks._equippedGun = equippedGun
	Hooks._aimOrigin = aimOrigin
	Hooks._Wallbang = Wallbang
	Hooks._findTarget = findTarget
	Hooks._GUN_NAMES = GUN_NAMES
	Hooks._shootRemote = shootRemote
	Hooks._reloadRemote = reloadRemote
	Hooks._carContainer = carContainer
	Hooks._replicatedStorage = replicatedStorage
	-- Aim Lock and Triggerbot (built in the next function) use these too; without them Aim Lock
	-- errored every frame ("attempt to call a nil value" in stillValid).
	Hooks._isValidTarget = isValidTarget
	Hooks._nameList = nameList
	Hooks._resolveAimPart = resolveAimPart
	Hooks._carWallbangAllowed = carWallbangAllowed
	function Hooks._getCurrentTarget()
		return currentTarget
	end

	end

	local function buildAimLockRageTrigger()
	local pickTarget = Hooks._pickTarget
	local canSee = Hooks._canSee
	local teamAllowed = Hooks._teamAllowed
	local partAllowed = Hooks._partAllowed
	local equippedGun = Hooks._equippedGun
	local aimOrigin = Hooks._aimOrigin
	local Wallbang = Hooks._Wallbang
	local findTarget = Hooks._findTarget
	local GUN_NAMES = Hooks._GUN_NAMES or { "M9", "Revolver", "MP5", "AK-47", "M4A1", "FAL", "Remington 870", "Taser" }
	local shootRemote = Hooks._shootRemote
	local reloadRemote = Hooks._reloadRemote
	local carContainer = Hooks._carContainer
	local replicatedStorage = Hooks._replicatedStorage or game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
	local isValidTarget = Hooks._isValidTarget
	local nameList = Hooks._nameList
	local resolveAimPart = Hooks._resolveAimPart
	local carWallbangAllowed = Hooks._carWallbangAllowed
	local aimLockTarget = nil
	local aimTab = Tabs.combat
	if not pickTarget then
		warn("[Aqua Labs] pickTarget missing — rebuild aim core failed")
		return
	end
	if not equippedGun then
		equippedGun = function()
			local character = localPlayer.Character
			local tool = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")
			if tool and table.find(GUN_NAMES, tool.Name) then
				return tool
			end
		end
	end

	do
		-- Aim Lock: moves your camera (or mouse) onto the closest target inside the FOV circle.
		local lockSection = aimTab:section({ name = "Aim Lock", side = "left" })
		local AIMLOCK_RENDER_KEY = "AquaAimLock"

		addFeature(lockSection, { name = "Aim Lock", flag = "aimlock_enabled" })
		lockSection:dropdown({ name = "activation", flag = "aimlock_activation", items = { "Hold Right Mouse", "Always" }, default = "Hold Right Mouse" })
		lockSection:dropdown({ name = "lock method", flag = "aimlock_method", items = { "Camera", "Mouse" }, default = "Camera" })
		lockSection:dropdown({ name = "lock part", flag = "aimlock_part", items = { "Head", "Torso", "HumanoidRootPart" }, default = "Head" })
		lockSection:dropdown({ name = "target priority", flag = "aimlock_priority", items = { "Crosshair", "Distance", "Lowest Health" }, default = "Crosshair" })
		lockSection:toggle({ name = "team check", flag = "aimlock_team_check", default = true })
		lockSection:toggle({ name = "friend check", flag = "aimlock_friend_check", default = true })
		lockSection:dropdown({ name = "whitelist teams", flag = "aimlock_team_whitelist", items = { "Inmates", "Guards", "Criminals" }, default = {}, multi = true })
		lockSection:slider({ name = "smoothness", flag = "aimlock_smoothness", min = 0, max = 0.95, default = 0.35, interval = 0.05 })
		lockSection:slider({ name = "prediction", flag = "aimlock_prediction", min = 0, max = 0.3, default = 0.08, interval = 0.01, suffix = "s" })
		lockSection:toggle({ name = "sticky target", flag = "aimlock_sticky", default = true })

		local lockedPart = nil
		local lastLockSearch = 0

		---Closest valid target part to the cursor inside the FOV circle.
		local function findLockTarget()
			return pickTarget(flags.aimlock_priority or "Crosshair", flags.aimlock_part or "Head", true, nil, nil, nil, "aimlock")
		end

		---Whether a locked part still belongs to a valid, living target.
		local function stillValid(part)
			local character = part and part.Parent
			local player = character and playersService:GetPlayerFromCharacter(character)
			return player ~= nil and isValidTarget(player, nameList("aim_only_targets"), nameList("aim_ignore_targets"))
				and teamAllowed("aimlock", player)
		end

		---Is the lock key held (or always on)?
		local function lockActive()
			-- Phones have no right mouse button, so the lock is always active there.
			if flags.aimlock_activation == "Always" or Hooks.isMobile then
				return true
			end
			return userInputService:IsMouseButtonPressed(Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton2)
		end

		runService:BindToRenderStep(AIMLOCK_RENDER_KEY, Enum.RenderPriority.Camera.Value + 1, function(deltaTime)
			aimLockTarget = lockedPart
			if not (flags.aimlock_enabled and isCurrentRun() and lockActive()) then
				lockedPart = nil
				aimLockTarget = nil
				return
			end

			-- Re-pick the target 20 times a second (or keep it while sticky and still valid).
			local now = os.clock()
			if now - lastLockSearch > 0.05 then
				lastLockSearch = now
				if not (flags.aimlock_sticky and lockedPart and lockedPart.Parent and stillValid(lockedPart)) then
					lockedPart = findLockTarget()
				end
			end

			if not (lockedPart and lockedPart.Parent) then
				return
			end

			local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
			local velocity = lockedPart.AssemblyLinearVelocity
			-- Resolver: desync, jitter and flings report huge fake speeds; don't lead those.
			if flags.aim_resolver and velocity.Magnitude > 60 then
				velocity = Vector3.zero
			end
			local aimPoint = lockedPart.Position + velocity * (flags.aimlock_prediction or 0)

			-- Frame-rate independent smoothing: 0 snaps, higher values glide.
			local smoothness = flags.aimlock_smoothness or 0
			local alpha = smoothness <= 0 and 1 or (1 - smoothness ^ (deltaTime * 60))

			-- Moving the mouse doesn't exist on phones; they always use the camera method.
			if flags.aimlock_method == "Mouse" and not Hooks.isMobile then
				local screen, onScreen = camera:WorldToViewportPoint(aimPoint)
				if onScreen then
					local mouse = userInputService:GetMouseLocation()
					mousemoverel((screen.X - mouse.X) * alpha, (screen.Y - mouse.Y) * alpha)
				end
			else
				local position = camera.CFrame.Position
				camera.CFrame = camera.CFrame:Lerp(CFrame.lookAt(position, aimPoint), alpha)
			end
		end)

		onUnload(function()
			pcall(runService.UnbindFromRenderStep, runService, AIMLOCK_RENDER_KEY)
		end)
	end

	do
		-- Ragebot: targets anyone valid in range (no FOV needed) and fires automatically.
		local rageSection = aimTab:section({ name = "Ragebot", side = "right" })
		local meleeRemote = replicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("meleeEvent")
		local GUN_PRIORITY = { "M4A1", "AK-47", "FAL", "MP5", "Remington 870", "Revolver", "M9" }

		addFeature(rageSection, { name = "Ragebot", flag = "rage_enabled", rage = true })
		rageSection:dropdown({ name = "rage part", flag = "rage_part", items = { "Head", "Torso", "HumanoidRootPart" }, default = "Head" })
		rageSection:dropdown({ name = "target priority", flag = "rage_priority", items = { "Closest", "Crosshair", "Lowest Health" }, default = "Closest" })
		-- Only fire at targets that are fully visible (cars don't count as cover for wanted targets).
		rageSection:toggle({ name = "visible check", flag = "rage_visible_check", default = true })
		-- Wallbang for Ragebot: targets in the open or behind up to "rage max walls" walls get shot
		-- (through the wall with wallbang); anyone behind more walls is skipped.
		rageSection:toggle({ name = "rage wallbang", flag = "rage_wallbang", default = true })
		rageSection:slider({ name = "rage max walls", flag = "rage_max_walls", min = 0, max = 3, default = 1, interval = 1 })
		Hooks.premiumGate(rageSection, "rage wallbang", "rage_wallbang")
		Hooks.premiumGate(rageSection, "rage max walls")
		rageSection:slider({ name = "rage delay", flag = "rage_delay", min = 0, max = 500, default = 0, interval = 10, suffix = "ms" })
		rageSection:toggle({ name = "team check", flag = "rage_team_check", default = true })
		rageSection:toggle({ name = "friend check", flag = "rage_friend_check", default = true })
		rageSection:toggle({ name = "only in fov", flag = "rage_use_fov", default = false })
		rageSection:dropdown({
			name = "guard targets",
			flag = "rage_guard_targets",
			items = { "Criminals", "Hostile", "Trespassing" },
			default = { "Criminals", "Hostile" },
			multi = true,
		})
		rageSection:toggle({ name = "use taser", flag = "rage_use_taser", default = false })
		rageSection:toggle({ name = "taser only", flag = "rage_taser_only", default = false })
		-- Tase trespassers near you (taser overrides your guns and Quick Swap) until they stop
		-- trespassing, get arrested or die.
		rageSection:toggle({ name = "taser trespassers", flag = "rage_taser_trespass", default = false })
		rageSection:slider({ name = "taser range", flag = "rage_taser_range", min = 10, max = 120, default = 40, interval = 5, suffix = " studs" })
		rageSection:dropdown({ name = "whitelist teams", flag = "rage_team_whitelist", items = { "Inmates", "Guards", "Criminals" }, default = {}, multi = true })
		rageSection:slider({ name = "rage range", flag = "rage_range", min = 50, max = 5000, default = 2500, interval = 25, suffix = " studs" })
		rageSection:toggle({ name = "auto equip best gun", flag = "rage_auto_equip", default = true })
		rageSection:toggle({ name = "face target", flag = "rage_face", default = false })
		addFeature(rageSection, { name = "Kill Aura", flag = "melee_aura", rage = true })
		rageSection:slider({ name = "punch range", flag = "melee_range", min = 4, max = 12, default = 9, interval = 1, suffix = " studs" })
		rageSection:toggle({ name = "wanted only as guard", flag = "melee_wanted_only", default = true })
		addFeature(rageSection, { name = "Anti Shield", flag = "anti_shield", rage = true })
		addFeature(rageSection, { name = "Arrest Aura", flag = "arrest_aura", rage = true })
		addFeature(rageSection, { name = "Auto Arrest", flag = "auto_arrest", rage = true })
		rageSection:slider({ name = "auto arrest range", flag = "auto_arrest_range", min = 2, max = 7.5, default = 7.5, interval = 0.5, suffix = " studs" })
		rageSection:slider({ name = "arrest range", flag = "arrest_aura_range", min = 3, max = 7.5, default = 7.5, interval = 0.5, suffix = " studs" })
		rageSection:toggle({ name = "auto equip handcuffs", flag = "arrest_aura_equip", default = true })

		-- Arrest Aura (as a guard): arrests anyone in reach the game would let you arrest with
		-- handcuffs: criminals, trespassing inmates, and hostile inmates who've been tased.
		local arrestRemote = replicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Remotes") and replicatedStorage.Remotes:FindFirstChild("ArrestPlayer")
		local teamsService = game:GetService("Teams")

		-- The tool you held before handcuffs came out, and when someone was last in reach.
		local arrestState = { swappedFrom = nil, lastTarget = 0 }
		Hooks._arrestActive = false
		Hooks.arrestPending = function()
			return Hooks._arrestActive == true
		end

		---Truthy character attribute / BoolValue (Prison Life sometimes is not strict boolean true).
		local function attrTrue(character, name)
			local value = character:GetAttribute(name)
			if value == true or value == 1 or value == "true" then
				return true
			end
			local child = character:FindFirstChild(name)
			if child and child:IsA("BoolValue") and child.Value then
				return true
			end
			return false
		end

		---Whether we should arrest this player (Guards + Auto Arrest / Arrest Aura).
		local function canArrest(player)
			local character = player.Character
			if not character or character:FindFirstChildOfClass("ForceField") then
				return false
			end
			local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
			if not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 then
				return false
			end
			-- Already cuffed: the game marks their character Arrested.
			if attrTrue(character, "Arrested") then
				return false
			end

			-- Same rules as the game's own handcuffs: criminals, trespassing inmates, and hostile
			-- inmates only once they've been tased.
			local teamName = player.Team and player.Team.Name
			if teamName == "Criminals" then
				return true
			end
			if teamName == "Inmates" then
				if attrTrue(character, "Hostile") then
					return attrTrue(character, "Tased")
				end
				return attrTrue(character, "Trespassing")
			end
			return false
		end
		Hooks.canArrestPlayer = canArrest

		-- The handcuffs can't arrest again for 7 seconds after a successful arrest.
		local ARREST_COOLDOWN = 7.1
		Hooks.arrestReadyAt = 0

		-- The frame whoever you were cuffing shows up Arrested (by you or anyone), handcuffs go away
		-- (your previous tool comes back if you had one) instead of waiting on the 0.2s loop.
		library:connection(runService.Heartbeat, function()
			local last = arrestState.lastPlayer
			if not (last and (flags.arrest_aura or flags.auto_arrest)) then
				return
			end
			local lastCharacter = last.Character
			if lastCharacter and lastCharacter.Parent and not attrTrue(lastCharacter, "Arrested") then
				return
			end
			arrestState.lastPlayer = nil
			arrestState.lastTarget = 0
			Hooks._arrestActive = false
			local character = localPlayer.Character
			local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
			if not (humanoid and character:FindFirstChild("Handcuffs")) or (Hooks.healPending and Hooks.healPending()) then
				return
			end
			local swappedFrom = arrestState.swappedFrom
			arrestState.swappedFrom = nil
			if swappedFrom and swappedFrom.Parent == localPlayer:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack") then
				pcall(humanoid.EquipTool, humanoid, swappedFrom)
			else
				pcall(humanoid.UnequipTools, humanoid)
			end
		end)

		task.spawn(function()
			while isCurrentRun() and watermarkHolder.Parent do
				task.wait(0.2)
				if not (isCurrentRun() and arrestRemote and (flags.arrest_aura or flags.auto_arrest)) then
					continue
				end

				local character = localPlayer.Character
				local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
				local myRoot = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
				if not (humanoid and myRoot and humanoid.Health > 0) then
					continue
				end
				if not (localPlayer.Team and localPlayer.Team.Name == "Guards") then
					continue
				end

				-- Closest arrestable player in reach (auto_arrest uses its own range; forcefield blocked in canArrest).
				local maxRange = flags.arrest_aura and (flags.arrest_aura_range or 7.5) or (flags.auto_arrest_range or 4)
				if flags.arrest_aura and flags.auto_arrest then
					maxRange = math.max(flags.arrest_aura_range or 7.5, flags.auto_arrest_range or 4)
				end
				-- The handcuffs only reach 7.5 studs (older configs saved bigger values).
				maxRange = math.min(maxRange, 7.5)
				local target, closest = nil, maxRange
				-- On cooldown nobody counts, so your guns come straight back out.
				local onCooldown = os.clock() < Hooks.arrestReadyAt
				for _, player in ipairs(onCooldown and {} or playersService:GetPlayers()) do
					if isGloballyWhitelisted(player) then continue end
					local root = player ~= localPlayer and player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
					if root and canArrest(player) then
						local distance = (root.Position - myRoot.Position).Magnitude
						if distance <= closest then
							target, closest = player, distance
						end
					end
				end

				-- Handcuffs stay out while anyone arrestable is around; your previous tool only
				-- comes back once nobody has been in reach for a moment. (Switching back after
				-- every try made your gun flick in and out nonstop.) Right after an arrest it comes
				-- back immediately.
				if not target then
					Hooks._arrestActive = false
					-- Whoever you were going for just got cuffed (by you or anyone): cuffs away right now.
					local last = arrestState.lastPlayer
					if last and (not last.Character or attrTrue(last.Character, "Arrested")) then
						arrestState.lastPlayer = nil
						arrestState.lastTarget = 0
						if not arrestState.swappedFrom and character:FindFirstChild("Handcuffs") and not (Hooks.healPending and Hooks.healPending()) then
							pcall(humanoid.UnequipTools, humanoid)
						end
					end
					if arrestState.swappedFrom and os.clock() - arrestState.lastTarget > 1.5 then
						if arrestState.swappedFrom.Parent and character:FindFirstChild("Handcuffs") and not (Hooks.healPending and Hooks.healPending()) then
							pcall(humanoid.EquipTool, humanoid, arrestState.swappedFrom)
						end
						arrestState.swappedFrom = nil
					end
					continue
				end
				arrestState.lastTarget = os.clock()
				arrestState.lastPlayer = target
				Hooks._arrestActive = true

				-- Auto Heal gets your hands first.
				if Hooks.healPending and Hooks.healPending() then
					continue
				end

				-- Handcuffs in hand; overrides gun auto-equip / ragebot.
				local shouldEquip = flags.arrest_aura_equip ~= false or flags.auto_arrest
				local cuffs = character:FindFirstChild("Handcuffs")
				if not cuffs and shouldEquip then
					local backpack = localPlayer:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack")
					local stored = backpack and backpack:FindFirstChild("Handcuffs")
					if stored then
						local held = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")
						if held and held.Name ~= "Handcuffs" then
							arrestState.swappedFrom = arrestState.swappedFrom or held
						end
						pcall(humanoid.UnequipTools, humanoid)
						task.wait(0.05)
						pcall(humanoid.EquipTool, humanoid, stored)
						task.wait(0.15)
						cuffs = character:FindFirstChild("Handcuffs")
					end
				end

				if cuffs then
					local arrested = false
					local attempts = {
						function() return arrestRemote:InvokeServer(target, 1) end,
						function() return arrestRemote:InvokeServer(target) end,
						function() return arrestRemote:InvokeServer(target.Character) end,
					}
					for _, attempt in ipairs(attempts) do
						local ok, result = pcall(attempt)
						-- The remote doesn't always return anything, so the game's Arrested mark counts too.
						if (ok and result) or (target.Character and attrTrue(target.Character, "Arrested")) then
							arrested = true
							break
						end
					end
					if arrested then
						library:notification({ text = "Arrested " .. target.DisplayName, time = 3 })
						-- Cuffs go away and your gun comes back out now; Ragebot / Quick Swap carry on.
						Hooks.arrestReadyAt = os.clock() + ARREST_COOLDOWN
						Hooks._arrestActive = false
						arrestState.lastTarget = 0
						arrestState.lastPlayer = nil
						local swappedFrom = arrestState.swappedFrom
						arrestState.swappedFrom = nil
						if character:FindFirstChild("Handcuffs") and not (Hooks.healPending and Hooks.healPending()) then
							local backpack = localPlayer:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack")
							if swappedFrom and swappedFrom.Parent == backpack then
								pcall(humanoid.EquipTool, humanoid, swappedFrom)
							else
								pcall(humanoid.UnequipTools, humanoid)
							end
						end
					end
				end
			end
		end)

		---Best target by priority; ragebot always needs line of sight so shots land.
		local function isDriving()
			local char = localPlayer.Character
			local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
			if not hum or not hum.Sit then return false end
			local seat = hum.SeatPart
			return seat and (seat:IsA("VehicleSeat") or seat.Name:lower():find("seat") or seat:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model") and seat:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model"):FindFirstChild("DriveSeat"))
		end

		local function findRageTarget()
			if isDriving() then return nil end
			if Hooks.arrestPending and Hooks.arrestPending() then return nil end
			local checkSight = flags.rage_visible_check ~= false
			-- Rage wallbang does its own wall count in pickTarget instead of the plain sight checks.
			if flags.rage_wallbang ~= false then
				checkSight = false
			end
			local useFov = flags.rage_use_fov == true
			-- Visible Check off: Ragebot ignores every sight check (its own and Target Filters').
			-- only in fov: same FOV radius as Silent Aim / Aim Lock.
			return pickTarget(flags.rage_priority or "Closest", flags.rage_part or "Head", useFov, flags.rage_range or 500, checkSight, not checkSight, "rage")
		end

		---Hold the best gun you own if you aren't holding one.
		local function equipBestGun()
			local humanoid = localPlayer.Character and localPlayer.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
			local backpack = localPlayer:FindFirstChild("Backpack")
			local held = equippedGun()
			if not (humanoid and backpack) then
				return
			end

			-- Taser Only: always the taser. Otherwise any gun you're holding is fine (the
			-- taser counts only with Use Taser on).
			if flags.rage_taser_only then
				local taser = backpack:FindFirstChild("Taser")
				if held and held.Name == "Taser" then
					return
				end
				if taser then
					pcall(humanoid.EquipTool, humanoid, taser)
				end
				return
			end
			if held and (held.Name ~= "Taser" or flags.rage_use_taser) then
				return
			end

			local order = table.clone(GUN_PRIORITY)
			if flags.rage_use_taser then
				table.insert(order, "Taser")
			end

			for _, name in ipairs(order) do
				local tool = backpack:FindFirstChild(name)
				if tool and (tool:GetAttribute("Local_CurrentAmmo") or 1) > 0 then
					pcall(humanoid.EquipTool, humanoid, tool)
					return
				end
			end
		end

		---Taser Trespassers: the closest trespassing inmate in taser range (as a guard, with a taser).
		local function findTrespasser()
			if not (flags.rage_taser_trespass and localPlayer.Team and localPlayer.Team.Name == "Guards") then
				return nil
			end
			local character = localPlayer.Character
			local myRoot = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			local backpack = localPlayer:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack")
			local hasTaser = (character and character:FindFirstChild("Taser")) or (backpack and backpack:FindFirstChild("Taser"))
			if not (myRoot and hasTaser) then
				return nil
			end

			local best, bestDistance = nil, flags.rage_taser_range or 40
			-- With someone prioritized, the taser leaves everyone else alone too.
			local priorityOnly = Hooks._priorityPresent and Hooks._priorityPresent()
			for _, player in ipairs(playersService:GetPlayers()) do
				if priorityOnly and not Hooks._isPrioritized(player) then
					continue
				end
				local other = player ~= localPlayer and player.Character
				local root = other and other:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
				local humanoid = other and other:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
				if root and humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0 and player.Team and player.Team.Name == "Inmates"
					and other:GetAttribute("Trespassing") == true and not other:FindFirstChildOfClass("ForceField")
					and teamAllowed("rage", player) then
					local distance = (root.Position - myRoot.Position).Magnitude
					local part = other:FindFirstChild(flags.rage_part or "Head") or root
					if distance < bestDistance and (flags.rage_visible_check == false or canSee(other, part)) then
						best, bestDistance = part, distance
					end
				end
			end
			return best
		end

		---Hold the taser (Taser Trespassers overrides other guns and Quick Swap).
		local function equipTaser()
			local character = localPlayer.Character
			local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
			if not humanoid or character:FindFirstChild("Taser") then
				return
			end
			local backpack = localPlayer:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack")
			local taser = backpack and backpack:FindFirstChild("Taser")
			if taser then
				pcall(humanoid.EquipTool, humanoid, taser)
			end
		end

		task.spawn(function()
			while isCurrentRun() and watermarkHolder.Parent do
				-- Every frame while on, so a target is picked the same frame they show up.
				if flags.rage_enabled then
					task.wait()
				else
					task.wait(0.25)
				end
				if not isCurrentRun() then
					break
				end

				-- Healing first: while Auto Heal is about to eat (or eating), Ragebot neither
				-- shoots nor pulls a gun out; it picks back up once you're healed.
				local healing = Hooks.healPending and Hooks.healPending()
				local previousCharacter = Hooks.rageTarget and Hooks.rageTarget.Parent

				-- Taser Trespassers comes first: the closest trespasser in taser range, until they're
				-- no longer trespassing, arrested or dead.
				local trespasser = flags.rage_enabled and not healing and findTrespasser() or nil
				Hooks.taserOverride = trespasser ~= nil
				Hooks.rageTarget = trespasser or (flags.rage_enabled and not healing and findRageTarget()) or nil

				-- Remember when a new player was picked (for the optional Rage Delay).
				if Hooks.rageTarget and Hooks.rageTarget.Parent ~= previousCharacter then
					Hooks.rageAcquiredAt = os.clock()
				end
				if Hooks.rageTarget and flags.rage_enabled and (flags.rage_auto_equip or Hooks.taserOverride) then
					if not (Hooks.arrestPending and Hooks.arrestPending()) then
						if Hooks.taserOverride then
							equipTaser()
						else
							equipBestGun()
						end
					end
				end
			end
		end)

		-- Face the target so the shots look natural from the server's view.
		library:connection(runService.Heartbeat, function()
			if not (flags.rage_enabled and flags.rage_face and Hooks.rageTarget and Hooks.rageTarget.Parent) then
				return
			end

			local root = localPlayer.Character and localPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			if root then
				local look = Vector3.new(Hooks.rageTarget.Position.X, root.Position.Y, Hooks.rageTarget.Position.Z)
				if (look - root.Position).Magnitude > 0.5 then
					root.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(root.Position, look)
				end
			end
		end)

		-- Melee Aura: punches every valid player within reach.
		task.spawn(function()
			while isCurrentRun() and watermarkHolder.Parent do
				task.wait(0.1)
				if not (isCurrentRun() and flags.melee_aura and meleeRemote) then
					continue
				end

				local myRoot = localPlayer.Character and localPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
				if not myRoot then
					continue
				end

				for _, player in ipairs(playersService:GetPlayers()) do
					local character = player.Character
					local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
					local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
					if player == localPlayer or not (root and humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0) then
						continue
					end
					if character:FindFirstChildOfClass("ForceField") then
						continue
					end
					if flags.aim_team_check and localPlayer.Team and player.Team == localPlayer.Team then
						continue
					end

					-- As a guard, only punch criminals and hostile or trespassing inmates.
					if flags.melee_wanted_only ~= false and localPlayer.Team and localPlayer.Team.Name == "Guards" then
						local team = player.Team and player.Team.Name
						local wanted = team == "Criminals"
							or (team == "Inmates" and (character:GetAttribute("Hostile") == true or character:GetAttribute("Trespassing") == true))
						if not wanted then
							continue
						end
					end

					if (root.Position - myRoot.Position).Magnitude <= (flags.melee_range or 9) then
						pcall(meleeRemote.FireServer, meleeRemote, player, 1, 1)
					end
				end
			end
		end)

		-- Anti Shield: riot shields stop blocking your bullets (only on your screen).
		local shieldOriginals = {}

		local antiShieldAcc = 0
		library:connection(runService.Heartbeat, function(dt)
			if not flags.anti_shield then
				if next(shieldOriginals) then
					for part, canQuery in pairs(shieldOriginals) do
						if part.Parent then
							part.CanQuery = canQuery
						end
					end
					table.clear(shieldOriginals)
			end
				return
			end

			antiShieldAcc += dt
			if antiShieldAcc < 0.2 then
				return
			end
			antiShieldAcc = 0

			for _, player in ipairs(playersService:GetPlayers()) do
				local shield = player ~= localPlayer and player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("RiotShieldPart", true)
				if shield and shield:IsA("BasePart") and shieldOriginals[shield] == nil then
					shieldOriginals[shield] = shield.CanQuery
					shield.CanQuery = false
				end
			end
		end)

		onUnload(function()
			for part, canQuery in pairs(shieldOriginals) do
				if part.Parent then
					part.CanQuery = canQuery
				end
			end
		end)
	end

	do
		-- Triggerbot: fires on its own once a valid enemy has been under your crosshair for
		-- the reaction delay (or, in Aim Helper mode, whenever Aim Helper has a target).
		local triggerSection = aimTab:section({ name = "Triggerbot", side = "left" })

		addFeature(triggerSection, { name = "Triggerbot", flag = "trigger_enabled" })
		triggerSection:dropdown({ name = "trigger mode", flag = "trigger_mode", items = { "Crosshair", "Aim Helper Target" }, default = "Crosshair" })
		triggerSection:slider({ name = "reaction delay", flag = "trigger_delay", min = 0, max = 500, default = 80, interval = 10, suffix = "ms" })
		triggerSection:slider({ name = "trigger range", flag = "trigger_range", min = 25, max = 5000, default = 300, interval = 25, suffix = " studs" })
		triggerSection:dropdown({ name = "trigger part", flag = "trigger_part", items = { "Head", "Torso", "HumanoidRootPart" }, default = "Torso" })

		local triggerParams = RaycastParams.new()
		triggerParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
		pcall(function()
			triggerParams.CollisionGroup = "ClientBullet"
		end)

		local candidate = nil
		local candidateSince = 0

		---The enemy part under your crosshair right now, if any.
		local function underCrosshair()
			local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
			local origin = aimOrigin()
			local ray = camera:ViewportPointToRay(origin.X, origin.Y)
			local reach = ray.Direction * (flags.trigger_range or 300) * 1.5
			triggerParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = { localPlayer.Character, camera }

			local result = workspace:Raycast(ray.Origin, reach, triggerParams)

			-- A car under the crosshair: look past it, but only take a target that qualifies
			-- for car wallbang.
			if result and carContainer and flags.shoot_through_cars and result.Instance:IsDescendantOf(carContainer) then
				triggerParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = { localPlayer.Character, camera, carContainer }
				result = workspace:Raycast(ray.Origin, reach, triggerParams)
				if result and not carWallbangAllowed(result.Instance) then
					return nil
				end
			end

			local model = result and result.Instance:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")
			local player = model and playersService:GetPlayerFromCharacter(model)
			if not player then
				return nil
			end

			if not isValidTarget(player, nameList("aim_only_targets"), nameList("aim_ignore_targets"), flags.trigger_range or 300) then
				return nil
			end
			-- Triggerbot follows Ragebot's team check and whitelist.
			if not teamAllowed("rage", player) then
				return nil
			end
			return resolveAimPart(model, flags.trigger_part or "Torso")
		end

		library:connection(runService.RenderStepped, function()
			if not flags.trigger_enabled then
				candidate, Hooks.triggerTarget = nil, nil
				return
			end

			local found
			if flags.trigger_mode == "Aim Helper Target" then
				found = flags.aim_enabled and Hooks._getCurrentTarget() or nil
			else
				found = underCrosshair()
			end

			-- Reaction delay: the same player has to stay under the crosshair this long.
			local foundCharacter = found and found.Parent
			if foundCharacter ~= (candidate and candidate.Parent) then
				candidate = found
				candidateSince = os.clock()
			end

			if found and os.clock() - candidateSince >= (flags.trigger_delay or 80) / 1000 then
				Hooks.triggerTarget = found
			else
				Hooks.triggerTarget = nil
			end
		end)
	end

	do
		-- Target highlight: marks whoever Ragebot, Aim Lock or Aim Helper is currently on.
		local targetHighlight = Instance.new("Highlight")
		targetHighlight.Name = ""
		targetHighlight.Enabled = false
		targetHighlight.DepthMode = Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop
		targetHighlight.FillTransparency = 0.35
		targetHighlight.OutlineTransparency = 0
		targetHighlight.Parent = coreGui

		local snapline = Drawing.new("Line")
		snapline.Thickness = 1.5
		snapline.ZIndex = 5

		library:connection(runService.RenderStepped, function()
			-- Each feature's target only counts if it passes that feature's whitelist, so a
			-- whitelisted player is never highlighted or given a snapline.
			local target = (flags.rage_enabled and partAllowed("rage", Hooks.rageTarget) and Hooks.rageTarget)
				or (flags.trigger_enabled and Hooks.triggerTarget and partAllowed("rage", Hooks.triggerTarget) and Hooks.triggerTarget)
				or (flags.aimlock_enabled and partAllowed("aimlock", aimLockTarget) and aimLockTarget)
				or (flags.aim_enabled and partAllowed("aimhelper", Hooks._getCurrentTarget()) and Hooks._getCurrentTarget())
				or nil
			local character = target and target.Parent

			-- When you were last locked onto someone (Auto Reload's idle reload uses this).
			if character then
				Hooks.lastTargetAt = os.clock()
			end
			Hooks.lockedTarget = target

			-- Shared with the ESP so the locked player's box, skeleton and text turn the lock color.
			Hooks.lockedCharacter = (character and character.Parent and flags.esp_target ~= false) and character or nil
			Hooks.lockedColor = flags.aim_target_color and flags.aim_target_color.Color or Color3.fromRGB(140, 0, 0)

			if not (character and character.Parent) then
				if targetHighlight.Enabled then
					targetHighlight.Enabled = false
					targetHighlight.Adornee = nil
				end
				snapline.Visible = false
				return
			end

			local color = flags.aim_target_color and flags.aim_target_color.Color or Color3.fromRGB(140, 0, 0)

			-- Deep, solid fill with a slightly brighter edge of the same color (no white tint).
			if flags.aim_target_highlight ~= false then
				if targetHighlight.Adornee ~= character then
					targetHighlight.Adornee = character
				end
				targetHighlight.FillColor = color
				targetHighlight.OutlineColor = color:Lerp(Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0), 0.35)
				targetHighlight.Enabled = true
			elseif targetHighlight.Enabled then
				targetHighlight.Enabled = false
			end

			if flags.aim_target_snapline then
				local screen, onScreen = workspace.CurrentCamera:WorldToViewportPoint(target.Position)
				snapline.Visible = onScreen
				if onScreen then
					snapline.From = aimOrigin()
					snapline.To = Vector2.new(screen.X, screen.Y)
					snapline.Color = color
				end
			else
				snapline.Visible = false
			end
		end)

		onUnload(function()
			targetHighlight:Destroy()
			snapline:Remove()
		end)
	end

	end

	local function buildGunModsTracers()
	local GUN_NAMES = Hooks._GUN_NAMES or { "M9", "Revolver", "MP5", "AK-47", "M4A1", "FAL", "Remington 870", "Taser" }
	local equippedGun = Hooks._equippedGun or function()
		local character = localPlayer.Character
		local tool = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")
		if tool and table.find(GUN_NAMES, tool.Name) then
			return tool
		end
		return nil
	end
	local shootRemote = Hooks._shootRemote
	local reloadRemote = Hooks._reloadRemote
	if not reloadRemote then
		local remotes = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):FindFirstChild("GunRemotes")
		reloadRemote = remotes and remotes:FindFirstChild("FuncReload")
	end
	local updateAmmoLabel = Hooks.updateAmmoLabel or function() end
	local aimTab = Tabs.combat
	local replicatedStorage = Hooks._replicatedStorage or game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

	-- Weapon tuning: auto fire, fire rate, auto reload. Originals are restored when turned off.
	local gunSection = aimTab:section({ name = "Weapon Tuning", side = "right" })

	addFeature(gunSection, { name = "Weapon Tuning", flag = "gunmod_enabled" })
	gunSection:toggle({ name = "automatic fire", flag = "gunmod_autofire", default = true })
	gunSection:toggle({ name = "fast fire rate", flag = "gunmod_fast_fire", default = false })
	gunSection:slider({ name = "fire rate", flag = "gunmod_fire_rate", min = 0.01, max = 1, default = 0.05, interval = 0.01, suffix = "s" })
	gunSection:toggle({ name = "no spread", flag = "gunmod_no_spread", default = false })
	-- Bullets (yours, Aim Helper, Aim Lock, Triggerbot and Ragebot) pass through vehicles.
	addFeature(gunSection, { name = "Shoot Through Cars", flag = "shoot_through_cars", rage = true })
	gunSection:slider({ name = "car wallbang range", flag = "car_wallbang_range", min = 25, max = 500, default = 150, interval = 5, suffix = " studs" })
	gunSection:toggle({ name = "wanted targets only", flag = "car_wallbang_wanted", default = true })
	-- Wallbang: shots blocked by walls are fired from a clear spot within Wallbang Range of you.
	addFeature(gunSection, { name = "Wallbang", flag = "aim_wallbang", rage = true })
	-- Up to 50 studs. The server has only accepted start points ~7 studs from your head in testing,
	-- so 7 stays the default; past that, shots may stop registering.
	gunSection:slider({ name = "wallbang range", flag = "wallbang_range", min = 3, max = 50, default = 7, interval = 0.5, suffix = " studs" })
	-- Shots only land through one wall, so targets behind more are skipped.
	gunSection:slider({ name = "max walls", flag = "wallbang_max_walls", min = 0, max = 3, default = 1, interval = 1 })
	Hooks.premiumGate(gunSection, "Wallbang", "aim_wallbang")

	-- Ragebot With Wallbang 2: an outside ragebot (auto shoots through walls), loaded once and
	-- patched before it runs so it follows our filters, priority, FOV and range, and so its own
	-- Roblox corner popup is gone. The link is pinned to one version, so the patches always match.
	;(function()
		local WALLBANG2_URL = "https://gist.githubusercontent.com/Onlyscripts1/4db9653a52776310ed20b5200436ae66/raw/b23500cffc815de93b525bb4d2d6dba486c335de/wallbang"
		local PATCHES = {
			-- Starts off; our settings turn it on.
			{ "enabled   = true,", "enabled   = false," },
			-- Our filters (whitelist, names, friends, teams) run before its own checks.
			{
				"if not player or player == LocalPlayer or not player.Character then return false end",
				"if not player or player == LocalPlayer or not player.Character then return false end "
					.. "if CFG.extraCheck then local verdict = CFG.extraCheck(player) "
					.. "if verdict == false then return false end "
					-- Prioritized players skip its team / hostile rules (still alive and no forcefield).
					.. "if verdict == \"force\" then return getTargetPart(player.Character) ~= nil and not isDead(player) and not player.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass(\"ForceField\") end end",
			},
			-- The taser counts as a gun too.
			{
				'if tool:IsA("Tool") and tool:GetAttribute("ToolType") == "Gun" then',
				'if tool:IsA("Tool") and (tool:GetAttribute("ToolType") == "Gun" or tool.Name == "Taser") then',
			},
			-- With FOV off, players off screen count too (ranked last for Crosshair).
			{ "if onScreen and sp.Z > 0 then", "if (onScreen and sp.Z > 0) or CFG.ignoreScreen then" },
			{
				"local dist = (Vector2.new(sp.X, sp.Y) - aimPos).Magnitude",
				"local dist = (onScreen and sp.Z > 0) and (Vector2.new(sp.X, sp.Y) - aimPos).Magnitude or 1e6",
			},
			-- Our target priority (crosshair, distance, lowest health, prioritized players first).
			{ "if CFG.prioritizeclosest then", "if CFG.sortCandidates then pcall(CFG.sortCandidates, candidates) elseif CFG.prioritizeclosest then" },
			-- No Roblox popup in the corner; the menu's own notification is enough.
			{ 'StarterGui:SetCore("SendNotification", {Title = "Silent Aim + Wallbang", Text = "Enabled", Duration = 3})', "" },
		}

		---Replace the first plain-text `old` in `source`.
		local function patch(source, old, new)
			local at = string.find(source, old, 1, true)
			if not at then
				warn("[Aqua] Wallbang 2 patch missing:", old)
				return source
			end
			return string.sub(source, 1, at - 1) .. new .. string.sub(source, at + #old)
		end

		local section = Tabs.combat:section({ name = "Ragebot With Wallbang 2", side = "right" })
		local loading = false

		local function load()
			if getgenv().SilentAimCFG or loading then
				return
			end
			loading = true
			task.spawn(function()
				local ok, problem = pcall(function()
					local source = fetchText(WALLBANG2_URL)
					for _, entry in ipairs(PATCHES) do
						source = patch(source, entry[1], entry[2])
					end
					runCode(source, "Wallbang 2")
				end)
				loading = false
				if not ok then
					library:notification({ text = "Wallbang 2 failed to load: " .. tostring(problem), time = 5 })
				end
			end)
		end

		addFeature(section, { name = "Ragebot With Wallbang 2", flag = "aim_wallbang2", rage = true, callback = function(enabled)
			if enabled then
				load()
			end
		end })
		section:dropdown({ name = "target part", flag = "wb2_part", items = { "Head", "Torso", "HumanoidRootPart" }, default = "Head" })
		section:dropdown({ name = "target priority", flag = "wb2_priority", items = { "Distance", "Crosshair", "Lowest Health" }, default = "Distance" })
		section:toggle({ name = "only in fov", flag = "wb2_use_fov", default = false })
		section:slider({ name = "fov radius", flag = "wb2_fov", min = 20, max = 1200, default = 300, interval = 5, suffix = "px" })
		section:slider({ name = "range", flag = "wb2_range", min = 25, max = 5000, default = 1000, interval = 25, suffix = " studs" })
		section:slider({ name = "wallbang range", flag = "wb2_wallbang_range", min = 7, max = 50, default = 20, interval = 1, suffix = " studs" })
		-- Off: shoots at people behind walls even when no wallbang shot is found (those miss).
		section:toggle({ name = "visible check", flag = "wb2_visible_check", default = true })
		section:toggle({ name = "team check", flag = "wb2_team_check", default = true })
		section:toggle({ name = "friend check", flag = "wb2_friend_check", default = true })
		section:toggle({ name = "force field check", flag = "wb2_ff_check", default = true })
		section:toggle({ name = "use taser", flag = "wb2_use_taser", default = true })
		section:dropdown({ name = "whitelist teams", flag = "wb2_team_whitelist", items = { "Inmates", "Guards", "Criminals" }, default = {}, multi = true })
		Hooks.premiumGate(section, "Ragebot With Wallbang 2", "aim_wallbang2")

		---Lowercased names from a comma separated textbox.
		local function names(flag)
			local list = {}
			for name in string.gmatch(flags[flag] or "", "[^,%s]+") do
				list[string.lower(name)] = true
			end
			return list
		end

		---Our filters, on top of its own team / forcefield / hostile checks.
		local function extraCheck(player)
			-- Holding the taser with "use taser" off: nobody is a target.
			local held = localPlayer.Character and localPlayer.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")
			if held and held.Name == "Taser" and flags.wb2_use_taser == false then
				return false
			end
			if isGloballyWhitelisted(player) then
				return false
			end
			local prioritized = Hooks._isPrioritized and Hooks._isPrioritized(player)
			if not prioritized and Hooks._priorityPresent and Hooks._priorityPresent() then
				return false
			end
			if prioritized then
				return "force"
			end
			-- Guards only go after criminals and hostile inmates.
			if localPlayer.Team and localPlayer.Team.Name == "Guards" then
				local team = player.Team and player.Team.Name
				local hostile = player.Character and player.Character:GetAttribute("Hostile") == true
				if not (team == "Criminals" or (team == "Inmates" and hostile)) then
					return false
				end
			end
			if flags.global_target_only_enabled and not listHas(flags.global_target_only, player.Name) then
				return false
			end
			local lowered = string.lower(player.Name)
			if names("aim_ignore_targets")[lowered] then
				return false
			end
			local only = names("aim_only_targets")
			if next(only) and not only[lowered] then
				return false
			end
			if flags.wb2_friend_check ~= false and Hooks.isFriend and Hooks.isFriend(player) then
				return false
			end
			local whitelist = flags.wb2_team_whitelist
			if player.Team and type(whitelist) == "table" and table.find(whitelist, player.Team.Name) then
				return false
			end
			return true
		end

		---Order candidates by the chosen priority; prioritized players always first.
		local function sortCandidates(candidates)
			local mode = flags.wb2_priority or "Distance"
			local myRoot = localPlayer.Character and localPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			local scores = {}
			for _, candidate in ipairs(candidates) do
				local score = candidate.dist
				local character = candidate.target.Character
				if mode == "Lowest Health" then
					local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
					score = humanoid and humanoid.Health or math.huge
				elseif mode == "Distance" and myRoot then
					score = (candidate.pos - myRoot.Position).Magnitude
				end
				if Hooks._isPrioritized and Hooks._isPrioritized(candidate.target) then
					score -= 1e7
				end
				scores[candidate] = score
			end
			table.sort(candidates, function(a, b)
				return scores[a] < scores[b]
			end)
		end

		-- Push the menu settings into it a few times a second.
		local syncedAt = 0
		library:connection(runService.Heartbeat, function()
			local config = getgenv().SilentAimCFG
			local now = os.clock()
			if not config or now - syncedAt < 0.2 then
				return
			end
			syncedAt = now
			-- Healing or arresting needs your hands, so it holds fire like the normal Ragebot.
			local busy = (Hooks.healPending and Hooks.healPending()) or (Hooks.arrestPending and Hooks.arrestPending())
			config.enabled = flags.aim_wallbang2 == true and not busy
			config.autoshoot = true
			config.wallbang = true
			config.aimpart = flags.wb2_part or "Head"
			config.ignoreScreen = flags.wb2_use_fov ~= true
			config.fov = flags.wb2_use_fov and (flags.wb2_fov or 300) or math.huge
			config.silentaimmaxdist = flags.wb2_range or 1000
			config.wallbangrange = flags.wb2_wallbang_range or 20
			config.wallcheck = flags.wb2_visible_check ~= false
			config.teamcheck = flags.wb2_team_check ~= false
			config.ffcheck = flags.wb2_ff_check ~= false
			-- As a guard: criminals, and inmates only while hostile (never just trespassing).
			config.hostilecheck = true
			config.trespasscheck = false
			-- As an inmate: criminals are targets. As a criminal: only hostile or trespassing inmates.
			config.inmatesTargetCriminals = true
			config.criminalsTargetSuspectedInmates = true
			config.taseralwayshit = true
			config.extraCheck = extraCheck
			config.sortCandidates = sortCandidates
		end)

		onUnload(function()
			local config = getgenv().SilentAimCFG
			if config then
				config.enabled = false
				config.extraCheck = nil
				config.sortCandidates = nil
			end
		end)
	end)()
	Hooks.premiumGate(gunSection, "wallbang range")
	Hooks.premiumGate(gunSection, "max walls")
	
	addFeature(gunSection, { name = "Auto Reload", flag = "gunmod_auto_reload" })
	-- Idle reload is fixed at 0 (off): Auto Reload reloads the moment the magazine is empty, and a
	-- config saved with another value can't bring the delay back.
	flags.gunmod_idle_reload = 0
	library:connection(runService.Heartbeat, function()
		if flags.gunmod_idle_reload ~= 0 then
			flags.gunmod_idle_reload = 0
		end
	end)

	local toolProperties = sharedModules and sharedModules:FindFirstChild("ToolProperties")
	local gunOriginals = {}
