	local moduleOriginals = {}

	---Set an attribute only when it differs, and report whether it did.
	local function setGunAttribute(tool, name, value)
		if tool:GetAttribute(name) == value then
			return false
		end
		tool:SetAttribute(name, value)
		return true
	end

	---Apply (or undo) gun mods on one tool. Returns whether its attributes changed.
	local function applyGunMod(tool)
		if not tool:IsA("Tool") or not table.find(GUN_NAMES, tool.Name) then
			return false
		end

		local properties = toolProperties and toolProperties:FindFirstChild(tool.Name)
		local props = properties and safeRequire(properties)

		if not gunOriginals[tool] then
			gunOriginals[tool] = {
				autoFire = tool:GetAttribute("AutoFire"),
				fireRate = tool:GetAttribute("FireRate"),
				spread = tool:GetAttribute("SpreadRadius"),
			}
		end
		if props and not moduleOriginals[tool.Name] then
			moduleOriginals[tool.Name] = { props = props, autoFire = props.AutoFire, fireRate = props.FireRate }
		end

		local original = gunOriginals[tool]
		local active = flags.gunmod_enabled == true
		local autoFire = active and flags.gunmod_autofire and true or original.autoFire
		local fireRate = (active and flags.gunmod_fast_fire) and (flags.gunmod_fire_rate or 0.05) or original.fireRate

		local changed = setGunAttribute(tool, "AutoFire", autoFire)
		changed = setGunAttribute(tool, "FireRate", fireRate) or changed
		if original.spread ~= nil then
			changed = setGunAttribute(tool, "SpreadRadius", (active and flags.gunmod_no_spread) and 0 or original.spread) or changed
		end

		if props then
			local moduleOriginal = moduleOriginals[tool.Name]
			props.AutoFire = active and flags.gunmod_autofire and true or moduleOriginal.autoFire
			props.FireRate = (active and flags.gunmod_fast_fire) and (flags.gunmod_fire_rate or 0.05) or moduleOriginal.fireRate
		end
		return changed
	end

	local reequipping = false

	---Re-apply to every gun you own (or restore them when Weapon Tuning is off).
	local function applyGunModsToAll()
		local character = localPlayer.Character
		for _, container in ipairs({ character, localPlayer:FindFirstChild("Backpack") }) do
			if container then
				for _, tool in ipairs(container:GetChildren()) do
					local changed = false
					pcall(function()
						changed = applyGunMod(tool) == true
					end)
					-- The game's GunController copies a gun's attributes once when it's equipped,
					-- so the gun in hand is re-equipped for a change to take effect.
					if changed and container == character and not reequipping then
						local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
						if humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0 then
							reequipping = true
							task.spawn(function()
								pcall(humanoid.UnequipTools, humanoid)
								task.wait()
								if tool.Parent and character.Parent and humanoid.Health > 0 then
									pcall(humanoid.EquipTool, humanoid, tool)
								end
								reequipping = false
							end)
						end
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end

	for _, flag in ipairs({ "gunmod_enabled", "gunmod_autofire", "gunmod_fast_fire", "gunmod_fire_rate", "gunmod_no_spread" }) do
		local setter = library.config_flags[flag]
		library.config_flags[flag] = function(...)
			setter(...)
			applyGunModsToAll()
		end
	end

	-- Newly picked-up guns get the mods too, and turning the toggle off (or changing a setting)
	-- from the menu restores or updates them here.
	task.spawn(function()
		while isCurrentRun() and watermarkHolder.Parent do
			task.wait(0.5)
			if not isCurrentRun() then
				break
			end
			applyGunModsToAll()
		end
	end)

	local reloading = {}

	library:connection(runService.Heartbeat, function()
		if not (flags.gunmod_auto_reload and reloadRemote) then
			return
		end

		local weapon = equippedGun()
		if not weapon or reloading[weapon] then
			return
		end
		if (weapon:GetAttribute("Local_ReloadSession") or 0) ~= 0 then
			return
		end

		-- Reload when empty, or (idle reload) when the magazine isn't full and you haven't been
		-- locked onto anyone for the chosen number of seconds.
		local ammo = weapon:GetAttribute("Local_CurrentAmmo") or 0
		local maxAmmo = weapon:GetAttribute("MaxAmmo") or ammo
		local idleFor = os.clock() - (Hooks.lastTargetAt or 0)
		local idleReload = (flags.gunmod_idle_reload or 0) > 0 and ammo < maxAmmo and idleFor >= flags.gunmod_idle_reload
		if ammo > 0 and not idleReload then
			return
		end

		local behavior = weapon:GetAttribute("Behavior")
		if behavior == "Sniper" and (weapon:GetAttribute("StoredAmmo") or 0) <= 0 then
			return
		end

		reloading[weapon] = true
		local session = os.clock()
		weapon:SetAttribute("Local_ReloadSession", session)
		if reloadRemote then
			task.spawn(function()
				pcall(function()
					reloadRemote:InvokeServer()
				end)
			end)
		end

		task.delay(weapon:GetAttribute("ReloadTime") or 1, function()
			if weapon:GetAttribute("Local_ReloadSession") == session then
				local refill = behavior == "Sniper" and 1 or (weapon:GetAttribute("MaxAmmo") or 0)
				weapon:SetAttribute("Local_CurrentAmmo", refill)
				pcall(updateAmmoLabel, weapon, refill)
				weapon:SetAttribute("Local_ReloadSession", 0)
			end
			reloading[weapon] = nil
		end)
	end)

	-- Quick Swap: cycles through chosen guns (or every gun you own) on a delay.
	local switchSection = aimTab:section({ name = "Quick Swap", side = "left" })

	addFeature(switchSection, { name = "Quick Swap", flag = "gunswitch_enabled", callback = function(enabled)
		if not enabled then
			local humanoid = localPlayer.Character and localPlayer.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
			if humanoid then
				humanoid:UnequipTools()
			end
		end
	end })
	local SWAP_GUNS = table.clone(GUN_NAMES)
	if not table.find(SWAP_GUNS, "Taser") then
		table.insert(SWAP_GUNS, "Taser")
	end
	switchSection:dropdown({ name = "guns", flag = "gunswitch_list", items = SWAP_GUNS, default = { "M9" }, multi = true })
	switchSection:toggle({ name = "cycle all owned guns", flag = "gunswitch_all", default = true })
	-- The taser joins the rotation (and Ragebot fires it when it comes up).
	switchSection:toggle({ name = "include taser", flag = "gunswitch_taser", default = true })
	switchSection:slider({ name = "switch delay", flag = "gunswitch_delay", min = 0.01, max = 1, default = 0.05, interval = 0.01, suffix = "s" })
	switchSection:toggle({ name = "pause in seat", flag = "gunswitch_pause_car", default = true })

	---Sitting in any seat (driving, a passenger, or a chair), for "pause in seat". Swapping picks
	---back up the moment you get up.
	local function inCar(humanoid)
		return humanoid ~= nil and (humanoid.SeatPart ~= nil or humanoid.Sit)
	end

	task.spawn(function()
		while isCurrentRun() and watermarkHolder.Parent do
			task.wait(0.05)
			if not isCurrentRun() then
				break
			end

			if not flags.gunswitch_enabled then
				continue
			end
			-- Arrest / Auto Heal take priority over cycling guns.
			if Hooks.arrestPending and Hooks.arrestPending() then
				continue
			end
			if Hooks.healPending and Hooks.healPending() then
				continue
			end
			-- Taser Trespassers holds the taser; no swapping while it's tasing someone.
			if Hooks.taserOverride then
				continue
			end

			local character = localPlayer.Character
			local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
			local backpack = localPlayer:FindFirstChild("Backpack")
			if not (humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0 and backpack) then
				continue
			end
			-- Pause in car: no swapping while seated in a car; it picks back up once you're out.
			if flags.gunswitch_pause_car ~= false and inCar(humanoid) then
				continue
			end

			local list = {}
			if flags.gunswitch_all then
				for _, container in ipairs({ backpack, character }) do
					for _, tool in ipairs(container:GetChildren()) do
						local isGun = table.find(GUN_NAMES, tool.Name) or (tool.Name == "Taser" and flags.gunswitch_taser ~= false)
						if tool:IsA("Tool") and isGun and not table.find(list, tool.Name) then
							table.insert(list, tool.Name)
						end
					end
				end
			elseif type(flags.gunswitch_list) == "table" then
				for _, name in ipairs(flags.gunswitch_list) do
					if name ~= "Taser" or flags.gunswitch_taser ~= false then
						table.insert(list, name)
					end
				end
			end

			for _, name in ipairs(list) do
				if not flags.gunswitch_enabled or not isCurrentRun() or Hooks.taserOverride
					or (flags.gunswitch_pause_car ~= false and inCar(humanoid)) then
					break
				end
				local tool = backpack:FindFirstChild(name)
				if tool then
					pcall(humanoid.EquipTool, humanoid, tool)
				end
				task.wait(flags.gunswitch_delay or 0.05)
			end
		end
	end)

	-- Its own function so its locals get their own register budget (Luau allows 200 per function).
	local function buildBulletTracers()
		-- Bullet tracers: every tracer the game draws (a "RayPart" in the camera, yours and
		-- everyone else's) is swapped for a glowing, animated one of our own.
		local bulletSection = Tabs.visuals:section({ name = "Bullet Tracers", side = "right" })
		local MAX_TRACERS = 48
		local WHITE = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)

		addFeature(bulletSection, { name = "Bullet Tracers", flag = "bullet_tracers_enabled" })
		bulletSection:colorpicker({ flag = "bullet_color", color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 185, 175) })
		bulletSection:dropdown({
			name = "tracer style",
			flag = "bullet_style",
			items = { "Streak", "Laser", "Plasma", "Lightning", "Helix", "Comet", "Classic" },
			default = "Streak",
		})
		bulletSection:dropdown({ name = "show tracers for", flag = "bullet_owner", items = { "Everyone", "Only mine" }, default = "Everyone" })
		-- With custom tracers on, the game's own tracers are always hidden. This also hides them
		-- when custom tracers are off.
		bulletSection:toggle({ name = "hide game tracers", flag = "bullet_hide_game", default = false })
		bulletSection:toggle({ name = "gradient", flag = "bullet_gradient", default = true })
		bulletSection:colorpicker({ flag = "bullet_color_end", color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 120, 140) })
		bulletSection:toggle({ name = "rainbow bullets", flag = "bullet_rainbow", default = false })
		bulletSection:slider({ name = "tracer width", flag = "bullet_width", min = 0.05, max = 1, default = 0.25, interval = 0.05 })
		bulletSection:slider({ name = "tracer lifetime", flag = "bullet_lifetime", min = 0.1, max = 3, default = 0.7, interval = 0.05, suffix = "s" })
		bulletSection:toggle({ name = "impact effects", flag = "bullet_impact", default = true })
		bulletSection:toggle({ name = "muzzle & impact light", flag = "bullet_light", default = true })
		-- Where your own tracers start (only on your screen; the shot itself is unchanged):
		-- the gun, an offset from you, or a ring around you that each shot moves along.
		bulletSection:dropdown({ name = "tracer origin", flag = "bullet_origin", items = { "Gun", "Offset", "Circle" }, default = "Gun" })
		bulletSection:slider({ name = "origin height", flag = "bullet_origin_up", min = tonumber("-5"), max = 25, default = 6, interval = 0.5, suffix = " studs" })
		bulletSection:slider({ name = "origin side", flag = "bullet_origin_side", min = tonumber("-15"), max = 15, default = 0, interval = 0.5, suffix = " studs" })
		bulletSection:slider({ name = "origin forward", flag = "bullet_origin_forward", min = tonumber("-15"), max = 15, default = 0, interval = 0.5, suffix = " studs" })
		bulletSection:slider({ name = "circle radius", flag = "bullet_circle_radius", min = 1, max = 20, default = 5, interval = 0.5, suffix = " studs" })
		bulletSection:slider({ name = "circle spin", flag = "bullet_circle_spin", min = 0, max = 5, default = 1, interval = 0.1 })

		-- Everything is built under one invisible anchor at the world origin, so attachment
		-- positions are world positions and cleanup is a single Destroy.
		local tracerAnchor = Instance.new("Part")
		tracerAnchor.Name = ""
		tracerAnchor.Anchored = true
		tracerAnchor.CanCollide = false
		tracerAnchor.CanQuery = false
		tracerAnchor.CanTouch = false
		tracerAnchor.Transparency = 1
		tracerAnchor.Size = Vector3.new(0.05, 0.05, 0.05)
		tracerAnchor.CFrame = CFrame.identity
		tracerAnchor.Parent = workspace

		local activeTracers = {}
		local tracerConnection = nil

		---Fade along the beam: the muzzle end is see-through, the hit end stays bright,
		---and the whole thing fades out with age (`a` goes 0 -> 1).
		local function fadeSequence(base, tail, a)
			local head = math.clamp(base + (1 - base) * a, 0, 1)
			local back = math.clamp(head + (1 - head) * tail, 0, 1)
			return NumberSequence.new({ NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, back), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, head) })
		end

		---World-space attachment; its X axis is turned sideways so beam curves bend across the shot.
		local function newPoint(position, direction)
			local attachment = Instance.new("Attachment")
			if direction and direction.Magnitude > 0 then
				attachment.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(position, position + direction)
			else
				attachment.Position = position
			end
			attachment.Parent = tracerAnchor
			return attachment
		end

		---Glowing beam between two attachments.
		local function newBeam(a0, a1, colors, width)
			local beam = Instance.new("Beam")
			beam.Attachment0 = a0
			beam.Attachment1 = a1
			beam.Color = colors
			beam.Width0 = width
			beam.Width1 = width
			beam.LightEmission = 1
			beam.LightInfluence = 0
			beam.FaceCamera = true
			beam.Segments = 1
			beam.Transparency = NumberSequence.new(0)
			beam.Parent = tracerAnchor
			return beam
		end

		---Short-lived neon part (impact flashes, comet heads).
		local function newGlowPart(position, size, color, shape)
			local part = Instance.new("Part")
			part.Name = ""
			part.Shape = shape or Enum.PartType.Ball
			part.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
			part.Color = color
			part.Anchored = true
			part.CanCollide = false
			part.CanQuery = false
			part.CanTouch = false
			part.CastShadow = false
			part.Size = Vector3.one * size
			part.CFrame = CFrame.new(position)
			part.Parent = tracerAnchor
			return part
		end

		---Two directions perpendicular to the shot, for spirals and jitter.
		local function sideAxes(direction)
			local up = math.abs(direction.Y) < 0.99 and Vector3.yAxis or Vector3.xAxis
			local right = direction:Cross(up).Unit
			return right, right:Cross(direction).Unit
		end

		---Track a tracer piece; the oldest is dropped once too many are alive.
		local function addTracer(record)
			record.born = os.clock()
			table.insert(activeTracers, record)

			if #activeTracers > (Hooks.lowPower() and 16 or MAX_TRACERS) then
				local oldest = table.remove(activeTracers, 1)
				for _, instance in ipairs(oldest.instances) do
					instance:Destroy()
				end
			end
		end

		---Current tracer colors (start at the muzzle, end at the hit).
		local function tracerColors()
			if flags.bullet_rainbow then
				local now = os.clock()
				return getRainbow(0.6), Color3.fromHSV((now * 0.6 + 0.35) % 1, 1, 1)
			end

			local primary = flags.bullet_color and flags.bullet_color.Color or Color3.fromRGB(255, 185, 175)
			local secondary = flags.bullet_gradient and flags.bullet_color_end and flags.bullet_color_end.Color or primary
			return secondary, primary
		end

		---Spark burst, expanding flash and light where the bullet landed.
		local function spawnImpact(position, color, width)
			local flash = newGlowPart(position, width * 2, color)
			local instances = { flash }

			local burst = newPoint(position)
			table.insert(instances, burst)

			local sparks = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
			sparks.Enabled = false
			sparks.Color = ColorSequence.new(WHITE, color)
			sparks.LightEmission = 1
			sparks.LightInfluence = 0
			sparks.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.15, 0.35)
			sparks.Speed = NumberRange.new(12, 28)
			sparks.SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(180, 180)
			sparks.Drag = 6
			sparks.Size = NumberSequence.new({ NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, width * 1.2), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0) })
			sparks.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({ NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1) })
			sparks.Parent = burst
			sparks:Emit(14)

			local light
			if flags.bullet_light ~= false then
				light = Instance.new("PointLight")
				light.Color = color
				light.Range = 12
				light.Brightness = 4
				light.Shadows = false
				light.Parent = flash
			end

			local startSize = width * 2
			addTracer({
				life = 0.45,
				instances = instances,
				update = function(_, a)
					local eased = 1 - (1 - a) ^ 3
					flash.Size = Vector3.one * (startSize + width * 10 * eased)
					flash.Transparency = 0.15 + 0.85 * eased
					if light then
						light.Brightness = 4 * (1 - eased)
					end
				end,
			})
		end

		---Quick light at the muzzle.
		local function spawnMuzzleFlash(position, color)
			if flags.bullet_light == false then
				return
			end

			local holder = newPoint(position)
			local light = Instance.new("PointLight")
			light.Color = color
			light.Range = 10
			light.Brightness = 3
			light.Shadows = false
			light.Parent = holder

			addTracer({
				life = 0.12,
				instances = { holder },
				update = function(_, a)
					light.Brightness = 3 * (1 - a)
				end,
			})
		end

		---Build one tracer in the chosen style from `start` (muzzle) to `finish` (hit).
		local function spawnTracer(start, finish)
			local offset = finish - start
			local length = offset.Magnitude
			if length < 0.5 then
				return
			end

			local direction = offset.Unit
			local style = flags.bullet_style or "Laser"
			local width = flags.bullet_width or 0.25
			local life = flags.bullet_lifetime or 0.7
			local startColor, endColor = tracerColors()
			local colors = ColorSequence.new(startColor, endColor)
			local hot = ColorSequence.new(startColor:Lerp(WHITE, 0.6), endColor:Lerp(WHITE, 0.6))
			local a0, a1 = newPoint(start, direction), newPoint(finish, direction)
			local instances = { a0, a1 }
			local record = { life = life, instances = instances }

			if style == "Streak" then
				-- A long white-hot streak in a soft colored haze. The tail retracts toward the
				-- hit point as it fades, so each shot reads as a fast-moving round.
				local haze = newBeam(a0, a1, colors, width * 3.2)
				local glow = newBeam(a0, a1, colors, width * 1.4)
				local core = newBeam(a0, a1, ColorSequence.new(WHITE, endColor:Lerp(WHITE, 0.75)), width * 0.35)
				table.insert(instances, haze)
				table.insert(instances, glow)
				table.insert(instances, core)

				---Transparency along the beam: hidden behind the retracting tail, bright past it.
				local function streakSequence(base, a)
					local cut = math.clamp(a * 0.9, 0.001, 0.9)
					local head = math.clamp(base + (1 - base) * a * a, 0, 1)
					return NumberSequence.new({
						NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 1),
						NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(cut, 1),
						NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(math.min(cut + 0.08, 0.99), math.clamp(base + 0.3, 0, 1)),
						NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, head),
					})
				end

				record.update = function(_, a)
					core.Transparency = streakSequence(0, a)
					glow.Transparency = streakSequence(0.45, a)
					haze.Transparency = streakSequence(0.82, a)
					haze.Width0, haze.Width1 = width * 2, width * 3.2 * (1 + a)
				end
			elseif style == "Laser" or style == "Plasma" then
				-- Bright white-hot core inside a soft colored glow that widens as it fades.
				local glow = newBeam(a0, a1, colors, width * 2.5)
				local core = newBeam(a0, a1, hot, width * 0.5)
				table.insert(instances, glow)
				table.insert(instances, core)

				local wobbles = {}
				if style == "Plasma" then
					-- Two energy strands that whip around the core.
					for index = 1, 2 do
						local strand = newBeam(a0, a1, colors, width * 0.6)
						strand.Segments = 24
						table.insert(wobbles, strand)
						table.insert(instances, strand)
						strand:SetAttribute("Phase", index * math.pi)
					end
				end

				local amplitude = math.clamp(length * 0.05, 0.4, 3)
				record.update = function(age, a)
					core.Transparency = fadeSequence(0, 0.55, a)
					glow.Transparency = fadeSequence(0.55, 0.6, a)
					core.Width0, core.Width1 = width * 0.25, width * 0.5 * (1 + a * 0.5 * NEG_ONE)
					glow.Width0, glow.Width1 = width * 1.2, width * 2.5 * (1 + a * 0.8)

					for _, strand in ipairs(wobbles) do
						local phase = strand:GetAttribute("Phase")
						strand.CurveSize0 = math.sin(age * 28 + phase) * amplitude * (1 - a)
						strand.CurveSize1 = -math.sin(age * 28 + phase + 1.3) * amplitude * (1 - a)
						strand.Transparency = fadeSequence(0.2, 0.5, a)
					end
				end
			elseif style == "Lightning" then
				-- A jagged bolt that re-forks every few frames, over a faint straight glow.
				local glow = newBeam(a0, a1, colors, width * 3)
				table.insert(instances, glow)

				local right, up = sideAxes(direction)
				local count = math.clamp(math.floor(length / 4), 5, 18)
				local points, bolts = { a0 }, {}
				for index = 1, count - 1 do
					table.insert(points, newPoint(start + offset * (index / count)))
					table.insert(instances, points[#points])
				end
				table.insert(points, a1)

				for index = 1, #points - 1 do
					local bolt = newBeam(points[index], points[index + 1], hot, width * 0.6)
					table.insert(bolts, bolt)
					table.insert(instances, bolt)
				end

				local lastJitter = 0
				local jitter = math.clamp(width * 5, 0.4, 3)
				record.update = function(age, a)
					if age - lastJitter > 0.04 then
						lastJitter = age
						for index = 2, #points - 1 do
							local t = (index - 1) / count
							local sway = (right * (math.random() - 0.5) + up * (math.random() - 0.5)) * 2 * jitter
							points[index].Position = start + offset * t + sway * math.sin(t * math.pi)
						end
					end

					local transparency = NumberSequence.new(math.clamp(a ^ 1.5 + (math.random() < 0.15 and 0.5 or 0), 0, 1))
					for _, bolt in ipairs(bolts) do
						bolt.Transparency = transparency
					end
					glow.Transparency = fadeSequence(0.7, 0.4, a)
				end
			elseif style == "Helix" then
				-- Two spinning strands spiralling around a thin core.
				local core = newBeam(a0, a1, hot, width * 0.3)
				table.insert(instances, core)

				local right, up = sideAxes(direction)
				local count = math.clamp(math.floor(length / 2.5), 10, 24)
				local turns = math.clamp(length / 8, 2, 10)
				local strands = {}

				for strandIndex = 1, 2 do
					local strand = { points = {}, beams = {}, phase = strandIndex * math.pi }
					for index = 0, count do
						local point = newPoint(start + offset * (index / count))
						table.insert(strand.points, point)
						table.insert(instances, point)
					end
					local strandColors = strandIndex == 1 and colors or ColorSequence.new(endColor, startColor)
					for index = 1, count do
						local beam = newBeam(strand.points[index], strand.points[index + 1], strandColors, width * 0.45)
						table.insert(strand.beams, beam)
						table.insert(instances, beam)
					end
					table.insert(strands, strand)
				end

				record.update = function(age, a)
					local radius = width * 2.2 * (1 + a * 1.5)
					for _, strand in ipairs(strands) do
						for index, point in ipairs(strand.points) do
							local t = (index - 1) / count
							-- Taper the spiral into the muzzle and hit points.
							local taper = math.sin(t * math.pi) ^ 0.5
							local angle = t * turns * math.pi * 2 + age * 14 + strand.phase
							point.Position = start + offset * t + (right * math.cos(angle) + up * math.sin(angle)) * radius * taper
						end

						local transparency = NumberSequence.new(math.clamp(0.1 + a * 0.9, 0, 1))
						for _, beam in ipairs(strand.beams) do
							beam.Transparency = transparency
						end
					end
					core.Transparency = fadeSequence(0.2, 0.6, a)
				end
			elseif style == "Comet" then
				-- A glowing round flies from the muzzle to the hit, leaving a fading trail.
				local travel = math.clamp(length / 700, 0.04, 0.3)
				local head = newGlowPart(start, width * 2, endColor:Lerp(WHITE, 0.4))
				table.insert(instances, head)

				local top, bottom = Instance.new("Attachment"), Instance.new("Attachment")
				top.Position = Vector3.new(0, width, 0)
				bottom.Position = Vector3.new(0, -width, 0)
				top.Parent, bottom.Parent = head, head

				local trail = Instance.new("Trail")
				trail.Attachment0, trail.Attachment1 = top, bottom
				trail.Color = colors
				trail.FaceCamera = true
				trail.LightEmission = 1
				trail.LightInfluence = 0
				trail.Lifetime = math.clamp(life * 0.5, 0.1, 0.6)
				trail.MinLength = 0
				trail.WidthScale = NumberSequence.new({ NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 1), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0) })
				trail.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({ NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1) })
				trail.Parent = head

				local line = newBeam(a0, a1, colors, width * 0.4)
				table.insert(instances, line)

				record.life = travel + trail.Lifetime + 0.05
				record.update = function(age, a)
					local progress = math.min(age / travel, 1)
					head.CFrame = CFrame.new(start + offset * progress)
					head.Transparency = progress >= 1 and 1 or 0
					line.Transparency = fadeSequence(0.75, 0.5, a)
				end
			end

			addTracer(record)
			spawnMuzzleFlash(start, startColor)

			if flags.bullet_impact ~= false and not Hooks.lowPower() then
				spawnImpact(finish, endColor, width)
			end
		end

		-- Animate (and expire) every live tracer once per frame.
		library:connection(runService.RenderStepped, function()
			local now = os.clock()
			for index = #activeTracers, 1, -1 do
				local record = activeTracers[index]
				local age = now - record.born
				if age >= record.life then
					for _, instance in ipairs(record.instances) do
						instance:Destroy()
					end
					table.remove(activeTracers, index)
				elseif record.update then
					pcall(record.update, age, age / record.life)
				end
			end
		end)

		---Whether a tracer starts at your character (for "Only mine").
		local function isMyShot(start)
			local character = localPlayer.Character
			local head = character and character:FindFirstChild("Head")
			return head ~= nil and (head.Position - start).Magnitude < 8
		end

		-- Each shot moves a step around the circle (plus the spin over time).
		local circleStep = 0

		---Where one of your tracers should start, from the "tracer origin" settings.
		local function tracerStart(start)
			local mode = flags.bullet_origin or "Gun"
			local root = localPlayer.Character and localPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			if mode == "Gun" or not root or not isMyShot(start) then
				return start
			end
			-- Measured from your body, turned with it (side = right, forward = where you face).
			local look = root.CFrame.LookVector
		local flat = Vector3.new(look.X, 0, look.Z)
		local base = flat.Magnitude > 0.01 and CFrame.lookAt(root.Position, root.Position + flat) or CFrame.new(root.Position)
			local up = tonumber(flags.bullet_origin_up) or 6
			local side = tonumber(flags.bullet_origin_side) or 0
			local forward = tonumber(flags.bullet_origin_forward) or 0
			if mode == "Offset" then
				return (base * CFrame.new(side, up, NEG_ONE * forward)).Position
			end
			circleStep += 1
			local radius = tonumber(flags.bullet_circle_radius) or 5
			local angle = circleStep * 0.7 + os.clock() * (tonumber(flags.bullet_circle_spin) or 1)
			return (base * CFrame.new(side + math.cos(angle) * radius, up, NEG_ONE * forward + math.sin(angle) * radius)).Position
		end

		-- Lets Ragebot / Triggerbot shots (which the game doesn't draw) use the same tracers.
		Hooks.spawnTracer = function(start, finish)
			if not flags.bullet_tracers_enabled or flags.bullet_style == "Classic" then
				return false
			end
			task.defer(pcall, spawnTracer, tracerStart(start), finish)
			return true
		end

		---Watch the current camera for the game's tracer parts.
		local function hookTracers()
			if tracerConnection then
				tracerConnection:Disconnect()
			end

			tracerConnection = workspace.CurrentCamera.ChildAdded:Connect(function(child)
				if child.Name ~= "RayPart" or not child:IsA("BasePart") then
					return
				end

				-- The game builds these as CFrame.new(midpoint, hit) with the length on Z.
				local cframe = child.CFrame
				local half = child.Size.Z / 2
				local start = cframe.Position + cframe.LookVector * half * NEG_ONE
				local finish = cframe.Position + cframe.LookVector * half
				local light = child:FindFirstChildOfClass("SurfaceLight")
				local custom = flags.bullet_tracers_enabled and flags.bullet_style ~= "Classic"

				-- Who fired it (the player whose head it starts at), for the ESP "shooting" flag.
				Hooks.lastShotBy = Hooks.lastShotBy or setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
				for _, player in ipairs(playersService:GetPlayers()) do
					local head = player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("Head")
					if head and (head.Position - start).Magnitude < 8 then
						Hooks.lastShotBy[player] = os.clock()
						break
					end
				end

				-- Classic: keep the game's tracer, just recolor it.
				if flags.bullet_tracers_enabled and flags.bullet_style == "Classic" then
					local _, color = tracerColors()
					child.Color = color
					if light then
						light.Color = color
					end
					return
				end

				-- Hide Game Tracers: every Prison Life tracer (yours and everyone else's) is
				-- hidden, so only the custom ones show.
				if custom or flags.bullet_hide_game == true then
					child.Transparency = 1
					child.LocalTransparencyModifier = 1
					if light then
						light.Enabled = false
					end
				end

				if not custom or (flags.bullet_owner == "Only mine" and not isMyShot(start)) then
					return
				end

				task.defer(pcall, spawnTracer, tracerStart(start), finish)
			end)
		end

		hookTracers()
		library:connection(workspace:GetPropertyChangedSignal("CurrentCamera"), hookTracers)

		onUnload(function()
			if tracerConnection then
				tracerConnection:Disconnect()
			end
			table.clear(activeTracers)
			tracerAnchor:Destroy()
		end)
	end

	buildBulletTracers()

	onUnload(function()
		-- Put gun stats back.
		flags.gunmod_enabled = false
		applyGunModsToAll()
	end)
	end

	buildAimCore()
	buildAimLockRageTrigger()
	buildGunModsTracers()

	-- FOV Effects: an animated FOV circle built from UI (gradient ring, fills, orbiting dots),
	-- used for every style except Classic. Same radius, color and visibility as FOV Circle.
	local function buildFovEffects()
		local section = Tabs.combat:section({ name = "FOV Effects", side = "right" })
		section:dropdown({ name = "fov style", flag = "aim_fov_style", items = { "Classic", "Gradient Ring", "Neon", "Dashed" }, default = "Gradient Ring" })
		section:dropdown({ name = "fov animation", flag = "aim_fov_anim", items = { "None", "Spin", "Pulse", "Breathe", "Orbit Dots", "Rainbow" }, default = "Spin" })
		section:dropdown({ name = "fov fill", flag = "aim_fov_fill_style", items = { "None", "Solid", "Gradient", "Spin Gradient", "Radial Glow" }, default = "None" })
		section:colorpicker({ name = "second color", flag = "aim_fov_color2", color = Color3.fromRGB(120, 80, 255) })
		section:slider({ name = "fill transparency", flag = "aim_fov_fill_transparency", min = 0, max = 1, default = 0.75, interval = 0.01 })
		section:slider({ name = "animation speed", flag = "aim_fov_speed", min = 0.1, max = 4, default = 1, interval = 0.1, suffix = "x" })

		local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
		gui.Name = ""
		gui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
		gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
		gui.DisplayOrder = 6
		gui:SetAttribute("AquaLabs", true)
		gui.Parent = coreGui

		local function circle(parent, zIndex)
			local frame = Instance.new("Frame")
			frame.Name = ""
			frame.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
			frame.BorderSizePixel = 0
			frame.BackgroundTransparency = 1
			frame.ZIndex = zIndex
			frame.Parent = parent
			local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
			corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
			corner.Parent = frame
			return frame
		end

		-- Fill (solid, gradient or glow), the outline ring, the colored ring, and orbiting dots.
		local fill = circle(gui, 1)
		local fillGradient = Instance.new("UIGradient")
		fillGradient.Parent = fill
		-- Radial glow: stacked see-through circles, brightest where they all overlap in the middle.
		local glow = Instance.new("Frame")
		glow.Name = ""
		glow.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
		glow.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		glow.Parent = gui
		local glowRings = {}
		for index = 1, 5 do
			local layer = circle(glow, 1)
			layer.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
			layer.Size = UDim2.fromScale(index / 5, index / 5)
			glowRings[index] = layer
		end

		local outline = circle(gui, 2)
		local outlineStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
		outlineStroke.Color = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
		outlineStroke.Transparency = 0.4
		outlineStroke.Parent = outline

		local ring = circle(gui, 3)
		local ringStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
		ringStroke.Color = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
		ringStroke.Parent = ring
		local ringGradient = Instance.new("UIGradient")
		ringGradient.Parent = ringStroke

		-- Dashed style and Orbit Dots: small dots spaced around the circle.
		local DOTS = 24
		local dots = {}
		for index = 1, DOTS do
			local dot = circle(gui, 4)
			dot.BackgroundTransparency = 0
			dots[index] = dot
		end

		local pieces = { fill, glow, outline, ring }
		local function hideAll()
			for _, piece in ipairs(pieces) do
				piece.Visible = false
			end
			for _, dot in ipairs(dots) do
				dot.Visible = false
			end
		end
		hideAll()

		local aimOrigin = Hooks._aimOrigin or function()
			return userInputService:GetMouseLocation()
		end

		library:connection(runService.RenderStepped, function()
			local style = flags.aim_fov_style or "Classic"
			if not Hooks.fovShown then
				if ring.Visible or dots[1].Visible or fill.Visible or glow.Visible then
					hideAll()
				end
				return
			end
			-- Classic keeps the old drawn circle, but still gets these fills.
			local classic = style == "Classic"

			local now = os.clock()
			if Hooks.lowPower() and now - (Hooks.fovEffectsAt or 0) < 1 / 30 then
				return
			end
			Hooks.fovEffectsAt = now
			local speed = flags.aim_fov_speed or 1
			local anim = flags.aim_fov_anim or "Spin"
			local center = aimOrigin()
			local radius = flags.aim_fov_radius or 100
			local thickness = flags.aim_fov_thickness or 1
			local first = flags.aim_fov_color and flags.aim_fov_color.Color or Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
			local second = flags.aim_fov_color2 and flags.aim_fov_color2.Color or Color3.fromRGB(120, 80, 255)
			if anim == "Rainbow" or flags.aim_fov_rainbow then
				first = getRainbow(0.3 * speed)
				second = getRainbow(0.3 * speed, 0.35)
			end
			if anim == "Pulse" then
				radius = radius * (1 + math.sin(now * 4 * speed) * 0.04)
			end

			local diameter = UDim2.fromOffset(radius * 2, radius * 2)
			local position = UDim2.fromOffset(center.X, center.Y)
			local spin = (now * 120 * speed) % 360

			-- Ring: a two-color gradient that turns (Spin) or sits still; Neon is thick and bright;
			-- Dashed swaps the ring for dots.
			local dashed = style == "Dashed"
			ring.Visible = not dashed and not classic
			outline.Visible = not dashed and not classic
			if ring.Visible then
				ring.Position, ring.Size = position, diameter
				outline.Position, outline.Size = position, diameter
				ringStroke.Thickness = style == "Neon" and thickness + 2 or thickness
				outlineStroke.Thickness = ringStroke.Thickness + 2
				outlineStroke.Transparency = style == "Neon" and 0.75 or 0.4
				ringGradient.Color = ColorSequence.new({
					ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, first),
					ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, second),
					ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, first),
				})
				ringGradient.Rotation = (anim == "Spin" or anim == "Rainbow") and spin or 0
				local breathe = anim == "Breathe" and (math.sin(now * 2.5 * speed) + 1) / 2 * 0.5 or 0
				ringStroke.Transparency = breathe
			end

			-- Dots: around the circle for Dashed, or a handful orbiting the ring for Orbit Dots.
			local dotCount = dashed and DOTS or ((anim == "Orbit Dots" and not classic) and 6 or 0)
			for index, dot in ipairs(dots) do
				local show = index <= dotCount
				dot.Visible = show
				if show then
					local angle = (index - 1) / dotCount * math.pi * 2 + math.rad(spin) * (dashed and 0.3 or 1)
					local size = dashed and math.max(thickness + 1, 3) or 6
					dot.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(center.X + math.cos(angle) * radius, center.Y + math.sin(angle) * radius)
					dot.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(size, size)
					dot.BackgroundColor3 = first:Lerp(second, (index - 1) / math.max(dotCount - 1, 1))
				end
			end

			-- Fill.
			local fillStyle = flags.aim_fov_fill_style or "None"
			-- FOV Circle's own "filled" toggle counts as a solid fill.
			if fillStyle == "None" and flags.aim_fov_filled then
				fillStyle = "Solid"
			end
			local fillTransparency = flags.aim_fov_fill_transparency or 0.75
			if anim == "Breathe" then
				fillTransparency = math.clamp(fillTransparency + math.sin(now * 2.5 * speed) * 0.08, 0, 1)
			end
			fill.Visible = fillStyle == "Solid" or fillStyle == "Gradient" or fillStyle == "Spin Gradient"
			if fill.Visible then
				fill.Position, fill.Size = position, diameter
				fill.BackgroundColor3 = fillStyle == "Solid" and first or Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
				fill.BackgroundTransparency = fillTransparency
				fillGradient.Enabled = fillStyle ~= "Solid"
				fillGradient.Color = ColorSequence.new(first, second)
				fillGradient.Rotation = fillStyle == "Spin Gradient" and spin or 90
			end
			glow.Visible = fillStyle == "Radial Glow"
			if glow.Visible then
				glow.Position, glow.Size = position, diameter
				-- Each layer adds a little, so the middle glows and the edge fades out.
				local layerTransparency = 1 + (1 - fillTransparency) / 2 * NEG_ONE
				for index, layer in ipairs(glowRings) do
					layer.BackgroundTransparency = layerTransparency
					layer.BackgroundColor3 = first:Lerp(second, (index - 1) / 4)
				end
			end
		end)

		onUnload(function()
			gui:Destroy()
		end)
	end

	buildFovEffects()
end

	Intro.step("loading esp & visuals", 0.62)

	-- ESP tab (other players) and visuals tab (yourself and screen effects).
	local espTab = Tabs.esp

	Tabs.esp = espTab
	Tabs.visuals = visualsTab
	local espObjects = {}
	-- Strong keys on purpose: Instance proxies can be collected, which silently drops weak entries.
	local overrideOriginals = {}
	local espImage = ""

	-- ESP lives in its own hidden gui so it never mixes with the menu.
	local espGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
	espGui.Name = ""
	espGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
	espGui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
	espGui.DisplayOrder = 0
	espGui:SetAttribute("AquaLabs", true)
	espGui.Parent = coreGui

	local chamsFolder = Instance.new("Folder")
	chamsFolder.Name = ""
	chamsFolder:SetAttribute("AquaLabs", true)
	chamsFolder.Parent = coreGui

	-- Skeleton bones between named joints. Joints are real body positions (shoulders,

	local R15_SKELETON = {

	-- Seconds between ESP redraws per update-rate option.

	-- Body box used for 3D boxes, relative to the root part (head top to feet).

	local function buildPlayerEsp()

	---Create a plain frame used as a line segment.
	---@return Frame
	local function createLine(parent)
		local line = Instance.new("Frame")
		line.Name = ""
		line.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
		line.BorderSizePixel = 0
		line.BorderColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
		line.Visible = false
		line.Parent = parent or espGui
		return line
	end

	---Create an ESP text label.
	---@param parent Instance
	---@param anchor Vector2
	---@return TextLabel
	local function createEspText(parent, anchor, fxGroup)
		local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
		label.Name = ""
		label.AnchorPoint = anchor
		label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		label.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 13)
		label.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X
		label.TextSize = 12
		label.TextStrokeTransparency = 0
		label.FontFace = library.font
		label.Parent = parent
		-- ESP > Text Animations picks this label's look.
		if fxGroup then
			Hooks.textFx.attach(label, fxGroup, true)
		end
		return label
	end

	---Build every drawable piece for one player once; the render loop only updates them.
	---@param player Player
	---`parent` builds a copy inside another frame (the ESP preview) instead of on screen.
	local function createEsp(player, parent)
		if not parent and (player == localPlayer or espObjects[player]) then
			return
		end

		local esp = { health = 1, skeleton = {}, box3d = {}, corners = {}, cache = {}, chamsShown = false, skeletonShown = 0 }

		-- One holder per player sized to the box (the vaderpaste visuals layout): everything inside
		-- is laid out by scale, so a frame only moves and resizes the holder.
		esp.container = Instance.new("Frame")
		esp.container.Name = ""
		esp.container.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		esp.container.Visible = false
		esp.container.Parent = parent or espGui

		-- Soft glow behind the box ("Glow" box style).
		esp.glow = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
		esp.glow.Name = ""
		esp.glow.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		esp.glow.Image = GLOW_IMAGE
		esp.glow.ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Slice
		esp.glow.SliceCenter = Rect.new(Vector2.new(21, 21), Vector2.new(79, 79))
		esp.glow.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(-16, -16)
		esp.glow.Size = UDim2.new(1, 32, 1, 32)
		esp.glow.Visible = false
		esp.glow.Parent = esp.container

		esp.boxHolder = Instance.new("Frame")
		esp.boxHolder.Name = ""
		esp.boxHolder.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
		esp.boxHolder.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
		esp.boxHolder.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
		esp.boxHolder.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		esp.boxHolder.Parent = esp.container

		esp.fill = Instance.new("Frame")
		esp.fill.Name = ""
		esp.fill.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
		esp.fill.BorderSizePixel = 0
		esp.fill.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
		esp.fill.Parent = esp.boxHolder
		esp.fillGradient = Instance.new("UIGradient")
		esp.fillGradient.Parent = esp.fill
		esp.fillCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
		esp.fillCorner.Parent = esp.fill

		-- Light band swept across the fill (Scan / Shimmer animations).
		esp.fillShine = Instance.new("Frame")
		esp.fillShine.Name = ""
		esp.fillShine.BorderSizePixel = 0
		esp.fillShine.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
		esp.fillShine.Visible = false
		esp.fillShine.Parent = esp.fill
		esp.fillShineGradient = Instance.new("UIGradient")
		esp.fillShineGradient.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({
			NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 1),
			NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.42, 1),
			NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, 0.45),
			NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.58, 1),
			NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1),
		})
		esp.fillShineGradient.Parent = esp.fillShine

		esp.image = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
		esp.image.Name = ""
		esp.image.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
		esp.image.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		esp.image.ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Stretch
		esp.image.Parent = esp.boxHolder
		esp.imageCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
		esp.imageCorner.Parent = esp.image

		---A transparent frame carrying one box stroke (UIStrokes draw just outside their frame).
		local function strokeFrame(color, zIndex)
			local frame = Instance.new("Frame")
			frame.Name = ""
			frame.BackgroundTransparency = 1
			frame.ZIndex = zIndex
			frame.Parent = esp.boxHolder
			local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
			stroke.Color = color
			stroke.LineJoinMode = Enum.LineJoinMode.Miter
			stroke.Parent = frame
			local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
			corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 0)
			corner.Parent = frame
			return frame, stroke, corner
		end

		-- Full box, as in the visuals library: a black ring outside, the colored ring, and a black
		-- ring inside, each one pixel-exact. Insets are set from the thickness in layoutBox.
		esp.boxOutline, esp.outlineStroke, esp.outlineCorner = strokeFrame(Color3.new(0, 0, 0), 2)
		esp.boxFrame, esp.boxStroke, esp.boxCorner = strokeFrame(Color3.new(1, 1, 1), 3)
		esp.innerOutline, esp.innerStroke, esp.innerCorner = strokeFrame(Color3.new(0, 0, 0), 2)
		esp.boxGradient = Instance.new("UIGradient")
		esp.boxGradient.Enabled = false
		esp.boxGradient.Parent = esp.boxStroke

		-- Corner box: eight black backing pieces with eight colored pieces on top, sized by scale.
		esp.cornerOutlines, esp.cornerGradients = {}, {}
		for index = 1, 8 do
			local outline = Instance.new("Frame")
			outline.Name = ""
			outline.BorderSizePixel = 0
			outline.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
			outline.ZIndex = 2
			outline.Visible = false
			outline.Parent = esp.boxHolder
			esp.cornerOutlines[index] = outline

			local corner = Instance.new("Frame")
			corner.Name = ""
			corner.BorderSizePixel = 0
			corner.ZIndex = 3
			corner.Visible = false
			corner.Parent = esp.boxHolder
			local gradient = Instance.new("UIGradient")
			gradient.Enabled = false
			gradient.Parent = corner
			esp.corners[index] = corner
			esp.cornerGradients[index] = gradient
		end

		esp.healthBack = Instance.new("Frame")
		esp.healthBack.Name = ""
		esp.healthBack.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0)
		esp.healthBack.Position = UDim2.new(0, -4, 0, -1)
		esp.healthBack.Size = UDim2.new(0, 4, 1, 2)
		esp.healthBack.BorderSizePixel = 0
		esp.healthBack.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
		esp.healthBack.BackgroundTransparency = 0.2
		esp.healthBack.Parent = esp.container

		esp.healthFill = Instance.new("Frame")
		esp.healthFill.Name = ""
		esp.healthFill.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 1)
		esp.healthFill.Position = UDim2.new(0, 1, 1, -1)
		esp.healthFill.BorderSizePixel = 0
		esp.healthFill.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
		esp.healthFill.Parent = esp.healthBack
		esp.healthGradient = Instance.new("UIGradient")
		esp.healthGradient.Rotation = 90
		esp.healthGradient.Parent = esp.healthFill

		-- Bright band that sweeps up the bar (Shimmer) and the glow behind it.
		esp.healthShine = Instance.new("Frame")
		esp.healthShine.Name = ""
		esp.healthShine.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
		esp.healthShine.BorderSizePixel = 0
		esp.healthShine.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
		esp.healthShine.Visible = false
		esp.healthShine.Parent = esp.healthFill
		esp.healthShineGradient = Instance.new("UIGradient")
		esp.healthShineGradient.Rotation = 90
		esp.healthShineGradient.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({
			NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 1),
			NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.4, 1),
			NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, 0.35),
			NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.6, 1),
			NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1),
		})
		esp.healthShineGradient.Parent = esp.healthShine

		esp.healthGlow = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
		esp.healthGlow.Name = ""
		esp.healthGlow.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		esp.healthGlow.Image = GLOW_IMAGE
		esp.healthGlow.ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Slice
		esp.healthGlow.SliceCenter = Rect.new(Vector2.new(21, 21), Vector2.new(79, 79))
		esp.healthGlow.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(-12, -12)
		esp.healthGlow.Size = UDim2.new(1, 24, 1, 24)
		esp.healthGlow.ZIndex = 0
		esp.healthGlow.Visible = false
		esp.healthGlow.Parent = esp.healthBack

		esp.healthText = createEspText(esp.container, Vector2.new(1, 0.5), "esp_health")
		esp.healthText.Visible = false

		esp.name = createEspText(esp.container, Vector2.new(0.5, 1), "esp_name")
		esp.name.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, -3)
		esp.status = createEspText(esp.container, Vector2.new(0.5, 1), "esp_tags")
		esp.status.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, -18)
		esp.status.TextSize = 13
		esp.status.TextStrokeTransparency = 0
		esp.status.RichText = true
		esp.aquaTag = createEspText(esp.container, Vector2.new(0.5, 1), "esp_tags")
		esp.aquaTag.Visible = false
		-- The tag on its own, for Aqua users the ESP itself skips (your team, friends, far away,
		-- or ESP off), so every user in the server gets one.
		esp.aquaOnly = createEspText(parent or espGui, Vector2.new(0.5, 1))
		esp.aquaOnly.Visible = false
		esp.weapon = createEspText(esp.container, Vector2.new(0.5, 0), "esp_name")
		esp.distance = createEspText(esp.container, Vector2.new(0.5, 0), "esp_name")
		esp.team = createEspText(esp.container, Vector2.new(0.5, 0), "esp_name")
		esp.team.Visible = false
		-- Player flags: a column of states beside the box (forcefield, shooting, in air...).
		esp.flags = createEspText(esp.container, Vector2.new(0, 0), "esp_flags")
		esp.flags.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.XY
		esp.flags.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Top
		esp.flags.RichText = true
		esp.flags.Visible = false

		-- Skeleton layers, back to front: soft glow, black outline, then the colored bone.
		-- Pill-rounded ends make the joints read as one smooth limb.
		esp.skeletonGlow, esp.skeletonOutline, esp.joints = {}, {}, {}

		local function roundLine(line)
			local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
			corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
			corner.Parent = line
			return line
		end

		for index = 1, SKELETON_BONE_COUNT do
			esp.skeletonGlow[index] = roundLine(createLine(parent))
		end

		for index = 1, SKELETON_BONE_COUNT do
			esp.skeletonOutline[index] = roundLine(createLine(parent))
			esp.skeletonOutline[index].BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
		end

		for index = 1, SKELETON_BONE_COUNT do
			esp.skeleton[index] = roundLine(createLine(parent))
		end

		for index = 1, SKELETON_BONE_COUNT + 1 do
			esp.joints[index] = roundLine(createLine(parent))
		end

		-- Head circle drawn like the bones: a black outline ring under the colored ring.
		esp.headOutline = createLine(parent)
		esp.headOutline.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		roundLine(esp.headOutline)
		esp.headOutlineStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
		esp.headOutlineStroke.Color = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
		esp.headOutlineStroke.Parent = esp.headOutline

		esp.headCircle = createLine(parent)
		esp.headCircle.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		roundLine(esp.headCircle)
		esp.headStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
		esp.headStroke.Parent = esp.headCircle
		esp.jointsShown = 0

		for index = 1, #BOX_EDGES do
			esp.box3d[index] = createLine(parent)
		end

		-- Outline first so the colored tracer draws on top of it. Drawing lines when the executor
		-- has them: a rotated full-screen gui frame per player was the costliest part of the ESP.
		-- (Not in the preview: Drawing lines are in screen space, the preview's are in its panel.)
		if Drawing.real and not parent then
			esp.tracerDrawn = true
			esp.tracerOutline = Drawing.new("Line")
			esp.tracerOutline.Color = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
			esp.tracerOutline.ZIndex = 1
			esp.tracer = Drawing.new("Line")
			esp.tracer.ZIndex = 2
		else
			esp.tracerOutline = createLine(parent)
			esp.tracerOutline.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
			esp.tracer = createLine(parent)
		end

		esp.highlight = Instance.new("Highlight")
		esp.highlight.Name = ""
		esp.highlight.Enabled = false
		esp.highlight.Parent = chamsFolder
		esp.chams = Chams.new(chamsFolder)
		esp.adorn = AdornChams.new()

		if parent then
			return esp
		end
		espObjects[player] = esp
	end

	---Restore any parts we recolored for this character.
	---@param character Model?
	local function restoreAppearance(character)
		if not character then
			return
		end

		for _, part in ipairs(character:GetDescendants()) do
			local original = overrideOriginals[part]
			if original then
				part.Material = original.material
				part.Color = original.color
				part.Transparency = original.transparency
				overrideOriginals[part] = nil
			end
		end
	end

	---Remove a player's ESP objects.
	---@param player Player
	local function destroyEsp(player)
		local esp = espObjects[player]
		if not esp then
			return
		end

		espObjects[player] = nil
		esp.container:Destroy()
		esp.aquaOnly:Destroy()
		esp.highlight:Destroy()
		esp.chams:destroy()
		esp.adorn:clear()
		-- Ghost trail copies go with them.
		for _, ghost in ipairs(esp._ghostTrails or {}) do
			ghost.dead = true
			ghost.model:Destroy()
		end
		esp.tracer:Destroy()
		esp.tracerOutline:Destroy()
		esp.headCircle:Destroy()
		esp.headOutline:Destroy()

		-- Every pooled piece goes, not just the colored bones: the outline and glow layers,
		-- joints and head circle were left behind on screen when a player left.
		for _, pool in ipairs({ esp.skeleton, esp.skeletonOutline, esp.skeletonGlow, esp.joints, esp.box3d, esp.corners }) do
			for _, line in ipairs(pool or {}) do
				line:Destroy()
			end
		end

		restoreAppearance(player.Character)
	end

	---Hide everything drawn for one player.
	---@param esp table
	---Only touches instances that are actually showing, so idle players cost nothing per frame.
	---@param keepChams boolean? leave the highlight alone (player is just off screen)
	local hideEsp = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(esp, keepChams)
		if not keepChams and esp.chamsShown then
			esp.chamsShown = false
			esp.highlight.Enabled = false
			esp.chams:clear()
			esp.adorn:clear()
		end

		if esp.hidden then
			return
		end

		esp.hidden = true

		-- These writes bypass the write-on-change cache, so forget it; the next show rewrites everything once.
		table.clear(esp.cache)
		esp.radius = nil
		esp.textAt = nil
		esp.container.Visible = false
		esp.tracer.Visible = false
		esp.tracerOutline.Visible = false

		for index = 1, esp.skeletonShown or 0 do
			esp.skeleton[index].Visible = false
			esp.skeletonOutline[index].Visible = false
			esp.skeletonGlow[index].Visible = false
		end
		esp.skeletonShown = 0

		for index = 1, esp.jointsShown or 0 do
			esp.joints[index].Visible = false
		end
		esp.jointsShown = 0
		esp.headCircle.Visible = false
		esp.headOutline.Visible = false

		if esp.box3dShown then
			esp.box3dShown = false
			for _, line in ipairs(esp.box3d) do
				line.Visible = false
			end
		end
	end)

	---Whether a player should be drawn at all (alive, in range, team filter).
	---@param player Player
	---@return Model?, BasePart?, Humanoid?, number?
	local getEspTarget = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(player)
		local character = player.Character
		local rootPart = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

		-- Characters that aren't in the world anymore (left, on the team menu) aren't drawn.
		if not (rootPart and humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0 and character:IsDescendantOf(workspace)) then
			return nil
		end

		-- Self ESP: none of the filters below apply to you; hidden in first person.
		if player == localPlayer then
			local head = character:FindFirstChild("Head")
			local cameraPosition = workspace.CurrentCamera.CFrame.Position
			if head and (cameraPosition - head.Position).Magnitude < 1.5 then
				return nil
			end
			return { character = character, rootPart = rootPart, humanoid = humanoid, distance = (cameraPosition - rootPart.Position).Magnitude }
		end

		-- Whitelisted players still draw (green + label later).
		if flags.esp_target_only and flags.global_target_only_enabled then
			if not listHas(flags.global_target_only, player.Name) then
				return nil
			end
		end
		local etw = flags.esp_team_whitelist
		if player.Team and type(etw) == "table" and table.find(etw, player.Team.Name) then
			return nil
		end
		if flags.esp_team_check and player.Team and player.Team == localPlayer.Team then
			return nil
		end
		if flags.esp_friend_check ~= false and Hooks.isFriend and Hooks.isFriend(player) then
			return nil
		end

		local distance = (workspace.CurrentCamera.CFrame.Position - rootPart.Position).Magnitude
		if distance > (flags.esp_max_distance or 2000) then
			return nil
		end

		-- One table, not four return values (the obfuscated build mixes up multiple returns).
		return { character = character, rootPart = rootPart, humanoid = humanoid, distance = distance }
	end)

	-- ESP preview: while it's being drawn, `view` holds the preview's camera, size and target, so
	-- the same ESP code draws into the preview panel. `z` is the depth of the last projected point.
	local espViewState = { view = nil, z = 0 }

	---The camera the ESP is drawn through.
	local espCameraCFrame = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()
		local view = espViewState.view
		if view then
			return view.cameraCFrame
		end
		return workspace.CurrentCamera.CFrame
	end)

	-- Whether the last point given to project() was on screen. Kept here instead of returned as a
	-- second value, which the obfuscated build mixes up.
	local projectOnScreen = false

	---A world point in gui space. Its on-screen flag lands in projectOnScreen.
	---@param position Vector3
	---@return Vector2
	local project = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(position)
		local view = espViewState.view
		if view then
			-- Preview: projected by hand through the preview camera, in the panel's pixels.
			local relative = view.cameraCFrame:PointToObjectSpace(position)
			local depth = NEG_ONE * relative.Z
			espViewState.z = depth
			local safeDepth = math.max(depth, 0.001)
			local scale = view.size.Y / 2 / math.tan(math.rad(view.fov) / 2)
			local x = view.size.X / 2 + relative.X / safeDepth * scale
			local y = view.size.Y / 2 + NEG_ONE * relative.Y / safeDepth * scale
			projectOnScreen = depth > 0 and x >= 0 and y >= 0 and x <= view.size.X and y <= view.size.Y
			return Vector2.new(x, y)
		end
		-- Viewport space matches the ESP gui (it ignores the top bar inset).
		local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
		local projected = camera:WorldToViewportPoint(position)
		local viewport = camera.ViewportSize
		espViewState.z = projected.Z
		projectOnScreen = projected.Z > 0 and projected.X >= 0 and projected.Y >= 0
			and projected.X <= viewport.X and projected.Y <= viewport.Y
		return Vector2.new(projected.X, projected.Y)
	end)

	-- Corner pieces: anchor corner, and whether the piece runs along the top/bottom edge.
	local CORNER_PIECES = {
		{ 0, 0, true }, { 0, 0, false }, { 1, 0, true }, { 1, 0, false },
		{ 0, 1, true }, { 0, 1, false }, { 1, 1, true }, { 1, 1, false },
	}

	---Place the box rings and corner pieces for a thickness, outline width and corner length.
	---Everything is by scale, so this only runs when one of those settings changes.
	local layoutBox = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(esp, thickness, outline, cornerLength)
		local key = thickness .. ":" .. outline .. ":" .. cornerLength
		if esp.boxLayout == key then
			return
		end
		esp.boxLayout = key

		-- Rings, outside in: black [-outline, 0], color [0, thickness], black [thickness, thickness + outline].
		esp.boxOutline.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 0)
		esp.boxOutline.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
		esp.outlineStroke.Thickness = outline
		esp.boxFrame.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(thickness, thickness)
		esp.boxFrame.Size = UDim2.new(1, -thickness * 2, 1, -thickness * 2)
		esp.boxStroke.Thickness = thickness
		local inner = thickness + outline
		esp.innerOutline.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(inner, inner)
		esp.innerOutline.Size = UDim2.new(1, -inner * 2, 1, -inner * 2)
		esp.innerStroke.Thickness = outline

		for index, piece in ipairs(CORNER_PIECES) do
			local ax, ay, horizontal = piece[1], piece[2], piece[3]
			local size = horizontal and UDim2.new(cornerLength, 0, 0, thickness) or UDim2.new(0, thickness, cornerLength * 0.8, 0)
			local corner = esp.corners[index]
			corner.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(ax, ay)
			corner.Position = UDim2.fromScale(ax, ay)
			corner.Size = size

			local backing = esp.cornerOutlines[index]
			backing.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(ax, ay)
			backing.Position = UDim2.new(ax, outline * (2 * ax - 1), ay, outline * (2 * ay - 1))
			backing.Size = size + UDim2.fromOffset(outline * 2, outline * 2)
		end
	end)

	---Write a property only when it changed. Skipping redundant writes is the biggest
	---per-frame saving: every write crosses into the engine and can re-layout the GUI.
	---@param esp table
	---@param instance Instance
	---@param key string
	---@param value any
	local set = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(esp, instance, key, value)
		local entry = esp.cache[instance]
		if not entry then
			entry = {}
			esp.cache[instance] = entry
		end

		if entry[key] ~= value then
			entry[key] = value
			instance[key] = value
		end
	end)

	---Cached version of setLine for ESP-owned lines.
	local setEspLine = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(esp, line, from, to, thickness)
		local delta = to - from
		set(esp, line, "Position", UDim2.fromOffset((from.X + to.X) / 2, (from.Y + to.Y) / 2))
		set(esp, line, "Size", UDim2.fromOffset(delta.Magnitude, thickness))
		set(esp, line, "Rotation", math.deg(math.atan2(delta.Y, delta.X)))
		set(esp, line, "Visible", true)
	end)

	---Two-color gradient, rebuilt only when either color changes.
	local setGradient = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(esp, gradient, first, second)
		local entry = esp.cache[gradient]
		if not entry then
			entry = {}
			esp.cache[gradient] = entry
		end

		-- Stored under its own key so it shares the per-instance entry used by set().
		local key = first:ToHex() .. second:ToHex()
		if entry.__colors ~= key then
			entry.__colors = key
			gradient.Color = ColorSequence.new(first, second)
		end
	end)

	---Draw the 2D box in its style, with its color animation and outline color.
	local drawBox = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(esp, player, size, color, second, thickness, outline, style, showBox, now)
		layoutBox(esp, thickness, math.max(outline, 1), flags.esp_corner_length or 0.3)

		local radius = style == "Rounded" and math.floor(math.min(8, size.X / 4)) or 0
		if esp.radius ~= radius then
			esp.radius = radius
			local corner = UDim.new(0, radius)
			for _, object in ipairs({ esp.boxCorner, esp.outlineCorner, esp.innerCorner, esp.fillCorner, esp.imageCorner }) do
				object.CornerRadius = corner
			end
		end

		local outlined = outline > 0
		local fullBox = showBox and (style == "Full" or style == "Rounded" or style == "Glow")
		set(esp, esp.boxFrame, "Visible", fullBox)
		set(esp, esp.boxOutline, "Visible", fullBox and outlined)
		set(esp, esp.innerOutline, "Visible", fullBox and outlined and flags.esp_box_inner_outline ~= false)

		local cornerBox = showBox and style == "Corner"
		local cornerState = cornerBox and (outlined and 2 or 1) or 0
		if esp.cornerState ~= cornerState then
			esp.cornerState = cornerState
			for index = 1, 8 do
				esp.corners[index].Visible = cornerState > 0
				esp.cornerOutlines[index].Visible = cornerState == 2
			end
		end

		local glowOn = showBox and (style == "Glow" or flags.esp_box_glow == true or (esp.locked and flags.esp_target_glow ~= false))
		set(esp, esp.glow, "Visible", glowOn)
		if glowOn then
			set(esp, esp.glow, "ImageColor3", color)
			set(esp, esp.glow, "ImageTransparency", math.floor((0.4 + (math.sin(now * 3) + 1) * 0.12) * 50) / 50)
		end

		if not (fullBox or cornerBox) then
			return
		end

		-- Color animation: a two-color gradient (static, spinning or flowing), rainbow or pulse.
		local mode = flags.esp_box_anim or "None"
		local speed = flags.esp_box_anim_speed or 0.5
		local useGradient, rotation, offset = false, 90, Vector2.zero
		if mode == "Rainbow" then
			color = getRainbow(speed, (player.UserId % 10) / 10)
		elseif mode == "Pulse" then
			color = color:Lerp(second, (math.sin(now * speed * 6) + 1) / 2)
		elseif mode == "Gradient" then
			useGradient = true
		elseif mode == "Spin" then
			useGradient, rotation = true, math.floor(now * speed * 360) % 360
		elseif mode == "Flow" then
			useGradient = true
			offset = Vector2.new(0, math.floor(math.sin(now * speed * 4) * 50) / 100)
		elseif mode == "Water" then
			-- Light aqua into deep blue, flowing down the box and tilting like a wave.
			color, second = Color3.fromRGB(150, 230, 255), Color3.fromRGB(20, 90, 220)
			useGradient = true
			rotation = math.floor(90 + math.sin(now * speed * 3) * 15)
			offset = Vector2.new(0, math.floor(math.sin(now * speed * 2.5) * 40) / 100)
		end

		local strokeColor = useGradient and Color3.new(1, 1, 1) or color
		local outlineColor = flags.esp_box_outline_color and flags.esp_box_outline_color.Color or Color3.new(0, 0, 0)

		if fullBox then
			set(esp, esp.boxStroke, "Color", strokeColor)
			set(esp, esp.outlineStroke, "Color", outlineColor)
			set(esp, esp.innerStroke, "Color", outlineColor)
			set(esp, esp.boxGradient, "Enabled", useGradient)
			if useGradient then
				setGradient(esp, esp.boxGradient, color, second)
				set(esp, esp.boxGradient, "Rotation", rotation)
				set(esp, esp.boxGradient, "Offset", offset)
			end
			return
		end

		for index = 1, 8 do
			set(esp, esp.corners[index], "BackgroundColor3", strokeColor)
			set(esp, esp.cornerOutlines[index], "BackgroundColor3", outlineColor)
			local gradient = esp.cornerGradients[index]
			set(esp, gradient, "Enabled", useGradient)
			if useGradient then
				setGradient(esp, gradient, color, second)
				set(esp, gradient, "Rotation", rotation)
				set(esp, gradient, "Offset", offset)
			end
		end
	end)

	local FILL_DIRECTIONS = { Vertical = 90, Horizontal = 0, Diagonal = 45 }

	---Gradient fill and its animation.
	local drawFill = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(esp, player, teamColor, now)
		local showFill = flags.esp_fill == true
		set(esp, esp.fill, "Visible", showFill)
		if not showFill then
			return
		end

		local top = teamColor or (flags.esp_fill_top and flags.esp_fill_top.Color or Color3.new(1, 1, 1))
		local bottom = teamColor and teamColor:Lerp(Color3.new(0, 0, 0), 0.55)
			or (flags.esp_fill_bottom and flags.esp_fill_bottom.Color or Color3.fromRGB(120, 80, 255))
		-- Keep top/bottom distinct so the gradient is readable while it moves.
		if (top.R - bottom.R) ^ 2 + (top.G - bottom.G) ^ 2 + (top.B - bottom.B) ^ 2 < 0.04 then
			bottom = top:Lerp(Color3.new(0, 0, 0), 0.55)
		end

		local baseT = flags.esp_fill_transparency or 0.7
		local anim = flags.esp_fill_anim or "Spin"
		local speed = math.max(tonumber(flags.esp_fill_spin_speed) or 0.25, 0.05)
		local rot = FILL_DIRECTIONS[flags.esp_fill_direction or "Vertical"] or 90
		local t = baseT
		local offset = Vector2.zero
		local shine, shineRotation = nil, 90
		-- Spinning looks use a three-stop gradient (color, second color, color) so the turn reads
		-- as a full circular sweep instead of a flat fade flipping over.
		local sweep = false

		local frost = anim == "Frost"
		if anim == "Spin" then
			rot = (now * speed * 360) % 360
			sweep = true
		elseif anim == "Water" then
			-- Water: light surface over deep blue, the level gently rising and falling, a soft
			-- tilt like a wave and a shine passing through.
			top, bottom = Color3.fromRGB(150, 230, 255), Color3.fromRGB(18, 80, 200)
			rot = 90 + math.sin(now * speed * 2.2) * 8
			offset = Vector2.new(0, math.sin(now * speed * 1.6) * 0.18)
			t = math.clamp(baseT * 0.8, 0.05, 0.95)
			shine, shineRotation = ((now * speed * 0.5) % 1.6) * 2 + NEG_ONE * 1.4, 45
		elseif frost then
			-- Frosted glass: white to light gray turning slowly, milky on two sides and clear
			-- through the middle (see the transparency below), with a soft diagonal shine.
			if not teamColor then
				bottom = top:Lerp(Color3.fromRGB(150, 150, 160), 0.55)
			end
			rot = (now * speed * 120) % 360
			sweep = true
			t = math.clamp(baseT * 0.6, 0.05, 0.95)
			shine, shineRotation = ((now * speed * 0.45) % 1.6) * 2 + NEG_ONE * 1.4, 45
		elseif anim == "Vortex" then
			-- Fast sweep, a light beam turning through the middle, and a gentle pulse.
			rot = (now * speed * 540) % 360
			sweep = true
			shine, shineRotation = 0, math.floor((rot + 90) % 360)
			t = math.clamp(baseT + math.sin(now * speed * 4) * 0.1, 0.05, 0.95)
		elseif anim == "Aurora" then
			-- Rainbow sweep whose colors drift as it turns.
			local hue = (now * speed * 0.25 + (player.UserId % 10) / 10) % 1
			top = Color3.fromHSV(hue, 0.7, 1)
			bottom = Color3.fromHSV((hue + 0.45) % 1, 0.8, 1)
			rot = (now * speed * 300) % 360
			sweep = true
		elseif anim == "Pulse" then
			local wave = (math.sin(now * speed * 5) + 1) / 2
			t = math.clamp(baseT * (0.55 + wave * 0.7), 0.05, 0.95)
			local mid = top:Lerp(bottom, 0.5)
			top = top:Lerp(mid, wave * 0.65)
			bottom = bottom:Lerp(mid, (1 - wave) * 0.65)
		elseif anim == "Wave" then
			rot = rot + math.sin(now * speed * 2.4) * 70
			local wave = (math.sin(now * speed * 3.2 + (player.UserId % 7) * 0.9) + 1) / 2
			t = math.clamp(baseT + (wave - 0.5) * 0.22, 0.05, 0.95)
			top = top:Lerp(bottom, wave * 0.4)
			bottom = bottom:Lerp(top, (1 - wave) * 0.25)
			offset = Vector2.new(0, (wave - 0.5) * 0.55)
		elseif anim == "Breathe" then
			t = math.clamp(baseT + math.sin(now * speed * 3) * 0.18, 0.05, 0.98)
		elseif anim == "Rainbow" then
			local hue = (now * speed * 0.4 + (player.UserId % 10) / 10) % 1
			top = Color3.fromHSV(hue, 0.75, 1)
			bottom = Color3.fromHSV((hue + 0.3) % 1, 0.75, 1)
			rot = (rot + now * speed * 60) % 360
		elseif anim == "Scan" then
			-- A bright line runs down the box, like a scanner.
			shine = ((now * speed * 0.8) % 1) * 2 - 1
		elseif anim == "Shimmer" then
			-- A diagonal shine glides across, then pauses.
			shine = ((now * speed * 0.6) % 1.6) * 2 - 1.4
			shineRotation = 45
		end

		if sweep then
			local entry = esp.cache[esp.fillGradient] or {}
			esp.cache[esp.fillGradient] = entry
			local key = "sweep" .. top:ToHex() .. bottom:ToHex()
			if entry.__colors ~= key then
				entry.__colors = key
				esp.fillGradient.Color = ColorSequence.new({
					ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, top),
					ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, bottom),
					ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, top),
				})
			end
		else
			setGradient(esp, esp.fillGradient, top, bottom)
		end
		set(esp, esp.fillGradient, "Rotation", math.floor(rot))
		set(esp, esp.fillGradient, "Offset", offset)
		set(esp, esp.fill, "BackgroundTransparency", math.floor(t * 100) / 100)
		-- Frost fades the fill out through the middle as it turns; every other look is even.
		local fadeKey = frost and "frost" or "even"
		if esp.fillFadeKey ~= fadeKey then
			esp.fillFadeKey = fadeKey
			esp.fillGradient.Transparency = frost and NumberSequence.new({
				NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0),
				NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, 0.8),
				NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0),
			}) or NumberSequence.new(0)
		end

		set(esp, esp.fillShine, "Visible", shine ~= nil)
		if shine then
			set(esp, esp.fillShine, "BackgroundColor3", top:Lerp(Color3.new(1, 1, 1), 0.6))
			set(esp, esp.fillShineGradient, "Rotation", shineRotation)
			set(esp, esp.fillShineGradient, "Offset", shineRotation == 90 and Vector2.new(0, shine) or Vector2.new(shine, shine))
		end
	end)

	---Health bar: smoothing, its color style, shimmer, glow, low-health flash and the number.
	local drawHealth = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(esp, humanoid, boxSize, outline, now, font, textSize, textStroke)
		local showHealth = flags.esp_healthbar == true
		set(esp, esp.healthBack, "Visible", showHealth)
		set(esp, esp.healthText, "Visible", showHealth and flags.esp_health_text == true)
		if not showHealth then
			return
		end

		local target = math.clamp(humanoid.Health / math.max(humanoid.MaxHealth, 1), 0, 1)
		local shownHealth = humanoid.Health
		-- Preview: the bar sweeps down and back up so you can see its colors and animation.
		if espViewState.view then
			target = 0.6 + math.sin(now * 1.2) * 0.4
			shownHealth = target * 100
		end
		esp.health += (target - esp.health) * (flags.esp_health_lerp or 0.15)
		local health = esp.health

		local high = flags.esp_health_high and flags.esp_health_high.Color or Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 100)
		local low = flags.esp_health_low and flags.esp_health_low.Color or Color3.fromRGB(255, 40, 40)
		local width = (flags.esp_health_width or 2) + 2
		local gap = 2 + outline
		local side = flags.esp_health_side or "Left"
		local right = side == "Right"
		-- Top or Bottom: the bar lies flat along that edge of the box and fills left to right.
		local flat = side == "Top" or side == "Bottom"
		local fill = math.floor(health * 100) / 100

		if flat then
			local top = side == "Top"
			set(esp, esp.healthBack, "AnchorPoint", top and Vector2.new(0, 1) or Vector2.new(0, 0))
			set(esp, esp.healthBack, "Position", top and UDim2.new(0, NEG_ONE * outline, 0, NEG_ONE * gap) or UDim2.new(0, NEG_ONE * outline, 1, gap))
			set(esp, esp.healthBack, "Size", UDim2.new(1, outline * 2, 0, width))
			set(esp, esp.healthFill, "AnchorPoint", Vector2.new(0, 0))
			set(esp, esp.healthFill, "Position", UDim2.new(0, 1, 0, 1))
			set(esp, esp.healthFill, "Size", UDim2.new(fill, -2, 1, -2))
		else
			set(esp, esp.healthBack, "AnchorPoint", right and Vector2.new(0, 0) or Vector2.new(1, 0))
			set(esp, esp.healthBack, "Position", right and UDim2.new(1, gap, 0, -outline) or UDim2.new(0, -gap, 0, -outline))
			set(esp, esp.healthBack, "Size", UDim2.new(0, width, 1, outline * 2))
			set(esp, esp.healthFill, "AnchorPoint", Vector2.new(0, 1))
			set(esp, esp.healthFill, "Position", UDim2.new(0, 1, 1, -1))
			set(esp, esp.healthFill, "Size", UDim2.new(1, -2, fill, -2))
		end
		-- The color runs along the bar: bottom-to-top standing up, left-to-right lying flat.
		set(esp, esp.healthGradient, "Rotation", flat and 180 or 90)
		set(esp, esp.healthShineGradient, "Rotation", flat and 0 or 90)

		local mode = flags.esp_health_type or "Gradient"
		local speed = flags.esp_health_anim_speed or 1
		local barColor = low:Lerp(high, health)
		local useGradient, offset = true, Vector2.zero
		local first, second = high, low

		if mode == "Solid" or mode == "Health Color" then
			useGradient = false
			barColor = low:Lerp(high, math.floor(health * 20) / 20)
		elseif mode == "Pulse" then
			useGradient = false
			barColor = barColor:Lerp(Color3.new(1, 1, 1), (math.sin(now * speed * 5) + 1) / 2 * 0.45)
		elseif mode == "Rainbow" then
			local hue = (now * speed * 0.3) % 1
			first, second = Color3.fromHSV(hue, 0.8, 1), Color3.fromHSV((hue + 0.25) % 1, 0.8, 1)
			barColor = first
		elseif mode == "Flow" then
			local flow = math.floor(math.sin(now * speed * 2) * 35) / 100
			offset = flat and Vector2.new(flow, 0) or Vector2.new(0, flow)
		elseif mode == "Heartbeat" then
			-- Double thump, beating faster the lower the health.
			useGradient = false
			local cycle = (now * speed * (1 + (1 + NEG_ONE * health) * 1.8)) % 1
			local thump = math.max(0, 1 + NEG_ONE * cycle * 8) + math.max(0, 1 + NEG_ONE * math.abs(cycle + NEG_ONE * 0.25) * 10) * 0.7
			barColor = barColor:Lerp(Color3.new(1, 1, 1), math.floor(math.min(thump, 1) * 55) / 100)
		elseif mode == "Strobe" then
			-- Snaps between the health color and the theme color.
			useGradient = false
			barColor = math.floor(now * speed * 4) % 2 == 0 and barColor or getAccent()
		elseif mode == "Theme" then
			local accent = getAccent()
			first, second = accent:Lerp(Color3.new(1, 1, 1), 0.4), accent:Lerp(Color3.new(0, 0, 0), 0.35)
			local flow = math.floor(math.sin(now * speed * 2) * 25) / 100
			offset = flat and Vector2.new(flow, 0) or Vector2.new(0, flow)
		elseif mode == "Liquid" then
			-- The health colors slosh back and forth along the bar.
			local slosh = math.floor((math.sin(now * speed * 3) * 0.3 + math.sin(now * speed * 7.3) * 0.08) * 100) / 100
			first, second = high:Lerp(Color3.new(1, 1, 1), 0.25), low:Lerp(high, health)
			offset = flat and Vector2.new(slosh, 0) or Vector2.new(0, slosh)
		end
		-- Breathe fades the whole fill in and out; every other type keeps it solid.
		set(esp, esp.healthFill, "BackgroundTransparency", mode == "Breathe" and math.floor((math.sin(now * speed * 3) + 1) * 25) / 100 or 0)

		set(esp, esp.healthGradient, "Enabled", useGradient)
		set(esp, esp.healthFill, "BackgroundColor3", useGradient and Color3.new(1, 1, 1) or barColor)
		if useGradient then
			setGradient(esp, esp.healthGradient, first, second)
			set(esp, esp.healthGradient, "Offset", offset)
		end

		-- Background: outline on/off, and a red flash under 30% health.
		local back = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
		if flags.esp_health_flash and health < 0.3 then
			back = back:Lerp(Color3.fromRGB(255, 30, 30), math.floor((math.sin(now * 10) + 1) * 35) / 100)
		end
		set(esp, esp.healthBack, "BackgroundColor3", back)
		set(esp, esp.healthBack, "BackgroundTransparency", flags.esp_health_outline ~= false and 0.2 or 1)

		local shimmer = flags.esp_health_shimmer == true
		set(esp, esp.healthShine, "Visible", shimmer)
		if shimmer then
			local shinePhase = ((now * speed * 0.7) % 1) * 2
			-- Sweeps toward the full end of the bar.
			set(esp, esp.healthShineGradient, "Offset", flat and Vector2.new(shinePhase + NEG_ONE, 0) or Vector2.new(0, 1 + shinePhase * NEG_ONE))
		end

		local glow = flags.esp_health_glow == true
		set(esp, esp.healthGlow, "Visible", glow)
		if glow then
			set(esp, esp.healthGlow, "ImageColor3", barColor)
			set(esp, esp.healthGlow, "ImageTransparency", 0.55)
		end

		if flags.esp_health_text then
			local textX = gap + width + 2
			if flat then
				-- Past the bar, following the end of the fill.
				local top = side == "Top"
				set(esp, esp.healthText, "AnchorPoint", top and Vector2.new(0.5, 1) or Vector2.new(0.5, 0))
				set(esp, esp.healthText, "Position", UDim2.new(math.clamp(health, 0.05, 0.95), 0, top and 0 or 1, top and NEG_ONE * textX or textX))
			else
				set(esp, esp.healthText, "AnchorPoint", right and Vector2.new(0, 0.5) or Vector2.new(1, 0.5))
				set(esp, esp.healthText, "Position", right and UDim2.new(1, textX, math.clamp(1 - health, 0.05, 0.95), 0)
					or UDim2.new(0, -textX, math.clamp(1 - health, 0.05, 0.95), 0))
			end
			set(esp, esp.healthText, "Text", tostring(math.floor(shownHealth + 0.5)))
			set(esp, esp.healthText, "TextColor3", Hooks.textFx.tint("esp_health", barColor))
			set(esp, esp.healthText, "FontFace", font)
			set(esp, esp.healthText, "TextSize", textSize)
			set(esp, esp.healthText, "TextStrokeTransparency", textStroke)
			set(esp, esp.healthText, "Size", UDim2.fromOffset(0, textSize + 1))
		end
	end)

	local visibilityParams = RaycastParams.new()
	visibilityParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude

	---Whether the camera can see this character (cached ~10 times a second per player).
	---Internal ESPs swap chams color on this: one color when visible, another behind walls.
	---@return boolean
	local isVisible = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(esp, character, now)
		-- The preview copy is always in plain view.
		if espViewState.view then
			return true
		end
		if esp.visibleCheckedAt and now - esp.visibleCheckedAt < 0.1 then
			return esp.visible
		end

		esp.visibleCheckedAt = now
