		local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
		local head = character:FindFirstChild("Head") or character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		if not head then
			esp.visible = false
			return false
		end

		visibilityParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = { camera, character, localPlayer.Character }
		local origin = camera.CFrame.Position
		local hit = workspace:Raycast(origin, head.Position - origin, visibilityParams)

		esp.visible = hit == nil
		return esp.visible
	end)

	-- Ghost trail: clean afterimages. Every so often while a player moves, a see-through copy of
	-- their body in one smooth color is left where they were and fades out in place. One folder
	-- and one 30 Hz loop handle every copy.
	local GHOST_LIFE = 0.5
	local GHOSTS_PER_PLAYER = 4
	local GHOST_START_TRANSPARENCY = 0.55
	local ghostFolder = Instance.new("Folder")
	ghostFolder.Name = ""
	ghostFolder.Parent = workspace
	local ghostCopies = {}
	local ghostAnimatedAt = 0

	---Leave an afterimage of `character` behind.
	local function spawnGhostCopy(esp, character, color)
		esp._ghostTrails = esp._ghostTrails or {}
		for index = #esp._ghostTrails, 1, -1 do
			if esp._ghostTrails[index].dead then
				table.remove(esp._ghostTrails, index)
			end
		end
		while #esp._ghostTrails >= GHOSTS_PER_PLAYER do
			local oldest = table.remove(esp._ghostTrails, 1)
			oldest.dead = true
			oldest.model:Destroy()
		end

		local model = Instance.new("Model")
		local copies = {}
		for _, part in ipairs(character:GetDescendants()) do
			if part:IsA("BasePart") and part.Name ~= "HumanoidRootPart" and part.Transparency < 0.99
				and not part:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Tool") then
				local archivable = part.Archivable
				part.Archivable = true
				local ok, copy = pcall(part.Clone, part)
				part.Archivable = archivable
				if ok and copy then
					-- Only the shape stays: no faces, clothes, welds, sounds or lights.
					for _, child in ipairs(copy:GetChildren()) do
						if not child:IsA("DataModelMesh") then
							child:Destroy()
						end
					end
					local mesh = copy:FindFirstChildOfClass("SpecialMesh")
					if mesh then
						mesh.TextureId = ""
					end
					if copy:IsA("MeshPart") then
						copy.TextureID = ""
					end
					copy.Anchored = true
					copy.CanCollide = false
					copy.CanQuery = false
					copy.CanTouch = false
					copy.CastShadow = false
					copy.Massless = true
					copy.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
					copy.Reflectance = 0
					copy.Color = color
					copy.Transparency = GHOST_START_TRANSPARENCY
					copy.LocalTransparencyModifier = 0
					copy.CFrame = part.CFrame
					copy.Parent = model
					table.insert(copies, copy)
				end
			end
		end
		model.Parent = ghostFolder
		local record = { model = model, copies = copies, born = os.clock() }
		table.insert(esp._ghostTrails, record)
		table.insert(ghostCopies, record)
	end

	library:connection(runService.Heartbeat, function()
		if #ghostCopies == 0 then
			return
		end
		local now = os.clock()
		if now - ghostAnimatedAt < 1 / 30 then
			return
		end
		ghostAnimatedAt = now
		for index = #ghostCopies, 1, -1 do
			local record = ghostCopies[index]
			local t = (now - record.born) / GHOST_LIFE
			if record.dead or t >= 1 or not record.model.Parent then
				record.dead = true
				record.model:Destroy()
				table.remove(ghostCopies, index)
			else
				-- Fade out in place, easing so it lingers a moment and then slips away.
				local transparency = GHOST_START_TRANSPARENCY + (1 - GHOST_START_TRANSPARENCY) * (t * t)
				for _, copy in ipairs(record.copies) do
					copy.Transparency = transparency
				end
			end
		end
	end)
	onUnload(function()
		ghostFolder:Destroy()
	end)

	---Recolor and animate one player's chams: a solid silhouette in their exact shape.
	---Chams, by type: highlight (their real body in one color), glass (glass shells), and
	---adornment / wireframe / image (handle adornments on their parts, through walls).
	local updateChams = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(esp, player, character, teamColor, now)
		local kind = flags.esp_chams_type or "highlight"

		-- No chams at all with type "None", and none on you while Self Chams is drawing you (the two
		-- stacked on top of each other). The ESP preview still shows your ESP chams.
		local selfCovered = player == localPlayer and not espViewState.view and flags.self_chams and flags.self_chams_material ~= "None"
		if kind == "None" or selfCovered then
			if esp.highlight.Enabled then
				esp.highlight.Enabled = false
			end
			if esp.chams.proxy then
				esp.chams:clear()
			end
			if esp.adorn then
				esp.adorn:clear()
			end
			return
		end
		-- Material "None": the plain highlight instead.
		if kind == "material" and flags.esp_chams_material == "None" then
			kind = "highlight"
		end

		local hiddenColor = flags.esp_chams_fill and flags.esp_chams_fill.Color or Color3.fromRGB(255, 40, 80)
		local visibleColor = flags.esp_chams_visible and flags.esp_chams_visible.Color or Color3.fromRGB(80, 255, 140)

		-- Team colors: bright team color when visible, a deeper shade of it behind walls.
		if teamColor then
			visibleColor = teamColor:Lerp(Color3.new(1, 1, 1), 0.25)
			hiddenColor = teamColor
		end

		local visible = flags.esp_chams_vischeck ~= false and isVisible(esp, character, now)
		local fillColor = visible and visibleColor or hiddenColor
		local fillTransparency = math.clamp(tonumber(flags.esp_chams_transparency) or 0.45, 0, 1)
		local edgeColor = flags.esp_chams_outline and flags.esp_chams_outline.Color or Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
		local edgeTransparency = flags.esp_chams_outline_enabled == false and 1 or (flags.esp_chams_outline_transparency or 0.12)
		local throughWalls = flags.esp_chams_depth ~= "Visible Only"

		-- Same extras as Self Chams: rainbow (each player a little out of step) and pulse.
		if flags.esp_chams_rainbow then
			fillColor = Color3.fromHSV((now * 0.25 + (player.UserId % 10) / 10) % 1, 0.75, 1)
		end
		if flags.esp_chams_pulse then
			fillTransparency = fillTransparency + (1 + fillTransparency * NEG_ONE) * (math.sin(now * 4) + 1) / 4
		end

		-- Preview: highlights and handle adornments don't draw inside a 3D viewport, so those types
		-- show as a flat tint over the body there (glass, water and material draw as they are).
		local previewTint = espViewState.view ~= nil and kind ~= "material" and kind ~= "glass" and kind ~= "water"
		if previewTint then
			esp.chams.hideSource = false
			esp.chams.glowEnabled = false
			esp.chams:update(character, fillColor, math.max(fillTransparency, 0.35), false, now, edgeColor, edgeTransparency, "Flat")
			return
		end

		-- Material: the Self Chams looks (Neon, Chrome, Galaxy, Lava...) as shells over the body.
		if kind == "material" then
			if esp.adorn then
				esp.adorn:clear()
			end
			if esp.highlight.Enabled then
				esp.highlight.Enabled = false
			end
			-- Their real body is hidden under the shells (on your screen only): with it showing through,
			-- every look came out as the same plain tint over their clothes.
			esp.chams.hideSource = true
			esp.chams.glowEnabled = flags.esp_chams_glow == true
			-- The flat through-walls fill only while they're behind something: drawn in plain view it
			-- covered the material and every look came out as the same flat ghost. And the shells are
			-- kept fairly solid (the transparency slider still lightens them) so the material reads.
			local inView = isVisible(esp, character, now)
			esp.chams:update(character, fillColor, fillTransparency * 0.4, throughWalls and not inView, now, edgeColor,
				edgeTransparency, flags.esp_chams_material or "Ropes")
			return
		end

		if kind == "highlight" then
			if esp.adorn then
				esp.adorn:clear()
			end
			if esp.chams.proxy then
				esp.chams:clear()
			end
			local highlight = esp.highlight
			-- A slow breathe on the fill and a sheen on the outline, 20 times a second (each player a
			-- little out of step), instead of a flat painted silhouette.
			if not esp.highlightAt or now - esp.highlightAt >= 1 / 20 then
				esp.highlightAt = now
				local breathe = (math.sin(now * 2.6 + (player.UserId % 7)) + 1) / 2
				esp.highlightBreathe = breathe
			end
			local breathe = esp.highlightBreathe or 0
			fillTransparency = math.clamp(fillTransparency + breathe * 0.15, 0, 1)
			edgeColor = edgeColor:Lerp(Color3.new(1, 1, 1), breathe * 0.45)
			edgeTransparency = math.clamp(edgeTransparency + NEG_ONE * breathe * 0.1, 0, 1)
			local key = fillColor:ToHex() .. edgeColor:ToHex() .. math.floor(fillTransparency * 50) .. math.floor(edgeTransparency * 50) .. tostring(throughWalls)
			if highlight.Adornee ~= character then
				highlight.Adornee = character
				esp.cleanKey = nil
			end
			if esp.cleanKey ~= key then
				esp.cleanKey = key
				highlight.FillColor = fillColor
				highlight.FillTransparency = fillTransparency
				highlight.OutlineColor = edgeColor
				highlight.OutlineTransparency = edgeTransparency
				highlight.DepthMode = throughWalls and Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop or Enum.HighlightDepthMode.Occluded
			end
			if not highlight.Enabled then
				highlight.Enabled = true
			end
			return
		end

		if esp.highlight.Enabled then
			esp.highlight.Enabled = false
		end

		-- Glass and water are see-through shells over the body.
		if kind == "glass" or kind == "water" then
			if esp.adorn then
				esp.adorn:clear()
			end
			esp.chams.hideSource = true
			esp.chams.glowEnabled = flags.esp_chams_glow ~= false
			esp.chams:update(character, fillColor, fillTransparency, throughWalls, now, edgeColor, edgeTransparency, kind == "water" and "Water" or "Glass")
			return
		end

		-- adornment, wireframe, image.
		if esp.chams.proxy then
			esp.chams:clear()
		end
		-- Store decal ids aren't images; they're looked up (once, in the background) to the
		-- image behind them. Nothing is drawn until that's known.
		local imageId = tostring(flags.esp_chams_image or ""):match("%d+") or "87906828750430"
		local image = resolvedImages[imageId]
		if not image then
			if kind == "image" and not AdornChams.resolving[imageId] then
				AdornChams.resolving[imageId] = true
				task.spawn(resolveImage, imageId)
			end
			image = kind == "image" and "" or "rbxassetid://" .. imageId
		end
		esp.adorn = esp.adorn or AdornChams.new()
		esp.adorn:update(character, kind, image, fillColor, fillTransparency, edgeColor, edgeTransparency, throughWalls)
	end)

	local skeletonRandom = Random.new()

	---World position at the top (or, with negative `along`, bottom) of a part, `inset` studs inward.
	local partEnd = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(part, along, inset)
		return (part.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, along * (part.Size.Y / 2 - (inset or 0)), 0)).Position
	end)

	---Joint positions and bone list for this rig ({ joints, bones }), or nil if pieces are missing.
	---@return table?
	local getSkeletonJoints = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(character, humanoid)
		local find = function(name)
			return character:FindFirstChild(name)
		end

		if humanoid.RigType == Enum.HumanoidRigType.R15 then
			local head, upperTorso, lowerTorso = find("Head"), find("UpperTorso"), find("LowerTorso")
			if not (head and upperTorso and lowerTorso) then
				return nil
			end

			local joints = {
				head = head.Position,
				neck = partEnd(upperTorso, 1, 0.1),
				pelvis = lowerTorso.Position,
			}

			for _, side in ipairs({ "Left", "Right" }) do
				local key = string.lower(side)
				local upperArm, lowerArm, hand = find(side .. "UpperArm"), find(side .. "LowerArm"), find(side .. "Hand")
				local upperLeg, lowerLeg, foot = find(side .. "UpperLeg"), find(side .. "LowerLeg"), find(side .. "Foot")

				if not (upperArm and lowerArm and hand and upperLeg and lowerLeg and foot) then
					return nil
				end

				joints[key .. "Shoulder"] = partEnd(upperArm, 1, 0.15)
				joints[key .. "Elbow"] = partEnd(lowerArm, 1, 0.05)
				joints[key .. "Hand"] = hand.Position
				joints[key .. "Hip"] = partEnd(upperLeg, 1, 0.1)
				joints[key .. "Knee"] = partEnd(lowerLeg, 1, 0.05)
				joints[key .. "Foot"] = foot.Position
			end

			return { joints = joints, bones = R15_SKELETON }
		end

		local head, torso = find("Head"), find("Torso")
		local leftArm, rightArm = find("Left Arm"), find("Right Arm")
		local leftLeg, rightLeg = find("Left Leg"), find("Right Leg")

		if not (head and torso and leftArm and rightArm and leftLeg and rightLeg) then
			return nil
		end

		local joints = {
			head = head.Position,
			neck = partEnd(torso, 1, 0.05),
			pelvis = partEnd(torso, -1, 0.05),
			leftShoulder = partEnd(leftArm, 1, 0.45),
			leftHand = partEnd(leftArm, -1, 0.15),
			rightShoulder = partEnd(rightArm, 1, 0.45),
			rightHand = partEnd(rightArm, -1, 0.15),
			leftHip = partEnd(leftLeg, 1, 0.1),
			leftFoot = partEnd(leftLeg, -1, 0.1),
			rightHip = partEnd(rightLeg, 1, 0.1),
			rightFoot = partEnd(rightLeg, -1, 0.1),
		}
		return { joints = joints, bones = R6_SKELETON }
	end)

	---Draw the skeleton with its color mode and effect.
	local drawSkeleton = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(esp, character, humanoid, teamColor, now)
		local drawn, jointCount = 0, 0
		local joints, bones

		if flags.esp_skeleton then
			local rig = getSkeletonJoints(character, humanoid)
			if type(rig) == "table" then
				joints, bones = rig.joints, rig.bones
			end
		end

		if joints then
			local mode = flags.esp_skeleton_color_mode or "Custom"
			local effect = flags.esp_skeleton_effect or "Glow"
			local thickness = flags.esp_skeleton_thickness or 2
			local baseColor = flags.esp_skeleton_color and flags.esp_skeleton_color.Color or Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
			local health = math.clamp(humanoid.Health / math.max(humanoid.MaxHealth, 1), 0, 1)

			-- "Custom" means your bone color, even with ESP team colors on.
			if teamColor and (mode == "Team" or (flags.esp_team_color and mode ~= "Custom")) then
				baseColor = teamColor
			end
			local effectColor = flags.esp_skeleton_effect_mode == "Custom" and flags.esp_skeleton_effect_color and flags.esp_skeleton_effect_color.Color or nil

			if mode == "Health" then
				baseColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 50, 50):Lerp(Color3.fromRGB(60, 255, 120), health)
			end

			-- Locked target: solid lock color, no rainbow or color-shifting effects.
			if esp.locked and teamColor then
				baseColor = teamColor
				mode = "Custom"
				effectColor = nil
				if effect == "Neon Flow" then
					effect = "Glow"
				end
			end

			-- Effect parameters shared by every bone this frame.
			local glowOn = effect ~= "None"
			local glowTransparency = 0.78
			local width = thickness

			if effect == "Pulse" then
				local wave = (math.sin(now * 5) + 1) / 2
				width = thickness + wave * 1.5
				glowTransparency = 0.6 + wave * 0.3
			elseif effect == "Electric" then
				glowTransparency = skeletonRandom:NextNumber(0.55, 0.9)
			end

			-- Project every joint once. Points behind the camera project mirrored onto the
			-- screen (the "ghost skeletons" at the bottom), so any joint behind us hides it.
			local screen = {}
			for name, position in pairs(joints) do
				local point = project(position)
				if espViewState.z <= 0.5 then
					screen = nil
					break
				end
				screen[name] = point
			end

			if not screen then
				bones = {}
				screen = {}
			end

			-- Bones are drawn in pixels, so at range a fixed width turns the skeleton into a
			-- blob. Thin everything out as the body gets smaller on screen, drop the glow and
			-- most of the outline when it's tiny, and skip it entirely when it can't be read.
			local outlineExtra, glowExtra = 2, 6
			local bodyHeight = (screen.head and screen.pelvis) and (screen.head - screen.pelvis).Magnitude or 0
			if bodyHeight > 0 then
				-- Thinned at range, but never below what you picked if that's already under 1 px.
				width = math.max(math.min(width, 1), width * math.clamp(bodyHeight / 45, 0.3, 1))
				if bodyHeight < 30 then
					glowOn = false
					outlineExtra = 1
				end
				if bodyHeight < 10 then
					bones = {}
				end
			end

			for index, bone in ipairs(bones) do
				local from, to = screen[bone[1]], screen[bone[2]]
				if not (from and to) then
					continue
				end

				if effect == "Electric" then
					-- Crackling: endpoints jitter a pixel or two every frame.
					from += Vector2.new(skeletonRandom:NextNumber(-1.5, 1.5), skeletonRandom:NextNumber(-1.5, 1.5))
					to += Vector2.new(skeletonRandom:NextNumber(-1.5, 1.5), skeletonRandom:NextNumber(-1.5, 1.5))
				end

				local color = baseColor
				if effect == "Neon Flow" and effectColor then
					-- Flows down the body between the bone color and the effect color.
					local wave = (math.sin(now * 3 + index / #bones * math.pi * 2) + 1) / 2
					color = baseColor:Lerp(effectColor, wave)
				elseif mode == "Rainbow" or effect == "Neon Flow" then
					-- Hue flows down the body from bone to bone.
					color = getRainbow(0.45, index / #bones)
				end
				local glowColor = effectColor or color

				drawn += 1

				local line = esp.skeleton[drawn]
				local lineWidth = math.max(1, math.floor(width + 0.5))
				setEspLine(esp, line, from, to, lineWidth)
				set(esp, line, "BackgroundColor3", effect == "Electric" and color:Lerp(effectColor or Color3.new(1, 1, 1), 0.35) or color)
				-- Thinner than a pixel: a 1 px line faded to match (0.5 px = half see-through).
				set(esp, line, "BackgroundTransparency", width < 1 and math.floor((1 - width) * 100) / 100 or 0)

				local outline = esp.skeletonOutline[drawn]
				if flags.esp_skeleton_outline ~= false then
					setEspLine(esp, outline, from, to, lineWidth + outlineExtra)
				else
					set(esp, outline, "Visible", false)
				end

				local glow = esp.skeletonGlow[drawn]
				if glowOn then
					setEspLine(esp, glow, from, to, lineWidth + glowExtra)
					set(esp, glow, "BackgroundColor3", glowColor)
					set(esp, glow, "BackgroundTransparency", math.floor(glowTransparency * 50) / 50)
				else
					set(esp, glow, "Visible", false)
				end
			end

			-- Joint dots at every point except the head (the head circle covers that).
			if flags.esp_skeleton_joints then
				local dotSize = math.max(3, math.floor(width + 3))

				for name, point in pairs(screen) do
					if name ~= "head" and jointCount < #esp.joints then
						jointCount += 1
						local dot = esp.joints[jointCount]
						set(esp, dot, "Position", UDim2.fromOffset(math.floor(point.X), math.floor(point.Y)))
						set(esp, dot, "Size", UDim2.fromOffset(dotSize, dotSize))
						set(esp, dot, "Rotation", 0)
						set(esp, dot, "BackgroundColor3", Color3.new(1, 1, 1))
						set(esp, dot, "Visible", true)
					end
				end
			end

			-- Head circle sized from the head's on-screen radius.
			local head = character:FindFirstChild("Head")
			local center = screen.head
			-- R6 head parts are 2 studs wide but the visible head is ~1.2, so size from the
			-- smallest side (the actual head height) instead of the width.
			local headRadius = head and math.min(head.Size.X, head.Size.Y, head.Size.Z) * 0.6 or 0.6
			local edge = head and center and project(head.Position + espCameraCFrame().UpVector * headRadius)
			local radius = edge and (edge - center).Magnitude or 0

			-- Far away the circle shrinks to a blob that covers the box, so it only draws
			-- once the head is big enough on screen to read as a circle.
			if flags.esp_skeleton_head ~= false and center and radius >= 4 then
				radius = math.floor(radius)
				local position = UDim2.fromOffset(math.floor(center.X), math.floor(center.Y))
				local lineWidth = math.max(1, math.floor(width + 0.5))

				-- Same color and width as the bones (including the Electric white tint).
				local headColor = (mode == "Rainbow" or effect == "Neon Flow") and getRainbow(0.45) or baseColor
				if effect == "Electric" then
					headColor = headColor:Lerp(Color3.new(1, 1, 1), 0.35)
				end

				set(esp, esp.headCircle, "Position", position)
				set(esp, esp.headCircle, "Size", UDim2.fromOffset(radius * 2, radius * 2))
				set(esp, esp.headCircle, "Rotation", 0)
				set(esp, esp.headCircle, "Visible", true)
				set(esp, esp.headStroke, "Color", headColor)
				set(esp, esp.headStroke, "Thickness", lineWidth)

				-- Outline ring sits 1px inside and 1px outside the colored ring, like the bones.
				local showOutline = flags.esp_skeleton_outline ~= false
				set(esp, esp.headOutline, "Visible", showOutline)
				if showOutline then
					set(esp, esp.headOutline, "Position", position)
					set(esp, esp.headOutline, "Size", UDim2.fromOffset(radius * 2 - 2, radius * 2 - 2))
					set(esp, esp.headOutline, "Rotation", 0)
					set(esp, esp.headOutlineStroke, "Thickness", lineWidth + outlineExtra)
				end
			else
				set(esp, esp.headCircle, "Visible", false)
				set(esp, esp.headOutline, "Visible", false)
			end
		else
			set(esp, esp.headCircle, "Visible", false)
			set(esp, esp.headOutline, "Visible", false)
		end

		-- Hide pooled pieces this frame didn't use.
		for index = drawn + 1, esp.skeletonShown or 0 do
			for _, pool in ipairs({ esp.skeleton, esp.skeletonOutline, esp.skeletonGlow }) do
				pool[index].Visible = false
				esp.cache[pool[index]] = nil
			end
		end
		esp.skeletonShown = drawn

		for index = jointCount + 1, esp.jointsShown or 0 do
			esp.joints[index].Visible = false
			esp.cache[esp.joints[index]] = nil
		end
		esp.jointsShown = jointCount
	end)

	---Update one player's ESP for this frame.
	---@param player Player
	---@param esp table
	---@param now number
	---Just the AQUA LAB USER tag above an Aqua user the ESP isn't drawing.
	local drawAquaOnly = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(player, esp)
		local label = esp.aquaOnly
		local character = player.Character
		local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		local show = flags.esp_aqua_user ~= false and root ~= nil
			and character:IsDescendantOf(workspace) and isAquaLabsUser(player)
		local point
		if show then
			point = project(root.Position + Vector3.new(0, 3.6, 0))
			show = projectOnScreen
		end
		if not show then
			if label.Visible then
				label.Visible = false
			end
			return
		end
		local textSize = flags.esp_text_size or 12
		label.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(math.floor(point.X), math.floor(point.Y))
		local developer = Hooks.isDeveloper(player)
		label.Text = developer and "AQUA LAB DEVELOPER" or "AQUA LAB USER"
		label.TextColor3 = developer and Color3.fromRGB(255, 90, 90) or Color3.fromRGB(100, 255, 200)
		label.TextStrokeTransparency = flags.esp_text_outline ~= false and 0 or 1
		label.TextSize = textSize + 1
		label.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, textSize + 2)
		label.FontFace = FONT_FACES[flags.esp_font] or library.font
		label.Visible = true
	end)

	-- Chams errors already printed (each kind once).
	local reportedChamsErrors = {}

	local updateEsp = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(player, esp, now)
		local character, rootPart, humanoid, distance
		local view = espViewState.view
		local target = view and view.target or getEspTarget(player)
		if target then
			character, rootPart, humanoid, distance = target.character, target.rootPart, target.humanoid, target.distance
		end

		if not (flags.esp_enabled and character) then
			hideEsp(esp)
			return drawAquaOnly(player, esp)
		end
		-- Drawn normally: the full ESP carries the tag.
		if esp.aquaOnly.Visible then
			esp.aquaOnly.Visible = false
		end

		-- Chams don't care whether the player is on screen.
		local teamColor = flags.esp_team_color and player.Team and player.TeamColor.Color or nil
		local whitelisted = isGloballyWhitelisted(player)
		if whitelisted then
			teamColor = Color3.fromRGB(40, 255, 90)
		end

		-- The player you're locked onto (Aim Helper, Aim Lock, Ragebot, Triggerbot) takes the
		-- lock color on everything: box, skeleton, text, tracer and chams.
		local locked = Hooks.lockedCharacter ~= nil and Hooks.lockedCharacter == character
		-- Target ESP: your current target gets its own color (optionally pulsing), a glow and a tag.
		if locked and not whitelisted then
			teamColor = flags.esp_target_color and flags.esp_target_color.Color or Color3.fromRGB(200, 20, 20)
			if flags.esp_target_pulse then
				teamColor = teamColor:Lerp(Color3.new(1, 1, 1), math.floor((math.sin(now * 6) + 1) * 15) / 100)
			end
		end
		esp.locked = locked

		local chamsOn = flags.esp_chams == true

		if chamsOn ~= esp.chamsShown then
			esp.chamsShown = chamsOn

			if not chamsOn then
				esp.highlight.Enabled = false
				esp.chams:clear()
				esp.adorn:clear()
			end
		end

		-- Chams run on their own: an error in them used to fail this whole update, which hid the
		-- player's entire ESP (box, name, health). Now only the chams switch off, and the first
		-- error of each kind is printed so it can be found.
		if chamsOn then
			local ok, problem = pcall(updateChams, esp, player, character, teamColor, now)
			if not ok then
				local message = tostring(problem)
				if not reportedChamsErrors[message] then
					reportedChamsErrors[message] = true
					warn("[Aqua] chams:", message, "| type", flags.esp_chams_type)
				end
				esp.highlight.Enabled = false
				pcall(esp.chams.clear, esp.chams)
				pcall(esp.adorn.clear, esp.adorn)
			end
		end

		local rootPosition = rootPart.Position
		project(rootPosition)

		if not projectOnScreen then
			return hideEsp(esp, true)
		end

		esp.hidden = false

		-- Box: the visuals library's solve (two points along the body, so it never jitters), or
		-- (Dynamic) the character's real bounding box.
		local minimum, size

		if flags.esp_bounding == "Dynamic" then
			local boundsCFrame, boundsSize = character:GetBoundingBox()
			local maximum = Vector2.new(-math.huge, -math.huge)
			minimum = Vector2.new(math.huge, math.huge)
			for x = -1, 1, 2 do
				for y = -1, 1, 2 do
					for z = -1, 1, 2 do
						local point = project((boundsCFrame * CFrame.new(boundsSize * Vector3.new(x, y, z) / 2)).Position)
						minimum = minimum:Min(point)
						maximum = maximum:Max(point)
					end
				end
			end
			size = maximum - minimum
		else
			local cameraUp = espCameraCFrame().UpVector
			local bodyUp = rootPart.CFrame.UpVector
			-- One operation per line: MoonVeil miscompiles `a - b * c` (it broke the ESP box).
			local headOffset = bodyUp * 1.8
			local feetOffset = bodyUp * 2.5
			local top = project(rootPosition + headOffset + cameraUp)
			local feet = rootPosition - feetOffset
			local bottom = project(feet - cameraUp)
			local spanX = top.X - bottom.X
			local spanY = bottom.Y - top.Y
			local width = math.max(math.abs(spanX), 3)
			local halfOfWidth = width / 2
			local height = math.max(math.abs(spanY), halfOfWidth, 3)
			local heightWidth = height / 1.5
			local boxWidth = math.max(heightWidth, width) * (flags.esp_width_scale or 1)
			local centerX = (top.X + bottom.X) / 2
			local halfBox = boxWidth / 2
			local left = centerX - halfBox
			minimum = Vector2.new(left, math.min(top.Y, bottom.Y))
			size = Vector2.new(boxWidth, height)
		end

		minimum = Vector2.new(math.floor(minimum.X), math.floor(minimum.Y))
		size = Vector2.new(math.max(math.floor(size.X), 3), math.max(math.floor(size.Y), 3))

		local boxColor = teamColor or (flags.esp_box_color and flags.esp_box_color.Color or Color3.new(1, 1, 1))
		local boxSecond = teamColor and teamColor:Lerp(Color3.new(1, 1, 1), 0.55)
			or (flags.esp_box_color_end and flags.esp_box_color_end.Color or Color3.fromRGB(120, 80, 255))
		local thickness = flags.esp_box_thickness or 1
		local outline = flags.esp_box_outline ~= false and (flags.esp_box_outline_thickness or 1) or 0
		local style = flags.esp_box_style or "Full"
		local showBox = flags.esp_box == true

		set(esp, esp.container, "Visible", true)
		set(esp, esp.container, "Position", UDim2.fromOffset(minimum.X, minimum.Y))
		set(esp, esp.container, "Size", UDim2.fromOffset(size.X, size.Y))
		set(esp, esp.boxHolder, "Rotation", flags.esp_box_spin and math.floor((now * (flags.esp_box_spin_speed or 0.3) * 360) % 360) or 0)

		drawBox(esp, player, size, boxColor, boxSecond, thickness, outline, style, showBox, now)

		-- 3D box: a fixed body-sized box that only turns with the player's facing,
		-- so tools, hats and ragdoll tilt don't warp it.
		if showBox and style == "3D" then
			esp.box3dShown = true
			local _, yaw = rootPart.CFrame:ToOrientation()
			local boxCFrame = CFrame.new(rootPosition + BODY_BOX_OFFSET) * CFrame.Angles(0, yaw, 0)
			local corners3d = table.create(8)

			for x = -1, 1, 2 do
				for y = -1, 1, 2 do
					for z = -1, 1, 2 do
						table.insert(corners3d, (project((boxCFrame * CFrame.new(BODY_BOX_SIZE * Vector3.new(x, y, z) / 2)).Position)))
					end
				end
			end

			for index, edge in ipairs(BOX_EDGES) do
				local line = esp.box3d[index]
				setEspLine(esp, line, corners3d[edge[1]], corners3d[edge[2]], thickness)
				set(esp, line, "BackgroundColor3", boxColor)
			end
		elseif esp.box3dShown then
			esp.box3dShown = false
			for _, line in ipairs(esp.box3d) do
				line.Visible = false
				esp.cache[line] = nil
			end
		end

		-- Tracers from the chosen origin to the chosen body point.
		if flags.esp_tracers then
			local screen = view and view.size or espGui.AbsoluteSize
			local origin = flags.esp_tracer_origin or "Bottom"
			local from

			if view then
				-- Preview: you're always in the middle of the panel, so a tracer from the panel's own
				-- edge ran straight up your body. Coming in from off to the side, it reads like a real one.
				local side = screen.X * 0.12
				from = origin == "Top" and Vector2.new(side, 0)
					or origin == "Middle" and Vector2.new(side, screen.Y / 2)
					or origin == "Mouse" and Vector2.new(screen.X + NEG_ONE * side, screen.Y * 0.8)
					or Vector2.new(side, screen.Y)
			elseif origin == "Middle" then
				from = screen / 2
			elseif origin == "Top" then
				from = Vector2.new(screen.X / 2, 0)
			elseif origin == "Mouse" then
				from = userInputService:GetMouseLocation()
			elseif origin == "From Me" and not view then
				local myRoot = localPlayer.Character and localPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
				from = myRoot and project(myRoot.Position - Vector3.new(0, 2.5, 0)) or Vector2.new(screen.X / 2, screen.Y)
			else
				from = Vector2.new(screen.X / 2, screen.Y)
			end

			local targetName = flags.esp_tracer_target or "Feet"
			local targetPosition = targetName == "Head" and rootPosition + Vector3.new(0, 1.5, 0)
				or targetName == "Torso" and rootPosition
				or rootPosition - Vector3.new(0, 3, 0)
			local to = project(targetPosition)
			local tracerThickness = flags.esp_tracer_thickness or 1

			local tracerColor = teamColor or (flags.esp_tracer_color and flags.esp_tracer_color.Color or Color3.new(1, 1, 1))
			if esp.tracerDrawn then
				local tracer, tracerOutline = esp.tracer, esp.tracerOutline
				tracer.From, tracer.To = from, to
				set(esp, tracer, "Thickness", tracerThickness)
				set(esp, tracer, "Color", tracerColor)
				set(esp, tracer, "Visible", true)
				local outlined = flags.esp_tracer_outline == true
				if outlined then
					tracerOutline.From, tracerOutline.To = from, to
					set(esp, tracerOutline, "Thickness", tracerThickness + 2)
				end
				set(esp, tracerOutline, "Visible", outlined)
			else
				setEspLine(esp, esp.tracer, from, to, tracerThickness)
				set(esp, esp.tracer, "BackgroundColor3", tracerColor)
				if flags.esp_tracer_outline then
					setEspLine(esp, esp.tracerOutline, from, to, tracerThickness + 2)
				else
					set(esp, esp.tracerOutline, "Visible", false)
				end
			end
		else
			set(esp, esp.tracer, "Visible", false)
			set(esp, esp.tracerOutline, "Visible", false)
		end

		drawFill(esp, player, teamColor, now)

		-- Custom image inside the box.
		local showImage = flags.esp_image == true and espImage ~= ""
		set(esp, esp.image, "Visible", showImage)
		if showImage then
			set(esp, esp.image, "Image", espImage)
			set(esp, esp.image, "ImageTransparency", flags.esp_image_transparency or 0.3)
		end

		-- The bar spans the box's full drawn height (its black outline sits outside the box).
		local font = FONT_FACES[flags.esp_font] or library.font
		local textSize = flags.esp_text_size or 12
		local textStroke = flags.esp_text_outline ~= false and 0 or 1
		drawHealth(esp, humanoid, size, showBox and outline or 0, now, font, textSize, textStroke)

		-- Text labels and tags: refreshed about 7 times a second (or right away when the player's
		-- color changes). They sit on the box by scale, so they follow it every frame regardless.
		if now - (esp.textAt or 0) >= 0.15 or esp.textColor ~= teamColor then
		esp.textAt, esp.textColor = now, teamColor
		-- Text stacks out from the box: upward from its top edge, downward from its bottom edge. Name,
		-- weapon and distance each go on the side picked for them (drag them on the ESP preview);
		-- the tags always sit on top.
		local topY, bottomY = -3, 3
		-- A health bar lying along the top or bottom edge pushes that side's text out past it.
		if flags.esp_healthbar then
			local barSpace = (flags.esp_health_width or 2) + 2 + 2 + outline + (flags.esp_health_text and textSize + 2 or 0)
			if flags.esp_health_side == "Top" then
				topY += NEG_ONE * barSpace
			elseif flags.esp_health_side == "Bottom" then
				bottomY += barSpace
			end
		end
		local function stack(label, height, onTop)
			if onTop then
				set(esp, label, "AnchorPoint", Vector2.new(0.5, 1))
				set(esp, label, "Position", UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, topY))
				topY -= height + 1
			else
				set(esp, label, "AnchorPoint", Vector2.new(0.5, 0))
				set(esp, label, "Position", UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 1, bottomY))
				bottomY += height + 1
			end
		end

		local showName = flags.esp_name == true
		set(esp, esp.name, "Visible", showName)
		if showName then
			stack(esp.name, textSize + 1, flags.esp_name_side ~= "Bottom")
			local nameType = flags.esp_name_type
			set(esp, esp.name, "Text", nameType == "Username" and player.Name
				or nameType == "Both" and string.format("%s (@%s)", player.DisplayName, player.Name)
				or player.DisplayName)
			set(esp, esp.name, "TextColor3", Hooks.textFx.tint("esp_name", teamColor or (flags.esp_name_color and flags.esp_name_color.Color or Color3.new(1, 1, 1))))
			set(esp, esp.name, "FontFace", font)
			set(esp, esp.name, "TextSize", textSize)
			set(esp, esp.name, "TextStrokeTransparency", textStroke)
			set(esp, esp.name, "Size", UDim2.fromOffset(0, textSize + 1))
		end

		-- Hostile / Trespassing / Whitelisted / Aqua User tags above the box.
		-- Team drives the label: Criminals always show HOSTILE; Trespassing only while still Inmates.
		-- Each tag keeps its own color on one line.
		local statusParts = {}
		local teamName = player.Team and player.Team.Name
		local function tag(label, color)
			table.insert(statusParts, string.format('<font color="#%s">%s</font>', color:ToHex(), label))
		end
		if esp.locked and flags.esp_target_tag ~= false then
			tag("TARGET", flags.esp_target_color and flags.esp_target_color.Color or Color3.fromRGB(200, 20, 20))
		end
		if isGloballyWhitelisted(player) then
			tag("WHITELISTED", Color3.fromRGB(40, 255, 90))
		end
		if teamName == "Criminals" then
			if flags.esp_show_hostile ~= false then
				tag("HOSTILE", Color3.fromRGB(255, 40, 55))
			end
		elseif teamName == "Inmates" then
			if flags.esp_show_hostile ~= false and character:GetAttribute("Hostile") == true then
				tag("HOSTILE", Color3.fromRGB(255, 40, 55))
			end
			if flags.esp_show_trespassing ~= false and character:GetAttribute("Trespassing") == true then
				tag("TRESPASSING", Color3.fromRGB(255, 210, 40))
			end
		end
		if Hooks.isPrioritized and Hooks.isPrioritized(player) then
			tag("PRIORITIZED", Color3.fromRGB(255, 70, 70))
		end
		-- Armor (riot gear and the like) pushes health over the normal 100.
		if flags.esp_show_armored ~= false and humanoid.Health > 100 then
			tag("ARMORED", Color3.fromRGB(90, 190, 255))
		end

		local showWeapon = flags.esp_weapon == true
		set(esp, esp.weapon, "Visible", showWeapon)
		if showWeapon then
			local tool = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")
			set(esp, esp.weapon, "Text", tool and tool.Name or "none")
			set(esp, esp.weapon, "TextColor3", Hooks.textFx.tint("esp_name", teamColor and teamColor:Lerp(Color3.new(1, 1, 1), 0.45) or (flags.esp_weapon_color and flags.esp_weapon_color.Color or Color3.new(1, 1, 1))))
			stack(esp.weapon, textSize, flags.esp_weapon_side == "Top")
			set(esp, esp.weapon, "FontFace", font)
			set(esp, esp.weapon, "TextSize", textSize)
			set(esp, esp.weapon, "TextStrokeTransparency", textStroke)
			set(esp, esp.weapon, "Size", UDim2.fromOffset(0, textSize + 1))
		end

		local showDistance = flags.esp_distance == true
		set(esp, esp.distance, "Visible", showDistance)
		if showDistance then
			set(esp, esp.distance, "Text", string.format("%dm", math.floor(distance / 3.571)))
			set(esp, esp.distance, "TextColor3", Hooks.textFx.tint("esp_name", teamColor and teamColor:Lerp(Color3.new(1, 1, 1), 0.45) or (flags.esp_distance_color and flags.esp_distance_color.Color or Color3.new(1, 1, 1))))
			stack(esp.distance, textSize, flags.esp_distance_side == "Top")
			set(esp, esp.distance, "FontFace", font)
			set(esp, esp.distance, "TextSize", textSize)
			set(esp, esp.distance, "TextStrokeTransparency", textStroke)
			set(esp, esp.distance, "Size", UDim2.fromOffset(0, textSize + 1))
		end

		-- Team line: which team they're on, in that team's color (or the picked color).
		local showTeam = flags.esp_team == true and esp.team ~= nil
		if esp.team then
			set(esp, esp.team, "Visible", showTeam)
		end
		if showTeam then
			local team = player.Team
			local color = flags.esp_team_use_color ~= false and team and team.TeamColor.Color
				or (flags.esp_team_color and flags.esp_team_color.Color or Color3.new(1, 1, 1))
			set(esp, esp.team, "Text", team and team.Name or "No Team")
			set(esp, esp.team, "TextColor3", Hooks.textFx.tint("esp_name", color))
			stack(esp.team, textSize, flags.esp_team_side == "Top")
			set(esp, esp.team, "FontFace", font)
			set(esp, esp.team, "TextSize", textSize)
			set(esp, esp.team, "TextStrokeTransparency", textStroke)
			set(esp, esp.team, "Size", UDim2.fromOffset(0, textSize + 1))
		end

		local showStatus = #statusParts > 0
		set(esp, esp.status, "Visible", showStatus)
		if showStatus then
			set(esp, esp.status, "Text", Hooks.textFx.tintText("esp_tags", table.concat(statusParts, '<font color="#8c8c8c"> · </font>')))
			set(esp, esp.status, "TextColor3", Color3.new(1, 1, 1))
			set(esp, esp.status, "TextStrokeTransparency", textStroke)
			set(esp, esp.status, "TextSize", textSize + 1)
			set(esp, esp.status, "Size", UDim2.fromOffset(0, textSize + 2))
			stack(esp.status, textSize + 2, true)
			set(esp, esp.status, "FontFace", font)
		end

		-- AQUA LAB USER sits on its own line above every other tag, so nothing overlaps.
		local showAqua = flags.esp_aqua_user ~= false and isAquaLabsUser(player)
		set(esp, esp.aquaTag, "Visible", showAqua)
		if showAqua then
			local developer = Hooks.isDeveloper(player)
			set(esp, esp.aquaTag, "Text", developer and "AQUA LAB DEVELOPER" or "AQUA LAB USER")
			set(esp, esp.aquaTag, "TextColor3", developer and Color3.fromRGB(255, 90, 90)
				or Hooks.textFx.tint("esp_tags", Color3.fromRGB(100, 255, 200)))
			set(esp, esp.aquaTag, "TextStrokeTransparency", textStroke)
			set(esp, esp.aquaTag, "TextSize", textSize + 1)
			set(esp, esp.aquaTag, "Size", UDim2.fromOffset(0, textSize + 2))
			stack(esp.aquaTag, textSize + 2, true)
			set(esp, esp.aquaTag, "FontFace", font)
		end

		-- Player flags beside the box on the picked side (past the health bar when it's there too).
		local showFlags = flags.esp_flags ~= false
		set(esp, esp.flags, "Visible", showFlags)
		if showFlags then
			local flagsLeft = flags.esp_flags_side == "Left"
			local barSide = flags.esp_health_side or "Left"
			local sharesBar = flags.esp_healthbar and barSide == (flagsLeft and "Left" or "Right")
			local gap = 4 + (sharesBar and ((flags.esp_health_width or 2) + 2 + 3) or 0)
			-- Far away the box gets shorter than the flags, so they hang down into the text under the
			-- box (weapon, distance). Only text the flags actually reach pushes them out, and only
			-- just past it; otherwise they sit right beside the box.
			local flagsTop = esp.flags.AbsolutePosition.Y
			local flagsBottom = flagsTop + esp.flags.TextBounds.Y
			local widest = 0
			for _, label in ipairs({ esp.name, esp.weapon, esp.distance, esp.team, esp.status, esp.aquaTag }) do
				local top = label.AbsolutePosition.Y
				if label.Visible and top < flagsBottom and top + label.AbsoluteSize.Y > flagsTop then
					widest = math.max(widest, label.TextBounds.X)
				end
			end
			gap += math.max(0, widest / 2 + NEG_ONE * size.X / 2 + 2)
			-- Flags cost several raycasts and an animation scan per player, so they're worked out
			-- 10 times a second (still instant to the eye) instead of every frame.
			if not esp.flagsText or not esp.flagsAt or now - esp.flagsAt >= 0.1 then
				esp.flagsAt = now
				esp.flagsText = Hooks.espFlags(player, character, humanoid, rootPart, now)
			end
			set(esp, esp.flags, "Text", Hooks.textFx.tintText("esp_flags", esp.flagsText))
			set(esp, esp.flags, "AnchorPoint", flagsLeft and Vector2.new(1, 0) or Vector2.new(0, 0))
			set(esp, esp.flags, "Position", flagsLeft and UDim2.new(0, NEG_ONE * gap, 0, 0) or UDim2.new(1, gap, 0, 0))
			set(esp, esp.flags, "TextXAlignment", flagsLeft and Enum.TextXAlignment.Right or Enum.TextXAlignment.Left)
			set(esp, esp.flags, "FontFace", font)
			set(esp, esp.flags, "TextSize", math.max(textSize - 1, 8))
			set(esp, esp.flags, "TextStrokeTransparency", textStroke)
		end

		end

		drawSkeleton(esp, character, humanoid, teamColor, now)
	end)

	-- Hide names: hides the game's own name tags above everyone's heads (only on your
	-- screen) so the ESP reads cleaner. Original settings come back when it's turned off.
	do
		local savedDistance = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
		local savedTags = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })

		local function hideNames(character)
			local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
			if humanoid and humanoid.DisplayDistanceType ~= Enum.HumanoidDisplayDistanceType.None then
				savedDistance[humanoid] = savedDistance[humanoid] or humanoid.DisplayDistanceType
				humanoid.DisplayDistanceType = Enum.HumanoidDisplayDistanceType.None
			end
			-- Some games draw their own name tag as a BillboardGui on the head.
			for _, gui in ipairs(character:GetDescendants()) do
				if gui:IsA("BillboardGui") and gui.Enabled then
					savedTags[gui] = true
					gui.Enabled = false
				end
			end
		end

		local function restoreNames()
			for humanoid, distance in pairs(savedDistance) do
				pcall(function()
					humanoid.DisplayDistanceType = distance
				end)
			end
			for gui in pairs(savedTags) do
				pcall(function()
					gui.Enabled = true
				end)
			end
			table.clear(savedDistance)
			table.clear(savedTags)
		end

		playerSection:toggle({
			name = "hide names",
			flag = "esp_hide_names",
			default = false,
			callback = function(state)
				if not state then
					restoreNames()
				end
			end,
		})

		-- Re-checks twice a second so respawns and new players get hidden too.
		local nextScan = 0
		library:connection(runService.Heartbeat, function()
			if not flags.esp_hide_names or os.clock() < nextScan then
				return
			end
			nextScan = os.clock() + 0.5
			for _, player in ipairs(playersService:GetPlayers()) do
				if player ~= localPlayer and player.Character then
					hideNames(player.Character)
				end
			end
		end)
		onUnload(restoreNames)
	end

	Hooks.espFlagParams = RaycastParams.new()
	Hooks.espFlagParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
	Hooks.espSightParams = RaycastParams.new()
	Hooks.espSightParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude

	---Whether the camera has a clear line to any of the head, torso or root.
	function Hooks.espCanSee(character, root)
		local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
		local origin = camera.CFrame.Position
		Hooks.espSightParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = { camera, character, localPlayer.Character }
		for _, name in ipairs({ "Head", "Torso", "UpperTorso" }) do
			local part = character:FindFirstChild(name)
			if part and not workspace:Raycast(origin, part.Position - origin, Hooks.espSightParams) then
				return true
			end
		end
		return not workspace:Raycast(origin, root.Position - origin, Hooks.espSightParams)
	end

	---Player flags for the ESP, one per line, each in its own color.
	function Hooks.espFlags(player, character, humanoid, root, now)
		local lines = {}
		local function add(text, r, g, b)
			table.insert(lines, string.format('<font color="#%s">%s</font>', Color3.fromRGB(r, g, b):ToHex(), text))
		end

		if flags.esp_flags_visible ~= false then
			if Hooks.espCanSee(character, root) then
				add("VISIBLE", 90, 255, 130)
			else
				add("NOT VISIBLE", 150, 150, 150)
			end
		end

		if character:FindFirstChildOfClass("ForceField") then
			add("FORCEFIELD", 90, 200, 255)
		end
		if Hooks.lastShotBy and now - (Hooks.lastShotBy[player] or 0) < 0.4 then
			add("SHOOTING", 255, 80, 80)
		end
		local animator = humanoid:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator")
		for _, track in ipairs(animator and animator:GetPlayingAnimationTracks() or {}) do
			local name = string.lower(track.Name .. (track.Animation and track.Animation.Name or ""))
			if string.find(name, "reload", 1, true) then
				add("RELOADING", 255, 200, 60)
				break
			end
		end
		if character:GetAttribute("Tased") == true then
			add("TASED", 255, 230, 90)
		end
		if character:GetAttribute("Arrested") == true then
			add("CUFFED", 120, 170, 255)
		end

		-- Movement: seated, climbing, airborne (jumping, falling), crouching, walking.
		local velocity = root.AssemblyLinearVelocity
		local seat = humanoid.SeatPart
		if seat then
			add(seat:IsA("VehicleSeat") and "DRIVING" or "SITTING", 200, 200, 200)
		elseif humanoid:GetState() == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Climbing then
			add("CLIMBING", 255, 170, 80)
		else
			local params = Hooks.espFlagParams
			-- Your own body is skipped too, for the ESP preview's copy of you standing in it.
			params.FilterDescendantsInstances = { character, localPlayer.Character }
			local legs = humanoid.RigType == Enum.HumanoidRigType.R6 and 2 or math.max(humanoid.HipHeight, 1)
			local grounded = workspace:Raycast(root.Position, Vector3.new(0, -(root.Size.Y / 2 + legs + 1.5), 0), params) ~= nil
			-- Other players' humanoid state rarely reaches us, so climbing is also spotted as off the
			-- ground, hugging an upright surface (ladder, truss, wall) right in front of them.
			-- Climbing is slow and steady with almost no sideways movement, and has to last a moment,
			-- so a jump into a wall (fast up, then fast down) doesn't count.
			local facing = Vector3.new(root.CFrame.LookVector.X, 0, root.CFrame.LookVector.Z)
			local wall = not grounded and facing.Magnitude > 0.01
				and workspace:Raycast(root.Position, facing.Unit * (root.Size.Z / 2 + 2), params)
			local sideways = Vector3.new(velocity.X, 0, velocity.Z).Magnitude
			local climbingNow = wall and math.abs(wall.Normal.Y) < 0.3 and math.abs(velocity.Y) < 14 and sideways < 4
			-- Hovering in the air (fly hacks) also has to last, so the top of a jump doesn't count.
			local hoveringNow = not grounded and not climbingNow and math.abs(velocity.Y) < 3
			Hooks.climbSince = Hooks.climbSince or setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
			Hooks.hoverSince = Hooks.hoverSince or setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
			Hooks.climbSince[player] = climbingNow and (Hooks.climbSince[player] or now) or nil
			Hooks.hoverSince[player] = hoveringNow and (Hooks.hoverSince[player] or now) or nil
			if climbingNow and now - Hooks.climbSince[player] >= 0.2 then
				add("CLIMBING", 255, 170, 80)
			elseif hoveringNow and now - Hooks.hoverSince[player] >= 0.6 then
				add("IN AIR", 200, 120, 255)
			elseif not grounded then
				if velocity.Y > 0 then
					add("JUMPING", 200, 200, 200)
				else
					add("FALLING", 200, 200, 200)
				end
			else
				-- Crouched bodies carry the head much lower over the root than standing ones.
				local head = character:FindFirstChild("Head")
				if head and head.Position.Y - root.Position.Y < 0.9 then
					add("CROUCHING", 200, 200, 200)
				end
				local speed = Vector3.new(velocity.X, 0, velocity.Z).Magnitude
				if speed > 18 then
					add("RUNNING", 200, 200, 200)
				elseif speed > 1 then
					add("WALKING", 200, 200, 200)
				else
					add("IDLE", 150, 150, 150)
				end
			end
		end
		return table.concat(lines, "\n")
	end

	chamsSection:toggle({ name = "visibility colors", flag = "esp_chams_vischeck", default = true })
	-- highlight: their real body in one color. adornment: a see-through box per body part.
	-- wireframe: a light tint with low-poly wire lines. glass: glass body. water: rippling blue
	-- water body. image: your picture on every body part. material: any Self Chams look.
	chamsSection:dropdown({
		name = "chams type",
		flag = "esp_chams_type",
		items = { "None", "adornment", "highlight", "material", "wireframe", "glass", "water", "image" },
		default = "highlight",
	})
	-- Self Chams' options, for other players (the material is used by the "material" type).
	-- Configs set the material too; that shouldn't count as picking one (see the callback below).
	do
		local loadConfig = library.load_config
		library.load_config = function(...)
			Hooks.loadingConfig = true
			local results = table.pack(pcall(loadConfig, ...))
			Hooks.loadingConfig = false
			if not results[1] then
				error(results[2], 0)
			end
			return table.unpack(results, 2, results.n)
		end
	end

	---Turn a flag on through its setter, so the menu shows it.
	local function enableFlag(flag)
		if flags[flag] == true then
			return
		end
		local setter = library.config_flags[flag]
		if setter then
			setter(true)
		else
			flags[flag] = true
		end
	end

	-- Materials only draw with the "material" chams type, so picking one used to do nothing on the
	-- default highlight type. Picking a material now switches to it and turns the chams on.
	chamsSection:dropdown({ name = "chams material", flag = "esp_chams_material", items = Chams.LOOK_CHOICES, default = "Ropes", callback = function(choice)
		if not featureNotificationsReady or Hooks.loadingConfig or choice == "None" then
			return
		end
		task.defer(function()
			if flags.esp_chams_type ~= "material" and library.config_flags.esp_chams_type then
				library.config_flags.esp_chams_type("material")
			end
			enableFlag("esp_chams")
			enableFlag("esp_enabled")
		end)
	end })
	chamsSection:toggle({ name = "rainbow", flag = "esp_chams_rainbow", default = false })
	chamsSection:toggle({ name = "pulse", flag = "esp_chams_pulse", default = false })
	chamsSection:toggle({ name = "glow layer", flag = "esp_chams_glow", default = true })
	chamsSection:slider({ name = "transparency", flag = "esp_chams_transparency", min = 0, max = 1, default = 0.45, interval = 0.01 })
	chamsSection:toggle({ name = "outline", flag = "esp_chams_outline_enabled", default = true })
	chamsSection:colorpicker({ flag = "esp_chams_outline", color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255) })
	chamsSection:slider({ name = "outline transparency", flag = "esp_chams_outline_transparency", min = 0, max = 1, default = 0.12, interval = 0.01 })
	chamsSection:dropdown({ name = "chams mode", flag = "esp_chams_depth", items = { "Through Walls", "Visible Only" }, default = "Through Walls" })
	-- For the image type: a Roblox image id (an image, not a decal page id).
	chamsSection:textbox({ placeholder = "chams image id", flag = "esp_chams_image" })

	-- Enemy material: recolor other players' bodies, restored on disable.
	local appearanceSection = espTab:section({ name = "Enemy Material", side = "right" })

	addFeature(appearanceSection, { name = "Enemy Material", flag = "esp_override" })
	appearanceSection:dropdown({

	})
	appearanceSection:toggle({ name = "color", flag = "esp_override_use_color", default = true })
	appearanceSection:dropdown({
		name = "color mode",
		flag = "esp_override_color_mode",
		items = { "Custom", "Team Colors", "Rainbow" },
		default = "Custom",
	})
	appearanceSection:colorpicker({ flag = "esp_override_color", color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 40, 40) })
	appearanceSection:slider({ name = "transparency", flag = "esp_override_transparency", min = 0, max = 1, default = 0, interval = 0.01 })

	-- Box image.
	local imageSection = espTab:section({ name = "Box Image", side = "right" })

	imageSection:toggle({ name = "image fill", flag = "esp_image", default = false })
	imageSection:textbox({
		placeholder = "Decal / image id",
		flag = "esp_image_id",
		callback = function(input)
			task.spawn(function()
				espImage = resolveImage(input)
				-- The ESP preview shows the same image.
				Hooks.espImage = espImage
			end)
		end,
	})
	imageSection:slider({ name = "image transparency", flag = "esp_image_transparency", min = 0, max = 1, default = 0.3, interval = 0.01 })

	-- Filters and look.
	local customSection = espTab:section({ name = "Filters", side = "right" })

	customSection:dropdown({
		name = "update rate",
		flag = "esp_update_rate",
		items = { "Every frame", "144 Hz", "120 Hz", "60 Hz", "30 Hz" },
		default = "Every frame",
	})
	customSection:toggle({ name = "team check", flag = "esp_team_check", default = true })
	customSection:toggle({ name = "friend check", flag = "esp_friend_check", default = true })
	customSection:toggle({ name = "team colors on everything", flag = "esp_team_color", default = true })
	customSection:dropdown({ name = "whitelist teams", flag = "esp_team_whitelist", items = { "Inmates", "Guards", "Criminals" }, default = {}, multi = true })
	customSection:toggle({ name = "Aqua Labs User Esp", flag = "esp_aqua_user", default = true })
	customSection:toggle({ name = "show hostile", flag = "esp_show_hostile", default = true })
	customSection:toggle({ name = "show trespassing", flag = "esp_show_trespassing", default = true })
	customSection:toggle({ name = "show armored", flag = "esp_show_armored", default = true })
	customSection:toggle({ name = "target only list", flag = "esp_target_only", default = false })
	customSection:dropdown({ name = "bounding mode", flag = "esp_bounding", items = { "Fixed", "Dynamic" }, default = "Fixed" })
	customSection:slider({ name = "fixed width scale", flag = "esp_width_scale", min = 0.5, max = 1.5, default = 1, interval = 0.01 })
	customSection:slider({ name = "max distance", flag = "esp_max_distance", min = 100, max = 5000, default = 2000, interval = 50 })

	-- Crosshair: several styles or a custom decal, with spin, pulse, rainbow and a smooth follow delay.
	do
		local crosshairSection = visualsTab:section({ name = "Crosshair", side = "right" })

		addFeature(crosshairSection, { name = "Crosshair", flag = "crosshair_enabled" })
		crosshairSection:colorpicker({ flag = "crosshair_color", color = Color3.new(1, 1, 1) })
		crosshairSection:dropdown({
			name = "style",
			flag = "crosshair_style",
			items = { "Classic", "Plus", "X", "Circle", "Circle Dot", "Image" },
			default = "Classic",
		})
		crosshairSection:toggle({ name = "rainbow", flag = "crosshair_rainbow", default = false })
		crosshairSection:toggle({ name = "spin", flag = "crosshair_spin", default = true })
		crosshairSection:slider({ name = "spin speed", flag = "crosshair_spin_speed", min = 0.05, max = 3, default = 0.5, interval = 0.05, suffix = "rps" })
		crosshairSection:slider({ name = "follow delay", flag = "crosshair_delay", min = 0, max = 0.95, default = 0.35, interval = 0.05 })
		crosshairSection:toggle({ name = "pulse", flag = "crosshair_pulse", default = false })
		crosshairSection:slider({ name = "length", flag = "crosshair_length", min = 2, max = 30, default = 8, interval = 1, suffix = "px" })
		crosshairSection:slider({ name = "gap", flag = "crosshair_gap", min = 0, max = 20, default = 4, interval = 1, suffix = "px" })
		crosshairSection:slider({ name = "thickness", flag = "crosshair_thickness", min = 1, max = 5, default = 2, interval = 1, suffix = "px" })
		crosshairSection:toggle({ name = "outline", flag = "crosshair_outline", default = true })
		crosshairSection:toggle({ name = "center dot", flag = "crosshair_dot", default = false })
		crosshairSection:textbox({
			placeholder = "Crosshair image: decal id",
			flag = "crosshair_image_id",
			callback = function(input)
				task.spawn(function()
					crosshairImage = resolveImage(input)
				end)
			end,
		})
		crosshairSection:slider({ name = "image scale", flag = "crosshair_image_scale", min = 0.5, max = 4, default = 1.5, interval = 0.05, suffix = "x" })
		crosshairSection:toggle({ name = "tint image", flag = "crosshair_image_tint", default = false })
		crosshairSection:toggle({ name = "hide cursor", flag = "crosshair_hide_cursor", default = false })

		local crosshairArms = {}
		local crosshairOutlines = {}

		for index = 1, 4 do
			local outline = Drawing.new("Line")
			outline.Color = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
			outline.ZIndex = 4
			crosshairOutlines[index] = outline

			local arm = Drawing.new("Line")
			arm.ZIndex = 5
			crosshairArms[index] = arm
		end

		local ringOutline = Drawing.new("Circle")
		ringOutline.Color = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
		ringOutline.NumSides = 48
		ringOutline.ZIndex = 4

		local ring = Drawing.new("Circle")
		ring.NumSides = 48
		ring.ZIndex = 5

		local dotOutline = Drawing.new("Circle")
		dotOutline.Filled = true
		dotOutline.NumSides = 16
		dotOutline.Color = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
		dotOutline.ZIndex = 4

		local dot = Drawing.new("Circle")
		dot.Filled = true
		dot.NumSides = 16
		dot.ZIndex = 5

		-- The image style is a GUI image so any decal works and rotates cleanly.
		local crosshairGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
		crosshairGui.Name = ""
		crosshairGui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
		crosshairGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
		crosshairGui.DisplayOrder = 10
		crosshairGui:SetAttribute("AquaLabs", true)
		crosshairGui.Parent = coreGui

		local imageLabel = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
		imageLabel.Name = ""
		imageLabel.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
		imageLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		imageLabel.ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Fit
		imageLabel.Visible = false
		imageLabel.Parent = crosshairGui

		local crosshairAngle = 0
		local crosshairPosition = nil
		local crosshairHidCursor = false

		---Hide every drawn piece of the crosshair.
		local function hideCrosshair()
			for index = 1, 4 do
				crosshairArms[index].Visible = false
				crosshairOutlines[index].Visible = false
			end

			ring.Visible, ringOutline.Visible = false, false
			dot.Visible, dotOutline.Visible = false, false
			imageLabel.Visible = false
		end

		library:connection(runService.RenderStepped, function(deltaTime)
			-- Hidden while the mouse is over the open menu.
			local enabled = flags.crosshair_enabled == true and not Hooks.mouseOverMenu()
			local mouse = userInputService:GetMouseLocation()

			-- Only touch the mouse icon when our state changes, so the custom cursor still works.
			local shouldHide = enabled and flags.crosshair_hide_cursor == true and not windowFrame.Visible
			if shouldHide ~= crosshairHidCursor then
				crosshairHidCursor = shouldHide
				userInputService.MouseIconEnabled = not shouldHide
			end

			if not enabled then
				-- Hide once, then skip all work while the crosshair stays off.
				if crosshairPosition then
					crosshairPosition = nil
					hideCrosshair()
				end
				return
			end

			-- Frame-rate independent ease toward the cursor.
			local delay = flags.crosshair_delay or 0
			crosshairPosition = crosshairPosition or mouse
			crosshairPosition = crosshairPosition:Lerp(mouse, 1 - delay ^ (deltaTime * 60))
			local center = crosshairPosition

			if flags.crosshair_spin then
				crosshairAngle = (crosshairAngle + deltaTime * (flags.crosshair_spin_speed or 0.5) * math.pi * 2) % (math.pi * 2)
			end

			local style = flags.crosshair_style or "Classic"
			local color = flags.crosshair_rainbow and getRainbow(0.35)
				or (flags.crosshair_color and flags.crosshair_color.Color or Color3.new(1, 1, 1))
			local pulse = flags.crosshair_pulse and (math.sin(os.clock() * 5) * 0.25 + 1) or 1
			local length = (flags.crosshair_length or 8) * pulse
			local gap = style == "Plus" and 0 or (flags.crosshair_gap or 4) * pulse
			local thickness = flags.crosshair_thickness or 2
			local outlined = flags.crosshair_outline == true
			local radius = gap + length

			hideCrosshair()

			if style == "Image" then
				imageLabel.Visible = crosshairImage ~= ""
				imageLabel.Image = crosshairImage
				imageLabel.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(center.X, center.Y)
				imageLabel.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(radius * 2 * (flags.crosshair_image_scale or 1.5), radius * 2 * (flags.crosshair_image_scale or 1.5))
				imageLabel.Rotation = math.deg(crosshairAngle)
				imageLabel.ImageColor3 = flags.crosshair_image_tint and color or Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
				return
			end

			if style == "Classic" or style == "Plus" or style == "X" or style == "Circle Dot" then
				local baseAngle = crosshairAngle + (style == "X" and math.pi / 4 or 0)

				for index = 1, 4 do
					local angle = baseAngle + (index - 1) * math.pi / 2
					local direction = Vector2.new(math.cos(angle), math.sin(angle))
					local from = center + direction * gap
					local to = center + direction * radius

					if style == "Circle Dot" then
						-- Short ticks just outside the ring.
						from = center + direction * (radius + 3)
						to = center + direction * (radius + 3 + length * 0.5)
					end

					local arm = crosshairArms[index]
					arm.From, arm.To = from, to
					arm.Color = color
					arm.Thickness = thickness
					arm.Visible = true

					local outline = crosshairOutlines[index]
					outline.From, outline.To = from - direction, to + direction
					outline.Thickness = thickness + 2
					outline.Visible = outlined
				end
			end

			if style == "Circle" or style == "Circle Dot" then
				ring.Position, ringOutline.Position = center, center
				ring.Radius, ringOutline.Radius = radius, radius
				ring.Thickness, ringOutline.Thickness = thickness, thickness + 2
				ring.Color = color
				ring.Visible = true
				ringOutline.Visible = outlined
			end

			if flags.crosshair_dot or style == "Circle Dot" then
				local dotRadius = math.max(thickness - 0.5, 1.5)
				dot.Position, dotOutline.Position = center, center
				dot.Radius, dotOutline.Radius = dotRadius, dotRadius + 1
				dot.Color = color
				dot.Visible = true
				dotOutline.Visible = outlined
			end
		end)

		table.insert(worldCleanupTasks, function()
			for index = 1, 4 do
				crosshairArms[index]:Remove()
				crosshairOutlines[index]:Remove()
			end

			ring:Remove()
			ringOutline:Remove()
			dot:Remove()
			dotOutline:Remove()
			crosshairGui:Destroy()
		end)
	end

	for _, player in ipairs(playersService:GetPlayers()) do
		createEsp(player)
	end

	library:connection(playersService.PlayerAdded, createEsp)
	library:connection(playersService.PlayerRemoving, destroyEsp)

	-- Self ESP: your own character gets the same ESP as everyone else (third person only).
	addFeature(playerSection, { name = "Self ESP", flag = "esp_self" })
	espObjects[localPlayer] = createEsp(localPlayer, espGui)

	local lastEspUpdate = 0

	library:connection(runService.RenderStepped, LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()
		local now = os.clock()

		-- Cap how often ESP redraws; at 200+ FPS this halves the work with no visible difference.
		local interval = math.max(ESP_UPDATE_INTERVALS[flags.esp_update_rate or "Every frame"] or 0, Hooks.visualInterval())
		if now - lastEspUpdate < interval then
			return
		end
		lastEspUpdate = now

		-- Far players move only a few pixels on screen, so outside Quality they update every other
		-- pass (from 500 studs on Balanced, 250 on Performance).
		local level = Hooks.perfLevel()
		local farAway = level >= 2 and 250 or 500
		local cameraPosition = workspace.CurrentCamera.CFrame.Position

		for player, esp in pairs(espObjects) do
			-- Self ESP only while it's on.
			if player == localPlayer and not flags.esp_self then
				hideEsp(esp)
				continue
			end

			-- Safety net if PlayerRemoving was missed: a player who left loses their ESP.
			if not player.Parent then
				destroyEsp(player)
				continue
			end

			if level >= 1 and not esp.hidden then
				local root = player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
				if root and (root.Position - cameraPosition).Magnitude > farAway then
					esp.lodSkip = not esp.lodSkip
					if esp.lodSkip then
						continue
					end
				end
			end

			local success, problem = pcall(updateEsp, player, esp, now)
			if not success then
				hideEsp(esp)
				-- Print each kind of failure once, so a broken build shows why its ESP vanished.
				local message = tostring(problem)
				if not reportedChamsErrors[message] then
					reportedChamsErrors[message] = true
					warn("[Aqua] esp:", message)
				end
			end
		end
	end))

	-- Appearance overrides change rarely, so they run on a slower loop.
	task.spawn(function()
		while isCurrentRun() and watermarkHolder.Parent do
			task.wait(0.25)
			if not isCurrentRun() then
				break
			end

			-- Forget parts whose characters are gone.
			for part in pairs(overrideOriginals) do
				if not part:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then
					overrideOriginals[part] = nil
				end
			end

			for player in pairs(espObjects) do
				local success, problem = pcall(function()
					local character = player.Character
					if not character then
						return
					end

					-- Enemy Material never recolors you (Self ESP puts you in this list).
				local active = player ~= localPlayer and flags.esp_enabled and flags.esp_override and getEspTarget(player) ~= nil
					if not active then
						return restoreAppearance(character)
					end

					local material = Enum.Material[flags.esp_override_material or "ForceField"]
					local color = flags.esp_override and flags.esp_override_color and flags.esp_override_color.Color
						or (flags.esp_chams_fill and flags.esp_chams_fill.Color)

					-- Per-player looks: each team gets its own color, or everyone cycles a different hue.
					local colorMode = flags.esp_override and flags.esp_override_color_mode or "Custom"
					if colorMode == "Team Colors" and player.Team then
						color = player.TeamColor.Color
					elseif colorMode == "Rainbow" then
						color = getRainbow(0.25, (player.UserId % 10) / 10)
					end

					for _, part in ipairs(character:GetDescendants()) do
						if not part:IsA("BasePart") or part.Name == "HumanoidRootPart" then
							continue
						end

						-- Held guns belong to Tool Visuals' "other players' guns" when that's on.
						if flags.tool_visuals_others and part:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Tool") then
							continue
						end

						if not overrideOriginals[part] then
							overrideOriginals[part] = {
								material = part.Material,
								color = part.Color,
								transparency = part.Transparency,
							}
						end

						local record = overrideOriginals[part]
						local useColor = (flags.esp_override_use_color or not flags.esp_override) and color
						local transparency = flags.esp_override and record.transparency < 1 and (flags.esp_override_transparency or 0) or nil

						applyPartLook(record, part, material, useColor or record.color, transparency)
					end
				end)

				if not success then
					warn("[Potent] appearance override:", problem)
				end
			end
		end
	end)

	-- ESP preview: a live 3D copy of your character beside the menu (while the ESP tab is open),
	-- with every ESP setting drawn on it by the same code that draws the real ESP. Drag to rotate.
	-- (Own function so its locals don't count against this one's.)
	;(function()
		local previewSection = espTab:section({ name = "Preview", side = "right" })
		previewSection:toggle({ name = "esp preview", flag = "esp_preview", default = true })
		previewSection:toggle({ name = "spin preview", flag = "esp_preview_spin", default = true })
		previewSection:slider({ name = "preview zoom", flag = "esp_preview_zoom", min = 6, max = 20, default = 11, interval = 0.5, suffix = " studs" })
		-- Which corner of the menu the panel locks to (or drag it by its title bar to a corner).
		previewSection:dropdown({ name = "preview side", flag = "esp_preview_side", items = { "Top Right", "Bottom Right", "Top Left", "Bottom Left" }, default = "Top Right" })
		-- Configs saved before the corners stored "Right" / "Custom" / "Left", which the dropdown no
		-- longer has (it showed blank). They're turned into the matching top corner as they load.
		do
			local LEGACY_SIDES = { Right = "Top Right", Custom = "Top Right", Left = "Top Left" }
			local loadConfig = library.load_config
			library.load_config = function(self, text, ...)
				if type(text) == "string" then
					text = string.gsub(text, '("esp_preview_side"%s*:%s*")(%a+)(")', function(before, side, after)
						return before .. (LEGACY_SIDES[side] or side) .. after
					end)
				end
				return loadConfig(self, text, ...)
			end
		end
		-- Where each piece of the ESP sits around the box. Drag them on the preview to change these.
		previewSection:dropdown({ name = "name position", flag = "esp_name_side", items = { "Top", "Bottom" }, default = "Top" })
		previewSection:dropdown({ name = "weapon position", flag = "esp_weapon_side", items = { "Top", "Bottom" }, default = "Bottom" })
		previewSection:dropdown({ name = "distance position", flag = "esp_distance_side", items = { "Top", "Bottom" }, default = "Bottom" })
		previewSection:dropdown({ name = "team position", flag = "esp_team_side", items = { "Top", "Bottom" }, default = "Bottom" })
		previewSection:dropdown({ name = "flags position", flag = "esp_flags_side", items = { "Right", "Left" }, default = "Right" })

		local PANEL_WIDTH, VIEW_HEIGHT = 260, 340

		local function make(className, properties)
			local object = Instance.new(className)
			for key, value in pairs(properties) do
				object[key] = value
			end
			return object
		end

		local panel = make("Frame", {
			Parent = Hooks.sideGui,
			Name = "",
			Size = UDim2.fromOffset(PANEL_WIDTH, VIEW_HEIGHT + 28),
			BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(26, 26, 26),
			BorderSizePixel = 0,
			Visible = false,
		})
		local panelStroke = make("UIStroke", { Parent = panel, Color = Color3.new(0, 0, 0), LineJoinMode = Enum.LineJoinMode.Miter })
		-- Shrinks with the menu on phones (and to fit short screens).
		local panelScale = make("UIScale", { Parent = panel, Scale = 1 })
		-- Settings > Background's image, behind everything in the panel (the 3D view goes see-through
		-- over it, like the menu's own panels).
		local backdrop = make("ImageLabel", {
			Parent = panel,
			Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1),
			BackgroundTransparency = 1,
			ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Crop,
			Image = "",
			ZIndex = 0,
		})
		local accentLine = make("Frame", {
			Parent = panel,
			Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 2),
			BorderSizePixel = 0,
			BackgroundColor3 = getAccent(),
			ZIndex = 3,
		})
		local title = make("TextLabel", {
			Parent = panel,
			Position = UDim2.fromOffset(8, 4),
			Size = UDim2.new(1, -16, 0, 18),
			BackgroundTransparency = 1,
			FontFace = library.font,
			TextSize = 12,
			TextColor3 = getTextColor(),
			TextStrokeTransparency = 0.5,
			TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
			Text = "esp preview  ·  drag here to move",
		})

		local viewport = make("ViewportFrame", {
			Parent = panel,
			Position = UDim2.fromOffset(4, 24),
			Size = UDim2.new(1, -8, 0, VIEW_HEIGHT),
			BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(16, 16, 16),
			BorderSizePixel = 0,
			Ambient = Color3.fromRGB(170, 170, 170),
			LightColor = Color3.new(1, 1, 1),
			LightDirection = Vector3.new(NEG_ONE, NEG_ONE, NEG_ONE),
			Active = true,
			ZIndex = 1,
		})
		local viewportStroke = make("UIStroke", { Parent = viewport, Color = Color3.fromRGB(57, 57, 57) })
		local viewCamera = make("Camera", { Parent = viewport, FieldOfView = 40 })
		viewport.CurrentCamera = viewCamera
		-- Settings > Background fills `image` and makes `dim` (the 3D view) see-through over it.
		table.insert(overlayPanels, { holder = panel, image = backdrop, dim = viewport })

		---Write a property only when it changed.
		local function setIf(object, property, value)
			if object[property] ~= value then
				object[property] = value
			end
		end

		---Recolor the panel to the menu's theme: background, borders, accent, text and font.
		local function applyTheme()
			local background = shadeColors.background or Color3.fromRGB(26, 26, 26)
			setIf(panel, "BackgroundColor3", background)
			setIf(viewport, "BackgroundColor3", background:Lerp(Color3.new(0, 0, 0), 0.35))
			setIf(viewportStroke, "Color", shadeColors.element or Color3.fromRGB(57, 57, 57))
			-- The same accent border as the menu when Border Outline is on.
			setIf(panelStroke, "Color", flags.ui_border_outline ~= false and getAccent() or (shadeColors.border or Color3.new(0, 0, 0)))
			setIf(accentLine, "BackgroundColor3", getAccent())
			setIf(title, "TextColor3", getTextColor())
			setIf(title, "FontFace", currentFont)
		end

		-- The ESP draws into this frame, laid exactly over the 3D view.
		local overlay = make("Frame", {
			Parent = panel,
			Position = viewport.Position,
			Size = viewport.Size,
			BackgroundTransparency = 1,
			ClipsDescendants = true,
			ZIndex = 2,
		})
		make("TextLabel", {
			Parent = overlay,
			AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 1),
			Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 1, -4),
			Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 12),
			BackgroundTransparency = 1,
			FontFace = library.font,
			TextSize = 11,
			TextColor3 = DULL_TEXT,
			Text = "drag to rotate · drag a label to move it",
		})

		local previewEsp = createEsp(localPlayer, overlay)
		previewEsp.chams.viewport = viewport

		-- The copy of your character: its parts paired with the real ones, posed every frame.
		local view = { character = nil, model = nil, root = nil, pairs = {}, dirty = false, angle = 0, dragging = false, connections = {} }

		local function clearView()
			pcall(previewEsp.chams.clear, previewEsp.chams)
			if view.model then
				view.model:Destroy()
			end
			for _, connection in ipairs(view.connections) do
				connection:Disconnect()
			end
			table.clear(view.connections)
			table.clear(view.pairs)
			view.model, view.character, view.root = nil, nil, nil
		end

		local function buildView(character)
			clearView()
			view.character = character
			view.dirty = false

			-- Tag the real parts (only on your side) so each copy can find its original.
			local originals = {}
			for _, part in ipairs(character:GetDescendants()) do
				if part:IsA("BasePart") then
					table.insert(originals, part)
					part:SetAttribute("AquaPreview", #originals)
				end
			end
			local archivable = character.Archivable
			character.Archivable = true
			local ok, copy = pcall(character.Clone, character)
			character.Archivable = archivable
			for _, part in ipairs(originals) do
				part:SetAttribute("AquaPreview", nil)
			end
			if not (ok and copy) then
				return
			end

			for _, object in ipairs(copy:GetDescendants()) do
				if object:IsA("BaseScript") or object:IsA("Sound") or object:IsA("ForceField") or object:IsA("ParticleEmitter")
					or object:IsA("Trail") or object:IsA("Beam") or object:IsA("JointInstance") or object:IsA("Constraint")
					or object:IsA("BillboardGui") or object:IsA("Highlight") then
					object:Destroy()
				elseif object:IsA("BasePart") then
					local index = object:GetAttribute("AquaPreview")
					object:SetAttribute("AquaPreview", nil)
					object.Anchored = true
					if object.Name == "HumanoidRootPart" then
						object.Transparency = 1
						view.root = object
					end
					if index and originals[index] then
						table.insert(view.pairs, { originals[index], object })
					end
				elseif object:IsA("Humanoid") then
					object.DisplayDistanceType = Enum.HumanoidDisplayDistanceType.None
				end
			end
			copy.Parent = viewport
			view.model = copy

			-- Rebuild when a tool or accessory comes or goes.
			local function markDirty()
				view.dirty = true
			end
			table.insert(view.connections, character.ChildAdded:Connect(markDirty))
			table.insert(view.connections, character.ChildRemoved:Connect(markDirty))
		end

		-- Dragging on the preview, three ways: the title bar moves the whole panel (anywhere around
		-- the menu, remembered), an ESP piece (name, weapon, distance, health bar, flags) can be picked
		-- up and dropped on another side of the box, and anywhere else turns your character.
		-- The panel snaps to one of four spots around the menu: its top or bottom corner on the right or
		-- left side. While dragging, the spots show as outlines and the closest one lights up; letting
		-- go locks it there (saved through "preview side").
		local panelDrag = { active = false, grab = nil, point = nil, nearest = nil, ghosts = {} }
		for _, spot in ipairs({ "Top Right", "Bottom Right", "Top Left", "Bottom Left" }) do
			local ghost = make("Frame", {
				Parent = Hooks.sideGui,
				Name = "",
				BackgroundColor3 = getAccent(),
				BackgroundTransparency = 0.9,
				BorderSizePixel = 0,
				Visible = false,
			})
			make("UIStroke", { Parent = ghost, Color = getAccent(), Transparency = 0.4 })
			panelDrag.ghosts[spot] = ghost
		end

		-- The pieces you can move, which setting each one changes, and whether it goes above/below
		-- the box ("vertical") or beside it ("horizontal").
		local MOVABLE = {
			{ name = "Name", object = previewEsp.name, flag = "esp_name_side", vertical = true },
			{ name = "Weapon", object = previewEsp.weapon, flag = "esp_weapon_side", vertical = true },
			{ name = "Distance", object = previewEsp.distance, flag = "esp_distance_side", vertical = true },
			{ name = "Team", object = previewEsp.team, flag = "esp_team_side", vertical = true },
			{ name = "Health Bar", object = previewEsp.healthBack, flag = "esp_health_side", anySide = true },
			{ name = "Flags", object = previewEsp.flags, flag = "esp_flags_side", vertical = false },
		}
		local elementDrag = nil

		-- The side the piece would land on, lit up on the box.
		local dropBar = make("Frame", {
			Parent = Hooks.sideGui,
			BorderSizePixel = 0,
			BackgroundColor3 = getAccent(),
			Visible = false,
			ZIndex = 19,
		})

		---A press or move in the same space as AbsolutePosition.
		local function pointOf(input)
