			local inset = game:GetService("GuiService"):GetGuiInset()
			if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
				local point = Vector2.new(input.Position.X, input.Position.Y)
				return Hooks.sideGui.IgnoreGuiInset and point + inset or point
			end
			local mouse = userInputService:GetMouseLocation()
			return Hooks.sideGui.IgnoreGuiInset and mouse or mouse - inset
		end

		local function inside(object, point, pad)
			local position, size = object.AbsolutePosition, object.AbsoluteSize
			return point.X >= position.X - pad and point.Y >= position.Y - pad
				and point.X <= position.X + size.X + pad and point.Y <= position.Y + size.Y + pad
		end

		---Which side of the box a dragged piece would go on, from where the pointer is.
		local function dropSide(entry, point)
			local box = previewEsp.container
			local center = box.AbsolutePosition + box.AbsoluteSize / 2
			if entry.anySide then
				-- Whichever edge the pointer is past the most, measured against the box's own shape.
				local half = box.AbsoluteSize / 2
				local relative = point - center
				local across = relative.X / math.max(half.X, 1)
				local down = relative.Y / math.max(half.Y, 1)
				if math.abs(across) >= math.abs(down) then
					return across < 0 and "Left" or "Right"
				end
				return down < 0 and "Top" or "Bottom"
			end
			if entry.vertical then
				return point.Y < center.Y and "Top" or "Bottom"
			end
			return point.X < center.X and "Left" or "Right"
		end

		---Light up the box edge a piece would land on.
		local function showDropBar(entry, side)
			local box = previewEsp.container
			local origin = Hooks.sideGui.AbsolutePosition
			local position = box.AbsolutePosition - origin
			local size = box.AbsoluteSize
			if side == "Top" then
				dropBar.Position, dropBar.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(position.X, position.Y + NEG_ONE * 4), UDim2.fromOffset(size.X, 2)
			elseif side == "Bottom" then
				dropBar.Position, dropBar.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(position.X, position.Y + size.Y + 2), UDim2.fromOffset(size.X, 2)
			elseif side == "Left" then
				dropBar.Position, dropBar.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(position.X + NEG_ONE * 4, position.Y), UDim2.fromOffset(2, size.Y)
			else
				dropBar.Position, dropBar.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(position.X + size.X + 2, position.Y), UDim2.fromOffset(2, size.Y)
			end
			dropBar.BackgroundColor3 = getAccent()
			dropBar.Visible = true
		end

		library:connection(userInputService.InputBegan, function(input)
			if input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 and input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
				return
			end
			if not panel.Visible then
				return
			end
			local point = pointOf(input)
			if not inside(panel, point, 0) then
				return
			end

			-- Title bar: move the panel.
			if point.Y <= panel.AbsolutePosition.Y + 22 * panelScale.Scale then
				panelDrag.active = true
				panelDrag.grab = point - panel.AbsolutePosition
				panelDrag.point = point
				return
			end

			-- An ESP piece: pick it up.
			for _, entry in ipairs(MOVABLE) do
				if entry.object.Visible and inside(entry.object, point, 3) then
					elementDrag = entry
					return
				end
			end

			-- Anywhere else on the 3D view: turn your character.
			if inside(overlay, point, 0) then
				view.dragging = true
				view.lastMouse = input.Position
			end
		end)

		library:connection(userInputService.InputChanged, function(input)
			if input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement and input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
				return
			end
			if view.dragging then
				local delta = input.Position - (view.lastMouse or input.Position)
				view.lastMouse = input.Position
				view.angle += delta.X * NEG_ONE * 0.012
			end
			local point = pointOf(input)
			if panelDrag.active then
				panelDrag.point = point
			end
			if elementDrag then
				showDropBar(elementDrag, dropSide(elementDrag, point))
			end
		end)

		library:connection(userInputService.InputEnded, function(input)
			if input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 and input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
				return
			end
			view.dragging = false
			if panelDrag.active then
				-- Dropped: lock into the closest spot.
				panelDrag.active = false
				for _, ghost in pairs(panelDrag.ghosts) do
					ghost.Visible = false
				end
				local spot = panelDrag.nearest
				if spot and flags.esp_preview_side ~= spot then
					local setter = library.config_flags.esp_preview_side
					if setter then
						setter(spot)
					else
						flags.esp_preview_side = spot
					end
				end
			end
			if elementDrag then
				-- Dropped: save the new side through its setting (so configs keep it).
				local entry = elementDrag
				elementDrag = nil
				dropBar.Visible = false
				local side = dropSide(entry, pointOf(input))
				if flags[entry.flag] ~= side then
					local setter = library.config_flags[entry.flag]
					if setter then
						setter(side)
					else
						flags[entry.flag] = side
					end
				end
				-- Redraw the text right away instead of at the next refresh.
				previewEsp.textAt = 0
			end
		end)

		onUnload(function()
			dropBar:Destroy()
			for _, ghost in pairs(panelDrag.ghosts) do
				ghost:Destroy()
			end
		end)

		---Whether the ESP tab is the one open in the menu.
		local function espTabOpen()
			local holder = espTab.column_holder and espTab.column_holder.Parent
			return library.current_tab ~= nil and holder ~= nil and library.current_tab[2] == holder
		end

		local shown = false
		library:connection(runService.RenderStepped, function(deltaTime)
			local character = localPlayer.Character
			local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
			local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			local show = flags.esp_preview ~= false and windowFrame.Visible and espTabOpen() and humanoid ~= nil and root ~= nil

			if panel.Visible ~= show then
				panel.Visible = show
			end
			if not show then
				if shown then
					shown = false
					hideEsp(previewEsp)
					clearView()
					panelDrag.active = false
					for _, ghost in pairs(panelDrag.ghosts) do
						ghost.Visible = false
					end
				end
				return
			end
			shown = true

			-- Same scale as the menu (phones shrink it), and never taller than the screen.
			local origin = library.gui.AbsolutePosition
			local screen = library.gui.AbsoluteSize
			local guiScale = library.gui:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIScale")
			local scale = guiScale and guiScale.Scale or 1
			scale = math.min(scale, (screen.Y + NEG_ONE * 16) / (VIEW_HEIGHT + 28))
			scale = math.floor(math.max(scale, 0.3) * 100) / 100
			setIf(panelScale, "Scale", scale)
			local width = PANEL_WIDTH * scale

			-- On the chosen side of the menu (the other side when there's no room), top-aligned with
			-- it. On a phone the menu fills the screen, so it sits over the menu's inner edge instead.
			local menuPosition = windowFrame.AbsolutePosition - origin
			local menuSize = windowFrame.AbsoluteSize
			local rightX = menuPosition.X + menuSize.X + 10
			local leftX = menuPosition.X + NEG_ONE * (width + 10)
			local rightFits = rightX + width <= screen.X
			local leftFits = leftX >= 0
			local height = (VIEW_HEIGHT + 28) * scale
			-- The four snap spots (a side without room falls back to the other side, then inside).
			local rightSpot = rightFits and rightX or leftFits and leftX or menuPosition.X + menuSize.X + NEG_ONE * (width + 8)
			local leftSpot = leftFits and leftX or rightFits and rightX or menuPosition.X + 8
			local topY = menuPosition.Y
			local bottomY = math.max(menuPosition.Y + menuSize.Y + NEG_ONE * height, topY)
			local spots = {
				["Top Right"] = Vector2.new(rightSpot, topY),
				["Bottom Right"] = Vector2.new(rightSpot, bottomY),
				["Top Left"] = Vector2.new(leftSpot, topY),
				["Bottom Left"] = Vector2.new(leftSpot, bottomY),
			}
			-- Older saved sides: "Right" / "Custom" are the top right, "Left" the top left.
			local side = flags.esp_preview_side
			local target = spots[side] or (side == "Left" and spots["Top Left"]) or spots["Top Right"]

			local x, y = target.X, target.Y
			if panelDrag.active and panelDrag.point then
				-- Follows the pointer while dragging; the closest spot lights up.
				local free = panelDrag.point - panelDrag.grab - origin
				x, y = free.X, free.Y
				local best, bestDistance = nil, math.huge
				for name, spot in pairs(spots) do
					local distance = (spot - free).Magnitude
					if distance < bestDistance then
						best, bestDistance = name, distance
					end
				end
				panelDrag.nearest = best
				for name, ghost in pairs(panelDrag.ghosts) do
					local spot = spots[name]
					ghost.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(spot.X, spot.Y)
					ghost.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(width, height)
					ghost.BackgroundColor3 = getAccent()
					ghost.BackgroundTransparency = name == best and 0.75 or 0.93
					ghost.Visible = true
				end
			end
			y = math.clamp(y, 4, math.max(screen.Y + NEG_ONE * (height + 4), 4))
			panel.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(math.clamp(x, 4, math.max(screen.X + NEG_ONE * (width + 4), 4)), y)
			applyTheme()

			if view.character ~= character or view.dirty or not view.model then
				buildView(character)
			end
			if not (view.model and view.root) then
				return
			end
			for _, pair in ipairs(view.pairs) do
				local source, copy = pair[1], pair[2]
				if source.Parent then
					copy.CFrame = source.CFrame
				end
			end

			-- Slow turn around you unless you're dragging; always facing you to start.
			if flags.esp_preview_spin ~= false and not view.dragging then
				view.angle += deltaTime * 0.5
			end
			local _, yaw = root.CFrame:ToOrientation()
			local focus = view.root.Position + Vector3.new(0, 0.2, 0)
			local zoom = flags.esp_preview_zoom or 11
			local direction = Vector3.new(math.sin(yaw + view.angle), 0.12, math.cos(yaw + view.angle))
			viewCamera.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(focus + direction.Unit * zoom, focus)

			espViewState.view = {
				cameraCFrame = viewCamera.CFrame,
				fov = viewCamera.FieldOfView,
				-- In the panel's own (unscaled) pixels: the UIScale shrinks what the ESP draws after.
				size = overlay.AbsoluteSize / math.max(panelScale.Scale, 0.01),
				target = { character = view.model, rootPart = view.root, humanoid = humanoid, distance = zoom },
			}
			local ok, problem = pcall(updateEsp, localPlayer, previewEsp, os.clock())
			espViewState.view = nil
			if not ok and not reportedChamsErrors[tostring(problem)] then
				reportedChamsErrors[tostring(problem)] = true
				warn("[Aqua] esp preview:", problem)
			end
		end)

		onUnload(function()
			clearView()
			panel:Destroy()
		end)
	end)()

	table.insert(worldCleanupTasks, function()
		for player in pairs(espObjects) do
			destroyEsp(player)
		end

		espGui:Destroy()
		chamsFolder:Destroy()
	end)
	end

	local function buildSelfVisuals()
	-- Self visuals: how your own character looks to you.
	local selfChams = Instance.new("Highlight")
	selfChams.Name = ""
	selfChams.Enabled = false
	selfChams.Parent = chamsFolder

	local selfOriginals = {}
	local selfTrail = nil

	---Hue that cycles over time for rainbow options.
	---@param speed number
	---@return Color3
	local function rainbowColor(speed)
		return Color3.fromHSV((os.clock() * speed) % 1, 0.75, 1)
	end

	---Put your character's parts back the way the game had them.
	local function restoreSelfMaterial()
		for part, original in pairs(selfOriginals) do
			if part.Parent then
				part.Material = original.material
				part.Color = original.color
				part.Transparency = original.transparency
			end
		end

		table.clear(selfOriginals)
	end

	---Remove both leg trails and their attachments.
	local function removeSelfTrail()
		if not selfTrail then
			return
		end

		for _, legTrail in ipairs(selfTrail.legs) do
			legTrail.trail:Destroy()
			legTrail.top:Destroy()
			legTrail.bottom:Destroy()
		end

		selfTrail = nil
	end

	---Build a thin trail near the bottom of one leg.
	---@param leg BasePart
	---@return table
	local function createLegTrail(leg)
		local top = Instance.new("Attachment")
		top.Name = ""
		top.Parent = leg

		local bottom = Instance.new("Attachment")
		bottom.Name = ""
		bottom.Parent = leg

		local trail = Instance.new("Trail")
		trail.Name = ""
		trail.Attachment0 = top
		trail.Attachment1 = bottom
		trail.LightEmission = 0.5
		trail.Transparency = NumberSequence.new(0.15, 1)
		trail.WidthScale = NumberSequence.new(1, 0.1)
		trail.FaceCamera = true
		trail.Parent = leg

		return { trail = trail, top = top, bottom = bottom, leg = leg }
	end

	local selfChamsSection = visualsTab:section({ name = "Self Chams", side = "left" })

	addFeature(selfChamsSection, { name = "Self Chams", flag = "self_chams" })
	selfChamsSection:colorpicker({ flag = "self_chams_outline", color = Color3.new(1, 1, 1) })
	selfChamsSection:colorpicker({ flag = "self_chams_fill", color = Color3.fromRGB(110, 90, 255) })
	selfChamsSection:dropdown({ name = "chams material", flag = "self_chams_material", items = Chams.LOOK_CHOICES, default = "Ropes" })
	selfChamsSection:slider({ name = "fill transparency", flag = "self_chams_fill_transparency", min = 0, max = 1, default = 0.55, interval = 0.01 })
	selfChamsSection:slider({ name = "outline transparency", flag = "self_chams_outline_transparency", min = 0, max = 1, default = 0, interval = 0.01 })
	selfChamsSection:toggle({ name = "rainbow", flag = "self_chams_rainbow", default = false })
	selfChamsSection:toggle({ name = "pulse", flag = "self_chams_pulse", default = false })
	selfChamsSection:toggle({ name = "glow rim", flag = "self_chams_glow", default = true })

	local selfMaterialSection = visualsTab:section({ name = "Self Material", side = "left" })

	addFeature(selfMaterialSection, { name = "Self Material", flag = "self_material", callback = function(enabled)
		if not enabled then
			restoreSelfMaterial()
		end
	end })
	selfMaterialSection:colorpicker({ flag = "self_material_color", color = Color3.fromRGB(110, 90, 255) })
	selfMaterialSection:dropdown({
		name = "material",
		flag = "self_material_type",
		items = { "ForceField", "Neon", "Glass", "Foil", "SmoothPlastic" },
		default = "ForceField",
	})
	selfMaterialSection:slider({ name = "body transparency", flag = "self_material_transparency", min = 0, max = 0.95, default = 0, interval = 0.01 })
	selfMaterialSection:toggle({ name = "rainbow", flag = "self_material_rainbow", default = false })
	selfMaterialSection:slider({ name = "rainbow speed", flag = "self_rainbow_speed", min = 0.05, max = 2, default = 0.25, interval = 0.05 })
	selfMaterialSection:toggle({ name = "include accessories", flag = "self_material_accessories", default = true })
	selfMaterialSection:toggle({ name = "include tools", flag = "self_material_tools", default = false })

	local trailSection = visualsTab:section({ name = "Trail", side = "left" })

	addFeature(trailSection, { name = "Trail", flag = "self_trail", callback = function(enabled)
		if not enabled then
			removeSelfTrail()
		end
	end })
	trailSection:colorpicker({ name = "left leg start", flag = "self_trail_start", color = Color3.fromRGB(110, 90, 255) })
	trailSection:colorpicker({ name = "left leg end", flag = "self_trail_end", color = Color3.fromRGB(80, 200, 255) })
	trailSection:toggle({ name = "same colors both legs", flag = "self_trail_match", default = false })
	trailSection:colorpicker({ name = "right leg start", flag = "self_trail_right_start", color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 90, 200) })
	trailSection:colorpicker({ name = "right leg end", flag = "self_trail_right_end", color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 200, 90) })
	trailSection:slider({ name = "trail width", flag = "self_trail_width", min = 0.05, max = 1, default = 0.25, interval = 0.05 })
	trailSection:slider({ name = "trail length", flag = "self_trail_lifetime", min = 0.1, max = 2, default = 0.5, interval = 0.05, suffix = "s" })
	trailSection:toggle({ name = "rainbow trail", flag = "self_trail_rainbow", default = false })

	-- Stretch res: squashes the camera's vertical axis so the screen looks stretched.
	local stretchSection = visualsTab:section({ name = "Stretch Res", side = "right" })

	addFeature(stretchSection, { name = "Stretch Res", flag = "stretch_enabled" })
	stretchSection:dropdown({
		name = "resolution",
		flag = "stretch_preset",
		items = { "4:3 (1440x1080)", "5:4 (1280x1024)", "16:10 (1680x1050)", "Custom" },
		default = "4:3 (1440x1080)",
	})
	stretchSection:slider({ name = "custom stretch", flag = "stretch_custom", min = 0.4, max = 1, default = 0.7, interval = 0.01 })

	-- Live self visuals: chams every frame, materials and trail on a short loop.
	local selfChamsShown = false
	local selfClassicChams = Chams.new(chamsFolder)
	-- Your real body is hidden under your chams too, so packages and clothes don't show through.
	selfClassicChams.hideSource = true

	library:connection(runService.RenderStepped, function()
		local character = localPlayer.Character
		-- Material "None" turns Self Chams off without losing the toggle.
		local show = flags.self_chams == true and character ~= nil and flags.self_chams_material ~= "None"

		if show ~= selfChamsShown then
			selfChamsShown = show

			if not show then
				selfClassicChams:clear()
			end
		end

		if not show then
			return
		end

		local now = os.clock()
		local speed = flags.self_rainbow_speed or 0.25
		local fill = flags.self_chams_fill and flags.self_chams_fill.Color or Color3.fromRGB(110, 90, 255)
		local fillTransparency = flags.self_chams_fill_transparency or 0.55

		if flags.self_chams_pulse then
			fillTransparency = fillTransparency + (1 + NEG_ONE * fillTransparency) * (math.sin(now * 4) + 1) / 4
		end

		local color = flags.self_chams_rainbow and rainbowColor(speed) or fill
		selfClassicChams.glowEnabled = flags.self_chams_glow ~= false

		-- Solid silhouette chams with the chosen edge color.
		selfClassicChams:update(
			character,
			color,
			fillTransparency,
			false,
			now,
			flags.self_chams_outline and flags.self_chams_outline.Color or color:Lerp(Color3.new(1, 1, 1), 0.35),
			flags.self_chams_outline_transparency or 0.1,
			flags.self_chams_material or "Ropes"
		)
	end)

	onUnload(function()
		selfClassicChams:clear()
	end)

	task.spawn(function()
		while isCurrentRun() and watermarkHolder.Parent do
			task.wait(0.05)
			if not isCurrentRun() then
				break
			end

			local character = localPlayer.Character
			local rootPart = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			local speed = flags.self_rainbow_speed or 0.25

			-- Self material.
			if flags.self_material and character then
				local material = Enum.Material[flags.self_material_type or "ForceField"]
				local color = flags.self_material_rainbow and rainbowColor(speed)
					or (flags.self_material_color and flags.self_material_color.Color or Color3.fromRGB(110, 90, 255))

				for _, part in ipairs(character:GetDescendants()) do
					if not part:IsA("BasePart") or part.Name == "HumanoidRootPart" then
						continue
					end

					local inAccessory = part:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Accessory") ~= nil
					local inTool = part:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Tool") ~= nil
					if (inAccessory and not flags.self_material_accessories) or (inTool and not flags.self_material_tools) then
						if selfOriginals[part] then
							part.Material = selfOriginals[part].material
							part.Color = selfOriginals[part].color
							part.Transparency = selfOriginals[part].transparency
							selfOriginals[part] = nil
						end
						continue
					end

					if not selfOriginals[part] then
						selfOriginals[part] = { material = part.Material, color = part.Color, transparency = part.Transparency }
					end

					local record = selfOriginals[part]
					applyPartLook(record, part, material, color, record.transparency < 1 and (flags.self_material_transparency or 0) or nil)
				end
			end

			-- Leg trails (R6 legs or R15 lower legs), rebuilt after respawns.
			if flags.self_trail and rootPart then
				if not selfTrail or selfTrail.character ~= character or not selfTrail.legs[1].leg.Parent then
					removeSelfTrail()

					local legs = {}
					for _, legName in ipairs({ "Left Leg", "LeftLowerLeg", "Right Leg", "RightLowerLeg" }) do
						local leg = character:FindFirstChild(legName)
						if leg then
							table.insert(legs, createLegTrail(leg))
						end
					end

					selfTrail = { character = character, legs = legs }
				end

				local width = flags.self_trail_width or 0.25
				local leftStart = flags.self_trail_start and flags.self_trail_start.Color or Color3.fromRGB(110, 90, 255)
				local leftEnd = flags.self_trail_end and flags.self_trail_end.Color or Color3.fromRGB(80, 200, 255)
				local rightStart = leftStart
				local rightEnd = leftEnd

				if not flags.self_trail_match then
					rightStart = flags.self_trail_right_start and flags.self_trail_right_start.Color or leftStart
					rightEnd = flags.self_trail_right_end and flags.self_trail_right_end.Color or leftEnd
				end

				if flags.self_trail_rainbow then
					leftStart = rainbowColor(speed)
					leftEnd = Color3.fromHSV(((os.clock() * speed) + 0.3) % 1, 0.75, 1)
					rightStart, rightEnd = leftStart, leftEnd
				end

				for index, legTrail in ipairs(selfTrail.legs) do
					-- Pin the ribbon to the foot: bottom edge of the leg, `width` studs tall.
					local footY = -legTrail.leg.Size.Y / 2 + 0.05
					legTrail.bottom.Position = Vector3.new(0, footY, 0)
					legTrail.top.Position = Vector3.new(0, footY + width, 0)

					local isLeft = index == 1
					legTrail.trail.Color = isLeft and ColorSequence.new(leftStart, leftEnd) or ColorSequence.new(rightStart, rightEnd)
					legTrail.trail.Lifetime = flags.self_trail_lifetime or 0.6
				end
			end
		end
	end)

	table.insert(worldCleanupTasks, function()
		restoreSelfMaterial()
		removeSelfTrail()
		selfChams:Destroy()
	end)

	-- Tool visuals: restyle whatever tool you're holding, restored when unequipped.
	do
		local toolOriginals = {}
		local toolHighlight = Instance.new("Highlight")
		toolHighlight.Name = ""
		toolHighlight.Enabled = false
		toolHighlight.Parent = chamsFolder
		local toolClassicChams = Chams.new(chamsFolder)

		local toolGlow = Instance.new("PointLight")
		toolGlow.Name = ""
		toolGlow.Range = 8
		toolGlow.Shadows = false

		---Restore every tool part we changed that isn't in `keepTool`.
		---@param keepTool Tool?
		local function restoreTools(keepTool)
			for part, original in pairs(toolOriginals) do
				if keepTool and part:IsDescendantOf(keepTool) then
					continue
				end

				if part.Parent then
					part.Material = original.material
					part.Color = original.color
					part.Transparency = original.transparency

					if original.textureId ~= nil then
						part.TextureID = original.textureId
					end
				end

				toolOriginals[part] = nil
			end
		end

		local toolSection = visualsTab:section({ name = "Tool Visuals", side = "right" })

		addFeature(toolSection, { name = "Tool Visuals", flag = "tool_visuals", callback = function(enabled)
			if not enabled then
				restoreTools(nil)
				toolGlow.Parent = nil
			end
		end })
		toolSection:colorpicker({ flag = "tool_color", color = Color3.fromRGB(110, 90, 255) })
		toolSection:dropdown({
			name = "tool material",
			flag = "tool_material",
			items = { "SmoothPlastic", "Neon", "Glass", "Foil", "ForceField" },
			default = "SmoothPlastic",
		})
		toolSection:slider({ name = "tool transparency", flag = "tool_transparency", min = 0, max = 0.95, default = 0, interval = 0.01 })
		toolSection:toggle({ name = "rainbow tool", flag = "tool_rainbow", default = false })

		-- Gun skin textures from the old Kayen Hub script (applied to mesh parts).
		local SKIN_TEXTURES = {
			["Matrix"] = "rbxassetid://108962544192848",
			["Blue Void"] = "rbxassetid://127882926538331",
			["Classic Blue White"] = "rbxassetid://80810460581216",
			["Green and Black"] = "rbxassetid://124882447520456",
			["White"] = "rbxassetid://121082905685777",
			["Blue Skies, White Guns"] = "rbxassetid://84745365197133",
			["Water"] = "rbxassetid://119639132290940",
			["Aurora"] = "rbxassetid://124100490232201",
			["Epic White"] = "rbxassetid://100880863815885",
			["Pink White"] = "rbxassetid://95856803518597",
			["Blue Stars"] = "rbxassetid://118405531972534",
		}

		local skinNames = { "None" }
		for name in pairs(SKIN_TEXTURES) do
			table.insert(skinNames, name)
		end
		table.sort(skinNames, function(a, b)
			return a == "None" or (b ~= "None" and a < b)
		end)

		toolSection:dropdown({ name = "skin texture", flag = "tool_skin_texture", items = skinNames, default = "None" })
		toolSection:toggle({ name = "tool chams", flag = "tool_chams", default = true })
		toolSection:colorpicker({ flag = "tool_chams_color", color = Color3.new(1, 1, 1) })
		toolSection:dropdown({ name = "chams style", flag = "tool_chams_style", items = { "Outline", "Soft Fill", "Solid" }, default = "Outline" })
		toolSection:toggle({ name = "tool glow", flag = "tool_glow", default = true })
		toolSection:slider({ name = "glow brightness", flag = "tool_glow_brightness", min = 0.5, max = 10, default = 3, interval = 0.5 })

		task.spawn(function()
			while isCurrentRun() and watermarkHolder.Parent do
				task.wait(0.05)
				if not isCurrentRun() then
					break
				end

				local character = localPlayer.Character
				local tool = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")
				local active = flags.tool_visuals and tool ~= nil

				-- Anything we changed on tools you no longer hold goes back to normal.
				restoreTools(active and tool or nil)

				local showToolChams = active and flags.tool_chams == true

				if not showToolChams then
					toolClassicChams:clear()
				end

				if not active then
					if toolGlow.Parent then
						toolGlow.Parent = nil
					end
					continue
				end

				local color = flags.tool_rainbow and rainbowColor(flags.self_rainbow_speed or 0.25)
					or (flags.tool_color and flags.tool_color.Color or Color3.fromRGB(110, 90, 255))
				local material = Enum.Material[flags.tool_material or "SmoothPlastic"]

				for _, part in ipairs(tool:GetDescendants()) do
					if not part:IsA("BasePart") then
						continue
					end

					if not toolOriginals[part] then
						toolOriginals[part] = { material = part.Material, color = part.Color, transparency = part.Transparency }
					end

					local record = toolOriginals[part]
					applyPartLook(record, part, material, color, record.transparency < 1 and (flags.tool_transparency or 0) or nil)

					-- Skin texture on mesh parts (remember the original once).
					if part:IsA("MeshPart") then
						if record.textureId == nil then
							record.textureId = part.TextureID
						end

						-- The gun's own texture image draws over the color, so with no skin chosen
						-- it's removed (restored when Tool Visuals turns off) and the material and
						-- color actually show.
						local skin = SKIN_TEXTURES[flags.tool_skin_texture or ""] or ""
						if part.TextureID ~= skin then
							part.TextureID = skin
						end
					end
				end

				-- Solid silhouette chams on the tool with its own edge color.
				-- Outline is a crisp edge only; Soft Fill adds a faint tint; Solid is a flat silhouette.
				if showToolChams then
					local style = flags.tool_chams_style or "Outline"
					local fill = style == "Solid" and 0.15 or style == "Soft Fill" and 0.75 or 1
					toolClassicChams:update(tool, color, fill, false, os.clock(),
						flags.tool_chams_color and flags.tool_chams_color.Color or Color3.new(1, 1, 1), 0)
				end

				local handle = tool:FindFirstChild("Handle") or tool:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
				if flags.tool_glow and handle then
					toolGlow.Color = color
					toolGlow.Brightness = flags.tool_glow_brightness or 3
					toolGlow.Parent = handle
				else
					toolGlow.Parent = nil
				end
			end
		end)

		-- Other players' guns: the same material and color on whatever tool they're holding
		-- (only you see it). Parts go back to normal when they put the tool away.
		toolSection:toggle({ name = "other players' guns", flag = "tool_visuals_others", default = false })
		toolSection:colorpicker({ flag = "tool_others_color", color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 70, 70) })
		local otherToolOriginals = {}

		---Put other players' tool parts back the way the game had them (all, or not in `keep`).
		local function restoreOtherTools(keep)
			for part, original in pairs(otherToolOriginals) do
				if keep and keep[part] then
					continue
				end
				if part.Parent then
					part.Material = original.material
					part.Color = original.color
					if original.textureId ~= nil then
						part.TextureID = original.textureId
					end
				end
				otherToolOriginals[part] = nil
			end
		end

		task.spawn(function()
			while isCurrentRun() and watermarkHolder.Parent do
				task.wait(0.2)
				if not isCurrentRun() then
					break
				end

				if not flags.tool_visuals_others then
					if next(otherToolOriginals) then
						restoreOtherTools(nil)
					end
					continue
				end

				local material = Enum.Material[flags.tool_material or "SmoothPlastic"]
				local color = flags.tool_rainbow and rainbowColor(flags.self_rainbow_speed or 0.25)
					or (flags.tool_others_color and flags.tool_others_color.Color or Color3.fromRGB(255, 70, 70))
				local skin = SKIN_TEXTURES[flags.tool_skin_texture or ""]
				local held = {}

				for _, player in ipairs(playersService:GetPlayers()) do
					local tool = player ~= localPlayer and player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")
					if not tool then
						continue
					end

					for _, part in ipairs(tool:GetDescendants()) do
						if not part:IsA("BasePart") then
							continue
						end

						held[part] = true
						local record = otherToolOriginals[part]
						if not record then
							record = { material = part.Material, color = part.Color }
							if part:IsA("MeshPart") then
								record.textureId = part.TextureID
							end
							otherToolOriginals[part] = record
						end

						applyPartLook(record, part, material, color, nil)
						if part:IsA("MeshPart") then
							local wanted = skin or ""
							if part.TextureID ~= wanted then
								part.TextureID = wanted
							end
						end
					end
				end

				-- Tools that were put away (or whose owner left) go back to normal.
				restoreOtherTools(held)
			end
		end)

		table.insert(worldCleanupTasks, function()
			restoreTools(nil)
			restoreOtherTools(nil)
			toolClassicChams:clear()
			toolHighlight:Destroy()
			toolGlow:Destroy()
		end)
	end
	end

	local function buildRadarCrosshair()
		-- Radar: a draggable round minimap with a rotating scan sweep that "pings" players as it passes.
		local SWEEP_TRAIL = 20

		local radarGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
		radarGui.Name = ""
		radarGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
		radarGui.DisplayOrder = 5
		radarGui:SetAttribute("AquaLabs", true)
		radarGui.Parent = coreGui

		local radar = Instance.new("Frame")
		radar.Name = ""
		radar.Position = UDim2.new(1, -230, 0, 70)
		radar.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(200, 200)
		radar.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(10, 10, 16)
		radar.BackgroundTransparency = 0.2
		radar.Active = true
		radar.Draggable = true
		radar.Visible = false
		radar.Parent = radarGui

		local function round(instance)
			local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
			corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
			corner.Parent = instance
		end

		round(radar)

		local edge = Instance.new("UIStroke")
		edge.Thickness = 2
		edge.Parent = radar

		-- Soft inner glow: a slightly smaller circle with a radial-ish gradient.
		local glow = Instance.new("Frame")
		glow.Name = ""
		glow.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
		glow.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
		glow.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
		glow.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
		glow.BackgroundTransparency = 0.92
		glow.Parent = radar
		round(glow)

		local glowGradient = Instance.new("UIGradient")
		glowGradient.Rotation = 90
		glowGradient.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({
			NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.6),
			NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, 1),
			NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0.6),
		})
		glowGradient.Parent = glow

		-- Range rings and crosshair lines.
		local decorations = {}

		for _, scale in ipairs({ 0.33, 0.66 }) do
			local ring = Instance.new("Frame")
			ring.Name = ""
			ring.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
			ring.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
			ring.Size = UDim2.fromScale(scale, scale)
			ring.BackgroundTransparency = 1
			ring.Parent = radar
			round(ring)

			local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
			stroke.Transparency = 0.75
			stroke.Parent = ring
			table.insert(decorations, stroke)
		end

		for _, vertical in ipairs({ true, false }) do
			local line = Instance.new("Frame")
			line.Name = ""
			line.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
			line.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
			line.Size = vertical and UDim2.new(0, 1, 1, -8) or UDim2.new(1, -8, 0, 1)
			line.BorderSizePixel = 0
			line.BackgroundTransparency = 0.8
			line.Parent = radar
			table.insert(decorations, line)
		end

		-- Sweep: full-size layers rotate around the radar's center, each carrying one line
		-- from the center to the edge; trailing layers fade out to form the scan wedge.
		local sweepLines = {}

		for index = 1, SWEEP_TRAIL do
			local layer = Instance.new("Frame")
			layer.Name = ""
			layer.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
			layer.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
			layer.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
			layer.BackgroundTransparency = 1
			layer.ZIndex = 2
			layer.Parent = radar

			local line = Instance.new("Frame")
			line.Name = ""
			line.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 1)
			line.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
			line.Size = UDim2.new(0, index == 1 and 2 or 3, 0.5, -2)
			line.BorderSizePixel = 0
			line.BackgroundTransparency = index == 1 and 0 or 0.55 + (index / SWEEP_TRAIL) * 0.45
			line.Parent = layer

			local fade = Instance.new("UIGradient")
			fade.Rotation = 90
			fade.Transparency = NumberSequence.new(0.1, 0.85)
			fade.Parent = line

			sweepLines[index] = { layer = layer, line = line }
		end

		-- You: a small diamond in the middle.
		local me = Instance.new("Frame")
		me.Name = ""
		me.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
		me.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
		me.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(7, 7)
		me.Rotation = 45
		me.BorderSizePixel = 0
		me.ZIndex = 4
		me.Parent = radar

		local rangeLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
		rangeLabel.Name = ""
		rangeLabel.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0)
		rangeLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 1, 4)
		rangeLabel.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(120, 14)
		rangeLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		rangeLabel.TextSize = 11
		rangeLabel.FontFace = library.font
		rangeLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(170, 170, 185)
		rangeLabel.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.5
		rangeLabel.Parent = radar

		local blips = {}

		---Create (once) the dot and name tag for a player.
		---@param player Player
		---@return table
		local function getBlip(player)
			local blip = blips[player]
			if blip then
				return blip
			end

			local dot = Instance.new("Frame")
			dot.Name = ""
			dot.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
			dot.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(7, 7)
			dot.BorderSizePixel = 0
			dot.ZIndex = 3
			dot.Visible = false
			dot.Parent = radar
			round(dot)

			local outline = Instance.new("UIStroke")
			outline.Color = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
			outline.Transparency = 0.3
			outline.Parent = dot

			local name = Instance.new("TextLabel")
			name.Name = ""
			name.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 1)
			name.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, -2)
			name.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(80, 10)
			name.BackgroundTransparency = 1
			name.TextSize = 10
			name.FontFace = library.font
			name.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
			name.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.4
			name.Text = player.DisplayName
			name.ZIndex = 3
			name.Parent = dot

			blip = { dot = dot, name = name, outline = outline, pingedAt = -math.huge, lastAngle = nil }
			blips[player] = blip
			return blip
		end

		local radarSection = visualsTab:section({ name = "Radar", side = "right" })

		addFeature(radarSection, { name = "Radar", flag = "radar_enabled" })
		radarSection:colorpicker({ flag = "radar_color", color = Color3.fromRGB(110, 90, 255) })
		radarSection:toggle({ name = "match theme color", flag = "radar_match_theme", default = true })
		radarSection:slider({ name = "radar range", flag = "radar_range", min = 50, max = 1500, default = 300, interval = 10, suffix = " studs" })
		radarSection:slider({ name = "radar size", flag = "radar_size", min = 120, max = 360, default = 200, interval = 5, suffix = "px" })
		radarSection:slider({ name = "scan speed", flag = "radar_speed", min = 0.1, max = 2, default = 0.5, interval = 0.05, suffix = "rps" })
		radarSection:toggle({ name = "sweep reveal", flag = "radar_reveal", default = true })
		radarSection:slider({ name = "blip fade time", flag = "radar_fade", min = 0.3, max = 4, default = 1.6, interval = 0.1, suffix = "s" })
		radarSection:toggle({ name = "show names", flag = "radar_names", default = false })
		radarSection:toggle({ name = "show teammates", flag = "radar_teammates", default = true })
		-- Round: the scanning minimap above. Panel: a flat tactical map (no sweep).
		radarSection:dropdown({ name = "radar style", flag = "radar_style", items = { "Round", "Panel" }, default = "Round" })
		radarSection:slider({ name = "radar text size", flag = "radar_text_size", min = 8, max = 20, default = 10, interval = 1, suffix = "px" })
		radarSection:toggle({ name = "show c4", flag = "radar_c4", default = true })

		-- Planted C4 (found by the C4 ESP) as a red diamond with a "C4" distance tag, on either style.
		-- Kept on Hooks, not locals: this block is near Luau's 200-local limit.
		Hooks.radarC4Blips = {}
		---@param parent Frame
		---@param place function world position -> (UDim2 position, off the map?)
		function Hooks.drawRadarC4(parent, place, origin)
			local c4Blips = Hooks.radarC4Blips
			local seen = {}
			local textSize = flags.radar_text_size or 10
			local color = flags.c4_color and flags.c4_color.Color or Color3.fromRGB(255, 60, 60)
			if flags.radar_c4 ~= false and flags.c4_esp ~= false then
				for part in pairs(Hooks.plantedC4 or {}) do
					if not part.Parent then
						continue
					end
					seen[part] = true
					local blip = c4Blips[part]
					if not blip then
						local dot = Instance.new("Frame")
						dot.Name = ""
						dot.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
						dot.Rotation = 45
						dot.BorderSizePixel = 0
						dot.ZIndex = 4
						local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
						stroke.Color = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
						stroke.Transparency = 0.2
						stroke.Parent = dot
						-- The tag sits in an unrotated holder so the diamond's 45 degrees don't tilt it.
						local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
						label.Name = ""
						label.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0)
						label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
						label.FontFace = library.font
						label.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.4
						label.ZIndex = 4
						blip = { dot = dot, label = label }
						c4Blips[part] = blip
					end
					if blip.dot.Parent ~= parent then
						blip.dot.Parent = parent
						blip.label.Parent = parent
					end
					local position, outside = place(part.Position)
					local dotSize = outside and 6 or 8
					blip.dot.Position = position
					blip.dot.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(dotSize, dotSize)
					blip.dot.BackgroundColor3 = color
					blip.dot.BackgroundTransparency = outside and 0.4 or 0
					blip.label.Position = position + UDim2.fromOffset(0, dotSize / 2 + 3)
					blip.label.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(80, textSize + 1)
					blip.label.TextSize = textSize
					blip.label.TextColor3 = color:Lerp(Color3.new(1, 1, 1), 0.35)
					blip.label.TextTransparency = outside and 0.5 or 0
					blip.label.Text = string.format("C4 %dm", math.floor((part.Position - origin).Magnitude / 3.571))
				end
			end
			for part, blip in pairs(c4Blips) do
				if not seen[part] then
					blip.dot:Destroy()
					blip.label:Destroy()
					c4Blips[part] = nil
				end
			end
		end

		-- Panel radar: a dark rectangle with you as the white dot in the middle, a soft cone showing
		-- where you're looking (always up), faint axes, and every player as a dot with their distance.
		local panel = Instance.new("Frame")
		panel.Name = ""
		panel.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0)
		panel.Position = UDim2.new(1, -16, 0, 70)
		panel.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(10, 10, 12)
		panel.BackgroundTransparency = 0.08
		panel.BorderSizePixel = 0
		panel.ClipsDescendants = true
		panel.Active = true
		panel.Draggable = true
		panel.Visible = false
		panel.Parent = radarGui
		local panelCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
		panelCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)
		panelCorner.Parent = panel
		local panelStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
		panelStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(40, 40, 46)
		panelStroke.Parent = panel

		local function panelText(text, anchor, position, size)
			local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
			label.Name = ""
			label.AnchorPoint = anchor
			label.Position = position
			label.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(120, 14)
			label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
			label.FontFace = library.font
			label.TextSize = size
			label.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(150, 150, 160)
			label.TextXAlignment = anchor.X == 0 and Enum.TextXAlignment.Left or Enum.TextXAlignment.Right
			label.Text = text
			label.ZIndex = 5
			label.Parent = panel
			return label
		end
		Hooks.panelRadarTitle = panelText("Radar", Vector2.new(0, 0), UDim2.fromOffset(10, 6), 12)
		local panelRange = panelText("", Vector2.new(1, 1), UDim2.new(1, -10, 1, -6), 11)

		-- Faint axes through the middle.
		for _, vertical in ipairs({ true, false }) do
			local axis = Instance.new("Frame")
			axis.Name = ""
			axis.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
			axis.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
			axis.Size = vertical and UDim2.new(0, 1, 1, 0) or UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 1)
			axis.BorderSizePixel = 0
			axis.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
			axis.BackgroundTransparency = 0.93
			axis.Parent = panel
		end

		-- The view cone: a fan of faint lines from the middle, 35 degrees either side of straight up.
		-- Each line sits in a square layer centered on you, so rotating the layer swings the line.
		local cone = {}
		for index = 1, 25 do
			local layer = Instance.new("Frame")
			layer.Name = ""
			layer.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
			layer.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
			layer.BackgroundTransparency = 1
			layer.Rotation = (index + NEG_ONE) / 24 * 70 + NEG_ONE * 35
			layer.ZIndex = 1
			layer.Parent = panel
			local line = Instance.new("Frame")
			line.Name = ""
			line.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 1)
			line.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
			line.Size = UDim2.new(0, 4, 0.5, 0)
			line.BorderSizePixel = 0
			line.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
			line.BackgroundTransparency = 0.955
			line.Parent = layer
			local fade = Instance.new("UIGradient")
			fade.Rotation = 90
			fade.Transparency = NumberSequence.new(0.3, 1)
			fade.Parent = line
			cone[index] = layer
		end

		local panelMe = Instance.new("Frame")
		panelMe.Name = ""
		panelMe.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
		panelMe.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
		panelMe.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(7, 7)
		panelMe.BorderSizePixel = 0
		panelMe.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
		panelMe.ZIndex = 4
		panelMe.Parent = panel
		round(panelMe)

		local panelBlips = {}
		local function getPanelBlip(player)
			local blip = panelBlips[player]
			if blip then
				return blip
			end
			local dot = Instance.new("Frame")
			dot.Name = ""
			dot.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
			dot.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(6, 6)
			dot.BorderSizePixel = 0
			dot.ZIndex = 3
			dot.Parent = panel
			round(dot)
			local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
			label.Name = ""
			label.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0)
			label.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 1, 2)
			label.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(90, 11)
			label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
			label.FontFace = library.font
			label.TextSize = 10
			label.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 200, 210)
			label.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.5
			label.ZIndex = 3
			label.Parent = dot
			blip = { dot = dot, label = label }
			panelBlips[player] = blip
			return blip
		end

		---Draw the panel radar (`look`/`right` flattened camera directions).
		local function updatePanel(origin, look, right, range, size)
			local width, height = math.floor(size * 2.4), math.floor(size * 1.25)
			panel.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(width, height)
			local coneSize = UDim2.fromOffset(height * 1.6, height * 1.6)
			for _, layer in ipairs(cone) do
				layer.Size = coneSize
			end
			panelRange.Text = string.format("%d studs", range)
			local textSize = flags.radar_text_size or 10
			panelRange.TextSize = textSize + 1
			Hooks.panelRadarTitle.TextSize = textSize + 2

			local halfWidth, halfHeight = width / 2 + NEG_ONE * 8, height / 2 + NEG_ONE * 8
			local scale = halfHeight / range
			local seen = {}
			for _, player in ipairs(playersService:GetPlayers()) do
				local character = player ~= localPlayer and player.Character
				local rootPart = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
				local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
				local teammate = player.Team ~= nil and player.Team == localPlayer.Team
				if not (rootPart and humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0) or (teammate and not flags.radar_teammates) then
					continue
				end
				seen[player] = true
				local offset = rootPart.Position - origin
				local x = offset:Dot(right) * scale
				local y = offset:Dot(look) * scale * NEG_ONE
				-- Off the map: held at the edge, dimmer.
				local fit = math.min(1, halfWidth / math.max(math.abs(x), 0.001), halfHeight / math.max(math.abs(y), 0.001))
				x, y = x * fit, y * fit
				local blip = getPanelBlip(player)
				blip.dot.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, x, 0.5, y)
				blip.dot.BackgroundColor3 = teammate and Color3.fromRGB(90, 200, 255)
					or (player.Team and player.TeamColor.Color) or Color3.fromRGB(255, 70, 70)
				blip.dot.BackgroundTransparency = fit < 1 and 0.45 or 0
				local meters = math.floor(offset.Magnitude / 3.571)
				blip.label.Text = flags.radar_names and string.format("%s %dm", player.DisplayName, meters) or string.format("%dm", meters)
				blip.label.TextTransparency = fit < 1 and 0.5 or 0
				blip.label.TextSize = textSize
				blip.label.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(120, textSize + 1)
				blip.dot.Visible = true
			end
			for player, blip in pairs(panelBlips) do
				if not seen[player] then
					blip.dot.Visible = false
				end
				if not player.Parent then
					blip.dot:Destroy()
					panelBlips[player] = nil
				end
			end

			Hooks.drawRadarC4(panel, function(position)
				local offset = position - origin
				local x = offset:Dot(right) * scale
				local y = offset:Dot(look) * scale * NEG_ONE
				local fit = math.min(1, halfWidth / math.max(math.abs(x), 0.001), halfHeight / math.max(math.abs(y), 0.001))
				return UDim2.new(0.5, x * fit, 0.5, y * fit), fit < 1
			end, origin)
		end

		local sweepAngle = 0
		local radarShown = false
		local radarElapsed = 0

		library:connection(runService.RenderStepped, function(deltaTime)
			local enabled = flags.radar_enabled == true
			local panelStyle = flags.radar_style == "Panel"

			if radar.Visible ~= (enabled and not panelStyle) then
				radar.Visible = enabled and not panelStyle
			end
			if panel.Visible ~= (enabled and panelStyle) then
				panel.Visible = enabled and panelStyle
			end
			radarShown = enabled

			if not enabled then
				return
			end

			-- Capped by the performance profile; the skipped time is carried into the next update.
			radarElapsed += deltaTime
			if radarElapsed < Hooks.visualInterval() then
				return
			end
			deltaTime = math.min(radarElapsed, 0.1)
			radarElapsed = 0

			local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
			local myRoot = localPlayer.Character and localPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			local origin = myRoot and myRoot.Position or camera.CFrame.Position
			local look = camera.CFrame.LookVector
			look = Vector3.new(look.X, 0, look.Z)
			look = look.Magnitude > 0 and look.Unit or Vector3.new(0, 0, -1)
			local right = Vector3.new(-look.Z, 0, look.X)

			local size = flags.radar_size or 200
			local radius = size / 2
			local range = flags.radar_range or 300
			local accent = flags.radar_match_theme and getAccent() or (flags.radar_color and flags.radar_color.Color or Color3.fromRGB(110, 90, 255))
			local now = os.clock()

			if panelStyle then
				return updatePanel(origin, look, right, range, size)
			end

			radar.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(size, size)
			edge.Color = accent
			me.BackgroundColor3 = accent
			rangeLabel.Text = string.format("%d studs", range)
			local textSize = flags.radar_text_size or 10
			rangeLabel.TextSize = textSize + 1

			for _, decoration in ipairs(decorations) do
				if decoration:IsA("UIStroke") then
					decoration.Color = accent
				else
					decoration.BackgroundColor3 = accent
				end
			end

			-- Advance the sweep; remember where it was so blips it crossed this frame get pinged.
			local previousSweep = sweepAngle
			sweepAngle = (sweepAngle + deltaTime * (flags.radar_speed or 0.5) * 360) % 360

			for index, sweep in ipairs(sweepLines) do
				sweep.layer.Rotation = sweepAngle + (index - 1) * 2.4 * NEG_ONE
				sweep.line.BackgroundColor3 = accent
			end

			local fadeTime = flags.radar_fade or 1.6
			local seen = {}

			for _, player in ipairs(playersService:GetPlayers()) do
				if player == localPlayer then
					continue
				end

				local character = player.Character
				local rootPart = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
				local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
				local teammate = player.Team ~= nil and player.Team == localPlayer.Team

				if not (rootPart and humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0) or (teammate and not flags.radar_teammates) then
					continue
				end

				seen[player] = true

				local blip = getBlip(player)
				local offset = rootPart.Position - origin
				local x = offset:Dot(right) / range * radius
				local y = -offset:Dot(look) / range * radius
				local distance = math.sqrt(x * x + y * y)
				local outside = distance > radius - 4

				-- Players out of range sit on the rim, smaller and dimmer.
				if outside then
					x, y = x / distance * (radius - 4), y / distance * (radius - 4)
				end

				-- Blip angle measured clockwise from "up", matching the sweep's rotation.
				local angle = (math.deg(math.atan2(x, -y)) + 360) % 360
				local crossed = previousSweep <= sweepAngle and (angle > previousSweep and angle <= sweepAngle)
					or previousSweep > sweepAngle and (angle > previousSweep or angle <= sweepAngle)

				if crossed then
					blip.pingedAt = now
				end

				local fade = flags.radar_reveal and math.clamp((now - blip.pingedAt) / fadeTime, 0, 1) or 0
				local pop = flags.radar_reveal and (1 - fade) ^ 3 * 0.8 or 0
				local dotSize = (outside and 5 or 7) * (1 + pop)
				local color = teammate and Color3.fromRGB(90, 200, 255)
					or (player.Team and player.TeamColor.Color)
					or Color3.fromRGB(255, 70, 70)

				blip.dot.Visible = fade < 1
				blip.dot.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(radius + x, radius + y)
				blip.dot.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(dotSize, dotSize)
				blip.dot.BackgroundColor3 = color
				blip.dot.BackgroundTransparency = math.max(fade, outside and 0.45 or 0)
				blip.outline.Transparency = 0.3 + fade * 0.7
				blip.name.Visible = flags.radar_names == true and not outside
				blip.name.TextTransparency = fade
				blip.name.TextSize = textSize
				blip.name.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(100, textSize)
			end

			Hooks.drawRadarC4(radar, function(position)
				local offset = position - origin
				local x = offset:Dot(right) / range * radius
				local y = offset:Dot(look) / range * radius * NEG_ONE
				local distance = math.sqrt(x * x + y * y)
				local outside = distance > radius + NEG_ONE * 4
				if outside then
					x, y = x / distance * (radius + NEG_ONE * 4), y / distance * (radius + NEG_ONE * 4)
				end
				return UDim2.fromOffset(radius + x, radius + y), outside
			end, origin)

			-- Hide blips for players who left, died or got filtered out.
			for player, blip in pairs(blips) do
				if not seen[player] then
					blip.dot.Visible = false
				end

				if not player.Parent then
					blip.dot:Destroy()
					blips[player] = nil
				end
			end
		end)

		onUnload(function()
			radarGui:Destroy()
		end)
	end

	-- Sonar: an expanding ring pulses out from you along the ground; anyone it passes is
	-- briefly revealed through walls with a highlight and a distance tag.
	do
		local sonarFolder = Instance.new("Folder")
		sonarFolder.Name = ""
		sonarFolder:SetAttribute("AquaLabs", true)
		sonarFolder.Parent = coreGui

		local pulses = {}
		local reveals = {}
		local lastPulse = 0

		local sonarSection = visualsTab:section({ name = "Sonar", side = "left" })

		addFeature(sonarSection, { name = "Sonar", flag = "sonar_enabled" })
		sonarSection:colorpicker({ flag = "sonar_color", color = Color3.fromRGB(80, 200, 255) })
		sonarSection:toggle({ name = "match theme color", flag = "sonar_match_theme", default = false })
		sonarSection:slider({ name = "pulse every", flag = "sonar_interval", min = 0.5, max = 10, default = 3, interval = 0.25, suffix = "s" })
		sonarSection:slider({ name = "sonar range", flag = "sonar_range", min = 25, max = 600, default = 150, interval = 5, suffix = " studs" })
		sonarSection:slider({ name = "pulse speed", flag = "sonar_speed", min = 20, max = 400, default = 120, interval = 5, suffix = " st/s" })
		sonarSection:slider({ name = "reveal time", flag = "sonar_reveal", min = 0.3, max = 5, default = 1.5, interval = 0.1, suffix = "s" })
		sonarSection:toggle({ name = "ring through walls", flag = "sonar_on_top", default = false })
		sonarSection:toggle({ name = "ping sound", flag = "sonar_sound", default = false })

		local pingSound = Instance.new("Sound")
		pingSound.Name = ""
		pingSound.SoundId = "rbxasset://sounds/electronicpingshort.wav"
		pingSound.Volume = 0.4
		pingSound.Parent = sonarFolder

		---Briefly reveal a player the pulse just passed.
		---@param player Player
		---@param character Model
		---@param distance number
		---@param color Color3
		local function reveal(player, character, distance, color)
			local entry = reveals[player]

			if not entry then
				local highlight = Instance.new("Highlight")
				highlight.Name = ""
				highlight.DepthMode = Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop
				highlight.Parent = sonarFolder

				local tag = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
				tag.Name = ""
				tag.AlwaysOnTop = true
				tag.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(90, 18)
				tag.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, 3.4, 0)
				tag.Parent = sonarFolder

				local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
				label.Name = ""
				label.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
				label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
				label.TextSize = 12
				label.FontFace = library.font
				label.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.3
				label.Parent = tag

				highlight.Enabled = false

				entry = { highlight = highlight, chams = Chams.new(sonarFolder), tag = tag, label = label }
				reveals[player] = entry
			end

			entry.startedAt = os.clock()
			entry.color = color
			entry.character = character
			entry.tag.Adornee = character:FindFirstChild("Head") or character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			entry.label.Text = string.format("%s · %dm", player.DisplayName, math.floor(distance / 3.571))
			entry.label.TextColor3 = color
			entry.tag.Enabled = true
		end

		---Start a new ring at your feet.
		local function emitPulse()
			local root = localPlayer.Character and localPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			if not root then
				return
			end

			local ring = Instance.new("CylinderHandleAdornment")
			ring.Name = ""
			ring.Adornee = workspace.Terrain
			ring.Height = 0.15
			ring.Radius = 1
			ring.InnerRadius = 0.5
			ring.AlwaysOnTop = flags.sonar_on_top == true
			ring.ZIndex = 1
			-- Cylinders point along Z; tip it flat onto the ground under you.
			ring.CFrame = CFrame.new(root.Position - Vector3.new(0, 2.8, 0)) * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(90), 0, 0)
			ring.Parent = sonarFolder

			table.insert(pulses, { ring = ring, origin = root.Position, radius = 0, hit = {} })

			if flags.sonar_sound then
				pingSound:Play()
			end
		end

		library:connection(runService.RenderStepped, function(deltaTime)
			local now = os.clock()
			local color = flags.sonar_match_theme and getAccent() or (flags.sonar_color and flags.sonar_color.Color or Color3.fromRGB(80, 200, 255))

			if flags.sonar_enabled and now - lastPulse >= (flags.sonar_interval or 3) then
				lastPulse = now
				emitPulse()
			end

			-- Grow rings and reveal anyone a ring just reached.
			local range = flags.sonar_range or 150

			for index = #pulses, 1, -1 do
				local pulse = pulses[index]
				local previous = pulse.radius
				pulse.radius += deltaTime * (flags.sonar_speed or 120)

				local progress = pulse.radius / range
				if progress >= 1 then
					pulse.ring:Destroy()
					table.remove(pulses, index)
					continue
				end

				local thickness = math.max(0.6, pulse.radius * 0.04)
				pulse.ring.Radius = pulse.radius
				pulse.ring.InnerRadius = math.max(pulse.radius - thickness, 0)
				pulse.ring.Color3 = color
				pulse.ring.Transparency = 0.15 + progress ^ 2 * 0.85

				for _, player in ipairs(playersService:GetPlayers()) do
					if player == localPlayer or pulse.hit[player] then
						continue
					end

					if isGloballyWhitelisted(player) then
						continue
					end
					if flags.esp_target_only and flags.global_target_only_enabled then
						if not listHas(flags.global_target_only, player.Name) then
							continue
						end
					end
					local etw = flags.esp_team_whitelist
					if player.Team and type(etw) == "table" and table.find(etw, player.Team.Name) then
						continue
					end
					if flags.esp_team_check and player.Team and player.Team == localPlayer.Team then
						continue
					end

					local character = player.Character
					local rootPart = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
					local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
					if not (rootPart and humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0) then
						continue
					end

					local flat = rootPart.Position - pulse.origin
					local distance = Vector2.new(flat.X, flat.Z).Magnitude

					if distance > previous and distance <= pulse.radius then
						pulse.hit[player] = true
						reveal(player, character, distance, color)
					end
				end
			end

			-- Fade reveals out.
			local revealTime = flags.sonar_reveal or 1.5

			for player, entry in pairs(reveals) do
				if not entry.startedAt then
					continue
				end

				local fade = math.clamp((now - entry.startedAt) / revealTime, 0, 1)

				if fade >= 1 or not player.Parent or not entry.character.Parent then
					entry.startedAt = nil
					entry.chams:clear()
					entry.tag.Enabled = false
				else
					-- Solid chams flash through walls, then fade.
					entry.chams:update(entry.character, entry.color, 0.3 + fade * 0.7, true, now)
					entry.label.TextTransparency = fade
					entry.label.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.3 + fade * 0.7
				end
			end
		end)

		onUnload(function()
			table.clear(pulses)
			sonarFolder:Destroy()
		end)
	end

	buildPlayerEsp()
	buildSelfVisuals()
	buildRadarCrosshair()
end
do
	Intro.step("loading world visuals", 0.76)

	-- World tab.
	local worldTab = Tabs.world
	Tabs.world = worldTab

	---Keep one of our effects parented while enabled, and remove it when disabled.
	---@param effect Instance
	---@param enabled boolean
	local function setEffectEnabled(effect, enabled)
		effect.Parent = enabled and lightingService or nil
	end

	---Hide instances of a class the game owns in Lighting, keeping them to restore later.
	---@param className string
	---@param keep Instance
	---@param stash table
	local function stashLightingChildren(className, keep, stash)
		for _, child in ipairs(lightingService:GetChildren()) do
			if child:IsA(className) and child ~= keep then
				table.insert(stash, child)
				child.Parent = nil
			end
		end
	end

	---Put stashed game instances back into Lighting.
	---@param stash table
	local function restoreStash(stash)
		for _, child in ipairs(stash) do
			pcall(function()
				child.Parent = lightingService
			end)
		end

		table.clear(stash)
	end

	-- Color correction.
	local colorCorrection = Instance.new("ColorCorrectionEffect")
	colorCorrection.Name = ""

			setEffectEnabled(colorCorrection, enabled)

	colorSection:colorpicker({
		flag = "world_color_tint",
		color = Color3.new(1, 1, 1),
		callback = function(color)
			colorCorrection.TintColor = color

	})

	colorSection:slider({
		name = "saturation",
		flag = "world_color_saturation",
		min = -1,
		max = 1,
		default = 0,
		interval = 0.01,
		callback = function(value)
			colorCorrection.Saturation = value
		end,
	})

	colorSection:slider({
		name = "contrast",
		flag = "world_color_contrast",
		min = -1,
		max = 1,

	colorSection:slider({
		name = "brightness",
		flag = "world_color_brightness",
		min = -1,

		default = 0,
		interval = 0.01,
		callback = function(value)
			colorCorrection.Brightness = value
		end,
