	-- Atmosphere, swapped in place of the game's own.
	local atmosphere = Instance.new("Atmosphere")
	atmosphere.Name = ""
	local stashedAtmospheres = {}

	---Any Atmosphere fades the skybox into its haze (black at night), so a custom sky clears them.
	---@return boolean
	local function skyClearsAtmosphere()
		return flags.world_skybox == true
	end

	---Decide which atmosphere (ours, the game's, or none) should be in Lighting right now.
	local function syncAtmospheres()
		if skyClearsAtmosphere() then
			stashLightingChildren("Atmosphere", atmosphere, stashedAtmospheres)
			atmosphere.Parent = nil
		elseif flags.world_atmosphere then
			stashLightingChildren("Atmosphere", atmosphere, stashedAtmospheres)
			atmosphere.Parent = lightingService
		else
			atmosphere.Parent = nil
			restoreStash(stashedAtmospheres)
		end
	end

	local atmosphereSection = worldTab:section({ name = "Atmosphere", side = "left" })

	addFeature(atmosphereSection, {
		name = "Atmosphere",
		flag = "world_atmosphere",
		callback = syncAtmospheres,
	})

	atmosphereSection:colorpicker({
		flag = "world_atmosphere_color",
		color = Color3.fromRGB(199, 170, 107),
		callback = function(color)
			atmosphere.Color = color
		end,
	})

	atmosphereSection:colorpicker({
		name = "decay",
		flag = "world_atmosphere_decay",
		color = Color3.fromRGB(92, 60, 13),
		callback = function(color)
			atmosphere.Decay = color
		end,
	})

	for _, setting in ipairs({
		{ name = "density", property = "Density", max = 1, default = 0.3 },
		{ name = "offset", property = "Offset", max = 1, default = 0.25 },
		{ name = "haze", property = "Haze", max = 10, default = 0 },
		{ name = "glare", property = "Glare", max = 10, default = 0 },
	}) do
		atmosphereSection:slider({
			name = setting.name,
			flag = "world_atmosphere_" .. setting.name,
			min = 0,
			max = setting.max,
			default = setting.default,
			interval = 0.01,
			callback = function(value)
				atmosphere[setting.property] = value
			end,
		})
	end

	-- Lighting overrides: each property is re-applied whenever the game changes it.
	local lightingSection = worldTab:section({ name = "Lighting", side = "left" })
	local lightingOriginals = {}
	local lightingValues = {}
	local lightingEnabled = {}

	---Write an overridden lighting value if its override is on.
	---@param property string
	local function applyLighting(property)
		if lightingEnabled[property] and lightingValues[property] ~= nil then
			lightingService[property] = lightingValues[property]
		end
	end

	for _, override in ipairs(LIGHTING_OVERRIDES) do
		local property = override.property
		local flag = "world_lighting_" .. string.lower(property)

		lightingValues[property] = lightingService[property]
		-- "ColorShift_Bottom" -> "Color Shift Bottom".
		local prettyName = (string.gsub(string.gsub(property, "_", " "), "(%l)(%u)", "%1 %2"))

		addFeature(lightingSection, {
			name = override.label or prettyName,
			flag = flag,
			callback = function(enabled)
				local wasEnabled = lightingEnabled[property]

				-- Flip state before writing, or the change listener re-applies the override.
				lightingEnabled[property] = enabled

				if enabled and not wasEnabled then
					lightingOriginals[property] = lightingService[property]
					applyLighting(property)
				elseif not enabled and wasEnabled then
					lightingService[property] = lightingOriginals[property]
				end
			end,
		})

		if override.kind == "color" then
			lightingSection:colorpicker({
				flag = flag .. "_value",
				color = lightingService[property],
				callback = function(color)
					lightingValues[property] = color
					applyLighting(property)
				end,
			})
		elseif override.kind == "number" then
			lightingSection:slider({
				name = string.lower(prettyName),
				flag = flag .. "_value",
				min = override.min,
				max = override.max,
				default = math.clamp(lightingService[property], override.min, override.max),
				interval = override.interval,
				callback = function(value)
					lightingValues[property] = value
					applyLighting(property)
				end,
			})
		elseif override.kind == "boolean" then
			lightingValues[property] = false
		end

		library:connection(lightingService:GetPropertyChangedSignal(property), function()
			if lightingEnabled[property] and lightingService[property] ~= lightingValues[property] then
				applyLighting(property)
			end
		end)
	end

	table.insert(worldCleanupTasks, function()
		for property, enabled in pairs(lightingEnabled) do
			if enabled then
				lightingEnabled[property] = false
				pcall(function()
					lightingService[property] = lightingOriginals[property]
				end)
			end
		end
	end)

	-- Skybox: presets plus live toolbox search.
	local skyCache = {}
	local stashedSkies = {}
	local activeSky = nil
	local selectedSkyId = SKYBOX_PRESETS[1][2]
	local searchResults = {}

	---Load the Sky out of a toolbox model, cached per asset id.
	---@param assetId number
	---@return Sky?
	local function loadSky(assetId)
		if skyCache[assetId] then
			return skyCache[assetId]
		end

		-- A table of six images (Bk, Dn, Ft, Lf, Rt, Up) builds the sky directly.
		if type(assetId) == "table" then
			local sky = Instance.new("Sky")
			sky.Name = ""
			sky.SkyboxBk, sky.SkyboxDn, sky.SkyboxFt = assetId[1], assetId[2], assetId[3]
			sky.SkyboxLf, sky.SkyboxRt, sky.SkyboxUp = assetId[4], assetId[5], assetId[6]
			skyCache[assetId] = sky
			return sky
		end

		-- "image:<content id>" builds a sky with the same picture on all six faces.
		local image = type(assetId) == "string" and assetId:match("^image:(.+)$")
		if image then
			local sky = Instance.new("Sky")
			sky.Name = ""
			sky.SkyboxBk, sky.SkyboxDn, sky.SkyboxFt = image, image, image
			sky.SkyboxLf, sky.SkyboxRt, sky.SkyboxUp = image, image, image
			sky.StarCount = 0
			skyCache[assetId] = sky
			return sky
		end

		-- Same loaders as Limiteds, in case the executor has no getobjects.
		local content = "rbxassetid://" .. tostring(assetId)
		local loaders = {
			function()
				return getobjects(game, content)
			end,
			function()
				return game:GetObjects(content)
			end,
			function()
				return { game:GetService("InsertService"):LoadLocalAsset(content) }
			end,
		}
		for _, loader in ipairs(loaders) do
			local success, objects = pcall(loader)
			for _, object in ipairs(success and type(objects) == "table" and objects or {}) do
				local sky = object:IsA("Sky") and object or object:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Sky", true)
				if sky then
					sky.Archivable = true
					local clone = sky:Clone()
					if clone then
						clone.Name = ""
						skyCache[assetId] = clone
						return clone
					end
				end
			end
		end

		return nil
	end

	-- Terrain clouds draw in front of the sky (a heavy cloud cover hides any skybox completely), so
	-- they're switched off while a custom sky is on and given back after.
	local hiddenClouds = {}
	local function setCloudsHidden(hidden)
		if hidden then
			for _, clouds in ipairs(workspace.Terrain:GetChildren()) do
				if clouds:IsA("Clouds") and clouds.Enabled then
					hiddenClouds[clouds] = true
					clouds.Enabled = false
				end
			end
			return
		end
		for clouds in pairs(hiddenClouds) do
			if clouds.Parent then
				clouds.Enabled = true
			end
		end
		table.clear(hiddenClouds)
	end

	---Swap the selected sky in, or put the game's sky back.
	local function refreshSky()
		if activeSky then
			activeSky.Parent = nil
			activeSky = nil
		end

		syncAtmospheres()

		if not flags.world_skybox then
			restoreStash(stashedSkies)
			setCloudsHidden(false)
			return
		end

		local assetId = selectedSkyId
		task.spawn(function()
			-- Protected, with the reason shown: a failure in here used to vanish without a word.
			local ok, problem = pcall(function()
				local sky = loadSky(assetId)
				if not sky then
					return library:notification({ text = "That skybox failed to load (not a sky, or the download failed)." })
				end

				if not flags.world_skybox or assetId ~= selectedSkyId then
					return
				end

				stashLightingChildren("Sky", sky, stashedSkies)
				setCloudsHidden(true)
				activeSky = sky
				sky.Parent = lightingService
			end)
			if not ok then
				warn("[Aqua] skybox:", problem)
				library:notification({ text = "Skybox error: " .. tostring(problem), time = 5 })
			end
		end)
	end

	---Switch to a newly picked sky (preset, decal or search result). The game's haze is always
	---cleared while a custom sky is on.
	local function pickSky(skyId)
		selectedSkyId = skyId
		refreshSky()
	end

	local skySection = worldTab:section({ name = "Skybox", side = "right" })

	addFeature(skySection, {
		name = "Skybox",
		flag = "world_skybox",
		callback = refreshSky,
	})

	local presetNames = {}
	local presetIds = {}
	for _, preset in ipairs(SKYBOX_PRESETS) do
		table.insert(presetNames, preset[1])
		presetIds[preset[1]] = preset[2]
	end

	skySection:dropdown({
		name = "Preset",
		flag = "world_skybox_preset",
		items = presetNames,
		default = presetNames[1],
		callback = function(name)
			if presetIds[name] then
				pickSky(presetIds[name])
			end
		end,
	})

	skySection:textbox({
		placeholder = "Custom sky: decal / image id",
		flag = "world_skybox_image",
		callback = function(input)
			if not input or not input:match("%d+") then
				return
			end

			task.spawn(function()
				local image = resolveImage(input)
				if image == "" then
					return
				end

				pickSky("image:" .. image)
			end)
		end,
	})

	skySection:textbox({
		placeholder = "search skyboxes",
		flag = "world_skybox_query",
	})

	local resultsDropdown

	skySection:button({
		name = "Search",
		callback = function()
			local query = flags.world_skybox_query
			if type(query) ~= "string" or query == "" then
				return library:notification({ text = "Type something to search first." })
			end

			if not string.find(string.lower(query), "sky") then
				query = query .. " skybox"
			end

			task.spawn(function()
				local response = request({
					Url = TOOLBOX_SEARCH_URL .. httpService:UrlEncode(query),
					Method = "GET",
				})

				local success, data = pcall(httpService.JSONDecode, httpService, response.Body)
				if not success or type(data.creatorStoreAssets) ~= "table" then
					return library:notification({ text = "Search failed." })
				end

				table.clear(searchResults)
				local names = {}

				for _, entry in ipairs(data.creatorStoreAssets) do
					local asset = entry.asset
					if not asset or asset.hasScripts then
						continue
					end

					local name = string.sub(asset.name, 1, 28)
					if searchResults[name] then
						name = name .. " #" .. asset.id
					end

					searchResults[name] = asset.id
					table.insert(names, name)
				end

				resultsDropdown:refresh_options(#names > 0 and names or { "---" })
				library:notification({ text = string.format("Found %d skyboxes.", #names) })
			end)
		end,
	})

	resultsDropdown = skySection:dropdown({
		name = "Search results",
		flag = "world_skybox_result",
		items = { "---" },
		default = "---",
		callback = function(name)
			if searchResults[name] then
				pickSky(searchResults[name])
			end
		end,
	})

	-- Keep game-made skies and atmospheres out while ours are active.
	library:connection(lightingService.ChildAdded, function(child)
		task.defer(function()
			if child:IsA("Sky") and activeSky and child ~= activeSky then
				table.insert(stashedSkies, child)
				child.Parent = nil
			elseif child:IsA("Atmosphere") and (flags.world_atmosphere or skyClearsAtmosphere()) and child ~= atmosphere then
				table.insert(stashedAtmospheres, child)
				child.Parent = nil
			end
		end)
	end)

	-- Weather: rain, snow and heavy rain each get their own emitter so they can run together.
	---Create an invisible emitter plate that follows the camera.
	---@param size number
	---@return Part, ParticleEmitter
	local function createWeatherEmitter(size)
		local plate = Instance.new("Part")
		plate.Name = ""
		plate.Anchored = true
		plate.CanCollide = false
		plate.CanQuery = false
		plate.CanTouch = false
		plate.Transparency = 1
		plate.Size = Vector3.new(size, 1, size)

		local emitter = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
		emitter.Texture = "rbxasset://textures/particles/sparkles_main.dds"
		emitter.EmissionDirection = Enum.NormalId.Bottom
		emitter.Parent = plate

		return plate, emitter
	end

	local weatherPart, rainEmitter = createWeatherEmitter(160)
	rainEmitter.Size = NumberSequence.new(0.12)
	rainEmitter.Squash = NumberSequence.new(3)
	rainEmitter.Speed = NumberRange.new(90, 110)
	rainEmitter.SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(2, 2)
	rainEmitter.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(1, 1.2)
	rainEmitter.Transparency = NumberSequence.new(0.35)

	local snowPart, snowEmitter = createWeatherEmitter(160)
	snowEmitter.Size = NumberSequence.new(0.35)
	snowEmitter.Speed = NumberRange.new(6, 10)
	snowEmitter.SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(25, 25)
	snowEmitter.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(8, 10)
	snowEmitter.RotSpeed = NumberRange.new(-60, 60)
	snowEmitter.Transparency = NumberSequence.new(0.1)

	local heavyRainPart, heavyRainEmitter = createWeatherEmitter(120)
	heavyRainEmitter.Size = NumberSequence.new(0.16)
	heavyRainEmitter.Squash = NumberSequence.new(3)
	heavyRainEmitter.Speed = NumberRange.new(150, 180)
	heavyRainEmitter.SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(4, 4)
	heavyRainEmitter.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.6, 0.8)
	heavyRainEmitter.Transparency = NumberSequence.new(0.2)
	heavyRainEmitter.LightInfluence = 0.6
	heavyRainEmitter.Rate = 2500

	---The color the rest of the world is tinted, if any world visual sets one.
	---@return Color3?
	local function getWorldTint()
		if flags.world_color_correction and flags.world_color_tint then
			local tint = flags.world_color_tint.Color
			-- Pure white tint means "no tint", so fall through to lighting.
			if tint ~= Color3.new(1, 1, 1) then
				return tint
			end
		end

		if lightingEnabled.Ambient and lightingValues.Ambient then
			return lightingValues.Ambient
		end

		if lightingEnabled.OutdoorAmbient and lightingValues.OutdoorAmbient then
			return lightingValues.OutdoorAmbient
		end

		return nil
	end

	---Color each weather layer from its own picker, or from the world tint when matching.
	local function applyWeatherColors()
		local tint = flags.world_weather_match and getWorldTint() or nil

		local rainColor = tint or (flags.world_rain_color and flags.world_rain_color.Color or Color3.fromRGB(170, 200, 255))
		local snowColor = tint or (flags.world_snow_color and flags.world_snow_color.Color or Color3.new(1, 1, 1))
		local heavyColor = tint or (flags.world_heavy_rain_color and flags.world_heavy_rain_color.Color or Color3.fromRGB(190, 210, 240))

		rainEmitter.Color = ColorSequence.new(rainColor)
		snowEmitter.Color = ColorSequence.new(snowColor)
		heavyRainEmitter.Color = ColorSequence.new(heavyColor)

		-- Matching colors glow a little so tinted weather still reads at night.
		local glow = flags.world_weather_glow and 0.6 or 0
		rainEmitter.LightEmission = glow
		snowEmitter.LightEmission = glow
		heavyRainEmitter.LightEmission = glow
	end

	local weatherSection = worldTab:section({ name = "Weather", side = "right" })

	addFeature(weatherSection, {
		name = "Rain",
		flag = "world_weather",
		callback = function(enabled)
			weatherPart.Parent = enabled and workspace.CurrentCamera or nil
		end,
	})
	weatherSection:colorpicker({ flag = "world_rain_color", color = Color3.fromRGB(170, 200, 255), callback = applyWeatherColors })
	weatherSection:slider({
		name = "rain intensity",
		flag = "world_weather_intensity",
		min = 0.05,
		max = 1,
		default = 0.5,
		interval = 0.01,
		callback = function(value)
			rainEmitter.Rate = 1500 * value
		end,
	})

	addFeature(weatherSection, {
		name = "Snow",
		flag = "world_snow",
		callback = function(enabled)
			snowPart.Parent = enabled and workspace.CurrentCamera or nil
		end,
	})
	weatherSection:colorpicker({ flag = "world_snow_color", color = Color3.new(1, 1, 1), callback = applyWeatherColors })
	weatherSection:slider({
		name = "snow intensity",
		flag = "world_snow_intensity",
		min = 0.05,
		max = 1,
		default = 0.5,
		interval = 0.01,
		callback = function(value)
			snowEmitter.Rate = 500 * value
		end,
	})

	addFeature(weatherSection, {
		name = "Heavy Rain",
		flag = "world_heavy_rain",
		callback = function(enabled)
			heavyRainPart.Parent = enabled and workspace.CurrentCamera or nil
		end,
	})
	weatherSection:colorpicker({ flag = "world_heavy_rain_color", color = Color3.fromRGB(190, 210, 240), callback = applyWeatherColors })
	weatherSection:slider({
		name = "wind",
		flag = "world_heavy_rain_wind",
		min = -60,
		max = 60,
		default = 15,
		interval = 1,
		callback = function(value)
			local wind = Vector3.new(value, 0, value * 0.4)
			heavyRainEmitter.Acceleration = wind
			rainEmitter.Acceleration = wind * 0.6
			snowEmitter.Acceleration = wind * 0.15
		end,
	})

	weatherSection:toggle({ name = "match world color", flag = "world_weather_match", default = false, callback = applyWeatherColors })
	weatherSection:toggle({ name = "glowing weather", flag = "world_weather_glow", default = false, callback = applyWeatherColors })

	-- Pick up tint changes made in other sections.
	task.spawn(function()
		while isCurrentRun() and watermarkHolder.Parent do
			task.wait(0.5)
			if not isCurrentRun() then
				break
			end
			applyWeatherColors()
		end
	end)

	-- Shaders: tuned post-processing presets. Effects live in the camera (local only) and every
	-- Lighting value we touch is restored when shaders are turned off.
	local function buildShaders()
			local SHADER_PRESETS = {
				Cinematic = {
					tint = { 255, 244, 232 }, saturation = 0.08, contrast = 0.16, brightness = 0.02,
					bloom = { 0.55, 24, 1.25 }, rays = { 0.07, 0.55 }, depth = { 0.22, 0, 45, 35 }, exposure = 0.12,
				},
				Vibrant = {
					tint = { 255, 255, 255 }, saturation = 0.38, contrast = 0.12, brightness = 0.03,
					bloom = { 0.4, 20, 1.4 }, rays = { 0.1, 0.7 }, depth = nil, exposure = 0.1,
				},
				Realistic = {
					tint = { 250, 250, 255 }, saturation = -0.05, contrast = 0.1, brightness = 0,
					bloom = { 0.3, 30, 1.6 }, rays = { 0.05, 0.4 }, depth = { 0.12, 0, 60, 50 }, exposure = 0,
				},
				Dreamy = {
					tint = { 255, 236, 246 }, saturation = 0.12, contrast = -0.04, brightness = 0.05,
					bloom = { 1.1, 40, 0.9 }, rays = { 0.12, 0.9 }, depth = { 0.3, 0.15, 30, 25 }, exposure = 0.18,
				},
				["Night City"] = {
					tint = { 215, 228, 255 }, saturation = 0.22, contrast = 0.26, brightness = -0.02,
					bloom = { 0.95, 28, 0.85 }, rays = { 0.04, 0.4 }, depth = nil, exposure = -0.15,
				},
				Moody = {
					tint = { 232, 238, 255 }, saturation = -0.35, contrast = 0.3, brightness = -0.04,
					bloom = { 0.35, 22, 1.3 }, rays = { 0.03, 0.3 }, depth = { 0.25, 0, 40, 30 }, exposure = -0.1,
				},
				-- Deep blue water tones with a soft glow on highlights (the aqua labs look).
				Ocean = {
					tint = { 200, 228, 255 }, saturation = 0.18, contrast = 0.18, brightness = 0.01,
					bloom = { 0.7, 30, 1.1 }, rays = { 0.06, 0.5 }, depth = { 0.18, 0, 50, 40 }, exposure = -0.02,
				},
				-- Warm low sun: amber tint, long glow and strong sun rays.
				["Golden Hour"] = {
					tint = { 255, 222, 186 }, saturation = 0.2, contrast = 0.12, brightness = 0.03,
					bloom = { 0.8, 34, 1.05 }, rays = { 0.16, 0.85 }, depth = { 0.15, 0, 55, 45 }, exposure = 0.08,
				},
				-- Sharp and clean: punchy contrast, barely any glow, no blur.
				Crisp = {
					tint = { 252, 252, 255 }, saturation = 0.15, contrast = 0.22, brightness = 0,
					bloom = { 0.15, 12, 1.8 }, rays = { 0.03, 0.3 }, depth = nil, exposure = 0.04,
				},
			}

			local SHADER_ORDER = { "Cinematic", "Vibrant", "Realistic", "Dreamy", "Night City", "Moody", "Ocean", "Golden Hour", "Crisp" }

			-- Changes glide into place instead of snapping.
			local SHADER_GLIDE = TweenInfo.new(0.6, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
			local function glide(effect, goal)
				tweenService:Create(effect, SHADER_GLIDE, goal):Play()
			end

			-- Vignette: the screen edges fade gently to dark (four gradient strips).
			local vignette = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
			vignette.Name = ""
			vignette.IgnoreGuiInset = true
			vignette.DisplayOrder = -1
			vignette.Enabled = false
			vignette.Parent = coreGui
			for _, side in ipairs({ { 0, 0, 1, 0.22, 90 }, { 0, 0.78, 1, 0.22, 270 }, { 0, 0, 0.16, 1, 0 }, { 0.84, 0, 0.16, 1, 180 } }) do
				local strip = Instance.new("Frame")
				strip.BorderSizePixel = 0
				strip.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
				strip.Position = UDim2.fromScale(side[1], side[2])
				strip.Size = UDim2.fromScale(side[3], side[4])
				strip.Parent = vignette
				local fade = Instance.new("UIGradient")
				fade.Rotation = side[5]
				fade.Transparency = NumberSequence.new(0.45, 1)
				fade.Parent = strip
			end
			onUnload(function()
				vignette:Destroy()
			end)

			local shaderCorrection = Instance.new("ColorCorrectionEffect")
			shaderCorrection.Name = ""
			local shaderBloom = Instance.new("BloomEffect")
			shaderBloom.Name = ""
			local shaderRays = Instance.new("SunRaysEffect")
			shaderRays.Name = ""
			local shaderDepth = Instance.new("DepthOfFieldEffect")
			shaderDepth.Name = ""

			local savedLighting = nil

			---Write the chosen preset, scaled by intensity, into our effects.
			local function applyShader()
				local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
				local enabled = flags.shaders_enabled == true
				local preset = SHADER_PRESETS[flags.shader_preset or "Cinematic"] or SHADER_PRESETS.Cinematic
				local strength = flags.shader_intensity or 1

				vignette.Enabled = enabled and flags.shader_vignette ~= false

				if not enabled then
					for _, effect in ipairs({ shaderCorrection, shaderBloom, shaderRays, shaderDepth }) do
						effect.Parent = nil
					end

					if savedLighting then
						for property, value in pairs(savedLighting) do
							pcall(function()
								lightingService[property] = value
							end)
						end

						if savedLighting.Technology then
							pcall(sethiddenproperty, lightingService, "Technology", savedLighting.Technology)
						end

						savedLighting = nil
					end

					return
				end

				-- Remember the game's lighting the first time shaders turn on.
				if not savedLighting then
					local technology = nil
					pcall(function()
						technology = gethiddenproperty(lightingService, "Technology")
					end)

					savedLighting = {
						ExposureCompensation = lightingService.ExposureCompensation,
						EnvironmentDiffuseScale = lightingService.EnvironmentDiffuseScale,
						EnvironmentSpecularScale = lightingService.EnvironmentSpecularScale,
						ShadowSoftness = lightingService.ShadowSoftness,
						Technology = technology,
					}
				end

				local tint = Color3.fromRGB(preset.tint[1], preset.tint[2], preset.tint[3])
				shaderCorrection.Parent = camera
				glide(shaderCorrection, {
					TintColor = Color3.new(1, 1, 1):Lerp(tint, math.min(strength, 1)),
					Saturation = preset.saturation * strength,
					Contrast = preset.contrast * strength,
					Brightness = preset.brightness * strength,
				})

				shaderBloom.Parent = camera
				glide(shaderBloom, { Intensity = preset.bloom[1] * strength, Size = preset.bloom[2], Threshold = preset.bloom[3] })

				shaderRays.Parent = flags.shader_sun_rays ~= false and camera or nil
				glide(shaderRays, { Intensity = preset.rays[1] * strength, Spread = preset.rays[2] })

				if preset.depth and flags.shader_depth ~= false then
					shaderDepth.Parent = camera
					glide(shaderDepth, {
						FarIntensity = preset.depth[1] * strength,
						NearIntensity = preset.depth[2] * strength,
						FocusDistance = preset.depth[3],
						InFocusRadius = preset.depth[4],
					})
				else
					shaderDepth.Parent = nil
				end

				-- Richer reflections and soft shadows on top of the color grade.
				lightingService.ExposureCompensation = savedLighting.ExposureCompensation + preset.exposure * strength
				lightingService.EnvironmentDiffuseScale = 1
				lightingService.EnvironmentSpecularScale = 1
				lightingService.ShadowSoftness = 0.15

				if flags.shader_future_lighting then
					pcall(sethiddenproperty, lightingService, "Technology", Enum.Technology.Future)
				elseif savedLighting.Technology then
					pcall(sethiddenproperty, lightingService, "Technology", savedLighting.Technology)
				end
			end

			local shaderSection = worldTab:section({ name = "Shaders", side = "right" })

			addFeature(shaderSection, { name = "Shaders", flag = "shaders_enabled", callback = applyShader })
			shaderSection:dropdown({ name = "preset", flag = "shader_preset", items = SHADER_ORDER, default = "Cinematic", callback = applyShader })
			shaderSection:slider({ name = "intensity", flag = "shader_intensity", min = 0.1, max = 1.5, default = 1, interval = 0.05, callback = applyShader })
			shaderSection:toggle({ name = "depth of field", flag = "shader_depth", default = true, callback = applyShader })
			shaderSection:toggle({ name = "sun rays", flag = "shader_sun_rays", default = true, callback = applyShader })
			shaderSection:toggle({ name = "vignette", flag = "shader_vignette", default = true, callback = applyShader })
			shaderSection:toggle({ name = "future lighting", flag = "shader_future_lighting", default = false, callback = applyShader })

			-- The camera can be replaced (respawns, cutscenes); keep the effects on the current one.
			task.spawn(function()
				while isCurrentRun() and watermarkHolder.Parent do
					task.wait(1)
					if not isCurrentRun() then
						break
					end

					if flags.shaders_enabled and shaderCorrection.Parent ~= workspace.CurrentCamera then
						applyShader()
					end
				end
			end)

			onUnload(function()
				flags.shaders_enabled = false
				applyShader()

				for _, effect in ipairs({ shaderCorrection, shaderBloom, shaderRays, shaderDepth }) do
					effect:Destroy()
				end
			end)
	end
	buildShaders()

	-- Bloom and sun rays.
	local bloom = Instance.new("BloomEffect")
	bloom.Name = ""
	local sunRays = Instance.new("SunRaysEffect")
	sunRays.Name = ""

	local postSection = worldTab:section({ name = "Bloom & Sun Rays", side = "right" })

	addFeature(postSection, {
		name = "Bloom",
		flag = "world_bloom",
		callback = function(enabled)
			setEffectEnabled(bloom, enabled)
		end,
	})

	for _, setting in ipairs({
		{ name = "intensity", property = "Intensity", max = 5, default = 0.6 },
		{ name = "size", property = "Size", max = 56, default = 26, interval = 1 },
		{ name = "threshold", property = "Threshold", max = 4, default = 0.4 },
	}) do
		postSection:slider({
			name = "bloom " .. setting.name,
			flag = "world_bloom_" .. setting.name,
			min = 0,
			max = setting.max,
			default = setting.default,
			interval = setting.interval or 0.01,
			callback = function(value)
				bloom[setting.property] = value
			end,
		})
	end

	addFeature(postSection, {
		name = "Sun Rays",
		flag = "world_sun_rays",
		callback = function(enabled)
			setEffectEnabled(sunRays, enabled)
		end,
	})

	postSection:slider({
		name = "rays intensity",
		flag = "world_sun_rays_intensity",
		min = 0,
		max = 1,
		default = 0.25,
		interval = 0.01,
		callback = function(value)
			sunRays.Intensity = value
		end,
	})

	postSection:slider({
		name = "rays spread",
		flag = "world_sun_rays_spread",
		min = 0,
		max = 1,
		default = 1,
		interval = 0.01,
		callback = function(value)
			sunRays.Spread = value
		end,
	})

	-- Camera.
	local blur = Instance.new("BlurEffect")
	blur.Name = ""
	local originalFieldOfView = nil

	local cameraSection = worldTab:section({ name = "Camera", side = "right" })

	addFeature(cameraSection, {
		name = "FOV Changer",
		flag = "world_fov",
		callback = function(enabled)
			local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera

			if enabled then
				originalFieldOfView = originalFieldOfView or camera.FieldOfView
			elseif originalFieldOfView then
				camera.FieldOfView = originalFieldOfView
				originalFieldOfView = nil
			end
		end,
	})

	cameraSection:slider({
		name = "fov",
		flag = "world_fov_value",
		min = 30,
		max = 120,
		default = 90,
		interval = 1,
	})

	addFeature(cameraSection, {
		name = "Blur",
		flag = "world_blur",
		callback = function(enabled)
			setEffectEnabled(blur, enabled)
		end,
	})

	cameraSection:slider({
		name = "blur",
		flag = "world_blur_size",
		min = 0,
		max = 56,
		default = 0,
		interval = 1,
		callback = function(value)
			blur.Size = value
		end,
	})

	-- Noclip Camera and Max Zoom (own function: this scope is near Luau's 200-local limit).
	;(function()
		local saved = { maxZoom = nil }

		-- Noclip camera: the camera's Popper module pulls the camera in front of walls. Its 0.25 and
		-- 0 constants are swapped (and swapped back when off), so the camera stays at full zoom and
		-- passes through walls without making them see-through.
		local noclipCam = { on = false, patched = {} }

		---The game's Popper functions (found by their script, through getgc).
		function noclipCam.popperFunctions()
			local playerScripts = localPlayer:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerScripts")
			local popper = playerScripts and playerScripts:FindFirstChild("Popper", true)
			local list = {}
			if not popper then
				return list
			end
			for _, fn in ipairs(getgc()) do
				if type(fn) == "function" and islclosure(fn) and not isexecutorclosure(fn) then
					local ok, env = pcall(getfenv, fn)
					if ok and type(env) == "table" and rawget(env, "script") == popper then
						table.insert(list, fn)
					end
				end
			end
			return list
		end

		function noclipCam.set(enabled)
			if enabled == noclipCam.on then
				return
			end
			noclipCam.on = enabled
			if not enabled then
				for _, patch in ipairs(noclipCam.patched) do
					pcall(debug.setconstant, patch.fn, patch.index, patch.value)
				end
				table.clear(noclipCam.patched)
				return
			end
			for _, fn in ipairs(noclipCam.popperFunctions()) do
				local ok, constants = pcall(debug.getconstants, fn)
				for index, value in pairs(ok and constants or {}) do
					local swapped = value == 0.25 and 0 or value == 0 and 0.25 or nil
					if swapped and pcall(debug.setconstant, fn, index, swapped) then
						table.insert(noclipCam.patched, { fn = fn, index = index, value = value })
					end
				end
			end
			if #noclipCam.patched == 0 then
				library:notification({ text = "Noclip Camera: couldn't find the camera's Popper module.", time = 3 })
			end
		end

		addFeature(cameraSection, { name = "Noclip Camera", flag = "camera_noclip", callback = function(enabled)
			task.defer(noclipCam.set, enabled == true)
		end })
		addFeature(cameraSection, { name = "Max Zoom", flag = "camera_max_zoom" })
		cameraSection:slider({ name = "max zoom distance", flag = "camera_zoom_distance", min = 128, max = 100000, default = 10000, interval = 64, suffix = " studs" })

		-- Re-applied every frame: the game (and respawns) can set these back.
		library:connection(runService.Heartbeat, function()
			if flags.camera_max_zoom then
				saved.maxZoom = saved.maxZoom or localPlayer.CameraMaxZoomDistance
				local distance = flags.camera_zoom_distance or 10000
				if localPlayer.CameraMaxZoomDistance ~= distance then
					localPlayer.CameraMaxZoomDistance = distance
				end
			elseif saved.maxZoom then
				localPlayer.CameraMaxZoomDistance = saved.maxZoom
				saved.maxZoom = nil
			end
		end)

		onUnload(function()
			noclipCam.set(false)
			if saved.maxZoom then
				localPlayer.CameraMaxZoomDistance = saved.maxZoom
			end
		end)
	end)()

	-- Runs right after the camera scripts so FOV and stretch apply on top of them.
	runService:BindToRenderStep("PotentCamera", Enum.RenderPriority.Camera.Value + 1, function()
		local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera

		if flags.world_fov then
			camera.FieldOfView = flags.world_fov_value or 90
		end

		if flags.stretch_enabled then
			local stretch = STRETCH_PRESETS[flags.stretch_preset] or flags.stretch_custom or 0.75
			camera.CFrame *= CFrame.new(0, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0, 0, stretch, 0, 0, 0, 1)
		end

		if weatherPart.Parent then
			weatherPart.CFrame = CFrame.new(camera.CFrame.Position + Vector3.new(0, 60, 0))
		end

		if heavyRainPart.Parent then
			heavyRainPart.CFrame = CFrame.new(camera.CFrame.Position + Vector3.new(0, 70, 0))
		end

		if snowPart.Parent then
			snowPart.CFrame = CFrame.new(camera.CFrame.Position + Vector3.new(0, 45, 0))
		end
	end)

	-- Re-parent our effects if the game clears Lighting.
	task.spawn(function()
		while isCurrentRun() and watermarkHolder.Parent do
			task.wait(1)
			if not isCurrentRun() then
				break
			end

			if flags.world_color_correction and colorCorrection.Parent ~= lightingService then
				colorCorrection.Parent = lightingService
			end

			if flags.world_bloom and bloom.Parent ~= lightingService then
				bloom.Parent = lightingService
			end

			if flags.world_sun_rays and sunRays.Parent ~= lightingService then
				sunRays.Parent = lightingService
			end

			if flags.world_blur and blur.Parent ~= lightingService then
				blur.Parent = lightingService
			end

			if flags.world_atmosphere and not skyClearsAtmosphere() and atmosphere.Parent ~= lightingService then
				atmosphere.Parent = lightingService
			end

			if activeSky and activeSky.Parent ~= lightingService then
				activeSky.Parent = lightingService
			end
		end
	end)

	table.insert(worldCleanupTasks, function()
		runService:UnbindFromRenderStep("PotentCamera")

		if originalFieldOfView then
			workspace.CurrentCamera.FieldOfView = originalFieldOfView
		end

		for _, effect in ipairs({ colorCorrection, atmosphere, bloom, sunRays, blur, weatherPart, heavyRainPart, snowPart }) do
			effect:Destroy()
		end

		if activeSky then
			activeSky.Parent = nil
		end

		restoreStash(stashedSkies)
		restoreStash(stashedAtmospheres)
		setCloudsHidden(false)
	end)

end
Intro.step("loading misc", 0.84)

do
	-- Shared effects (spawn/death effects, force fields, alerts). Their sections live in the
	-- tabs they belong to; the misc tab itself is filled by the block after this one.
	local miscTab = Tabs.misc
	Tabs.misc = miscTab
	local tweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")

	-- Everything misc spawns in the world lives here (local to you only).
	local effectsFolder = Instance.new("Folder")
	effectsFolder.Name = ""
	effectsFolder.Parent = workspace

	---Color for a player's effects: team color, or the theme accent.
	---@param player Player
	---@return Color3
	local function effectColor(player)
		if flags.effects_team_color and player.Team then
			return player.TeamColor.Color
		end

		return flags.effects_color and flags.effects_color.Color or getAccent()
	end

	---Tween helper that cleans up after itself.
	local function tween(instance, seconds, goal, style)
		local info = TweenInfo.new(seconds, style or Enum.EasingStyle.Quint, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
		local created = tweenService:Create(instance, info, goal)
		created:Play()
		return created
	end

	---A glowing neon part in the effects folder.
	local function neonPart(shape, size, cframe, color)
		local part = Instance.new("Part")
		part.Name = ""
		part.Shape = shape
		part.Anchored = true
		part.CanCollide = false
		part.CanQuery = false
		part.CanTouch = false
		part.CastShadow = false
		part.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
		part.Color = color
		part.Size = size
		part.CFrame = cframe
		part.Parent = effectsFolder
		return part
	end

	---Expanding ground shockwave ring.
	local function shockwave(position, color, radius, seconds)
		local ring = Instance.new("CylinderHandleAdornment")
		ring.Name = ""
		ring.Adornee = workspace.Terrain
		ring.Height = 0.2
		ring.Radius = 0.5
		ring.InnerRadius = 0.2
		ring.Color3 = color
		ring.Transparency = 0.1
		ring.CFrame = CFrame.new(position) * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(90), 0, 0)
		ring.Parent = effectsFolder

		tween(ring, seconds, { Radius = radius, InnerRadius = radius - 0.6, Transparency = 1 })
		task.delay(seconds, function()
			ring:Destroy()
		end)
	end

	---Burst of small spinning neon cubes (the "eliminated" look).
	---@param origins table list of CFrames/positions to emit from
	---@param color Color3
	---@param count number
	---@param upward boolean float up and dissolve, or blow outward
	local function cubeBurst(origins, color, count, upward)
		local random = Random.new()
		-- Fewer cubes on the Performance profile.
		if Hooks.lowPower() then
			count = math.max(1, math.floor(count * 0.4 + 0.5))
		end

		for index = 1, count do
			local origin = origins[(index - 1) % #origins + 1]
			local start = origin + Vector3.new(random:NextNumber(-0.8, 0.8), random:NextNumber(-1, 1), random:NextNumber(-0.8, 0.8))
			local size = random:NextNumber(0.25, 0.55)
			local cube = neonPart(Enum.PartType.Block, Vector3.one * size, CFrame.new(start), color)
			cube.Transparency = 0.05

			local travel = upward
				and Vector3.new(random:NextNumber(-1.5, 1.5), random:NextNumber(5, 10), random:NextNumber(-1.5, 1.5))
				or Vector3.new(random:NextNumber(-6, 6), random:NextNumber(1, 7), random:NextNumber(-6, 6))
			local spin = CFrame.Angles(random:NextNumber(-3, 3), random:NextNumber(-3, 3), random:NextNumber(-3, 3))
			local seconds = random:NextNumber(0.8, 1.4)

			tween(cube, seconds, {
				CFrame = CFrame.new(start + travel) * spin,
				Size = Vector3.one * 0.05,
				Transparency = 1,
			}, Enum.EasingStyle.Sine)

			task.delay(seconds, function()
				cube:Destroy()
			end)
		end
	end

	---Vertical beam of light that shoots up and fades.
	local function lightPillar(position, color, height, seconds)
		local beam = neonPart(
			Enum.PartType.Cylinder,
			Vector3.new(height, 3, 3),
			CFrame.new(position + Vector3.new(0, height / 2 - 3, 0)) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(90)),
			color
		)
		beam.Transparency = 0.25

		tween(beam, seconds, { Size = Vector3.new(height, 0.05, 0.05), Transparency = 1 })

		local light = Instance.new("PointLight")
		light.Color = color
		light.Range = 18
		light.Brightness = 6
		light.Parent = beam
		tween(light, seconds, { Brightness = 0 })

		task.delay(seconds, function()
			beam:Destroy()
		end)
	end

	---Fade a character's parts locally (LocalTransparencyModifier never replicates).
	local function fadeCharacter(character, from, to, seconds)
		for _, part in ipairs(character:GetDescendants()) do
			if part:IsA("BasePart") or part:IsA("Decal") then
				part.LocalTransparencyModifier = from
				tween(part, seconds, { LocalTransparencyModifier = to }, Enum.EasingStyle.Sine)
			end
		end
	end

	-- Spawn and death effect pieces, kept on one table (this block is near Luau's local limit).
	local Fx = {
		SPARK = "rbxasset://textures/particles/sparkles_main.dds",
		SMOKE = "rbxasset://textures/particles/smoke_main.dds",
		FIRE = "rbxasset://textures/particles/fire_main.dds",
		WHITE = Color3.new(1, 1, 1),
		-- Particle Burst shapes (Spawn & Death Effects > burst particle).
		BURST_SHAPES = { "Cubes", "Orbs", "Shards", "Sparks", "Stars" },
	}

	---An invisible part to hang particles and lights on; removes itself after `life` seconds.
	function Fx.anchor(position, life)
		local anchor = neonPart(Enum.PartType.Block, Vector3.one * 0.2, CFrame.new(position), Fx.WHITE)
		anchor.Transparency = 1
		task.delay(life or 3, function()
			anchor:Destroy()
		end)
		return anchor
	end

	---One burst of particles from `anchor`.
	function Fx.burst(anchor, count, properties)
		local emitter = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
		emitter.Enabled = false
		emitter.LightEmission = 1
		emitter.LightInfluence = 0
		for key, value in pairs(properties) do
			emitter[key] = value
		end
		emitter.Parent = anchor
		emitter:Emit(count)
		return emitter
	end

	---A light that flashes on and fades.
	function Fx.flash(anchor, color, range, brightness, seconds)
		local light = Instance.new("PointLight")
		light.Color, light.Range, light.Brightness, light.Shadows = color, range, brightness, false
		light.Parent = anchor
		tween(light, seconds, { Brightness = 0 })
	end

	---A colored wash over the whole character that holds, then fades away.
	function Fx.wash(character, color, fill, hold)
		local highlight = Instance.new("Highlight")
		highlight.Adornee = character
		highlight.FillColor = color
		highlight.OutlineColor = color:Lerp(Fx.WHITE, 0.5)
		highlight.FillTransparency = fill
		highlight.OutlineTransparency = 0
		highlight.DepthMode = Enum.HighlightDepthMode.Occluded
		highlight.Parent = effectsFolder
		task.delay(hold, function()
			tween(highlight, 0.5, { FillTransparency = 1, OutlineTransparency = 1 })
			task.wait(0.55)
			highlight:Destroy()
		end)
	end

	---The character's height span, width and the pieces (parts and decals) it's made of.
	function Fx.body(character)
		local cframe, size = character:GetBoundingBox()
		local half = size.Y / 2
		local pieces = {}
		for _, object in ipairs(character:GetDescendants()) do
			if (object:IsA("BasePart") and object.Name ~= "HumanoidRootPart" and object.Transparency < 1) or object:IsA("Decal") then
				table.insert(pieces, object)
			end
		end
		return {
			center = cframe.Position,
			bottom = cframe.Position.Y + half * NEG_ONE,
			top = cframe.Position.Y + half,
			width = math.max(size.X, size.Z),
			pieces = pieces,
		}
	end

	---How high a body piece is (a decal goes by the part it's on).
	function Fx.heightOf(piece)
		local part = piece:IsA("Decal") and piece.Parent or piece
		return part and part:IsA("BasePart") and part.Position.Y or 0
	end

	---A thin glowing ring with a soft disc inside that sweeps from `fromY` to `toY` around the body,
	---easing out, calling `onPass(y)` every frame with its height.
	function Fx.scan(body, color, fromY, toY, seconds, onPass)
		local radius = body.width / 2 + 0.7
		local ring = Instance.new("CylinderHandleAdornment")
		ring.Adornee = workspace.Terrain
		ring.Height = 0.08
		ring.Radius = radius
		ring.InnerRadius = radius + 0.2 * NEG_ONE
		ring.Color3 = color:Lerp(Fx.WHITE, 0.35)
		ring.Transparency = 0.05
		ring.Parent = effectsFolder
		local disc = Instance.new("CylinderHandleAdornment")
		disc.Adornee = workspace.Terrain
		disc.Height = 0.04
		disc.Radius = radius
		disc.Color3 = color
		disc.Transparency = 0.82
		disc.Parent = effectsFolder

		local started = os.clock()
		local connection
		connection = runService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
			local t = math.min((os.clock() - started) / seconds, 1)
			local eased = 1 + (1 - t) ^ 3 * NEG_ONE
			local y = fromY + (toY - fromY) * eased
			local cframe = CFrame.new(body.center.X, y, body.center.Z) * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(90), 0, 0)
			ring.CFrame, disc.CFrame = cframe, cframe
			pcall(onPass, y)
			if t >= 1 then
				connection:Disconnect()
				tween(ring, 0.25, { Transparency = 1, Radius = radius + 0.8 })
				tween(disc, 0.25, { Transparency = 1 })
				task.delay(0.3, function()
					ring:Destroy()
					disc:Destroy()
				end)
			end
		end)
	end

	---Glowing chunks flung out on arcs under gravity, spinning and shrinking away.
	function Fx.debris(origin, color, count, power)
		local random = Random.new()
		local pieces = {}
		for _ = 1, Fx.amount(count) do
			local size = random:NextNumber(0.25, 0.6)
			local part = neonPart(Enum.PartType.Block, Vector3.one * size, CFrame.new(origin), color:Lerp(Fx.WHITE, random:NextNumber(0, 0.45)))
			local direction = Vector3.new(random:NextNumber(-1, 1), random:NextNumber(0.3, 1.2), random:NextNumber(-1, 1)).Unit
			table.insert(pieces, {
				part = part,
				size = size,
				velocity = direction * random:NextNumber(power * 0.5, power),
				spin = Vector3.new(random:NextNumber(-8, 8), random:NextNumber(-8, 8), random:NextNumber(-8, 8)),
			})
		end
		local gravity = Vector3.new(0, 28 * NEG_ONE, 0)
		local life = 1.1
		local started = os.clock()
		local connection
		connection = runService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
			local t = os.clock() - started
			local fade = math.min(t / life, 1)
			for _, piece in ipairs(pieces) do
				local position = origin + piece.velocity * t + gravity * (t * t * 0.5)
				piece.part.CFrame = CFrame.new(position) * CFrame.Angles(piece.spin.X * t, piece.spin.Y * t, piece.spin.Z * t)
				piece.part.Size = Vector3.one * piece.size * (1 + fade * 0.8 * NEG_ONE)
				piece.part.Transparency = fade * fade
			end
			if fade >= 1 then
				connection:Disconnect()
				for _, piece in ipairs(pieces) do
					piece.part:Destroy()
				end
			end
		end)
	end

	---A see-through copy of one body part (mesh parts keep their shape).
	function Fx.copyPart(part, color)
		local copy
		if part:IsA("MeshPart") then
			local archivable = part.Archivable
			part.Archivable = true
			local ok, clone = pcall(part.Clone, part)
			part.Archivable = archivable
			if not (ok and clone) then
				return nil
			end
			clone:ClearAllChildren()
			clone.Name = ""
			clone.TextureID = ""
			clone.Anchored, clone.CanCollide, clone.CanQuery, clone.CanTouch, clone.CastShadow = true, false, false, false, false
			clone.Color = color
			clone.Parent = effectsFolder
			copy = clone
		else
			copy = neonPart(Enum.PartType.Block, part.Size, part.CFrame, color)
		end
		copy.Material = Enum.Material.ForceField
		copy.Transparency = 0
		copy.LocalTransparencyModifier = 0
		return copy
	end

	---Spawn-in: a glowing ring rises from the feet and builds the body as it passes, with a soft
	---ground ring, a few rising sparkles and a short color wash.
	function Fx.spawnIn(player, character)
		local root = character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart", 5)
		if not root or not flags.spawn_effect or not isCurrentRun() then
			return
		end
		task.wait(0.1)
		local color = effectColor(player)
		local body = Fx.body(character)
		local shown = {}
		for _, piece in ipairs(body.pieces) do
			piece.LocalTransparencyModifier = 1
		end

		Fx.scan(body, color, body.bottom, body.top + 0.3, 0.75, function(y)
			for _, piece in ipairs(body.pieces) do
				if not shown[piece] and Fx.heightOf(piece) <= y then
					shown[piece] = true
					if piece.Parent then
						tween(piece, 0.2, { LocalTransparencyModifier = 0 }, Enum.EasingStyle.Sine)
					end
				end
			end
		end)
		-- Anything the ring missed (accessories added late) is shown anyway.
		task.delay(1.1, function()
			for _, piece in ipairs(body.pieces) do
				if not shown[piece] and piece.Parent then
					piece.LocalTransparencyModifier = 0
				end
			end
		end)

		local feet = Vector3.new(root.Position.X, body.bottom + 0.1, root.Position.Z)
		shockwave(feet, color, 6, 0.9)
		local anchor = Fx.anchor(feet, 3)
		Fx.flash(anchor, color, 12, 3, 1)
		Fx.burst(anchor, 22, {
			Texture = Fx.SPARK,
			Color = ColorSequence.new(Fx.WHITE, color),
			Size = NumberSequence.new({ NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.35), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0) }),
			Transparency = NumberSequence.new(0, 1),
			Speed = NumberRange.new(2, 5),
			SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(35, 35),
			EmissionDirection = Enum.NormalId.Top,
			Drag = 2,
			Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.6, 1.1),
		})
		Fx.wash(character, color, 0.45, 0.55)
	end

	---Fortnite: a color wash, then a ring sweeps down and breaks the body into glowing cubes that
	---float away as it passes.
	function Fx.digitize(character, color)
		local body = Fx.body(character)
		local gone = {}
		Fx.wash(character, color, 0.25, 0.7)
		Fx.scan(body, color, body.top + 0.3, body.bottom, 0.85, function(y)
			for _, piece in ipairs(body.pieces) do
				if not gone[piece] and Fx.heightOf(piece) >= y then
					gone[piece] = true
					if piece.Parent then
						tween(piece, 0.15, { LocalTransparencyModifier = 1 })
						if piece:IsA("BasePart") then
							cubeBurst({ piece.Position }, color, 3, true)
						end
					end
				end
			end
		end)
		Fx.flash(Fx.anchor(body.center, 2), color, 14, 3, 0.9)
	end

	---Ghost: the body fades while a see-through copy of it drifts up, swaying, trailing wisps.
	function Fx.ghost(character, color)
		local body = Fx.body(character)
		local tint = color:Lerp(Fx.WHITE, 0.5)
		local copies = {}
		for _, part in ipairs(character:GetChildren()) do
			if part:IsA("BasePart") and part.Name ~= "HumanoidRootPart" and part.Transparency < 1 then
				local copy = Fx.copyPart(part, tint)
				if copy then
					table.insert(copies, { part = copy, start = part.CFrame })
				end
			end
		end
		fadeCharacter(character, 0, 1, 0.35)

		local anchor = Fx.anchor(body.center, 3)
		Fx.burst(anchor, 14, {
			Texture = Fx.SMOKE,
			Color = ColorSequence.new(Fx.WHITE, color),
			LightEmission = 0.6,
			Size = NumberSequence.new({ NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 1), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 3.2) }),
			Transparency = NumberSequence.new({ NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.6), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1) }),
			Speed = NumberRange.new(1, 3),
			SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(180, 180),
			Acceleration = Vector3.new(0, 4, 0),
			Lifetime = NumberRange.new(1, 1.6),
			Rotation = NumberRange.new(0, 360),
			RotSpeed = NumberRange.new(-30, 30),
		})
		Fx.flash(anchor, tint, 12, 2, 1.4)

		local started = os.clock()
		local life = 1.6
		local connection
		connection = runService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
			local t = math.min((os.clock() - started) / life, 1)
			local rise = 7 * (1 + (1 - t) ^ 2 * NEG_ONE)
			local sway = math.sin(t * 9) * 0.35 * (1 - t)
			for _, copy in ipairs(copies) do
				copy.part.CFrame = copy.start + Vector3.new(sway, rise, 0)
				copy.part.Transparency = t
			end
			if t >= 1 then
				connection:Disconnect()
				for _, copy in ipairs(copies) do
					copy.part:Destroy()
				end
			end
		end)
	end

	---The ground under a point (or a little under it if there's nothing to hit), skipping players
	---and our own effects.
	---How many pieces an effect gets: 40% on the Performance profile (phones by default), where a
	---full kill effect or blast dropped frames.
	function Fx.amount(count)
		if Hooks.lowPower() then
			return math.max(1, math.floor(count * 0.4 + 0.5))
		end
		return count
	end

	function Fx.groundBelow(position)
		local params = RaycastParams.new()
		params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
		local ignore = { effectsFolder, workspace.CurrentCamera }
		for _, player in ipairs(playersService:GetPlayers()) do
			if player.Character then
				table.insert(ignore, player.Character)
			end
		end
		params.FilterDescendantsInstances = ignore
		local hit = workspace:Raycast(position, Vector3.new(0, NEG_ONE * 12, 0), params)
		return hit and hit.Position or position - Vector3.new(0, 2.8, 0)
	end

	-- The explosion palette: white-hot, then yellow, orange, the effect color and finally smoke.
	Fx.BLAST_HOT = Color3.fromRGB(255, 226, 140)
	Fx.BLAST_FIRE = Color3.fromRGB(255, 120, 30)
	Fx.BLAST_SMOKE = Color3.fromRGB(38, 34, 34)

	---Fireball color as it cools (heat 0 = just lit, 1 = burnt out).
	function Fx.cool(heat, color)
		if heat < 0.15 then
			return Fx.WHITE:Lerp(Fx.BLAST_HOT, heat / 0.15)
		elseif heat < 0.4 then
			return Fx.BLAST_HOT:Lerp(Fx.BLAST_FIRE, (heat + NEG_ONE * 0.15) / 0.25)
		elseif heat < 0.7 then
			return Fx.BLAST_FIRE:Lerp(color, (heat + NEG_ONE * 0.4) / 0.3)
		end
		return color:Lerp(Fx.BLAST_SMOKE, (heat + NEG_ONE * 0.7) / 0.3)
	end

	---Explosion (no Roblox Explosion): a white-hot flash, a rolling fireball of lobes that swell and
	---cool from white to orange to the effect color to smoke while drifting up, a shock sphere and a
	---ground ring racing out, sparks streaking off on trails under gravity, glowing debris, a column
	---of smoke and a scorch mark that fades. `scale` sizes the whole thing (1 is a normal blast).
	function Fx.blast(position, color, scale)
		scale = scale or 1
		local random = Random.new()
		local ground = Fx.groundBelow(position)

		local core = neonPart(Enum.PartType.Ball, Vector3.one * 0.5, CFrame.new(position), Fx.WHITE)
		local lobes = {}
		for _ = 1, Fx.amount(8) do
			local direction = Vector3.new(random:NextNumber(0, 2) + NEG_ONE, random:NextNumber(0, 1.4) + NEG_ONE * 0.3, random:NextNumber(0, 2) + NEG_ONE)
			direction = direction.Magnitude > 0.01 and direction.Unit or Vector3.yAxis
			table.insert(lobes, {
				part = neonPart(Enum.PartType.Ball, Vector3.one * 0.5, CFrame.new(position), Fx.WHITE),
				offset = direction * random:NextNumber(1, 2.8) * scale,
				size = random:NextNumber(4, 7.5) * scale,
				delay = random:NextNumber(0, 0.09),
				life = random:NextNumber(0.9, 1.25),
			})
		end
		local shell = neonPart(Enum.PartType.Ball, Vector3.one, CFrame.new(position), Fx.WHITE:Lerp(color, 0.3))
		shell.Material = Enum.Material.ForceField

		local flat = CFrame.new(ground + Vector3.new(0, 0.05, 0)) * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(90), 0, 0)
		local ring = Instance.new("CylinderHandleAdornment")
		ring.Adornee = workspace.Terrain
		ring.Height = 0.1
		ring.Color3 = Fx.BLAST_HOT:Lerp(color, 0.4)
		ring.CFrame = flat
		ring.Parent = effectsFolder
		local scorch = Instance.new("CylinderHandleAdornment")
		scorch.Adornee = workspace.Terrain
		scorch.Height = 0.04
		scorch.Radius = 4.5 * scale
		scorch.Color3 = Color3.fromRGB(14, 12, 12)
		scorch.Transparency = 0.25
		scorch.CFrame = CFrame.new(ground + Vector3.new(0, 0.02, 0)) * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(90), 0, 0)
		scorch.Parent = effectsFolder

		-- Sparks: hot streaks with trails, thrown out and pulled down.
		local sparks = {}
		for _ = 1, Fx.amount(18) do
			local direction = Vector3.new(random:NextNumber(0, 2) + NEG_ONE, random:NextNumber(0.2, 1.3), random:NextNumber(0, 2) + NEG_ONE)
			direction = direction.Magnitude > 0.01 and direction.Unit or Vector3.yAxis
			local spark = neonPart(Enum.PartType.Block, Vector3.new(0.14, 0.14, 0.7), CFrame.new(position), Fx.BLAST_HOT)
			Fx.trail(spark, Fx.BLAST_FIRE, 0.22, 0.3)
			table.insert(sparks, { part = spark, velocity = direction * random:NextNumber(28, 62) * scale })
		end
		Fx.debris(position, color, 12, 26 * scale)

		local anchor = Fx.anchor(position, 4)
		local light = Instance.new("PointLight")
		light.Color = Fx.BLAST_HOT
		light.Range = 40 * scale
		light.Brightness = 10
		light.Shadows = false
		light.Parent = anchor

		-- Rolling flames licking out of the fireball, burning from white-hot to the effect color.
		Fx.burst(anchor, Fx.amount(30), {
			Texture = Fx.FIRE,
			Color = ColorSequence.new({
				ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, Fx.WHITE),
				ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.25, Fx.BLAST_HOT),
				ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.55, Fx.BLAST_FIRE),
				ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, color),
			}),
			Size = NumberSequence.new({ NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 3 * scale), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.4, 5 * scale), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1.5 * scale) }),
			Transparency = NumberSequence.new({ NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.1), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.7, 0.45), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1) }),
			Speed = NumberRange.new(14 * scale, 26 * scale),
			SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(180, 180),
			Drag = 5,
			Acceleration = Vector3.new(0, 8, 0),
			Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.45, 0.85),
			Rotation = NumberRange.new(0, 360),
			RotSpeed = NumberRange.new(NEG_ONE * 120, 120),
		})

		-- A skirt of dust blown out flat along the ground.
		local dustAnchor = Fx.anchor(ground + Vector3.new(0, 0.6, 0), 4)
		Fx.burst(dustAnchor, Fx.amount(20), {
			Texture = Fx.SMOKE,
			Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(120, 108, 98), Color3.fromRGB(60, 54, 50)),
			LightEmission = 0,
			LightInfluence = 1,
			Size = NumberSequence.new({ NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 1.5 * scale), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 5 * scale) }),
			Transparency = NumberSequence.new({ NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.4), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1) }),
			Speed = NumberRange.new(22 * scale, 34 * scale),
			SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(86, 86),
			EmissionDirection = Enum.NormalId.Top,
			Drag = 4,
			Lifetime = NumberRange.new(1, 1.6),
			Rotation = NumberRange.new(0, 360),
			RotSpeed = NumberRange.new(NEG_ONE * 60, 60),
		})

		-- Embers drifting up out of the smoke after the flash.
		task.delay(0.25, function()
			Fx.burst(anchor, Fx.amount(24), {
				Texture = Fx.SPARK,
				Color = ColorSequence.new(Fx.BLAST_HOT, color),
				Size = NumberSequence.new({ NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.3), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0) }),
				Transparency = NumberSequence.new(0, 1),
				Speed = NumberRange.new(3, 9),
				SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(70, 70),
				EmissionDirection = Enum.NormalId.Top,
				Acceleration = Vector3.new(0, 4, 0),
				Drag = 1,
				Lifetime = NumberRange.new(1.2, 2.2),
			})
		end)
		task.delay(0.12, function()
			Fx.burst(anchor, Fx.amount(16), {
				Texture = Fx.SMOKE,
				Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(80, 74, 72), Color3.fromRGB(26, 24, 24)),
				LightEmission = 0,
				LightInfluence = 1,
				Size = NumberSequence.new({ NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 2.5 * scale), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 8 * scale) }),
				Transparency = NumberSequence.new({ NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 1), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.15, 0.35), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1) }),
				Speed = NumberRange.new(2, 6),
				SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(60, 60),
				EmissionDirection = Enum.NormalId.Top,
				Drag = 2,
				Acceleration = Vector3.new(0, 5, 0),
				Lifetime = NumberRange.new(1.6, 2.6),
				Rotation = NumberRange.new(0, 360),
				RotSpeed = NumberRange.new(NEG_ONE * 30, 30),
			})
		end)

		local LIFE = 1.6
		local gravity = Vector3.new(0, NEG_ONE * 60, 0)
		Fx.animate(LIFE, function(t)
			local time = t * LIFE

			-- Flash: swells to full size in a blink and is gone a third of a second later.
			local flashT = math.clamp(time / 0.35, 0, 1)
			core.Size = Vector3.one * (0.5 + (1 + NEG_ONE * (1 + NEG_ONE * flashT) ^ 3) * 9 * scale)
			core.Transparency = flashT ^ 0.6

			-- Fireball: each lobe swells fast and eases out, cools, drifts up and fades.
			for _, lobe in ipairs(lobes) do
				local lobeT = math.clamp((time + NEG_ONE * lobe.delay) / lobe.life, 0, 1)
				local grow = 1 + NEG_ONE * (1 + NEG_ONE * lobeT) ^ 4
				lobe.part.Size = Vector3.one * math.max(lobe.size * grow, 0.05)
				lobe.part.CFrame = CFrame.new(position + lobe.offset * grow + Vector3.new(0, lobeT * lobeT * 3.5 * scale, 0))
				lobe.part.Color = Fx.cool(lobeT, color)
				lobe.part.Transparency = lobeT >= 1 and 1 or math.clamp(0.05 + lobeT * lobeT * 1.05, 0, 1)
			end

			-- Shock sphere and ground ring racing out.
			local shockT = math.clamp(time / 0.45, 0, 1)
			shell.Size = Vector3.one * (1 + (1 + NEG_ONE * (1 + NEG_ONE * shockT) ^ 3) * 26 * scale)
			shell.Transparency = shockT
			local ringT = math.clamp(time / 0.75, 0, 1)
			local radius = 1 + (1 + NEG_ONE * (1 + NEG_ONE * ringT) ^ 3) * 18 * scale
			ring.Radius = radius
			ring.InnerRadius = math.max(radius + NEG_ONE * (1.4 * (1 + NEG_ONE * ringT) + 0.2), 0)
			ring.Transparency = ringT

			for _, spark in ipairs(sparks) do
				local velocity = spark.velocity + gravity * time
				local point = position + spark.velocity * time + gravity * (time * time * 0.5)
				spark.part.CFrame = velocity.Magnitude > 0.01 and CFrame.lookAt(point, point + velocity) or CFrame.new(point)
				spark.part.Transparency = math.clamp((time + NEG_ONE * 0.45) / 0.5, 0, 1)
			end

			light.Brightness = 10 * (1 + NEG_ONE * t) ^ 2
		end, function()
			core:Destroy()
			shell:Destroy()
			ring:Destroy()
			for _, lobe in ipairs(lobes) do
				lobe.part:Destroy()
			end
			for _, spark in ipairs(sparks) do
				spark.part:Destroy()
			end
			tween(scorch, 3, { Transparency = 1 })
			task.delay(3, function()
				scorch:Destroy()
			end)
		end)
	end
	Hooks.blast = Fx.blast

	---Explode (the death effect, and the finisher of other effects): a normal-sized blast.
	function Fx.explode(position, color)
		Fx.blast(position, color, 1)
	end

	---Dissolve: the body glows like a hot ember and burns away into rising sparks.
	function Fx.embers(character, color)
		local ember = color:Lerp(Color3.fromRGB(255, 120, 40), 0.5)
		Fx.wash(character, ember, 0.1, 0.5)
		local emitters = {}
		for _, part in ipairs(character:GetChildren()) do
			if part:IsA("BasePart") and part.Name ~= "HumanoidRootPart" and part.Transparency < 1 and #emitters < 8 then
				local emitter = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
				emitter.Texture = Fx.SPARK
				emitter.Color = ColorSequence.new(Fx.WHITE, ember)
				emitter.LightEmission = 1
				emitter.LightInfluence = 0
				emitter.Size = NumberSequence.new({ NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.28), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0) })
				emitter.Transparency = NumberSequence.new(0, 1)
				emitter.Speed = NumberRange.new(1, 3)
				emitter.SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(180, 180)
				emitter.Acceleration = Vector3.new(0, 6, 0)
				emitter.Drag = 1
				emitter.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.8, 1.4)
				emitter.Rate = 45
				emitter.Parent = part
				table.insert(emitters, emitter)
			end
		end
		fadeCharacter(character, 0, 1, 0.9)
		Fx.flash(Fx.anchor(Fx.body(character).center, 2), ember, 14, 3, 1)
		task.delay(0.7, function()
			for _, emitter in ipairs(emitters) do
				emitter.Enabled = false
			end
			task.wait(1.5)
			for _, emitter in ipairs(emitters) do
				emitter:Destroy()
			end
		end)
	end

	local function playSpawnEffect(player, character)
		Fx.spawnIn(player, character)
	end

	---Death / leave, in the chosen style.
	local function playDeathEffect(player, character)
		if not flags.death_effect or not isCurrentRun() or not character then
			return
		end

		local root = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or character:FindFirstChild("Torso")
		if not root then
			return
		end

		local color = effectColor(player)
		local style = flags.death_effect_style or "Fortnite"
		if style == "Explode" then
			fadeCharacter(character, 0, 1, 0.12)
			Fx.explode(root.Position, color)
		elseif style == "Ghost" then
			Fx.ghost(character, color)
		elseif style == "Dissolve" then
			Fx.embers(character, color)
		elseif style == "Wind Bomb" then
			task.spawn(Fx.windBomb, root.Position, color, character)
		elseif style == "Particle Burst" then
			Fx.particleBurst(root.Position, color, character)
		else
			Fx.digitize(character, color)
		end
	end

	-- Join / leave alerts.
	-- The settings tab is created later, so its Player Alerts section is built from there.
	function Tabs.buildPlayerAlerts(tab)
		local alertSection = tab:section({ name = "Player Alerts", side = "left" })

		addFeature(alertSection, { name = "Join / Leave Alerts", flag = "join_alerts", default = true, listActive = false })
		alertSection:toggle({ name = "show team", flag = "join_alerts_team", default = true })
		alertSection:toggle({ name = "alert sound", flag = "join_alerts_sound", default = false })
	end

	local alertSound = Instance.new("Sound")
	alertSound.SoundId = "rbxasset://sounds/electronicpingshort.wav"
	alertSound.Volume = 0.3
	alertSound.Parent = effectsFolder

	---Show a join/leave notification.
	local function alert(player, joined)
		if not flags.join_alerts or not isCurrentRun() then
			return
		end

		local team = flags.join_alerts_team and player.Team and (" [" .. player.Team.Name .. "]") or ""
		local name = player.DisplayName ~= player.Name and (player.DisplayName .. " (@" .. player.Name .. ")") or player.Name

		library:notification({
			text = (joined and "+ " or "- ") .. name .. (joined and " joined" or " left") .. team,
			time = 4,
		})

		if flags.join_alerts_sound then
			alertSound:Play()
		end
	end

	-- Kill effects: a big finisher on the player you just killed (only you see it).

	local SPARK = "rbxasset://textures/particles/sparkles_main.dds"
	local FIRE = "rbxasset://textures/particles/fire_main.dds"
	local SMOKE = "rbxasset://textures/particles/smoke_main.dds"

	---An invisible anchor part holding emitters and lights for an effect.
	local function effectAnchor(position)
		local anchor = neonPart(Enum.PartType.Block, Vector3.one * 0.2, CFrame.new(position), Color3.new(1, 1, 1))
		anchor.Transparency = 1
		return anchor
	end

	---Burst a particle emitter once.
	local function burst(anchor, count, properties)
		local emitter = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
		emitter.Enabled = false
		emitter.LightEmission = 1
		emitter.LightInfluence = 0
		for key, value in pairs(properties) do
			emitter[key] = value
		end
		emitter.Parent = anchor
		emitter:Emit(count)
		return emitter
	end

	---A flash of light that fades.
	local function flashLight(anchor, color, range, brightness, seconds)
		local light = Instance.new("PointLight")
		light.Color = color
		light.Range = range
		light.Brightness = brightness
		light.Shadows = false
		light.Parent = anchor
		tween(light, seconds, { Brightness = 0, Range = range * 0.4 })
	end

	---Glowing copies of a character's body parts (for Soul Rip / Shatter).
	local function bodyCopies(character, color, material)
		local copies = {}
		for _, part in ipairs(character:GetChildren()) do
			if part:IsA("BasePart") and part.Name ~= "HumanoidRootPart" and part.Transparency < 1 then
				local copy = neonPart(Enum.PartType.Block, part.Size, part.CFrame, color)
				copy.Material = material or Enum.Material.Neon
				copy.Transparency = 0.25
				table.insert(copies, copy)
			end
		end
		return copies
	end

	---A lightning bolt from the sky into `target`: a jagged white core inside a colored glow, with
	---forks splitting off, re-striking along a new path a few times (the flicker) before fading.
	local function bolt(target, color, seconds)
		local SEGMENTS = 12
		local top = target + Vector3.new(math.random(0, 24) + NEG_ONE * 12, 120, math.random(0, 24) + NEG_ONE * 12)
		local glowColor = color:Lerp(Color3.new(1, 1, 1), 0.2)
		local pieces = {}

		---One straight piece of the bolt from `a` to `b` (a core and its glow).
		local function piece(width)
			local core = neonPart(Enum.PartType.Block, Vector3.one, CFrame.new(target), Color3.new(1, 1, 1))
			local glow = neonPart(Enum.PartType.Block, Vector3.one, CFrame.new(target), glowColor)
			glow.Transparency = 0.55
			local entry = { core = core, glow = glow, width = width }
			table.insert(pieces, entry)
			return entry
		end
		local function place(entry, a, b, fade)
			local length = (b - a).Magnitude
			local mid = (a + b) / 2
			local frame = length > 0.01 and CFrame.lookAt(mid, b) or CFrame.new(mid)
			entry.core.CFrame, entry.glow.CFrame = frame, frame
			entry.core.Size = Vector3.new(entry.width, entry.width, length)
			entry.glow.Size = Vector3.new(entry.width * 3.5, entry.width * 3.5, length)
			entry.core.Transparency = fade
			entry.glow.Transparency = 0.55 + fade * 0.45
		end

		local main, forks = {}, {}
		for index = 1, SEGMENTS do
			main[index] = piece(0.35 * (1 + NEG_ONE * index / SEGMENTS * 0.4))
		end
		for index = 1, 2 do
			forks[index] = { start = math.random(3, 7), pieces = { piece(0.18), piece(0.15), piece(0.12) } }
		end

		---Lay the bolt (and its forks) out along a fresh random path.
		local function strike(fade)
			local previous = top
			local points = { top }
			for index = 1, SEGMENTS do
				local t = index / SEGMENTS
				local point = top:Lerp(target, t)
				if index < SEGMENTS then
					local jitter = 10 * (1 + NEG_ONE * t * 0.7)
					point += Vector3.new(math.random() + NEG_ONE * 0.5, 0, math.random() + NEG_ONE * 0.5) * jitter
				end
				place(main[index], previous, point, fade)
				points[index + 1] = point
				previous = point
			end
			for _, fork in ipairs(forks) do
				local from = points[fork.start]
				local direction = Vector3.new(math.random() + NEG_ONE * 0.5, NEG_ONE * 0.8, math.random() + NEG_ONE * 0.5).Unit
				for _, entry in ipairs(fork.pieces) do
					local to = from + direction * math.random(5, 9) + Vector3.new(math.random() + NEG_ONE * 0.5, 0, math.random() + NEG_ONE * 0.5) * 3
					place(entry, from, to, math.min(fade + 0.2, 1))
					from = to
				end
			end
		end

		-- Re-strikes a few times while fading, then it's gone.
		local nextStrike = 0
		Fx.animate(seconds, function(t)
			if t >= nextStrike then
				nextStrike = t + 0.18
				strike(t * t)
			end
		end, function()
			for _, entry in ipairs(pieces) do
				entry.core:Destroy()
				entry.glow:Destroy()
			end
		end)
	end

	local KILL_STYLES = {}

	-- Supernova: their body collapses into a star. Three tilted rings of light spin inward while a
	-- white-hot core gathers and trembles, then it goes off as a huge blast with a pillar of light
	-- and a spray of stars.
	function KILL_STYLES.Supernova(position, color, character)
		if character then
			fadeCharacter(character, 0, 1, 0.35)
		end
		local center = position + Vector3.new(0, 0.5, 0)
		local core = neonPart(Enum.PartType.Ball, Vector3.one * 0.3, CFrame.new(center), Color3.new(1, 1, 1))
		local glow = neonPart(Enum.PartType.Ball, Vector3.one * 0.6, CFrame.new(center), color)
		glow.Material = Enum.Material.ForceField
		local rings = {}
		for index = 1, 3 do
			local ring = Instance.new("CylinderHandleAdornment")
			ring.Adornee = workspace.Terrain
			ring.Height = 0.12
			ring.Color3 = index == 2 and Color3.new(1, 1, 1) or color
			ring.Parent = effectsFolder
			rings[index] = { adornment = ring, tilt = CFrame.Angles(math.rad(index * 60), math.rad(index * 35), 0) }
		end
		local anchor = effectAnchor(center)
		local light = Instance.new("PointLight")
		light.Color, light.Range, light.Shadows = color, 20, false
		light.Parent = anchor

		local GATHER = 0.7
		Fx.animate(GATHER, function(t)
			local eased = t * t * (3 + NEG_ONE * 2 * t)
			local tremble = Vector3.new(math.random() + NEG_ONE * 0.5, math.random() + NEG_ONE * 0.5, math.random() + NEG_ONE * 0.5) * 0.25 * t
			core.CFrame = CFrame.new(center + tremble)
			core.Size = Vector3.one * (0.3 + eased * 2.4)
			glow.CFrame = core.CFrame
			glow.Size = Vector3.one * (0.6 + eased * 5)
			light.Brightness = 2 + eased * 8
			for index, ring in ipairs(rings) do
				local radius = 9 * (1 + NEG_ONE * eased) + 1.2
				ring.adornment.Radius = radius
				ring.adornment.InnerRadius = math.max(radius + NEG_ONE * 0.3, 0)
				ring.adornment.Transparency = 0.6 + NEG_ONE * eased * 0.5
				ring.adornment.CFrame = CFrame.new(center) * ring.tilt * CFrame.Angles(0, t * (4 + index), 0) * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(90), 0, 0)
			end
		end, function()
			core:Destroy()
			glow:Destroy()
			anchor:Destroy()
			for _, ring in ipairs(rings) do
				ring.adornment:Destroy()
			end
			Fx.blast(center, color, 1.4)
			lightPillar(position, color, 110, 1.1)
			cubeBurst({ center }, color, 20, false)
		end)
	end

	-- Black Hole: a dark sphere opens, everything spirals into it, then it collapses into a
	-- blinding implosion.
	KILL_STYLES["Black Hole"] = function(position, color)
		local center = position + Vector3.new(0, 1.5, 0)
		local hole = neonPart(Enum.PartType.Ball, Vector3.one * 0.5, CFrame.new(center), Color3.new(0, 0, 0))
		hole.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
		local rim = neonPart(Enum.PartType.Ball, Vector3.one * 0.6, CFrame.new(center), color)
		rim.Transparency = 0.55
		tween(hole, 0.35, { Size = Vector3.one * 4.5 }, Enum.EasingStyle.Back)
		tween(rim, 0.35, { Size = Vector3.one * 6 }, Enum.EasingStyle.Back)
		local disk = Instance.new("CylinderHandleAdornment")
		disk.Adornee = workspace.Terrain
		disk.Height = 0.05
		disk.Radius = 9
		disk.InnerRadius = 3
		disk.Color3 = color
		disk.Transparency = 0.45
		disk.AlwaysOnTop = false
		disk.CFrame = CFrame.new(center) * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(80), 0, 0)
		disk.Parent = effectsFolder

		-- Debris spiralling in.
		local random = Random.new()
		for index = 1, 28 do
			local angle = random:NextNumber(0, math.pi * 2)
			local distance = random:NextNumber(7, 14)
			local start = center + Vector3.new(math.cos(angle) * distance, random:NextNumber(-3, 4), math.sin(angle) * distance)
			local cube = neonPart(Enum.PartType.Block, Vector3.one * random:NextNumber(0.25, 0.6), CFrame.new(start), color:Lerp(Color3.new(1, 1, 1), random:NextNumber(0, 0.5)))
			task.spawn(function()
				local begin = os.clock()
				local life = random:NextNumber(0.7, 1.1)
				while cube.Parent and os.clock() - begin < life do
					local t = (os.clock() - begin) / life
					local a = angle + t * 9
					local r = distance * (1 - t) ^ 1.6
					cube.CFrame = CFrame.new(center + Vector3.new(math.cos(a) * r, (start.Y - center.Y) * (1 - t), math.sin(a) * r)) * CFrame.Angles(t * 12, t * 9, 0)
					cube.Size = Vector3.one * 0.5 * (1 - t) + Vector3.one * 0.05
					task.wait()
				end
				cube:Destroy()
			end)
		end
		task.spawn(function()
			local begin = os.clock()
			while disk.Parent and os.clock() - begin < 1.2 do
				disk.CFrame = CFrame.new(center) * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(80), 0, 0) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, (os.clock() - begin) * 6)
				task.wait()
			end
		end)
		task.delay(1.15, function()
			tween(hole, 0.15, { Size = Vector3.one * 0.1 })
			tween(rim, 0.15, { Size = Vector3.one * 0.1 })
			tween(disk, 0.15, { Radius = 0.2, InnerRadius = 0 })
			task.wait(0.15)
			local flash = neonPart(Enum.PartType.Ball, Vector3.one * 0.5, CFrame.new(center), Color3.new(1, 1, 1))
			tween(flash, 0.45, { Size = Vector3.one * 22, Transparency = 1 })
			local anchor = effectAnchor(center)
			flashLight(anchor, color, 45, 12, 0.8)
			burst(anchor, 50, {
				Texture = SPARK, Color = ColorSequence.new(color, Color3.new(1, 1, 1)),
				Size = NumberSequence.new({ NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 1), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0) }),
				Speed = NumberRange.new(30, 60), SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(180, 180), Drag = 5, Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.5, 1),
			})
			shockwave(position - Vector3.new(0, 2.6, 0), color, 22, 0.7)
			hole:Destroy()
			rim:Destroy()
			disk:Destroy()
			task.delay(1.2, function()
				flash:Destroy()
				anchor:Destroy()
			end)
		end)
	end

	-- Thunder God: a storm of forked, flickering bolts hammers the spot, then the last one sets off a
	-- blast, scorching the ground with sparks flying.
	KILL_STYLES["Thunder God"] = function(position, color, character)
		local ground = Fx.groundBelow(position)
		local strikes = Fx.amount(5)
		for index = 1, strikes do
			task.delay((index - 1) * 0.11, function()
				local offset = Vector3.new(math.random(0, 6) + NEG_ONE * 3, 0, math.random(0, 6) + NEG_ONE * 3)
				bolt(index == strikes and position or ground + offset, color, 0.55)
			end)
		end
		-- The blast goes off as the last bolt lands.
		task.delay((strikes - 1) * 0.11 + 0.04, function()
			if character then
				fadeCharacter(character, 0, 1, 0.08)
			end
			Fx.blast(position, color:Lerp(Color3.new(1, 1, 1), 0.25), 0.9)
		end)
		-- The sky strobes with every strike.
		local anchor = effectAnchor(position)
		for index = 1, strikes do
			task.delay((index - 1) * 0.11, function()
				flashLight(anchor, color:Lerp(Color3.new(1, 1, 1), 0.5), 60, 12, 0.18)
			end)
		end
		task.delay(1.5, function()
			anchor:Destroy()
		end)
	end

	-- Soul Rip: their glowing soul is torn out of the body, spirals upward trailing fire and
	-- bursts into light.
	KILL_STYLES["Soul Rip"] = function(position, color, character)
		local copies = bodyCopies(character, color, Enum.Material.ForceField)
		local anchor = effectAnchor(position)
		local trail = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
		trail.Texture = FIRE
		trail.Color = ColorSequence.new(color, Color3.new(1, 1, 1))
		trail.LightEmission = 1
		trail.Size = NumberSequence.new({ NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 1.6), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0) })
		trail.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({ NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.2), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1) })
		trail.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.4, 0.8)
		trail.Rate = 120
		trail.Speed = NumberRange.new(1, 3)
		trail.Parent = anchor
		flashLight(anchor, color, 25, 5, 1.6)
		local starts = {}
		for _, copy in ipairs(copies) do
			starts[copy] = copy.CFrame
		end
		task.spawn(function()
			local begin = os.clock()
			while os.clock() - begin < 1.3 do
				local t = (os.clock() - begin) / 1.3
				local lift = 14 * t ^ 1.5
				local spin = CFrame.Angles(0, t * 10, 0)
				for copy, start in pairs(starts) do
					local offset = start.Position - position
					copy.CFrame = CFrame.new(position + Vector3.new(0, lift, 0)) * spin * CFrame.new(offset * (1 + t * 0.4)) * start.Rotation
					copy.Transparency = 0.25 + t * 0.5
				end
				anchor.CFrame = CFrame.new(position + Vector3.new(0, lift, 0))
				task.wait()
			end
			trail.Enabled = false
			local top = position + Vector3.new(0, 14, 0)
			local flash = neonPart(Enum.PartType.Ball, Vector3.one, CFrame.new(top), Color3.new(1, 1, 1))
			tween(flash, 0.4, { Size = Vector3.one * 14, Transparency = 1 })
			burst(anchor, 45, {
				Texture = SPARK, Color = ColorSequence.new(color, Color3.new(1, 1, 1)),
				Size = NumberSequence.new({ NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 1), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0) }),
				Speed = NumberRange.new(18, 35), SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(180, 180), Drag = 3, Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.6, 1.1),
			})
			for _, copy in ipairs(copies) do
				copy:Destroy()
			end
			task.delay(1.2, function()
				flash:Destroy()
				anchor:Destroy()
			end)
		end)
	end

	-- Shatter: the body turns to glass and explodes into tumbling shards.
	function KILL_STYLES.Shatter(position, color, character)
		local random = Random.new()
		local copies = bodyCopies(character, color:Lerp(Color3.new(1, 1, 1), 0.4), Enum.Material.Glass)
		for _, copy in ipairs(copies) do
			copy.Transparency = 0.1
			copy.Reflectance = 0.4
		end
		task.wait(0.12)
		local anchor = effectAnchor(position)
		flashLight(anchor, color, 25, 6, 0.6)
		for _, copy in ipairs(copies) do
			local center = copy.Position
			local size = copy.Size
			copy:Destroy()
			for _ = 1, 6 do
				local shard = neonPart(Enum.PartType.Wedge, Vector3.new(random:NextNumber(0.1, 0.25), random:NextNumber(0.3, 0.9), random:NextNumber(0.3, 0.8)),
					CFrame.new(center + Vector3.new(random:NextNumber(-0.5, 0.5) * size.X, random:NextNumber(-0.5, 0.5) * size.Y, random:NextNumber(-0.5, 0.5) * size.Z)),
					color:Lerp(Color3.new(1, 1, 1), random:NextNumber(0.2, 0.7)))
				shard.Material = Enum.Material.Glass
				shard.Transparency = 0.15
				shard.Reflectance = 0.5
				local away = (shard.Position - position)
				away = (away.Magnitude > 0.01 and away.Unit or Vector3.yAxis) * random:NextNumber(6, 14) + Vector3.new(0, random:NextNumber(3, 9), 0)
				local spin = CFrame.Angles(random:NextNumber(-6, 6), random:NextNumber(-6, 6), random:NextNumber(-6, 6))
				local life = random:NextNumber(0.8, 1.3)
