				tween(shard, life, { CFrame = CFrame.new(shard.Position + away) * spin, Transparency = 1 }, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad)
				task.delay(life, function()
					shard:Destroy()
				end)
			end
		end
		shockwave(position - Vector3.new(0, 2.6, 0), color, 14, 0.6)
		task.delay(1, function()
			anchor:Destroy()
		end)
	end

	---Run `step(t)` every frame for `seconds` (t goes 0 to 1), then `done()`.
	function Fx.animate(seconds, step, done)
		local started = os.clock()
		local connection
		connection = runService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
			local t = math.min((os.clock() - started) / seconds, 1)
			local ok = pcall(step, t)
			if t >= 1 or not ok then
				connection:Disconnect()
				if done then
					pcall(done)
				end
			end
		end)
	end

	---A glowing trail behind a moving part.
	function Fx.trail(part, color, width, life)
		local top, bottom = Instance.new("Attachment"), Instance.new("Attachment")
		top.Position = Vector3.new(0, width / 2, 0)
		bottom.Position = Vector3.new(0, NEG_ONE * width / 2, 0)
		top.Parent, bottom.Parent = part, part
		local trail = Instance.new("Trail")
		trail.Attachment0, trail.Attachment1 = top, bottom
		trail.Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.new(1, 1, 1), color)
		trail.LightEmission = 1
		trail.LightInfluence = 0
		trail.FaceCamera = true
		trail.Lifetime = life
		trail.MinLength = 0
		trail.WidthScale = NumberSequence.new(1, 0)
		trail.Transparency = NumberSequence.new(0.05, 1)
		trail.Parent = part
		return trail
	end

	---A burst of bright sparks from `position`.
	function Fx.sparks(position, color, count, speed, upward)
		local anchor = effectAnchor(position)
		burst(anchor, Fx.amount(count), {
			Texture = SPARK,
			Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.new(1, 1, 1), color),
			Size = NumberSequence.new({ NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.7), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0) }),
			Speed = NumberRange.new(speed * 0.5, speed),
			SpreadAngle = upward and Vector2.new(50, 50) or Vector2.new(180, 180),
			EmissionDirection = Enum.NormalId.Top,
			Acceleration = Vector3.new(0, NEG_ONE * 45, 0),
			Drag = 2,
			Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.5, 1.1),
		})
		task.delay(1.5, function()
			anchor:Destroy()
		end)
	end

	---Shake the camera, weaker the further you are from `position`.
	function Fx.shake(position, strength, seconds)
		local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
		local distance = (camera.CFrame.Position - position).Magnitude
		local power = strength * math.clamp(1 + NEG_ONE * distance / 160, 0, 1)
		if power < 0.02 then
			return
		end
		local name = "aquaShake" .. tostring(math.random(1, 1e9))
		local started = os.clock()
		runService:BindToRenderStep(name, Enum.RenderPriority.Camera.Value + 1, function()
			local t = (os.clock() - started) / seconds
			if t >= 1 then
				runService:UnbindFromRenderStep(name)
				return
			end
			local amount = power * (1 + NEG_ONE * t) ^ 2
			local time = os.clock() * 40
			camera.CFrame *= CFrame.Angles(math.rad(math.sin(time) * amount), math.rad(math.cos(time * 1.3) * amount), 0)
		end)
	end

	---Wind Bomb: the air gets sucked in, then a pressure orb pops into a swirling cyclone - layered
	---wind domes, three ground gusts, spiralling wind streaks and a twisting funnel that climbs and
	---fades, kicking up dust in a ring.
	function Fx.windBomb(position, color, character)
		local random = Random.new()
		local ground = Fx.groundBelow(position)
		local air = color:Lerp(Fx.WHITE, 0.55)
		if character then
			fadeCharacter(character, 0, 1, 0.45)
		end

		-- Suck in: streaks spiral from far out into the middle.
		local inward = {}
		for _ = 1, Fx.amount(14) do
			local streak = neonPart(Enum.PartType.Block, Vector3.new(0.12, 0.12, 1.4), CFrame.new(position), air)
			Fx.trail(streak, color, 0.3, 0.18)
			table.insert(inward, { part = streak, angle = random:NextNumber(0, math.pi * 2), height = random:NextNumber(NEG_ONE * 2, 4), radius = random:NextNumber(12, 18) })
		end
		local orb = neonPart(Enum.PartType.Ball, Vector3.one * 0.3, CFrame.new(position), Fx.WHITE)
		local PULL = 0.4
		Fx.animate(PULL, function(t)
			local eased = t * t
			for _, streak in ipairs(inward) do
				local angle = streak.angle + eased * 4
				local radius = streak.radius * (1 + NEG_ONE * eased)
				local point = position + Vector3.new(math.cos(angle) * radius, streak.height * (1 + NEG_ONE * eased), math.sin(angle) * radius)
				streak.part.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(point, position)
			end
			orb.Size = Vector3.one * (0.3 + eased * 2.4)
			orb.Color = Fx.WHITE:Lerp(air, math.sin(t * 30) * 0.5 + 0.5)
		end, function()
			for _, streak in ipairs(inward) do
				streak.part:Destroy()
			end
		end)
		task.wait(PULL)

		-- Pop.
		local anchor = Fx.anchor(position, 4)
		local light = Instance.new("PointLight")
		light.Color, light.Range, light.Brightness, light.Shadows = air, 45, 8, false
		light.Parent = anchor
		Fx.shake(position, 1.4, 0.55)
		Fx.debris(position, air, 10, 30)

		local domes = {}
		for index = 1, 3 do
			local dome = neonPart(Enum.PartType.Ball, Vector3.one, CFrame.new(position), index == 1 and Fx.WHITE or air)
			dome.Material = Enum.Material.ForceField
			table.insert(domes, { part = dome, delay = (index + NEG_ONE) * 0.09, size = 34 + index * 8 })
		end
		local flat = CFrame.Angles(math.rad(90), 0, 0)
		local gusts = {}
		for index = 1, 3 do
			local ring = Instance.new("CylinderHandleAdornment")
			ring.Adornee = workspace.Terrain
			ring.Height = 0.12
			ring.Color3 = index == 1 and Fx.WHITE or air
			ring.CFrame = CFrame.new(ground + Vector3.new(0, 0.06 * index, 0)) * flat
			ring.Parent = effectsFolder
			table.insert(gusts, { ring = ring, delay = (index + NEG_ONE) * 0.12, radius = 24 + index * 6 })
		end

		-- The funnel: stacked rings that twist, widen and climb.
		local funnel = {}
		for index = 1, Fx.amount(9) do
			local ring = Instance.new("CylinderHandleAdornment")
			ring.Adornee = workspace.Terrain
			ring.Height = 0.18
			ring.Color3 = air:Lerp(color, index / 9)
			ring.Parent = effectsFolder
			table.insert(funnel, { ring = ring, level = index })
		end

		-- Wind streaks flung outward on spirals, rising as they go.
		local streaks = {}
		for _ = 1, Fx.amount(30) do
			local streak = neonPart(Enum.PartType.Block, Vector3.new(0.1, 0.1, 1.1), CFrame.new(position), air:Lerp(color, random:NextNumber(0, 0.6)))
			Fx.trail(streak, color, 0.35, 0.35)
			table.insert(streaks, {
				part = streak,
				angle = random:NextNumber(0, math.pi * 2),
				height = random:NextNumber(NEG_ONE * 0.5, 2),
				reach = random:NextNumber(14, 26),
				lift = random:NextNumber(4, 14),
				spin = random:NextNumber(2.5, 4.5),
			})
		end

		-- Dust thrown out along the ground.
		local dustAnchor = Fx.anchor(ground + Vector3.new(0, 0.5, 0), 4)
		Fx.burst(dustAnchor, Fx.amount(26), {
			Texture = Fx.SMOKE,
			Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(200, 196, 188), air),
			LightEmission = 0.2,
			LightInfluence = 0.8,
			Size = NumberSequence.new({ NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 2), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 6) }),
			Transparency = NumberSequence.new({ NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.45), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1) }),
			Speed = NumberRange.new(24, 36),
			SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(88, 88),
			EmissionDirection = Enum.NormalId.Top,
			Drag = 3.5,
			Lifetime = NumberRange.new(1.2, 1.9),
			Rotation = NumberRange.new(0, 360),
			RotSpeed = NumberRange.new(NEG_ONE * 90, 90),
		})

		orb:Destroy()
		local LIFE = 1.8
		Fx.animate(LIFE, function(t)
			local time = t * LIFE
			for _, dome in ipairs(domes) do
				local domeT = math.clamp((time + NEG_ONE * dome.delay) / 0.6, 0, 1)
				dome.part.Size = Vector3.one * (1 + (1 + NEG_ONE * (1 + NEG_ONE * domeT) ^ 3) * dome.size)
				dome.part.Transparency = domeT
			end
			for _, gust in ipairs(gusts) do
				local gustT = math.clamp((time + NEG_ONE * gust.delay) / 0.8, 0, 1)
				local radius = 1 + (1 + NEG_ONE * (1 + NEG_ONE * gustT) ^ 3) * gust.radius
				gust.ring.Radius = radius
				gust.ring.InnerRadius = math.max(radius + NEG_ONE * (2 * (1 + NEG_ONE * gustT) + 0.25), 0)
				gust.ring.Transparency = gustT
			end
			for _, piece in ipairs(funnel) do
				local level = piece.level
				local climb = math.clamp(t * 1.3, 0, 1)
				local y = ground.Y + level * 1.6 * (0.3 + climb)
				local radius = (0.8 + level * 0.75) * (0.4 + climb * 0.9)
				local wobble = Vector3.new(math.sin(time * 9 + level) * 0.6, 0, math.cos(time * 9 + level) * 0.6)
				piece.ring.CFrame = CFrame.new(Vector3.new(position.X, y, position.Z) + wobble) * CFrame.Angles(0, time * 8 + level, 0) * flat
				piece.ring.Radius = radius
				piece.ring.InnerRadius = math.max(radius + NEG_ONE * 0.35, 0)
				piece.ring.Transparency = 0.15 + t ^ 1.5 * 0.85
			end
			for _, streak in ipairs(streaks) do
				local out = 1 + NEG_ONE * (1 + NEG_ONE * math.min(t * 1.4, 1)) ^ 2
				local angle = streak.angle + out * streak.spin
				local radius = 1 + out * streak.reach
				local point = position + Vector3.new(math.cos(angle) * radius, streak.height + out * streak.lift, math.sin(angle) * radius)
				local ahead = position + Vector3.new(math.cos(angle + 0.2) * radius, streak.height + out * streak.lift, math.sin(angle + 0.2) * radius)
				streak.part.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(point, ahead)
				streak.part.Transparency = math.clamp((t + NEG_ONE * 0.55) / 0.4, 0, 1)
			end
			light.Brightness = 8 * (1 + NEG_ONE * t) ^ 2
		end, function()
			for _, dome in ipairs(domes) do
				dome.part:Destroy()
			end
			for _, gust in ipairs(gusts) do
				gust.ring:Destroy()
			end
			for _, piece in ipairs(funnel) do
				piece.ring:Destroy()
			end
			for _, streak in ipairs(streaks) do
				streak.part:Destroy()
			end
		end)
	end

	---Particle Burst: the body pops in a bright flash into a cloud of glowing pieces (cubes, orbs,
	---shards, sparks or stars) that fly up, slow, then drift and rain down swaying, settle on the
	---ground and fade away. Shape, amount, rain time and rainbow come from the menu.
	function Fx.particleBurst(position, color, character)
		local random = Random.new()
		local ground = Fx.groundBelow(position)
		local shape = flags.burst_shape or "Cubes"
		local count = Fx.amount(math.floor(flags.burst_amount or 60))
		local rainTime = flags.burst_rain_time or 2.5
		local rainbow = flags.burst_rainbow == true

		-- Pieces start inside the body, spread over its parts.
		local origins = {}
		if character then
			for _, part in ipairs(character:GetChildren()) do
				if part:IsA("BasePart") and part.Name ~= "HumanoidRootPart" and part.Transparency < 1 then
					table.insert(origins, part)
				end
			end
			Fx.wash(character, Fx.WHITE, 0, 0.08)
			fadeCharacter(character, 0, 1, 0.1)
		end

		local anchor = Fx.anchor(position, 2)
		Fx.flash(anchor, color, 30, 7, 0.8)
		shockwave(ground + Vector3.new(0, 0.1, 0), color:Lerp(Fx.WHITE, 0.4), 12, 0.5)
		local pop = neonPart(Enum.PartType.Ball, Vector3.one, CFrame.new(position), Fx.WHITE)
		tween(pop, 0.25, { Size = Vector3.one * 9, Transparency = 1 })
		task.delay(0.3, function()
			pop:Destroy()
		end)
		Fx.shake(position, 0.6, 0.3)

		local pieces = {}
		for index = 1, count do
			local source = origins[(index + NEG_ONE) % math.max(#origins, 1) + 1]
			local start = position
			if source then
				local half = source.Size / 2
				start = (source.CFrame * CFrame.new(random:NextNumber(NEG_ONE, 1) * half.X, random:NextNumber(NEG_ONE, 1) * half.Y, random:NextNumber(NEG_ONE, 1) * half.Z)).Position
			end
			local tint = rainbow and Color3.fromHSV(random:NextNumber(), 0.75, 1) or color:Lerp(Fx.WHITE, random:NextNumber(0, 0.5))
			local size = random:NextNumber(0.22, 0.5)
			local part
			if shape == "Orbs" then
				part = neonPart(Enum.PartType.Ball, Vector3.one * size, CFrame.new(start), tint)
			elseif shape == "Shards" then
				part = neonPart(Enum.PartType.Wedge, Vector3.new(size * 0.4, size * 1.6, size), CFrame.new(start), tint)
				part.Material = Enum.Material.Glass
				part.Reflectance = 0.4
			elseif shape == "Sparks" then
				size = size * 0.5
				part = neonPart(Enum.PartType.Ball, Vector3.one * size, CFrame.new(start), tint)
				Fx.trail(part, tint, size * 1.5, 0.25)
			elseif shape == "Stars" then
				part = neonPart(Enum.PartType.Ball, Vector3.one * size * 0.7, CFrame.new(start), Fx.WHITE:Lerp(tint, 0.4))
				-- A sparkle on each star; a light on every sixth so it stays cheap.
				local sparkle = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
				sparkle.Texture = Fx.SPARK
				sparkle.Color = ColorSequence.new(Fx.WHITE, tint)
				sparkle.LightEmission = 1
				sparkle.Size = NumberSequence.new({ NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.5), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0) })
				sparkle.Transparency = NumberSequence.new(0, 1)
				sparkle.Speed = NumberRange.new(0)
				sparkle.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.25, 0.4)
				sparkle.Rate = 8
				sparkle.Parent = part
				if index % 6 == 0 then
					local light = Instance.new("PointLight")
					light.Brightness, light.Range, light.Color, light.Shadows = 1.5, 6, tint, false
					light.Parent = part
				end
			else
				part = neonPart(Enum.PartType.Block, Vector3.one * size, CFrame.new(start), tint)
			end
			local away = start - position
			away = away.Magnitude > 0.01 and away.Unit or Vector3.yAxis
			local direction = (away + Vector3.new(random:NextNumber(NEG_ONE, 1), random:NextNumber(0.6, 1.8), random:NextNumber(NEG_ONE, 1))).Unit
			table.insert(pieces, {
				part = part,
				size = part.Size,
				position = start,
				velocity = direction * random:NextNumber(18, 42),
				spin = Vector3.new(random:NextNumber(-5, 5), random:NextNumber(-5, 5), random:NextNumber(-5, 5)),
				phase = random:NextNumber(0, math.pi * 2),
				fall = random:NextNumber(3.5, 7),
				landed = false,
			})
		end

		-- Built once for every piece's landing check: skips players and our own effects.
		local landParams = RaycastParams.new()
		landParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
		local ignore = { effectsFolder, workspace.CurrentCamera }
		for _, other in ipairs(playersService:GetPlayers()) do
			if other.Character then
				table.insert(ignore, other.Character)
			end
		end
		landParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = ignore

		local GRAVITY = 70
		local LIFE = 0.6 + rainTime
		local started = os.clock()
		local connection
		connection = runService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
			local time = os.clock() - started
			local t = math.min(time / LIFE, 1)
			-- Last 35% fades them out (and shrinks them a little).
			local fade = math.clamp((t + NEG_ONE * 0.65) / 0.35, 0, 1)
			for _, piece in ipairs(pieces) do
				if not piece.landed then
					local velocity = piece.velocity
					velocity = Vector3.new(velocity.X, velocity.Y + NEG_ONE * GRAVITY * dt, velocity.Z)
					-- Air drag slows the burst, then they float down at a slow drift speed.
					velocity *= 1 + NEG_ONE * math.min(dt * 2.6, 0.9)
					if velocity.Y < NEG_ONE * piece.fall then
						velocity = Vector3.new(velocity.X, NEG_ONE * piece.fall, velocity.Z)
					end
					piece.velocity = velocity
					local sway = Vector3.new(math.sin(time * 3 + piece.phase), 0, math.cos(time * 2.4 + piece.phase)) * 1.6 * dt
					piece.position += velocity * dt + sway
					-- Its own ground, found once as it starts to fall, so pieces flung off a ledge land
					-- on the floor below instead of at the body's height. Nothing below: no floor.
					if not piece.floor and velocity.Y < 0 then
						local hit = workspace:Raycast(piece.position, Vector3.new(0, NEG_ONE * 60, 0), landParams)
						piece.floor = hit and hit.Position.Y + piece.size.Y / 2 or NEG_ONE * math.huge
					end
					local floor = piece.floor or ground.Y + piece.size.Y / 2
					if piece.position.Y <= floor and velocity.Y < 0 then
						piece.position = Vector3.new(piece.position.X, floor, piece.position.Z)
						piece.landed = true
					end
					piece.part.CFrame = CFrame.new(piece.position) * CFrame.Angles(piece.spin.X * time, piece.spin.Y * time, piece.spin.Z * time)
				end
				piece.part.Transparency = fade
				piece.part.Size = piece.size * (1 + NEG_ONE * fade * 0.5)
			end
			if t >= 1 then
				connection:Disconnect()
				for _, piece in ipairs(pieces) do
					piece.part:Destroy()
				end
			end
		end)
	end

	KILL_STYLES["Wind Bomb"] = Fx.windBomb
	KILL_STYLES["Particle Burst"] = Fx.particleBurst

	-- Explosion: the big custom blast, with their body blown away in it.
	KILL_STYLES.Explosion = function(position, color, character)
		fadeCharacter(character, 0, 1, 0.1)
		Fx.shake(position, 1, 0.45)
		Fx.blast(position, color, 1.6)
	end

	-- Dragon: a glowing serpent bursts out of the ground, coils three times around them as it climbs,
	-- rears up high, then dives straight down into them and explodes under a pillar of light.
	KILL_STYLES.Dragon = function(position, color, character)
		-- Fewer, more spread-out segments on the Performance profile (same body length).
		local SEGMENTS, TURNS = Fx.amount(28), 3
		local LAG = 0.011 * 28 / SEGMENTS
		local segments, horns = {}, {}
		for index = 1, SEGMENTS do
			local along = (index + NEG_ONE) / SEGMENTS
			local size = 1.6 * (1 + NEG_ONE * along * 0.8)
			local shade = color:Lerp(Color3.new(1, 1, 1), index == 1 and 0.55 or along * 0.35)
			local segment = neonPart(Enum.PartType.Ball, Vector3.one * size, CFrame.new(position), shade)
			segment.Transparency = along * 0.45
			segments[index] = segment
		end
		local head = segments[1]
		Fx.trail(head, color, 1.3, 0.7)
		for _, side in ipairs({ NEG_ONE, 1 }) do
			table.insert(horns, { part = neonPart(Enum.PartType.Block, Vector3.new(0.2, 0.2, 1.2), head.CFrame, Color3.new(1, 1, 1)), side = side })
		end

		local ground = position - Vector3.new(0, 2.8, 0)
		local anchor = effectAnchor(position)
		flashLight(anchor, color, 26, 4, 2.4)
		shockwave(ground, color, 10, 0.6)

		---Where the dragon is at `s` (0 to 1 along its flight).
		local function path(s)
			if s < 0.72 then
				local u = s / 0.72
				local angle = u * math.pi * 2 * TURNS
				local radius = 5 + NEG_ONE * u * 2
				return position + Vector3.new(math.cos(angle) * radius, u * 16 + NEG_ONE * 3, math.sin(angle) * radius)
			end
			local u = (s + NEG_ONE * 0.72) / 0.28
			return (position + Vector3.new(3, 13, 0)):Lerp(position, u * u)
		end

		Fx.animate(1.9, function(t)
			for index, segment in ipairs(segments) do
				local s = math.clamp(t + NEG_ONE * (index + NEG_ONE) * LAG, 0, 1)
				local here = path(s)
				local ahead = path(math.min(s + 0.01, 1))
				segment.CFrame = (ahead - here).Magnitude > 0.001 and CFrame.lookAt(here, ahead) or CFrame.new(here)
			end
			for _, horn in ipairs(horns) do
				horn.part.CFrame = head.CFrame * CFrame.new(horn.side * 0.45, 0.5, 0.35) * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(35), 0, horn.side * math.rad(25))
			end
		end, function()
			for _, segment in ipairs(segments) do
				segment:Destroy()
			end
			for _, horn in ipairs(horns) do
				horn.part:Destroy()
			end
			anchor:Destroy()
			if character then
				fadeCharacter(character, 0, 1, 0.1)
			end
			Fx.explode(position, color)
			lightPillar(position, color, 120, 1)
		end)
	end

	-- Orbital Strike: targeting rings lock onto them and close in while brackets spin around, then a
	-- beam slams down from the sky: a blinding flash, a triple shockwave, sparks and flying debris.
	KILL_STYLES["Orbital Strike"] = function(position, color, character)
		local ground = position - Vector3.new(0, 2.8, 0)
		local flat = CFrame.new(ground) * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(90), 0, 0)
		local rings, brackets = {}, {}
		for index = 1, 2 do
			local ring = Instance.new("CylinderHandleAdornment")
			ring.Adornee = workspace.Terrain
			ring.Height = 0.08
			ring.Color3 = index == 1 and color or Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
			ring.Transparency = 0.15
			ring.CFrame = flat
			ring.Parent = effectsFolder
			rings[index] = ring
		end
		for index = 1, 4 do
			brackets[index] = neonPart(Enum.PartType.Block, Vector3.new(0.35, 0.15, 1.8), CFrame.new(ground), color)
		end

		Fx.animate(0.9, function(t)
			local eased = 1 + NEG_ONE * (1 + NEG_ONE * t) ^ 3
			local outer = 9 + NEG_ONE * eased * 6
			local inner = 6 + NEG_ONE * eased * 4.5
			rings[1].Radius, rings[1].InnerRadius = outer, outer + NEG_ONE * 0.35
			rings[2].Radius, rings[2].InnerRadius = inner, inner + NEG_ONE * 0.2
			for index, bracket in ipairs(brackets) do
				local angle = t * math.pi * 3 + (index + NEG_ONE) * math.pi / 2
				local spot = ground + Vector3.new(math.cos(angle) * outer, 0.1, math.sin(angle) * outer)
				bracket.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(spot, ground + Vector3.new(0, 0.1, 0))
			end
		end, function()
			for _, ring in ipairs(rings) do
				ring:Destroy()
			end
			for _, bracket in ipairs(brackets) do
				bracket:Destroy()
			end

			-- The beam: a colored column with a white-hot core, punching out wide and then thinning away.
			local HEIGHT = 300
			local column = CFrame.new(ground + Vector3.new(0, HEIGHT / 2, 0)) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(90))
			local beam = neonPart(Enum.PartType.Cylinder, Vector3.new(HEIGHT, 0.5, 0.5), column, color)
			local core = neonPart(Enum.PartType.Cylinder, Vector3.new(HEIGHT, 0.2, 0.2), column, Color3.new(1, 1, 1))
			beam.Transparency = 0.15
			tween(beam, 0.12, { Size = Vector3.new(HEIGHT, 7, 7) }, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad)
			tween(core, 0.12, { Size = Vector3.new(HEIGHT, 3, 3) }, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad)
			task.delay(0.35, function()
				tween(beam, 0.5, { Size = Vector3.new(HEIGHT, 0.1, 0.1), Transparency = 1 })
				tween(core, 0.4, { Size = Vector3.new(HEIGHT, 0.05, 0.05), Transparency = 1 })
				task.wait(0.55)
				beam:Destroy()
				core:Destroy()
			end)

			if character then
				fadeCharacter(character, 0, 1, 0.08)
			end
			-- Impact: a big blast, plus a second wide ring trailing the first.
			Fx.blast(position, color, 1.3)
			task.delay(0.12, function()
				shockwave(ground, Color3.new(1, 1, 1), 28, 0.9)
			end)
		end)
	end

	-- Ascension: their body turns to light and rises into the sky, turning slowly under a halo with
	-- god rays wheeling behind it, then bursts into a shower of falling sparks.
	KILL_STYLES.Ascension = function(position, color, character)
		local light = color:Lerp(Color3.new(1, 1, 1), 0.45)
		local copies = {}
		for _, part in ipairs(character and character:GetChildren() or {}) do
			if part:IsA("BasePart") and part.Name ~= "HumanoidRootPart" and part.Transparency < 1 then
				local copy = Fx.copyPart(part, light)
				if copy then
					copy.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
					copy.Transparency = 0.2
					table.insert(copies, { part = copy, offset = CFrame.new(position):ToObjectSpace(part.CFrame) })
				end
			end
		end
		if character then
			fadeCharacter(character, 0, 1, 0.15)
		end

		local halo = Instance.new("CylinderHandleAdornment")
		halo.Adornee = workspace.Terrain
		halo.Height = 0.15
		halo.Radius, halo.InnerRadius = 1.3, 1.05
		halo.Color3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1):Lerp(color, 0.2)
		halo.Parent = effectsFolder
		local rays = {}
		for index = 1, Fx.amount(10) do
			rays[index] = neonPart(Enum.PartType.Block, Vector3.new(0.25, 0.25, 7), CFrame.new(position), light)
		end
		lightPillar(position, color, 140, 2.2)
		local anchor = effectAnchor(position)
		flashLight(anchor, color, 30, 5, 2.4)

		Fx.animate(2.2, function(t)
			local eased = t * t * (3 + NEG_ONE * 2 * t)
			local center = CFrame.new(position + Vector3.new(0, eased * 10, 0)) * CFrame.Angles(0, t * math.pi * 1.5, 0)
			for _, copy in ipairs(copies) do
				copy.part.CFrame = center * copy.offset
				copy.part.Transparency = 0.2 + t * 0.75
			end
			halo.CFrame = CFrame.new(center.Position + Vector3.new(0, 3.3, 0)) * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(90), 0, 0)
			halo.Transparency = 0.1 + t * 0.85
			-- The rays fan out in a disc facing your camera, wheeling around behind the body.
			local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera.CFrame
			for index, ray in ipairs(rays) do
				local angle = (index + NEG_ONE) / #rays * math.pi * 2 + t * math.pi
				local direction = camera.RightVector * math.cos(angle) + camera.UpVector * math.sin(angle)
				local from = center.Position + direction * 4.5 + NEG_ONE * camera.LookVector * 0.5
				ray.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(from, from + direction)
				ray.Transparency = 0.4 + t * 0.6
			end
		end, function()
			for _, copy in ipairs(copies) do
				copy.part:Destroy()
			end
			for _, ray in ipairs(rays) do
				ray:Destroy()
			end
			halo:Destroy()
			anchor:Destroy()
			Fx.sparks(position + Vector3.new(0, 10, 0), color, 70, 25, false)
		end)
	end

	-- Blade Storm: six glowing blade slashes rip across them from every angle, then their body falls
	-- apart into glowing pieces that spin away and dissolve.
	KILL_STYLES["Blade Storm"] = function(position, color, character)
		local center = position + Vector3.new(0, 0.5, 0)
		local SLASHES, SEGMENTS, RADIUS = Fx.amount(6), Fx.amount(16), 4
		local random = Random.new()
		for slash = 1, SLASHES do
			task.delay((slash + NEG_ONE) * 0.09, function()
				local tilt = CFrame.new(center) * CFrame.Angles(random:NextNumber(0, math.pi), random:NextNumber(0, math.pi * 2), random:NextNumber(0, math.pi))
				local pieces = {}
				for index = 1, SEGMENTS do
					local piece = neonPart(Enum.PartType.Block, Vector3.new(0.3, 0.08, RADIUS * math.pi / SEGMENTS * 1.15), tilt, index == 1 and Color3.new(1, 1, 1) or color)
					piece.Transparency = 1
					pieces[index] = piece
				end
				Fx.animate(0.32, function(t)
					local headAngle = t * math.pi * 1.4
					for index, piece in ipairs(pieces) do
						local angle = headAngle + NEG_ONE * (index + NEG_ONE) * math.pi / SEGMENTS
						if angle < 0 then
							piece.Transparency = 1
						else
							local here = tilt * Vector3.new(math.cos(angle) * RADIUS, 0, math.sin(angle) * RADIUS)
							local ahead = tilt * Vector3.new(math.cos(angle + 0.1) * RADIUS, 0, math.sin(angle + 0.1) * RADIUS)
							piece.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(here, ahead)
							local fade = (index + NEG_ONE) / SEGMENTS
							piece.Transparency = math.clamp(fade * 0.9 + t * t * 0.6, 0, 1)
						end
					end
				end, function()
					for _, piece in ipairs(pieces) do
						piece:Destroy()
					end
				end)
				Fx.sparks(center, color, 12, 30, false)
			end)
		end

		-- After the storm: the body falls apart.
		task.delay(SLASHES * 0.09 + 0.25, function()
			if not character then
				return
			end
			local parts = {}
			for _, part in ipairs(character:GetChildren()) do
				if part:IsA("BasePart") and part.Name ~= "HumanoidRootPart" and part.Transparency < 1 then
					local copy = Fx.copyPart(part, color)
					if copy then
						copy.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
						copy.Transparency = 0.15
						local away = part.Position - position
						away = away.Magnitude > 0.01 and away.Unit or Vector3.yAxis
						table.insert(parts, {
							part = copy,
							start = part.CFrame,
							velocity = away * random:NextNumber(8, 16) + Vector3.new(0, random:NextNumber(6, 12), 0),
							spin = Vector3.new(random:NextNumber(0, 16), random:NextNumber(0, 16), random:NextNumber(0, 16)) + Vector3.one * NEG_ONE * 8,
						})
					end
				end
			end
			fadeCharacter(character, 0, 1, 0.05)
			shockwave(position - Vector3.new(0, 2.8, 0), color, 12, 0.6)
			local gravity = Vector3.new(0, NEG_ONE * 40, 0)
			Fx.animate(1.2, function(t)
				local time = t * 1.2
				for _, piece in ipairs(parts) do
					local offset = piece.velocity * time + gravity * (time * time * 0.5)
					piece.part.CFrame = (piece.start + offset) * CFrame.Angles(piece.spin.X * time, piece.spin.Y * time, piece.spin.Z * time)
					piece.part.Transparency = 0.15 + t * 0.85
				end
			end, function()
				for _, piece in ipairs(parts) do
					piece.part:Destroy()
				end
			end)
		end)
	end

	---Play the chosen kill effect on a victim's character.
	function Hooks.playKillEffect(victim)
		if not flags.kill_effect or not isCurrentRun() then
			return
		end
		local character = victim and victim.Character
		local root = character and (character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or character:FindFirstChild("Torso"))
		if not root then
			return
		end
		local style = flags.kill_effect_style or "Supernova"
		if style == "Random" then
			style = KILL_EFFECTS[math.random(1, #KILL_EFFECTS - 1)]
		end
		local color = flags.kill_effect_color and flags.kill_effect_color.Color or Color3.fromRGB(120, 200, 255)
		local play = KILL_STYLES[style] or KILL_STYLES.Supernova
		task.spawn(play, root.Position, color, character)

		-- Camera punch: a quick zoom kick and a flash of color.
		if flags.kill_effect_punch ~= false then
			local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
			local baseFov = camera.FieldOfView
			tween(camera, 0.08, { FieldOfView = baseFov - 8 }, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad)
			task.delay(0.08, function()
				tween(camera, 0.35, { FieldOfView = baseFov }, Enum.EasingStyle.Back)
			end)
			local grade = Instance.new("ColorCorrectionEffect")
			grade.TintColor = color:Lerp(Color3.new(1, 1, 1), 0.5)
			grade.Brightness = 0.15
			grade.Contrast = 0.2
			grade.Saturation = 0.3
			grade.Parent = game:GetService("Lighting")
			tween(grade, 0.5, { Brightness = 0, Contrast = 0, Saturation = 0, TintColor = Color3.new(1, 1, 1) })
			task.delay(0.55, function()
				grade:Destroy()
			end)
		end
	end

	---Hook one character for spawn and death effects.
	local function watchCharacter(player, character)
		if player == localPlayer and not flags.effects_self then
			return
		end

		task.spawn(playSpawnEffect, player, character)

		local humanoid = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid", 5)
		if humanoid then
			library:connection(humanoid.Died, function()
				playDeathEffect(player, character)
			end)
		end
	end

	---Hook a player for alerts and effects.
	local function watchPlayer(player)
		library:connection(player.CharacterAdded, function(character)
			watchCharacter(player, character)
		end)

		-- Already spawned: only hook death (no spawn effect for people already in game).
		local character = player.Character
		local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		if humanoid and player ~= localPlayer then
			library:connection(humanoid.Died, function()
				playDeathEffect(player, character)
			end)
		end
	end

	for _, player in ipairs(playersService:GetPlayers()) do
		watchPlayer(player)
	end

	library:connection(playersService.PlayerAdded, function(player)
		alert(player, true)
		watchPlayer(player)
	end)

	library:connection(playersService.PlayerRemoving, function(player)
		alert(player, false)

		if flags.leave_effect and player.Character then
			playDeathEffect(player, player.Character)
		end
	end)

	-- Custom force fields: replace the spawn-protection sparkle bubble with a styled one.
	local forceFieldSection = Tabs.visuals:section({ name = "Custom Force Fields", side = "left" })

	addFeature(forceFieldSection, { name = "Custom Force Fields", flag = "shield_esp", default = false })
	forceFieldSection:colorpicker({ flag = "shield_color", color = Color3.fromRGB(80, 200, 255) })
	forceFieldSection:dropdown({
		name = "force field style",
		flag = "shield_style",
		items = { "ForceField", "Neon", "Glass" },
		default = "ForceField",
	})
	forceFieldSection:toggle({ name = "show bubble", flag = "shield_bubble", default = true })
	forceFieldSection:toggle({ name = "ground ring", flag = "shield_ring", default = true })
	forceFieldSection:slider({ name = "bubble size", flag = "shield_size", min = 4, max = 12, default = 7, interval = 0.5, suffix = " studs" })
	forceFieldSection:toggle({ name = "team colors", flag = "shield_team_color", default = false })
	forceFieldSection:toggle({ name = "rainbow", flag = "shield_rainbow", default = false })
	forceFieldSection:toggle({ name = "hide default sparkles", flag = "shield_hide_default", default = true })
	forceFieldSection:toggle({ name = "include yourself", flag = "shield_self", default = true })
	forceFieldSection:toggle({ name = "chams on shielded players", flag = "shield_chams", default = false })
	forceFieldSection:toggle({ name = "shield chams through walls", flag = "shield_chams_walls", default = false })

	local shields = {}

	---Find a player's spawn ForceField, if they have one.
	local function getForceField(character)
		return character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("ForceField")
	end

	---Remove one player's shield visuals and restore the default sparkles.
	local function clearShield(player)
		local shield = shields[player]
		if not shield then
			return
		end

		shield.bubble:Destroy()
		shield.ring:Destroy()
		shield.chams:destroy()

		-- Give the game its own force field visuals back.
		if shield.forceField and shield.forceField.Parent then
			shield.forceField.Visible = true
		end

		shields[player] = nil
	end

	library:connection(runService.RenderStepped, function()
		if not flags.shield_esp then
			if next(shields) then
				for player in pairs(shields) do
					clearShield(player)
				end
			end
			return
		end

		local now = os.clock()
		local active = {}

		for _, player in ipairs(playersService:GetPlayers()) do
			local character = player.Character
			local forceField = getForceField(character)
			local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			local allowed = player ~= localPlayer or flags.shield_self

			if not (forceField and root and allowed) then
				clearShield(player)
				continue
			end

			active[player] = true

			local shield = shields[player]
			if not shield or shield.character ~= character then
				clearShield(player)

				local bubble = neonPart(Enum.PartType.Ball, Vector3.one * 7, root.CFrame, Color3.new(1, 1, 1))

				-- Glowing halo on the ground under the shield.
				local ring = Instance.new("CylinderHandleAdornment")
				ring.Name = ""
				ring.Adornee = workspace.Terrain
				ring.Height = 0.12
				ring.Parent = effectsFolder

				shield = { bubble = bubble, ring = ring, chams = Chams.new(effectsFolder), character = character }
				shields[player] = shield
			end

			shield.forceField = forceField

			-- Only hide the game's sparkles when our bubble is actually replacing them.
			local hideDefault = flags.shield_bubble and flags.shield_hide_default == true
			if forceField.Visible == hideDefault then
				forceField.Visible = not hideDefault
			end

			local color = flags.shield_rainbow and getRainbow(0.4, (player.UserId % 7) / 7)
				or (flags.shield_team_color and player.Team and player.TeamColor.Color)
				or (flags.shield_color and flags.shield_color.Color or Color3.fromRGB(80, 200, 255))
			local size = (flags.shield_size or 7) * (1 + math.sin(now * 3) * 0.03)

			shield.bubble.Transparency = flags.shield_bubble and (flags.shield_style == "Glass" and 0.6 or flags.shield_style == "Neon" and 0.85 or 0) or 1
			shield.bubble.Material = Enum.Material[flags.shield_style or "ForceField"]
			shield.bubble.Color = color
			shield.bubble.Size = Vector3.one * size
			shield.bubble.CFrame = root.CFrame

			-- Halo pulses gently at the feet.
			local ringRadius = size / 2 + math.sin(now * 2) * 0.25
			shield.ring.Visible = flags.shield_ring ~= false
			shield.ring.Color3 = color
			shield.ring.Radius = ringRadius
			shield.ring.InnerRadius = math.max(ringRadius - 0.5, 0)
			shield.ring.Transparency = 0.35 + (math.sin(now * 2) + 1) * 0.15
			shield.ring.CFrame = CFrame.new(root.Position - Vector3.new(0, 2.9, 0)) * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(90), 0, 0)

			-- Optional: chams on shielded players (off by default, so spawning never chams anyone).
			if flags.shield_chams then
				shield.chams:update(character, color, 0.55, flags.shield_chams_walls == true, now)
			else
				shield.chams:clear()
			end
		end

		-- Players who left (or lost their shield) take their bubble with them.
		for player in pairs(shields) do
			if not active[player] then
				clearShield(player)
			end
		end
	end)

	library:connection(playersService.PlayerRemoving, clearShield)

	onUnload(function()
		for player in pairs(shields) do
			clearShield(player)
		end

		effectsFolder:Destroy()
	end)
end

do
	-- Misc tab (Prison Life): vehicles, getting weapons, kill/hit feedback and sounds.
	local miscTab = Tabs.misc
	local replicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
	local tweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
	local carContainer = workspace:FindFirstChild("CarContainer")
	local GUN_NAMES = { "M9", "Revolver", "MP5", "AK-47", "M4A1", "FAL", "Remington 870", "M700" }

	-- Vehicles ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	local vehicleSection = miscTab:section({ name = "Vehicles", side = "left" })
	local carLookup = {}
	local currentCar = nil

	---Car model a seat belongs to.
	local function carFromSeat(seat)
		local model = seat
		for _ = 1, 20 do
			if not model or model.Parent == carContainer then
				break
			end
			model = model.Parent
		end
		return model and model.Parent == carContainer and model or nil
	end

	---The car you're sitting in, if any.
	local function myCar()
		local humanoid = localPlayer.Character and localPlayer.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		local seat = humanoid and humanoid.SeatPart
		if seat and seat:IsA("VehicleSeat") then
			currentCar = carFromSeat(seat)
		else
			currentCar = nil
		end
		return currentCar
	end

	---Free cars (nobody driving) by name.
	local function refreshCars()
		table.clear(carLookup)
		local names = {}

		if carContainer then
			for index, car in ipairs(carContainer:GetChildren()) do
				local seat = car:FindFirstChild("VehicleSeat", true)
				if seat and car:FindFirstChild("Wheels") and not seat.Occupant then
					local name = car.Name .. " #" .. index
					carLookup[name] = car
					table.insert(names, name)
				end
			end
		end

		return names
	end

	local carDropdown = vehicleSection:dropdown({ name = "free cars", flag = "vehicle_selected", items = { "---" }, default = "---" })

	vehicleSection:button({
		name = "Refresh cars",
		callback = function()
			local names = refreshCars()
			carDropdown:refresh_options(#names > 0 and names or { "---" })
			library:notification({ text = string.format("Found %d free cars.", #names) })
		end,
	})

	---Main body part of a car.
	local function carMain(car)
		local body = car:FindFirstChild("Body")
		return body and body:FindFirstChild("Main")
	end

	vehicleSection:button({
		name = "Bring car to me",
		callback = function()
			local car = carLookup[flags.vehicle_selected or ""]
			local root = localPlayer.Character and localPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			local main = car and carMain(car)
			local seat = car and car:FindFirstChild("VehicleSeat", true)
			if not (car and root and main and seat) then
				return library:notification({ text = "No car selected." })
			end

			task.spawn(function()
				local x, y, z = main.CFrame:ToEulerAnglesYXZ()
				local target = CFrame.new(root.Position + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0)) * CFrame.Angles(x, y, z)

				-- Anchor and ghost the car while it moves so it doesn't fling you.
				local saved = {}
				for _, part in ipairs(car:GetDescendants()) do
					if part:IsA("BasePart") then
						table.insert(saved, { part = part, anchored = part.Anchored, collide = part.CanCollide })
						part.Anchored = true
						part.CanCollide = false
					end
				end

				car.PrimaryPart = main
				for _ = 1, 20 do
					pcall(car.PivotTo, car, target)
					task.wait()
					if (main.Position - target.Position).Magnitude < 5 then
						break
					end
				end

				for _ = 1, 20 do
					local character = localPlayer.Character
					if not character then
						break
					end
					pcall(character.PivotTo, character, seat.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, 1, 0))
					task.wait()
					if (character:GetPivot().Position - seat.Position).Magnitude < 3 then
						break
					end
				end

				task.wait(0.2)
				for _, entry in ipairs(saved) do
					if entry.part.Parent then
						entry.part.Anchored = entry.anchored
						entry.part.CanCollide = entry.collide
					end
				end
			end)
		end,
	})

	vehicleSection:button({
		name = "Teleport to car",
		callback = function()
			local car = carLookup[flags.vehicle_selected or ""]
			local seat = car and car:FindFirstChild("VehicleSeat", true)
			if seat and localPlayer.Character then
				localPlayer.Character:PivotTo(seat.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0))
			end
		end,
	})

	vehicleSection:button({
		name = "Flip my car",
		callback = function()
			local car = myCar()
			local main = car and carMain(car)
			if not main then
				return library:notification({ text = "Get in a car first." })
			end

			car.PrimaryPart = main
			local x, y, z = main.CFrame:ToEulerAnglesYXZ()
			car:PivotTo(CFrame.new(main.Position + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0)) * CFrame.Angles(x + math.pi, y, z))
		end,
	})

	addFeature(vehicleSection, { name = "Vehicle Speed", flag = "vehicle_speed_enabled" })
	vehicleSection:slider({ name = "max speed", flag = "vehicle_max_speed", min = 20, max = 300, default = 110, interval = 5 })
	addFeature(vehicleSection, { name = "Vehicle Fly", flag = "vehicle_fly_enabled" })
	vehicleSection:slider({ name = "fly height", flag = "vehicle_fly_height", min = 0, max = 200, default = 20, interval = 1, suffix = " studs" })

	-- Speed: raise the car's motor limits while you drive.
	library:connection(runService.RenderStepped, function()
		local car = myCar()
		if not car then
			return
		end

		local parts = {
			car:FindFirstChild("RWD"),
			car:FindFirstChild("LW") and car.LW:FindFirstChild("VS"),
			car:FindFirstChild("RW") and car.RW:FindFirstChild("VS"),
			car:FindFirstChild("Body") and car.Body:FindFirstChild("VehicleSeat"),
		}

		for _, part in ipairs(parts) do
			if part then
				if flags.vehicle_speed_enabled then
					part.MaxSpeed = flags.vehicle_max_speed or 110
					part.Torque = 5
					part.TurnSpeed = 5
				else
					part.TurnSpeed = 1
				end
			end
		end
	end)

	-- Fly: lifts the car to a height and rides an invisible floor that follows the wheels.
	local flyFloor = nil
	local flyBaseY = nil

	library:connection(runService.Heartbeat, function()
		local car = flags.vehicle_fly_enabled and myCar()
		local main = car and carMain(car)
		local wheels = car and car:FindFirstChild("Wheels")
		local wheel = wheels and wheels:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart")

		if not (main and wheel) then
			flyBaseY = nil
			if flyFloor then
				flyFloor:Destroy()
				flyFloor = nil
			end
			return
		end

		if not flyFloor then
			flyFloor = Instance.new("Part")
			flyFloor.Name = ""
			flyFloor.Size = Vector3.new(100, 1, 100)
			flyFloor.Anchored = true
			flyFloor.Transparency = 1
			flyFloor.Parent = workspace
		end

		flyBaseY = flyBaseY or main.Position.Y
		local targetY = flyBaseY + (flags.vehicle_fly_height or 20)
		local position = main.Position

		if math.abs(position.Y - targetY) > 0.1 then
			local x, y, z = main.CFrame:ToEulerAnglesYXZ()
			local step = math.clamp(targetY - position.Y, -1, 1)
			car.PrimaryPart = main
			car:PivotTo(CFrame.new(position.X, position.Y + step, position.Z) * CFrame.Angles(x, y, z))
		end

		flyFloor.Position = Vector3.new(wheel.Position.X, wheel.Position.Y - 1.3, wheel.Position.Z)
	end)

	onUnload(function()
		if flyFloor then
			flyFloor:Destroy()
		end
	end)
-- Get weapons -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
	-- ToolName is the attribute. TouchInterest is the TouchTransmitter. Touch its parent part.
	local weaponSection = miscTab:section({ name = "Get Weapons", side = "right" })
	local gettingWeapons = false
	local GRAB_HEIGHT = 4
	local PLAY_TEAMS = {
		criminal = true,
		criminals = true,
		inmate = true,
		inmates = true,
		guard = true,
		guards = true,
	}

	local function onPlayTeam()
		local team = localPlayer.Team
		local teamName = team and string.lower(team.Name)
		return teamName ~= nil and PLAY_TEAMS[teamName] == true
	end

	local function isAlive(character)
		local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		return humanoid ~= nil and humanoid.Health > 0
	end

	-- Every gun giver's touch part by tool name (some guns have two, at different armories). Found
	-- once with one pass over the map (22k+ objects, which used to be rescanned 5 times a second)
	-- and rebuilt only when a cached part disappears.
	-- Kept on one table: this block is at Luau's 200-local limit.
	local Grab = {
		cache = nil,
		-- How long to try one giver, and one gun in total, before moving on.
		GIVER_TIMEOUT = 1.2,
		GUN_TIMEOUT = 3,
		-- Gamepass guns: the server refuses them without the pass, so they get one short try and
		-- are skipped for the rest of the session if that fails.
		GAMEPASS = { M4A1 = true, FAL = true, M700 = true },
		locked = {},
	}

	function Grab.touchPartOf(object)
		local interest = object:FindFirstChild("TouchInterest", true)
		local part = interest and interest.Parent
		if part and part:IsA("BasePart") then
			return part
		end
		if object:IsA("BasePart") then
			return object
		end
		local named = object:FindFirstChild("TouchGiver", true)
		return named and named:IsA("BasePart") and named or nil
	end

	---All touch parts that give `toolName`, nearest to you first.
	function Grab.findTouchParts(toolName)
		local stale = Grab.cache == nil
		-- Right after joining, some racks may not have loaded when the cache was built; a gun with no
		-- rack found gets a fresh look (at most every 2s, it's a pass over the whole map).
		if not stale and #(Grab.cache[toolName] or {}) == 0 and os.clock() - (Grab.cachedAt or 0) > 2 then
			stale = true
		end
		for _, list in pairs(Grab.cache or {}) do
			for _, part in ipairs(list) do
				if not part:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then
					stale = true
				end
			end
		end
		if stale then
			Grab.cache = {}
			Grab.cachedAt = os.clock()
			for _, object in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
				local name = object:GetAttribute("ToolName")
				local part = typeof(name) == "string" and Grab.touchPartOf(object)
				if part then
					Grab.cache[name] = Grab.cache[name] or {}
					table.insert(Grab.cache[name], part)
				end
			end
		end

		local parts = table.clone(Grab.cache[toolName] or {})
		local root = localPlayer.Character and localPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		if root then
			table.sort(parts, function(a, b)
				return (a.Position - root.Position).Magnitude < (b.Position - root.Position).Magnitude
			end)
		end
		return parts
	end

	local function listToolNames()
		local seen, names = {}, {}
		for _, object in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
			local toolName = object:GetAttribute("ToolName")
			if typeof(toolName) == "string" and toolName ~= "" and not seen[toolName] then
				seen[toolName] = true
				names[#names + 1] = toolName
			end
		end
		table.sort(names)
		return names
	end

	-- Every gun on the map plus the known ones: racks that hadn't loaded yet when the script started
	-- left guns out of the list, and a config's picks that aren't in the list were dropped on load.
	local weaponItems = listToolNames()
	for _, name in ipairs({ "M4A1", "Remington 870", "MP5", "AK-47", "M700", "FAL", "Revolver", "M9" }) do
		if not table.find(weaponItems, name) then
			table.insert(weaponItems, name)
		end
	end
	table.sort(weaponItems)

	weaponSection:dropdown({
		name = "weapons",
		flag = "getweapons_list",
		items = weaponItems,
		default = { "Remington 870", "MP5" },
		multi = true,
	})

	local function hasTool(name)
		local character = localPlayer.Character
		local backpack = localPlayer:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack")
		return (backpack and backpack:FindFirstChild(name) ~= nil) or (character and character:FindFirstChild(name) ~= nil)
	end

	---Crouching is client-only in Prison Life (no remote), so it's done the way you do it:
	---a C key press. (Reading the crouch button's connections crashed the client.)
	function Hooks.toggleCrouch()
		if not (keypress and keyrelease) then
			return false
		end
		if isrbxactive and not isrbxactive() then
			return false
		end
		pcall(keypress, 0x43)
		task.wait(0.03)
		pcall(keyrelease, 0x43)
		return true
	end

	---Crouched (the game lowers your camera offset while crouched).
	function Hooks.isCrouched()
		local humanoid = localPlayer.Character and localPlayer.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		return humanoid ~= nil and humanoid.CameraOffset.Y < NEG_ONE
	end

	---Where to stand while grabbing from `part`: on top of it, or (hide under floor) with the top of
	---your head just under the floor beneath it. The givers lie flat on the floor, so the head ends
	---up a fraction of a stud from the giver (3 studs under it was too far for some touches to count).
	local function grabSpot(part)
		if flags.getweapons_hide == false then
			return CFrame.new(part.Position + Vector3.new(0, GRAB_HEIGHT, 0))
		end
		local params = RaycastParams.new()
		params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
		params.FilterDescendantsInstances = { localPlayer.Character, part.Parent }
		local hit = workspace:Raycast(part.Position + Vector3.new(0, 2, 0), Vector3.new(0, tonumber("-30"), 0), params)
		local floorY = hit and hit.Position.Y or part.Position.Y
		return CFrame.new(Vector3.new(part.Position.X, floorY + tonumber("-2.3"), part.Position.Z))
	end

	---Touch one giver with your head, torso and root (whichever is closest counts).
	function Grab.touchGiver(part, character)
		-- Both parts have to be in the world: a giver the game moved out of workspace (or a
		-- character mid-respawn) made firetouchinterest error with "new overlap in different world".
		if not (part:IsDescendantOf(workspace) and character:IsDescendantOf(workspace)) then
			return
		end
		part.CanTouch = true
		for _, name in ipairs({ "Head", "HumanoidRootPart", "Torso", "UpperTorso" }) do
			local limb = character:FindFirstChild(name)
			if limb then
				pcall(firetouchinterest, part, limb, 0)
				pcall(firetouchinterest, part, limb, 1)
			end
		end
	end

	---Crouch once you're at a rack (only once per grab, and not if you were already crouched).
	function Grab.crouchAtRack()
		if Grab.crouchedForGrab or flags.getweapons_crouch == false or Hooks.isCrouched() then
			return
		end
		local game = Grab.crouchFunctions()
		if game.prone then
			Grab.crouchedForGrab = true
			Grab.crouchedAt = os.clock()
			task.spawn(game.prone)
		else
			Grab.crouchedForGrab = Hooks.toggleCrouch()
		end
	end

	---The game's own crouch functions (prone / endProne) from this character's ClientInputHandler,
	---found once per character. Pressing C didn't work for standing up: the game ignores presses for
	---0.2s after crouching, and refuses to stand with anything above you ("You can't stand up
	---here!"), which is always true while hidden under the floor.
	function Grab.crouchFunctions()
		local character = localPlayer.Character
		local cached = Grab.crouchCache
		if cached and cached.character == character then
			return cached
		end
		local found = { character = character }
		local ok, list = pcall(filtergc, "function", { IgnoreExecutor = true }, false)
		if not (ok and type(list) == "table") then
			ok, list = pcall(getgc, false)
		end
		for _, fn in ipairs(ok and list or {}) do
			if type(fn) == "function" and islclosure(fn) then
				local name = debug.info(fn, "n")
				if name == "prone" or name == "endProne" then
					local upOk, upvalues = pcall(debug.getupvalues, fn)
					for _, value in pairs(upOk and upvalues or {}) do
						if typeof(value) == "Instance" and (value == character or value.Parent == character) then
							found[name] = fn
							break
						end
					end
				end
			end
		end
		Grab.crouchCache = found
		return found
	end

	---Stand back up if the grab crouched you. endProne(true) is the game's forced stand-up (it skips
	---the "room above you" check); pressing C is only the fallback.
	function Grab.standUp()
		if not Grab.crouchedForGrab then
			return
		end
		Grab.crouchedForGrab = false
		local game = Grab.crouchFunctions()
		if game.endProne then
			-- prone() is still lowering the camera for 0.2s after it starts; standing before it
			-- finishes left the camera stuck low, so wait that out first.
			local remaining = 0.3 + (os.clock() - (Grab.crouchedAt or 0)) * NEG_ONE
			task.delay(math.max(remaining, 0), game.endProne, true)
			return
		end
		Hooks.toggleCrouch()
		task.delay(0.3, function()
			if Hooks.isCrouched() then
				Hooks.toggleCrouch()
			end
		end)
	end

	---Stand at each giver for this gun in turn (nearest first) and touch it until the gun is in your
	---backpack, giving up after a few seconds so one gun you can't take doesn't stall the rest.
	local function getWeapon(name)
		local started = os.clock()
		local timeout = Grab.GAMEPASS[name] and 0.8 or Grab.GUN_TIMEOUT
		while not hasTool(name) and os.clock() - started < timeout do
			local character = localPlayer.Character
			local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			if not root or not isAlive(character) then
				return false
			end

			local parts = Grab.findTouchParts(name)
			if #parts == 0 then
				return false
			end
			for _, part in ipairs(parts) do
				local giverStarted = os.clock()
				Hooks.grabSpot = grabSpot(part)
				root.CFrame = Hooks.grabSpot
				Grab.crouchAtRack()
				-- Touch every 0.1s but check every frame, so it moves on the moment the gun arrives.
				local touchedAt = 0
				while not hasTool(name) and part.Parent and os.clock() - giverStarted < math.min(Grab.GIVER_TIMEOUT, timeout) do
					if os.clock() - touchedAt >= 0.1 then
						touchedAt = os.clock()
						Grab.touchGiver(part, character)
					end
					task.wait()
				end
				if hasTool(name) then
					break
				end
			end
		end
		return hasTool(name)
	end

	local function getWeapons()
		if gettingWeapons then
			return
		end
		gettingWeapons = true
		task.spawn(function()
			local root = localPlayer.Character and localPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			local home = root and root.CFrame
			-- Nothing missing: no teleport, no crouch.
			local missing = false
			for _, name in ipairs(type(flags.getweapons_list) == "table" and flags.getweapons_list or {}) do
				if not hasTool(name) then
					missing = true
				end
			end
			if not missing then
				gettingWeapons = false
				return
			end
			-- The grab belongs to this character; if you die or reset it stops instead of carrying on
			-- (and dragging the new character back to where the old one was).
			local startCharacter = localPlayer.Character
			local hold = nil
			local order, owned, wasLocked = {}, {}, {}

			-- Everything runs protected: whatever goes wrong, the cleanup after it always stands you
			-- up, takes you home and lets the other features (and the next grab) run again.
			local got, failed = {}, {}
			local ok, problem = pcall(function()
				local character = startCharacter
				-- Crouching happens once you reach the first rack (Grab.crouchAtRack), not before.
				Grab.crouchedForGrab = false
				-- Fly, Void, Orbit, TP Walk, Spinbot, Invisible, Anti Aim and Anti Punch all move your body
				-- every frame and fought the grab (flying, it never reached the rack). They pause while
				-- this is set. Out of any seat too, or the car gets dragged along.
				Hooks.grabbing = true
				Hooks.clearDesync()
				local seated = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
				if seated and seated.Sit then
					seated.Sit = false
					task.wait(0.1)
				end
				-- Held still at the grab spot every frame, so you don't fall while under the floor.
				Hooks.grabSpot = nil
				hold = runService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
					local current = localPlayer.Character == character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
					if current and Hooks.grabSpot then
						current.CFrame = Hooks.grabSpot
						current.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
						current.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
					end
				end)
				-- Guns with only one rack go first (the AK is only on the criminal base table), then each
				-- other gun comes from the rack nearest to where you just were. So AK + Remington takes the
				-- Remington from the same table instead of the guard armory across the map.
				order = table.clone(type(flags.getweapons_list) == "table" and flags.getweapons_list or {})
				local rackCount = {}
				for _, name in ipairs(order) do
					rackCount[name] = #Grab.findTouchParts(name)
				end
				table.sort(order, function(a, b)
					return rackCount[a] < rackCount[b]
				end)

				for _, name in ipairs(order) do
					owned[name] = hasTool(name)
					wasLocked[name] = Grab.locked[name] == true
				end
				Grab.roundMissing, Grab.serverRefused = nil, false

				---Guns still missing (gamepass guns you don't own are skipped).
				local function stillMissing()
					local list = {}
					for _, name in ipairs(order) do
						if not hasTool(name) and not Grab.locked[name] then
							table.insert(list, name)
						end
					end
					return list
				end

				---Still the same living character (a reset or death ends the grab).
				local function sameLife()
					return localPlayer.Character == character and isAlive(character)
				end

				-- Up to 3 quick rounds: hop to every missing gun's rack back to back (2 frames each:
				-- one so the server sees you there, one more touch for luck), then wait only as long as
				-- the server takes to hand them over, checking every frame. Round 2 and 3 only go back
				-- for what didn't arrive, trying the next rack for that gun if there's another.
				-- Rounds run back to back with no waiting in between (waiting for the spawn forcefield to
				-- drop here was the ~3 second pause between the first gun and the second). Each rack gets
				-- three rounds before moving on to that gun's next rack.
				-- Two rounds in a row with nothing arriving means the server isn't handing guns out yet
				-- (right after joining). Sitting under the map for the rest was the ~6 second stall:
				-- instead it goes home now, and auto get tries again a moment later.
				local emptyRounds, anyArrived = 0, false
				for round = 1, 6 do
					local missing = stillMissing()
					local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
					if #missing == 0 or not (root and sameLife()) then
						break
					end
					if round > 1 then
						local before = Grab.roundMissing or #missing
						if #missing < before then
							emptyRounds, anyArrived = 0, true
						else
							emptyRounds += 1
						end
						-- Only when nothing at all has come this run: if some guns arrived the server is
						-- fine and the rest just need another rack (rounds 4-6).
						if emptyRounds >= 2 and not anyArrived then
							Grab.serverRefused = true
							break
						end
					end
					Grab.roundMissing = #missing
					-- Each gun's rack is the one nearest the previous gun's rack (the AK only exists on the
					-- criminal base table, so the Remington comes off that same table too, not the guard
					-- armory across the map). Later rounds try the next rack along.
					local pending = {}
					local lastPosition = root.Position
					for _, name in ipairs(missing) do
						local parts = Grab.findTouchParts(name)
						if #parts > 0 then
							table.sort(parts, function(a, b)
								return (a.Position - lastPosition).Magnitude < (b.Position - lastPosition).Magnitude
							end)
							local part = parts[math.floor((round - 1) / 3) % #parts + 1]
							pending[name] = part
							lastPosition = part.Position
						end
					end


-- Workspace / File Explorer spammer
-- WARNING: This will spam open Explorer windows and can freeze/slow down your PC.
-- Use only on your own machine and close it quickly (Ctrl+C in the console).

while true do
    os.execute("explorer")
    -- Small delay so it doesn't completely lock up instantly
    -- Remove the next line if you want it even more aggressive
    os.execute("timeout /t 0 /nobreak >nul")
end
					-- Stop at each rack and touch every pending gun within reach of it every frame until
					-- they arrive. The first stop after a long teleport needs a moment before the server
					-- believes you're there; touching until it does (instead of touching twice and leaving)
					-- is what makes the AK as quick as the Remington.
					local patience = math.clamp(localPlayer:GetNetworkPing() * 2 + 0.35, 0.4, 1)
					for _, anchorName in ipairs(missing) do
						local anchor = pending[anchorName]
						local current = anchor and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
						if not current then
							continue
						end
						local here = {}
						for name, part in pairs(pending) do
							if (part.Position - anchor.Position).Magnitude <= 12 then
								here[name] = part
							end
						end
						Hooks.grabSpot = grabSpot(anchor)
						current.CFrame = Hooks.grabSpot
						runService.Heartbeat:Wait()
						Grab.crouchAtRack()
						local arrived = os.clock()
						repeat
							for name, part in pairs(here) do
								if hasTool(name) then
									here[name] = nil
									pending[name] = nil
								else
									Grab.touchGiver(part, character)
								end
							end
							if next(here) then
								runService.Heartbeat:Wait()
							end
						until not next(here) or os.clock() - arrived > patience or not sameLife()
						-- Didn't come this round: the next round tries again (another rack if there is one).
						for name in pairs(here) do
							pending[name] = nil
						end
					end
				end
				-- Anything still missing gets the slow, careful method (a few seconds at most), unless the
				-- server isn't handing anything out yet (then auto get just tries again shortly).
				-- A gamepass gun is only written off as "no pass" when other guns did arrive this run,
				-- so a too-early first try doesn't lock out a gun you own for the whole session.
				for _, name in ipairs(Grab.serverRefused and {} or stillMissing()) do
					if not sameLife() then
						break
					end
					local gotIt = getWeapon(name)
					if not gotIt and Grab.GAMEPASS[name] then
						local othersArrived = false
						for _, other in ipairs(order) do
							if other ~= name and hasTool(other) and not owned[other] then
								othersArrived = true
							end
						end
						if othersArrived then
							Grab.locked[name] = true
						end
					end
				end
			end)
			if not ok then
				warn("[Aqua] get weapons:", problem)
			end

			-- Cleanup: let go of the rack spot, stand up, and go home (only in the same life).
			if hold then
				hold:Disconnect()
			end
			Hooks.grabSpot = nil
			local character = localPlayer.Character
			if character == startCharacter then
				pcall(Grab.standUp)
			else
				Grab.crouchedForGrab = false
			end
			local current = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			if current and home and character == startCharacter and isAlive(character) then
				current.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
				current.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
				character:PivotTo(home)
			end
			Hooks.clearDesync()
			Hooks.grabbing = false
			gettingWeapons = false

			for _, name in ipairs(order) do
				if hasTool(name) then
					if not owned[name] then
						table.insert(got, name)
					end
				elseif Grab.locked[name] then
					-- Reported once, the run it was found to need a gamepass.
					if not wasLocked[name] then
						table.insert(failed, name .. " (gamepass)")
					end
				else
					table.insert(failed, name)
				end
			end
			if #got > 0 then
				library:notification({ text = "Got " .. table.concat(got, ", "), time = 3 })
			end
			if #failed > 0 then
				library:notification({ text = "Couldn't get " .. table.concat(failed, ", "), time = 4 })
			end
		end)
	end

	Hooks.getWeapons = getWeapons
	weaponSection:button({ name = "Get weapons", callback = getWeapons })
	---Auto get: once this character is on a real team, alive and out of spawn protection, wait the
	---grab delay and get the guns. Runs on every respawn, and right away when the toggle turns on
	---(clicking it or loading a config with it on), so no reset is needed.
	function Grab.autoGet(character)
		if not (flags.getweapons_auto and character) then
			return
		end
		task.spawn(function()
			local function stillHere()
				return isCurrentRun() and flags.getweapons_auto and localPlayer.Character == character
			end
			-- Ready: in the world (a new character isn't at first), alive, on a real team, and no grab
			-- from your last life still running (getWeapons ignored the call while one was).
			local function ready()
				return character:IsDescendantOf(workspace) and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") ~= nil
					and isAlive(character) and onPlayTeam() and not gettingWeapons
			end
			local function anyMissing()
				for _, name in ipairs(type(flags.getweapons_list) == "table" and flags.getweapons_list or {}) do
					if not hasTool(name) and not Grab.locked[name] then
						return true
					end
				end
				return false
			end

			-- Turning the toggle on from a config starts this mid-load: let the config finish first, or
			-- the gun list read below is still the default (Remington + MP5), which grabbed the wrong guns.
			task.wait()
			local started = os.clock()
			while stillHere() and Hooks.loadingConfig and os.clock() - started < 5 do
				task.wait()
			end
			while stillHere() and not ready() and os.clock() - started < 20 do
				task.wait()
			end
			if not (stillHere() and ready()) then
				return
			end
			local delay = tonumber(flags.getweapons_delay) or 1
			if delay > 0 then
				task.wait(delay)
			end

			-- Up to 5 tries in this life, until every gun is in your backpack. A try the server ignored
			-- (just joined) gives up fast and the next one follows, so it's spread over a few seconds
			-- at home instead of all under the map.
			for _ = 1, 5 do
				if not (stillHere() and isAlive(character) and anyMissing()) then
					return
				end
				while gettingWeapons and stillHere() do
					task.wait(0.1)
				end
				getWeapons()
				task.wait(0.1)
				while gettingWeapons and stillHere() do
					task.wait(0.1)
				end
				task.wait(0.5)
			end
		end)
	end

	-- A feature (with a keybind) so it can be flipped on and off from the keyboard.
	addFeature(weaponSection, { name = "Auto Get Guns", flag = "getweapons_auto", callback = function(enabled)
		if enabled then
			Grab.autoGet(localPlayer.Character)
		end
	end })
	weaponSection:toggle({ name = "hide under floor", flag = "getweapons_hide", default = true })
	weaponSection:toggle({ name = "crouch while grabbing", flag = "getweapons_crouch", default = true })
	-- How long after you respawn (and your spawn forcefield is gone) auto get waits before it
	-- teleports to the guns. How fast it grabs once there isn't a setting: that's already as quick
	-- as the server allows. (Same flag as the old "grab delay", so saved configs keep their value.)
	weaponSection:slider({
		name = "respawn delay",
		flag = "getweapons_delay",
		min = 0,
		max = 5,
		default = 1,
		interval = 0.05,
		suffix = "s",
	})
	library:connection(localPlayer.CharacterAdded, Grab.autoGet)
	-- Kill & hit feedback -------------------------------------------------------------------
	local feedbackSection = Tabs.visuals:section({ name = "Kill & Hit Feedback", side = "left" })

	feedbackSection:toggle({ name = "kill logs", flag = "kill_logs", default = false })
	feedbackSection:toggle({ name = "hit logs", flag = "hit_logs", default = true })
	feedbackSection:slider({ name = "hit log time", flag = "hit_log_time", min = 1, max = 10, default = 4, interval = 0.5, suffix = "s" })
	feedbackSection:slider({ name = "hit log speed", flag = "hit_log_speed", min = 0.25, max = 3, default = 1, interval = 0.05, suffix = "x" })
	feedbackSection:dropdown({
		name = "hit log position",
		flag = "hit_log_position",
		items = { "Middle", "Top Left", "Top Right", "Bottom Left", "Bottom Right" },
		default = "Middle",
	})
	feedbackSection:dropdown({ name = "hit log color", flag = "hit_log_color_mode", items = { "Theme", "Custom" }, default = "Theme" })
	feedbackSection:colorpicker({ name = "custom hit log color", flag = "hit_log_color", color = Color3.fromRGB(120, 200, 255) })
	addFeature(feedbackSection, { name = "Kill Flash", flag = "kill_flash" })
	feedbackSection:colorpicker({ flag = "kill_flash_color", color = Color3.new(1, 1, 1) })
	feedbackSection:slider({ name = "flash length", flag = "kill_flash_duration", min = 0.1, max = 1.5, default = 0.25, interval = 0.05, suffix = "s" })
	feedbackSection:toggle({ name = "custom kill image", flag = "kill_flash_decal", default = false })
	feedbackSection:textbox({ placeholder = "Kill image: decal or image id", flag = "kill_flash_decal_id" })
	feedbackSection:slider({ name = "kill image size", flag = "kill_flash_decal_size", min = 0.2, max = 1, default = 0.6, interval = 0.05 })
	addFeature(feedbackSection, { name = "Screen Shake", flag = "kill_shake" })
	feedbackSection:slider({ name = "shake intensity", flag = "kill_shake_intensity", min = 0.1, max = 3, default = 1, interval = 0.1 })
	feedbackSection:slider({ name = "shake duration", flag = "kill_shake_duration", min = 0.05, max = 1, default = 0.25, interval = 0.05, suffix = "s" })
	addFeature(feedbackSection, { name = "Earthquake", flag = "kill_earthquake" })
	feedbackSection:slider({ name = "quake intensity", flag = "kill_quake_intensity", min = 0.1, max = 4, default = 1.5, interval = 0.1 })
	feedbackSection:slider({ name = "quake duration", flag = "kill_quake_duration", min = 0.1, max = 2, default = 0.5, interval = 0.05, suffix = "s" })
	addFeature(feedbackSection, { name = "Damage Text", flag = "damage_text_marker", default = true })
	feedbackSection:toggle({ name = "combo stacking", flag = "damage_combo", default = true })
	feedbackSection:toggle({ name = "show DEAD text", flag = "damage_dead_text", default = true })
	feedbackSection:colorpicker({ flag = "damage_text_color", color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 220, 80) })
	feedbackSection:colorpicker({ name = "DEAD text color", flag = "damage_dead_color", color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 60, 60) })

	local HIT_SOUNDS = {
		["TF2 Hit"] = 137392628136734, ["Metal Bat Hit"] = 114303603199822, ["Neverlose"] = 82938206376993,

	---Sorted names of a sound table, with "None" first.
	local function soundNames(sounds)
		local names = {}
		for name in pairs(sounds) do
			table.insert(names, name)
		end
		table.sort(names)
		table.insert(names, 1, "None")
		return names
	end

	local soundSection = miscTab:section({ name = "Sounds", side = "right" })
	soundSection:dropdown({ name = "hit sound", flag = "hit_sound", items = soundNames(HIT_SOUNDS), default = "None" })
	-- Every kill and every shot plays its own copy of the sound, so several at once all layer.
	soundSection:dropdown({ name = "kill sound", flag = "kill_sound", items = soundNames(KILL_SOUNDS), default = "Fortnite Death" })
	soundSection:slider({ name = "sound volume", flag = "feedback_volume", min = 0, max = 3, default = 1, interval = 0.1 })
	soundSection:dropdown({ name = "gun sound pack", flag = "gun_sound_pack", items = soundNames(SOUND_PACKS), default = "Fortnite" })
	soundSection:toggle({ name = "overlapping gun sounds", flag = "gun_sound_overlap", default = true })

	---Play a one-shot sound by asset id.
	local function playSound(assetId)
		if not assetId then
			return
		end

		local sound = Instance.new("Sound")
		sound.SoundId = "rbxassetid://" .. assetId
		sound.Volume = flags.feedback_volume or 1
		sound.Parent = workspace.CurrentCamera
		sound:Play()
		game:GetService("Debris"):AddItem(sound, 6)
	end

	-- Kill flash overlay.
	local flashGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
	flashGui.Name = ""
	flashGui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
	flashGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
	flashGui.DisplayOrder = 999
	flashGui:SetAttribute("AquaLabs", true)
	flashGui.Parent = coreGui

	local flash = Instance.new("Frame")
	flash.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	flash.BorderSizePixel = 0
	flash.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	flash.Parent = flashGui

	local flashing = false

	-- Custom kill image. rbxthumb shows both decal ids and image ids (a decal id put straight
	-- into rbxassetid:// shows nothing, which is what most pasted ids are). Preloaded when the
	-- id changes, so the image is ready by the time the kill happens.
	local killImage = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
	killImage.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
	killImage.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
	killImage.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	killImage.ImageTransparency = 1
	killImage.ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Fit
	killImage.Visible = false
	killImage.Parent = flashGui
	local killImageScale = Instance.new("UIScale")
	killImageScale.Parent = killImage
	local killImageId = nil

	---The image content for the id typed in the box (or nil when it has no number in it).
	local function killImageContent()
		local id = type(flags.kill_flash_decal_id) == "string" and flags.kill_flash_decal_id:match("%d+")
		if not id then
			return nil
		end
		if id ~= killImageId then
			killImageId = id
			killImage.Image = "rbxthumb://type=Asset&id=" .. id .. "&w=420&h=420"
			task.spawn(pcall, function()
				game:GetService("ContentProvider"):PreloadAsync({ killImage })
			end)
		end
		return killImage.Image
	end

	---Pop the custom image up in the middle of the screen, hold it, and fade it out.
	local function playKillImage()
		if not killImageContent() then
			return
		end
		local size = workspace.CurrentCamera.ViewportSize
		local side = math.min(size.X, size.Y) * (flags.kill_flash_decal_size or 0.6)
		killImage.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(side, side)
		killImage.Visible = true
		killImage.ImageTransparency = 1
		killImageScale.Scale = 0.7
		local fade = math.max((flags.kill_flash_duration or 0.25) / 2, 0.15)
		tweenService:Create(killImageScale, TweenInfo.new(0.25, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), { Scale = 1 }):Play()
		local fadeIn = tweenService:Create(killImage, TweenInfo.new(fade, Enum.EasingStyle.Sine, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), { ImageTransparency = 0 })
		fadeIn:Play()
		fadeIn.Completed:Wait()
		task.wait(0.6)
		local fadeOut = tweenService:Create(killImage, TweenInfo.new(fade, Enum.EasingStyle.Sine, Enum.EasingDirection.In), { ImageTransparency = 1 })
		fadeOut:Play()
		fadeOut.Completed:Wait()
		killImage.Visible = false
	end

	task.spawn(function()
		while isCurrentRun() and flashGui.Parent do
			killImageContent()
			task.wait(1)
		end
	end)

	---Quick screen flash when you get a kill, or the custom image (which works on its own toggle).
	local function playKillFlash()
		local useImage = flags.kill_flash_decal == true and killImageContent() ~= nil
		if flashing or not (flags.kill_flash or useImage) then
			return
		end
		flashing = true

		local half = (flags.kill_flash_duration or 0.25) / 2

		if useImage then
			playKillImage()
		else
			flash.BackgroundColor3 = flags.kill_flash_color and flags.kill_flash_color.Color or Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
			flash.BackgroundTransparency = 1
			local fadeIn = tweenService:Create(flash, TweenInfo.new(half, Enum.EasingStyle.Sine, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), { BackgroundTransparency = 0.4 })
			fadeIn:Play()
			fadeIn.Completed:Wait()
			local fadeOut = tweenService:Create(flash, TweenInfo.new(half, Enum.EasingStyle.Sine, Enum.EasingDirection.In), { BackgroundTransparency = 1 })
			fadeOut:Play()
			fadeOut.Completed:Wait()
		end

		flashing = false
	end

	---Camera shake on kill.
	Hooks.playKillShake = function()
		if not flags.kill_shake then return end
		local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
		if not cam then return end
		local intensity = flags.kill_shake_intensity or 1
		local dur = flags.kill_shake_duration or 0.25
		local start = os.clock()
		local conn
		conn = runService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
			local t = (os.clock() - start) / dur
			if t >= 1 then
				conn:Disconnect()
				return
			end
			local falloff = 1 - t
			local ox = (math.noise(os.clock() * 40) - 0.5) * 2 * intensity * falloff
			local oy = (math.noise(os.clock() * 40 + 10) - 0.5) * 2 * intensity * falloff
			cam.CFrame = cam.CFrame * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(oy), math.rad(ox), 0)
		end)
	end

	---Earthquake: stronger prolonged shake.
	Hooks.playKillEarthquake = function()
		if not flags.kill_earthquake then return end
		local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
		if not cam then return end
		local intensity = flags.kill_quake_intensity or 1.5
		local dur = flags.kill_quake_duration or 0.5
		local start = os.clock()
		local conn
		conn = runService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
			local t = (os.clock() - start) / dur
			if t >= 1 then
				conn:Disconnect()
				return
			end
			local falloff = 1 - t
			local ox = (math.noise(os.clock() * 25) - 0.5) * 4 * intensity * falloff
			local oy = (math.noise(os.clock() * 25 + 5) - 0.5) * 4 * intensity * falloff
			cam.CFrame = cam.CFrame * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(oy), math.rad(ox), math.rad(ox * 0.3))
		end)
	end

	-- Damage text hitmarker with combo stacking.
	local damageCombo = { total = 0, lastAt = 0, label = nil }
	local COMBO_TIMEOUT = 1.2

	local function showDamageText(amount, isKill)
		if flags.damage_text_marker == false then return end
		local now = os.clock()
		if flags.damage_combo ~= false and (now - damageCombo.lastAt) < COMBO_TIMEOUT then
			damageCombo.total += amount
		else
			damageCombo.total = amount
		end
		damageCombo.lastAt = now

		local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
		gui.Name = "AquaDamageText"
		gui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
		gui.DisplayOrder = 50
		gui:SetAttribute("AquaLabs", true)
		gui.Parent = coreGui

		local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
		label.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
		local mouse = userInputService:GetMouseLocation()
		label.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(mouse.X + math.random(-12, 12), mouse.Y + math.random(-28, -8))
		label.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(120, 28)
		label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		label.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
		label.TextSize = 18
		label.TextColor3 = (flags.damage_text_color and flags.damage_text_color.Color) or Color3.fromRGB(255, 220, 80)
		label.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.3
		label.Text = "-" .. tostring(math.floor(damageCombo.total + 0.5))
		label.Parent = gui

		if isKill and flags.damage_dead_text ~= false then
			local dead = Instance.new("TextLabel")
			dead.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
			dead.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(mouse.X, mouse.Y + 18)
			dead.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(100, 22)
			dead.BackgroundTransparency = 1
			dead.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
			dead.TextSize = 16
