			dead.TextColor3 = flags.damage_dead_color and flags.damage_dead_color.Color or Color3.fromRGB(255, 60, 60)
			dead.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.3
			dead.Text = "DEAD!"
			dead.Parent = gui
		end

		task.spawn(function()
			local start = os.clock()
			while gui.Parent and (os.clock() - start) < 0.9 do
				local t = (os.clock() - start) / 0.9
				label.TextTransparency = t
				label.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.3 + t * 0.7
				label.Position = label.Position + UDim2.fromOffset(0, -0.6)
				task.wait()
			end
			gui:Destroy()
		end)
	end

	Hooks.showDamageText = showDamageText

	-- Hits are reported by the combat tab's shot hook.
	Hooks.onHit = function(hitPlayer, damageAmount, isKill)
		playSound(HIT_SOUNDS[flags.hit_sound or ""])
		if type(damageAmount) == "number" and damageAmount > 0 then
			showDamageText(damageAmount, isKill == true)
		end
	end

	-- Kills come from the game's killfeed: "Display (@user) killed Victim with Weapon".
	local killfeed = replicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Killfeed")
	if killfeed then
		library:connection(killfeed.ChildAdded, function(entry)
			local killerDisplay, killerUser, victim, weapon = entry.Name:match("^(.-)%s*%(@(.-)%)%s*killed%s+(.-)%s+with%s+(.+)$")
			if not killerDisplay then
				return
			end

			if flags.kill_logs then
				library:notification({ text = killerDisplay .. " killed " .. victim .. " with " .. weapon, time = 4 })
			end

			if killerUser == localPlayer.Name then
				-- The victim: the feed shows their display name; prefer someone you just shot.
				local victimPlayer
				local victimUser = victim:match("%(@(.-)%)")
				local victimDisplay = victim:gsub("%s*%(@.-%)", "")
				for _, player in ipairs(playersService:GetPlayers()) do
					if player.Name == victimUser or player.DisplayName == victimDisplay or player.Name == victimDisplay then
						if not victimPlayer or (Hooks.lastHit and Hooks.lastHit[player]) then
							victimPlayer = player
						end
					end
				end
				if victimPlayer and Hooks.playKillEffect then
					task.spawn(Hooks.playKillEffect, victimPlayer)
				end
				task.spawn(playKillFlash)
				task.spawn(function()
					if Hooks.playKillShake then Hooks.playKillShake() end
				end)
				task.spawn(function()
					if Hooks.playKillEarthquake then Hooks.playKillEarthquake() end
				end)
				playSound(KILL_SOUNDS[flags.kill_sound or ""])
			end
		end)
	end

	-- Gun sound packs: swap your guns' shoot sound (originals restored on "None").
	local originalShootSounds = {}
	local shootVolumes = {}

	---Apply the chosen pack to one gun.
	local function applySoundPack(tool)
		if not tool:IsA("Tool") or not table.find(GUN_NAMES, tool.Name) then
			return
		end

		local handle = tool:FindFirstChild("Handle")
		local sound = handle and handle:FindFirstChild("ShootSound")
		if not sound then
			return
		end

		if originalShootSounds[sound] == nil then
			originalShootSounds[sound] = sound.SoundId
		end

		local pack = SOUND_PACKS[flags.gun_sound_pack or ""]
		local wanted = pack and ("rbxassetid://" .. pack) or originalShootSounds[sound]
		if sound.SoundId ~= wanted then
			sound.SoundId = wanted
		end

		-- Overlapping shots: the gun's own sound restarts on every shot (cutting itself off),
		-- so it's muted and each shot plays its own copy instead.
		if shootVolumes[sound] == nil then
			shootVolumes[sound] = sound.Volume
		end
		local volume = flags.gun_sound_overlap ~= false and 0 or shootVolumes[sound]
		if sound.Volume ~= volume then
			sound.Volume = volume
		end
	end

	---Play one shot's sound as its own instance so rapid shots layer instead of cutting off.
	---`force` is set for our own auto-fired shots, which the game never plays a sound for.
	Hooks.onShot = function(weapon, force)
		local character = localPlayer.Character
		weapon = weapon or (character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool"))
		local handle = weapon and weapon:FindFirstChild("Handle")
		local sound = handle and handle:FindFirstChild("ShootSound")
		if not sound then
			return
		end

		if flags.gun_sound_overlap == false and not force then
			return
		end

		local clone = sound:Clone()
		clone.Volume = shootVolumes[sound] or sound.Volume
		clone.Parent = handle
		clone:Play()
		game:GetService("Debris"):AddItem(clone, 4)
	end

	task.spawn(function()
		while isCurrentRun() and watermarkHolder.Parent do
			task.wait(0.5)
			if not isCurrentRun() then
				break
			end

			for _, container in ipairs({ localPlayer.Character, localPlayer:FindFirstChild("Backpack") }) do
				if container then
					for _, tool in ipairs(container:GetChildren()) do
						pcall(applySoundPack, tool)
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end)

	onUnload(function()
		for sound, soundId in pairs(originalShootSounds) do
			if sound.Parent then
				sound.SoundId = soundId
			end
		end
		for sound, volume in pairs(shootVolumes) do
			if sound.Parent then
				sound.Volume = volume
			end
		end
		flashGui:Destroy()
		Hooks.onHit = nil
		Hooks.onShot = nil
	end)
end

do
	-- Prison Life utilities: teleports, team tools, respawn protection, player tools and world tweaks.
	local miscTab = Tabs.misc
	local replicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
	local teamsService = game:GetService("Teams")
	local remotes = replicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Remotes")
	local CRIMINAL_PAD = CFrame.new(-975, 108, 2071)
	local ARREST_ANIMATION = "rbxassetid://287112271"

	local LOCATIONS = {
		["Criminal Base"] = CFrame.new(-929, 97, 2056),
		["Prison Yard"] = CFrame.new(799, 98, 2469),
		["Cell Block"] = CFrame.new(913, 100, 2385),
		["Cafeteria"] = CFrame.new(906, 100, 2298),
		["Guard Tower"] = CFrame.new(822, 125, 2588),
		["Armory"] = CFrame.new(829, 100, 2244),
		["Car Garage"] = CFrame.new(624, 98, 2495),
	}
	local LOCATION_NAMES = { "Criminal Base", "Prison Yard", "Cell Block", "Cafeteria", "Guard Tower", "Armory", "Car Garage" }

	---Your root part, if you're alive.
	local function myRoot()
		local character = localPlayer.Character
		local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		return humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0 and root or nil
	end

	---Move your character (out of any seat first).
	local function teleportTo(cframe)
		local character = localPlayer.Character
		local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		if not (character and myRoot()) then
			return false
		end
		if humanoid.Sit then
			humanoid.Sit = false
			task.wait()
		end
		Hooks.clearDesync()
		character:PivotTo(cframe)
		return true
	end

	---Wait (up to `timeout`) for a fresh living character with a root part.
	local function waitForRespawn(oldCharacter, timeout)
		local started = os.clock()
		while os.clock() - started < timeout do
			local character = localPlayer.Character
			if character and character ~= oldCharacter and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
				return character
			end
			task.wait(0.1)
		end
		return nil
	end

	---Touch the criminal pad, then come back once you're a criminal.
	local function becomeCriminal()
		local root = myRoot()
		if not root then
			return
		end
		if localPlayer.Team and localPlayer.Team.Name ~= "Inmates" then
			return library:notification({ text = "You have to be an inmate first." })
		end

		local home = root.CFrame
		teleportTo(CRIMINAL_PAD)

		local started = os.clock()
		while os.clock() - started < 3 and not (localPlayer.Team and localPlayer.Team.Name == "Criminals") do
			task.wait(0.1)
		end
		task.wait(0.1)
		teleportTo(home)
	end

	---Ask the server for a team (re-requesting your own team respawns you).
	local function requestTeam(teamName)
		local remote = remotes and remotes:FindFirstChild("RequestTeamChange")
		local neutral = teamsService:FindFirstChild("Neutral")
		local team = teamsService:FindFirstChild(teamName)
		if not (remote and team) then
			return false
		end

		-- Re-requesting your own team does nothing, so a respawn goes through Neutral (the
		-- team menu) first. Firing both at once sometimes left you stuck on the menu, so wait
		-- for Neutral to take, then keep asking for the team until the server puts you on it.
		if neutral and localPlayer.Team ~= neutral then
			pcall(remote.InvokeServer, remote, neutral, 1)
			local started = os.clock()
			while localPlayer.Team ~= neutral and os.clock() - started < 2 do
				task.wait(0.1)
			end
			task.wait(0.25)
		end

		local started = os.clock()
		repeat
			pcall(remote.InvokeServer, remote, team, 1)
			local asked = os.clock()
			while localPlayer.Team ~= team and os.clock() - asked < 0.8 do
				task.wait(0.1)
			end
		-- The server ignores team requests for ~6 seconds after going Neutral (measured), so
		-- keep asking well past that.
		until localPlayer.Team == team or os.clock() - started > 12

		-- The menu's camera can stay stuck after a scripted spawn (black screen); give the
		-- camera back to your character.
		if localPlayer.Team == team then
			task.spawn(function()
				local character = localPlayer.Character or localPlayer.CharacterAdded:Wait()
				local humanoid = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid", 5)
				task.wait(0.5)
				local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
				if humanoid and camera.CameraType == Enum.CameraType.Scriptable then
					camera.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Custom
					camera.CameraSubject = humanoid
				end
			end)
		end
		return localPlayer.Team == team
	end

	---Respawn on your current team and (optionally) return to `returnCFrame`.
	local respawning = false
	local function respawnSameTeam(returnCFrame)
		if respawning or not localPlayer.Team then
			return
		end
		respawning = true

		local wasCriminal = localPlayer.Team.Name == "Criminals"
		local oldCharacter = localPlayer.Character
		requestTeam(wasCriminal and "Inmates" or localPlayer.Team.Name)

		local character = waitForRespawn(oldCharacter, 8)
		if character then
			task.wait(0.2)
			if wasCriminal then
				becomeCriminal()
			end
			if returnCFrame then
				teleportTo(returnCFrame)
			end
		end

		respawning = false
	end

	-- Teleports -------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	-- Teleports live in Main with the other movement features.
	local teleportSection = mainTab:section({ name = "Teleports", side = "right" })

	teleportSection:dropdown({ name = "location", flag = "teleport_location", items = LOCATION_NAMES, default = "Criminal Base" })
	teleportSection:button({
		name = "Teleport",
		callback = function()
			local cframe = LOCATIONS[flags.teleport_location or ""]
			if cframe and not teleportTo(cframe) then
				library:notification({ text = "You need to be alive to teleport." })
			end
		end,
	})

	-- Saved spot: remember where you're standing and come back to it later.
	local savedSpot = nil
	teleportSection:button({
		name = "Save Current Spot",
		callback = function()
			local root = myRoot()
			if root then
				savedSpot = root.CFrame
				library:notification({ text = "Spot saved.", time = 2 })
			end
		end,
	})
	teleportSection:button({
		name = "Teleport To Saved Spot",
		callback = function()
			if not savedSpot then
				return library:notification({ text = "Save a spot first.", time = 2 })
			end
			if not teleportTo(savedSpot) then
				library:notification({ text = "You need to be alive to teleport." })
			end
		end,
	})

	-- Team tools ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	local teamSection = miscTab:section({ name = "Team & Respawn", side = "left" })

	teamSection:button({ name = "Become criminal", callback = function()
		task.spawn(becomeCriminal)
	end })
	teamSection:dropdown({ name = "team", flag = "team_switch_target", items = { "Inmates", "Guards" }, default = "Inmates" })
	teamSection:toggle({ name = "keep position on switch", flag = "team_switch_keep", default = true })
	teamSection:button({
		name = "Switch team",
		callback = function()
			task.spawn(function()
				local root = myRoot()
				local home = root and root.CFrame
				local oldCharacter = localPlayer.Character
				local teamName = flags.team_switch_target or "Inmates"

				if not requestTeam(teamName) then
					return library:notification({ text = "Couldn't switch teams." })
				end

				local character = waitForRespawn(oldCharacter, 8)
				if not (localPlayer.Team and localPlayer.Team.Name == teamName) then
					return library:notification({ text = teamName .. " is full." })
				end
				if character and home and flags.team_switch_keep ~= false then
					task.wait(0.2)
					teleportTo(home)
				end
			end)
		end,
	})
	teamSection:button({ name = "Quick respawn", callback = function()
		local root = myRoot()
		task.spawn(respawnSameTeam, root and root.CFrame)
	end })

	addFeature(teamSection, { name = "Auto Respawn", flag = "auto_respawn" })
	teamSection:toggle({ name = "return to death spot", flag = "auto_respawn_return", default = true })

	library:connection(runService.Heartbeat, function()
		if not flags.anti_arrest or respawning then
			return
		end
		local character = localPlayer.Character
		local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		if not humanoid then
			return
		end
		for _, track in ipairs(humanoid:GetPlayingAnimationTracks()) do
			if track.Animation and track.Animation.AnimationId == ARREST_ANIMATION then
				local root = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
				task.spawn(respawnSameTeam, root and root.CFrame)
				return
			end
		end
	end)

	-- Criminal Spawn: a criminal who respawns in the prison (an inmate spawn) is sent straight to
	-- the Criminals spawn, and made a criminal again first if the game put them back on Inmates.
	addFeature(teamSection, { name = "Criminal Spawn", flag = "criminal_spawn" })
	local diedAsCriminal = false

	---The Criminals team's spawn, standing on top of it.
	local function criminalSpawnCFrame()
		local criminals = teamsService:FindFirstChild("Criminals")
		for _, spawn in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
			if spawn:IsA("SpawnLocation") and criminals and spawn.TeamColor == criminals.TeamColor then
				return CFrame.new(spawn.Position + Vector3.new(0, 4, 0))
			end
		end
		return LOCATIONS["Criminal Base"]
	end

	library:connection(localPlayer.CharacterAdded, function(character)
		local wasCriminal = diedAsCriminal
		diedAsCriminal = false
		if not flags.criminal_spawn then
			return
		end
		task.spawn(function()
			character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart", 5)
			task.wait(0.3)
			-- Auto Respawn already brings criminals back on its own.
			if respawning or localPlayer.Character ~= character then
				return
			end
			local team = localPlayer.Team and localPlayer.Team.Name
			if wasCriminal and team == "Inmates" then
				becomeCriminal()
				team = localPlayer.Team and localPlayer.Team.Name
			end
			local root = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			local target = criminalSpawnCFrame()
			if team == "Criminals" and root and (root.Position - target.Position).Magnitude > 60 then
				teleportTo(target)
			end
		end)
	end)

	---Hook death and arrest detection onto one of your characters.
	local function watchCharacter(character)
		local humanoid = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid", 5)
		if not humanoid then
			return
		end

		library:connection(humanoid.Died, function()
			diedAsCriminal = localPlayer.Team ~= nil and localPlayer.Team.Name == "Criminals"
		end)

		library:connection(humanoid.Died, function()
			if not flags.auto_respawn then
				return
			end
			local root = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			local deathSpot = root and flags.auto_respawn_return ~= false and root.CFrame or nil
			task.spawn(respawnSameTeam, deathSpot)
		end)
	end

	if localPlayer.Character then
		task.spawn(watchCharacter, localPlayer.Character)
	end
	library:connection(localPlayer.CharacterAdded, function(character)
		task.spawn(watchCharacter, character)
	end)

	-- Player tools + car fling (own function = own 200-local register budget)
	do
	local function setupPlayerTools()
	-- Player tools ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
	local playerSection = miscTab:section({ name = "Player Tools", side = "right" })
	local spectating = nil

	---Player dropdown labels: DisplayName (@Username).
	local function playerNames()
		local names = {}
		for _, player in ipairs(playersService:GetPlayers()) do
			if player ~= localPlayer then
				table.insert(names, playerLabel(player))
			end
		end
		table.sort(names)
		return #names > 0 and names or { "---" }
	end

	local playerDropdown = playerSection:dropdown({ name = "player", flag = "tools_player", items = playerNames(), default = "---" })
	-- Multi-select for car fling rotation (falls back to single "player" if empty).
	local carFlingDropdown = playerSection:dropdown({
		name = "car fling targets",
		flag = "tools_car_fling_targets",
		items = playerNames(),
		default = {},
		multi = true,
	})

	---The selected player, if they're still here.
	local function selectedPlayer()
		local user = usernameFromLabel(flags.tools_player)
		local player = user and playersService:FindFirstChild(user)
		if not (player and player:IsA("Player")) then
			library:notification({ text = "No player selected." })
			return nil
		end
		return player
	end

	-- Auto-refresh player list (no manual refresh button).
	local function refreshToolsPlayers()
		local names = playerNames()
		pcall(function()
			playerDropdown:refresh_options(names)
		end)
		pcall(function()
			carFlingDropdown:refresh_options(names)
		end)
	end
	library:connection(playersService.PlayerAdded, function()
		task.defer(refreshToolsPlayers)
	end)
	library:connection(playersService.PlayerRemoving, function()
		task.defer(refreshToolsPlayers)
	end)
	task.defer(refreshToolsPlayers)

	playerSection:button({ name = "Teleport to player", callback = function()
		local player = selectedPlayer()
		local root = player and player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		if root then
			teleportTo(root.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0, 3))
		end
	end })

	---Point the camera at a player's humanoid (nil = back to you).
	local function setSpectate(player)
		spectating = player
		local character = (player or localPlayer).Character
		local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		if humanoid then
			workspace.CurrentCamera.CameraSubject = humanoid
		end
	end

	playerSection:button({ name = "Spectate", callback = function()
		local player = selectedPlayer()
		if player then
			setSpectate(player)
			library:notification({ text = "Spectating " .. player.DisplayName .. "." })
		end
	end })
	playerSection:button({ name = "Stop spectating", callback = function()
		setSpectate(nil)
	end })

	-- Orbit lives primarily on Main > Orbit; keep a short link here for the selected player.
	addFeature(playerSection, { name = "Orbit Target", flag = "tools_orbit" })
	playerSection:slider({ name = "orbit speed", flag = "tools_orbit_speed", min = 0.5, max = 60, default = 3, interval = 0.5, suffix = " rps" })
	-- Height can go negative to orbit under the map.
	playerSection:slider({ name = "orbit Y (height)", flag = "tools_orbit_height", min = -200, max = 50, default = 6, interval = 0.5, suffix = " studs" })
	playerSection:slider({ name = "orbit X (distance)", flag = "tools_orbit_radius", min = 0, max = 40, default = 8, interval = 0.5, suffix = " studs" })
	playerSection:toggle({ name = "orbit void on forcefield", flag = "tools_orbit_void", default = true })
	playerSection:slider({ name = "orbit void height", flag = "tools_orbit_void_depth", min = -500, max = -1, default = -20, interval = 1, suffix = " y" })

	local orbitAngle = 0
	local orbitVoidHide = false
	local orbitRandom = Random.new()
	local lastOrbitTp = 0
	Hooks.orbitTargetName = Hooks.orbitTargetName or nil

	---Random point on a sphere around the target (above, under the floor, every side).
	local function randomOrbitOffset(spread)
		local direction
		repeat
			direction = Vector3.new(orbitRandom:NextNumber(-1, 1), orbitRandom:NextNumber(-1, 1), orbitRandom:NextNumber(-1, 1))
		until direction.Magnitude > 0.1 and direction.Magnitude <= 1
		return direction.Unit * orbitRandom:NextNumber(math.max(spread * 0.35, 1.5), spread)
	end

	---Resolve who we are orbiting (mouse-lock name, else tools player dropdown).
	local function getOrbitTarget()
		local name = Hooks.orbitTargetName or flags.tools_player
		if type(name) ~= "string" or name == "" or name == "---" then
			return nil
		end
		-- Direct username first (mouse lock stores .Name).
		local byName = playersService:FindFirstChild(name)
		if byName then
			return byName
		end
		local user = usernameFromLabel(name)
		if user then
			return playersService:FindFirstChild(user)
		end
		return nil
	end

	-- Where you were when the orbit started, so you land back there (on the map) when it stops.
	local orbitHome = nil
	local orbitActive = false
	local orbitMoved = false
	local landParams = RaycastParams.new()
	landParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude

	---Put you back on solid ground once the orbit stops moving you.
	local function landAfterOrbit()
		local character = localPlayer.Character
		local myRoot = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		if not myRoot then
			return
		end
		local spot = orbitHome
		-- No usable start spot (started under the map): drop onto whatever is below you from high up.
		if not spot or spot.Position.Y < 60 then
			landParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = { character, workspace.CurrentCamera }
			local from = Vector3.new(myRoot.Position.X, 600, myRoot.Position.Z)
			local hit = workspace:Raycast(from, Vector3.new(0, -1200, 0), landParams)
			spot = hit and CFrame.new(hit.Position + Vector3.new(0, 4, 0)) or spot
		end
		if spot then
			Hooks.clearDesync()
			myRoot.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
			myRoot.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
			character:PivotTo(spot + Vector3.new(0, 1, 0))
		end
	end

	---Called the first frame the orbit moves you: remember where you were.
	local function beginOrbit(myRoot)
		if not orbitActive then
			orbitActive = true
			orbitHome = myRoot.CFrame
		end
		orbitMoved = true
	end

	local function orbitStep(deltaTime)
		if not flags.tools_orbit then return end
		-- Phantom owns your body while it runs.
		if Hooks.phantomActive and Hooks.phantomActive() then return end
		local target = getOrbitTarget()
		local tChar = target and target.Character
		local tRoot = tChar and tChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		local myRoot = localPlayer.Character and localPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		if not (tRoot and myRoot) then return end

		local hasFF = tChar:FindFirstChildOfClass("ForceField") ~= nil

		-- Leave them alone until their spawn forcefield is gone.
		if flags.tools_orbit_unff_only and hasFF then
			orbitVoidHide = false
			return
		end

		beginOrbit(myRoot)

		if flags.tools_orbit_void and hasFF then
			orbitVoidHide = true
			local depth = flags.tools_orbit_void_depth or -20
			myRoot.CFrame = CFrame.new(tRoot.Position.X, depth, tRoot.Position.Z)
			myRoot.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
			return
		end
		if orbitVoidHide and not hasFF then
			orbitVoidHide = false
		end

		if flags.tools_orbit_mode == "Random TP" then
			local now = os.clock()
			if now - lastOrbitTp < (flags.tools_orbit_tp_delay or 0) then
				myRoot.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
				return
			end
			lastOrbitTp = now

			local point = tRoot.Position + randomOrbitOffset(tonumber(flags.tools_orbit_spread) or 8)
			myRoot.CFrame = CFrame.new(point, tRoot.Position)
			myRoot.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
			myRoot.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
			return
		end

		orbitAngle = (orbitAngle + deltaTime * (flags.tools_orbit_speed or 3) * math.pi * 2) % (math.pi * 2)
		local height = tonumber(flags.tools_orbit_height) or 6
		local radius = math.max(0, tonumber(flags.tools_orbit_radius) or 8)
		local offset = Vector3.new(math.cos(orbitAngle) * radius, height, math.sin(orbitAngle) * radius)
		myRoot.CFrame = CFrame.new(tRoot.Position + offset, tRoot.Position)
		myRoot.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
	end

	library:connection(runService.Heartbeat, function(deltaTime)
		-- Typing, Get Weapons or driving with Car Orbit: leave everything as it is.
		if isTyping() or Hooks.grabbing then return end
		local myHumanoid = localPlayer.Character and localPlayer.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		if flags.tools_car_orbit and myHumanoid and myHumanoid.SeatPart then return end

		orbitMoved = false
		orbitStep(deltaTime)

		-- The orbit just stopped (turned off, target gone or died, forcefield pause): land on the map.
		if orbitActive and not orbitMoved then
			orbitActive = false
			landAfterOrbit()
			orbitHome = nil
		end
	end)

	-- Car Orbit: the car you're driving circles the orbit target, facing along the circle like
	-- it's driving around them. A LinearVelocity drives it and an AlignOrientation steers it, so
	-- physics stays smooth. Only works while you drive: the server takes the car back (and it
	-- stops) the moment you leave the seat. State lives on one table to keep locals down.
	local carOrbit = { warnedAt = 0 }
	-- How hard the car is pulled onto the circle, and the fastest it closes in from far away.
	local CAR_ORBIT_CORRECTION = 4
	local CAR_ORBIT_MAX_PULL = 90

	---The car model you're sitting in the driver seat of, and that seat.
	function carOrbit.getCar()
		local humanoid = localPlayer.Character and localPlayer.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		local seat = humanoid and humanoid.SeatPart
		if not (seat and seat:IsA("VehicleSeat")) then
			return nil
		end
		-- The whole car is the topmost ancestor under CarContainer (or workspace).
		local model = seat
		while model.Parent and model.Parent ~= workspace and model.Parent.Name ~= "CarContainer" do
			model = model.Parent
		end
		if not model:IsA("Model") then
			model = seat:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")
		end
		if not model then
			return nil
		end
		return { model = model, seat = seat }
	end

	---Put the movers on this seat (once per seat).
	function carOrbit.attach(seat)
		if carOrbit.seat == seat and carOrbit.velocity and carOrbit.velocity.Parent then
			return
		end
		carOrbit.detach()
		local attachment = Instance.new("Attachment")
		attachment.Name = ""
		attachment.Parent = seat
		local velocity = Instance.new("LinearVelocity")
		velocity.Name = ""
		velocity.Attachment0 = attachment
		velocity.RelativeTo = Enum.ActuatorRelativeTo.World
		velocity.VelocityConstraintMode = Enum.VelocityConstraintMode.Vector
		velocity.MaxForce = math.huge
		velocity.Parent = seat
		local align = Instance.new("AlignOrientation")
		align.Name = ""
		align.Mode = Enum.OrientationAlignmentMode.OneAttachment
		align.Attachment0 = attachment
		align.MaxTorque = math.huge
		align.Responsiveness = 200
		align.Parent = seat
		carOrbit.seat, carOrbit.attachment, carOrbit.velocity, carOrbit.align = seat, attachment, velocity, align
	end

	---Remove the movers so the car drives normally again.
	function carOrbit.detach()
		for _, key in ipairs({ "velocity", "align", "attachment" }) do
			if carOrbit[key] then
				pcall(carOrbit[key].Destroy, carOrbit[key])
				carOrbit[key] = nil
			end
		end
		carOrbit.seat = nil
	end
	onUnload(carOrbit.detach)

	carOrbit.spawnAt = 0

	library:connection(runService.Heartbeat, function(deltaTime)
		if not flags.tools_car_orbit then
			if carOrbit.seat then
				carOrbit.detach()
			end
			return
		end
		local car = carOrbit.getCar()
		if not car then
			if carOrbit.seat then
				carOrbit.detach()
			end
			local now = os.clock()
			-- The server takes a car back the moment you leave it, so you have to be driving.
			if flags.tools_car_orbit_spawn ~= false and Hooks.claimCarForOrbit then
				if now - carOrbit.spawnAt > 3 then
					carOrbit.spawnAt = now
					Hooks.claimCarForOrbit()
				end
			elseif now - carOrbit.warnedAt > 6 then
				carOrbit.warnedAt = now
				library:notification({ text = "Car Orbit: get in the driver seat of a car.", time = 2 })
			end
			return
		end
		local target = getOrbitTarget()
		local tChar = target and target.Character
		local tRoot = tChar and tChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		local tHumanoid = tChar and tChar:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		if not (tRoot and tHumanoid and tHumanoid.Health > 0) then
			if carOrbit.seat then
				carOrbit.detach()
			end
			return
		end

		carOrbit.attach(car.seat)

		local speed = tonumber(flags.tools_car_orbit_speed) or 0.8
		local radius = tonumber(flags.tools_car_orbit_radius) or 14
		local height = tonumber(flags.tools_car_orbit_height) or 0
		-- Steer from where the car really is around them (a moving goal point made it trail
		-- behind and drive at an angle).
		local center = tRoot.Position
		local seatPosition = car.seat.Position
		local outward = Vector3.new(seatPosition.X + center.X * NEG_ONE, 0, seatPosition.Z + center.Z * NEG_ONE)
		local distance = outward.Magnitude
		if distance < 0.1 then
			outward, distance = Vector3.new(1, 0, 0), 1
		end
		outward = outward / distance
		-- Along the circle, counter-clockwise seen from above.
		local tangent = Vector3.new(outward.Z * NEG_ONE, 0, outward.X)

		-- Drive along the circle, pulled in or out onto it (capped so a far start doesn't tip it).
		local circleSpeed = radius * speed * math.pi * 2
		local pull = math.clamp((radius + distance * NEG_ONE) * CAR_ORBIT_CORRECTION, NEG_ONE * CAR_ORBIT_MAX_PULL, CAR_ORBIT_MAX_PULL)
		local heightOffset = center.Y + height + seatPosition.Y * NEG_ONE
		local lift = math.clamp(heightOffset * CAR_ORBIT_CORRECTION, NEG_ONE * 30, 30)
		local flat = tangent * circleSpeed + outward * pull
		carOrbit.velocity.VectorVelocity = Vector3.new(flat.X, lift, flat.Z)
		-- Face the way it's actually going, so it never slides sideways.
		carOrbit.align.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(Vector3.zero, flat.Unit)
	end)

	-- Car Fling: always spawn Squad at pad, sit, then fling (no random cars / no dead skip).
	-- Helpers live on one table so this scope stays under Luau's 200-local limit.
	local CAR_PAD = CFrame.new(586, 98, 2495)
	local ANGULAR_FLING = 150000
	local carFlingBusy = false
	local CF = {}

	-- Per-player car fling from Players tab profile. Survives their resets until toggled off.
	Hooks.persistentCarFling = Hooks.persistentCarFling or {}
	Hooks.persistentExploiterFling = Hooks.persistentExploiterFling or {}
	Hooks.ensureCarFlingCar = function()
		if CF.getDrivenSquad and CF.getDrivenSquad() then
			return
		end
		if CF.ensureCarOnce then
			CF.ensureCarOnce()
		end
	end

	function CF.carPrimary(car)
		if not car then
			return nil
		end
		local seat = car:FindFirstChild("VehicleSeat", true)
		if seat and seat:IsA("BasePart") then
			return seat
		end
		if car.PrimaryPart then
			return car.PrimaryPart
		end
		local body = car:FindFirstChild("Body")
		if body then
			if body:IsA("BasePart") then
				return body
			end
			local main = body:FindFirstChild("Main") or body:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart")
			if main then
				return main
			end
		end
		return car:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
	end

	function CF.findCarSpawner()
		local items = workspace:FindFirstChild("Prison_ITEMS")
		local buttons = items and items:FindFirstChild("buttons")
		if not buttons then
			return nil
		end
		-- The pad nearest the car pad spot, preferring a ready (Cyan) one: the server ignores
		-- requests for pads you aren't standing by (it used to pick the 5th button, which could
		-- be a spawner across the map).
		local best, bestScore = nil, math.huge
		for _, child in ipairs(buttons:GetChildren()) do
			local spawner = child:FindFirstChild("Car Spawner")
			if spawner and spawner:IsA("BasePart") then
				local score = (spawner.Position - CAR_PAD.Position).Magnitude
				if spawner.BrickColor ~= BrickColor.new("Cyan") then
					score += 1000
				end
				if score < bestScore then
					best, bestScore = spawner, score
				end
			end
		end
		return best
	end

	function CF.invokeCarSpawn()
		local remotes = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):FindFirstChild("Remotes")
		local interact = remotes and remotes:FindFirstChild("InteractWithItem")
		local spawner = CF.findCarSpawner()
		if not (interact and spawner) then
			return false
		end
		return pcall(function()
			interact:InvokeServer(spawner)
		end)
	end

	---Only the police Squad model (never random civilian cars).
	function CF.isSquadCar(car)
		if not car then
			return false
		end
		local n = string.lower(car.Name)
		return n == "squad" or string.find(n, "squad", 1, true) ~= nil
	end

	function CF.sitInCar(car)
		local humanoid = localPlayer.Character and localPlayer.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		local myRoot = localPlayer.Character and localPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		local seat = car and car:FindFirstChild("VehicleSeat", true)
		local part = CF.carPrimary(car)
		if not (humanoid and myRoot and seat and part) then
			return false
		end
		if seat.Occupant and seat.Occupant ~= humanoid then
			return false
		end
		if humanoid.SeatPart == seat then
			return true
		end
		pcall(function()
			myRoot.CFrame = part.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, 4, 0)
		end)
		pcall(function()
			seat:Sit(humanoid)
		end)
		task.wait(0.15)
		return humanoid.SeatPart == seat
	end

	function CF.getDrivenSquad()
		local humanoid = localPlayer.Character and localPlayer.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		local seat = humanoid and humanoid.SeatPart
		if not (seat and seat:IsA("VehicleSeat")) then
			return nil
		end
		local model = seat
		for _ = 1, 25 do
			if not model then
				break
			end
			if model.Parent and model.Parent.Name == "CarContainer" then
				if CF.isSquadCar(model) then
					return model
				end
				return nil
			end
			model = model.Parent
		end
		return nil
	end

	---TP to pad, fire spawner, wait for a NEW Squad model, sit in it.
	function CF.spawnAndClaimSquad()
		local character = localPlayer.Character
		local myRoot = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		if not (myRoot and humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0) then
			return nil
		end

		local container = workspace:FindFirstChild("CarContainer")
		local before = {}
		if container then
			for _, car in ipairs(container:GetChildren()) do
				before[car] = true
			end
		end

		-- Stand right on the pad being used, so the server takes the request.
		local spawnerPart = CF.findCarSpawner()
		myRoot.CFrame = spawnerPart and CFrame.new(spawnerPart.Position + Vector3.new(0, 3.5, 0)) or CAR_PAD
		myRoot.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
		task.wait(0.2)
		CF.invokeCarSpawn()

		local spawned = nil
		local deadline = os.clock() + 4
		while os.clock() < deadline do
			task.wait(0.12)
			container = workspace:FindFirstChild("CarContainer")
			if not container then
				continue
			end
			-- Prefer brand-new Squad from this spawn call.
			for _, car in ipairs(container:GetChildren()) do
				if not before[car] and CF.isSquadCar(car) then
					local seat = car:FindFirstChild("VehicleSeat", true)
					if seat and (not seat.Occupant or seat.Occupant == humanoid) then
						spawned = car
						break
					end
				end
			end
			if spawned then
				break
			end
			-- Fallback: any free Squad near the pad (still Squad only).
			for _, car in ipairs(container:GetChildren()) do
				if CF.isSquadCar(car) then
					local seat = car:FindFirstChild("VehicleSeat", true)
					if seat and not seat.Occupant then
						spawned = car
						break
					end
				end
			end
			if spawned then
				break
			end
		end

		if not spawned then
			-- One more spawn attempt.
			CF.invokeCarSpawn()
			task.wait(0.7)
			container = workspace:FindFirstChild("CarContainer")
			if container then
				for _, car in ipairs(container:GetChildren()) do
					if CF.isSquadCar(car) then
						local seat = car:FindFirstChild("VehicleSeat", true)
						if seat and not seat.Occupant then
							spawned = car
							break
						end
					end
				end
			end
		end

		if not spawned then
			return nil
		end
		CF.sitInCar(spawned)
		task.wait(0.2)
		if not CF.sitInCar(spawned) then
			return nil
		end
		return spawned
	end

	-- Your body has to pass through them while you sit in the flinging car, or it hits them and
	-- throws you out of the seat (the fling only worked with Noclip on). The game's collision
	-- guard is paused the same way Noclip does it, and given back a second after flinging stops.
	CF.noclipAt = 0
	function CF.holdNoclip()
		CF.noclipAt = os.clock()
		if not noclipConnection then
			enableNoclip()
			CF.noclipHeld = true
		end
	end
	library:connection(runService.Heartbeat, function()
		if CF.noclipHeld and os.clock() - CF.noclipAt > 1 then
			CF.noclipHeld = false
			if not flags.noclip_enabled then
				disableNoclip()
			end
		end
	end)

	-- Moving: pin on predicted path only. Standing still: orbit so the car never freezes.
	local flingSpin = 0
	local STILL_SPEED = 4
	function CF.flingCarIntoTarget(car, tRoot)
		if not (car and tRoot) then
			return
		end
		CF.holdNoclip()
		local char = tRoot.Parent
		local torso = char and (char:FindFirstChild("Torso") or char:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso"))
		local base = (torso and torso.Position) or (tRoot.Position + Vector3.new(0, -0.5, 0))

		local vel = tRoot.AssemblyLinearVelocity
		local speed = Vector3.new(vel.X, 0, vel.Z).Magnitude
		local pin
		local linear

		if speed < STILL_SPEED then
			-- Standing still: orbit around torso so physics always hits.
			flingSpin = (flingSpin + 1.35) % (math.pi * 2)
			local r = 2.8
			pin = base + Vector3.new(math.cos(flingSpin) * r, math.sin(flingSpin * 2) * 0.8, math.sin(flingSpin) * r)
			local shoveDir = Vector3.new(math.cos(flingSpin), 0, math.sin(flingSpin))
			linear = Vector3.new(shoveDir.X * 35000, 25000, shoveDir.Z * 35000)
		else
			-- Moving: go where they are going, no orbit.
			local lead = math.clamp(0.06 + speed * 0.012, 0.06, 0.28)
			pin = base + vel * lead
			pin = Vector3.new(pin.X, base.Y + math.clamp(vel.Y * lead * 0.35, -1.5, 2.5), pin.Z)
			linear = Vector3.new(vel.X * 0.4, 25000, vel.Z * 0.4)
		end

		local angular = Vector3.new(ANGULAR_FLING, ANGULAR_FLING, ANGULAR_FLING)

		for _, part in ipairs(car:GetDescendants()) do
			if part:IsA("BasePart") then
				pcall(function()
					part.Anchored = false
					part.CanCollide = true
					part.CFrame = CFrame.new(pin)
					part.AssemblyLinearVelocity = linear
					part.AssemblyAngularVelocity = angular
				end)
			end
		end
		pcall(function()
			car:PivotTo(CFrame.new(pin))
		end)
		for _, part in ipairs(car:GetDescendants()) do
			if part:IsA("BasePart") then
				pcall(function()
					part.AssemblyLinearVelocity = linear
					part.AssemblyAngularVelocity = angular
				end)
			end
		end
	end

	-- Exploiter fling: heavy 3D lead for people flying/speeding so the car stays on them.
	function CF.flingCarIntoExploiter(car, tRoot)
		if not (car and tRoot) then
			return
		end
		CF.holdNoclip()
		local char = tRoot.Parent
		local torso = char and (char:FindFirstChild("Torso") or char:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso") or char:FindFirstChild("Head"))
		local base = (torso and torso.Position) or tRoot.Position
		local vel = tRoot.AssemblyLinearVelocity
		local speed = vel.Magnitude
		local lead = math.clamp(0.12 + speed * 0.018, 0.12, 0.85)
		local pin = base + vel * lead
		pin = Vector3.new(pin.X, pin.Y + math.clamp(vel.Y * 0.05, -3, 4), pin.Z)
		local linear
		if speed < 8 then
			flingSpin = (flingSpin + 1.8) % (math.pi * 2)
			local r = 2.2
			pin = base + Vector3.new(math.cos(flingSpin) * r, math.sin(flingSpin * 2.4) * 1.2, math.sin(flingSpin) * r)
			local shoveDir = Vector3.new(math.cos(flingSpin), 0.35, math.sin(flingSpin)).Unit
			linear = shoveDir * 48000
		else
			linear = vel * 1.15 + Vector3.new(0, 18000, 0)
			if linear.Magnitude < 30000 then
				linear = linear.Unit * 30000
			end
		end
		local angular = Vector3.new(ANGULAR_FLING * 1.25, ANGULAR_FLING * 1.25, ANGULAR_FLING * 1.25)
		for _, part in ipairs(car:GetDescendants()) do
			if part:IsA("BasePart") then
				pcall(function()
					part.Anchored = false
					part.CanCollide = true
					part.CFrame = CFrame.new(pin)
					part.AssemblyLinearVelocity = linear
					part.AssemblyAngularVelocity = angular
				end)
			end
		end
		pcall(function()
			car:PivotTo(CFrame.new(pin))
		end)
		for _, part in ipairs(car:GetDescendants()) do
			if part:IsA("BasePart") then
				pcall(function()
					part.AssemblyLinearVelocity = linear
					part.AssemblyAngularVelocity = angular
				end)
			end
		end
	end

	-- Multi-target / team / all rotation. Same car until you die; only then re-spawn.
	local carFlingIndex = 1
	local carFlingState = {
		target = nil,
		startPos = nil,
		startAt = 0,
		switchAfter = 1.5,
	}
	local carSpawnOnce = false -- true while a spawn task is running

	function CF.listFromMultiFlag(flagValue)
		local out = {}
		if type(flagValue) ~= "table" then
			return out
		end
		for key, value in pairs(flagValue) do
			local label = nil
			if type(value) == "string" and value ~= "" and value ~= "---" then
				label = value
			elseif value == true and type(key) == "string" and key ~= "---" then
				label = key
			end
			if label then
				local user = usernameFromLabel(label)
				local plr = user and playersService:FindFirstChild(user)
				if plr and plr:IsA("Player") and plr ~= localPlayer then
					table.insert(out, plr)
				end
			end
		end
		return out
	end

	function CF.teamFlagSelected(teamName)
		local raw = flags.tools_car_fling_teams
		if type(raw) ~= "table" then
			return false
		end
		if raw[teamName] == true then
			return true
		end
		for key, value in pairs(raw) do
			if value == true and key == teamName then
				return true
			end
			if type(value) == "string" and value == teamName then
				return true
			end
		end
		return false
	end

	function CF.anyTeamFlingSelected()
		return CF.teamFlagSelected("Inmates") or CF.teamFlagSelected("Criminals") or CF.teamFlagSelected("Guards")
	end

	function CF.getCarFlingTargets()
		local list = {}
		if flags.tools_car_fling_all then
			for _, plr in ipairs(playersService:GetPlayers()) do
				if plr ~= localPlayer and not isGloballyWhitelisted(plr) then
					table.insert(list, plr)
				end
			end
		elseif CF.anyTeamFlingSelected() then
			for _, plr in ipairs(playersService:GetPlayers()) do
				if plr == localPlayer or isGloballyWhitelisted(plr) then
					continue
				end
				local teamName = plr.Team and plr.Team.Name
				if teamName and CF.teamFlagSelected(teamName) then
					table.insert(list, plr)
				end
			end
		else
			list = CF.listFromMultiFlag(flags.tools_car_fling_targets)
			if #list == 0 then
				local user = usernameFromLabel(flags.tools_player)
				local plr = user and playersService:FindFirstChild(user)
				if plr and plr:IsA("Player") then
					table.insert(list, plr)
				end
			end
		end
		table.sort(list, function(a, b)
			return a.Name:lower() < b.Name:lower()
		end)
		return list
	end

	local _oldGetCarFlingTargets = CF.getCarFlingTargets
	function CF.getCarFlingTargets()
		local list = _oldGetCarFlingTargets()
		local seen = {}
		for _, plr in ipairs(list) do
			seen[plr.UserId] = true
		end
		for userId in pairs(Hooks.persistentCarFling) do
			local plr = playersService:GetPlayerByUserId(userId)
			if plr and plr ~= localPlayer and not seen[userId] and not isGloballyWhitelisted(plr) then
				table.insert(list, plr)
				seen[userId] = true
			end
		end
		for userId in pairs(Hooks.persistentExploiterFling) do
			local plr = playersService:GetPlayerByUserId(userId)
			if plr and plr ~= localPlayer and not seen[userId] and not isGloballyWhitelisted(plr) then
				table.insert(list, plr)
				seen[userId] = true
			end
		end
		return list
	end

	local function anyPersistentCarFling()
		for _ in pairs(Hooks.persistentCarFling) do
			return true
		end
		for _ in pairs(Hooks.persistentExploiterFling) do
			return true
		end
		return false
	end

	local function isExploiterTarget(plr)
		return plr and Hooks.persistentExploiterFling and Hooks.persistentExploiterFling[plr.UserId] == true
	end

	---True if any live fling target still exists (persistent or dropdown/team/all).
	local function hasLiveFlingTargets()
		return #CF.getCarFlingTargets() > 0
	end

	---Drop a leaving player from the persistent sets (the fling itself stays on).
	local function onFlingTargetLeft(player)
		if not player then
			return
		end
		local uid = player.UserId
		if Hooks.persistentCarFling then
			Hooks.persistentCarFling[uid] = nil
		end
		if Hooks.persistentExploiterFling then
			Hooks.persistentExploiterFling[uid] = nil
		end
		if carFlingState.target == player then
			carFlingState.target = nil
			carFlingState.startPos = nil
		end
		-- Purge any stale userIds whose players are already gone.
		for _, bag in ipairs({ Hooks.persistentCarFling, Hooks.persistentExploiterFling }) do
			if type(bag) == "table" then
				for id in pairs(bag) do
					if not playersService:GetPlayerByUserId(id) then
						bag[id] = nil
					end
				end
			end
		end
		-- Car Fling stays on until you turn it off (it used to switch itself off here whenever
		-- anyone left and it briefly saw no targets).
		if not hasLiveFlingTargets() then
			carFlingBusy = false
			carSpawnOnce = false
			carFlingState.target = nil
		end
	end

	library:connection(playersService.PlayerRemoving, function(player)
		onFlingTargetLeft(player)
	end)

	function CF.switchDelay()
		if flags.tools_car_fling_all then
			return tonumber(flags.tools_car_fling_all_dwell) or 1.5
		end
		if CF.anyTeamFlingSelected() then
			return tonumber(flags.tools_car_fling_team_dwell) or 2
		end
		return tonumber(flags.tools_car_fling_dwell) or 0.55
	end

	---True once they were launched (speed / distance) or the dwell timed out.
	function CF.targetWasFlung(root)
		if not (root and carFlingState.startPos) then
			return false
		end
		local moved = (root.Position - carFlingState.startPos).Magnitude
		local speed = root.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Magnitude
		return speed >= 70 or moved >= 35
	end

	function CF.lockTarget(plr, root)
		carFlingState.target = plr
		carFlingState.startPos = root.Position
		carFlingState.startAt = os.clock()
		carFlingState.switchAfter = CF.switchDelay()
	end

	function CF.advanceTarget()
		local list = CF.getCarFlingTargets()
		if #list == 0 then
			carFlingState.target = nil
			return nil
		end
		carFlingIndex = (carFlingIndex % #list) + 1
		for i = 0, #list - 1 do
			local idx = ((carFlingIndex - 1 + i) % #list) + 1
			local plr = list[idx]
			local root = plr.Character and plr.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			local hum = plr.Character and plr.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
			if root and hum and hum.Health > 0 then
				carFlingIndex = idx
				CF.lockTarget(plr, root)
				return plr, root
			end
		end
		carFlingState.target = nil
		return nil
	end

	function CF.currentFlingTarget()
		local list = CF.getCarFlingTargets()
		if #list == 0 then
			carFlingState.target = nil
			return nil
		end
		local plr = carFlingState.target
		local root = plr and plr.Character and plr.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		local hum = plr and plr.Character and plr.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		if plr and root and hum and hum.Health > 0 then
			local elapsed = os.clock() - (carFlingState.startAt or 0)
			if CF.targetWasFlung(root) and elapsed >= 0.35 then
				return CF.advanceTarget()
			end
			if elapsed >= (carFlingState.switchAfter or CF.switchDelay()) then
				return CF.advanceTarget()
			end
			return plr, root
		end
		return CF.advanceTarget()
	end

	---Spawn/sit only when we have no car. Never mid-rotation while alive.
	function CF.ensureCarOnce()
		if CF.getDrivenSquad() then
			return CF.getDrivenSquad()
		end
		if carSpawnOnce or carFlingBusy then
			return nil
		end
		if flags.tools_car_fling_spawn == false then
			return nil
		end
		carSpawnOnce = true
		carFlingBusy = true
		task.spawn(function()
			local ok, err = pcall(function()
				CF.spawnAndClaimSquad()
			end)
			if not ok then
				warn("[aqua labs] car fling spawn:", err)
			end
			carFlingBusy = false
			carSpawnOnce = false
		end)
		return nil
	end

	---Car Orbit auto spawn: hop into the nearest free car close by, or spawn a Squad.
	local claimingCar = false
	Hooks.claimCarForOrbit = function()
		if claimingCar or carSpawnOnce or carFlingBusy then
			return
		end
		claimingCar = true
		task.spawn(function()
			pcall(function()
				local myRoot = localPlayer.Character and localPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
				local container = workspace:FindFirstChild("CarContainer")
				local nearest, nearestDistance = nil, 300
				for _, car in ipairs(container and container:GetChildren() or {}) do
					local seat = car:FindFirstChild("VehicleSeat", true)
					if myRoot and seat and not seat.Occupant and not seat.Disabled then
						local distance = (seat.Position - myRoot.Position).Magnitude
						if distance < nearestDistance then
							nearest, nearestDistance = car, distance
						end
					end
				end
				if not (nearest and CF.sitInCar(nearest)) then
					CF.spawnAndClaimSquad()
				end
			end)
			claimingCar = false
		end)
	end

	addFeature(playerSection, {
		name = "Carfling",
		flag = "tools_car_fling",
		callback = function(enabled)
			if enabled then
				carFlingIndex = 0
				carFlingState.target = nil
				if not CF.getDrivenSquad() then
					CF.ensureCarOnce()
				end
			end
		end,
	})
	playerSection:toggle({ name = "auto spawn car", flag = "tools_car_fling_spawn", default = true })
	playerSection:toggle({
		name = "loop fling all",
		flag = "tools_car_fling_all",
		default = false,
		callback = function(enabled)
			if enabled then
				carFlingIndex = 0
				carFlingState.target = nil
			end
		end,
	})
	playerSection:dropdown({
		name = "fling teams",
		flag = "tools_car_fling_teams",
		items = { "Inmates", "Criminals", "Guards" },
		default = {},
		multi = true,
	})
	playerSection:slider({
		name = "all switch after",
		flag = "tools_car_fling_all_dwell",
		min = 0.75,
		max = 5,
		default = 1.5,
		interval = 0.25,
		suffix = "s",
	})
	playerSection:slider({
		name = "team switch after",
		flag = "tools_car_fling_team_dwell",
		min = 0.75,
		max = 5,
		default = 2,
		interval = 0.25,
		suffix = "s",
	})
	playerSection:slider({
		name = "target switch time",
		flag = "tools_car_fling_dwell",
		min = 0.2,
		max = 3,
		default = 0.55,
		interval = 0.05,
		suffix = "s",
	})

	library:connection(runService.Heartbeat, function()
		if not flags.tools_car_fling or isTyping() then
			return
		end
		local character = localPlayer.Character
		local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		if not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 then
			return
		end

		local car = CF.getDrivenSquad()
		if not car then
			-- The server deletes the car after a fling: get a new one right away and keep going
			-- (it used to wait while a target was locked, so it looked like it turned off).
			if hasLiveFlingTargets() and not carFlingBusy and not carSpawnOnce and flags.tools_car_fling_spawn ~= false then
				CF.ensureCarOnce()
			end
			return
		end

		local tPlr, tRoot = CF.currentFlingTarget()
		if not tRoot then
			-- Target left / no one left: stop chasing cars.
			if not hasLiveFlingTargets() then
				carFlingState.target = nil
				carFlingBusy = false
				carSpawnOnce = false
			end
			return
		end
		if isExploiterTarget(tPlr) then
			CF.flingCarIntoExploiter(car, tRoot)
		else
			CF.flingCarIntoTarget(car, tRoot)
		end
	end)

	-- Same fling loop for profile-panel targets when main toggle is off.
	library:connection(runService.Heartbeat, function()
		if flags.tools_car_fling or not anyPersistentCarFling() or isTyping() then
			return
		end
		local character = localPlayer.Character
		local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		if not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 then
			return
		end
		local car = CF.getDrivenSquad()
		if not car then
			-- Same as above: a new car right away, so the fling keeps going.
			if hasLiveFlingTargets() and not carFlingBusy and not carSpawnOnce and flags.tools_car_fling_spawn ~= false then
				CF.ensureCarOnce()
			end
			return
		end
		local tPlr, tRoot = CF.currentFlingTarget()
		if not tRoot then
			if not hasLiveFlingTargets() then
				carFlingState.target = nil
				carFlingBusy = false
				carSpawnOnce = false
			end
			return
		end
		if isExploiterTarget(tPlr) then
			CF.flingCarIntoExploiter(car, tRoot)
		else
			CF.flingCarIntoTarget(car, tRoot)
		end
	end)

	-- Only place we re-spawn the Squad: after you die and come back.
	library:connection(localPlayer.CharacterAdded, function()
		carFlingBusy = false
		carSpawnOnce = false
		carFlingState.target = nil
		if not flags.tools_car_fling then
			return
		end
		task.delay(1.0, function()
			if flags.tools_car_fling and flags.tools_car_fling_spawn ~= false and hasLiveFlingTargets() then
				CF.ensureCarOnce()
			end
		end)
	end)

	-- Re-spawn car on your death when only profile targets are active.
	library:connection(localPlayer.CharacterAdded, function()
		if flags.tools_car_fling or not anyPersistentCarFling() then
			return
		end
		carFlingBusy = false
		carSpawnOnce = false
		carFlingState.target = nil
		task.delay(1.0, function()
			if anyPersistentCarFling() and flags.tools_car_fling_spawn ~= false and hasLiveFlingTargets() then
				CF.ensureCarOnce()
			end
		end)
	end)

	-- Keep following them through respawns; stop if they leave.
	task.spawn(function()
		while isCurrentRun() and watermarkHolder.Parent do
			task.wait(0.5)
			if not (isCurrentRun() and spectating) then
				continue
			end
			if not spectating.Parent then
				setSpectate(nil)
				continue
			end
			local humanoid = spectating.Character and spectating.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
			if humanoid and workspace.CurrentCamera.CameraSubject ~= humanoid then
				workspace.CurrentCamera.CameraSubject = humanoid
			end
		end
	end)

	playerSection:button({ name = "Inspect inventory", callback = function()
		local player = selectedPlayer()
		if not player then
			return
		end

		local tools = {}
		for _, container in ipairs({ player:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack"), player.Character }) do
			for _, tool in ipairs(container and container:GetChildren() or {}) do
				if tool:IsA("Tool") then
					table.insert(tools, container == player.Character and (tool.Name .. " (held)") or tool.Name)
				end
			end
		end

		library:notification({
			text = player.DisplayName .. ": " .. (#tools > 0 and table.concat(tools, ", ") or "no tools"),
			time = 6,
		})
	end })

	playerSection:button({ name = "Arrest player", callback = function()
		local player = selectedPlayer()
		if not player then
			return
		end

		local character = player.Character
		local targetRoot = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		local arrestRemote = remotes and remotes:FindFirstChild("ArrestPlayer")
		if not (targetRoot and arrestRemote) then
			return
		end
		if not (localPlayer.Team and localPlayer.Team.Name == "Guards") then
			return library:notification({ text = "You have to be a guard to arrest." })
		end
		if not (character:GetAttribute("Hostile") or character:GetAttribute("Trespassing")) then
			return library:notification({ text = player.DisplayName .. " isn't hostile or trespassing." })
		end

		task.spawn(function()
			local root = myRoot()
			local humanoid = localPlayer.Character and localPlayer.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
			local backpack = localPlayer:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack")
			local cuffs = (backpack and backpack:FindFirstChild("Handcuffs")) or (localPlayer.Character and localPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("Handcuffs"))
			if not (root and humanoid and cuffs) then
				return
			end

			local home = root.CFrame
			humanoid:EquipTool(cuffs)
			for _ = 1, 10 do
				if not targetRoot.Parent then
					break
				end
				teleportTo(targetRoot.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0, 2))
				pcall(arrestRemote.InvokeServer, arrestRemote, player, 1)
				task.wait(0.05)
			end
			teleportTo(home)
		end)
	end })

	-- Items -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	local itemSection = miscTab:section({ name = "Items", side = "left" })

	---Pick up a map item (hammer, crude knife) and return.
	local function grabItem(itemName)
		local item = workspace:FindFirstChild(itemName)
		local pickup = item and item:FindFirstChild("ITEMPICKUP")
		local giverRemote = remotes and remotes:FindFirstChild("GiverPressed")
		local root = myRoot()
		if not (pickup and giverRemote and root) then
			return library:notification({ text = itemName .. " hasn't spawned yet." })
		end

		local home = root.CFrame
		local started = os.clock()
		local function holding()
			local backpack = localPlayer:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack")
			return backpack and backpack:FindFirstChild(itemName) ~= nil
		end
		while os.clock() - started < 3 and not holding() do
			teleportTo(pickup.CFrame)
			pcall(giverRemote.FireServer, giverRemote, item)
			task.wait()
		end
		teleportTo(home)
	end

	itemSection:button({ name = "Get hammer", callback = function()
		task.spawn(grabItem, "Hammer")
	end })
	itemSection:button({ name = "Get crude knife", callback = function()
		task.spawn(grabItem, "Crude Knife")
	end })

	-- Auto Heal in its own function so it stays under Luau's 200-local limit.
	local function buildAutoHeal()
		-- Auto Heal -------------------------------------------------------------------------------
		-- Meals (Breakfast, Lunch, Dinner) heal when eaten: the tool is equipped and activated,
		-- which is what clicking with it does. Meal givers only exist while that meal is served.
		local healSection = miscTab:section({ name = "Auto Heal", side = "left" })
		local MEALS = { "Dinner", "Lunch", "Breakfast" }
		local eating = false
		local lastHealAttempt = 0

		addFeature(healSection, { name = "Auto Heal", flag = "auto_heal" })
		healSection:slider({ name = "heal below", flag = "auto_heal_threshold", min = 1, max = 100, default = 50, interval = 1, suffix = " hp" })
		healSection:toggle({ name = "grab a meal when out", flag = "auto_heal_grab", default = false })
		healSection:toggle({ name = "grab meals when served", flag = "auto_heal_grab_served", default = true })
		healSection:dropdown({ name = "meal", flag = "food_choice", items = { "Any", "Breakfast", "Lunch", "Dinner" }, default = "Any" })
		-- Idle heal: once nobody has been targeted for a while, top up even above "heal below".
		healSection:toggle({ name = "heal when idle", flag = "auto_heal_idle", default = true })
		healSection:slider({ name = "idle for", flag = "auto_heal_idle_time", min = 1, max = 30, default = 4, interval = 0.5, suffix = "s" })
		healSection:slider({ name = "idle heal below", flag = "auto_heal_idle_below", min = 1, max = 100, default = 100, interval = 1, suffix = " hp" })
		-- Eat Mode (bind a key): holds a meal and eats until toggled off; Ragebot, Quick Swap and gun
		-- pulling all stand down while it's on.
		local eatModeSwappedFrom = nil
		local leaveEatMode = nil
		addFeature(healSection, { name = "Eat Mode", flag = "heal_eat_mode", callback = function(enabled)
			if not enabled and leaveEatMode then
				task.spawn(leaveEatMode)
			end
		end })

		---Health to heal below right now (raised while you're idle).
		local function healThreshold()
			local threshold = flags.auto_heal_threshold or 50
			if flags.auto_heal_idle ~= false and os.clock() - (Hooks.lastTargetAt or 0) >= (flags.auto_heal_idle_time or 4) then
				threshold = math.max(threshold, flags.auto_heal_idle_below or 100)
			end
			return threshold
		end

		---A meal you're holding or carrying.
		---@return Tool?
		local function findMeal()
			for _, container in ipairs({ localPlayer.Character, localPlayer:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack") }) do
				for _, name in ipairs(MEALS) do
					local tool = container and container:FindFirstChild(name)
					if tool and tool:IsA("Tool") then
						return tool
					end
				end
			end
			return nil
		end

		---The pickup part of a meal giver being served right now.
		---@return BasePart?
		local function mealPickup()
			local items = workspace:FindFirstChild("Prison_ITEMS")
			local giver = items and items:FindFirstChild("giver")
			if not giver then
				return nil
			end

			-- The game hands out a meal for any part of its giver (it checks the clicked part's
			-- parent is a meal under "giver"). Breakfast has an ITEMPICKUP part; Dinner doesn't,
			-- so any part of the giver is used, ITEMPICKUP first when there is one.
			local choice = flags.food_choice or "Any"
			for _, name in ipairs(MEALS) do
				if choice == "Any" or choice == name then
					local meal = giver:FindFirstChild(name)
					if meal then
						local parts = {}
						local pickup = meal:FindFirstChild("ITEMPICKUP")
						if pickup and pickup:IsA("BasePart") then
							table.insert(parts, pickup)
						end
						for _, child in ipairs(meal:GetChildren()) do
							if child:IsA("BasePart") and child ~= pickup then
								table.insert(parts, child)
							end
						end
						if #parts > 0 then
							return parts
						end
					end
				end
			end
			return nil
		end

		---A spot on your team's spawn (one of its enabled SpawnLocations), standing on top of it.
		---@return CFrame?
		Hooks.teamSpawnCFrame = function()
			local options = {}
			for _, spawn in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
				if spawn:IsA("SpawnLocation") and spawn.Enabled and not spawn.Neutral and spawn.TeamColor == localPlayer.TeamColor then
					table.insert(options, spawn)
				end
			end
			local spawn = options[math.random(1, math.max(#options, 1))]
			return spawn and CFrame.new(spawn.Position + Vector3.new(0, 4, 0)) or nil
		end

		---Teleport to a meal giver, take a meal, and come back.
		---@return boolean
		local function grabMeal()
			local parts = mealPickup()
			local interact = remotes and remotes:FindFirstChild("InteractWithItem")
			local root = myRoot()
			if not (parts and interact and root) then
				return false
			end

			-- Only parts above the floor: some giver pieces sit hidden under the map, and standing
			-- on those dropped you below it.
			local usable = {}
			for _, part in ipairs(parts) do
				if part.Position.Y > 60 then
					table.insert(usable, part)
				end
			end
			if #usable == 0 then
				return false
			end

			-- Where to come back to. Right after spawning (or while on the team menu) you're briefly
			-- at the Neutral spawn under the map, so a spot that low goes to your team's spawn instead.
			local home = root.CFrame
			if home.Position.Y < 60 then
				home = Hooks.teamSpawnCFrame and Hooks.teamSpawnCFrame() or nil
			end

			local started = os.clock()
			local index = 0
			-- The server only hands it over within 12 studs, so stand right on the part being
			-- used, cycling through the giver's parts until one works.
			while os.clock() - started < 4 and not findMeal() do
				index = index % #usable + 1
				local part = usable[index]
				if part.Parent then
					teleportTo(CFrame.new(part.Position + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0)))
					task.wait(0.05)
					pcall(interact.InvokeServer, interact, part)
				end
				task.wait(0.15)
			end
			if home then
				teleportTo(home)
			end
			return findMeal() ~= nil
		end

		---Equip a meal, eat it, then switch back to what you were holding.
		local function eatMeal(meal)
			local character = localPlayer.Character
			local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
			if not humanoid then
				return
			end

			eating = true
			local previous = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")
			if meal.Parent ~= character then
				pcall(humanoid.EquipTool, humanoid, meal)
				task.wait(0.2)
			end

			-- Eating is the meal's EatScript firing Remotes.EatFood (no arguments) while the meal is
			-- held, so fire it directly. Retry once a second until it heals you or the meal is used
			-- up; fall back to clicking with the tool if the remote isn't there.
			local eatRemote = remotes and remotes:FindFirstChild("EatFood")
			local before = humanoid.Health
			local started = os.clock()
			local lastBite = 0
			while os.clock() - started < 5 and humanoid.Health <= before and humanoid.Health > 0 and meal.Parent do
				-- Something swapped it out of your hand: put it straight back.
				if meal.Parent ~= character then
					pcall(humanoid.EquipTool, humanoid, meal)
				end
				if os.clock() - lastBite >= 1 then
					lastBite = os.clock()
					if eatRemote then
						pcall(eatRemote.FireServer, eatRemote)
					else
						pcall(meal.Activate, meal)
					end
				end
				task.wait(0.1)
			end

			if previous and previous ~= meal and previous.Parent then
				pcall(humanoid.EquipTool, humanoid, previous)
			end
			eating = false
		end

		---Auto Heal needs your hands: you're below the heal threshold and there's a meal to eat
		---(or you're eating one). Ragebot, Quick Swap and Arrest Aura hold off on pulling out
		---weapons until this is false again, so they don't fight over what you're holding.
		Hooks.healPending = function()
			if eating or flags.heal_eat_mode then
				return true
			end
			if not flags.auto_heal then
				return false
			end
			local humanoid = localPlayer.Character and localPlayer.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
			-- Only the normal threshold holds Ragebot back (idle healing must not stop it from
			-- picking up a new target).
			if not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 or humanoid.Health >= (flags.auto_heal_threshold or 50) then
				return false
			end
			-- Healing overrides Ragebot and Quick Swap: once you're under the threshold with a meal to
			-- eat, they stop pulling guns out until you've eaten. (This used to wait until nobody had
			-- been targeted for a while, which with Ragebot or Silent Aim on never happened.)
			return findMeal() ~= nil or (flags.auto_heal_grab and mealPickup() ~= nil)
		end

		healSection:button({ name = "Get meal", callback = function()
			task.spawn(function()
				if findMeal() then
					return library:notification({ text = "You already have a meal." })
				end
				if not mealPickup() then
					return library:notification({ text = "No meal is being served right now." })
				end
				library:notification({ text = grabMeal() and "Got a meal." or "Couldn't get a meal." })
			end)
		end })

		healSection:button({ name = "Eat now", callback = function()
			local meal = findMeal()
			if not meal then
				return library:notification({ text = "No meal in your inventory." })
			end
			if not eating then
				task.spawn(eatMeal, meal)
			end
		end })

		task.spawn(function()
			while isCurrentRun() and watermarkHolder.Parent do
				task.wait(0.25)
				if not (isCurrentRun() and flags.auto_heal) or flags.heal_eat_mode or eating or os.clock() - lastHealAttempt < 2 then
					continue
				end

				-- A meal just got served and you don't have one: go grab it right away, whatever
				-- your health, so it's ready for later.
				-- A failed grab (e.g. the server won't hand out another) waits 30s before retrying,
				-- so it doesn't keep teleporting you back and forth.
				-- Never while on the team menu or still at the under-map Neutral spawn.
				local spawnedIn = localPlayer.Team and localPlayer.Team.Name ~= "Neutral"
					and myRoot() and myRoot().Position.Y > 60
				if flags.auto_heal_grab_served ~= false and spawnedIn and os.clock() >= (Hooks.mealRetryAt or 0)
					and not findMeal() and mealPickup() then
					lastHealAttempt = os.clock()
					if not grabMeal() then
						Hooks.mealRetryAt = os.clock() + 30
					end
					continue
				end

				local humanoid = localPlayer.Character and localPlayer.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
				if not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 or humanoid.Health >= math.min(healThreshold(), humanoid.MaxHealth) then
					continue
				end

				lastHealAttempt = os.clock()
				local meal = findMeal()
				if not meal and flags.auto_heal_grab and mealPickup() and grabMeal() then
					meal = findMeal()
				end
				if meal then
					eatMeal(meal)
				end
			end
		end)

		-- Eat Mode: keep a meal in hand and take a bite every second you're hurt. Turning it off puts
		-- back what you were holding.
		-- Guns in the order Ragebot prefers them, for when there was nothing in hand to go back to.
		local GUN_ORDER = { "M4A1", "AK-47", "FAL", "MP5", "Remington 870", "Revolver", "M9" }

		---Eat Mode off: the meal goes away and a gun comes straight back out (what you held before,
		---or your best gun), so Ragebot and Quick Swap carry on with no gap.
		leaveEatMode = function()
			local swappedFrom = eatModeSwappedFrom
			eatModeSwappedFrom = nil
			local character = localPlayer.Character
			local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
			if not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 then
				return
			end
			local held = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")
			if held and not table.find(MEALS, held.Name) then
				return
			end

			local backpack = localPlayer:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack")
			local nextTool = swappedFrom and swappedFrom.Parent == backpack and swappedFrom or nil
			if not nextTool and backpack then
				for _, name in ipairs(GUN_ORDER) do
					nextTool = backpack:FindFirstChild(name)
					if nextTool then
						break
					end
				end
			end
			if nextTool then
				pcall(humanoid.EquipTool, humanoid, nextTool)
			else
				pcall(humanoid.UnequipTools, humanoid)
			end
		end

		task.spawn(function()
			local lastBite = 0
			local eatRemote = remotes and remotes:FindFirstChild("EatFood")
			while isCurrentRun() and watermarkHolder.Parent do
				task.wait(0.1)
				local character = localPlayer.Character
				local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

				if not flags.heal_eat_mode then
					continue
				end
				if not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 or eating then
					continue
				end

				local meal = findMeal()
				if not meal then
					-- Out of food: grab one if a meal is being served (retry every 10s if refused).
					if os.clock() >= (Hooks.mealRetryAt or 0) and mealPickup() and not grabMeal() then
						Hooks.mealRetryAt = os.clock() + 10
					end
					continue
				end

				if meal.Parent ~= character then
					local held = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")
					if held and not eatModeSwappedFrom then
						eatModeSwappedFrom = held
					end
					pcall(humanoid.EquipTool, humanoid, meal)
				end
				if humanoid.Health < humanoid.MaxHealth and os.clock() - lastBite >= 1 then
					lastBite = os.clock()
					if eatRemote then
						pcall(eatRemote.FireServer, eatRemote)
					else
						pcall(meal.Activate, meal)
					end
				end
			end
		end)

	end
	buildAutoHeal()

	onUnload(function()
		if spectating then
			setSpectate(nil)
		end
	end)
end

do
	end
	setupPlayerTools()
	end

	-- World tweaks (own scope — keeps the misc block under Luau's 200-local limit).
	local miscTab = Tabs.misc
	-- World Tweaks sit in Main's right column.
	local worldSection = mainTab:section({ name = "World Tweaks", side = "right" })
	local removedDoors = {}

	---Hide every door on your screen, or put them back.
	local function setDoorsRemoved(enabled)
		if enabled then
			local doors = workspace:FindFirstChild("Doors")
			for _, door in ipairs(doors and doors:GetChildren() or {}) do
				table.insert(removedDoors, { door = door, parent = doors })
				door.Parent = nil
			end
		else
			for _, entry in ipairs(removedDoors) do
				if entry.parent.Parent then
					entry.door.Parent = entry.parent
				end
			end
			table.clear(removedDoors)
		end
	end

	addFeature(worldSection, { name = "Remove Doors", flag = "remove_doors", callback = setDoorsRemoved })

	-- Remove Fence Damage: the electric fences hurt through invisible "damagePart" touch
	-- parts. Taking them out on your side means your character never touches them.
	local removedFenceParts = {}

	---Pull the fence damage parts out, or put them back.
	local function setFenceDamageRemoved(enabled)
		if enabled then
			local fences = workspace:FindFirstChild("Prison_Fences")
			for _, part in ipairs(fences and fences:GetDescendants() or {}) do
				if part.Name == "damagePart" and part:IsA("BasePart") then
					table.insert(removedFenceParts, { part = part, parent = part.Parent })
					part.Parent = nil
				end
			end
		else
			for _, entry in ipairs(removedFenceParts) do
				if entry.parent.Parent then
					entry.part.Parent = entry.parent
				end
			end
			table.clear(removedFenceParts)
		end
	end

	addFeature(worldSection, { name = "Remove Fence Damage", flag = "remove_fence_damage", callback = setFenceDamageRemoved })
	onUnload(function()
		setFenceDamageRemoved(false)
	end)

	-- Remove Boundary: the invisible map walls (workspace.BOUNDARY), put back when turned off.
	local removedBoundary = nil
	addFeature(worldSection, { name = "Remove Boundary", flag = "remove_boundary", callback = function(enabled)
		if enabled then
			local boundary = workspace:FindFirstChild("BOUNDARY")
			if boundary then
				removedBoundary = boundary
				boundary.Parent = nil
			end
		elseif removedBoundary then
			removedBoundary.Parent = workspace
			removedBoundary = nil
		end
	end })
	onUnload(function()
		if removedBoundary then
			removedBoundary.Parent = workspace
		end
	end)

	-- Remove Trees: workspace.Prison_Trees, put back when turned off.
	local removedTrees = nil
	local function setTreesRemoved(enabled)
		if enabled then
			local trees = workspace:FindFirstChild("Prison_Trees")
			if trees then
				removedTrees = trees
				trees.Parent = nil
			end
		elseif removedTrees then
			removedTrees.Parent = workspace
			removedTrees = nil
		end
	end
	addFeature(worldSection, { name = "Remove Trees", flag = "remove_trees", callback = setTreesRemoved })
	onUnload(function()
		setTreesRemoved(false)
	end)

	-- Anti car fling: strip collision + kill velocity on nearby enemy cars every frame, and take
	-- out every car seat (driver seats too, unless "keep driver seats" is on), so nobody can
	-- seat you in theirs. The seat you're sitting in is never taken.
	addFeature(worldSection, { name = "Anti Car Fling", flag = "anti_car_fling" })
	worldSection:toggle({ name = "keep driver seats", flag = "anti_car_fling_keep_driver", default = false })
	local carCollisions = {}
	local removedCarSeats = {}

	local function restoreCars()
		for part, canCollide in pairs(carCollisions) do
			if part.Parent then
				part.CanCollide = canCollide
			end
		end
		table.clear(carCollisions)
		for seat, parent in pairs(removedCarSeats) do
			if parent.Parent then
				seat.Parent = parent
			end
		end
		table.clear(removedCarSeats)
	end

	---The driver's seat, which always stays.
	local function isDriverSeat(seat)
		return seat:IsA("VehicleSeat") and seat.Name == "VehicleSeat" and seat.Parent ~= nil and seat.Parent.Name == "Body"
	end

	-- The full pass over every car part runs 4 times a second; only stopping nearby cars dead
	-- runs every frame, from the list the last pass made.
	local carScanAt = 0
	local closeCarParts = {}
	library:connection(runService.Heartbeat, function()
		if not flags.anti_car_fling or Hooks.isTossing() then
			if next(carCollisions) or next(removedCarSeats) then
				restoreCars()
			end
			table.clear(closeCarParts)
			return
		end

		for _, part in ipairs(closeCarParts) do
			if part.Parent then
				part.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
				part.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
			end
		end

		local now = os.clock()
		if now - carScanAt < 0.25 then
			return
		end
		carScanAt = now
		table.clear(closeCarParts)

		local cars = workspace:FindFirstChild("CarContainer")
		if not cars then
			return
		end
		local humanoid = localPlayer.Character and localPlayer.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		local myRoot = localPlayer.Character and localPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		local mySeat = humanoid and humanoid.SeatPart
		local myPos = myRoot and myRoot.Position

		for _, car in ipairs(cars:GetChildren()) do
			if mySeat and mySeat:IsDescendantOf(car) then
				for _, part in ipairs(car:GetDescendants()) do
					if carCollisions[part] ~= nil then
						part.CanCollide = carCollisions[part]
						carCollisions[part] = nil
					end
				end
				continue
			end

			local descendants = car:GetDescendants()
			local close = false
			if myPos then
				for _, part in ipairs(descendants) do
					if part:IsA("BasePart") and (part.Position - myPos).Magnitude < 50 then
						close = true
						break
					end
				end
			end

			for _, part in ipairs(descendants) do
				if not part:IsA("BasePart") then
					continue
				end
				local keepDriver = flags.anti_car_fling_keep_driver == true and isDriverSeat(part)
				if part:IsA("Seat") or (part:IsA("VehicleSeat") and not keepDriver) then
					if part ~= mySeat and part.Parent then
						removedCarSeats[part] = part.Parent
						part.Parent = nil
					end
					continue
				end
				if carCollisions[part] == nil then
					carCollisions[part] = part.CanCollide
				end
				if part.CanCollide then
					part.CanCollide = false
				end
				if close then
					table.insert(closeCarParts, part)
				end
			end
		end
	end)

	onUnload(restoreCars)

	onUnload(function()
		setDoorsRemoved(false)
		restoreCars()
	end)
end

do
	-- Character Ring: two glowing rings spin at your feet in opposite directions, each with
	-- a bright head and a fading comet tail.
	local ringSection = Tabs.visuals:section({ name = "Character Ring", side = "left" })
	local POINTS = 48

	addFeature(ringSection, { name = "Character Ring", flag = "char_ring" })
	ringSection:colorpicker({ flag = "char_ring_color", color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 170, 160) })
