	ringSection:toggle({ name = "match theme", flag = "char_ring_theme", default = false })
	ringSection:slider({ name = "ring size", flag = "char_ring_size", min = 1.5, max = 6, default = 3, interval = 0.1, suffix = " studs" })
	ringSection:slider({ name = "spin speed", flag = "char_ring_speed", min = 0.2, max = 4, default = 1.2, interval = 0.1, suffix = " rps" })

	local anchor = Instance.new("Part")
	anchor.Name = ""
	anchor.Anchored = true
	anchor.CanCollide = false
	anchor.CanQuery = false
	anchor.CanTouch = false
	anchor.Transparency = 1
	anchor.Size = Vector3.new(0.05, 0.05, 0.05)
	anchor.CFrame = CFrame.identity
	anchor.Parent = workspace

	local rings = {}
	for ringIndex = 1, 2 do
		local ring = { points = {}, beams = {}, direction = ringIndex == 1 and 1 or -1, scale = ringIndex == 1 and 1 or 0.68 }
		for index = 1, POINTS do
			local attachment = Instance.new("Attachment")
			attachment.Parent = anchor
			ring.points[index] = attachment
		end
		for index = 1, POINTS do
			local beam = Instance.new("Beam")
			beam.Attachment0 = ring.points[index]
			beam.Attachment1 = ring.points[index % POINTS + 1]
			beam.FaceCamera = true
			beam.LightEmission = 1
			beam.LightInfluence = 0
			beam.Segments = 1
			beam.Enabled = false
			beam.Parent = anchor
			ring.beams[index] = beam
		end
		rings[ringIndex] = ring
	end

	local shown = false

	library:connection(runService.RenderStepped, function()
		local character = localPlayer.Character
		local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		local show = flags.char_ring == true and root ~= nil and humanoid ~= nil and humanoid.Health > 0

		if show ~= shown then
			shown = show
			for _, ring in ipairs(rings) do
				for _, beam in ipairs(ring.beams) do
					beam.Enabled = show
				end
			end
		end
		if not show then
			return
		end

		local now = os.clock()
		local color = flags.char_ring_theme and getAccent() or (flags.char_ring_color and flags.char_ring_color.Color or Color3.fromRGB(255, 170, 160))
		local hot = ColorSequence.new(color:Lerp(Color3.new(1, 1, 1), 0.55))
		local soft = ColorSequence.new(color)
		local radius = flags.char_ring_size or 3
		local feet = Hooks.feetPosition(character, root) + Vector3.new(0, 0.15, 0)
		local turn = now * (flags.char_ring_speed or 1.2) * math.pi * 2

		for ringIndex, ring in ipairs(rings) do
			local ringRadius = radius * ring.scale
			-- A gentle breathing bob, offset between the two rings.
			local height = math.sin(now * 2 + ringIndex) * 0.08
			local head = (turn * ring.direction) % (math.pi * 2)

			for index, attachment in ipairs(ring.points) do
				local angle = (index - 1) / POINTS * math.pi * 2
				attachment.Position = feet + Vector3.new(math.cos(angle) * ringRadius, height, math.sin(angle) * ringRadius)
			end

			for index, beam in ipairs(ring.beams) do
				-- How far behind the spinning head this segment is (0 = at the head).
				local angle = (index - 0.5) / POINTS * math.pi * 2
				local behind = ((head - angle) * ring.direction) % (math.pi * 2) / math.pi / 2
				local transparency = math.clamp(0.05 + behind * 0.9, 0, 0.95)
				beam.Transparency = NumberSequence.new(transparency)
				beam.Color = behind < 0.15 and hot or soft
				local width = 0.22 * (1 + behind * 0.6 * NEG_ONE) * (ring.scale + 0.2)
				beam.Width0, beam.Width1 = width, width
			end
		end
	end)

	onUnload(function()
		anchor:Destroy()
	end)
end

-- Auras: animated effects around your character (only you see them). Built in its own
-- function so its locals get their own register budget.
local function buildAuras()
	local auraSection = Tabs.visuals:section({ name = "Aura", side = "right" })
	local FIRE = "rbxasset://textures/particles/fire_main.dds"
	local SPARKLE = "rbxasset://textures/particles/sparkles_main.dds"
	local SMOKE = "rbxasset://textures/particles/smoke_main.dds"
	local WHITE = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)

	addFeature(auraSection, { name = "Aura", flag = "aura_enabled" })
	addFeature(auraSection, { name = "Halo", flag = "self_halo" })
	auraSection:colorpicker({ flag = "self_halo_color", color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 220, 80) })
	auraSection:slider({ name = "halo size", flag = "self_halo_size", min = 0.4, max = 3, default = 1, interval = 0.05 })
	auraSection:slider({ name = "halo height", flag = "self_halo_height", min = 0.5, max = 6, default = 2.25, interval = 0.05, suffix = " studs" })
	addFeature(auraSection, { name = "Angel Wings", flag = "self_wings" })
	auraSection:colorpicker({ flag = "self_wings_color", color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 150, 255) })
	auraSection:slider({ name = "wing visibility", flag = "self_wings_visibility", min = 0, max = 1, default = 0.9, interval = 0.01 })
	auraSection:slider({ name = "wing size", flag = "self_wings_size", min = 0.5, max = 2.5, default = 1, interval = 0.05 })
	auraSection:slider({ name = "wing flap speed", flag = "self_wings_flap", min = 0.5, max = 6, default = 3.2, interval = 0.1 })
	addFeature(auraSection, { name = "Galaxy Orbit", flag = "self_galaxy_orbit" })
	auraSection:colorpicker({ flag = "self_galaxy_color", color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 90, 255) })
	auraSection:slider({ name = "orbit speed", flag = "self_galaxy_speed", min = 0.2, max = 4, default = 1, interval = 0.1 })
	auraSection:slider({ name = "orbit size", flag = "self_galaxy_size", min = 2, max = 12, default = 5, interval = 0.5 })
	addFeature(auraSection, { name = "Fire Aura", flag = "self_fire_aura" })
	auraSection:colorpicker({ flag = "self_fire_color", color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 120, 40) })
	addFeature(auraSection, { name = "Star Ring", flag = "self_star_ring" })
	auraSection:colorpicker({ flag = "self_star_color", color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 180) })

	-- Aura: just a clean glowing highlight around your body (fill + outline), no particles.
	auraSection:colorpicker({ name = "aura color", flag = "aura_color", color = Color3.fromRGB(80, 170, 255) })
	auraSection:colorpicker({ name = "aura outline", flag = "aura_outline_color", color = Color3.fromRGB(140, 220, 255) })
	auraSection:toggle({ name = "match theme", flag = "aura_theme", default = false })
	auraSection:toggle({ name = "rainbow", flag = "aura_rainbow", default = false })
	auraSection:slider({ name = "aura fill", flag = "aura_fill", min = 0, max = 1, default = 0.75, interval = 0.01 })
	auraSection:slider({ name = "aura outline fade", flag = "aura_outline_fade", min = 0, max = 1, default = 0, interval = 0.01 })
	auraSection:toggle({ name = "aura through walls", flag = "aura_through_walls", default = false })

	local glow = nil

	---Remove the highlight.
	local function clearAura()
		if glow then
			glow:Destroy()
			glow = nil
		end
	end

	library:connection(runService.RenderStepped, function()
		local character = localPlayer.Character
		local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		if not (flags.aura_enabled and humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0) then
			if glow then
				clearAura()
			end
			return
		end
		if not glow or glow.Parent ~= character then
			clearAura()
			glow = Instance.new("Highlight")
			glow.Name = ""
			glow.Adornee = character
			glow.Parent = character
		end

		local fill, outline
		if flags.aura_rainbow then
			fill = Color3.fromHSV(os.clock() * 0.15 % 1, 0.8, 1)
			outline = fill:Lerp(WHITE, 0.35)
		elseif flags.aura_theme then
			fill = getAccent()
			outline = fill:Lerp(WHITE, 0.35)
		else
			fill = flags.aura_color and flags.aura_color.Color or Color3.fromRGB(80, 170, 255)
			outline = flags.aura_outline_color and flags.aura_outline_color.Color or fill:Lerp(WHITE, 0.35)
		end
		glow.FillColor = fill
		glow.OutlineColor = outline
		glow.FillTransparency = math.clamp(flags.aura_fill or 0.75, 0, 1)
		glow.OutlineTransparency = math.clamp(flags.aura_outline_fade or 0, 0, 1)
		glow.DepthMode = flags.aura_through_walls and Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop or Enum.HighlightDepthMode.Occluded
	end)

	onUnload(clearAura)
end

buildAuras()

-- First Person Arms: in first person Roblox hides your whole body every frame (through
-- LocalTransparencyModifier). Right after the camera does that, your arms (and the tool you're
-- holding) are shown again, only on your screen. Called in place: the top level is at the
-- 200-local limit.
;(function()
	local section = Tabs.visuals:section({ name = "First Person", side = "right" })
	addFeature(section, { name = "Show Arms", flag = "fp_arms" })
	section:slider({ name = "arm transparency", flag = "fp_arms_transparency", min = 0, max = 0.9, default = 0, interval = 0.05 })
	section:toggle({ name = "show held tool", flag = "fp_arms_tool", default = true })

	local ARM_PARTS = {
		["Left Arm"] = true, ["Right Arm"] = true,
		LeftUpperArm = true, LeftLowerArm = true, LeftHand = true,
		RightUpperArm = true, RightLowerArm = true, RightHand = true,
	}
	local RENDER_KEY = "AquaFirstPersonArms"

	runService:BindToRenderStep(RENDER_KEY, Enum.RenderPriority.Camera.Value + 2, function()
		if not flags.fp_arms then
			return
		end
		local character = localPlayer.Character
		local head = character and character:FindFirstChild("Head")
		-- Only in first person (camera inside your head); third person is left alone.
		if not head or (workspace.CurrentCamera.CFrame.Position - head.Position).Magnitude > 1.5 then
			return
		end

		local amount = flags.fp_arms_transparency or 0
		for _, child in ipairs(character:GetChildren()) do
			if child:IsA("BasePart") and ARM_PARTS[child.Name] then
				child.LocalTransparencyModifier = amount
			elseif child:IsA("Tool") and flags.fp_arms_tool ~= false then
				for _, part in ipairs(child:GetDescendants()) do
					if part:IsA("BasePart") then
						part.LocalTransparencyModifier = amount
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end)

	onUnload(function()
		pcall(runService.UnbindFromRenderStep, runService, RENDER_KEY)
	end)
end)()

-- Target effects: an info card for whoever your aim features are locked onto, damage numbers
-- when you hit them, and a lightning strike when you kill them.
local function buildTargetEffects()

	local tweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
	local DARK = Color3.fromRGB(22, 22, 22)

	})

	effectsSection:dropdown({ name = "lightning color", flag = "kill_lightning_mode", items = { "Target", "Custom", "Theme" }, default = "Target" })

	addFeature(effectsSection, { name = "Blood Splatter", flag = "blood_splatter", default = true, listActive = false })
	effectsSection:colorpicker({ name = "blood color", flag = "blood_color", color = Color3.fromRGB(150, 0, 0) })

	local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")

	gui.ResetOnSpawn = false

	gui:SetAttribute("AquaLabs", true)
	gui.Parent = coreGui

	---Frame helper.
	local function make(className, properties)
		local object = Instance.new(className)
		for key, value in pairs(properties) do
			object[key] = value
		end
		return object
	end

	-- Same layout as watermark/keybinds: decal on the holder, panel on top (see-through).
	local card = make("Frame", {
		Parent = gui,
		AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 1),
		Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 1, -120),
		Size = UDim2.fromOffset(270, 92),
		BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40, 40, 40),
		BorderSizePixel = 0,
		Visible = false,
		ClipsDescendants = true,
	})
	make("UIStroke", { Parent = card, Color = Color3.new(0, 0, 0), LineJoinMode = Enum.LineJoinMode.Miter })
	-- Sized to the screen: full size on a monitor, smaller on tablets and phones so it never
	-- covers the middle of the screen, and lifted above the touch controls.
	local cardScale = make("UIScale", { Parent = card })
	local function fitCardToScreen()
		local viewport = workspace.CurrentCamera.ViewportSize
		local touch = Hooks.isMobile or (userInputService.TouchEnabled and not userInputService.MouseEnabled)
		cardScale.Scale = math.clamp(math.min(viewport.X / 1400, viewport.Y / 800), touch and 0.5 or 0.75, 1)
		if touch then
			card.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0)
			card.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, game:GetService("GuiService"):GetGuiInset().Y + 6)
		else
			card.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 1)
			card.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 1, -120)
		end
	end
	fitCardToScreen()
	library:connection(workspace.CurrentCamera:GetPropertyChangedSignal("ViewportSize"), fitCardToScreen)
	-- Full-bleed decal under the panel (same asset pipeline as menu / watermark / keybinds).
	local cardBackground = make("ImageLabel", {
		Parent = card,
		Name = "",
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		BorderSizePixel = 0,
		Position = UDim2.fromScale(0, 0),
		Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1),

		Image = "",
		ImageTransparency = 0.5,
		ZIndex = 1,
	})
	local accent = make("Frame", { Parent = card, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 2), BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 5 })
	local content = make("Frame", {
		Parent = card,
		Position = UDim2.fromOffset(3, 5),
		Size = UDim2.new(1, -6, 1, -8),

		BorderSizePixel = 0,

	make("UIStroke", { Parent = content, Color = Color3.fromRGB(57, 57, 57), LineJoinMode = Enum.LineJoinMode.Miter })
	table.insert(overlayPanels, { holder = card, image = cardBackground, dim = content })

	---Copy the menu background decal onto this card (same as watermark / keybinds).
	local function refreshCardBackground()
		local show = flags.theme_background_overlays ~= false
		local image, transparency, scale = "", 0.5, Enum.ScaleType.Crop
		if show and backgroundImage and backgroundImage.Image ~= "" then
			image = backgroundImage.Image
			transparency = backgroundImage.ImageTransparency
			scale = backgroundImage.ScaleType
		elseif show then
			local raw = flags.theme_background_image
			if raw ~= nil and tostring(raw) ~= "" then
				local id = tostring(raw):match("(%d+)") or tostring(raw)
				if id:find("%d") then
					image = "rbxassetid://" .. id
				end
			end
			transparency = tonumber(flags.theme_background_image_transparency) or 0.5
		end
		cardBackground.Image = image
		cardBackground.ImageTransparency = transparency
		cardBackground.ScaleType = scale
		local has = image ~= "" and show
		content.BackgroundTransparency = has and math.clamp(tonumber(flags.theme_panel_transparency) or 0.45, 0.2, 0.9) or 0
		card.BackgroundTransparency = has and math.clamp(tonumber(flags.theme_panel_transparency) or 0.45, 0.2, 0.9) or 0
	end
	Hooks.refreshTargetInfoBackground = refreshCardBackground
	-- Apply whatever is already set (config autoload / previous applyBackground).
	task.defer(refreshCardBackground)

	local avatar = make("ImageLabel", {
		Parent = content,
		Position = UDim2.fromOffset(6, 6),
		Size = UDim2.fromOffset(56, 56),
		BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(30, 30, 30),
		BorderSizePixel = 0,

		ZIndex = 2,
	})

	local cross = make("Frame", { Parent = avatar, Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Visible = false, ZIndex = 4 })
	local crossLines = {}
	for index = 1, 2 do
		crossLines[index] = make("Frame", {
			Parent = cross,
			AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
			Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5),
			Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 4),
			Rotation = index == 1 and 45 or -45,
			BorderSizePixel = 0,

		})
	end

	---Text line helper.
	local function line(y, size)
		return make("TextLabel", {
			Parent = content,
			Position = UDim2.fromOffset(70, y),
			Size = UDim2.new(1, -78, 0, size),

			TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,
			RichText = true,
			ZIndex = 2,
		})
	end

	local nameLabel = line(4, 14)
	local userLabel = line(18, 12)
	local healthBack = make("Frame", {
		Parent = content,
		Position = UDim2.fromOffset(70, 34),
		Size = UDim2.new(1, -78, 0, 6),
		BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(8, 8, 8),
		BorderSizePixel = 0,
	})
	local healthFill = make("Frame", { Parent = healthBack, Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), BorderSizePixel = 0 })
	local detailLabel = line(44, 12)
	local teamLabel = line(56, 12)
	-- Same font / size / stroke as the team line ("Criminals", "Inmates", etc.).
	local statusLabel = line(68, 12)

	local thumbnails = {}
	local shownPlayer = nil
	local deadUntil = 0

	---Headshot for a player (fetched once, in the background).
	local function setAvatar(player)
		local cached = thumbnails[player.UserId]
		if cached then
			avatar.Image = cached
			return
		end
		avatar.Image = ""
		task.spawn(function()
			local ok, image = pcall(playersService.GetUserThumbnailAsync, playersService, player.UserId,
				Enum.ThumbnailType.HeadShot, Enum.ThumbnailSize.Size100x100)
			if ok then
				thumbnails[player.UserId] = image
				if shownPlayer == player then
					avatar.Image = image
				end
			end
		end)
	end

	---Play the X over the avatar.
	local function playDeathCross(color)
		cross.Visible = true
		for _, crossLine in ipairs(crossLines) do
			crossLine.BackgroundColor3 = color
			crossLine.Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 4)
			tweenService:Create(crossLine, TweenInfo.new(0.25, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
				Size = UDim2.new(1.25, 0, 0, 4),
			}):Play()
		end
	end

	-- Lightning strike: a jagged bolt from the sky into the target, a flash and a blast.
	local function strikeLightning(position, color)
		local parts = {}
		local top = position + Vector3.new(math.random(-6, 6), 140, math.random(-6, 6))
		local previous = top
		for index = 1, 9 do
			local t = index / 9
			local point = top:Lerp(position, t)
			if index < 9 then
				point += Vector3.new(math.random() - 0.5, 0, math.random() - 0.5) * 9 * (1 + t * 0.5 * NEG_ONE)
			end
			local length = (point - previous).Magnitude
			local bolt = make("Part", {
				Anchored = true,
				CanCollide = false,
				CanQuery = false,
				CanTouch = false,
				CastShadow = false,
				Material = Enum.Material.Neon,
				Color = color:Lerp(Color3.new(1, 1, 1), 0.55),
				Size = Vector3.new(0.6, 0.6, length),
				CFrame = CFrame.lookAt((previous + point) / 2, point),
				Parent = workspace,
			})
			table.insert(parts, bolt)
			previous = point
		end

		local flash = make("Part", {
			Anchored = true,
			CanCollide = false,
			CanQuery = false,
			CanTouch = false,
			Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball,
			Material = Enum.Material.Neon,
			Color = color,
			Size = Vector3.one * 2,
			CFrame = CFrame.new(position),
			Transparency = 0.2,
			Parent = workspace,
		})
		table.insert(parts, flash)
		make("PointLight", { Parent = flash, Color = color, Range = 30, Brightness = 6, Shadows = false })

		-- Our own blast (visual only), not Roblox's Explosion.
		if Hooks.blast then
			Hooks.blast(position, color, 0.8)
		end

		local fade = TweenInfo.new(0.55, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
		tweenService:Create(flash, fade, { Size = Vector3.one * 16, Transparency = 1 }):Play()
		for _, part in ipairs(parts) do
			if part ~= flash then
				tweenService:Create(part, fade, { Transparency = 1 }):Play()
			end
		end
		task.delay(0.7, function()
			for _, part in ipairs(parts) do
				part:Destroy()
			end
		end)
	end

	-- Damage numbers: Fortnite-style yellow numbers in Burbank Black (Oswald without the font files).
	-- Hits that land while the last number is still on screen stack onto it (20, 40, 60); once it
	-- has faded, the next hit starts a fresh number.
	local fortniteFamily = FONT_FACES.Fortnite and FONT_FACES.Fortnite.Family or "rbxasset://fonts/families/Oswald.json"
	local DAMAGE_FONT = Font.new(fortniteFamily, Enum.FontWeight.Heavy)
	-- How long a number stays up after the last hit (fade included).
	local DAMAGE_HOLD, DAMAGE_FADE = 0.6, 0.4
	local damageStacks = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })

	-- Hit marker styles: font, color, outline, normal and big (40+) size, a prefix, and whether it
	-- pops in. Classic is the small plain "-17" kind.
	-- Aqua is soft lowercase "-17" with the logo beside it, a glow behind it and the water look.
	local DAMAGE_STYLES = {
		Aqua = {
			font = Font.new("rbxasset://fonts/families/GothamSSm.json", Enum.FontWeight.Medium),
			color = Color3.new(1, 1, 1), outline = Color3.fromRGB(60, 170, 255), stroke = 2.5, glow = 0.55,
			size = 22, big = 28, prefix = "-", pop = true, icon = "rbxassetid://126991906779623", water = true,
		},
		Fortnite = { font = DAMAGE_FONT, color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 221, 40), outline = Color3.fromRGB(40, 25, 0), stroke = 3.5, size = 38, big = 48, prefix = "", pop = true },
		Classic = { font = Font.fromEnum(Enum.Font.SourceSansBold), color = Color3.fromRGB(235, 225, 140), outline = Color3.new(0, 0, 0), stroke = 1, size = 16, big = 18, prefix = "-", pop = false },
		Minimal = { font = Font.fromEnum(Enum.Font.GothamMedium), color = Color3.new(1, 1, 1), outline = Color3.new(0, 0, 0), stroke = 1, size = 13, big = 15, prefix = "", pop = false },
		Crit = { font = Font.fromEnum(Enum.Font.GothamBlack), color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 70, 70), outline = Color3.fromRGB(50, 0, 0), stroke = 2.5, size = 30, big = 40, prefix = "", pop = true },
		Comic = { font = Font.fromEnum(Enum.Font.Cartoon), color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 150, 30), outline = Color3.new(0, 0, 0), stroke = 3, size = 34, big = 44, prefix = "", pop = true },
		Neon = { font = Font.fromEnum(Enum.Font.Arcade), color = Color3.fromRGB(80, 255, 220), outline = Color3.fromRGB(0, 60, 80), stroke = 2, size = 26, big = 32, prefix = "", pop = true },
	}

	---The number's fill and outline: the style's own colors, your picked color, or the theme
	---accent (outline a deep shade of the fill, like the Fortnite brown under yellow).
	local function damageColors(style)
		local mode = flags.damage_color_mode or "Style"
		if mode == "Style" or style.water then
			return { fill = style.color, outline = style.outline }
		end
		local fill = mode == "Theme" and getAccent() or (flags.damage_color and flags.damage_color.Color or style.color)
		return { fill = fill, outline = fill:Lerp(Color3.new(0, 0, 0), 0.82) }
	end

	-- Fortnite numbers: the number slams in big, settles, holds, then drops off to the side,
	-- shrinking and fading. Every hit while it's still on screen adds to it (15, 30, 45...) and
	-- pops it again from the top; once it has fallen away, the next hit starts over. Pixel-sized,
	-- so it reads the same up close and across the map. (Kept on the style table: this function is
	-- close to the local limit.)
	DAMAGE_STYLES.Fortnite.recent = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
	function DAMAGE_STYLES.Fortnite.spawn(head, hit)
		local style = DAMAGE_STYLES.Fortnite
		local now = os.clock()
		local recent = style.recent[head]
		if recent and recent.billboard.Parent then
			recent.total += hit
			recent.label.Text = tostring(recent.total)
			recent.label.TextSize = recent.total >= 40 and style.big or style.size
			-- Back where it started, fully visible, and pumped again (a smaller pop than the first).
			recent.started = now
			recent.popFrom = 0.75
			recent.billboard.SizeOffset = recent.startOffset
			recent.label.Rotation = NEG_ONE * 4
			recent.label.TextTransparency = 0
			recent.outline.Transparency = 0
			return
		end

		local billboard = make("BillboardGui", {
			Adornee = head,
			AlwaysOnTop = true,
			Size = UDim2.fromOffset(160, 70),
			StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, 0.9, 0),
			SizeOffset = Vector2.new(math.random() * 0.7 + NEG_ONE * 0.35, 0.45 + math.random() * 0.2),
			Parent = gui,
		})
		local colors = damageColors(style)
		local label = make("TextLabel", {
			Parent = billboard,
			Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1),
			BackgroundTransparency = 1,
			FontFace = style.font,
			Text = tostring(hit),
			TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1),
			TextSize = hit >= 40 and style.big or style.size,
			-- The slight forward lean of Fortnite's numbers.
			Rotation = NEG_ONE * 4,
		})
		local outline = make("UIStroke", {
			Parent = label,
			Color = colors.outline,
			Thickness = style.stroke,
			LineJoinMode = Enum.LineJoinMode.Round,
		})
		-- Bright on top, deeper at the bottom, like the real thing's gold.
		make("UIGradient", {
			Parent = label,
			Rotation = 90,
			Color = ColorSequence.new({
				ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, colors.fill:Lerp(Color3.new(1, 1, 1), 0.45)),
				ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, colors.fill),
				ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, colors.fill:Lerp(Color3.fromRGB(200, 90, 0), 0.35)),
			}),
		})
		local scale = make("UIScale", { Parent = label, Scale = 0.3 })
		-- Each new hit on it resets `started` (and `popFrom`), so the animation plays again from the top.
		local entry = {
			billboard = billboard, label = label, outline = outline, total = hit,
			started = now, popFrom = 0.3, startOffset = billboard.SizeOffset,
		}
		style.recent[head] = entry

		-- Pop, hold, then fall off to one side.
		local POP, HOLD, FALL = 0.16, 0.45, 0.5
		local side = math.random() < 0.5 and NEG_ONE or 1
		local startOffset = entry.startOffset
		local connection
		connection = runService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
			local time = os.clock() - entry.started
			if not billboard.Parent then
				connection:Disconnect()
				return
			end
			if time < POP then
				-- Overshoots to 1.3x, then settles.
				local t = time / POP
				local from = entry.popFrom
				scale.Scale = t < 0.6 and from + t / 0.6 * (1.3 + NEG_ONE * from) or 1.3 + NEG_ONE * (t + NEG_ONE * 0.6) / 0.4 * 0.3
			elseif time < POP + HOLD then
				scale.Scale = 1
			else
				local t = math.min((time + NEG_ONE * POP + NEG_ONE * HOLD) / FALL, 1)
				-- Drifts sideways and drops faster and faster, like it's falling.
				billboard.SizeOffset = startOffset + Vector2.new(side * 0.35 * t, NEG_ONE * 0.9 * t * t)
				scale.Scale = 1 + NEG_ONE * 0.45 * t
				label.Rotation = NEG_ONE * 4 + side * 10 * t
				local fade = math.clamp((t + NEG_ONE * 0.3) / 0.7, 0, 1)
				label.TextTransparency = fade
				outline.Transparency = fade
				if t >= 1 then
					connection:Disconnect()
					billboard:Destroy()
				end
			end
		end)
	end

	local function popDamage(head, amount)
		local now = os.clock()
		local hit = math.max(1, math.floor(amount + 0.5))
		local stack = damageStacks[head]
		local style = DAMAGE_STYLES[flags.damage_style or "Fortnite"] or DAMAGE_STYLES.Fortnite
		if style.spawn then
			return style.spawn(head, hit)
		end

		if not (stack and stack.billboard.Parent and stack.style == style and now - stack.lastHit < DAMAGE_HOLD + DAMAGE_FADE * 0.5) then
			local billboard = make("BillboardGui", {
				Adornee = head,
				AlwaysOnTop = true,
				Size = UDim2.fromOffset(180, 80),
				StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, 1.15, 0),
				SizeOffset = Vector2.new(math.random() * 0.5 - 0.25, 0.55),
				Parent = gui,
			})
			local label = make("TextLabel", {
				Parent = billboard,
				Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1),
				BackgroundTransparency = 1,
				FontFace = style.font,
				Text = "0",
				TextColor3 = style.color,
				TextSize = style.pop and 8 or style.size,
			})
			local outline = make("UIStroke", {
				Parent = label,
				Color = style.outline,
				Thickness = style.stroke,
				LineJoinMode = Enum.LineJoinMode.Round,
			})
			local icon = nil
			if style.icon then
				-- Number and logo side by side, centered together.
				make("UIListLayout", {
					Parent = billboard,
					FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal,
					HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Center,
					VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Center,
					Padding = UDim.new(0, 4),
				})
				label.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X
				label.Size = UDim2.fromScale(0, 1)
				icon = make("ImageLabel", {
					Parent = billboard,
					LayoutOrder = 1,
					Size = UDim2.fromOffset(style.size, style.size),
					BackgroundTransparency = 1,
					ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Fit,
					Image = style.icon,
				})
			end
			if style.water then
				-- The glow takes the theme color; the text gets the moving water.
				outline.Color = getAccent()
				local gradient = make("UIGradient", { Parent = label })
				Hooks.water.add(gradient, math.random() * 3)
			end
			stack = { billboard = billboard, label = label, outline = outline, icon = icon, total = 0, shown = 0, generation = 0, style = style }
			damageStacks[head] = stack

			-- Float up over the whole time it's on screen.
			tweenService:Create(billboard, TweenInfo.new(1.6, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
				SizeOffset = billboard.SizeOffset + Vector2.new(0, 1.3),
			}):Play()
		end

		stack.lastHit = now
		stack.generation += 1
		local generation = stack.generation
		local from, total = stack.shown, stack.total + hit
		stack.total = total

		-- Fully visible again and popped bigger for each hit.
		local label, outline = stack.label, stack.outline
		label.TextTransparency = 0
		outline.Transparency = style.glow or 0
		local colors = damageColors(style)
		label.TextColor3 = colors.fill
		if not style.water then
			outline.Color = colors.outline
		end
		if stack.icon then
			stack.icon.ImageTransparency = 0
		end
		local textSize = total >= 40 and style.big or style.size
		if style.pop then
			label.TextSize = textSize * 0.75
			tweenService:Create(label, TweenInfo.new(0.14, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
				TextSize = textSize,
			}):Play()
		else
			label.TextSize = textSize
		end

		-- Count up from what's showing to the new total.
		task.spawn(function()
			local start = os.clock()
			local duration = math.clamp(0.08 + (total - from) * 0.004, 0.1, 0.28)
			while stack.billboard.Parent and stack.generation == generation do
				local t = math.clamp((os.clock() - start) / duration, 0, 1)
				local eased = 1 + (1 - t) * (1 - t) * NEG_ONE
				stack.shown = math.floor(from + (total - from) * eased + 0.5)
				label.Text = style.prefix .. tostring(stack.shown)
				if t >= 1 then
					break
				end
				task.wait()
			end
		end)

		-- Fade and remove, unless another hit stacks on first.
		task.delay(DAMAGE_HOLD, function()
			if stack.generation ~= generation or not label.Parent then
				return
			end
			tweenService:Create(label, TweenInfo.new(DAMAGE_FADE), { TextTransparency = 1 }):Play()
			tweenService:Create(outline, TweenInfo.new(DAMAGE_FADE), { Transparency = 1 }):Play()
			if stack.icon then
				tweenService:Create(stack.icon, TweenInfo.new(DAMAGE_FADE), { ImageTransparency = 1 }):Play()
			end
		end)
		task.delay(DAMAGE_HOLD + DAMAGE_FADE + 0.05, function()
			if stack.generation == generation then
				stack.billboard:Destroy()
				if damageStacks[head] == stack then
					damageStacks[head] = nil
				end
			end
		end)
	end

	-- Blood Splatter: a burst of blood flying away from you out of their body, and a pool on
	-- the ground under them that fades out.
	local function splatterBlood(character)
		local torso = character:FindFirstChild("Torso") or character:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso") or character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		if not torso then
			return
		end

		local myRoot = localPlayer.Character and localPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		local away = myRoot and (torso.Position - myRoot.Position) or torso.CFrame.LookVector
		away = Vector3.new(away.X, 0, away.Z)
		away = away.Magnitude > 0.01 and away.Unit or Vector3.zAxis

		local holder = make("Part", {
			Anchored = true,
			CanCollide = false,
			CanQuery = false,
			CanTouch = false,
			Transparency = 1,
			Size = Vector3.one * 0.2,
			CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(torso.Position, torso.Position + away),
			Parent = workspace,
		})
		local burst = make("ParticleEmitter", {
			Parent = holder,
			Enabled = false,
			Texture = "rbxasset://textures/particles/smoke_main.dds",
			Color = (function()
				local blood = flags.blood_color and flags.blood_color.Color or Color3.fromRGB(150, 0, 0)
				return ColorSequence.new(blood, blood:Lerp(Color3.new(0, 0, 0), 0.5))
			end)(),
			LightInfluence = 1,
			EmissionDirection = Enum.NormalId.Front,
			SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(40, 40),
			Speed = NumberRange.new(8, 18),
			Acceleration = Vector3.new(0, -60, 0),
			Drag = 1.5,
			Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.35, 0.75),
			Size = NumberSequence.new({ NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.35), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0.12) }),
			Transparency = NumberSequence.new({ NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.8, 0.2), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1) }),
		})
		burst:Emit(24)
		task.delay(1.2, function()
			holder:Destroy()
		end)

		-- Floor pool disabled (particle-only CSGO style).
	end

	-- Hit log: "Hit name for 53 in the Head" lines stacked under the crosshair, newest at the
	-- bottom, in the menu's font, text color, accent and background image.
	local HIT_LOG_MAX = 8
	local PART_NAMES = { HumanoidRootPart = "Torso", UpperTorso = "Torso", LowerTorso = "Torso" }
	-- Anchored by its bottom just above the hotbar, so new lines push the stack upward.
	local hitLogHolder = make("Frame", {
		Parent = gui,
		AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 1),
		Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 1, -140),
		Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 0),
		AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.XY,
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
	})
	local hitLogLayout = make("UIListLayout", {
		Parent = hitLogHolder,
		HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Center,
		VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Bottom,
		SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder,
		Padding = UDim.new(0, 3),
	})

	-- Where the hit log sits (Kill & Hit Feedback > hit log position). The top corners leave room
	-- for the watermark (top left) and the kill feed (top right); lines line up with their side.
	local HIT_LOG_SPOTS = {
		Middle = { anchor = Vector2.new(0.5, 1), position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 1, -140), align = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Center },
		["Top Left"] = { anchor = Vector2.new(0, 0), position = UDim2.new(0, 20, 0, 70), align = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Left },
		["Top Right"] = { anchor = Vector2.new(1, 0), position = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0.38, 0), align = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Right },
		["Bottom Left"] = { anchor = Vector2.new(0, 1), position = UDim2.new(0, 20, 1, -140), align = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Left },
		["Bottom Right"] = { anchor = Vector2.new(1, 1), position = UDim2.new(1, -20, 1, -140), align = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Right },
	}
	local hitLogSpot = nil
	library:connection(runService.Heartbeat, function()
		local name = flags.hit_log_position or "Middle"
		if name == hitLogSpot then
			return
		end
		hitLogSpot = name
		local spot = HIT_LOG_SPOTS[name] or HIT_LOG_SPOTS.Middle
		hitLogHolder.AnchorPoint = spot.anchor
		hitLogHolder.Position = spot.position
		hitLogLayout.HorizontalAlignment = spot.align
	end)
	-- Phones: same spot, but smaller and fewer lines so it covers less of the target.
	if Hooks.isMobile then
		make("UIScale", { Parent = hitLogHolder, Scale = 0.6 })
		HIT_LOG_MAX = 3
	end
	local hitLogOrder = 0

	---Add one line to the hit log.
	local function pushHitLog(player, damage)
		hitLogOrder += 1
		local logColor = flags.hit_log_color_mode == "Custom" and flags.hit_log_color and flags.hit_log_color.Color or getAccent()
		local accent = logColor:ToHex()
		local partName = Hooks.lastHitName and Hooks.lastHitName[player] or "Torso"
		partName = PART_NAMES[partName] or partName

		local entry = make("Frame", {
			Parent = hitLogHolder,
			LayoutOrder = hitLogOrder,
			Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 20),
			AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X,
			BackgroundColor3 = DARK,
			BackgroundTransparency = 1,
			BorderSizePixel = 0,
			ClipsDescendants = true,
		})
		make("UIPadding", { Parent = entry, PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 7), PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 7) })
		local image = flags.theme_background_overlays ~= false and backgroundImage.Image or ""
		local backdrop = make("ImageLabel", {
			Parent = entry,
			Position = UDim2.fromOffset(-7, 0),
			Size = UDim2.new(1, 14, 1, 0),
			BackgroundTransparency = 1,
			ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Crop,
			Image = image,
			ImageTransparency = 1,
		})
		local label = make("TextLabel", {
			Parent = entry,
			Size = UDim2.fromScale(0, 1),
			AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X,
			BackgroundTransparency = 1,
			FontFace = currentFont,
			TextSize = 13,
			TextColor3 = getTextColor(),
			TextTransparency = 1,
			TextStrokeTransparency = 1,
			RichText = true,
			ZIndex = 2,
			Text = string.format('Hit <font color="#%s">%s</font> for <font color="#%s">%d</font> in the <font color="#%s">%s</font>',
				accent, player.DisplayName, accent, math.floor(damage + 0.5), accent, partName),
		})
		-- Timer bar along the bottom: starts full and runs down to nothing over the hit log time.
		local line = make("Frame", {
			Parent = entry,
			AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 1),
			Position = UDim2.new(0, -7, 1, 0),
			Size = UDim2.new(1, 14, 0, 2),
			BorderSizePixel = 0,
			BackgroundColor3 = logColor,
			BackgroundTransparency = 1,
			ZIndex = 3,
		})
		local scale = make("UIScale", { Parent = entry, Scale = 0.9 })

		-- Fade (and grow slightly) in. Hit log speed scales how fast it pops in and out.
		local speed = math.max(flags.hit_log_speed or 1, 0.05)
		local fadeIn = TweenInfo.new(0.22 / speed, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
		tweenService:Create(entry, fadeIn, { BackgroundTransparency = 0.25 }):Play()
		tweenService:Create(label, fadeIn, { TextTransparency = 0, TextStrokeTransparency = 0.5 }):Play()
		tweenService:Create(line, fadeIn, { BackgroundTransparency = 0 }):Play()
		tweenService:Create(scale, fadeIn, { Scale = 1 }):Play()
		if image ~= "" then
			tweenService:Create(backdrop, fadeIn, { ImageTransparency = math.max(backgroundImage.ImageTransparency, 0.4) }):Play()
		end
		local lifetime = flags.hit_log_time or 4
		tweenService:Create(line, TweenInfo.new(lifetime, Enum.EasingStyle.Linear), { Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 2) }):Play()

		-- Keep the newest few.
		local entries = {}
		for _, child in ipairs(hitLogHolder:GetChildren()) do
			if child:IsA("Frame") then
				table.insert(entries, child)
			end
		end
		table.sort(entries, function(a, b)
			return a.LayoutOrder < b.LayoutOrder
		end)
		for index = 1, #entries - HIT_LOG_MAX do
			entries[index]:Destroy()
		end

		-- Timer ran out: fade (and shrink slightly) away.
		task.delay(lifetime, function()
			if not entry.Parent then
				return
			end
			local fade = TweenInfo.new(0.35 / speed, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In)
			tweenService:Create(entry, fade, { BackgroundTransparency = 1 }):Play()
			tweenService:Create(label, fade, { TextTransparency = 1, TextStrokeTransparency = 1 }):Play()
			tweenService:Create(line, fade, { BackgroundTransparency = 1 }):Play()
			tweenService:Create(backdrop, fade, { ImageTransparency = 1 }):Play()
			tweenService:Create(scale, fade, { Scale = 0.9 }):Play()
			task.wait(0.4 / speed)
			entry:Destroy()
		end)
	end

	local lastHealth = {}

	local lastCardUpdate = 0
	library:connection(runService.RenderStepped, function()
		local now = os.clock()
		if Hooks.lowPower() and now - lastCardUpdate < 1 / 20 then
			return
		end
		lastCardUpdate = now
		local target = Hooks.lockedTarget
		local character = target and target.Parent
		local player = character and playersService:GetPlayerFromCharacter(character)
		local color = Hooks.lockedColor or Color3.fromRGB(140, 0, 0)

		-- Health tracking for the locked player and the one on the card (the lock moves to the
		-- next target the instant someone dies, so deaths are watched on the card's player).
		-- Plus anyone you've shot in the last 1.5s, so damage numbers show on every hit, not
		-- only on the locked target.
		local watchList = { player, shownPlayer }
		for hitPlayer, hitAt in pairs(Hooks.lastHit or {}) do
			if now - hitAt < 1.5 and hitPlayer ~= player and hitPlayer ~= shownPlayer then
				table.insert(watchList, hitPlayer)
			end
		end

		for _, watched in pairs(watchList) do
			local watchedCharacter = watched and watched.Character
			local humanoid = watchedCharacter and watchedCharacter:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
			if not watched or lastHealth[watched] == -1 then
				continue
			end

			local health = humanoid and humanoid.Health or 0
			local previous = lastHealth[watched]

			-- Damage numbers and blood when they lose health.
			if previous and health < previous - 0.5 and watchedCharacter then
				local head = watchedCharacter:FindFirstChild("Head")
				if head and health > 0 and flags.damage_numbers ~= false then
					popDamage(head, previous - health)
				end
				local shotAt = Hooks.lastHit and Hooks.lastHit[watched]
				if flags.blood_splatter ~= false and shotAt and now - shotAt < 1.5 then
					splatterBlood(watchedCharacter)
				end
				if flags.hit_logs ~= false and shotAt and now - shotAt < 1.5 then
					pushHitLog(watched, previous - math.max(health, 0))
				end
			end

			if previous and previous > 0 and health <= 0 then
				-- Died: the X on the card, then lightning if you shot them in the last 3s.
				lastHealth[watched] = -1
				if watched == shownPlayer then
					deadUntil = now + 1.2
					playDeathCross(getAccent())
					-- Force health bar + text to 0 the moment they die (don't freeze at last HP).
					healthFill.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 50, 50)
					healthFill.Size = UDim2.fromScale(0, 1)
					local held = watchedCharacter and watchedCharacter:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")
					detailLabel.Text = "0 hp  |  " .. (held and held.Name or "no weapon")
				end
				local shotAt = Hooks.lastHit and Hooks.lastHit[watched]
				local root = watchedCharacter and watchedCharacter:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
				if flags.kill_lightning ~= false and root and shotAt and now - shotAt < 3 then
					local mode = flags.kill_lightning_mode or "Target"
					if mode == "Custom" and flags.kill_lightning_color then
						strikeLightning(root.Position, flags.kill_lightning_color.Color)
					elseif mode == "Theme" then
						strikeLightning(root.Position, getAccent())
					else
						strikeLightning(root.Position, color)
					end
				end
			else
				lastHealth[watched] = health
			end
		end

		-- A respawned player starts being tracked again.
		for watched, value in pairs(lastHealth) do
			if value == -1 then
				local humanoid = watched.Character and watched.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
				if humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0 then
					lastHealth[watched] = nil
				end
			end
		end

		-- The card keeps showing a target that just died until the X has played.
		if now < deadUntil and shownPlayer then
			-- Keep HP locked at 0 while the death X is up.
			healthFill.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 50, 50)
			healthFill.Size = UDim2.fromScale(0, 1)
			if not string.match(detailLabel.Text, "^0 hp") then
				detailLabel.Text = "0 hp  |  no weapon"
			end
			refreshCardBackground()
			card.Visible = flags.target_info ~= false
			return
		end

		if not (player and flags.target_info ~= false) then
			card.Visible = false
			shownPlayer = nil
			statusLabel.Text = ""
			statusLabel.Visible = false
			return
		end

		if shownPlayer ~= player then
			shownPlayer = player
			cross.Visible = false
			setAvatar(player)
		end

		local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		local health = humanoid and math.max(humanoid.Health, 0) or 0
		local maxHealth = humanoid and math.max(humanoid.MaxHealth, 1) or 100
		local tool = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")
		local team = player.Team

		-- The card is part of the UI, so it follows the theme accent like every other panel.
		local themeAccent = getAccent()
		accent.BackgroundColor3 = themeAccent
		healthFill.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 50, 50):Lerp(Color3.fromRGB(60, 255, 120), health / maxHealth)
		healthFill.Size = UDim2.fromScale(math.clamp(health / maxHealth, 0, 1), 1)
		nameLabel.Text = string.format('<font color="#%s">%s</font>', themeAccent:ToHex(), player.DisplayName)
		userLabel.Text = "@" .. player.Name
		detailLabel.Text = string.format("%d hp  |  %s", math.floor(health + 0.5), tool and tool.Name or "no weapon")
		teamLabel.Text = string.format('<font color="#%s">%s</font>', team and team.TeamColor.Color:ToHex() or "aaaaaa", team and team.Name or "no team")

		-- Status follows team: Criminals = Hostile; Trespassing only while still Inmates.
		local tags = {}
		local teamName = team and team.Name
		if teamName == "Criminals" then
			table.insert(tags, '<font color="#ff5555">Hostile</font>')
		elseif teamName == "Inmates" then
			if character:GetAttribute("Hostile") == true then
				table.insert(tags, '<font color="#ff5555">Hostile</font>')
			end
			if character:GetAttribute("Trespassing") == true then
				table.insert(tags, '<font color="#e8b84a">Trespassing</font>')
			end
		end
		if Hooks.isDeveloper(player) and player ~= localPlayer then
			table.insert(tags, '<font color="#ff5a5a">AQUA LAB DEVELOPER</font>')
		elseif Hooks.isAquaLabsUser(player) then
			table.insert(tags, '<font color="#64ffc8">AQUA LAB USER</font>')
		end
		if #tags > 0 then
			statusLabel.Text = table.concat(tags, "  ·  ")
			statusLabel.Visible = true
		else
			statusLabel.Text = ""
			statusLabel.Visible = false
		end

		refreshCardBackground()
		card.Visible = true
	end)

	onUnload(function()
		gui:Destroy()
	end)
end

buildTargetEffects()

-- World extras: kill feed, X-ray and anti void.
local function buildWorldExtras()
	local replicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
	local tweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")

	-- Kill feed (CS:GO style, top right) ------------------------------------------------------
	local feedSection = Tabs.visuals:section({ name = "Csgo Kill Feed", side = "right" })
	addFeature(feedSection, { name = "Kill Feed", flag = "kill_feed", default = true, listActive = false })
	feedSection:slider({ name = "feed time", flag = "kill_feed_time", min = 2, max = 12, default = 6, interval = 0.5, suffix = "s" })

	-- CS:GO kill feed look: a heavy condensed font, CT blue / T gold names, and the dark red
	-- outline around kills you were part of.
	local CS_FONT = Font.new("rbxasset://fonts/families/Oswald.json", Enum.FontWeight.Bold)
	local CS_KILLER_BORDER = Color3.fromRGB(150, 22, 22)
	local CS_GUARDS = Color3.fromRGB(64, 150, 225)
	local CS_PRISONERS = Color3.fromRGB(234, 177, 68)
	local CS_CRIMINALS = Color3.fromRGB(230, 95, 70)
	local ICON_SHEET_CELL = Vector2.new(256, 128)

	local feedGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
	feedGui.Name = ""
	feedGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
	feedGui.DisplayOrder = 35
	feedGui:SetAttribute("AquaLabs", true)
	feedGui.Parent = coreGui

	local feedHolder = Instance.new("Frame")
	feedHolder.Name = ""
	feedHolder.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0)
	feedHolder.Position = UDim2.new(1, -16, 0, 14)
	feedHolder.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(460, 320)
	feedHolder.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	feedHolder.Parent = feedGui
	local feedLayout = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
	feedLayout.HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Right
	feedLayout.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
	feedLayout.Padding = UDim.new(0, 4)
	feedLayout.Parent = feedHolder

	local feedOrder = 0
	local reportedDeaths = {}

	-- Prison Life's own weapon icons: one white sprite sheet, each gun at an offset (read from
	-- the game's ToolProperties modules at game-script identity).
	local sheetIcons = {}
	do
		local properties = replicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("SharedModules")
		properties = properties and properties:FindFirstChild("ToolProperties")
		local previous = getthreadidentity and getthreadidentity() or 8
		if setthreadidentity then
			setthreadidentity(2)
		end
		for _, module in ipairs(properties and properties:GetChildren() or {}) do
			local ok, data = pcall(require, module)
			if ok and type(data) == "table" and type(data.Icon) == "string" and typeof(data.ImageRectOffset) == "Vector2" then
				sheetIcons[module.Name] = { image = data.Icon, offset = data.ImageRectOffset }
			end
		end
		if setthreadidentity then
			setthreadidentity(previous)
		end
	end

	---The weapon's tool model (guns and melees), for weapons without a sheet icon.
	local function weaponModel(weaponName)
		local tools = replicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Tools")
		if not tools then
			return nil
		end
		for _, folder in ipairs({ tools:FindFirstChild("Guns"), tools:FindFirstChild("Melees"), tools }) do
			local tool = folder and folder:FindFirstChild(weaponName)
			if tool and tool:IsA("Tool") then
				return tool
			end
		end
		return nil
	end

	---A CS:GO style white weapon icon: the game's sprite when it has one, otherwise the
	---weapon's own model rendered as a flat white silhouette.
	---@return GuiObject?
	local function weaponIcon(weaponName)
		local sheet = sheetIcons[weaponName]
		if sheet then
			local image = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
			image.Name = ""
			image.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(62, 30)
			image.BackgroundTransparency = 1
			image.Image = sheet.image
			image.ImageRectOffset = sheet.offset
			image.ImageRectSize = ICON_SHEET_CELL
			image.ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Fit
			return image
		end

		local tool = weaponModel(weaponName)
		if not tool then
			return nil
		end

		local viewport = Instance.new("ViewportFrame")
		viewport.Name = ""
		viewport.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(62, 30)
		viewport.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		-- Flat white: full ambient light, no directional shading.
		viewport.Ambient = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
		viewport.LightColor = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
		viewport.ImageColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)

		local model = Instance.new("Model")
		for _, part in ipairs(tool:GetDescendants()) do
			if part:IsA("BasePart") then
				local copy = part:Clone()
				for _, child in ipairs(copy:GetChildren()) do
					if not (child:IsA("SpecialMesh") or child:IsA("DataModelMesh")) then
						child:Destroy()
					end
				end
				copy.Color = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
				copy.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
				if copy:IsA("MeshPart") then
					copy.TextureID = ""
				end
				copy.Parent = model
			end
		end
		for _, mesh in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do
			if mesh:IsA("SpecialMesh") then
				mesh.TextureId = ""
			end
		end
		model.Parent = viewport

		-- Look at the weapon side-on: down its thinnest axis, with its middle axis as up, framed to
		-- fit its length. Picked with plain comparisons: the obfuscated build mangled the old
		-- table.sort, which put the camera inside the gun and drew garbage.
		local boxCFrame, size = model:GetBoundingBox()
		local sx, sy, sz = size.X, size.Y, size.Z
		local right, up, look = boxCFrame.RightVector, boxCFrame.UpVector, boxCFrame.LookVector
		local thinAxis, upAxis
		if sx <= sy and sx <= sz then
			thinAxis, upAxis = right, (sy <= sz) and up or look
		elseif sy <= sx and sy <= sz then
			thinAxis, upAxis = up, (sx <= sz) and right or look
		else
			thinAxis, upAxis = look, (sx <= sy) and right or up
		end
		local longest = math.max(sx, sy, sz)
		local camera = Instance.new("Camera")
		camera.FieldOfView = 20
		-- 1 / tan(10°) written out (the obfuscated build mangled the division).
		local INVERSE_TAN_10 = tonumber("5.671281819617709")
		local halfLongest = longest * 0.5
		local fit = halfLongest * INVERSE_TAN_10
		local distance = math.max(fit * 1.15, 2)
		camera.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(boxCFrame.Position + thinAxis * distance, boxCFrame.Position, upAxis)
		camera.Parent = viewport
		viewport.CurrentCamera = camera
		return viewport
	end

	---Name in a CS:GO team color (guards blue, prisoners gold, criminals red).
	local function teamName(name)
		local player
		for _, candidate in ipairs(playersService:GetPlayers()) do
			if candidate.Name == name or candidate.DisplayName == name then
				player = candidate
				break
			end
		end
		local team = player and player.Team and player.Team.Name
		local color = team == "Guards" and CS_GUARDS
			or team == "Inmates" and CS_PRISONERS
			or team == "Criminals" and CS_CRIMINALS
			or Color3.fromRGB(220, 220, 220)
		-- One table, not three return values (the obfuscated build mixes up multiple returns).
		return { name = name, color = color, player = player }
	end

	---Add one kill (or "oof") line.
	local function pushEntry(killer, weapon, victim)
		if flags.kill_feed == false then
			return
		end
		feedOrder += 1

		local killerName, killerColor, killerPlayer = "", nil, nil
		if killer then
			local killerInfo = teamName(killer)
			killerName, killerColor, killerPlayer = killerInfo.name, killerInfo.color, killerInfo.player
		end
		local victimInfo = teamName(victim)
		local victimName, victimColor, victimPlayer = victimInfo.name, victimInfo.color, victimInfo.player
		local myKill = killerPlayer == localPlayer
		local myDeath = victimPlayer == localPlayer

		-- CS:GO look: translucent black bar, red outline when it's your kill.
		local entry = Instance.new("Frame")
		entry.Name = ""
		entry.LayoutOrder = -feedOrder
		entry.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X
		entry.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 34)
		entry.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(8, 8, 8)
		entry.BackgroundTransparency = (myKill or myDeath) and 0.05 or 0.35
		entry.BorderSizePixel = 0
		entry.Parent = feedHolder
		Instance.new("UICorner", entry).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 7)
		local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
		stroke.Color = CS_KILLER_BORDER
		stroke.Thickness = 3
		stroke.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border
		stroke.Enabled = myKill or myDeath
		stroke.Parent = entry
		local padding = Instance.new("UIPadding")
		padding.PaddingLeft, padding.PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 14), UDim.new(0, 14)
		padding.Parent = entry
		local row = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
		row.FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal
		row.VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Center
		row.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
		row.Padding = UDim.new(0, 10)
		row.Parent = entry

		local function label(text, color, order)
			local object = Instance.new("TextLabel")
			object.Name = ""
			object.LayoutOrder = order
			object.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X
			object.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 30)
			object.BackgroundTransparency = 1
			object.FontFace = CS_FONT
			object.TextSize = 20
			object.TextColor3 = color
			object.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.65
			object.Text = text
			object.Parent = entry
			return object
		end

		-- The skull before the victim's name (your decal 99449406966944).
		local function skull(order)
			local image = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
			image.Name = ""
			image.LayoutOrder = order
			image.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(24, 24)
			image.BackgroundTransparency = 1
			image.ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Fit
			image.Image = "rbxassetid://90699903602644"
			image.Parent = entry
		end

		if killer then
			label(killerName, killerColor, 1)
			local icon = weapon and weaponIcon(weapon)
			if icon then
				icon.LayoutOrder = 2
				icon.Parent = entry
			else
				-- Fists and anything without a model: the weapon name in white caps.
				label(string.upper(weapon or "fists"), Color3.new(1, 1, 1), 2)
			end
			skull(3)
			label(victimName, victimColor, 4)
		else
			skull(1)
			label(victimName, victimColor, 2)
			label("oofed themselves", Color3.fromRGB(200, 200, 200), 3)
		end

		task.delay(flags.kill_feed_time or 6, function()
			if not entry.Parent then
				return
			end
			local fade = TweenInfo.new(0.35)
			for _, object in ipairs(entry:GetDescendants()) do
				if object:IsA("TextLabel") then
					tweenService:Create(object, fade, { TextTransparency = 1, TextStrokeTransparency = 1 }):Play()
				elseif object:IsA("ImageLabel") or object:IsA("ViewportFrame") then
					tweenService:Create(object, fade, { ImageTransparency = 1 }):Play()
				elseif object:IsA("UIStroke") then
					tweenService:Create(object, fade, { Transparency = 1 }):Play()
				end
			end
			tweenService:Create(entry, fade, { BackgroundTransparency = 1 }):Play()
			task.wait(0.4)
			entry:Destroy()
		end)

		-- Keep at most 7 lines, newest on top.
		local lines = {}
		for _, child in ipairs(feedHolder:GetChildren()) do
			if child:IsA("Frame") then
				table.insert(lines, child)
			end
		end
		table.sort(lines, function(a, b)
			return a.LayoutOrder > b.LayoutOrder
		end)
		for index = 1, #lines - 7 do
			lines[index]:Destroy()
		end
	end
	Hooks.pushKillFeed = pushEntry

	-- Kills come from the game's killfeed: "Display (@user) killed Victim with Weapon".
	local killfeed = replicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Killfeed")
	if killfeed then
		library:connection(killfeed.ChildAdded, function(item)
			local killerDisplay, killerUser, victim, weapon = item.Name:match("^(.-)%s*%(@(.-)%)%s*killed%s+(.-)%s+with%s+(.+)$")
			if not killerUser then
				return
			end
			reportedDeaths[string.lower(victim)] = os.clock()

			-- Your kill counter (shown in the watermark), counted this session.
			if killerUser == localPlayer.Name then
				Hooks.myKills = (Hooks.myKills or 0) + 1
				Hooks.lastKill = { name = (string.gsub(victim, "%s*%(@.-%)", "")), at = os.clock() }
			end

			pushEntry(killerDisplay ~= "" and killerDisplay or killerUser, weapon, victim)
			if flags.c4_deaths ~= false and string.find(string.lower(weapon), "c4", 1, true) then
				library:notification({
					text = (string.gsub(victim, "%s*%(@.-%)", "")) .. " died to C4 (" .. (killerDisplay ~= "" and killerDisplay or killerUser) .. ")",
					time = 4,
				})
			end
		end)
	end

	-- Deaths with no killer in the killfeed (resets, falls) show as "oofed themselves".
	local function watchDeaths(player)
		library:connection(player.CharacterAdded, function(character)
			local humanoid = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid", 10)
			if not humanoid then
				return
			end
			humanoid.Died:Connect(function()
				-- Where they died, before the body falls apart (for explosion deaths below).
				local root = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or character:FindFirstChild("Head")
				local where = root and root.Position
				local diedAt = os.clock()
				task.wait(0.8)
				local reported = reportedDeaths[string.lower(player.DisplayName)] or reportedDeaths[string.lower(player.Name)]
				if reported and os.clock() - reported < 2 then
					return
				end
				-- No killer in the game's feed, but an explosion went off on them: C4 or explosion.
				local blast = where and Hooks.explosionCause and Hooks.explosionCause(where, diedAt)
				if blast then
					-- "Planter [C4] Victim", like a normal kill.
					pushEntry(blast.owner or (blast.isC4 and "Someone" or "Explosion"), blast.isC4 and "C4 Explosive" or "Explosion", player.DisplayName)
					if flags.c4_deaths ~= false then
						library:notification({
							text = player.DisplayName .. " died to " .. (blast.isC4 and "C4" or "an explosion")
								.. (blast.owner and (" (" .. blast.owner .. ")") or ""),
							time = 4,
						})
					end
					return
				end
				pushEntry(nil, nil, player.DisplayName)
			end)
		end)
	end
	for _, player in ipairs(playersService:GetPlayers()) do
		watchDeaths(player)
	end
	library:connection(playersService.PlayerAdded, watchDeaths)

	-- X-ray -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	local worldSection = Tabs.world:section({ name = "X-Ray", side = "left" })
	addFeature(worldSection, { name = "X-Ray", flag = "xray_enabled" })
	worldSection:slider({ name = "x-ray see-through", flag = "xray_amount", min = 0.3, max = 0.95, default = 0.7, interval = 0.05 })

	local xrayParts = {}
	local xrayAdded = nil

	---Whether a part is map geometry (not a character, tool, or our own effects).
	local function isMapPart(part)
		if not part:IsA("BasePart") or part.Transparency >= 1 then
			return false
		end
		local model = part:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")
		return not (model and model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")) and not part:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Tool")
			and not part:IsDescendantOf(workspace.CurrentCamera)
	end

	local function applyXray(part)
		if isMapPart(part) then
			xrayParts[part] = true
			part.LocalTransparencyModifier = flags.xray_amount or 0.7
		end
	end

	local function setXray(enabled)
		if xrayAdded then
			xrayAdded:Disconnect()
			xrayAdded = nil
		end
		if enabled then
			for _, part in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
				applyXray(part)
			end
			xrayAdded = workspace.DescendantAdded:Connect(applyXray)
		else
			for part in pairs(xrayParts) do
				if part.Parent then
					part.LocalTransparencyModifier = 0
				end
			end
			table.clear(xrayParts)
		end
	end

	-- Re-run when toggled or when the amount changes.
	local lastAmount = nil
	library:connection(runService.Heartbeat, function()
		local wanted = flags.xray_enabled == true
		if wanted ~= (xrayAdded ~= nil) then
			setXray(wanted)
			lastAmount = flags.xray_amount
		elseif wanted and lastAmount ~= flags.xray_amount then
			lastAmount = flags.xray_amount
			for part in pairs(xrayParts) do
				if part.Parent then
					part.LocalTransparencyModifier = flags.xray_amount or 0.7
				end
			end
		end
	end)

	-- Anti void: only lowers destroy height so you can sit in the void (no bounce/TP).
	local voidSection = Tabs.world:section({ name = "Anti Void", side = "left" })
	addFeature(voidSection, { name = "Anti Void", flag = "anti_void" })
	local originalVoid = workspace.FallenPartsDestroyHeight

	library:connection(runService.Heartbeat, function()
		local enabled = flags.anti_void == true
		local wanted = enabled and -math.huge or originalVoid
		if workspace.FallenPartsDestroyHeight ~= wanted then
			pcall(function()
				workspace.FallenPartsDestroyHeight = wanted
			end)
		end
	end)

	onUnload(function()
		pcall(function()
			workspace.FallenPartsDestroyHeight = originalVoid
		end)
		setXray(false)
		feedGui:Destroy()
	end)
end

-- C4 ESP: planted C4 gets a highlight, a "C4" tag (who planted it, how far) and its blast radius;
-- planting sends an alert, and explosion deaths show in the kill feed. Placed C4 is made by the
-- server with the same mesh as the C4 tool, so that's how it's found. The blast radius is read from
-- the first C4 explosion seen and remembered in a file. (Called in place: the top level is at
-- Luau's 200-local limit.)
;(function()
	local section = Tabs.esp:section({ name = "C4 ESP", side = "right" })
	addFeature(section, { name = "C4 ESP", flag = "c4_esp", default = true, listActive = false })
	section:colorpicker({ flag = "c4_color", color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 60, 60) })
	section:toggle({ name = "blast radius", flag = "c4_radius", default = true })
	section:toggle({ name = "plant alerts", flag = "c4_alerts", default = true })
	section:toggle({ name = "explosion death alerts", flag = "c4_deaths", default = true })

	local replicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
	local tools = replicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Tools")
	local template = tools and tools:FindFirstChild("C4 Explosive")
	local templatePart = template and template:FindFirstChild("Explosive")
	local meshId = templatePart and templatePart:IsA("MeshPart") and templatePart.MeshId or nil
	local RADIUS_FILE = (library.directory or "Aqua Lab") .. "/c4_radius.txt"
	-- Until a C4 has been seen going off, the radius is a guess (shown as "~").
	local GUESS_RADIUS = 12
	local learnedRadius = nil
	pcall(function()
		if isfile(RADIUS_FILE) then
			learnedRadius = tonumber(readfile(RADIUS_FILE))
		end
	end)

	local folder = Instance.new("Folder")
	folder.Name = ""
	folder.Parent = workspace
	local guiFolder = Instance.new("Folder")
	guiFolder.Name = ""
	guiFolder.Parent = coreGui

	local planted = {}
	-- Shared so the radar can show planted C4 too.
	Hooks.plantedC4 = planted
	local recentBlasts = {}
	-- Blast zones, outside in: how far out each reaches (share of the radius) and its color.
	local BLAST_ZONES = {
		{ scale = 1, color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 225, 60), label = "low" },
		{ scale = 0.66, color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 140, 30), label = "medium" },
		{ scale = 0.33, color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 40, 40), label = "high" },
	}

	---Planted C4 only: the C4 mesh, not someone's tool, the map's giver or the game's preview copies.
	local function isPlantedC4(part)
		if not (meshId and part:IsA("MeshPart") and part.MeshId == meshId) then
			return false
		end
		if part.Name == "GhostC4" or part.Name == "ClientC4" or part:IsDescendantOf(folder) then
			return false
		end
		local items = workspace:FindFirstChild("Prison_ITEMS")
		if items and part:IsDescendantOf(items) then
			return false
		end
		return part:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Tool") == nil and part:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Backpack") == nil
	end

	-- When each player last had C4 in hand, sampled 10 times a second (for guessing who planted).
	local c4Held = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
	local c4SampledAt = 0
	library:connection(runService.Heartbeat, function()
		local now = os.clock()
		if now - c4SampledAt < 0.1 then
			return
		end
		c4SampledAt = now
		for _, player in ipairs(playersService:GetPlayers()) do
			if player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("C4 Explosive") then
				c4Held[player] = now
			end
		end
	end)

	---Who planted it: an owner tag on the C4 if the game gives one, otherwise the closest player
	---who just had C4 out (you can only place it up to 20 studs from yourself).
	local function findOwner(part)
		for _, value in pairs(part:GetAttributes()) do
			if typeof(value) == "Instance" and value:IsA("Player") then
				return value
			end
			local byId = type(value) == "number" and playersService:GetPlayerByUserId(value)
			if byId then
				return byId
			end
			local byName = type(value) == "string" and playersService:FindFirstChild(value)
			if byName and byName:IsA("Player") then
				return byName
			end
		end
		-- Only someone who had C4 out in the last 2 seconds can have planted it (planting your last
		-- one takes the tool away, so "had it" counts, not just "holding it now"). Of those, the
		-- closest one facing it. Only with no C4 holder around does plain distance decide.
		local now = os.clock()
		local best, bestScore = nil, math.huge
		local fallback, fallbackDistance = nil, 30
		for _, player in ipairs(playersService:GetPlayers()) do
			local character = player.Character
			local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			if root then
				local offset = part.Position - root.Position
				local distance = offset.Magnitude
				local hadC4 = character:FindFirstChild("C4 Explosive") ~= nil or now - (c4Held[player] or NEG_ONE * math.huge) < 2
				if hadC4 and distance < 25 then
					local flat = Vector3.new(offset.X, 0, offset.Z)
					local facing = flat.Magnitude > 0.01 and root.CFrame.LookVector:Dot(flat.Unit) > 0.3
					local score = facing and distance * 0.5 or distance
					if score < bestScore then
						best, bestScore = player, score
					end
				elseif distance < fallbackDistance then
					fallback, fallbackDistance = player, distance
				end
			end
		end
		return best or fallback
	end

	local function radius()
		return learnedRadius or GUESS_RADIUS
	end

	---Stop showing one C4 (it exploded or was picked up).
	local function untrack(part)
		local entry = planted[part]
		if not entry then
			return
		end
		planted[part] = nil
		entry.highlight:Destroy()
		entry.billboard:Destroy()
		for _, layer in ipairs(entry.layers) do
			layer.sphere:Destroy()
			layer.ring:Destroy()
		end
	end

	local function track(part)
		if planted[part] or not isPlantedC4(part) then
			return
		end
		local owner = findOwner(part)
		local color = flags.c4_color and flags.c4_color.Color or Color3.fromRGB(255, 60, 60)

		local highlight = Instance.new("Highlight")
		highlight.Adornee = part
		highlight.FillColor = color
		highlight.OutlineColor = color
		highlight.FillTransparency = 0.55
		highlight.OutlineTransparency = 0.1
		highlight.DepthMode = Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop
		highlight.Parent = guiFolder

		-- Styled like the player ESP's text: same font and size, plain text with a black stroke.
		local billboard = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
		billboard.Adornee = part
		billboard.AlwaysOnTop = true
		billboard.LightInfluence = 0
		billboard.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(200, 30)
		billboard.SizeOffset = Vector2.new(0, 0.5)
		billboard.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, 0.6, 0)
		billboard.Parent = guiFolder
		local layout = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
		layout.HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Center
		layout.VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Bottom
		layout.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
		layout.Parent = billboard
		local function line(order)
			local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
			label.LayoutOrder = order
			label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
			label.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 13)
			label.RichText = true
			label.TextStrokeTransparency = 0
			label.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
			label.Parent = billboard
			return label
		end
		local title = line(1)
		local info = line(2)

		-- Blast radius: nested see-through spheres and ground rings, yellow at the edge (least damage)
		-- through orange to red in the middle (most damage).
		local layers = {}
		for _, zone in ipairs(BLAST_ZONES) do
			local sphere = Instance.new("Part")
			sphere.Name = ""
			sphere.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
			sphere.Material = Enum.Material.ForceField
			sphere.Anchored, sphere.CanCollide, sphere.CanQuery, sphere.CanTouch, sphere.CastShadow = true, false, false, false, false
			sphere.Color = zone.color
			sphere.Parent = folder
			local ring = Instance.new("CylinderHandleAdornment")
			ring.Adornee = workspace.Terrain
			ring.Height = 0.1
			ring.Color3 = zone.color
			ring.Transparency = 0.3
			ring.Parent = guiFolder
			table.insert(layers, { zone = zone, sphere = sphere, ring = ring })
		end

		planted[part] = {
			part = part, owner = owner, color = color, highlight = highlight, billboard = billboard,
			info = info, title = title, layers = layers, at = os.clock(), lastPosition = part.Position,
		}

		if flags.c4_alerts ~= false and flags.c4_esp ~= false then
			library:notification({ text = (owner and owner.DisplayName or "Someone") .. " planted C4", time = 4 })
		end

		-- Gone without us seeing the explosion (it went off on the server): count it as one here.
		part.AncestryChanged:Connect(function()
			if part:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then
				return
			end
			local entry = planted[part]
			if entry then
				table.insert(recentBlasts, { position = entry.lastPosition, radius = radius(), at = os.clock(),
					owner = entry.owner and entry.owner.DisplayName, isC4 = true })
				untrack(part)
			end
		end)
	end

	-- Explosions: learn the C4's real radius, and remember every blast for death messages.
	library:connection(workspace.DescendantAdded, function(object)
		if object:IsA("Explosion") then
			task.defer(function()
				local position, blastRadius = object.Position, object.BlastRadius
				local nearest, nearestDistance = nil, 12
				for part, entry in pairs(planted) do
					local distance = (entry.lastPosition - position).Magnitude
					if distance < nearestDistance then
						nearest, nearestDistance = entry, distance
					end
				end
				-- The C4 part usually disappears a moment before this runs, so it was already logged as
				-- a C4 blast (with who planted it). Reuse that instead of adding a nameless "Explosion".
				local now = os.clock()
				for index = #recentBlasts, 1, -1 do
					local logged = recentBlasts[index]
					if logged.isC4 and now - logged.at < 1 and (logged.position - position).Magnitude < 12 then
						if blastRadius > 0 then
							logged.radius = blastRadius
							learnedRadius = blastRadius
							pcall(writefile, RADIUS_FILE, tostring(blastRadius))
						end
						return
					end
				end
				if nearest and blastRadius > 0 then
					learnedRadius = blastRadius
					pcall(writefile, RADIUS_FILE, tostring(blastRadius))
				end
				table.insert(recentBlasts, { position = position, radius = blastRadius, at = os.clock(),
					owner = nearest and nearest.owner and nearest.owner.DisplayName, isC4 = nearest ~= nil })
				if nearest then
					untrack(nearest.part)
				end
			end)
			return
		end
		if object:IsA("MeshPart") and object.MeshId == meshId then
			track(object)
		end
	end)
	for _, object in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
		if object:IsA("MeshPart") then
			track(object)
		end
	end

	---The explosion that killed someone who died at `where` at `diedAt`, if there was one.
	function Hooks.explosionCause(where, diedAt)
		-- A C4 blast (it knows who planted it) wins over a plain explosion at the same spot.
		local found = nil
		for index = #recentBlasts, 1, -1 do
			local blast = recentBlasts[index]
			local timing = math.abs(diedAt - blast.at)
			if timing < 1.5 and (blast.position - where).Magnitude <= blast.radius + 4 then
				if blast.isC4 then
					return blast
				end
				found = found or blast
			end
		end
		return found
	end

	-- Labels, radius and colors, 10 times a second.
	local updatedAt = 0
	library:connection(runService.Heartbeat, function()
		local now = os.clock()
		if now - updatedAt < 0.1 then
			return
		end
		updatedAt = now
		for index = #recentBlasts, 1, -1 do
			if now - recentBlasts[index].at > 5 then
				table.remove(recentBlasts, index)
			end
		end

		local show = flags.c4_esp ~= false
		local showRadius = show and flags.c4_radius ~= false
		local color = flags.c4_color and flags.c4_color.Color or Color3.fromRGB(255, 60, 60)
		local myRoot = localPlayer.Character and localPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		local size = radius()
		for part, entry in pairs(planted) do
			if not part.Parent then
				continue
			end
			entry.lastPosition = part.Position
			entry.highlight.Enabled = show
			entry.billboard.Enabled = show
			entry.highlight.FillColor = color

			local distance = myRoot and (myRoot.Position - part.Position).Magnitude or math.huge
			-- The innermost zone you're standing in (nil when outside the blast).
			local zone = nil
			for _, candidate in ipairs(BLAST_ZONES) do
				if distance <= size * candidate.scale then
					zone = candidate
				end
			end
			-- Same font, size and separators as the player ESP tags.
			local font = FONT_FACES[flags.esp_font] or library.font
			local textSize = flags.esp_text_size or 12
			local stroke = flags.esp_text_outline ~= false and 0 or 1
			for _, label in ipairs({ entry.title, entry.info }) do
				label.FontFace = font
				label.TextStrokeTransparency = stroke
			end
			entry.title.TextSize = textSize + 1
			entry.title.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, textSize + 2)
			entry.info.TextSize = math.max(textSize - 1, 8)
			entry.info.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, textSize)

			local separator = '<font color="#8c8c8c"> · </font>'
			local title = string.format('<font color="#%s">C4</font>', color:ToHex())
			if zone then
				title ..= separator .. string.format('<font color="#%s">%s</font>', zone.color:ToHex(), string.upper(zone.label))
			end
			entry.title.Text = title
			local ownerName = entry.owner and entry.owner.DisplayName or "unknown"
			local meters = math.floor((distance == math.huge and 0 or distance) / 3.571)
			entry.info.Text = string.format('<font color="#c8c8c8">%s</font>%s<font color="#c8c8c8">%dm</font>', ownerName, separator, meters)

			local rotation = CFrame.new(part.Position) * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(90), 0, 0)
			for index, layer in ipairs(entry.layers) do
				local layerRadius = size * layer.zone.scale
				-- Inner zones a little more solid so the red core stands out through the yellow.
				local transparency = 0.82 + (index - 1) * 0.06 * NEG_ONE
				layer.sphere.Transparency = showRadius and (zone and transparency + 0.12 * NEG_ONE or transparency) or 1
				layer.sphere.Size = Vector3.one * layerRadius * 2
				layer.sphere.CFrame = CFrame.new(part.Position)
				layer.ring.Visible = showRadius
				layer.ring.Radius = layerRadius
				layer.ring.InnerRadius = math.max(layerRadius + 0.35 * NEG_ONE, 0)
				layer.ring.CFrame = rotation
			end
		end
	end)

	onUnload(function()
		for part in pairs(planted) do
			untrack(part)
		end
		folder:Destroy()
		guiFolder:Destroy()
	end)
end)()

buildWorldExtras()

-- Players tab: everyone in the server with their avatar. Clicking one opens a profile panel
-- beside the menu with a live 3D view of them, their stats, backpack and quick actions.
local function buildPlayerProfiles()
	-- The library's own player list is replaced by this one.

	orbitSection:slider({ name = "orbit speed", flag = "tools_orbit_speed", min = 0.5, max = 60, default = 3, interval = 0.5, suffix = " rps" })
	orbitSection:slider({ name = "random tp spread", flag = "tools_orbit_spread", min = 2, max = 30, default = 8, interval = 0.5, suffix = " studs" })
	orbitSection:slider({ name = "random tp delay", flag = "tools_orbit_tp_delay", min = 0, max = 0.25, default = 0, interval = 0.01, suffix = "s" })
	orbitSection:toggle({ name = "only orbit unforcefielded", flag = "tools_orbit_unff_only", default = false })

	local EDGE = Color3.fromRGB(57, 57, 57)

	local selected = nil

	---Instance helper.
	local function make(className, properties)
		local object = Instance.new(className)
		for key, value in pairs(properties) do
			object[key] = value
		end
		return object
	end

	---Text in the menu's font.
	local function text(parent, properties)
		local label = make("TextLabel", {
			Parent = parent,
			BackgroundTransparency = 1,
			FontFace = library.font,
			TextSize = 12,
			TextColor3 = getTextColor(),
			TextStrokeTransparency = 0.5,
			TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
			TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,
		})
		for key, value in pairs(properties) do
			label[key] = value
		end
		return label
	end

	---Headshot for a user id, fetched once in the background.
	local function loadThumbnail(userId, image)
		if thumbnails[userId] then
			image.Image = thumbnails[userId]
			return
		end
		task.spawn(function()
			local ok, content = pcall(playersService.GetUserThumbnailAsync, playersService, userId,
				Enum.ThumbnailType.HeadShot, Enum.ThumbnailSize.Size48x48)
			if ok then
				thumbnails[userId] = content
				if image.Parent then
					image.Image = content
				end
			end
		end)
	end

	---"nov 2016" from Roblox's account API (the date the account was made), cached per user.
	local function joinDate(userId, onDone)
		if joinDates[userId] then
			return onDone(joinDates[userId])
		end
		task.spawn(function()
			local ok, response = pcall(request, { Url = "https://users.roblox.com/v1/users/" .. userId, Method = "GET" })
			local decoded = ok and response and response.Success and select(2, pcall(httpService.JSONDecode, httpService, response.Body))
			local created = type(decoded) == "table" and decoded.created
			local year, month = nil, nil
			if type(created) == "string" then
				year, month = created:match("^(%d+)%-(%d+)")
			end
			joinDates[userId] = (year and MONTHS[tonumber(month)]) and (MONTHS[tonumber(month)] .. " " .. year) or "unknown"
			onDone(joinDates[userId])
		end)
	end
