	make("UIPadding", {

	-- It sits beside the panel (not inside it) so it can't stretch the panel's auto size.

	table.insert(overlayPanels, { holder = panel, image = backdrop, dim = content })	make("UIStroke", { Parent = content, Color = EDGE, LineJoinMode = Enum.LineJoinMode.Miter })

			button.BackgroundColor3 = TILE

	end

	---Point the camera at a player (nil = back to yourself).
	local function setSpectate(player)
		spectating = player
		local character = (player or localPlayer).Character
		local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		if humanoid then
			workspace.CurrentCamera.CameraSubject = humanoid
		end
	end

	actionButton(1, "Teleport", function()
		local root = selected.Character and selected.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		local character = localPlayer.Character
		local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		if not (root and character) then
			return library:notification({ text = "They aren't spawned in." })
		end
		if humanoid and humanoid.Sit then
			humanoid.Sit = false
		end
		character:PivotTo(root.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0, 3))
	end)

	local spectateButton = actionButton(2, "Spectate", function()
		setSpectate(spectating ~= selected and selected or nil)
	end)

	local whitelistButton = actionButton(3, "Whitelist", function()
		-- Same list as Settings > Combat Filters > Whitelist Players.
		local list, found = {}, false
		local current = flags.global_whitelist
		for key, value in pairs(type(current) == "table" and current or {}) do
			local label = type(value) == "string" and value or (value == true and type(key) == "string" and key) or nil
			if label and label ~= "---" then
				if usernameFromLabel(label) == selected.Name then
					found = true
				else
					table.insert(list, label)
				end
			end
		end
		if not found then
			table.insert(list, playerLabel(selected))
		end
		local setter = library.config_flags.global_whitelist
		if setter then
			setter(list)
		end
		library:notification({ text = selected.DisplayName .. (found and " removed from whitelist" or " whitelisted"), time = 2 })
	end)

	actionButton(4, "Copy Username", function()
		setclipboard(selected.Name)
		library:notification({ text = "Copied " .. selected.Name, time = 2 })
	end)

	-- Loop Kill: melee kills them from under their feet while you're flipped invisible, waits out
	-- their respawn and forcefield, then does it again until stopped. It never changes your team
	-- (leaving Guards strands you on the menu). Kept on Hooks (this builder is near the local limit).
	Hooks.loopKill = { target = nil, token = 0 }
	local LoopKill = Hooks.loopKill

	---Whether this run is still the live one for its target.
	function LoopKill.active(token)
		return isCurrentRun() and LoopKill.token == token and LoopKill.target ~= nil and LoopKill.target.Parent ~= nil
	end

	---How high a standing rig's root sits above its feet.
	function LoopKill.standHeight(humanoid, root)
		local legs = humanoid.RigType == Enum.HumanoidRigType.R6 and 2 or humanoid.HipHeight
		return legs + root.Size.Y / 2
	end

	-- Lying flat face up, front flush with the floor right under their feet (not sunk deep).
	LoopKill.DEPTH = 0.5
	-- Punches sent per frame.
	LoopKill.SWINGS = 3
	-- Lying face up: look vector points at the sky.
	LoopKill.LAY = CFrame.Angles(math.pi / 2, 0, 0)

	---Lie down with collisions off so nothing pushes you out from under them. Invisible is paused
	---(it would sink you far under the map).
	function LoopKill.hide()
		if LoopKill.hidden then
			return
		end
		LoopKill.hidden = true
		LoopKill.wasInvisible = flags.invisible_enabled == true
		local setter = library.config_flags.invisible_enabled
		if LoopKill.wasInvisible and setter then
			setter(false)
		end
		Hooks.clearDesync()
		LoopKill.collisions = {}
		local character = localPlayer.Character
		for _, part in ipairs(character and character:GetDescendants() or {}) do
			if part:IsA("BasePart") then
				LoopKill.collisions[part] = part.CanCollide
				part.CanCollide = false
			end
		end
		local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		if humanoid then
			LoopKill.humanoid = humanoid
			humanoid.PlatformStand = true
		end
	end

	---Undo hide(): stand back up, collisions and Invisible come back.
	function LoopKill.unhide()
		if not LoopKill.hidden then
			return
		end
		LoopKill.hidden = false
		for _, connection in ipairs(LoopKill.connections or {}) do
			connection:Disconnect()
		end
		LoopKill.connections = nil
		if LoopKill.humanoid and LoopKill.humanoid.Parent then
			LoopKill.humanoid.PlatformStand = false
		end
		LoopKill.humanoid = nil
		local setter = library.config_flags.invisible_enabled
		if LoopKill.wasInvisible and setter then
			setter(true)
		end
		for part, canCollide in pairs(LoopKill.collisions or {}) do
			if part.Parent then
				part.CanCollide = canCollide
			end
		end
		LoopKill.collisions = nil
	end

	---One kill: lying flat under their feet (led by your ping so flyers / speeders can't outrun
	---you), re-placed before and after physics every frame, punching several times a frame.
	function LoopKill.killOnce(player, token)
		local character = player.Character
		local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		local target = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		if not (humanoid and target) or humanoid.Health <= 0 or character:FindFirstChildOfClass("ForceField") then
			return
		end
		local myCharacter = localPlayer.Character
		local myHumanoid = myCharacter and myCharacter:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		local myRoot = myCharacter and myCharacter:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		if not (myHumanoid and myRoot) or myHumanoid.Health <= 0 or myCharacter:FindFirstChildOfClass("ForceField") then
			return
		end

		local melee = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):FindFirstChild("meleeEvent")
		if not melee then
			return
		end
		local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
		LoopKill.hide()
		local floorParams = RaycastParams.new()
		floorParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
		floorParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = { character, myCharacter }

		---Put your root flat under where their feet will be by the time the server sees you.
		local function place()
			if not (target.Parent and myRoot.Parent) then
				return
			end
			-- Crouched / prone players keep the root at standing height while the body sits lower and
			-- further forward, so follow the torso then.
			local anchor = target.Position
			local torso = character:FindFirstChild("Torso") or character:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso")
			local head = character:FindFirstChild("Head")
			local crouched = torso and (torso.CFrame.UpVector.Y < 0.75 or (torso.Position - target.Position).Magnitude > 1
				or (head and head.Position.Y + NEG_ONE * target.Position.Y < 0.9))
			if crouched then
				anchor = torso.Position
			end
			-- Lead them by your ping so flying / speeding players are still on top of you server-side.
			local lead = math.clamp(localPlayer:GetNetworkPing(), 0, 0.3)
			anchor += target.AssemblyLinearVelocity * lead
			local floor = workspace:Raycast(Vector3.new(anchor.X, anchor.Y, anchor.Z), Vector3.new(0, tonumber("-12"), 0), floorParams)
			local feetY = floor and floor.Position.Y or anchor.Y + NEG_ONE * LoopKill.standHeight(humanoid, target)
			local _, yaw = target.CFrame:ToOrientation()
			myRoot.CFrame = CFrame.new(anchor.X, feetY + NEG_ONE * LoopKill.DEPTH, anchor.Z) * CFrame.Angles(0, yaw, 0) * LoopKill.LAY
			myRoot.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
			myRoot.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
		end
		-- Before physics, after physics and before render: no frame where you lag behind them.
		LoopKill.connections = {
			runService.Stepped:Connect(place),
			runService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
				place()
				if humanoid.Health > 0 then
					for _ = 1, LoopKill.SWINGS do
						melee:FireServer(player, 1, 1)
					end
				end
			end),
			runService.RenderStepped:Connect(place),
		}
		while LoopKill.active(token) and humanoid.Parent and humanoid.Health > 0 and myHumanoid.Health > 0 do
			camera.CameraSubject = humanoid
			runService.Heartbeat:Wait()
		end
		-- You stay where the kill happened (no teleport back), stood up on top of the floor.
		LoopKill.unhide()
		if myRoot.Parent then
			local _, yaw = myRoot.CFrame:ToOrientation()
			myRoot.CFrame = CFrame.new(myRoot.Position + Vector3.new(0, LoopKill.DEPTH + LoopKill.standHeight(myHumanoid, myRoot), 0)) * CFrame.Angles(0, yaw, 0)
			myRoot.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
		end
		local mine = localPlayer.Character and localPlayer.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		if mine then
			camera.CameraSubject = mine
		end
	end

	---Start (or retarget) the loop.
	function LoopKill.start(player)
		LoopKill.token += 1
		local token = LoopKill.token
		LoopKill.target = player
		task.spawn(function()
			while LoopKill.active(token) do
				local character = player.Character
				local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
				-- Guards can't hit guards, and swapping to Inmates isn't possible: once you leave Guards
				-- the menu calls the teams unbalanced and leaves you stuck on it. Wait until one of you
				-- changes team instead.
				local sameTeam = player.Team ~= nil and player.Team == localPlayer.Team and player.Team.Name == "Guards"
				LoopKill.waiting = sameTeam
				if not sameTeam and humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0 and not character:FindFirstChildOfClass("ForceField") then
					LoopKill.killOnce(player, token)
				end
				-- Back on them the frame their forcefield drops.
				runService.Heartbeat:Wait()
			end
			-- They left (not a manual stop): clean up the same way.
			if LoopKill.token == token then
				LoopKill.stop()
			end
		end)
	end

	---Stop the loop and show yourself again.
	function LoopKill.stop()
		LoopKill.token += 1
		LoopKill.target = nil
		LoopKill.waiting = false
		LoopKill.unhide()
		local mine = localPlayer.Character and localPlayer.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		if mine then
			workspace.CurrentCamera.CameraSubject = mine
		end
	end
	onUnload(LoopKill.stop)

	-- Toggle Loop Kill on them.
	---Developers can't be hit by the Players tab tools (unless you're one too).
	function Hooks.protectedDev(player)
		if Hooks.isDeveloper(player) and not Hooks.DEV_BUILD then
			library:notification({ text = "Can't target Developers", time = 2 })
			return true
		end
		return false
	end

	Hooks.loopKillButton = actionButton(10, "Loop Kill", function()
		if LoopKill.target ~= selected and Hooks.protectedDev(selected) then
			return
		end
		if LoopKill.target == selected then
			LoopKill.stop()
		else
			LoopKill.start(selected)
		end
	end)

	---Is Orbit currently circling this player?
	local function orbitingSelected()
		return flags.tools_orbit == true and Hooks.orbitTargetName == selected.Name
	end

	-- Orbit (Main > Orbit) around them, or stop.
	local orbitButton = actionButton(5, "Orbit", function()
		local setter = library.config_flags.tools_orbit
		if orbitingSelected() then
			Hooks.orbitTargetName = nil
			if setter then
				setter(false)
			end
		else
			Hooks.orbitTargetName = selected.Name
			if setter then
				setter(true)
			end
		end
	end)

	---Names in Target Filters > Priority Target Names.
	local function priorityNames()
		local names = {}
		for name in string.gmatch(flags.aim_priority_targets or "", "[^,%s]+") do
			table.insert(names, name)
		end
		return names
	end

	-- Priority target: every aim feature (and Ragebot) goes for them first.
	local priorityButton = actionButton(6, "Prioritize", function()
		local names, found = {}, false
		for _, name in ipairs(priorityNames()) do
			if string.lower(name) == string.lower(selected.Name) then
				found = true
			else
				table.insert(names, name)
			end
		end
		if not found then
			table.insert(names, selected.Name)
		end
		local setter = library.config_flags.aim_priority_targets
		if setter then
			setter(table.concat(names, ", "))
		else
			flags.aim_priority_targets = table.concat(names, ", ")
		end
		library:notification({ text = selected.DisplayName .. (found and " is no longer a priority" or " is now a priority target"), time = 2 })
	end)

	-- Declared up front: each button's click handler updates its own label, and a local isn't
	-- visible inside the function passed to its own `local x = ...` line.
	-- carFlingButton is Car Kick; expFlingButton is Car Fling (tracks flyers too).
	local carFlingButton, expFlingButton, isExploiterFlingingSelected, isCarFlingingSelected

	-- Car Kick: while they drive, sit in their car's passenger seat, play the
	-- flinging seat animation and die, which throws the car (and them). Repeats every respawn,
	-- putting you back where you started, until stopped or they leave.
	Hooks.carKick = Hooks.carKick or { target = nil, running = false }
	local carKick = Hooks.carKick
	carKick.ANIM_ID = "rbxassetid://148840371"
	carKick.ANIM_TIME = 0.19

	---Their car model and driver seat (nil when they aren't driving).
	function carKick.targetCar(player)
		local humanoid = player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		local seat = humanoid and humanoid.SeatPart
		if not (seat and seat:IsA("VehicleSeat")) then
			return nil
		end
		local model = seat:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")
		while model and model.Parent and model.Parent:IsA("Model") and model.Parent ~= workspace do
			model = model.Parent
		end
		return model and { model = model, seat = seat }
	end

	---A free seat in the car other than the driver's, plain seats first.
	function carKick.passengerSeat(car)
		local fallback = nil
		for _, item in ipairs(car.model:GetDescendants()) do
			if item ~= car.seat and item:IsA("Seat") and item.Occupant == nil and not item.Disabled then
				return item
			end
			if item ~= car.seat and item:IsA("VehicleSeat") and item.Occupant == nil and not item.Disabled then
				fallback = fallback or item
			end
		end
		return fallback
	end

	---One kick: get in their passenger seat, spin, die. True when it got that far.
	function carKick.once(target)
		local character = localPlayer.Character
		local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		if not (humanoid and root) or humanoid.Health <= 0 then
			return false
		end
		local car = carKick.targetCar(target)
		local seat = car and carKick.passengerSeat(car)
		if not seat then
			return false
		end

		local started = os.clock()
		while carKick.target == target and localPlayer.Character == character and humanoid.Health > 0
			and humanoid.SeatPart ~= seat and os.clock() - started < 3.2 do
			pcall(function()
				root.CFrame = seat.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 2, 0)
				seat:Sit(humanoid)
			end)
			task.wait()
		end
		if carKick.target ~= target or humanoid.SeatPart ~= seat then
			return false
		end

		local track = nil
		pcall(function()
			local animation = Instance.new("Animation")
			animation.AnimationId = carKick.ANIM_ID
			track = humanoid:LoadAnimation(animation)
			track.Looped = true
			track:Play()
		end)
		task.wait(carKick.ANIM_TIME)
		pcall(function()
			if track then
				track:Stop()
			end
			humanoid.Health = 0
			character:BreakJoints()
		end)
		return true
	end

	---Stop kicking.
	function carKick.stop()
		carKick.target = nil
		if carKick.respawn then
			carKick.respawn:Disconnect()
			carKick.respawn = nil
		end
	end

	---Start kicking `target` (replaces anyone already being kicked).
	function carKick.start(target)
		carKick.stop()
		local root = localPlayer.Character and localPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		carKick.home = root and root.CFrame
		carKick.target = target

		-- Back to where you started for a moment after each respawn.
		carKick.respawn = localPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(character)
			if carKick.target ~= target or not carKick.home then
				return
			end
			local newRoot = character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart", 8)
			local newHumanoid = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid", 8)
			if not (newRoot and newHumanoid) then
				return
			end
			local started = os.clock()
			while carKick.target == target and os.clock() - started < 1.6 and newHumanoid.Health > 0 do
				newRoot.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
				newRoot.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
				newRoot.CFrame = carKick.home
				task.wait()
			end
		end)

		task.spawn(function()
			local landed = false
			while carKick.target == target and target.Parent == playersService and isCurrentRun() do
				local character = localPlayer.Character
				local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
				if humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0 and not carKick.running then
					carKick.running = true
					local ok, kicked = pcall(carKick.once, target)
					carKick.running = false
					if ok and kicked then
						landed = true
						repeat
							task.wait(0.06)
						until carKick.target ~= target or localPlayer.Character ~= character
					end
				end
				task.wait(0.12)
			end
			if carKick.target == target then
				-- They left the server after at least one kick landed.
				if landed and target.Parent ~= playersService then
					library:notification({ text = "Successfully kicked " .. target.DisplayName, time = 4 })
				end
				carKick.stop()
			end
		end)
	end
	onUnload(carKick.stop)

	function isCarFlingingSelected()
		return selected ~= nil and carKick.target == selected
	end

	carFlingButton = actionButton(8, "Carkick", function()
		if not selected then
			return
		end
		-- Premium only (stopping one that's running is always allowed).
		if carKick.target ~= selected and not Hooks.isPremium() then
			return library:notification({ text = "That's a Premium feature.", time = 3 })
		end
		if carKick.target ~= selected and Hooks.protectedDev(selected) then
			return
		end
		if carKick.target == selected then
			carKick.stop()
			library:notification({ text = "Stopped carkick on " .. selected.DisplayName, time = 2 })
		else
			carKick.start(selected)
			library:notification({ text = "Carkicking " .. selected.DisplayName .. " (works while they drive)", time = 2 })
		end
		carFlingButton.Text = isCarFlingingSelected() and "Stop Kick" or "Carkick"
	end)

	function isExploiterFlingingSelected()
		return selected and Hooks.persistentExploiterFling and Hooks.persistentExploiterFling[selected.UserId] == true
	end

	expFlingButton = actionButton(7, "Carfling", function()
		if not selected then
			return
		end
		local uid = selected.UserId
		if not (Hooks.persistentExploiterFling and Hooks.persistentExploiterFling[uid]) and Hooks.protectedDev(selected) then
			return
		end
		Hooks.persistentExploiterFling = Hooks.persistentExploiterFling or {}
		Hooks.persistentCarFling = Hooks.persistentCarFling or {}
		if Hooks.persistentExploiterFling[uid] then
			Hooks.persistentExploiterFling[uid] = nil
			local stillAny = false
			for _ in pairs(Hooks.persistentCarFling) do
				stillAny = true
				break
			end
			if not stillAny then
				for _ in pairs(Hooks.persistentExploiterFling) do
					stillAny = true
					break
				end
			end
			if not stillAny then
				local mainSetter = library.config_flags.tools_car_fling
				if mainSetter then
					mainSetter(false)
				else
					flags.tools_car_fling = false
				end
			end
			library:notification({ text = "Stopped carfling on " .. selected.DisplayName, time = 2 })
		else
			Hooks.persistentCarFling[uid] = nil
			Hooks.persistentExploiterFling[uid] = true
			local spawnSetter = library.config_flags.tools_car_fling_spawn
			if spawnSetter then
				spawnSetter(true)
			else
				flags.tools_car_fling_spawn = true
			end
			local mainSetter = library.config_flags.tools_car_fling
			if mainSetter then
				mainSetter(true)
			else
				flags.tools_car_fling = true
			end
			if Hooks.ensureCarFlingCar then
				Hooks.ensureCarFlingCar()
			end
			library:notification({ text = "Carflinging " .. selected.DisplayName .. " (persists through reset)", time = 2 })
		end
		expFlingButton.Text = isExploiterFlingingSelected() and "Stop Fling" or "Carfling"
	end)

	Hooks.carToss = Hooks.carToss or { target = nil }
	local carToss = Hooks.carToss
	carToss.PAD = Vector3.new(586, 98, 2495)

	function carToss.active(target, token)
		return carToss.target == target and carToss.token == token and target.Parent == playersService and isCurrentRun()
	end

	function carToss.spawners()
		local items = workspace:FindFirstChild("Prison_ITEMS")
		local buttons = items and items:FindFirstChild("buttons")
		local children = buttons and buttons:GetChildren() or {}
		local first = children[4] and children[4]:FindFirstChild("Car Spawner")
		local second = children[5] and children[5]:FindFirstChild("Car Spawner")
		if first then
			return { first, second }
		end
		local list = {}
		for _, child in ipairs(children) do
			local spawner = child:FindFirstChild("Car Spawner")
			if spawner and spawner:IsA("BasePart") then
				table.insert(list, spawner)
			end
		end
		table.sort(list, function(a, b)
			return (a.Position - carToss.PAD).Magnitude < (b.Position - carToss.PAD).Magnitude
		end)
		return { list[1], list[2] }
	end

	function carToss.ensureTeam(target, token)
		local remotes = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):FindFirstChild("Remotes")
		local remote = remotes and remotes:FindFirstChild("RequestTeamChange")
		local teams = game:GetService("Teams")
		local function playable()
			local name = localPlayer.Team and localPlayer.Team.Name
			return name == "Inmates" or name == "Guards"
		end
		if playable() or not remote then
			return
		end
		if localPlayer.Team and localPlayer.Team.Name == "Criminals" and teams:FindFirstChild("Neutral") then
			pcall(remote.InvokeServer, remote, teams.Neutral, 1)
		end
		local started = os.clock()
		while carToss.active(target, token) and not playable() and os.clock() - started < 12 do
			pcall(remote.InvokeServer, remote, teams:FindFirstChild("Inmates"), 1)
			task.wait(0.5)
		end
		local character = localPlayer.Character or localPlayer.CharacterAdded:Wait()
		character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart", 8)
		task.wait(0.5)
	end

	function carToss.newSquads(container, before)
		local found = {}
		for _, car in ipairs(container:GetChildren()) do
			if car.Name == "Squad" and not before[car] then
				table.insert(found, car)
			end
		end
		return found
	end

	function carToss.owned(part)
		if typeof(isnetworkowner) ~= "function" then
			return true
		end
		local started = os.clock()
		while os.clock() - started < 3 do
			local ok, owned = pcall(isnetworkowner, part)
			if ok and owned then
				return true
			end
			task.wait()
		end
		return false
	end

	function carToss.fling(car, target, token)
		local body = car:FindFirstChild("Body")
		local seat = body and body:FindFirstChild("VehicleSeat")
		if not seat then
			return
		end
		local parts = {}
		for _, part in ipairs(body:GetDescendants()) do
			if part:IsA("BasePart") then
				table.insert(parts, part)
			end
		end
		if not carToss.owned(seat) then
			return
		end

		local hasHandle = typeof(InstanceHandle) == "table" or typeof(InstanceHandle) == "function"
		local started = os.clock()
		while carToss.active(target, token) and car.Parent and seat.Parent and os.clock() - started < 4 do
			local character = target.Character
			local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
			local head = character and character:FindFirstChild("Head")
			local targetRoot = humanoid and (humanoid.RootPart or character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart"))
			if head and targetRoot then
				pcall(sethiddenproperty, localPlayer, "SimulationRadius", 1e9)
				pcall(sethiddenproperty, localPlayer, "MaximumSimulationRadius", 1e9)
				pcall(setsimulationradius, 1e9, 1e9)
				pcall(sethiddenproperty, seat, "PhysicsRepRootPart", targetRoot)
				if hasHandle then
					pcall(sethiddenproperty, seat, "PhysicsRepRootRef", InstanceHandle.new(targetRoot))
				end
				pcall(function()
					seat.CFrame = head.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, NEG_ONE * 1.5, 0.5)
				end)
				for _, part in ipairs(parts) do
					if part.Parent then
						pcall(function()
							part.Velocity = Vector3.new(10000, 10000, 10000)
						end)
					end
				end
			end
			runService.Heartbeat:Wait()
		end
	end

	function carToss.stop()
		carToss.target = nil
		carToss.token = nil
	end

	function carToss.start(target)
		local token = {}
		carToss.target, carToss.token = target, token
		task.spawn(function()
			local garage = CFrame.new(589, 98, 2494)

			while carToss.active(target, token) do
				carToss.ensureTeam(target, token)
				local container = workspace:FindFirstChild("CarContainer")
				local remotes = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):FindFirstChild("Remotes")
				local interact = remotes and remotes:FindFirstChild("InteractWithItem")
				local spawners = carToss.spawners()
				local root = localPlayer.Character and localPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
				if not (container and interact and spawners[1]) then
					library:notification({ text = "Carkick 2: no car spawner found.", time = 3 })
					break
				end
				if not root then
					task.wait(0.5)
					continue
				end

				local before = {}
				for _, car in ipairs(container:GetChildren()) do
					if car.Name == "Squad" then
						before[car] = true
					end
				end

				Hooks.grabbing = true
				Hooks.clearDesync()
				-- Huge simulation radius up front, so the new car is yours the moment it spawns.
				pcall(sethiddenproperty, localPlayer, "SimulationRadius", 1e9)
				pcall(sethiddenproperty, localPlayer, "MaximumSimulationRadius", 1e9)
				pcall(setsimulationradius, 1e9, 1e9)

				-- Every new squad car is flung the instant it appears, each on its own thread.
				local flinging = {}
				local function onCar(car)
					if car.Name ~= "Squad" or before[car] or flinging[car] then
						return
					end
					flinging[car] = true
					task.spawn(function()
						car:WaitForChild("Body", 2)
						pcall(carToss.fling, car, target, token)
						flinging[car] = "done"
					end)
				end
				local carAdded = container.ChildAdded:Connect(onCar)

				-- Instant hops instead of tweens: stand on the spawner, send both spawn requests at once
				-- and wait for the server to answer (so it ran them while you were there), then hop to
				-- the garage pad and watch for the car.
				local started = os.clock()
				while carToss.active(target, token) and root.Parent and next(flinging) == nil and os.clock() - started < 15 do
					root.CFrame = spawners[1].CFrame
					root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
					runService.Heartbeat:Wait()
					runService.Heartbeat:Wait()
					local pending = 0
					for _, spawner in ipairs(spawners) do
						pending += 1
						task.spawn(function()
							pcall(interact.InvokeServer, interact, spawner)
							pending -= 1
						end)
					end
					local asked = os.clock()
					while pending > 0 and os.clock() - asked < 1.5 do
						runService.Heartbeat:Wait()
					end
					root.CFrame = garage
					root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
					local waitedFrom = os.clock()
					while next(flinging) == nil and os.clock() - waitedFrom < 0.6 and carToss.active(target, token) do
						for _, car in ipairs(carToss.newSquads(container, before)) do
							onCar(car)
						end
						runService.Heartbeat:Wait()
					end
				end
				Hooks.grabbing = false

				-- Let the flings run (each stops on its own after a few seconds or once they're gone).
				while carToss.active(target, token) do
					local running = false
					for _, state in pairs(flinging) do
						if state ~= "done" then
							running = true
						end
					end
					if not running then
						break
					end
					runService.Heartbeat:Wait()
				end
				carAdded:Disconnect()
				if next(flinging) == nil then
					task.wait(0.3)
				end
			end

			Hooks.grabbing = false
			if carToss.token == token then
				if target.Parent ~= playersService then
					library:notification({ text = "Successfully kicked " .. target.DisplayName, time = 4 })
				end
				carToss.stop()
			end
		end)
	end
	onUnload(carToss.stop)

	local carToss2Button
	carToss2Button = actionButton(9, "Carkick 2", function()
		if carToss.target ~= selected and not Hooks.isPremium() then
			return library:notification({ text = "That's a Premium feature.", time = 3 })
		end
		if carToss.target ~= selected and Hooks.protectedDev(selected) then
			return
		end
		if carToss.target == selected then
			carToss.stop()
			library:notification({ text = "Stopped carkick 2 on " .. selected.DisplayName, time = 2 })
		else
			carToss.start(selected)
			library:notification({ text = "Carkick 2 on " .. selected.DisplayName, time = 2 })
		end
		carToss2Button.Text = carToss.target == selected and "Stop Kick 2" or "Carkick 2"
	end)
	Hooks.carToss2Button = carToss2Button
	Hooks.premiumButton(carFlingButton, "Carkick")
	Hooks.premiumButton(carToss2Button, "Carkick 2")

	-- The grid holds 8 buttons in 4 full rows; the odd one out gets its own full-width row below,
	-- instead of sitting alone in half a row.
	local wideRow = make("Frame", { Parent = content, LayoutOrder = 7, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 24), BackgroundTransparency = 1 })
	carToss2Button.Parent = wideRow
	carToss2Button.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	actions.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 4 * 24 + 3 * 6)
	-- Loop Kill gets its own full-width row under Carkick 2.
	local loopKillRow = make("Frame", { Parent = content, LayoutOrder = 8, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 24), BackgroundTransparency = 1 })
	Hooks.loopKillButton.Parent = loopKillRow
	Hooks.loopKillButton.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	-- Phantom (Main > Orbit > Phantom) on them, full width under Loop Kill.
	Hooks.phantomButton = actionButton(11, "Phantom", function()
		if not Hooks.phantom then
			return
		end
		if Hooks.phantom.target ~= selected and Hooks.protectedDev(selected) then
			return
		end
		Hooks.phantom.startOn(selected)
	end)
	Hooks.phantomRow = make("Frame", { Parent = content, LayoutOrder = 9, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 24), BackgroundTransparency = 1 })
	Hooks.phantomButton.Parent = Hooks.phantomRow
	Hooks.phantomButton.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)

	closeButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
		selected = nil
	end)

	-- 3D view state: the copy, its parts paired with the real ones, and the orbit angle.
	local view = { character = nil, model = nil, pairs = {}, dirty = false, angle = 0, dragging = false, lastMouse = nil, connections = {} }

	---Throw away the current copy.
	local function clearView()
		if view.model then
			view.model:Destroy()
		end
		for _, connection in ipairs(view.connections) do
			connection:Disconnect()
		end
		table.clear(view.connections)
		view.model, view.character = nil, nil
		table.clear(view.pairs)
	end

	---Copy a character into the viewport, pairing every part with the one it copies.
	local function buildView(character)
		clearView()
		view.character = character
		view.dirty = false

		-- Tag the real parts (only on your side) so each copy can find its original.
		local originals = {}
		for _, part in ipairs(character:GetDescendants()) do
			if part:IsA("BasePart") then
				table.insert(originals, part)
				part:SetAttribute("AquaView", #originals)
			end
		end

		local archivable = character.Archivable
		character.Archivable = true
		local ok, copy = pcall(character.Clone, character)
		character.Archivable = archivable
		for _, part in ipairs(originals) do
			part:SetAttribute("AquaView", nil)
		end
		if not (ok and copy) then
			return
		end

		for _, object in ipairs(copy:GetDescendants()) do
			if object:IsA("BaseScript") or object:IsA("Sound") or object:IsA("ForceField")
				or object:IsA("ParticleEmitter") or object:IsA("JointInstance") or object:IsA("Constraint") then
				object:Destroy()
			elseif object:IsA("BasePart") then
				local index = object:GetAttribute("AquaView")
				object:SetAttribute("AquaView", nil)
				object.Anchored = true
				if object.Name == "HumanoidRootPart" then
					object.Transparency = 1
				end
				if index and originals[index] then
					table.insert(view.pairs, { originals[index], object })
				end
			elseif object:IsA("Humanoid") then
				object.DisplayDistanceType = Enum.HumanoidDisplayDistanceType.None
			end
		end
		copy.Parent = viewport
		view.model = copy

		-- Rebuild when they pick up, drop or swap a tool (or put on a hat).
		local function markDirty()
			view.dirty = true
		end
		table.insert(view.connections, character.ChildAdded:Connect(markDirty))
		table.insert(view.connections, character.ChildRemoved:Connect(markDirty))
	end

	-- Drag inside the 3D view to spin around them.
	viewport.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
		if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
			view.dragging = true
			view.lastMouse = input.Position
		end
	end)
	library:connection(userInputService.InputChanged, function(input)
		if view.dragging and (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
			local delta = input.Position - (view.lastMouse or input.Position)
			view.lastMouse = input.Position
			view.angle -= delta.X * 0.012
		end
	end)
	library:connection(userInputService.InputEnded, function(input)
		if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
			view.dragging = false
		end
	end)

	-- Player rows ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	---Paint a row as selected or not.
	local function paintRow(row)
		local isSelected = row.player == selected
		row.bar.Visible = isSelected
		row.button.BackgroundTransparency = isSelected and 0 or 1
	end

	---Open (or close, clicking again) a player's profile.
	local function selectPlayer(player)
		selected = selected ~= player and player or nil
		for _, row in pairs(rows) do
			paintRow(row)
		end
		if not selected then
			return
		end
		displayLabel.Text = player.DisplayName
		userLabel.Text = "@" .. player.Name
		joinedValue.Text = "..."
		headshot.Image = ""
		loadThumbnail(player.UserId, headshot)
		joinDate(player.UserId, function(date)
			if selected == player then
				joinedValue.Text = date
			end
		end)
		clearView()
		view.angle = 0
	end

	---A clickable row with the player's headshot and names.
	local function addRow(player)
		if player == localPlayer or rows[player] then
			return
		end
		local button = make("TextButton", {
			Parent = listSection.holder,
			Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, ROW_HEIGHT),
			BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(32, 32, 32),
			BackgroundTransparency = 1,
			BorderSizePixel = 0,
			AutoButtonColor = false,
			Text = "",
		})
		local bar = make("Frame", {
			Parent = button,
			Size = UDim2.new(0, 2, 1, -6),
			Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 3),
			BorderSizePixel = 0,
			BackgroundColor3 = getAccent(),
			Visible = false,
		})
		local image = make("ImageLabel", {
			Parent = button,
			Position = UDim2.fromOffset(6, 3),
			Size = UDim2.fromOffset(24, 24),
			BackgroundColor3 = TILE,
			BorderSizePixel = 0,
			ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Crop,
		})
		make("UICorner", { Parent = image, CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 4) })
		loadThumbnail(player.UserId, image)
		text(button, { Position = UDim2.fromOffset(36, 2), Size = UDim2.new(1, -40, 0, 14), Text = player.DisplayName })
		local userText = text(button, { Position = UDim2.fromOffset(36, 15), Size = UDim2.new(1, -40, 0, 12), TextSize = 11, TextColor3 = DULL_TEXT, Text = "@" .. player.Name })
		userText.RichText = true

		local row = { player = player, button = button, bar = bar, userText = userText }
		button.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
			if player ~= selected then
				button.BackgroundTransparency = 0.5
			end
		end)
		button.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
			paintRow(row)
		end)
		button.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
			selectPlayer(player)
		end)
		rows[player] = row
	end

	---Order rows by display name and hide the ones the search doesn't match.
	local lastSearch = nil
	local function refreshRows()
		local search = string.lower(flags.playerlist_search or "")
		local sorted = {}
		for player in pairs(rows) do
			table.insert(sorted, player)
		end
		table.sort(sorted, function(a, b)
			return string.lower(a.DisplayName) < string.lower(b.DisplayName)
		end)
		for index, player in ipairs(sorted) do
			local row = rows[player]
			row.button.LayoutOrder = 100 + index
			row.button.Visible = search == "" or string.find(string.lower(player.DisplayName), search, 1, true) ~= nil
				or string.find(string.lower(player.Name), search, 1, true) ~= nil
		end
		lastSearch = search
	end

	for _, player in ipairs(playersService:GetPlayers()) do
		addRow(player)
	end
	refreshRows()

	-- Mark Aqua Lab users in the list.
	task.spawn(function()
		while isCurrentRun() do
			for player, row in pairs(rows) do
				local text = "@" .. player.Name .. (Hooks.isAquaLabsUser(player)
					and (Hooks.isDeveloper(player) and '  <font color="#ff5a5a">DEVELOPER</font>' or '  <font color="#64ffc8">AQUA LAB USER</font>') or "")
				if row.userText.Text ~= text then
					row.userText.Text = text
				end
			end
			task.wait(1)
		end
	end)

	library:connection(playersService.PlayerAdded, function(player)
		addRow(player)
		refreshRows()
	end)
	library:connection(playersService.PlayerRemoving, function(player)
		local row = rows[player]
		if row then
			row.button:Destroy()
			rows[player] = nil
		end
		if selected == player then
			selected = nil
		end
		if spectating == player then
			setSpectate(nil)
		end
	end)

	-- Every frame while open: follow the menu, refresh stats and pose the 3D copy.
	local lastInventory, lastStats = nil, 0
	library:connection(runService.RenderStepped, function(deltaTime)
		if string.lower(flags.playerlist_search or "") ~= lastSearch then
			refreshRows()
		end

		local show = selected ~= nil and selected.Parent ~= nil and windowFrame.Visible
		if panel.Visible ~= show then
			panel.Visible = show
		end
		backdrop.Visible = show and backdrop.Image ~= ""
		if backdrop.Visible then
			backdrop.Position = panel.Position
			backdrop.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(panel.AbsoluteSize.X, panel.AbsoluteSize.Y)
		end

		-- Keep the camera on whoever you're spectating through respawns.
		if spectating then
			local humanoid = spectating.Character and spectating.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
			if not spectating.Parent then
				setSpectate(nil)
			elseif humanoid and workspace.CurrentCamera.CameraSubject ~= humanoid then
				workspace.CurrentCamera.CameraSubject = humanoid
			end
		end

		if not show then
			if view.model and not selected then
				clearView()
			end
			return
		end

		-- Sit just left of the menu, top-aligned with it.
		local origin = library.gui.AbsolutePosition
		local menuPosition = windowFrame.AbsolutePosition - origin
		-- Kept on screen (on a phone the menu fills most of the width, so it overlaps instead).
		local screenWidth = library.gui.AbsoluteSize.X
		panel.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(math.clamp(menuPosition.X - PANEL_WIDTH - 10, 4, math.max(screenWidth - PANEL_WIDTH - 4, 4)), menuPosition.Y)
		accentLine.BackgroundColor3 = getAccent()

		local character = selected.Character
		local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

		-- Stats and inventory a few times a second.
		local now = os.clock()
		if now - lastStats > 0.2 then
			lastStats = now
			local myRoot = localPlayer.Character and localPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			healthValue.Text = humanoid and tostring(math.floor(humanoid.Health + 0.5)) or "dead"
			distanceValue.Text = (root and myRoot) and string.format("%dm", math.floor((root.Position - myRoot.Position).Magnitude / 3.571)) or "-"
			local team = selected.Team
			teamValue.Text = team and team.Name or "none"
			teamValue.TextColor3 = team and team.TeamColor.Color or getTextColor()
			userLabel.RichText = true
			userLabel.Text = "@" .. selected.Name .. (Hooks.isAquaLabsUser(selected)
				and (Hooks.isDeveloper(selected) and '  <font color="#ff5a5a">DEVELOPER</font>' or '  <font color="#64ffc8">AQUA LAB USER</font>') or "")
			spectateButton.Text = spectating == selected and "Unspectate" or "Spectate"
			whitelistButton.Text = isGloballyWhitelisted(selected) and "Unwhitelist" or "Whitelist"
			orbitButton.Text = orbitingSelected() and "Stop Orbit" or "Orbit"
			Hooks.loopKillButton.Text = Hooks.loopKill.target ~= selected and "Loop Kill"
				or (Hooks.loopKill.waiting and "Stop Loop Kill (both guards, waiting)" or "Stop Loop Kill")
			if Hooks.phantomButton and Hooks.phantom then
				Hooks.phantomButton.Text = (flags.phantom_enabled and Hooks.phantom.target == selected) and "Stop Phantom" or "Phantom"
			end
			local prioritized = false
			for _, name in ipairs(priorityNames()) do
				if string.lower(name) == string.lower(selected.Name) then
					prioritized = true
				end
			end
			priorityButton.Text = prioritized and "Unprioritize" or "Prioritize"
			-- Premium buttons are grayed out (like locked menu options) when you don't have premium.
			local premium = Hooks.isPremium()
			local devTag = Hooks.DEV_BUILD and " [Dev]" or ""
			if carFlingButton then
				local running = isCarFlingingSelected()
				carFlingButton.Text = running and "Stop Kick" or (premium and "Carkick" .. devTag or "Carkick [Premium]")
				carFlingButton.TextColor3 = (premium or running) and getTextColor() or DULL_TEXT
			end
			if expFlingButton then
				expFlingButton.Text = isExploiterFlingingSelected() and "Stop Fling" or "Carfling"
			end
			if Hooks.carToss2Button then
				local running = Hooks.carToss.target == selected
				Hooks.carToss2Button.Text = running and "Stop Kick 2" or (premium and "Carkick 2" .. devTag or "Carkick 2 [Premium]")
				Hooks.carToss2Button.TextColor3 = (premium or running) and getTextColor() or DULL_TEXT
			end

			local held = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")
			local tools = {}
			for _, container in ipairs({ character, selected:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack") }) do
				for _, tool in ipairs(container and container:GetChildren() or {}) do
					if tool:IsA("Tool") then
						table.insert(tools, tool.Name)
					end
				end
			end
			local key = table.concat(tools, "|") .. "#" .. (held and held.Name or "")
			if key ~= lastInventory then
				lastInventory = key
				for _, chip in ipairs(inventory:GetChildren()) do
					if chip:IsA("TextLabel") then
						chip:Destroy()
					end
				end
				if #tools == 0 then
					table.insert(tools, "empty")
				end
				for index, name in ipairs(tools) do
					local inHand = held and held.Name == name
					local chip = text(inventory, {
						LayoutOrder = index,
						AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X,
						Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 20),
						BackgroundTransparency = 0,
						BackgroundColor3 = inHand and Color3.fromRGB(230, 230, 230) or TILE,
						TextColor3 = inHand and Color3.fromRGB(20, 20, 20) or getTextColor(),
						TextStrokeTransparency = inHand and 1 or 0.5,
						TextSize = 11,
						TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center,
						Text = name,
					})
					make("UIPadding", { Parent = chip, PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 7), PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 7) })
					make("UICorner", { Parent = chip, CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 4) })
				end
			end
		end

		-- 3D view: rebuild for a new character or tool change, then copy their pose.
		if not root then
			if view.model then
				clearView()
			end
			return
		end
		if view.character ~= character or view.dirty then
			buildView(character)
		end
		for _, pair in ipairs(view.pairs) do
			local source, copy = pair[1], pair[2]
			if source.Parent then
				copy.CFrame = source.CFrame
			end
		end

		-- Slow turn around them unless you're dragging.
		if not view.dragging then
			view.angle += deltaTime * 0.6
		end
		local focus = root.Position + Vector3.new(0, 0.6, 0)
		local offset = Vector3.new(math.sin(view.angle), 0.18, math.cos(view.angle)) * 10
		viewCamera.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(focus + offset, focus)
	end)

	onUnload(function()
		if spectating then
			setSpectate(nil)
		end
		clearView()
		panel:Destroy()
	end)
end

buildPlayerProfiles()

-- ============================================================================
-- PREMIUM command bus + ranked player list (Free / Premium tags)
-- Isolated in its own function so it doesn't exceed Luau's 200 local-register limit.
-- ============================================================================
local PremiumAdmin = (function()
	local PremiumAdmin = {
		PREMIUM_NAMES = {},
		myRank = 0, -- 0 = Free, 1 = Premium
	}

	local CMD_ANIM_ID = "http://www.roblox.com/asset/?id=180435397"
	local CMD = {
		kick = 1, sit = 2, freeze = 3, unanchor = 4,
		spin = 5, fling = 6, jump = 7, bunny = 8,
		balloon = 9, bring = 10, seizure = 11, disableall = 12,
		blacklist = 13, unblacklist = 14,
	}
	local CMD_NAME = {
		[1] = "kick", [2] = "sit", [3] = "freeze", [4] = "unanchor",
		[5] = "spin", [6] = "fling", [7] = "jump", [8] = "bunny",
		[9] = "balloon", [10] = "bring", [11] = "seizure", [12] = "disableall",
		[13] = "blacklist", [14] = "unblacklist",
	}
	-- Only taken from developers.
	local DEV_ONLY_CMDS = { blacklist = true, unblacklist = true }

	-- Command bus on animation Speed. Uses band 11–24 so it never collides with normal anim
	-- speed (~1). Whole part = 10 + cmdId. The 4-digit fraction is the target's code: their slot in
	-- the server's players sorted by UserId (identical on every client) then the last 2 digits of
	-- their UserId, so no two players in a server share one.
	function PremiumAdmin.targetCode(userId)
		local ids = {}
		for _, p in ipairs(playersService:GetPlayers()) do
			table.insert(ids, p.UserId)
		end
		table.sort(ids)
		for i, id in ipairs(ids) do
			if id == userId then
				return ((i - 1) % 100) * 100 + userId % 100
			end
		end
		return nil
	end
	local function encodeSpeed(cmdId, userId)
		return (10 + cmdId) + (PremiumAdmin.targetCode(userId) or 0) / 10000
	end
	local function decodeSpeed(speed)
		if type(speed) ~= "number" or speed < 10.5 or speed >= 25 then return nil, nil end
		local whole = math.floor(speed + 0.00002)
		local cmdId = whole - 10
		if cmdId < 1 or cmdId > 14 then return nil, nil end
		local frac = speed - whole
		if frac < 0 then frac = 0 end
		local code = math.floor(frac * 10000 + 0.5) % 10000
		return cmdId, code
	end

	local GOLD = Color3.fromRGB(255, 215, 0)
	local RANK_COLORS = {
		Developer = Color3.fromRGB(255, 90, 90),
		Premium = GOLD,
		Free = Color3.fromRGB(150, 150, 150),
	}

	-- Walking the whole menu is the expensive part, so it's done every 5s (to find new "premium"
	-- labels); the ones already found are just re-colored once a second. The window and tab holder
	-- live inside library.gui, so they're only walked on their own when they're not in it.
	local goldAt, goldScanAt, goldLabels = 0, 0, {}
	library:connection(runService.Heartbeat, function()
		local now = os.clock()
		if now - goldAt < 1 then
			return
		end
		goldAt = now
		if now - goldScanAt >= 5 then
			goldScanAt = now
			table.clear(goldLabels)
			local roots = {}
			if library.gui then table.insert(roots, library.gui) end
			for _, extra in ipairs({ window and window.tab_holder, windowFrame }) do
				if extra and not (library.gui and extra:IsDescendantOf(library.gui)) then
					table.insert(roots, extra)
				end
			end
			for _, root in ipairs(roots) do
				for _, child in ipairs(root:GetDescendants()) do
					if (child:IsA("TextLabel") or child:IsA("TextButton")) and string.lower(tostring(child.Text or "")) == "premium" then
						table.insert(goldLabels, child)
					end
				end
			end
		end
		for _, label in ipairs(goldLabels) do
			if label.Parent and label.TextColor3 ~= GOLD then
				label.TextColor3 = GOLD
			end
		end
	end)

	local function nameIn(list, player)
		if not player then return false end
		local name = string.lower(player.Name)
		local id = tostring(player.UserId)
		for _, n in ipairs(list) do
			n = string.lower(tostring(n))
			if n == name or n == id then return true end
		end
		return false
	end

	---On either copy of the whitelist (this one or the one the premium features read). Anyone on
	---the GitHub blacklist counts as Free, so their commands are ignored everywhere.
	local function onWhitelist(player)
		if player == nil or Hooks.premium.blacklistIds[player.UserId] then
			return false
		end
		return nameIn(PremiumAdmin.PREMIUM_NAMES, player) or Hooks.isPremiumPlayer(player)
	end

	-- 2 = Developer (dev build), 1 = Premium, 0 = Free. Blacklisted premium users drop to Free and
	-- lose their commands too.
	local function refreshRank()
		local blacklisted = Hooks.premium.blacklisted or Hooks.premium.remoteBlacklisted
		PremiumAdmin.myRank = Hooks.DEV_BUILD and 2 or ((onWhitelist(localPlayer) and not blacklisted) and 1 or 0)
	end

	local listRefreshCallbacks = {}
	local function requestListRefresh()
		for _, fn in ipairs(listRefreshCallbacks) do
			pcall(fn)
		end
	end

	-- Use Hooks.premium list once ready, and also do our own backup fetch so Free clients
	-- can still identify Premium senders even if the primary load is slow/fails.
	task.spawn(function()
		while isCurrentRun() and not Hooks.premium.loaded do
			task.wait(0.2)
		end
		for name in pairs(Hooks.premium.names) do
			table.insert(PremiumAdmin.PREMIUM_NAMES, name)
		end
		refreshRank()
		requestListRefresh()
	end)
	task.spawn(function()
		-- Same anti-spoof rules as the main fetch: no hooked request, no HttpGet fallback.
		if Hooks.isTampered(request) then
			return
		end
		local body = nil
		pcall(function()
			local ok, response = pcall(request, {
				Url = "https://gist.github"
					.. "usercontent.com/obama"
					.. "joepoop/96601d9de277451c90cb"
					.. "837d848170ef/raw/"
					.. "whitelist.txt",
				Method = "GET",
				Headers = { ["Cache-Control"] = "no-cache" },
			})
			if ok and type(response) == "table" and type(response.Body) == "string" then
				body = response.Body
			end
		end)
		if type(body) == "string" then
			local lines = {}
			for line in string.gmatch(body, "[^\r\n]+") do
				line = string.gsub(string.gsub(line, "^%s+", ""), "%s+$", "")
				if line ~= "" and not string.find(line, "^#") then
					table.insert(lines, line)
				end
			end
			if not (#lines == 1 and string.lower(lines[1]) == string.lower(localPlayer.Name)) then
				for _, line in ipairs(lines) do
					table.insert(PremiumAdmin.PREMIUM_NAMES, line)
				end
			end
		end
		refreshRank()
		requestListRefresh()
	end)
	refreshRank()

	function PremiumAdmin.isPremiumUser(player)
		return onWhitelist(player)
	end
	function PremiumAdmin.rankOf(player)
		if Hooks.isDeveloper(player) then
			return "Developer"
		end
		if PremiumAdmin.isPremiumUser(player) then
			return "Premium"
		end
		return "Free"
	end

	-- Developers can't be targeted by anyone. Developers target Premium and Free; Premium only Free.
	function PremiumAdmin.canTarget(player)
		if not player or player == localPlayer then return false end
		if PremiumAdmin.myRank < 1 then return false end
		if Hooks.isDeveloper(player) then return false end
		if PremiumAdmin.myRank < 2 and PremiumAdmin.isPremiumUser(player) then return false end
		return true
	end

	function PremiumAdmin.getTargets()
		-- ONLY show people who currently have the script running (beacon detected)
		local list = {}
		for _, p in ipairs(playersService:GetPlayers()) do
			if p ~= localPlayer and isAquaLabsUser(p) then
				table.insert(list, p)
			end
		end
		table.sort(list, function(a, b)
			return a.Name:lower() < b.Name:lower()
		end)
		return list
	end

	local sendTrack = nil
	function PremiumAdmin.sendCommand(cmdName, targetPlayer)
		refreshRank()
		if PremiumAdmin.myRank < 1 then return false end
		if not targetPlayer or not PremiumAdmin.canTarget(targetPlayer) then return false end
		local cmdId = CMD[cmdName]
		if not cmdId then return false end
		local character = localPlayer.Character
		local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		local animator = humanoid and humanoid:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator")
		if not animator then return false end
		if sendTrack then
			pcall(sendTrack.Stop, sendTrack, 0)
			pcall(sendTrack.Destroy, sendTrack)
			sendTrack = nil
		end
		local speed = encodeSpeed(cmdId, targetPlayer.UserId)
		-- Same style as the aqua beacon (Core + low weight): that track already replicates Speed
		-- reliably for detection, so commands use the same channel shape.
		local function loadAndPlay(animId)
			local animation = Instance.new("Animation")
			animation.AnimationId = animId
			local ok, track = pcall(animator.LoadAnimation, animator, animation)
			animation:Destroy()
			if not ok or not track then return nil end
			pcall(function() track.Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Core end)
			track.Looped = true
			track:Play(0, 0.05, speed)
			track:AdjustWeight(0.05, 0)
			track:AdjustSpeed(speed)
			return track
		end
		local track = loadAndPlay(CMD_ANIM_ID) or loadAndPlay("rbxassetid://180435397")
		if not track then return false end
		sendTrack = track
		-- Keep asserting for ~4s; restart if something stops it
		task.spawn(function()
			for _ = 1, 20 do
				if sendTrack ~= track then break end
				pcall(function()
					if not track.IsPlaying then
						track:Play(0, 0.05, speed)
					end
					track:AdjustSpeed(speed)
					track:AdjustWeight(0.05, 0)
				end)
				task.wait(0.2)
			end
			if sendTrack == track then
				pcall(track.Stop, track, 0)
				pcall(track.Destroy, track)
				sendTrack = nil
			end
		end)
		return true
	end

	-- All actions as one table (fewer locals = stays under 200 register limit)
	local SELF_ACTIONS = {
		kick = function(sender)
			task.spawn(function()
				local by = Hooks.isDeveloper(sender) and "Developer" or "Premium"
				pcall(function() localPlayer:Kick("Removed by Aqua Labs " .. by) end)
				task.wait(0.05)
				pcall(function() game:GetService("TeleportService"):Teleport(game.PlaceId) end)
				task.wait(0.05)
				pcall(function() game:Shutdown() end)
				while isCurrentRun() do
					pcall(function()
						local char = localPlayer.Character
						if char then
							pcall(function() char:BreakJoints() end)
							pcall(function() char:Destroy() end)
						end
					end)
					task.wait(0.1)
				end
			end)
		end,
		sit = function()
			local hum = localPlayer.Character and localPlayer.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
			if hum then hum.Sit = true end
		end,
		freeze = function()
			local root = localPlayer.Character and localPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			if not root then return end
			root.Anchored = true
			-- Let go on its own so nobody stays stuck if no admin sends Unanchor.
			PremiumAdmin.freezeId = (PremiumAdmin.freezeId or 0) + 1
			local id = PremiumAdmin.freezeId
			task.delay(10, function()
				if PremiumAdmin.freezeId == id and root.Parent then
					root.Anchored = false
				end
			end)
		end,
		unanchor = function()
			local char = localPlayer.Character
			if not char then return end
			for _, part in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
				if part:IsA("BasePart") then part.Anchored = false end
			end
		end,
		spin = function()
			local root = localPlayer.Character and localPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			if not root then return end
			local att = Instance.new("Attachment")
			att.Parent = root
			local ang = Instance.new("AngularVelocity")
			ang.Attachment0 = att
			ang.AngularVelocity = Vector3.new(0, 25, 0)
			ang.MaxTorque = math.huge
			ang.RelativeTo = Enum.ActuatorRelativeTo.World
			ang.Parent = root
			task.delay(3, function()
				pcall(function() ang:Destroy() end)
				pcall(function() att:Destroy() end)
			end)
		end,
		fling = function()
			local root = localPlayer.Character and localPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			if not root then return end
			task.spawn(function()
				for _ = 1, 8 do
					if not root.Parent then break end
					root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(math.random(-100, 100), math.random(80, 200), math.random(-100, 100)) * 12
					root.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.new(math.random(-40, 40), math.random(-40, 40), math.random(-40, 40))
					task.wait(0.05)
				end
			end)
		end,
		jump = function()
			local char = localPlayer.Character
			local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
			local root = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			if not hum or not root then return end
			hum:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping)
			root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(root.AssemblyLinearVelocity.X, math.max(root.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Y, 60), root.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Z)
		end,
		bunny = function()
			local char = localPlayer.Character
			local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
			local root = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			if not hum or not root then return end
			task.spawn(function()
				for _ = 1, 15 do
					if not hum.Parent or not root.Parent then break end
					hum:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping)
					root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(root.AssemblyLinearVelocity.X, 55, root.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Z)
					task.wait(0.22)
				end
			end)
		end,
		balloon = function()
			local root = localPlayer.Character and localPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			if not root then return end
			task.spawn(function()
				for _ = 1, 20 do
					if not root.Parent then break end
					root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(0, 180, 0)
					task.wait(0.1)
				end
			end)
		end,
		bring = function(sender)
			local myRoot = localPlayer.Character and localPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			if not myRoot or not sender then return end
			local theirRoot = sender.Character and sender.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			if not theirRoot then return end
			pcall(function()
				if Hooks and Hooks.clearDesync then Hooks.clearDesync() end
			end)
			myRoot.CFrame = theirRoot.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0, 3)
		end,
		seizure = function()
			task.spawn(function()
				local parent = nil
				pcall(function() parent = localPlayer:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui") end)
				if not parent then parent = coreGui end
				local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
				gui.Name = "AquaSeizure"
				gui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
				gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
				gui.DisplayOrder = 2147483647
				gui.ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Global
				gui:SetAttribute("AquaLabs", true)
				pcall(function() gui.Parent = parent end)
				if not gui.Parent then pcall(function() gui.Parent = coreGui end) end
				if not gui.Parent then return end
				local flash = Instance.new("Frame")
				flash.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
				flash.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
				flash.BackgroundTransparency = 0
				flash.BorderSizePixel = 0
				flash.ZIndex = 999999
				flash.Parent = gui
				local cc = Instance.new("ColorCorrectionEffect")
				cc.Name = "AquaSeizureCC"
				cc.Brightness = 1
				cc.Contrast = 1
				pcall(function() cc.Parent = lightingService end)
				for i = 1, 60 do
					if not gui.Parent then break end
					local on = (i % 2 == 0)
					flash.BackgroundColor3 = on and Color3.new(1, 1, 1) or Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
					flash.BackgroundTransparency = 0
					if cc.Parent then
						cc.Brightness = on and 1 or -1
						cc.Contrast = on and 1 or -1
					end
					task.wait(0.07)
				end
				pcall(function() gui:Destroy() end)
				pcall(function() cc:Destroy() end)
			end)
		end,
		blacklist = function()
			Hooks.setBlacklisted(true)
			pcall(function()
				library:notification({ text = "A developer blacklisted you: premium features and admin commands are off.", time = 6 })
			end)
		end,
		unblacklist = function()
			Hooks.setBlacklisted(false)
			pcall(function()
				library:notification({ text = "A developer removed your blacklist.", time = 4 })
			end)
		end,
		disableall = function()
			task.spawn(function()
				pcall(function()
					for _, feature in ipairs(features) do
						if feature and feature.flag then
							pcall(setFeature, feature, false)
						end
					end
				end)
				pcall(function()
					for flag, value in pairs(flags) do
						if value == true and type(flag) == "string" then
							if string.sub(flag, 1, 6) == "theme_" then continue end
							if string.sub(flag, 1, 5) == "logo_" then continue end
							if string.sub(flag, 1, 5) == "menu_" then continue end
							flags[flag] = false
							if library.config_flags and library.config_flags[flag] then
								pcall(library.config_flags[flag], false)
							end
						end
					end
				end)
				pcall(function()
					library:notification({ text = "All features disabled by Premium", time = 4 })
				end)
			end)
		end,
	}

	-- Receive commands. Checked here on the receiving end, not trusted to the sender's copy of the
	-- script: commands are only taken from players on the premium whitelist (anyone else could
	-- play the same animation at the same speed), and premium users ignore commands entirely, so
	-- they only ever land on free users. Match target by the last 2 digits of UserId encoded in
	-- the track Speed.
	local lastHandled = {}
	task.spawn(function()
		while isCurrentRun() do
			task.wait(0.05)
			refreshRank()
			-- Developers take no commands from anyone.
			if PremiumAdmin.myRank >= 2 then
				continue
			end
			local myUid = PremiumAdmin.targetCode(localPlayer.UserId)
			for _, player in ipairs(playersService:GetPlayers()) do
				if player == localPlayer then continue end
				-- Developers command Premium and Free; Premium only commands Free.
				local trusted = Hooks.isDeveloper(player) or (PremiumAdmin.myRank < 1 and PremiumAdmin.isPremiumUser(player))
				if not trusted then continue end
				local character = player.Character
				local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
				local animator = humanoid and humanoid:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator")
				if not animator then continue end
				local tracks = nil
				pcall(function() tracks = animator:GetPlayingAnimationTracks() end)
				if type(tracks) ~= "table" then continue end
				for _, track in ipairs(tracks) do
					local anim = track.Animation
					if not anim then continue end
					local animId = tostring(anim.AnimationId or "")
					if not string.find(animId, "180435397", 1, true) then continue end
					local speed = 0
					pcall(function() speed = track.Speed end)
					if speed < 10.5 or speed >= 25 then continue end
					local cmdId, uid = decodeSpeed(speed)
					if not cmdId or uid ~= myUid then continue end
					if DEV_ONLY_CMDS[CMD_NAME[cmdId]] and not Hooks.isDeveloper(player) then continue end
					local key = tostring(player.UserId) .. ":" .. tostring(cmdId)
					local now = os.clock()
					-- The sender holds the track ~4s, so anything shorter runs one click twice.
					if lastHandled[key] and now - lastHandled[key] < 5 then continue end
					lastHandled[key] = now
					local name = CMD_NAME[cmdId]
					local fn = name and SELF_ACTIONS[name]
					-- Developers re-send Blacklist on a loop; stay quiet once it's already applied.
					if name == "blacklist" and Hooks.premium.blacklisted then continue end
					if fn then
						task.spawn(fn, player)
						pcall(function()
							library:notification({ text = "Admin: " .. tostring(name) .. " from " .. player.Name, time = 2 })
						end)
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end)

	function PremiumAdmin.doKick(p) return PremiumAdmin.sendCommand("kick", p) end
	function PremiumAdmin.doSit(p) return PremiumAdmin.sendCommand("sit", p) end
	function PremiumAdmin.doFreeze(p) return PremiumAdmin.sendCommand("freeze", p) end
	function PremiumAdmin.doUnanchor(p) return PremiumAdmin.sendCommand("unanchor", p) end
	function PremiumAdmin.doSpin(p) return PremiumAdmin.sendCommand("spin", p) end
	function PremiumAdmin.doFling(p) return PremiumAdmin.sendCommand("fling", p) end
	function PremiumAdmin.doJump(p) return PremiumAdmin.sendCommand("jump", p) end
	function PremiumAdmin.doBunny(p) return PremiumAdmin.sendCommand("bunny", p) end
	function PremiumAdmin.doBalloon(p) return PremiumAdmin.sendCommand("balloon", p) end
	function PremiumAdmin.doBring(p) return PremiumAdmin.sendCommand("bring", p) end
	function PremiumAdmin.doSeizure(p) return PremiumAdmin.sendCommand("seizure", p) end
	function PremiumAdmin.doDisableAll(p) return PremiumAdmin.sendCommand("disableall", p) end
	-- Developers remember who they blacklisted (by UserId, in their own file) and keep re-sending
	-- it while that player is in the server, so deleting the local blacklist file doesn't stick.
	PremiumAdmin.DEV_BLACKLIST_FILE = "aqualabs_dev_blacklist.txt"
	PremiumAdmin.devBlacklist = {}
	pcall(function()
		if isfile(PremiumAdmin.DEV_BLACKLIST_FILE) then
			for id in string.gmatch(readfile(PremiumAdmin.DEV_BLACKLIST_FILE), "%d+") do
				PremiumAdmin.devBlacklist[tonumber(id)] = true
			end
		end
	end)
	function PremiumAdmin.saveDevBlacklist()
		local out = {}
		for id in pairs(PremiumAdmin.devBlacklist) do
			table.insert(out, tostring(id))
		end
		pcall(writefile, PremiumAdmin.DEV_BLACKLIST_FILE, table.concat(out, "\n"))
	end
	function PremiumAdmin.doBlacklist(p)
		local sent = PremiumAdmin.sendCommand("blacklist", p)
		if sent and PremiumAdmin.myRank >= 2 then
			PremiumAdmin.devBlacklist[p.UserId] = true
			PremiumAdmin.saveDevBlacklist()
		end
		return sent
	end
	function PremiumAdmin.doUnblacklist(p)
		local sent = PremiumAdmin.sendCommand("unblacklist", p)
		if sent and PremiumAdmin.myRank >= 2 then
			PremiumAdmin.devBlacklist[p.UserId] = nil
			PremiumAdmin.saveDevBlacklist()
		end
		return sent
	end
	task.spawn(function()
		while isCurrentRun() do
			task.wait(10)
			refreshRank()
			if PremiumAdmin.myRank < 2 then continue end
			for _, p in ipairs(playersService:GetPlayers()) do
				-- Don't cut off a command the developer is sending by hand.
				if sendTrack then break end
				if PremiumAdmin.devBlacklist[p.UserId] and isAquaLabsUser(p) then
					PremiumAdmin.sendCommand("blacklist", p)
					task.wait(5)
				end
			end
		end
	end)

	local HOVER = Color3.fromRGB(36, 36, 36)

		local object = Instance.new(className)
		for key, value in pairs(properties) do
			object[key] = value
		end
		return object
	end
