	})
	-- Shown when nobody in the server runs the script (or the search matches no one).
	local emptyLabel = make("TextLabel", {
		Parent = scroll,
		LayoutOrder = 0,
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 60),
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		FontFace = library.font,
		TextSize = 12,
		TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(110, 110, 110),
		Text = "No aqua lab users found in this server yet.\nThe list updates by itself.",
	})

	local function clearRows()
		for _, row in pairs(rows) do
			row:Destroy()
		end
		table.clear(rows)
	end

	---Highlight the picked user's card with the theme color.
	local function paintRows()
		local accent = getAccent()
		for _, row in pairs(rows) do
			local bg, stroke = row:FindFirstChild("bg"), row:FindFirstChild("bg") and row.bg:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke")
			local picked = row:GetAttribute("UserId") == (selectedPlayer and selectedPlayer.UserId)
			if bg then
				bg.BackgroundColor3 = picked and TILE:Lerp(accent, 0.18) or (row:GetAttribute("Hover") and HOVER or TILE)
			end
			if stroke then
				stroke.Color = picked and accent or EDGE
				stroke.Transparency = picked and 0 or 0.4
			end
		end
	end

	local function selectPlayer(player)
		selectedPlayer = player
		paintRows()
	end

	local function refreshList()
		clearRows()
		local search = string.lower(tostring(flags.premium_search or ""))
		local targets = PremiumAdmin.getTargets()
		for _, player in ipairs(targets) do
			local display = player.DisplayName
			local name = player.Name
			local rank = PremiumAdmin.rankOf(player)
			if search ~= "" then
				local blob = string.lower(display .. " " .. name .. " " .. rank)
				if not string.find(blob, search, 1, true) then
					continue
				end
			end
			local rankColor = RANK_COLORS[rank] or RANK_COLORS.Free
			local row = make("Frame", {
				Parent = scroll,
				Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, ROW_HEIGHT),
				BackgroundTransparency = 1,
				LayoutOrder = #rows + 1,
			})
			row:SetAttribute("UserId", player.UserId)
			local bg = make("Frame", {
				Name = "bg",
				Parent = row,
				Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1),
				BackgroundColor3 = TILE,
				BorderSizePixel = 0,
			})
			make("UICorner", { Parent = bg, CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6) })
			make("UIStroke", { Parent = bg, Color = EDGE, Transparency = 0.4, ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border })
			local head = make("ImageLabel", {
				Parent = row,
				AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5),
				Position = UDim2.new(0, 7, 0.5, 0),
				Size = UDim2.fromOffset(28, 28),
				BackgroundColor3 = DARK,
				BorderSizePixel = 0,
				ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Crop,
			})
			make("UICorner", { Parent = head, CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0) })
			-- Ring in the rank color around the avatar.
			make("UIStroke", { Parent = head, Color = rankColor, Thickness = 1.5, Transparency = 0.2 })
			task.spawn(function()
				local ok, content = pcall(playersService.GetUserThumbnailAsync, playersService, player.UserId,
					Enum.ThumbnailType.HeadShot, Enum.ThumbnailSize.Size48x48)
				if ok and head.Parent then
					head.Image = content
				end
			end)
			make("TextLabel", {
				Parent = row,
				Position = UDim2.fromOffset(44, 5),
				Size = UDim2.new(1, -130, 0, 15),
				BackgroundTransparency = 1,
				FontFace = library.font,
				TextSize = 13,
				TextColor3 = getTextColor(),
				TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
				TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,
				Text = display,
			})
			make("TextLabel", {
				Parent = row,
				Position = UDim2.fromOffset(44, 20),
				Size = UDim2.new(1, -130, 0, 13),
				BackgroundTransparency = 1,
				FontFace = library.font,
				TextSize = 11,
				TextColor3 = AQUA,
				TextTransparency = 0.25,
				TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
				TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,
				Text = "@" .. name,
			})
			-- Rank as a small pill on the right.
			local pill = make("TextLabel", {
				Parent = row,
				AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5),
				Position = UDim2.new(1, -10, 0.5, 0),
				Size = UDim2.fromOffset(64, 18),
				BackgroundColor3 = rankColor,
				BackgroundTransparency = 0.82,
				BorderSizePixel = 0,
				FontFace = library.font,
				TextSize = 11,
				TextColor3 = rankColor,
				Text = string.upper(rank),
			})
			make("UICorner", { Parent = pill, CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0) })
			make("UIStroke", { Parent = pill, Color = rankColor, Transparency = 0.55, ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border })
			local btn = make("TextButton", {
				Parent = row,
				Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1),
				BackgroundTransparency = 1,
				Text = "",
				ZIndex = 2,
			})
			btn.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
				row:SetAttribute("Hover", true)
				paintRows()
			end)
			btn.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
				row:SetAttribute("Hover", nil)
				paintRows()
			end)
			btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
				selectPlayer(player)
			end)
			table.insert(rows, row)
		end
		emptyLabel.Visible = #rows == 0
		-- The pick survives a refresh (and a search that hides it) while they're still a target.
		if selectedPlayer and not table.find(targets, selectedPlayer) then
			selectedPlayer = nil
		end
		paintRows()
	end

	table.insert(listRefreshCallbacks, refreshList)

	local actionSection = tab:section({ name = "Commands", side = "left" })

	---Send one command to the picked user (every check the old buttons had).
	local function runAction(action)
		if PremiumAdmin.myRank < 1 then
			return library:notification({ text = "Premium only", time = 3 })
		end
		if action.devOnly and PremiumAdmin.myRank < 2 then
			return library:notification({ text = "Developer only", time = 3 })
		end
		if not selectedPlayer or not selectedPlayer.Parent then
			return library:notification({ text = "Select a player first", time = 2 })
		end
		if Hooks.isDeveloper(selectedPlayer) then
			return library:notification({ text = "Can't target Developers", time = 2 })
		end
		if PremiumAdmin.myRank < 2 and PremiumAdmin.isPremiumUser(selectedPlayer) then
			return library:notification({ text = "Can't target Premium users", time = 2 })
		end
		if not PremiumAdmin.canTarget(selectedPlayer) then
			return library:notification({ text = "Can't target that player", time = 2 })
		end
		local ok = action.fn(selectedPlayer)
		library:notification({ text = ok and (action.name .. " → " .. selectedPlayer.Name) or "Failed to send", time = 2 })
	end

	-- Who the commands go to, above the grid.
	local targetLabel = make("TextLabel", {
		Parent = actionSection.holder,
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 20),
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		FontFace = library.font,
		TextSize = 12,
		RichText = true,
		TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
		TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(150, 150, 150),
		Text = "Select a user above",
	})
	-- Commands as a 3-wide grid of tiles instead of a long column of bars.
	local grid = make("Frame", {
		Parent = actionSection.holder,
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0),
		AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
	})
	make("UIGridLayout", {
		Parent = grid,
		CellSize = UDim2.new(1 / 3, -4, 0, 30),
		CellPadding = UDim2.fromOffset(6, 6),
		SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder,
	})
	-- The rougher ones get a red tint so they aren't clicked by mistake.
	local HARSH = { Kick = true, Fling = true, Seizure = true, ["Disable All"] = true }
	local tiles = {}
	for index, action in ipairs(ACTIONS_FULL) do
		local tile = make("TextButton", {
			Parent = grid,
			LayoutOrder = index,
			BackgroundColor3 = TILE,
			BorderSizePixel = 0,
			AutoButtonColor = false,
			FontFace = library.font,
			TextSize = 12,
			Text = action.name,
		})
		make("UICorner", { Parent = tile, CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6) })
		local stroke = make("UIStroke", { Parent = tile, Color = EDGE, ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border })
		local entry = { tile = tile, stroke = stroke, harsh = HARSH[action.name], hover = false, devOnly = action.devOnly }
		tile.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
			entry.hover = true
		end)
		tile.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
			entry.hover = false
		end)
		tile.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
			runAction(action)
		end)
		table.insert(tiles, entry)
	end

	-- Tiles and the target line follow the theme, the pick and your rank, a few times a second.
	library:connection(runService.Heartbeat, function()
		local now = os.clock()
		if now - (PremiumAdmin.tilesAt or 0) < 0.1 then
			return
		end
		PremiumAdmin.tilesAt = now
		local accent = getAccent()
		local usable = PremiumAdmin.myRank >= 1 and selectedPlayer ~= nil and selectedPlayer.Parent ~= nil
		if PremiumAdmin.myRank < 1 then
			targetLabel.Text = "Commands are <font color=\"#ffd700\">Premium</font> only"
		elseif selectedPlayer and selectedPlayer.Parent then
			targetLabel.Text = string.format('Target: <font color="#%s">%s</font> <font color="#6e6e6e">@%s</font>',
				accent:ToHex(), selectedPlayer.DisplayName, selectedPlayer.Name)
		else
			targetLabel.Text = "Select a user above"
		end
		scroll.ScrollBarImageColor3 = accent
		for _, entry in ipairs(tiles) do
			local usable = usable and (not entry.devOnly or PremiumAdmin.myRank >= 2)
			local color = entry.harsh and Color3.fromRGB(255, 120, 120) or getTextColor()
			entry.tile.TextColor3 = usable and color or Color3.fromRGB(90, 90, 90)
			entry.tile.BackgroundColor3 = (usable and entry.hover) and HOVER or TILE
			entry.stroke.Color = (usable and entry.hover) and (entry.harsh and Color3.fromRGB(255, 90, 90) or accent) or EDGE
		end
	end)

	-- library:connection so these are dropped on unload instead of stacking on every re-execute.
	library:connection(playersService.PlayerAdded, function(player)
		task.defer(requestListRefresh)
		library:connection(player.CharacterAdded, function()
			task.defer(requestListRefresh)
		end)
	end)
	library:connection(playersService.PlayerRemoving, function(p)
		if selectedPlayer == p then selectedPlayer = nil end
		task.defer(requestListRefresh)
	end)
	for _, player in ipairs(playersService:GetPlayers()) do
		if player ~= localPlayer then
			library:connection(player.CharacterAdded, function()
				task.defer(requestListRefresh)
			end)
		end
	end

	task.spawn(function()
		local lastSearch, lastCount, lastSignature = "", -1, ""
		while isCurrentRun() do
			task.wait(0.5)
			local cur = tostring(flags.premium_search or "")
			local count = #playersService:GetPlayers()
			local ids = {}
			for _, p in ipairs(playersService:GetPlayers()) do
				ids[p.UserId] = true
			end
			local changed = false
			for id in pairs(ids) do
				if not knownUserIds[id] then changed = true break end
			end
			if not changed then
				for id in pairs(knownUserIds) do
					if not ids[id] then changed = true break end
				end
			end
			knownUserIds = ids
			-- Users are found a few seconds after they join (and can turn premium), with no one
			-- joining or leaving, so the list also rebuilds whenever who's on it or their rank changes.
			local parts = {}
			for _, player in ipairs(PremiumAdmin.getTargets()) do
				table.insert(parts, player.UserId .. ":" .. tostring(PremiumAdmin.rankOf(player)))
			end
			table.sort(parts)
			local signature = table.concat(parts, ",")
			if signature ~= lastSignature then
				lastSignature = signature
				changed = true
			end
			if cur ~= lastSearch or count ~= lastCount or changed then
				lastSearch = cur
				lastCount = count
				refreshList()
			end
		end
	end)

	refreshList()

	return PremiumAdmin
end)()

Intro.step("loading configs & themes", 0.88)

-- Settings tab.
local settingsTab = window:tab({ name = "settings" })

-- Discord: the first thing in Settings. With "auto open discord" on, every run opens our
-- server's invite in the Discord app (and copies it). The choice is kept in its own file, so
-- turning it off stays off on the next run even before a config loads.
do
	local DISCORD_SETTING_FILE = "Aqua Lab/discord_autojoin.txt"
	local inviteCode = DISCORD_INVITE:match("discord%.gg/([%w%-]+)") or ""
	local enabled = true
	pcall(function()
		if isfile(DISCORD_SETTING_FILE) then
			enabled = readfile(DISCORD_SETTING_FILE) ~= "off"
		end
	end)

	---Open the invite in the Discord app (its local RPC port), and copy the link either way.
	local function openDiscord()
		pcall(setclipboard, DISCORD_INVITE)
		task.spawn(function()
			local httpService = game:GetService("HttpService")
			local result = "closed"
			for port = 6463, 6472 do
				local ok, response = pcall(request, {
					Url = "http://127.0.0.1:" .. port .. "/rpc?v=1",
					Method = "POST",
					Headers = { ["Content-Type"] = "application/json", ["Origin"] = "https://discord.com" },
					Body = httpService:JSONEncode({
						cmd = "INVITE_BROWSER",
						nonce = httpService:GenerateGUID(false),
						args = { code = inviteCode },
					}),
				})
				-- The first port that answers is the Discord app; its reply says whether the invite opened
				-- (it answers 200 even for an expired invite, with an ERROR event in the body).
				if ok and response and response.StatusCode ~= 0 then
					local decoded = pcall(httpService.JSONDecode, httpService, response.Body or "")
						and httpService:JSONDecode(response.Body) or nil
					if decoded and decoded.evt == "ERROR" then
						result = "invalid"
						warn("[Aqua] Discord couldn't open the invite:", decoded.data and decoded.data.message)
					else
						result = "opened"
					end
					break
				end
			end
			local messages = {
				opened = "Opened the Aqua Labs Discord - come join us!",
				invalid = "The Discord invite link is expired - ask the owner for a new one.",
				closed = "Discord invite copied - open Discord or paste it in your browser to join us!",
			}
			library:notification({ text = messages[result], time = 5 })
		end)
	end

	local discordSection = settingsTab:section({ name = "Discord", side = "left" })
	discordSection:toggle({
		name = "auto open discord",
		flag = "discord_auto_open",
		default = enabled,
		callback = function(value)
			pcall(writefile, DISCORD_SETTING_FILE, value and "on" or "off")
		end,
	})
	discordSection:button({ name = "Join our Discord", callback = openDiscord })

	if enabled then
		task.delay(3, openDiscord)
	end
end

-- Global combat whitelist / target-only
local combatFilterSection = Tabs.combat:section({ name = "Combat Filters", side = "left" })

local function combatFilterPlayerNames()
	local names = {}
	for _, plr in ipairs(playersService:GetPlayers()) do
		if plr ~= localPlayer then
			table.insert(names, playerLabel(plr))
		end
	end
	table.sort(names)
	return #names > 0 and names or { "---" }
end

local whitelistDropdown = combatFilterSection:dropdown({
	name = "whitelist players",
	flag = "global_whitelist",
	items = combatFilterPlayerNames(),
	default = {},
	multi = true,
})
local targetOnlyDropdown = combatFilterSection:dropdown({
	name = "target only players",
	flag = "global_target_only",
	items = combatFilterPlayerNames(),
	default = {},
	multi = true,
})
combatFilterSection:toggle({ name = "use target only list", flag = "global_target_only_enabled", default = false })

local function multiSelection(flagValue)
	local selected = {}
	if type(flagValue) ~= "table" then
		return selected
	end
	for key, value in pairs(flagValue) do
		if value == true and type(key) == "string" and key ~= "---" then
			table.insert(selected, key)
		elseif type(value) == "string" and value ~= "---" then
			table.insert(selected, value)
		end
	end
	return selected
end

local function refreshCombatFilterLists()
	local list = combatFilterPlayerNames()
	local keepWhitelist = multiSelection(flags.global_whitelist)
	local keepTarget = multiSelection(flags.global_target_only)
	-- Drop names that left the server so unwhitelist/leave actually clears.
	local valid = {}
	for _, name in ipairs(list) do
		valid[name] = true
	end
	local function filterKeep(keep)
		local out = {}
		-- valid keys are current labels; also accept by username match.
		local validByUser = {}
		for label in pairs(valid) do
			local u = usernameFromLabel(label)
			if u then
				validByUser[u] = label
			end
		end
		for _, name in ipairs(keep) do
			if valid[name] then
				table.insert(out, name)
			else
				local u = usernameFromLabel(name)
				if u and validByUser[u] then
					table.insert(out, validByUser[u])
				end
			end
		end
		return out
	end
	keepWhitelist = filterKeep(keepWhitelist)
	keepTarget = filterKeep(keepTarget)
	pcall(function()
		whitelistDropdown:refresh_options(list)
	end)
	pcall(function()
		targetOnlyDropdown:refresh_options(list)
	end)
	-- Re-apply only names still selected (prevents sticky whitelist after uncheck + refresh).
	pcall(function()
		if library.config_flags.global_whitelist then
			library.config_flags.global_whitelist(keepWhitelist)
		end
	end)
	pcall(function()
		if library.config_flags.global_target_only then
			library.config_flags.global_target_only(keepTarget)
		end
	end)
end

-- Auto-refresh player lists when people join/leave (no manual button).
library:connection(playersService.PlayerAdded, function()
	task.defer(refreshCombatFilterLists)
end)
library:connection(playersService.PlayerRemoving, function()
	task.defer(refreshCombatFilterLists)
end)
task.defer(refreshCombatFilterLists)


-- Window chrome: an accent border around the menu and a soft glow behind it. The glow sits
-- under the window in the menu's gui and follows it as it's dragged or resized.
do
	-- The glow is only the soft edge around the menu: four strips cut from the glow image (top,
	-- bottom, left, right), with nothing in the middle, so it never tints a see-through menu. Two
	-- layers: a tight bright one and a wide faint one, each fading from the menu's edge outward.
	-- The glow image is 100x100 with its fade in the outer 21 pixels.
	local EDGE = 21
	local LAYERS = { { spread = 26, strength = 0.75 }, { spread = 95, strength = 0.35 } }
	local glowHolder = Instance.new("Frame")
	glowHolder.Name = ""
	glowHolder.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	glowHolder.ZIndex = 1
	glowHolder.Visible = false
	glowHolder.Parent = Hooks.sideGui

	local strips = {}
	for _, layer in ipairs(LAYERS) do
		for _, side in ipairs({ "top", "bottom", "left", "right" }) do
			local horizontal = side == "top" or side == "bottom"
			local strip = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
			strip.Name = ""
			strip.BackgroundTransparency = 1
			strip.Image = GLOW_IMAGE
			strip.ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Slice
			strip.SliceScale = layer.spread / EDGE
			strip.ZIndex = 1
			if horizontal then
				strip.ImageRectOffset = Vector2.new(0, side == "top" and 0 or 100 - EDGE)
				strip.ImageRectSize = Vector2.new(100, EDGE)
				strip.SliceCenter = Rect.new(EDGE, 0, 100 - EDGE, EDGE)
			else
				strip.ImageRectOffset = Vector2.new(side == "left" and 0 or 100 - EDGE, EDGE)
				strip.ImageRectSize = Vector2.new(EDGE, 100 + EDGE * 2 * NEG_ONE)
				strip.SliceCenter = Rect.new(0, 0, EDGE, 100 + EDGE * 2 * NEG_ONE)
			end
			strip.Parent = glowHolder
			table.insert(strips, { image = strip, side = side, layer = layer })
		end
	end

	local menuBorder = Instance.new("UIStroke")
	menuBorder.Thickness = 1
	menuBorder.LineJoinMode = Enum.LineJoinMode.Miter
	menuBorder.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border
	menuBorder.Enabled = false
	menuBorder.Parent = windowFrame

	---Apply the Border Outline / UI Glow settings.
	function Hooks.applyUiChrome()
		menuBorder.Enabled = flags.ui_border_outline ~= false
	end

	-- Every frame: follow the window, and keep the glow and border on their colors.
	library:connection(runService.RenderStepped, function()
		local show = flags.ui_glow == true and windowFrame.Visible and not Hooks.lowPower()
		if glowHolder.Visible ~= show then
			glowHolder.Visible = show
		end
		if show then
			local color = flags.ui_glow_theme ~= false and getAccent()
				or (flags.ui_glow_color and flags.ui_glow_color.Color or getAccent())
			local amount = math.clamp(flags.ui_glow_amount or 0.45, 0, 1)
			local origin = library.gui.AbsolutePosition
			local position = windowFrame.AbsolutePosition - origin
			local size = windowFrame.AbsoluteSize
			-- Only touched when the menu moved or a setting changed.
			local glowKey = tostring(position) .. tostring(size) .. color:ToHex() .. amount
			if glowHolder:GetAttribute("Key") == glowKey then
				return
			end
			glowHolder:SetAttribute("Key", glowKey)
			for _, entry in ipairs(strips) do
				local spread = entry.layer.spread
				local image = entry.image
				if entry.side == "top" then
					image.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(position.X - spread, position.Y - spread)
					image.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(size.X + spread * 2, spread)
				elseif entry.side == "bottom" then
					image.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(position.X - spread, position.Y + size.Y)
					image.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(size.X + spread * 2, spread)
				elseif entry.side == "left" then
					image.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(position.X - spread, position.Y)
					image.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(spread, size.Y)
				else
					image.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(position.X + size.X, position.Y)
					image.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(spread, size.Y)
				end
				image.ImageColor3 = color
				image.ImageTransparency = 1 + amount * entry.layer.strength * NEG_ONE
			end
		end
		if menuBorder.Enabled then
			local accent = getAccent()
			if menuBorder.Color ~= accent then
				menuBorder.Color = accent
			end
		end
	end)

	onUnload(function()
		glowHolder:Destroy()
		menuBorder:Destroy()
	end)
end

-- Menu section.
local menuSection = settingsTab:section({ name = "Menu", side = "left" })

-- On by default on phones and tablets (see Hooks.lowPower).

menuSection:toggle({
	name = "Watermark",
	flag = "watermark",
	default = true,
	callback = function(enabled)
		watermarkHolder.Visible = enabled
	end,
})

-- Menu logo: a big, faint "AQUA LABS" in the middle of the menu. A heavy rounded font with an
-- accent gradient across it (the menu's pixel font, stretched this big, looked thin and blurry).
do
	local menuLogo = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	menuLogo.Name = ""
	menuLogo.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
	menuLogo.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.52)
	menuLogo.Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.72, 0.13)
	menuLogo.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	menuLogo.Text = "AQUA LABS"
	menuLogo.TextScaled = true
	menuLogo.FontFace = Font.new("rbxasset://fonts/families/GothamSSm.json", Enum.FontWeight.Heavy, Enum.FontStyle.Normal)
	-- The theme font changes every text in the menu; this one keeps its heavy font.
	menuLogo:SetAttribute("KeepFont", true)
	menuLogo.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
	menuLogo.ZIndex = 50
	menuLogo.Active = false
	menuLogo.Visible = false
	menuLogo.Parent = windowFrame
	-- Keeps the letters from getting huge on a wide menu.
	local logoSize = Instance.new("UITextSizeConstraint")
	logoSize.MaxTextSize = 64
	logoSize.Parent = menuLogo
	-- Accent fading into a lighter accent across the word.
	local logoGradient = Instance.new("UIGradient")
	logoGradient.Rotation = 20
	logoGradient.Parent = menuLogo

	local DEFAULT_LOGO_FONT = menuLogo.FontFace

	local function paintMenuLogo()
		menuLogo.Visible = flags.menu_logo_watermark ~= false
		-- Font (any menu font, custom ones included) and text size.
		local face = FONT_FACES[flags.menu_logo_watermark_font or ""]
		local weight = flags.menu_logo_watermark_bold ~= false and Enum.FontWeight.Heavy or Enum.FontWeight.Regular
		menuLogo.FontFace = face and Font.new(face.Family, weight) or DEFAULT_LOGO_FONT
		local size = math.floor(tonumber(flags.menu_logo_watermark_size) or 64)
		logoSize.MaxTextSize = size
		menuLogo.Size = UDim2.new(0.95, 0, 0, size + 8)
		menuLogo.TextTransparency = math.clamp(tonumber(flags.menu_logo_watermark_transparency) or 0.88, 0, 1)
		-- Height: how far down the menu it sits (0 = top edge, 1 = bottom edge).
		menuLogo.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, math.clamp(tonumber(flags.menu_logo_watermark_height) or 0.52, 0, 1))
		-- Text animation: the picked menu look. Otherwise the accent fading lighter.
		if Hooks.textFx.styleOf("menu") ~= "None" then
			if not Hooks.textFx.entries[logoGradient] then
				Hooks.textFx.add(logoGradient, "menu", 1.7)
			end
			return
		end
		Hooks.textFx.entries[logoGradient] = nil
		logoGradient.Enabled = true
		logoGradient.Transparency = NumberSequence.new(0)
		local accent = getAccent()
		logoGradient.Color = ColorSequence.new(accent, accent:Lerp(Color3.new(1, 1, 1), 0.45))
		logoGradient.Offset = Vector2.zero
		logoGradient.Rotation = 20
	end

	-- Menu animations: the menu fades in when opened and out when closed, and each tab's contents
	-- slide up into place when you switch to it. For the fade the window sits in a CanvasGroup only
	-- while it's fading (a CanvasGroup draws to a texture, which slightly softens text), then goes
	-- straight back.
	local SLIDE = TweenInfo.new(0.24, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
	local FADE = TweenInfo.new(0.18, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
	local fadeGroup = Instance.new("CanvasGroup")
	fadeGroup.Name = ""
	fadeGroup.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	fadeGroup.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	fadeGroup.ZIndex = windowFrame.ZIndex
	fadeGroup.Parent = library.gui
	local menuFade = { tween = nil }
	local setVisibility = window.set_menu_visibility

	window.set_menu_visibility = function(visible)
		if menuFade.tween then
			menuFade.tween:Cancel()
			menuFade.tween = nil
		end
		-- No fade with animations off, while unloading, or on phones (the gui's UIScale would scale
		-- the fade group a second time).
		local instant = flags.menu_animations == false or shuttingDown or library.gui:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIScale") ~= nil
		if instant or (visible == windowFrame.Visible and windowFrame.Parent ~= fadeGroup) then
			windowFrame.Parent = library.gui
			fadeGroup.GroupTransparency = 0
			return setVisibility(visible)
		end

		-- Pick up from wherever a fade that was cut short left off.
		if windowFrame.Parent ~= fadeGroup then
			fadeGroup.GroupTransparency = visible and 1 or 0
			windowFrame.Parent = fadeGroup
		end
		if visible then
			setVisibility(true)
		end
		local tween = tweenService:Create(fadeGroup, FADE, { GroupTransparency = visible and 0 or 1 })
		menuFade.tween = tween
		tween.Completed:Connect(function(state)
			if state ~= Enum.PlaybackState.Completed or menuFade.tween ~= tween then
				return
			end
			menuFade.tween = nil
			if not visible then
				setVisibility(false)
			end
			windowFrame.Parent = library.gui
			fadeGroup.GroupTransparency = 0
		end)
		tween:Play()
	end
	onUnload(function()
		window.set_menu_visibility = setVisibility
		windowFrame.Parent = library.gui
		fadeGroup:Destroy()
	end)

	local tabHome = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
	function library.onTabOpened(tab)
		if flags.menu_animations == false then
			return
		end
		-- Remember where the tab belongs the first time, then slide up from a little below it.
		tabHome[tab] = tabHome[tab] or tab.Position
		local home = tabHome[tab]
		tab.Position = home + UDim2.fromOffset(0, 14)
		tweenService:Create(tab, SLIDE, { Position = home }):Play()
	end
	onUnload(function()
		library.onTabOpened = nil
	end)
	menuSection:toggle({ name = "menu animations", flag = "menu_animations", default = true })

	-- Text animations: the menu title and this logo animate with the picked look (Water by default).
	menuSection:toggle({
		name = "text animations",
		flag = "water_text",
		default = true,
		callback = function()
			paintMenuLogo()
			Hooks.refreshHeader()
		end,
	})
	menuSection:dropdown({
		name = "menu text animation",
		flag = "text_anim_menu",
		items = table.clone(Hooks.textFx.STYLES),
		default = "Water",
		callback = paintMenuLogo,
	})
	menuSection:slider({ name = "text anim speed", flag = "text_anim_speed", min = 0.1, max = 4, default = 1, interval = 0.1, suffix = "x" })
	-- Colors for the two-color looks (Gradient / Fade / Flash), on menu and ESP text alike.
	menuSection:colorpicker({ name = "text anim color", flag = "text_anim_color1", color = Color3.new(1, 1, 1) })
	menuSection:toggle({ name = "second color is theme", flag = "text_anim_theme", default = true })
	menuSection:colorpicker({ flag = "text_anim_color2", color = Color3.fromRGB(120, 80, 255) })

	-- Header: corner logo, split-color brand, and the flashing "$$" around the title.
	menuSection:toggle({ name = "corner logo", flag = "header_logo", default = true, callback = function()
		Hooks.refreshHeader()
	end })
	menuSection:toggle({ name = "split color logo", flag = "header_split_logo", default = true, callback = function()
		Hooks.refreshHeader()
	end })
	menuSection:toggle({ name = "$$ title decor", flag = "header_dollars", default = true, callback = function()
		Hooks.refreshHeader()
	end })
	menuSection:colorpicker({ name = "$$ white color", flag = "header_dollar_color1", color = Color3.new(1, 1, 1) })
	menuSection:toggle({ name = "$$ second is theme", flag = "header_dollar_theme", default = true })
	menuSection:colorpicker({ flag = "header_dollar_color2", color = Color3.fromRGB(100, 100, 255) })
	menuSection:dropdown({ name = "$$ style", flag = "header_dollar_style", items = { "Split", "White To Theme", "Smooth", "Hard", "Wave" }, default = "Hard" })
	menuSection:slider({ name = "$$ speed", flag = "header_dollar_speed", min = 0.1, max = 5, default = 1.5, interval = 0.1, suffix = "x" })

	-- The "$$" color. White To Theme: white each time the menu opens, then fades into the theme
	-- color and stays there. The others keep flashing between the two colors (Wave runs the left
	-- pair a half beat ahead of the right one).
	library:connection(runService.RenderStepped, function()
		local dollars = Hooks.headerDollars
		if not windowFrame.Visible then
			Hooks.dollarsShownAt = nil
		end
		if flags.header_dollars == false or not dollars or not windowFrame.Visible then
			return
		end
		local now = os.clock()
		Hooks.placeDollars()
		Hooks.dollarsShownAt = Hooks.dollarsShownAt or now
		local first = flags.header_dollar_color1 and flags.header_dollar_color1.Color or Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
		local second = flags.header_dollar_theme ~= false and getAccent()
			or (flags.header_dollar_color2 and flags.header_dollar_color2.Color or Color3.fromRGB(100, 100, 255))
		local speed = flags.header_dollar_speed or 1.5
		local t = now * speed
		local style = flags.header_dollar_style or "Split"
		for index, dollar in ipairs(dollars) do
			-- Split: the first "$" in your color (white by default), the second in the theme color.
			local text = style == "Split"
				and string.format('<font color="#%s">$</font><font color="#%s">$</font>', first:ToHex(), second:ToHex())
				or "$$"
			if dollar.Text ~= text then
				dollar.RichText = true
				dollar.Text = text
			end
			local mix
			if style == "Split" then
				mix = 0
			elseif style == "White To Theme" then
				-- Hold white briefly, then ease into the theme color.
				local progress = math.clamp(((now + NEG_ONE * Hooks.dollarsShownAt) * speed + NEG_ONE * 0.4) / 1.2, 0, 1)
				mix = 1 + NEG_ONE * (1 + NEG_ONE * progress) ^ 3
			else
				local beat = t * 3 + (style == "Wave" and index * math.pi / 2 or 0)
				mix = style == "Hard" and (math.sin(beat) >= 0 and 1 or 0) or (math.sin(beat) + 1) / 2
			end
			dollar.TextColor3 = first:Lerp(second, mix)
		end
	end)
	menuSection:toggle({ name = "menu watermark", flag = "menu_logo_watermark", default = true, callback = paintMenuLogo })
	menuSection:slider({
		name = "menu watermark transparency",
		flag = "menu_logo_watermark_transparency",
		min = 0.5,
		max = 0.98,
		default = 0.88,
		interval = 0.01,
		callback = paintMenuLogo,
	})
	menuSection:slider({
		name = "menu watermark height",
		flag = "menu_logo_watermark_height",
		min = 0.05,
		max = 0.95,
		default = 0.52,
		interval = 0.01,
		callback = paintMenuLogo,
	})
	local logoFonts = { "Aqua Heavy" }
	for _, name in ipairs(fontNames) do
		table.insert(logoFonts, name)
	end
	menuSection:dropdown({
		name = "menu watermark font",
		flag = "menu_logo_watermark_font",
		items = logoFonts,
		default = "Aqua Heavy",
		callback = paintMenuLogo,
	})
	menuSection:toggle({ name = "menu watermark bold", flag = "menu_logo_watermark_bold", default = true, callback = paintMenuLogo })
	menuSection:slider({
		name = "menu watermark size",
		flag = "menu_logo_watermark_size",
		min = 16,
		max = 160,
		default = 64,
		interval = 1,
		suffix = "px",
		callback = paintMenuLogo,
	})
	-- Follows the accent color when the theme changes.
	task.spawn(function()
		while isCurrentRun() and menuLogo.Parent do
			task.wait(1)
			paintMenuLogo()
		end
	end)
	paintMenuLogo()
end

-- Performance: the script's own profile, plus game-side savings (low graphics, tabbed-out rendering).
-- Called in place (no named local): the top level is at Luau's 200-local limit.
;(function()
	local section = settingsTab:section({ name = "Performance", side = "left" })
	section:dropdown({
		name = "performance profile",
		flag = "performance_profile",
		items = { "Auto", "Quality", "Balanced", "Performance" },
		default = "Auto",
	})
	createLabel(section, "Auto On Mobile: Performance")
	createLabel(section, "Auto On PC: Balanced")

	-- Low graphics: plain materials, no shadows, textures, particles or post effects (only on your
	-- screen). Everything changed is remembered and put back when it's turned off.
	local saved = { parts = {}, decals = {}, effects = {}, lighting = nil }
	local watcher = nil

	---Our own instances are all named "", so the game's are the only ones touched.
	local function isGame(object)
		return object.Name ~= "" and not object:IsDescendantOf(workspace.CurrentCamera)
	end

	local function lowerOne(object)
		if not isGame(object) then
			return
		end
		if object:IsA("BasePart") then
			local model = object:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")
			if model and model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") then
				return
			end
			if not saved.parts[object] then
				saved.parts[object] = { material = object.Material, reflectance = object.Reflectance, shadow = object.CastShadow }
			end
			object.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
			object.Reflectance = 0
			object.CastShadow = false
		elseif object:IsA("Decal") or object:IsA("Texture") then
			if saved.decals[object] == nil then
				saved.decals[object] = object.Transparency
			end
			object.Transparency = 1
		elseif object:IsA("ParticleEmitter") or object:IsA("Trail") or object:IsA("Smoke") or object:IsA("Fire") or object:IsA("Sparkles") then
			if saved.effects[object] == nil then
				saved.effects[object] = object.Enabled
			end
			object.Enabled = false
		end
	end

	local function setLowGraphics(enabled)
		if watcher then
			watcher:Disconnect()
			watcher = nil
		end
		if enabled then
			saved.lighting = saved.lighting or { shadows = lightingService.GlobalShadows }
			lightingService.GlobalShadows = false
			for _, effect in ipairs(lightingService:GetChildren()) do
				if effect:IsA("PostEffect") and isGame(effect) and saved.effects[effect] == nil then
					saved.effects[effect] = effect.Enabled
					effect.Enabled = false
				end
			end
			pcall(function()
				saved.lighting.decoration = saved.lighting.decoration == nil and workspace.Terrain.Decoration or saved.lighting.decoration
				workspace.Terrain.Decoration = false
			end)
			task.spawn(function()
				-- In batches, so a big map doesn't freeze the game for a frame.
				for index, object in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
					if not flags.low_graphics then
						return
					end
					pcall(lowerOne, object)
					if index % 2000 == 0 then
						task.wait()
					end
				end
			end)
			watcher = workspace.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(object)
				task.defer(pcall, lowerOne, object)
			end)
			return
		end

		for part, original in pairs(saved.parts) do
			if part.Parent then
				part.Material, part.Reflectance, part.CastShadow = original.material, original.reflectance, original.shadow
			end
		end
		for decal, transparency in pairs(saved.decals) do
			if decal.Parent then
				decal.Transparency = transparency
			end
		end
		for effect, wasEnabled in pairs(saved.effects) do
			if effect.Parent then
				effect.Enabled = wasEnabled
			end
		end
		if saved.lighting then
			lightingService.GlobalShadows = saved.lighting.shadows
			if saved.lighting.decoration ~= nil then
				pcall(function()
					workspace.Terrain.Decoration = saved.lighting.decoration
				end)
			end
		end
		saved.parts, saved.decals, saved.effects, saved.lighting = {}, {}, {}, nil
	end

	section:toggle({ name = "low graphics", flag = "low_graphics", default = false, callback = setLowGraphics })
	onUnload(function()
		setLowGraphics(false)
	end)

	-- Optimize Mode: every animation and cosmetic effect off, plain looks everywhere, low graphics on
	-- and the lightest performance profile. Your old settings come back when it's turned off.
	local OPTIMIZE_SETTINGS = {
		{ "low_graphics", true },
		-- Menu.
		{ "menu_animations", false }, { "water_text", false }, { "menu_logo_watermark", false },
		{ "menu_blur", false }, { "menu_rainfall", false }, { "menu_shapes", false }, { "menu_bats", false },
		{ "menu_pumpkin", false }, { "menu_emojis", false }, { "menu_logo", false }, { "logo_rainbow", false },
		{ "logo_shadow", false }, { "ui_glow", false }, { "theme_rainbow", false },
		-- Kill and hit feedback.
		{ "kill_effect", false }, { "kill_effect_punch", false }, { "kill_flash", false }, { "kill_shake", false },
		{ "kill_earthquake", false }, { "damage_text_marker", false }, { "damage_numbers", false },
		{ "kill_lightning", false }, { "blood_splatter", false }, { "spawn_effect", false },
		{ "death_effect", false }, { "leave_effect", false },
		-- Bullets, shields, auras and trails.
		{ "bullet_tracers_enabled", false }, { "bullet_impact", false }, { "bullet_light", false },
		{ "shield_esp", false }, { "aura_enabled", false }, { "self_halo", false }, { "self_wings", false },
		{ "self_galaxy_orbit", false }, { "self_fire_aura", false }, { "self_star_ring", false },
		{ "char_ring", false }, { "self_trail", false }, { "sonar_enabled", false }, { "tool_glow", false },
		{ "self_chams_pulse", false }, { "self_chams_rainbow", false }, { "self_material_rainbow", false },
		{ "tool_rainbow", false }, { "shield_rainbow", false },
		-- World post effects and weather.
		{ "shaders_enabled", false }, { "world_bloom", false }, { "world_sun_rays", false }, { "world_blur", false },
		{ "world_atmosphere", false }, { "world_weather", false }, { "world_snow", false }, { "world_heavy_rain", false },
		-- ESP and FOV: no animation, plain styles.
		{ "esp_box_anim", "None" }, { "esp_fill_anim", "None" }, { "esp_skeleton_effect", "None" },
		{ "esp_box_glow", false }, { "esp_box_spin", false }, { "esp_health_shimmer", false },
		{ "esp_health_glow", false }, { "esp_health_flash", false }, { "esp_target_pulse", false },
		{ "esp_target_glow", false }, { "aim_fov_style", "Classic" }, { "aim_fov_anim", "None" },
		{ "aim_fov_fill_style", "None" }, { "aim_fov_rainbow", false },
		{ "crosshair_spin", false }, { "crosshair_pulse", false }, { "crosshair_rainbow", false },
	}
	local optimizeSaved = {}

	---Write a flag through its setter so the menu and the feature both update.
	local function setFlag(flag, value)
		local setter = library.config_flags[flag]
		if setter then
			pcall(setter, value)
		else
			flags[flag] = value
		end
	end

	---Hold every listed setting at its plain value (also catches configs loaded while it's on).
	local function enforceOptimize()
		for _, entry in ipairs(OPTIMIZE_SETTINGS) do
			local flag, value = entry[1], entry[2]
			if flags[flag] ~= value then
				if optimizeSaved[flag] == nil then
					optimizeSaved[flag] = flags[flag] == nil and false or flags[flag]
				end
				setFlag(flag, value)
			end
		end
	end

	---Put back everything Optimize Mode changed.
	local function restoreOptimize()
		for flag, value in pairs(optimizeSaved) do
			setFlag(flag, value)
		end
		table.clear(optimizeSaved)
	end

	section:toggle({
		name = "optimize mode",
		flag = "optimize_mode",
		default = false,
		callback = function(enabled)
			task.defer(function()
				if enabled then
					enforceOptimize()
					library:notification({ text = "Optimize Mode on: effects and animations off.", time = 3 })
				else
					restoreOptimize()
				end
			end)
		end,
	})

	task.spawn(function()
		while isCurrentRun() do
			task.wait(1)
			if flags.optimize_mode == true then
				enforceOptimize()
			end
		end
	end)

	-- Tabbed out: stop drawing the 3D world and drop the frame cap, so the game barely uses the
	-- GPU or CPU in the background. Both come back the moment the window is focused again.
	section:toggle({ name = "pause rendering when tabbed out", flag = "pause_unfocused", default = not Hooks.isMobile })
	section:slider({ name = "fps when tabbed out", flag = "fps_unfocused", min = 0, max = 60, default = 15, interval = 5 })

	local function setFocused(focused)
		if focused then
			pcall(runService.Set3dRenderingEnabled, runService, true)
			applyFpsCap()
			return
		end
		if flags.pause_unfocused then
			pcall(runService.Set3dRenderingEnabled, runService, false)
		end
		if setfpscap and (flags.fps_unfocused or 0) > 0 then
			setfpscap(flags.fps_unfocused)
		end
	end

	library:connection(userInputService.WindowFocusReleased, function()
		setFocused(false)
	end)
	library:connection(userInputService.WindowFocused, function()
		setFocused(true)
	end)
	onUnload(function()
		pcall(runService.Set3dRenderingEnabled, runService, true)
	end)
end)()

-- Mobile (phones and tablets only; PC never sees this): pick which features get an on-screen
-- toggle button, since there are no keybinds on a touch screen.
if Hooks.isMobile and Hooks.rebuildMobileButtons then
	local mobileSection = settingsTab:section({ name = "Mobile", side = "left" })
	local featureNames = {}
	for _, feature in ipairs(features) do
		table.insert(featureNames, feature.name)
	end
	mobileSection:dropdown({
		name = "mobile buttons",
		flag = "mobile_buttons",
		items = featureNames,
		default = { "Ragebot", "Silent Aim", "Aim Lock", "Fly", "Player ESP", "Noclip" },
		multi = true,
		callback = function()
			task.defer(Hooks.rebuildMobileButtons, features)
		end,
	})
	task.defer(Hooks.rebuildMobileButtons, features)
end

do
	-- Menu effects: only shown while the menu is open.
	local menuEffectsSection = settingsTab:section({ name = "Menu Effects", side = "left" })

	menuEffectsSection:toggle({ name = "Background Blur", flag = "menu_blur", default = true })
	menuEffectsSection:slider({ name = "blur size", flag = "menu_blur_size", min = 2, max = 56, default = 18, interval = 1 })
	menuEffectsSection:toggle({ name = "Rainfall", flag = "menu_rainfall", default = true })
	menuEffectsSection:colorpicker({ flag = "menu_rain_color", color = Color3.fromRGB(200, 220, 255) })
	menuEffectsSection:slider({ name = "rain density", flag = "menu_rain_density", min = 10, max = 200, default = 60, interval = 1 })
	-- Holiday decorations start off; turn them on here.
	menuEffectsSection:toggle({ name = "Floating Shapes", flag = "menu_shapes", default = false })
	menuEffectsSection:slider({ name = "shape amount", flag = "menu_shapes_rate", min = 1, max = 30, default = 12, interval = 1, suffix = "/s" })
	menuEffectsSection:toggle({ name = "Bats", flag = "menu_bats", default = false })
	menuEffectsSection:slider({ name = "bat count", flag = "menu_bat_count", min = 1, max = 6, default = 3, interval = 1 })
	menuEffectsSection:toggle({ name = "Jack O Lantern", flag = "menu_pumpkin", default = false })
	menuEffectsSection:toggle({ name = "Holiday Emojis", flag = "menu_emojis", default = false })
	menuEffectsSection:dropdown({
		name = "emoji theme",
		flag = "menu_emoji_theme",
		items = { "Auto", "Halloween", "Christmas", "Valentine's Day", "St. Patrick's Day", "Easter", "Fourth of July", "Thanksgiving", "New Year's Eve" },
		default = "Auto",
	})

	-- Logo look: color, material, outline, shadow and motion.
	local logoSection = settingsTab:section({ name = "Logo", side = "left" })

	logoSection:toggle({ name = "Aqualabs Logo", flag = "menu_logo", default = true })
	-- Header logo: your logo image (default), or an "A" drawn in the theme accent.
	logoSection:toggle({ name = "theme colored logo", flag = "logo_theme_colored", default = true, callback = function()
		refreshHeader()
	end })
	logoSection:colorpicker({ flag = "logo_color", color = Color3.new(1, 1, 1) })
	logoSection:toggle({ name = "match theme colors", flag = "logo_match_theme", default = true })
	logoSection:toggle({ name = "rainbow logo", flag = "logo_rainbow", default = false })
	logoSection:dropdown({
		name = "logo material",
		flag = "logo_material",
		items = { "SmoothPlastic", "Neon", "Glass", "Metal", "ForceField" },
		default = "SmoothPlastic",
	})
	logoSection:dropdown({ name = "logo motion", flag = "logo_motion", items = { "Spin", "Swing", "Float" }, default = "Spin" })
	logoSection:slider({ name = "logo speed", flag = "menu_logo_speed", min = 0.05, max = 2, default = 0.35, interval = 0.05, suffix = "rps" })
	logoSection:slider({ name = "logo size", flag = "logo_size", min = 0.5, max = 1.6, default = 1, interval = 0.05, suffix = "x" })
	logoSection:toggle({ name = "outline", flag = "logo_outline", default = true })
	logoSection:colorpicker({ flag = "logo_outline_color", color = Color3.fromRGB(110, 90, 255) })
	logoSection:slider({ name = "outline thickness", flag = "logo_outline_thickness", min = 0.02, max = 0.3, default = 0.1, interval = 0.01 })
	logoSection:toggle({ name = "drop shadow", flag = "logo_shadow", default = false })

	local RAIN_POOL_SIZE = 200

	local menuFxGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
	menuFxGui.Name = ""
	menuFxGui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
	menuFxGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
	menuFxGui.DisplayOrder = 1
	menuFxGui:SetAttribute("AquaLabs", true)
	menuFxGui.Parent = coreGui

	local menuBlur = Instance.new("BlurEffect")
	menuBlur.Name = ""
	menuBlur.Size = 0
	local menuBlurSize = 0

	-- Rain streaks: a fixed pool, recycled from the top once they fall off screen.
	local rainDrops = {}
	local random = Random.new()

	for index = 1, RAIN_POOL_SIZE do
		local drop = Instance.new("Frame")
		drop.Name = ""
		drop.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0)
		drop.BorderSizePixel = 0
		drop.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 220, 255)
		drop.Rotation = -12
		drop.Visible = false
		drop.Parent = menuFxGui

		local fade = Instance.new("UIGradient")
		fade.Rotation = 90
		fade.Transparency = NumberSequence.new(1, 0.35)
		fade.Parent = drop

		rainDrops[index] = {
			frame = drop,
			x = 0,
			y = 0,
			speed = 0,
		}
	end

	---Send a rain drop back above the screen with a new random lane and speed.
	---@param drop table
	---@param viewport Vector2
	---@param anywhere boolean
	local function resetDrop(drop, viewport, anywhere)
		local length = random:NextInteger(14, 34)

		drop.x = random:NextNumber(-80, viewport.X + 80)
		drop.y = anywhere and random:NextNumber(-viewport.Y, viewport.Y) or random:NextNumber(-120, -length)
		drop.speed = random:NextNumber(700, 1100)
		drop.frame.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(1, length)
		drop.frame.BackgroundTransparency = random:NextNumber(0.2, 0.6)
	end

	-- The "A" logo: three bars in a ViewportFrame, spun in 3D.
	local logoHolder = Instance.new("Frame")
	logoHolder.Name = ""
	logoHolder.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
	logoHolder.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
	logoHolder.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	logoHolder.Visible = false
	logoHolder.Parent = menuFxGui

	-- The "A": each leg runs between two fixed points (foot to apex).
	-- Obfuscation-safe: no negative number literals, no Vector3.zAxis, numbers built at runtime
	-- from strings so CFF/MoonVeil cannot rewrite the geometry.
	local function logoNum(s)
		return (tonumber(s) or 0) + 0
	end

	local function logoV3(x, y, z)
		return Vector3.new(logoNum(x), logoNum(y), logoNum(z))
	end

	-- Coordinates stored as strings so obfuscators cannot flip unary-minus constants.
	local LOGO_APEX = logoV3("0", "2.2", "0")
	local LOGO_LEFT_FOOT = logoV3("-1.5", "-2.15", "0")
	local LOGO_RIGHT_FOOT = logoV3("1.5", "-2.15", "0")
	local LOGO_UP = logoV3("0", "0", "1")

	---Build the white "A" model: two legs meeting at a flat apex, plus the crossbar.
	---@param parent Instance
	---@return Model
	local function buildLogoModel(parent)
		local model = Instance.new("Model")

		local function addBar(sx, sy, sz, cframe)
			local bar = Instance.new("Part")
			bar.Anchored = true
			bar.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
			bar.Color = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
			bar.Size = logoV3(sx, sy, sz)
			bar.CFrame = cframe
			bar.Parent = model
		end

		---A leg from `foot` to the apex: length on Z (the look direction).
		local function addLeg(foot)
			local middle = (foot + LOGO_APEX) * logoNum("0.5")
			local length = (LOGO_APEX - foot).Magnitude
			addBar("1", "0.9", tostring(length), CFrame.lookAt(middle, LOGO_APEX, LOGO_UP))
		end

		addLeg(LOGO_LEFT_FOOT)
		addLeg(LOGO_RIGHT_FOOT)
		addBar("2", "0.7", "0.9", CFrame.new(logoNum("0"), logoNum("-0.4"), logoNum("0")))
		addBar("1.4", "0.6", "0.9", CFrame.new(logoNum("0"), logoNum("1.95"), logoNum("0")))

		-- Pin pivot upright at center so PivotTo spin does not lay the A flat along a leg.
		model.WorldPivot = CFrame.new()

		model.Parent = parent
		return model
	end

	---A viewport layer showing its own copy of the logo.
	---@param flat boolean unlit silhouette (for outline and shadow layers)
	---@return table { viewport, model } (one value: the obfuscated build mixes up multiple returns)
	local function createLogoLayer(flat)
		local viewport = Instance.new("ViewportFrame")
		viewport.Name = ""
		viewport.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
		viewport.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
		viewport.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
		viewport.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		viewport.Ambient = flat and Color3.new(1, 1, 1) or Color3.fromRGB(210, 210, 210)
		viewport.LightColor = flat and Color3.new(0, 0, 0) or Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
		viewport.LightDirection = logoV3("-1", "-1", "-1.5")
		viewport.Parent = logoHolder

		local camera = Instance.new("Camera")
		camera.FieldOfView = 40
		camera.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(logoV3("0", "0", "9"), logoV3("0", "0", "0"))
		camera.Parent = viewport
		viewport.CurrentCamera = camera

		return { viewport = viewport, model = buildLogoModel(viewport) }
	end

	-- Back to front: shadow, outline (a slightly bigger flat copy), then the lit logo.
	local shadowLayer = createLogoLayer(true)
	local outlineLayer = createLogoLayer(true)
	local logoLayer = createLogoLayer(false)
	local shadowViewport, shadowModel = shadowLayer.viewport, shadowLayer.model
	local outlineViewport, outlineModel = outlineLayer.viewport, outlineLayer.model
	local logoViewport, logoModel = logoLayer.viewport, logoLayer.model
	shadowViewport.ImageColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
	shadowViewport.ImageTransparency = 0.55
	shadowViewport.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 4, 0.5, 6)

	local logoAngle = 0
	local logoClock = 0
	local logoMaterial = "SmoothPlastic"
	local currentRainColor = nil
	local rainWasVisible = false
	local FX_STEP = 1 / 60
	local fxElapsed = 0

	library:connection(runService.RenderStepped, function(deltaTime)
		local menuOpen = windowFrame.Visible and windowFrame.Parent ~= nil

		-- Menu closed and everything already faded out: nothing to do this frame.
		if not menuOpen and menuBlurSize == 0 and not rainWasVisible and not logoHolder.Visible then
			return
		end

		-- Ease the blur in and out rather than snapping it; snap to exact values at the ends.
		local targetBlur = (menuOpen and flags.menu_blur and not Hooks.lowPower()) and (flags.menu_blur_size or 18) or 0
		menuBlurSize += (targetBlur - menuBlurSize) * math.min(deltaTime * 10, 1)
		if math.abs(targetBlur - menuBlurSize) < 0.05 then
			menuBlurSize = targetBlur
		end

		local blurSize = math.floor(menuBlurSize * 10) / 10
		if menuBlur.Size ~= blurSize then
			menuBlur.Size = blurSize
		end

		local blurParent = menuBlurSize > 0.5 and lightingService or nil
		if menuBlur.Parent ~= blurParent then
			menuBlur.Parent = blurParent
		end

		-- Logo and rain move at 60 Hz: each move redraws the whole effects layer, and at high
		-- frame rates that cost more than it showed.
		fxElapsed += deltaTime
		if fxElapsed < (Hooks.lowPower() and 1 / 30 or FX_STEP) then
			return
		end
		deltaTime = math.min(fxElapsed, 0.1)
		fxElapsed = 0

		-- Logo sits in the middle of the screen while the menu is open.
		local showLogo = menuOpen and flags.menu_logo == true
		if logoHolder.Visible ~= showLogo then
			logoHolder.Visible = showLogo
		end

		if showLogo then
			-- LPH-safe logo motion (no virtualize-sensitive closures on the hot path).
			local screen = workspace.CurrentCamera.ViewportSize
			local logoSize = math.clamp(math.min(screen.X, screen.Y) * 0.26, 90, 320) * (flags.logo_size or 1)
			logoHolder.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(logoSize, logoSize)

			local speed = flags.menu_logo_speed or 0.35
			logoClock = logoClock + deltaTime
			logoAngle = (logoAngle + deltaTime * speed * 6.283185307179586) % 6.283185307179586

			local motion = flags.logo_motion or "Spin"
			local pivot
			local sc = logoClock
			local sa = logoAngle
			local sp = speed

			if motion == "Swing" then
				pivot = CFrame.Angles(0, math.sin(sc * sp * 6.283185307179586) * 0.75, 0)
			elseif motion == "Float" then
				pivot = CFrame.new(0, math.sin(sc * 2) * 0.25, 0)
					* CFrame.Angles(math.sin(sc * 1.3) * 0.1, math.sin(sc * sp * 3.141592653589793) * 0.4, 0)
			else
				pivot = CFrame.Angles(math.sin(sa * 2) * 0.12, sa, 0)
			end

			-- Only layers that are showing need to move (each viewport re-renders when its model moves).
			local showOutline = flags.logo_outline == true
			local showShadow = flags.logo_shadow == true

			if outlineViewport.Visible ~= showOutline then
				outlineViewport.Visible = showOutline
			end

			if shadowViewport.Visible ~= showShadow then
				shadowViewport.Visible = showShadow
			end

			logoModel:PivotTo(pivot)

			if showOutline then
				outlineModel:PivotTo(pivot)

				local outlineScale = 1 + (flags.logo_outline_thickness or 0.1)
				if math.abs(outlineModel:GetScale() - outlineScale) > 0.001 then
					outlineModel:ScaleTo(outlineScale)
				end

				-- Matching the theme keeps a clean black outline around the accent-colored "A".
				outlineViewport.ImageColor3 = flags.logo_rainbow and getRainbow(0.25, 0.5)
					or (flags.logo_match_theme and Color3.new(0, 0, 0))
					or (flags.logo_outline_color and flags.logo_outline_color.Color or Color3.fromRGB(110, 90, 255))
			end

			if showShadow then
				shadowModel:PivotTo(pivot)
			end

			-- Color, rainbow and material (material only when it changes).
			logoViewport.ImageColor3 = flags.logo_rainbow and getRainbow(0.25)
				or (flags.logo_match_theme and getAccent())
				or (flags.logo_color and flags.logo_color.Color or Color3.new(1, 1, 1))

			local materialName = flags.logo_material or "SmoothPlastic"
			if materialName ~= logoMaterial then
				logoMaterial = materialName
				for _, bar in ipairs(logoModel:GetChildren()) do
					bar.Material = Enum.Material[materialName]
				end
			end
		end

		-- Rainfall streaks; visibility and color are only written when they change.
		local rainVisible = menuOpen and flags.menu_rainfall == true and not Hooks.lowPower()
		local viewport = workspace.CurrentCamera.ViewportSize
		local activeDrops = rainVisible and math.floor(flags.menu_rain_density or 90) or 0
		local rainColor = flags.menu_rain_color and flags.menu_rain_color.Color or Color3.fromRGB(200, 220, 255)
		local recolor = rainColor ~= currentRainColor
		currentRainColor = rainColor

		for index, drop in ipairs(rainDrops) do
			local active = index <= activeDrops

			if active ~= drop.active then
				drop.active = active
				drop.frame.Visible = active

				if active then
					resetDrop(drop, viewport, true)
				end
			end

			if recolor then
				drop.frame.BackgroundColor3 = rainColor
			end

			if active then
				drop.y += drop.speed * deltaTime
				drop.x += drop.speed * deltaTime * 0.21

				if drop.y > viewport.Y then
					resetDrop(drop, viewport, false)
				end

				drop.frame.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(math.floor(drop.x), math.floor(drop.y))
			end
		end

		rainWasVisible = rainVisible
	end)

	table.insert(worldCleanupTasks, function()
		menuBlur:Destroy()
		menuFxGui:Destroy()
	end)
end

-- Menu decorations (Settings > Menu Effects), only while the menu is open: shapes that drift off
-- the menu's edges and fade, bats flapping around it, and a candle-lit jack-o'-lantern on its corner.
local function buildMenuDecorations()
	local tweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
	local guiService = game:GetService("GuiService")
	local random = Random.new()

	---A full-screen gui in CoreGui at a draw order.
	local function overlay(displayOrder)
		local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
		gui.Name = ""
		gui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
		gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
		gui.DisplayOrder = displayOrder
		gui:SetAttribute("AquaLabs", true)
		gui.Parent = coreGui
		return gui
	end

	-- Shapes drift out from under the menu; bats and the pumpkin sit on top of it.
	local underGui = overlay(1)
	local overGui = overlay(1000001)

	---Instance helper.
	local function make(className, properties)
		local object = Instance.new(className)
		for key, value in pairs(properties) do
			object[key] = value
		end
		return object
	end

	---The menu's top-left corner and size in screen pixels.
	local function menuRect()
		local position = windowFrame.AbsolutePosition
		if not library.gui.IgnoreGuiInset then
			position += guiService:GetGuiInset()
		end
		return position, windowFrame.AbsoluteSize
	end

	-- Floating shapes ------------------------------------------------------------------------
	local SHAPES = { "circle", "diamond", "ring", "square", "plus", "spark" }
	local shapeClock = 0
	local liveShapes = 0

	---One shape at `position`, made of frames so it can fade as a whole.
	local function makeShape(kind, size, color)
		local holder = make("Frame", { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(size, size), AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), BackgroundTransparency = 1 })
		local fading = {}

		local function solid(parent, properties)
			local frame = make("Frame", { Parent = parent, BorderSizePixel = 0, BackgroundColor3 = color })
			for key, value in pairs(properties) do
				frame[key] = value
			end
			table.insert(fading, { frame, "BackgroundTransparency" })
			return frame
		end

		if kind == "circle" or kind == "diamond" then
			local frame = solid(holder, { Size = UDim2.fromScale(kind == "diamond" and 0.7 or 1, kind == "diamond" and 0.7 or 1),
				AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5), Rotation = kind == "diamond" and 45 or 0 })
			if kind == "circle" then
				make("UICorner", { Parent = frame, CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0) })
			end
		elseif kind == "ring" or kind == "square" then
			local frame = make("Frame", { Parent = holder, Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), BackgroundTransparency = 1 })
			local stroke = make("UIStroke", { Parent = frame, Color = color, Thickness = 1.5 })
			table.insert(fading, { stroke, "Transparency" })
			if kind == "ring" then
				make("UICorner", { Parent = frame, CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0) })
			end
		else
			-- Plus (upright) or spark (turned 45 degrees): two crossed bars.
			local turn = kind == "spark" and 45 or 0
			for _, bar in ipairs({ Vector2.new(1, 0.22), Vector2.new(0.22, 1) }) do
				solid(holder, { Size = UDim2.fromScale(bar.X, bar.Y), AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
					Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5), Rotation = turn })
			end
		end
		return holder, fading
	end

	---Launch one shape from a random point on the menu's edge, drifting outward as it fades.
	local function spawnShape(position, size)
		local edge = random:NextInteger(1, 4)
		local along = random:NextNumber()
		local start, outward
		if edge == 1 then
			start, outward = position + Vector2.new(size.X * along, 0), Vector2.new(0, -1)
		elseif edge == 2 then
			start, outward = position + Vector2.new(size.X, size.Y * along), Vector2.new(1, 0)
		elseif edge == 3 then
			start, outward = position + Vector2.new(size.X * along, size.Y), Vector2.new(0, 1)
		else
			start, outward = position + Vector2.new(0, size.Y * along), Vector2.new(-1, 0)
		end

		local color = getAccent():Lerp(Color3.new(1, 1, 1), random:NextNumber(0, 0.45))
		local holder, fading = makeShape(SHAPES[random:NextInteger(1, #SHAPES)], random:NextInteger(5, 13), color)
		holder.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(start.X, start.Y)
		holder.Rotation = random:NextNumber(0, 360)
		holder.Parent = underGui
		liveShapes += 1

		local life = random:NextNumber(1.2, 2)
		local drift = outward * random:NextNumber(30, 80) + Vector2.new(random:NextNumber(-20, 20), random:NextNumber(-25, 5))
		local info = TweenInfo.new(life, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
		tweenService:Create(holder, info, {
			Position = UDim2.fromOffset(start.X + drift.X, start.Y + drift.Y),
			Rotation = holder.Rotation + random:NextNumber(-180, 180),
			Size = holder.Size + UDim2.fromOffset(4, 4),
		}):Play()
		for _, entry in ipairs(fading) do
			tweenService:Create(entry[1], TweenInfo.new(life, Enum.EasingStyle.Sine, Enum.EasingDirection.In), { [entry[2]] = 1 }):Play()
		end
		task.delay(life, function()
			holder:Destroy()
			liveShapes -= 1
		end)
	end

	-- Bats --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	local BAT_COLOR = Color3.fromRGB(78, 68, 82)
	local bats = {}

	---A small bat: round body, two ears, and two-part wings that flap.
	local function makeBat()
		local holder = make("Frame", { Parent = overGui, Size = UDim2.fromOffset(40, 24), AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), BackgroundTransparency = 1 })
		local function piece(properties)
			local frame = make("Frame", { Parent = holder, BorderSizePixel = 0, BackgroundColor3 = BAT_COLOR, AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5) })
			for key, value in pairs(properties) do
				frame[key] = value
			end
			return frame
		end

		local body = piece({ Size = UDim2.fromOffset(8, 10), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.55), ZIndex = 2 })
		make("UICorner", { Parent = body, CornerRadius = UDim.new(0.5, 0) })
		piece({ Size = UDim2.fromOffset(3, 4), Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -2, 0.55, -6), Rotation = 340, ZIndex = 2 })
		piece({ Size = UDim2.fromOffset(3, 4), Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 2, 0.55, -6), Rotation = 20, ZIndex = 2 })

		local bat = { holder = holder, wings = {} }
		for _, side in ipairs({ -1, 1 }) do
			local inner = piece({ Size = UDim2.fromOffset(9, 3) })
			local outer = piece({ Size = UDim2.fromOffset(9, 3) })
			make("UICorner", { Parent = outer, CornerRadius = UDim.new(0.5, 0) })
			table.insert(bat.wings, { side = side, inner = inner, outer = outer })
		end

		bat.phase = random:NextNumber(0, math.pi * 2)
		bat.speed = random:NextNumber(0.25, 0.45) * (random:NextNumber() < 0.5 and -1 or 1)
		bat.flap = random:NextNumber(11, 15)
		return bat
	end

	---Pose the wings: each wing bends at its middle, flapping between up and down.
	local function poseBat(bat, now)
		local flap = math.sin(now * bat.flap + bat.phase)
		for _, wing in ipairs(bat.wings) do
			-- Angle measured from straight out to the side; negative is up.
			local innerAngle = math.rad(-35 * flap - 5)
			local outerAngle = innerAngle + math.rad(-25 * flap + 15)
			local shoulder = Vector2.new(20 + 3 * wing.side, 13)
			local innerDirection = Vector2.new(math.cos(innerAngle) * wing.side, math.sin(innerAngle))
			local elbow = shoulder + innerDirection * 9
			local outerDirection = Vector2.new(math.cos(outerAngle) * wing.side, math.sin(outerAngle))

			local innerCenter = shoulder + innerDirection * 4.5
			local outerCenter = elbow + outerDirection * 4.5
			wing.inner.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(innerCenter.X, innerCenter.Y)
			wing.inner.Rotation = math.deg(math.atan2(innerDirection.Y, innerDirection.X))
			wing.outer.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(outerCenter.X, outerCenter.Y)
			wing.outer.Rotation = math.deg(math.atan2(outerDirection.Y, outerDirection.X))
		end
	end

	-- Jack-o'-lantern --------------------------------------------------------------------------
	-- Parented to the menu itself, so it stays perfectly still in the bottom-right corner while you
	-- drag. Built at full size and scaled down, so every carved detail shrinks with it.
	local pumpkin = make("Frame", {
		Parent = windowFrame,
		Size = UDim2.fromOffset(46, 40),
		AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 1),
		Position = UDim2.new(1, -3, 1, -2),
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		Visible = false,
		ZIndex = 100,
	})
	make("UIScale", { Parent = pumpkin, Scale = 0.42 })
	local glow = make("ImageLabel", {
		Parent = pumpkin,
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		Image = GLOW_IMAGE,
		ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Slice,
		SliceCenter = Rect.new(Vector2.new(21, 21), Vector2.new(79, 79)),
		Position = UDim2.fromOffset(-18, -14),
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 36, 1, 30),
		ImageColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 160, 40),
	})
	local pumpkinBody = make("Frame", {
		Parent = pumpkin,
		Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 6),
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, -6),
		BorderSizePixel = 0,
		BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(226, 112, 24),
		ZIndex = 2,
	})
	make("UICorner", { Parent = pumpkinBody, CornerRadius = UDim.new(0.45, 0) })
	-- Ridges down the pumpkin.
	for _, x in ipairs({ 0.3, 0.7 }) do
		local ridge = make("Frame", {
			Parent = pumpkinBody,
			AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
			Position = UDim2.fromScale(x, 0.5),
			Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.08, 0.86),
			BorderSizePixel = 0,
			BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(190, 88, 16),
			ZIndex = 2,
		})
		make("UICorner", { Parent = ridge, CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0) })
	end
	local stem = make("Frame", {
		Parent = pumpkin,
		AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0),
		Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0),
		Size = UDim2.fromOffset(5, 9),
		Rotation = 12,
		BorderSizePixel = 0,
		BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(88, 110, 40),
		ZIndex = 1,
	})
	make("UICorner", { Parent = stem, CornerRadius = UDim.new(0.4, 0) })

	-- Carved face: eyes, nose and a toothy grin, lit from inside by the candle.
	local face = {}
	local function carve(x, y, width, height, rotation)
		local cut = make("Frame", {
			Parent = pumpkinBody,
			AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
			Position = UDim2.fromScale(x, y),
			Size = UDim2.fromOffset(width, height),
			Rotation = rotation or 0,
			BorderSizePixel = 0,
			ZIndex = 3,
		})
		table.insert(face, cut)
		return cut
	end
	carve(0.3, 0.36, 7, 7, 45)
	carve(0.7, 0.36, 7, 7, 45)
	carve(0.5, 0.54, 4, 4, 45)
	make("UICorner", { Parent = carve(0.5, 0.74, 22, 6), CornerRadius = UDim.new(0.5, 0) })
	-- Teeth cut back into the grin.
	for _, x in ipairs({ 0.4, 0.6 }) do
		make("Frame", {
			Parent = pumpkinBody,
			AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0),
			Position = UDim2.new(x, 0, 0.74, -3),
			Size = UDim2.fromOffset(3, 3),
			BorderSizePixel = 0,
			BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(226, 112, 24),
			ZIndex = 4,
		})
	end

	local DARK_FACE = Color3.fromRGB(60, 24, 4)
	local LIT_FACE = Color3.fromRGB(255, 214, 96)

	-- Holiday emojis --------------------------------------------------------------------------
	local EMOJI_SETS = {
		["Halloween"] = { "🎃", "👻", "🦇", "🕷️", "🍬", "💀" },
		["Christmas"] = { "🎄", "🎅", "❄️", "🎁", "⛄", "🔔" },
		["Valentine's Day"] = { "❤️", "💘", "💖", "🌹", "💌", "💕" },
		["St. Patrick's Day"] = { "🍀", "☘️", "🌈", "💰", "🎩", "🪙" },
		["Easter"] = { "🐰", "🥚", "🐣", "🌷", "🌸", "🧺" },
		["Fourth of July"] = { "🎆", "🇺🇸", "🎇", "⭐", "🦅", "🧨" },
		["Thanksgiving"] = { "🦃", "🍂", "🥧", "🌽", "🍁", "🍗" },
		["New Year's Eve"] = { "🎉", "🥂", "🎆", "✨", "🎊", "🕛" },
	}
	-- "Auto" follows the holiday theme you applied, or the month when that's Default.
	local MONTH_HOLIDAYS = {
		[1] = "New Year's Eve", [2] = "Valentine's Day", [3] = "St. Patrick's Day", [4] = "Easter",
		[5] = "Easter", [6] = "Fourth of July", [7] = "Fourth of July", [8] = "Halloween",
		[9] = "Halloween", [10] = "Halloween", [11] = "Thanksgiving", [12] = "Christmas",
	}
	local emojiClock, liveEmojis = 0, 0

	local function emojiSet()
		local theme = flags.menu_emoji_theme or "Auto"
		if theme == "Auto" then
			theme = EMOJI_SETS[flags.holiday_theme or ""] and flags.holiday_theme or MONTH_HOLIDAYS[tonumber(os.date("%m"))]
		end
		return EMOJI_SETS[theme] or EMOJI_SETS.Halloween
	end

	---One emoji that pops in at the menu's edge, floats up with a little sway, and fades away.
	local function spawnEmoji(position, size)
		local set = emojiSet()
		local start = position + Vector2.new(random:NextNumber(-20, size.X + 20), random:NextNumber(size.Y * 0.2, size.Y + 10))
		-- Mostly from the sides and bottom, so they float up past the menu.
		if random:NextNumber() < 0.6 then
			start = Vector2.new(random:NextNumber() < 0.5 and position.X - random:NextNumber(10, 34) or position.X + size.X + random:NextNumber(10, 34), start.Y)
		end
		local label = make("TextLabel", {
			Parent = overGui,
			AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
			Position = UDim2.fromOffset(start.X, start.Y),
			Size = UDim2.fromOffset(30, 30),
			BackgroundTransparency = 1,
			Text = set[random:NextInteger(1, #set)],
			TextScaled = true,
			TextTransparency = 1,
			Rotation = random:NextNumber(-15, 15),
		})
		liveEmojis += 1
		local life = random:NextNumber(2.2, 3.4)
		local rise = random:NextNumber(50, 110)
		local sway = random:NextNumber(-25, 25)
		local scale = make("UIScale", { Parent = label, Scale = 0.3 })
		tweenService:Create(scale, TweenInfo.new(0.35, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), { Scale = random:NextNumber(0.6, 1) }):Play()
		tweenService:Create(label, TweenInfo.new(0.3), { TextTransparency = 0 }):Play()
		tweenService:Create(label, TweenInfo.new(life, Enum.EasingStyle.Sine, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
			Position = UDim2.fromOffset(start.X + sway, start.Y - rise),
			Rotation = label.Rotation + random:NextNumber(-30, 30),
		}):Play()
		task.delay(life * 0.6, function()
			if label.Parent then
				tweenService:Create(label, TweenInfo.new(life * 0.4), { TextTransparency = 1 }):Play()
			end
		end)
		task.delay(life, function()
			label:Destroy()
			liveEmojis -= 1
		end)
	end

	-- Every frame -------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	local decorElapsed, flickerAt = 0, 0
	library:connection(runService.RenderStepped, function(deltaTime)
		-- Performance mode: shapes, emojis and bats stay off (the pumpkin stays, it's cheap).
		local lowPower = Hooks.lowPower()
		local menuOpen = windowFrame.Visible and windowFrame.Parent ~= nil
		local decorOpen = menuOpen and not lowPower
		local position, size = menuRect()
		local now = os.clock()

		-- Shapes: a steady trickle while the menu is open.
		if decorOpen and flags.menu_shapes ~= false then
			shapeClock += deltaTime
			local interval = 1 / math.max(flags.menu_shapes_rate or 12, 1)
			while shapeClock >= interval and liveShapes < 60 do
				shapeClock -= interval
				spawnShape(position, size)
			end
			shapeClock = math.min(shapeClock, interval)
		else
			shapeClock = 0
		end

		-- Holiday emojis: a few at a time drifting up around the menu.
		if decorOpen and flags.menu_emojis ~= false then
			emojiClock += deltaTime
			while emojiClock >= 0.45 and liveEmojis < 14 do
				emojiClock -= 0.45
				spawnEmoji(position, size)
			end
			emojiClock = math.min(emojiClock, 0.45)
		else
			emojiClock = 0
		end

		-- Bats move at 60 Hz and the candle flickers at 30 Hz. The pumpkin lives in the menu, so
		-- each flicker redraws the whole menu; every frame was far more than the eye needs.
		decorElapsed += deltaTime
		if decorElapsed < 1 / 60 then
			return
		end
		decorElapsed = 0

		-- Bats: circle the menu on wobbly paths, flapping.
		local wanted = (decorOpen and flags.menu_bats ~= false) and math.floor(flags.menu_bat_count or 3) or 0
		while #bats < wanted do
			table.insert(bats, makeBat())
		end
		while #bats > wanted do
			table.remove(bats).holder:Destroy()
		end
		local center = position + size / 2
		for index, bat in ipairs(bats) do
			local angle = now * bat.speed + bat.phase + index * 2.1
			local radius = size / 2 + Vector2.new(34 + math.sin(now * 0.9 + index) * 14, 26 + math.cos(now * 1.1 + index) * 10)
			local point = center + Vector2.new(math.cos(angle) * radius.X, math.sin(angle) * radius.Y)
				+ Vector2.new(0, math.sin(now * 3 + bat.phase) * 6)
			bat.holder.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(point.X, point.Y)
			bat.holder.Rotation = math.sin(now * 2 + bat.phase) * 10
			poseBat(bat, now)
		end

		-- Pumpkin: perched on the menu's top-right corner, its face flickering like a candle,
		-- swelling to a bright glow now and then and settling back.
		local showPumpkin = menuOpen and flags.menu_pumpkin ~= false
		if pumpkin.Visible ~= showPumpkin then
			pumpkin.Visible = showPumpkin
		end
		if showPumpkin and now - flickerAt >= 1 / 30 then
			flickerAt = now
			local swell = (math.sin(now * 0.7) + 1) / 2
			local flicker = math.noise(now * 6, 0.5) * 0.5 + math.noise(now * 13, 3.2) * 0.25
			local light = math.clamp(0.25 + swell * 0.6 + flicker, 0, 1)
			local faceColor = DARK_FACE:Lerp(LIT_FACE, light)
			for _, cut in ipairs(face) do
				cut.BackgroundColor3 = faceColor
			end
			glow.ImageTransparency = 1 + light * 0.75 * NEG_ONE
		end
	end)

	onUnload(function()
		underGui:Destroy()
		overGui:Destroy()
	end)
end

buildMenuDecorations()

		})

createLabel(themesSection, "Drop .ttf/.otf into Aqua Lab/fonts")

do
	-- Holiday themes: one click recolors the menu, logo, crosshair, ESP, self visuals and (optionally) the world.
	local HOLIDAYS = {
		["Valentine's Day"] = {
			accent = { 255, 90, 150 }, glow = { 255, 120, 170 }, background = { 30, 18, 24 }, element = { 52, 30, 40 },
			border = { 12, 6, 9 }, text = { 255, 220, 230 }, outline = { 60, 30, 45 }, inline = { 120, 50, 80 },
			contrast = { 70, 30, 50 }, logo = { 255, 190, 215 }, logoOutline = { 255, 60, 130 }, effect = { 255, 150, 190 },
			second = { 255, 60, 110 }, tint = { 255, 225, 238 }, sky = "Pink",
		},
		["St. Patrick's Day"] = {
			accent = { 60, 200, 90 }, glow = { 255, 200, 60 }, background = { 16, 28, 18 }, element = { 30, 52, 34 },
			border = { 6, 12, 7 }, text = { 210, 255, 215 }, outline = { 25, 55, 30 }, inline = { 40, 110, 55 },
			contrast = { 25, 70, 35 }, logo = { 110, 235, 130 }, logoOutline = { 255, 200, 60 }, effect = { 120, 255, 150 },
			second = { 255, 200, 60 }, tint = { 220, 255, 222 }, sky = "Clouds",
		},
		["Easter"] = {
			accent = { 180, 140, 255 }, glow = { 255, 200, 120 }, background = { 30, 28, 36 }, element = { 52, 48, 62 },
			border = { 10, 9, 12 }, text = { 245, 240, 255 }, outline = { 70, 60, 90 }, inline = { 130, 110, 170 },
			contrast = { 60, 55, 80 }, logo = { 255, 240, 170 }, logoOutline = { 170, 140, 255 }, effect = { 255, 200, 230 },
			second = { 150, 230, 200 }, tint = { 250, 242, 255 }, sky = "Clear Blue",
		},
		["Fourth of July"] = {
			accent = { 60, 120, 255 }, glow = { 255, 60, 60 }, background = { 16, 20, 34 }, element = { 32, 38, 60 },
			border = { 6, 8, 14 }, text = { 255, 255, 255 }, outline = { 40, 50, 90 }, inline = { 200, 50, 60 },
			contrast = { 30, 40, 80 }, logo = { 255, 255, 255 }, logoOutline = { 220, 40, 50 }, effect = { 255, 255, 255 },
			second = { 220, 40, 50 }, tint = { 235, 240, 255 }, sky = "Night",
		},
		["Halloween"] = {
			accent = { 255, 130, 20 }, glow = { 160, 60, 255 }, background = { 20, 14, 10 }, element = { 40, 26, 16 },
			border = { 8, 5, 3 }, text = { 255, 210, 160 }, outline = { 60, 35, 20 }, inline = { 130, 60, 200 },
			contrast = { 60, 30, 10 }, logo = { 255, 145, 35 }, logoOutline = { 0, 0, 0 }, effect = { 255, 150, 60 },
			second = { 150, 60, 255 }, tint = { 255, 205, 160 }, sky = "Scary Red",
		},
		["Thanksgiving"] = {
			accent = { 220, 120, 40 }, glow = { 200, 80, 30 }, background = { 28, 20, 14 }, element = { 50, 36, 24 },
			border = { 10, 7, 5 }, text = { 255, 230, 200 }, outline = { 70, 45, 25 }, inline = { 160, 90, 40 },
			contrast = { 80, 50, 20 }, logo = { 255, 200, 120 }, logoOutline = { 180, 70, 20 }, effect = { 230, 150, 80 },

			contrast = { 30, 70, 40 }, logo = { 255, 255, 255 }, logoOutline = { 220, 40, 50 }, effect = { 255, 255, 255 },
			second = { 40, 200, 90 }, tint = { 232, 245, 255 }, sky = "Night", snow = true,
		},
