			border = { 5, 5, 8 }, text = { 255, 245, 220 }, outline = { 50, 45, 70 }, inline = { 180, 150, 60 },
			contrast = { 40, 35, 60 }, logo = { 255, 215, 90 }, logoOutline = { 255, 255, 255 }, effect = { 255, 220, 120 },
			second = { 200, 170, 255 }, tint = { 255, 246, 228 }, sky = "Galaxy", snow = true,
		},
		["Default"] = {
			accent = { 100, 100, 255 }, glow = { 100, 100, 255 }, background = { 26, 26, 26 }, element = { 38, 38, 38 },
			border = { 8, 8, 8 }, text = { 170, 170, 170 }, outline = { 32, 32, 38 }, inline = { 60, 55, 75 },
			contrast = { 35, 35, 47 }, logo = { 255, 255, 255 }, logoOutline = { 110, 90, 255 }, effect = { 200, 220, 255 },
			second = { 80, 200, 255 }, tint = { 255, 255, 255 },
		},
	}

	local HOLIDAY_ORDER = {
		"Default",
		"Valentine's Day",
		"St. Patrick's Day",
		"Easter",
		"Fourth of July",
		"Halloween",
		"Thanksgiving",
		"Christmas",
		"New Year's Eve",
	}

	---Set a colorpicker flag through its setter so the UI and callbacks stay in sync.
	---@param flag string
	---@param rgb table
	local function setColorFlag(flag, rgb)
		local setter = library.config_flags[flag]
		if setter then
			setter(Color3.fromRGB(rgb[1], rgb[2], rgb[3]), 1)
		end
	end

	---Apply a holiday palette across the whole script.
	---@param name string
	local function applyHoliday(name)
		local holiday = HOLIDAYS[name]
		if not holiday then
			return
		end

		-- Menu.
		setColorFlag("theme_accent", holiday.accent)
		setColorFlag("theme_glow", holiday.glow)
		setColorFlag("theme_background", holiday.background)
		setColorFlag("theme_element", holiday.element)
		setColorFlag("theme_border", holiday.border)
		setColorFlag("theme_text", holiday.text)
		setColorFlag("theme_outline", holiday.outline)
		setColorFlag("theme_inline", holiday.inline)
		setColorFlag("theme_contrast", holiday.contrast)

		-- Logo, menu rain and crosshair.
		setColorFlag("logo_color", holiday.logo)
		setColorFlag("logo_outline_color", holiday.logoOutline)
		setColorFlag("menu_rain_color", holiday.effect)
		setColorFlag("crosshair_color", holiday.accent)

		-- ESP and self visuals.
		setColorFlag("esp_box_color", holiday.accent)
		setColorFlag("esp_fill_bottom", holiday.accent)
		setColorFlag("esp_fill_top", holiday.second)
		setColorFlag("esp_chams_fill", holiday.accent)
		setColorFlag("esp_tracer_color", holiday.accent)
		setColorFlag("self_chams_fill", holiday.accent)
		setColorFlag("self_material_color", holiday.accent)
		setColorFlag("tool_color", holiday.second)
		setColorFlag("self_trail_start", holiday.accent)
		setColorFlag("self_trail_end", holiday.second)
		setColorFlag("self_trail_right_start", holiday.second)
		setColorFlag("self_trail_right_end", holiday.accent)

		-- Weather particles.
		setColorFlag("world_rain_color", holiday.effect)
		setColorFlag("world_snow_color", holiday.effect)
		setColorFlag("world_heavy_rain_color", holiday.effect)

		-- World: tint, matching sky and holiday snow.
		if flags.holiday_world and name ~= "Default" then
			setColorFlag("world_color_tint", holiday.tint)
			library.config_flags.world_color_correction(true)

			if holiday.sky and library.config_flags.world_skybox_preset then
				library.config_flags.world_skybox_preset(holiday.sky)
				library.config_flags.world_skybox(true)
			end

			if holiday.snow then
				library.config_flags.world_snow(true)
			end
		end

		library:notification({ text = name == "Default" and "Theme reset." or ("Happy " .. name .. "!") })
	end

	local holidaySection = settingsTab:section({ name = "Holiday Themes", side = "right" })

	holidaySection:dropdown({ name = "holiday", flag = "holiday_theme", items = HOLIDAY_ORDER, default = "Default" })
	holidaySection:toggle({ name = "apply to world too", flag = "holiday_world", default = true })
	holidaySection:button({
		name = "Apply holiday theme",
		callback = function()
			applyHoliday(flags.holiday_theme or "Default")
		end,
	})

	-- Rainbow accent: cycles the menu's accent and glow colors.
	holidaySection:toggle({
		name = "rainbow accent",
		flag = "theme_rainbow",
		default = false,
		callback = function(enabled)
			if not enabled and flags.theme_accent then
				library:update_theme("accent", flags.theme_accent.Color)
				library:update_theme("glow", flags.theme_glow and flags.theme_glow.Color or flags.theme_accent.Color)
			end
		end,
	})
	holidaySection:slider({ name = "rainbow speed", flag = "theme_rainbow_speed", min = 0.02, max = 1, default = 0.15, interval = 0.01 })

	task.spawn(function()
		while isCurrentRun() and watermarkHolder.Parent do
			task.wait(0.05)
			if not isCurrentRun() then
				break
			end

			if flags.theme_rainbow then
				local color = getRainbow(flags.theme_rainbow_speed or 0.15)
				library:update_theme("accent", color)
				library:update_theme("glow", color)
			end
		end
	end)
end

-- Background: any Creator Store 2D decal (or a file in the workspace) behind the menu.
local backgroundSection = settingsTab:section({ name = "Background", side = "right" })
local backgroundResults = {}

-- Panels we made see-through for the background, with their original transparency.
local translucentPanels = {}

---Make the menu's dark panels see-through so the background shows behind every control,
---or put them back. Bright accents (toggle checks, slider fills) are left solid.
---@param enabled boolean
local function setPanelsTranslucent(enabled)
	local amount = flags.theme_panel_transparency or 0.35

	if not enabled then
		for panel, original in pairs(translucentPanels) do
			if panel.Parent then
				panel.BackgroundTransparency = original
			end
		end

		table.clear(translucentPanels)
		return
	end

	-- The menu, plus the watermark and keybind panels when the overlay option is on.
	local roots = { windowFrame }
	for tab in pairs(library.parked_tabs) do
		table.insert(roots, tab)
	end
	if flags.theme_background_overlays ~= false then
		for _, panel in ipairs(overlayPanels) do
			table.insert(roots, panel.holder)
		end
	end

	for _, root in ipairs(roots) do
		for _, object in ipairs(root:GetDescendants()) do
			if not object:IsA("GuiObject") or object == backgroundImage or object:IsA("ImageLabel") then
				continue
			end

			local original = translucentPanels[object] or object.BackgroundTransparency
			if original >= 1 then
				continue
			end

			local _, _, brightness = object.BackgroundColor3:ToHSV()
			if brightness > 0.3 then
				continue
			end

			translucentPanels[object] = original
			object.BackgroundTransparency = math.max(original, amount)
		end
	end
end

---Show the same background on the watermark, keybind panels, and target info card.
local function syncOverlayBackgrounds()
	local show = flags.theme_background_overlays ~= false and backgroundImage.Image ~= ""
	local panelAlpha = tonumber(flags.theme_panel_transparency) or 0.35

	for _, panel in ipairs(overlayPanels) do
		local img = panel.image
		if img then
			pcall(function()
				img.Image = show and backgroundImage.Image or ""
				img.ImageTransparency = backgroundImage.ImageTransparency
				img.ScaleType = backgroundImage.ScaleType
			end)
		end
		if panel.dim then
			pcall(function()
				panel.dim.BackgroundTransparency = show and math.clamp(panelAlpha, 0.2, 0.9) or 0
			end)
		end
		-- Outer holder frames (watermark shell / target card) go see-through too.
		if panel.holder and panel.holder:IsA("GuiObject") then
			pcall(function()
				if show and panel.dim then
					panel.holder.BackgroundTransparency = math.clamp(panelAlpha, 0.2, 0.9)
				elseif not show and panel.dim then
					panel.holder.BackgroundTransparency = 0
				end
			end)
		end
	end
	pcall(function()
		if Hooks.refreshTargetInfoBackground then
			Hooks.refreshTargetInfoBackground()
		end
	end)
end

-- The image fills the whole window behind everything.
backgroundImage.Parent = windowInner
backgroundImage.ZIndex = 0
backgroundImage.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)

---Apply a background from a decal id, image id, store link or workspace file path.
---@param input string
local function applyBackground(input)
	if not input or input == "" then
		backgroundImage.Image = ""
		setPanelsTranslucent(false)
		syncOverlayBackgrounds()
		return
	end

	if isfile(input) then
		backgroundImage.Image = getcustomasset(input)
		setPanelsTranslucent(true)
		syncOverlayBackgrounds()
		return
	end

	task.spawn(function()
		local image = resolveImage(input)
		backgroundImage.Image = image
		setPanelsTranslucent(image ~= "")
		syncOverlayBackgrounds()
	end)
end

onUnload(function()
	setPanelsTranslucent(false)
end)

	flag = "theme_background_image",

-- Client: which executor is running the script, what device you're on, and your kills.
local function buildClientInfo()
	local section = settingsTab:section({ name = "Client", side = "right" })

	local executor = "unknown"
	pcall(function()
		local name = select(1, identifyexecutor())
		-- Name only (drop version tags like V253 / 1.2.0).
		executor = tostring(name or "unknown"):gsub("%s+[Vv]?%d[%w%.%-]*$", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")
		if executor == "" then
			executor = tostring(name)
		end
	end)

	-- Device: the reported platform when the executor allows it, otherwise from input type.
	local device = "PC"
	local platformOk, platform = pcall(function()
		return userInputService:GetPlatform()
	end)
	if platformOk and typeof(platform) == "EnumItem" and platform ~= Enum.Platform.None then
		device = platform.Name
	elseif userInputService.GamepadEnabled and not userInputService.KeyboardEnabled then
		device = "Console"
	elseif Hooks.isMobile then
		device = "Mobile"
	end
	-- Phones and tablets: "Mobile (Android)", "Mobile (IOS)" and so on.
	if Hooks.isMobile and not string.find(device, "Mobile") then
		device = (device == "PC" or device == "Windows") and "Mobile" or ("Mobile (" .. device .. ")")
	end

	createLabel(section, "Executor: " .. executor)
	createLabel(section, "Device: " .. device)
	local killsLabel = createLabel(section, "Kills this session: 0")

	task.spawn(function()
		while isCurrentRun() and watermarkHolder.Parent do
			task.wait(0.5)
			killsLabel.Text = "Kills This Session: " .. (Hooks.myKills or 0)
		end
	end)
end

buildClientInfo()

-- Custom cursor drawn on top of the menu. Some executors' Drawing objects reject properties,
-- so each one is set safely (an error here used to stop the script loading).
local cursorFill = Drawing.new("Triangle")
local cursorOutline = Drawing.new("Triangle")
pcall(function()
	cursorFill.Filled = true
	cursorFill.ZIndex = 2
end)
pcall(function()
	cursorOutline.Filled = false
	cursorOutline.Thickness = 1
	cursorOutline.Color = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
	cursorOutline.ZIndex = 3
end)

local notificationOrder = {}

library:connection(runService.RenderStepped, function(deltaTime)
	frameCounter += 1

	-- No cursor on touch screens. Kept apart from the notifications below: a Drawing error on
	-- some executors used to stop this whole function, so notifications never moved or left.
	pcall(function()
		local shouldShow = flags.custom_cursor and windowFrame.Visible and not Hooks.isMobile or false

		if shouldShow ~= cursorVisible then
			cursorVisible = shouldShow
			userInputService.MouseIconEnabled = not shouldShow
		end

		cursorFill.Visible = shouldShow
		cursorOutline.Visible = shouldShow

		if shouldShow then
			local mousePosition = userInputService:GetMouseLocation()
			local pointA = mousePosition
			local pointB = mousePosition + Vector2.new(0, 15)
			local pointC = mousePosition + Vector2.new(10, 11)

			cursorFill.Color = flags.theme_accent and flags.theme_accent.Color or Color3.fromRGB(100, 100, 255)
			cursorFill.PointA, cursorFill.PointB, cursorFill.PointC = pointA, pointB, pointC
			cursorOutline.PointA, cursorOutline.PointB, cursorOutline.PointC = pointA, pointB, pointC
		end
	end)

	-- Notifications are stacked here instead of by the library: it frees a slot while the
	-- old notification is still fading out, so the next one landed on top of it. A slot is
	-- only freed once the notification is actually gone, and moves glide into place.
	for _, holder in ipairs(library.notifications) do
		if not trackedNotifications[holder] then
			trackedNotifications[holder] = true
			table.insert(notificationOrder, holder)
		end
	end

	-- Backup removal: a notification still on screen 2 seconds after it should have faded out
	-- is removed here (on some executors the library's own timer never removed it).
	local now = os.clock()
	for index = #notificationOrder, 1, -1 do
		local holder = notificationOrder[index]
		local expires = library.notificationExpiry and library.notificationExpiry[holder]
		if holder.Parent and expires and now > expires then
			local slot = table.find(library.notifications, holder)
			if slot then
				table.remove(library.notifications, slot)
			end
			pcall(holder.Destroy, holder)
		end
		if not holder.Parent then
			table.remove(notificationOrder, index)
		end
	end

	local onRight = flags.notification_side == "Right"
	local blend = math.min(1, deltaTime * 14)

	for index, holder in ipairs(notificationOrder) do
		local targetY = 72 + (index - 1) * 28
		local y = holder.Position.Y.Offset
		y = math.abs(targetY - y) < 0.5 and targetY or y + (targetY - y) * blend

		if onRight then
			-- Mirror the slide-in to the right edge.
			local width = holder.AbsoluteSize.X
			local anchor = holder.AnchorPoint.X
			local target = UDim2.new(1, -20 - width + 2 * anchor * width, 0, y)
			if holder.Position ~= target then
				holder.Position = target
			end
		elseif holder.Position ~= UDim2.new(0, 20, 0, y) then
			holder.Position = UDim2.new(0, 20, 0, y)
		end
	end
end)

-- Keep new UI elements (dropdown lists, notifications) on the current theme.
library:connection(library.gui.DescendantAdded, function(object)
	task.defer(function()
		if not object.Parent then
			return
		end

		applyShade(object)
		applyFont(object)
	end)
end)

-- Feature keybinds and the menu bind, handled here so each bind has its own state.
library:connection(userInputService.InputBegan, function(input, gameProcessed)
	if gameProcessed then
		return
	end

	local menuBind = flags.menu_bind
	if type(menuBind) == "table" and matchesKey(menuBind.key, input) and menuBind.key == menuBindKey then
		window.set_menu_visibility(not windowFrame.Visible)
	end

	for _, feature in ipairs(features) do
		local bind = flags[feature.bindFlag]
		if type(bind) ~= "table" or not matchesKey(bind.key, input) then
			continue
		end

		-- Ignore the key press that was used to set the bind.
		if bind.key ~= feature.lastKey then
			continue
		end

		if bind.mode == "toggle" then
			setFeature(feature, not flags[feature.flag])
		elseif bind.mode == "hold" then
			setFeature(feature, true)
		end
	end
end)

library:connection(userInputService.InputEnded, function(input)
	for _, feature in ipairs(features) do
		local bind = flags[feature.bindFlag]
		if type(bind) == "table" and bind.mode == "hold" and matchesKey(bind.key, input) then
			setFeature(feature, false)
		end
	end
end)

-- Twice a second: overlays, server info, "always" binds and settled keys.
task.spawn(function()
	local elapsed = 0

	while isCurrentRun() and watermarkHolder.Parent do
		task.wait(0.5)
		if not isCurrentRun() then
			break
		end
		elapsed += 0.5

		if elapsed >= 1 then
			framesPerSecond = frameCounter
			frameCounter = 0
			elapsed = 0
		end

		local ping = math.floor(localPlayer:GetNetworkPing() * 1000)
		local playerCount = #playersService:GetPlayers()
		-- Other Aqua Lab users in this server.
		local aquaUsers = 0
		for _, player in ipairs(playersService:GetPlayers()) do
			if Hooks.isAquaLabsUser(player) then
				aquaUsers += 1
			end
		end

		if Hooks.isMobile then
			-- Phones: the short version, so it fits the screen.
			watermarkText.Text = string.format(
				"%s | %d fps | %d/%d | <font color=\"#64ffc8\">%d aqua</font> | %d kills",
				Hooks.brandText(),
				framesPerSecond,
				playerCount,
				playersService.MaxPlayers,
				aquaUsers,
				Hooks.myKills or 0
			)
		else
			watermarkText.Text = string.format(
				"%s | %d fps | %d ms | %d/%d players | <font color=\"#64ffc8\">%d aqua users</font> | %d kills | %s",
				Hooks.brandText(),
				framesPerSecond,
				ping,
				playerCount,
				playersService.MaxPlayers,
				aquaUsers,
				Hooks.myKills or 0,
				getEasternTime()
			)
		end
		watermarkText.TextColor3 = getTextColor()
		keybindTitle.TextColor3 = getTextColor()
		headerGameName = serverInfo.game
		refreshHeader()

		local sessionSeconds = math.floor(workspace.DistributedGameTime)
		local sessionText = string.format(
			"Time in server: %02d:%02d:%02d",
			sessionSeconds // 3600,
			sessionSeconds % 3600 // 60,
			sessionSeconds % 60
		)

		for _, labels in ipairs(serverLabelSets) do
			labels.game.Text = "Game: " .. serverInfo.game
			labels.players.Text = string.format("Players: %d/%d", playerCount, playersService.MaxPlayers)
			labels.session.Text = sessionText
			labels.ping.Text = string.format("Ping: %d ms", ping)
			labels.region.Text = "Your region: " .. serverInfo.region
		end

		local menuBind = flags.menu_bind
		menuBindKey = type(menuBind) == "table" and menuBind.key or nil

		for _, feature in ipairs(features) do
			local bind = flags[feature.bindFlag]
			if type(bind) ~= "table" then
				continue
			end

			feature.lastKey = bind.key

			if bind.mode == "always" then
				setFeature(feature, true)
			end
		end

		refreshKeybindList()
	end
end)

end)

end)

-- Menu layout: every tab's sections, top to bottom, in each column. Sections are built all over the
-- script, so this pass at the end puts them in a tidy order (related things together, the main
-- toggle of each group first, the two columns about the same length). A section not listed here
-- stays where it was, below the listed ones.
do
	local LAYOUT = {
		{
			tab = mainTab,
			left = { "Movement", "Humanoid", "Void", "Teleports" },
			right = { "Character", "Fake Position", "Orbit", "World Tweaks" },
		},
		{
			tab = Tabs.combat,
			left = { "Silent Aim", "Target Filters", "Combat Filters", "Aim Lock", "Triggerbot", "Hitbox Assist" },
			right = { "Ragebot", "Ragebot With Wallbang 2", "Weapon Tuning", "Quick Swap", "FOV Circle", "FOV Effects" },
		},
		{
			tab = Tabs.esp,
			left = { "Players", "Box Effects", "Health Bar", "Skeleton", "Text", "Tracers" },
			right = { "Chams", "Preview", "Enemy Material", "Target ESP", "C4 ESP", "Box Image", "Filters" },
		},
		{
			tab = Tabs.visuals,
			left = { "Cosmetics", "Self Chams", "Self Material", "Aura", "Trail", "Character Ring", "First Person",
				"Custom Force Fields", "Spawn & Death Effects" },
			right = { "Crosshair", "Tool Visuals", "Bullet Tracers", "Kill & Hit Feedback", "Target Effects",
				"Csgo Kill Feed", "Radar", "Sonar", "Stretch Res" },
		},
		{
			tab = Tabs.world,
			left = { "Lighting", "Color Correction", "Atmosphere", "X-Ray", "Anti Void" },
			right = { "Skybox", "Shaders", "Bloom & Sun Rays", "Weather", "Camera" },
		},
		{
			tab = Tabs.misc,
			left = { "Get Weapons", "Auto Heal", "Items", "Team & Respawn" },
			right = { "Player Tools", "Vehicles", "Sounds" },
		},
		{
			tab = settingsTab,
			left = { "Menu", "Themes", "Holiday Themes", "Background", "Logo", "Menu Effects" },
			right = { "Configuration", "Performance", "Player Alerts", "Discord", "Mobile", "Client", "Server" },
		},
	}

	local registry = library.sectionRegistry or {}

	---A section by name: from this tab if it has one, otherwise from any tab except Players and
	---Premium (their "Players" and "Orbit" sections stay put).
	local function findSection(tab, name)
		if registry[tab] and registry[tab][name] then
			return registry[tab][name]
		end
		for owner, sections in pairs(registry) do
			if owner ~= Tabs.players and owner ~= Tabs.premium and sections[name] then
				return sections[name]
			end
		end
		return nil
	end

	---The section's outer frame (the one sitting directly in a tab column).
	local function sectionFrame(section)
		local frame = section.holder
		while frame and frame.Parent and not frame.Parent:IsA("ScrollingFrame") do
			frame = frame.Parent
		end
		return frame
	end

	for _, page in ipairs(LAYOUT) do
		for _, side in ipairs({ "left", "right" }) do
			local column = page.tab and page.tab[side]
			for order, name in ipairs(column and page[side] or {}) do
				local section = findSection(page.tab, name)
				local frame = section and sectionFrame(section)
				if frame then
					frame.Parent = column
					frame.LayoutOrder = order
				end
			end
		end
		-- Anything left in this tab that the list doesn't mention goes after the listed ones.
		for _, side in ipairs({ "left", "right" }) do
			local column = page.tab and page.tab[side]
			for _, child in ipairs(column and column:GetChildren() or {}) do
				if child:IsA("GuiObject") and child.LayoutOrder == 0 then
					child.LayoutOrder = 100
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

mainTab.open_tab()

-- Park every tab except the open one (the library brings them back when they're opened).
do
	local tabs = { mainTab, Tabs.combat, Tabs.esp, Tabs.visuals, Tabs.world, Tabs.misc, Tabs.players, Tabs.premium, settingsTab }
	library.tab_home = mainTab.column_holder.Parent.Parent
	for _, tab in ipairs(tabs) do
		local frame = tab and tab.column_holder and tab.column_holder.Parent
		if frame and frame ~= library.current_tab[2] then
			library.parked_tabs[frame] = true
			frame.Parent = nil
		end
	end
	onUnload(function()
		library.tab_home = nil
		for frame in pairs(library.parked_tabs) do
			frame:Destroy()
		end
	end)

	-- Closed popups (dropdown lists, color pickers, keybind menus: ~350 of them, 6000 objects)
	-- are parked the same way, coming back the moment one is shown.
	for _, popup in ipairs(library.gui:GetChildren()) do
		if popup == windowFrame or windowFrame:IsDescendantOf(popup) or not popup:IsA("GuiObject") then
			continue
		end
		local function follow()
			local show = popup.Visible
			library.parked_popups[popup] = not show or nil
			popup.Parent = show and library.gui or nil
		end
		library:connection(popup:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Visible"), function()
			if library.gui and library.gui.Parent then
				follow()
			end
		end)
		if not popup.Visible then
			follow()
		end
	end
	onUnload(function()
		for popup in pairs(library.parked_popups) do
			popup:Destroy()
		end
	end)
end

-- Hand off from the intro to the menu.
Intro.finish(function()
	-- Always open on the main tab.
	pcall(mainTab.open_tab)
	window.set_menu_visibility(true)
end)


-- Self auras (Visuals > Aura): Halo, Angel Wings, Galaxy Orbit, Fire Aura and Star Ring. Each is
-- glowing energy made of beams and particles that spins around you (only you see them):
--   Halo         two tilted rings above your head, each with a bright comet head trailing
--                glitter, chasing each other in opposite directions around a soft inner ring.
--   Angel Wings  feathered energy wings from your back, every feather arched and fading to its
--                tip, flapping, with sparkles falling off the wing tips.
--   Galaxy Orbit three tilted orbits around your body, each carrying a glowing planet with a
--                comet tail, inside a cloud of star dust.
--   Fire Aura    three flame strands twisting up around you from your feet, with flames and
--                embers rising.
--   Star Ring    a spinning vortex on the ground: spiral arms swirling into a bright core, an
--                outer ring, and light rising from the middle.
-- Comet tails cost nothing per frame: each ring segment keeps a fixed fade, and the ring itself
-- is turned, so the bright head moves around without rebuilding any beams.
do
	local WHITE = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
	local SPARKLE = "rbxasset://textures/particles/sparkles_main.dds"
	local FIRE = "rbxasset://textures/particles/fire_main.dds"
	local TAU = math.pi * 2

	-- Every attachment hangs off one invisible part at the world origin, so attachment positions
	-- are world positions.
	local anchor = Instance.new("Part")
	anchor.Name = ""
	anchor.Anchored = true
	anchor.CanCollide = false
	anchor.CanQuery = false
	anchor.CanTouch = false
	anchor.Transparency = 1
	anchor.Size = Vector3.one * 0.05
	anchor.CFrame = CFrame.identity
	anchor.Parent = workspace

	local function point()
		local attachment = Instance.new("Attachment")
		attachment.Parent = anchor
		return attachment
	end

	local function beam(a0, a1, width0, width1, transparency)
		local object = Instance.new("Beam")
		object.Attachment0, object.Attachment1 = a0, a1
		object.Width0, object.Width1 = width0, width1
		object.FaceCamera = true
		object.LightEmission = 1
		object.LightInfluence = 0
		object.Segments = 1
		object.Transparency = NumberSequence.new(transparency)
		object.Parent = anchor
		return object
	end

	local function emitter(parent, properties)
		local object = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
		object.LightEmission = 1
		object.LightInfluence = 0
		for key, value in pairs(properties) do
			object[key] = value
		end
		object.Parent = parent
		return object
	end

	---A ring of `count` segments. With `comet`, segment 1 is the bright head and the rest fade
	---behind it; otherwise every segment shares `fade`.
	local function newRing(count, width, comet, fade)
		local ring = { points = {}, beams = {}, count = count }
		for index = 1, count do
			ring.points[index] = point()
		end
		for index = 1, count do
			local t = (index - 1) / count
			local transparency = comet and math.clamp(t * 0.98, 0, 0.98) or fade
			local w0 = comet and width * (1 + t * 0.75 * NEG_ONE) or width
			local w1 = comet and width * (1 + (t + 1 / count) * 0.75 * NEG_ONE) or width
			ring.beams[index] = beam(ring.points[index], ring.points[index % count + 1], w0, w1, transparency)
		end
		return ring
	end

	---Lay a ring flat in `frame`'s XZ plane at `radius`, turned to `spin` (the head leads).
	local function placeRing(ring, frame, radius, spin)
		for index, attachment in ipairs(ring.points) do
			local angle = spin + (index - 1) / ring.count * TAU * NEG_ONE
			attachment.Position = (frame * CFrame.new(math.cos(angle) * radius, 0, math.sin(angle) * radius)).Position
		end
	end

	---Recolor a group of beams, only when the colors actually change.
	local function paint(group, first, second)
		local key = first:ToHex() .. second:ToHex()
		if group.colorKey == key then
			return
		end
		group.colorKey = key
		local sequence = ColorSequence.new(first, second)
		for _, object in ipairs(group.beams) do
			object.Color = sequence
		end
	end

	---Remove everything an effect made.
	local function destroyEffect(effect)
		for _, object in ipairs(effect.instances) do
			object:Destroy()
		end
	end

	---Track every instance an effect makes so it can be removed in one go.
	local function collect(effect, ...)
		for _, object in ipairs({ ... }) do
			table.insert(effect.instances, object)
		end
	end

	local function collectRing(effect, ring)
		for _, attachment in ipairs(ring.points) do
			table.insert(effect.instances, attachment)
		end
		for _, object in ipairs(ring.beams) do
			table.insert(effect.instances, object)
			table.insert(effect.beams, object)
		end
	end

	local function colorOf(flag, fallback)
		return flags[flag] and flags[flag].Color or fallback
	end

	local EFFECTS = {}

	-- Halo --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	-- Built from smooth solid rings (not beam segments, which looked like a caterpillar from above):
	-- a thin blazing white-gold band, a soft golden glow hugging it, and a wide faint aura of light
	-- fading out around it, stacked like layers of light. Two glints glide around the band shedding
	-- glitter, holy dust drifts down from it, and the whole thing breathes, floats and sways,
	-- tipped back a little like it rests behind the head.
	local HALO_LAYERS = {
		-- outer radius, inner radius, thickness, transparency (at full glow), whiteness
		{ name = "aura", outer = 1.7, inner = 0.45, height = 0.01, fade = 0.9, white = 0.15 },
		{ name = "glow", outer = 1.36, inner = 0.76, height = 0.025, fade = 0.72, white = 0.35 },
		{ name = "rim", outer = 1.16, inner = 0.9, height = 0.06, fade = 0.4, white = 0.55 },
		{ name = "core", outer = 1.09, inner = 0.97, height = 0.12, fade = 0, white = 0.82 },
	}

	EFFECTS.halo = {
		flag = "self_halo",
		build = function(effect)
			effect.layers = {}
			for _, layer in ipairs(HALO_LAYERS) do
				local ring = Instance.new("CylinderHandleAdornment")
				ring.Name = ""
				ring.Adornee = anchor
				ring.AlwaysOnTop = false
				ring.ZIndex = 1
				ring.Parent = anchor
				collect(effect, ring)
				table.insert(effect.layers, { ring = ring, layer = layer })
			end
			-- Two glints riding the band, each shedding glitter.
			effect.glints = {}
			for index = 1, 2 do
				local glint = Instance.new("SphereHandleAdornment")
				glint.Name = ""
				glint.Adornee = anchor
				glint.Parent = anchor
				local spot = point()
				local glitter = emitter(spot, {
					Texture = SPARKLE,
					Rate = 18,
					Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.4, 0.8),
					Speed = NumberRange.new(0.05, 0.25),
					SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(180, 180),
					Rotation = NumberRange.new(0, 360),
					RotSpeed = NumberRange.new(-90, 90),
					Size = NumberSequence.new({ NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.28), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0) }),
					Transparency = NumberSequence.new(0, 1),
				})
				collect(effect, glint, spot, glitter)
				effect.glints[index] = { glint = glint, spot = spot, glitter = glitter }
			end
			-- Holy dust: soft motes drifting down from the halo.
			effect.center = point()
			effect.dust = emitter(effect.center, {
				Texture = SPARKLE,
				Rate = 10,
				Lifetime = NumberRange.new(1.4, 2.2),
				Speed = NumberRange.new(0.2, 0.5),
				SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(180, 180),
				Acceleration = Vector3.new(0, NEG_ONE * 0.6, 0),
				Drag = 1,
				Rotation = NumberRange.new(0, 360),
				Size = NumberSequence.new({ NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.25, 0.16), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0) }),
				Transparency = NumberSequence.new({ NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 1), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.2, 0.2), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1) }),
			})
			effect.light = Instance.new("PointLight")
			effect.light.Range, effect.light.Brightness, effect.light.Shadows = 10, 2, false
			effect.light.Parent = effect.center
			collect(effect, effect.center, effect.dust, effect.light)
		end,
		update = function(effect, character, root, now)
			local head = character:FindFirstChild("Head") or root
			local color = colorOf("self_halo_color", Color3.fromRGB(255, 220, 80))
			local size = math.clamp(flags.self_halo_size or 1, 0.4, 3)
			local bob = math.sin(now * 1.4) * 0.07
			local center = head.Position + Vector3.new(0, (flags.self_halo_height or 2.25) - 1.2 + bob, 0)
			local yaw = select(2, root.CFrame:ToOrientation())
			-- Tipped back like it rests behind the head, swaying slowly.
			local frame = CFrame.new(center) * CFrame.Angles(0, yaw, 0)
				* CFrame.Angles(math.rad(12 + math.sin(now * 0.8) * 2), 0, math.rad(math.sin(now * 0.6) * 2.5))
			-- Ring adornments stand along their look vector; turn them to lie flat in the halo's plane.
			local flat = frame * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(90), 0, 0)
			local pulse = 0.5 + 0.5 * math.sin(now * 2)

			for _, entry in ipairs(effect.layers) do
				local ring, layer = entry.ring, entry.layer
				ring.CFrame = flat
				ring.Radius = layer.outer * size
				ring.InnerRadius = layer.inner * size
				ring.Height = layer.height * size
				ring.Color3 = color:Lerp(WHITE, layer.white)
				-- The glow layers breathe; the core stays blazing.
				ring.Transparency = layer.fade == 0 and 0 or math.min(layer.fade + (1 - layer.fade) * 0.35 * (1 - pulse), 0.97)
			end

			for index, entry in ipairs(effect.glints) do
				local angle = now * 1.3 + (index - 1) * math.pi
				local position = (frame * CFrame.new(math.cos(angle) * 1.03 * size, 0, math.sin(angle) * 1.03 * size)).Position
				entry.glint.CFrame = CFrame.new(position)
				entry.glint.Radius = 0.11 * size * (0.85 + 0.3 * pulse)
				entry.glint.Color3 = WHITE
				entry.glint.Transparency = 0.05
				entry.spot.Position = position
				entry.glitter.Color = ColorSequence.new(WHITE, color:Lerp(WHITE, 0.4))
			end

			effect.center.Position = center
			effect.dust.Color = ColorSequence.new(WHITE, color)
			effect.light.Color = color:Lerp(WHITE, 0.3)
			effect.light.Brightness = 1.6 + pulse * 0.9
		end,
	}

	-- Angel wings -------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	-- A real wing rig: an arm (shoulder, elbow, wrist, tip) with four feather layers hanging off it
	-- (long primaries fanned from the wrist, secondaries along the forearm, tertials by the body
	-- and short coverts over the top). Every feather arches and runs from a white root to a
	-- colored tip. The flap is a quick downstroke that fans the feathers open and a slower
	-- upstroke that folds the wing at the wrist, with a soft glide between beats.
	local WING_LAYERS = {
		-- name, count, where on the arm (from, to), length (first, last), width, droop (first, last)
		-- Dense and overlapping so the wing reads as one full surface, not separate spikes.
		{ name = "primaries", count = 11, from = 3, to = 3, length = { 3.5, 2.3 }, width = 0.46, droop = { 0.05, 0.72 } },
		{ name = "secondaries", count = 11, from = 2, to = 2.97, length = { 2.45, 2.05 }, width = 0.54, droop = { 0.76, 0.9 } },
		{ name = "tertials", count = 7, from = 1.0, to = 1.95, length = { 2.1, 1.4 }, width = 0.54, droop = { 0.9, 1 } },
		{ name = "coverts", count = 13, from = 1.05, to = 2.95, length = { 1.35, 1.05 }, width = 0.55, droop = { 0.8, 0.86 }, covert = true },
		{ name = "marginals", count = 11, from = 1.0, to = 2.95, length = { 0.75, 0.6 }, width = 0.5, droop = { 0.6, 0.7 }, covert = true },
	}

	---A direction out from your back: `elevation` up from level, `back` swept behind you.
	local function wingDirection(side, elevation, back)
		return Vector3.new(side * math.cos(elevation) * math.cos(back), math.sin(elevation), math.cos(elevation) * math.sin(back))
	end

	EFFECTS.wings = {
		flag = "self_wings",
		build = function(effect)
			effect.sides = {}
			-- NEG_ONE, not a -1 literal: the obfuscator flipped it to 1 and both wings grew on one side.
			for _, side in ipairs({ NEG_ONE, 1 }) do
				local wing = { side = side, joints = {}, feathers = {}, edges = {} }
				-- Shoulder, elbow, wrist, tip.
				for index = 1, 4 do
					wing.joints[index] = point()
					collect(effect, wing.joints[index])
				end
				-- Glowing leading edge along the arm.
				for index = 1, 3 do
					local edge = beam(wing.joints[index], wing.joints[index + 1], 0.22 + index * 0.04 * NEG_ONE, 0.18 + index * 0.05 * NEG_ONE, 0)
					collect(effect, edge)
					table.insert(wing.edges, edge)
				end
				for layerIndex, layer in ipairs(WING_LAYERS) do
					for index = 1, layer.count do
						local t = layer.count > 1 and (index - 1) / (layer.count - 1) or 0
						local feather = {
							layer = layer, t = t, layerIndex = layerIndex,
							root = point(), mid = point(), tip = point(),
						}
						local width = layer.width * (1 + t * 0.25 * NEG_ONE)
						feather.inner = beam(feather.root, feather.mid, width * 0.75, width, 0)
						-- Rounded tips (not needle points) so neighbours overlap into a full edge.
						feather.outer = beam(feather.mid, feather.tip, width, width * (layer.covert and 0.6 or 0.3), 0)
						collect(effect, feather.root, feather.mid, feather.tip, feather.inner, feather.outer)
						table.insert(wing.feathers, feather)
					end
				end
				-- Sparkles streaming off the two longest primaries, and loose glowing down drifting away.
				for _, feather in ipairs({ wing.feathers[1], wing.feathers[3] }) do
					collect(effect, emitter(feather.tip, {
						Texture = SPARKLE,
						Rate = 22,
						Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.7, 1.3),
						Speed = NumberRange.new(0.3, 1.2),
						Acceleration = Vector3.new(0, 1.5 * NEG_ONE, 0),
						SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(70, 70),
						Rotation = NumberRange.new(0, 360),
						RotSpeed = NumberRange.new(120 * NEG_ONE, 120),
						Size = NumberSequence.new({ NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.32), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0) }),
						Transparency = NumberSequence.new(0.05, 1),
					}))
				end
				wing.down = emitter(wing.joints[3], {
					Texture = SPARKLE,
					Rate = 5,
					Lifetime = NumberRange.new(1.4, 2.2),
					Speed = NumberRange.new(0.2, 0.6),
					Acceleration = Vector3.new(0, 0.8 * NEG_ONE, 0),
					SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(180, 180),
					Rotation = NumberRange.new(0, 360),
					RotSpeed = NumberRange.new(60 * NEG_ONE, 60),
					Size = NumberSequence.new({ NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.5), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, 0.35), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0) }),
					Transparency = NumberSequence.new({ NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 1), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.2, 0.3), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1) }),
				})
				collect(effect, wing.down)
				wing.light = Instance.new("PointLight")
				wing.light.Range, wing.light.Brightness, wing.light.Shadows = 9, 1.4, false
				wing.light.Parent = wing.joints[3]
				collect(effect, wing.light)
				table.insert(effect.sides, wing)
			end
		end,
		update = function(effect, character, root, now)
			local color = colorOf("self_wings_color", Color3.fromRGB(255, 160, 255))
			local size = flags.self_wings_size or 1
			local speed = flags.self_wings_flap or 3.2
			local visibility = 1 - math.clamp(flags.self_wings_visibility or 0.9, 0, 1)
			local torso = character:FindFirstChild("Torso") or character:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso") or root
			local base = torso.CFrame

			-- Wingbeat: a fast downstroke and slower upstroke (the phase is squashed so down takes
			-- about 40% of the beat), easing into a short glide every few beats.
			local phase = now * speed
			local beat = math.sin(phase + 0.45 * math.sin(phase))
			local glide = math.clamp(math.sin(now * speed * 0.25) * 1.6, 0, 1)
			local flap = beat * (1 + glide * 0.7 * NEG_ONE)
			-- How strongly the wing is moving down right now (0 on the way up, 1 mid-downstroke).
			-- Everything below blends with it: the feathers used to snap between fanned and tucked,
			-- and the wrist fold jumped 28° in one frame, twice a beat, which read as a glitch.
			local velocity = math.cos(phase + 0.45 * math.sin(phase))
			local down = math.clamp(velocity * 2.5 * NEG_ONE, 0, 1)
			down = down * down * (3 + 2 * down * NEG_ONE)
			-- Feathers fan open on the way down and tuck in on the way up.
			local spread = 0.55 + 0.45 * down
			-- The wrist folds on the upstroke.
			local fold = math.rad(28) * (1 - glide) * (1 - down)

			-- Colors and fades only change when the settings do.
			local styleKey = color:ToHex() .. visibility
			local repaint = effect.styleKey ~= styleKey
			effect.styleKey = styleKey
			local rootColor = WHITE:Lerp(color, 0.25)

			for _, wing in ipairs(effect.sides) do
				local side = wing.side
				local shoulder = Vector3.new(side * 0.42, 0.6, 0.55)
				local upperDir = wingDirection(side, math.rad(22 + flap * 32), math.rad(22 + flap * 8 * NEG_ONE))
				local elbow = shoulder + upperDir * 1.35 * size
				local foreDir = wingDirection(side, math.rad(12 + flap * 40) + fold * 0.5 * NEG_ONE, math.rad(18 + fold * 40))
				local wrist = elbow + foreDir * 1.55 * size
				local handDir = wingDirection(side, math.rad(4 + flap * 46) + fold * NEG_ONE, math.rad(8 + fold * 70))
				local tip = wrist + handDir * 1.1 * size
				local joints = { shoulder, elbow, wrist, tip }
				for index, position in ipairs(joints) do
					wing.joints[index].Position = base:PointToWorldSpace(position)
				end

				-- Where along the arm (1 = shoulder ... 3 = wrist) and the arm's heading there. One table,
				-- not two return values (the obfuscated build mixes up multiple returns).
				local function along(at)
					if at <= 2 then
						return { position = shoulder:Lerp(elbow, at + NEG_ONE), direction = upperDir }
					end
					return { position = elbow:Lerp(wrist, math.min(at + 2 * NEG_ONE, 1)), direction = foreDir }
				end
				-- Feathers hang down and back from the arm.
				local hang = Vector3.new(side * 0.12, NEG_ONE, 0.42).Unit

				for _, feather in ipairs(wing.feathers) do
					local layer, t = feather.layer, feather.t
					local rootPosition, armDir
					if layer.name == "primaries" then
						rootPosition = wrist + handDir * 0.25 * size
						armDir = handDir
					else
						local spot = along(layer.from + (layer.to + layer.from * NEG_ONE) * t)
						rootPosition, armDir = spot.position, spot.direction
					end
					local droop = layer.droop[1] + (layer.droop[2] + layer.droop[1] * NEG_ONE) * t
					if layer.name == "primaries" then
						-- Fan: the leading primary follows the hand, the rest swing down behind it.
						droop *= spread
					end
					-- (A zero-length blend would give NaN and make a feather vanish for a frame.)
					local blended = armDir:Lerp(hang, droop)
					local direction = blended.Magnitude > 0.001 and blended.Unit or hang
					local length = (layer.length[1] + (layer.length[2] + layer.length[1] * NEG_ONE) * t) * size
					-- Coverts sit on top, so they lie a touch above and behind the arm.
					if layer.covert then
						rootPosition += Vector3.new(0, 0.12, 0.1)
					end
					-- A gentle arch: the middle bows back and up.
					local mid = rootPosition + direction * length * 0.52 + Vector3.new(0, 0.12, 0.18) * length * 0.3
					feather.root.Position = base:PointToWorldSpace(rootPosition)
					feather.mid.Position = base:PointToWorldSpace(mid)
					feather.tip.Position = base:PointToWorldSpace(rootPosition + direction * length)

					if repaint then
						local tipColor = layer.covert and WHITE:Lerp(color, 0.55) or color
						feather.inner.Color = ColorSequence.new(rootColor, WHITE:Lerp(tipColor, 0.7))
						feather.outer.Color = ColorSequence.new(WHITE:Lerp(tipColor, 0.7), tipColor)
						local layerFade = visibility + (1 - visibility) * (layer.covert and 0.15 or 0)
						feather.inner.Transparency = NumberSequence.new(layerFade)
						feather.outer.Transparency = NumberSequence.new(layerFade, math.min(layerFade + (1 - layerFade) * 0.3, 1))
					end
				end

				if repaint then
					for _, edge in ipairs(wing.edges) do
						edge.Color = ColorSequence.new(WHITE, WHITE:Lerp(color, 0.4))
						edge.Transparency = NumberSequence.new(visibility)
					end
					wing.light.Color = color
					wing.down.Color = ColorSequence.new(WHITE, color)
				end
				-- The glow pulses with each downstroke.
				wing.light.Brightness = 1.4 + 0.8 * down
			end
		end,
	}
	-- Galaxy orbit -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
	EFFECTS.galaxy = {
		flag = "self_galaxy_orbit",
		build = function(effect)
			effect.orbits = {}
			for index = 1, 3 do
				local ring = newRing(36, 0.16, true)
				collectRing(effect, ring)
				local planet = Instance.new("Part")
				planet.Name = ""
				planet.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
				planet.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
				planet.Size = Vector3.one * (index == 1 and 0.55 or 0.38)
				planet.Anchored, planet.CanCollide, planet.CanQuery, planet.CanTouch, planet.CastShadow = true, false, false, false, false
				planet.Parent = anchor
				local light = Instance.new("PointLight")
				light.Range, light.Brightness, light.Shadows = 6, 1.2, false
				light.Parent = planet
				collect(effect, planet)
				table.insert(effect.orbits, { ring = ring, planet = planet, light = light, tilt = index })
			end
			-- Star dust around you.
			effect.dust = point()
			collect(effect, effect.dust, emitter(effect.dust, {
				Texture = SPARKLE,
				Rate = 30,
				Lifetime = NumberRange.new(1.2, 2.2),
				Speed = NumberRange.new(0.3, 1.2),
				SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(180, 180),
				Drag = 1.5,
				Size = NumberSequence.new({ NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.3, 0.22), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0) }),
				Transparency = NumberSequence.new(0.2, 1),
			}))
		end,
		update = function(effect, character, root, now)
			local color = colorOf("self_galaxy_color", Color3.fromRGB(255, 90, 255))
			local second = Color3.fromHSV((now * 0.05) % 1, 0.7, 1):Lerp(color, 0.4)
			local speed = flags.self_galaxy_speed or 1
			local radius = (flags.self_galaxy_size or 5) * 0.55
			effect.dust.Position = root.Position
			for index, orbit in ipairs(effect.orbits) do
				local tilt = CFrame.Angles(math.rad(25 + index * 32), math.rad(index * 60 + now * 8), math.rad(index * 20))
				local frame = CFrame.new(root.Position) * tilt
				local spin = now * speed * (1.4 + index * 0.45) * (index % 2 == 0 and -1 or 1)
				placeRing(orbit.ring, frame, radius * (0.8 + index * 0.18), spin)
				orbit.planet.CFrame = CFrame.new(orbit.ring.points[1].Position)
				orbit.planet.Color = index == 1 and color or second
				orbit.light.Color = orbit.planet.Color
			end
			paint(effect, WHITE:Lerp(color, 0.5), second)
		end,
	}

	-- Fire aura ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	local STRAND_POINTS = 14
	EFFECTS.fire = {
		flag = "self_fire_aura",
		build = function(effect)
			effect.strands = {}
			for strandIndex = 1, 3 do
				local strand = { points = {} }
				for index = 1, STRAND_POINTS do
					strand.points[index] = point()
					collect(effect, strand.points[index])
				end
				for index = 1, STRAND_POINTS - 1 do
					local t = (index - 1) / (STRAND_POINTS - 1)
					local object = beam(strand.points[index], strand.points[index + 1], 0.55 + t * 0.4 * NEG_ONE, 0.5 + t * 0.42 * NEG_ONE, 0.1 + t * 0.8)
					collect(effect, object)
					table.insert(effect.beams, object)
				end
				table.insert(effect.strands, strand)
			end
			effect.base = point()
			collect(effect, effect.base,
				emitter(effect.base, {
					Texture = FIRE,
					Rate = 45,
					Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.5, 0.9),
					Speed = NumberRange.new(2, 4),
					SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(25, 25),
					EmissionDirection = Enum.NormalId.Top,
					Rotation = NumberRange.new(0, 360),
					RotSpeed = NumberRange.new(-90, 90),
					Size = NumberSequence.new({ NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 1.6), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0) }),
					Transparency = NumberSequence.new({ NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.6), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.3, 0.3), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1) }),
				}),
				emitter(effect.base, {
					Texture = SPARKLE,
					Rate = 25,
					Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.8, 1.5),
					Speed = NumberRange.new(3, 7),
					SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(30, 30),
					EmissionDirection = Enum.NormalId.Top,
					Drag = 1,
					Size = NumberSequence.new({ NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.2), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0) }),
					Transparency = NumberSequence.new(0, 1),
				}))
			effect.fires = { effect.instances[#effect.instances - 1], effect.instances[#effect.instances] }
			effect.light = Instance.new("PointLight")
			effect.light.Range, effect.light.Brightness, effect.light.Shadows = 12, 2, false
			effect.light.Parent = effect.base
			collect(effect, effect.light)
		end,
		update = function(effect, character, root, now)
			local color = colorOf("self_fire_color", Color3.fromRGB(255, 120, 40))
			local hot = Color3.fromRGB(255, 225, 120)
			local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
			local feet = Hooks.feetPosition(character, root) + Vector3.new(0, 0.1, 0)
			effect.base.Position = feet
			for strandIndex, strand in ipairs(effect.strands) do
				for index, attachment in ipairs(strand.points) do
					local t = (index - 1) / (STRAND_POINTS - 1)
					-- Twisting up and inward, rising like a flame.
					local angle = now * 3.2 + strandIndex * TAU / 3 + t * 5
					local radius = 1.9 + t * 1.1 * NEG_ONE + math.sin(now * 6 + t * 8 + strandIndex) * 0.12
					attachment.Position = feet + Vector3.new(math.cos(angle) * radius, t * 6.2, math.sin(angle) * radius)
				end
			end
			for _, fire in ipairs(effect.fires) do
				fire.Color = ColorSequence.new(color, hot)
			end
			effect.light.Color = color
			effect.light.Brightness = 1.6 + math.noise(now * 5) * 0.8
			paint(effect, color, hot)
		end,
	}

	-- Star ring (ground vortex) -------------------------------------------------------------------
	local ARMS, ARM_POINTS = 4, 12
	EFFECTS.stars = {
		flag = "self_star_ring",
		build = function(effect)
			effect.arms = {}
			for arm = 1, ARMS do
				local points = {}
				for index = 1, ARM_POINTS do
					points[index] = point()
					collect(effect, points[index])
				end
				for index = 1, ARM_POINTS - 1 do
					local t = (index - 1) / (ARM_POINTS - 1)
					local object = beam(points[index], points[index + 1], 0.55 + t * 0.35 * NEG_ONE, 0.5 + t * 0.38 * NEG_ONE, 0.05 + t * 0.85)
					collect(effect, object)
					table.insert(effect.beams, object)
				end
				table.insert(effect.arms, points)
			end
			effect.rim = newRing(40, 0.22, true)
			effect.core = newRing(20, 0.35, false, 0.2)
			collectRing(effect, effect.rim)
			collectRing(effect, effect.core)
			effect.center = point()
			collect(effect, effect.center, emitter(effect.center, {
				Texture = SPARKLE,
				Rate = 35,
				Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.8, 1.6),
				Speed = NumberRange.new(2.5, 6),
				SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(20, 20),
				EmissionDirection = Enum.NormalId.Top,
				Drag = 0.8,
				Size = NumberSequence.new({ NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.35), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0) }),
				Transparency = NumberSequence.new(0, 1),
			}))
			effect.light = Instance.new("PointLight")
			effect.light.Range, effect.light.Brightness, effect.light.Shadows = 10, 2, false
			effect.light.Parent = effect.center
			collect(effect, effect.light)
		end,
		update = function(effect, character, root, now)
			local color = colorOf("self_star_color", Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 160))
			local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
			local ground = Hooks.feetPosition(character, root) + Vector3.new(0, 0.08, 0)
			local frame = CFrame.new(ground)
			local spin = now * 2.4
			for arm, points in ipairs(effect.arms) do
				for index, attachment in ipairs(points) do
					local t = (index - 1) / (ARM_POINTS - 1)
					-- Spiral arms curling in toward the core.
					local angle = spin + arm * TAU / ARMS + t * 2.2
					local radius = 0.5 + t * 4
					attachment.Position = ground + Vector3.new(math.cos(angle) * radius, math.sin(now * 3 + t * 4) * 0.05, math.sin(angle) * radius)
				end
			end
			placeRing(effect.rim, frame, 4.7 + math.sin(now * 2) * 0.15, -now * 3)
			placeRing(effect.core, frame, 0.6, 0)
			effect.center.Position = ground
			effect.light.Color = color
			paint(effect, WHITE:Lerp(color, 0.4), color)
		end,
	}

	-- Build an effect when its toggle turns on (or you respawn), remove it when it turns off.
	local live = {}
	local lastAuraUpdate = 0
	library:connection(runService.RenderStepped, function()
		local now = os.clock()
		if Hooks.lowPower() and now - lastAuraUpdate < 1 / 30 then
			return
		end
		lastAuraUpdate = now
		local character = localPlayer.Character
		local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		local alive = root ~= nil and humanoid ~= nil and humanoid.Health > 0

		for name, definition in pairs(EFFECTS) do
			local wanted = alive and flags[definition.flag] == true
			local effect = live[name]
			if effect and (not wanted or effect.character ~= character) then
				destroyEffect(effect)
				live[name] = nil
				effect = nil
			end
			if wanted then
				if not effect then
					effect = { instances = {}, beams = {}, character = character }
					definition.build(effect)
					live[name] = effect
				end
				local ok = pcall(definition.update, effect, character, root, now)
				if not ok then
					destroyEffect(effect)
					live[name] = nil
				end
			end
		end
	end)

	onUnload(function()
		for name, effect in pairs(live) do
			destroyEffect(effect)
			live[name] = nil
		end
		anchor:Destroy()
	end)
end
